    _ < f (n + 1) := hfg n
  
  replace hg : StrictMono f := strictMono_pnat_of_lt_succ λ n ↦ (h 1 (f n)).trans_lt (hfg n)
  
  replace hfg (n) : f n ≤ n := PNat.lt_add_one_iff.mp (hg.lt_iff_lt.mp (hfg n))
  
  exact funext λ n ↦ (h 1 n).antisymm' (hfg n)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {f g : ℕ+ → ℕ+} :
    (∀ n, f^[g n + 1] n + g^[f n] n + g (n + 1) = f (n + 1) + 1)
      ↔ f = id ∧ g = λ _ ↦ 1
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ h n ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [Function.iterate_id, id, fn_iterate_const n.pos 1 n]; rfl
  
  obtain rfl : f = id := by
    
    refine f_eq_id_of_map_iter_lt_map_succ (g := λ n ↦ g n + 1)
      (λ n ↦ Nat.succ_le_succ (g n).pos) (λ n ↦ ?_)
    
    apply lt_of_add_lt_add_right (a := 1)
    
    calc f^[g n + 1] n + 1
      _ ≤ f^[g n + 1] n + g^[f n] n := add_le_add_right one_le _
      _ < f^[g n + 1] n + g^[f n] n + g (n + 1) := PNat.lt_add_right _ _
      _ = f (n + 1) + 1 := h n
  
  refine ⟨rfl, funext λ n ↦ ?_⟩
  
  replace h (n : ℕ+) : g^[n] n + g (n + 1) = 1 + 1 := by
    simpa only [Function.iterate_id, id, add_assoc, add_right_inj] using h n
  
  obtain rfl | h0 : n = 1 ∨ 1 < n := eq_one_or_one_lt n
  · exact pnat_add_eq_two_imp_left_eq_one (h 1)
  
  calc g n
    _ = g (n - 1 + 1) := congrArg g (PNat.sub_add_of_lt h0).symm
    _ = 1 := pnat_add_eq_two_imp_left_eq_one ((add_comm _ _).trans (h _))

name: of_const
statement:
theorem of_const (α) : IsGoodTable (λ _ : Fin 1 × Fin 1 ↦ α) where
  injective
proof:
:= Function.injective_of_subsingleton _
  row_spec _ _ := rfl
  col_spec _ _ := rfl

name: row_col_swap
statement:
theorem row_col_swap (hT : IsGoodTable T) : IsGoodTable (T ∘ Prod.swap) where
  injective
proof:
:= hT.injective.comp Prod.swap_injective
  row_spec := hT.col_spec
  col_spec := hT.row_spec

name: num_cols_eq_one_of_num_rows_eq_one
statement:
theorem num_cols_eq_one_of_num_rows_eq_one
    {T : Fin 1 × Fin (c + 1) → ℕ} (hT : IsGoodTable T) : c = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have h : T (0, 1) = T (0, 0) := hT.col_spec 1 0
  replace h : (1 : Fin (c + 1)) = 0 := (Prod.mk_inj.mp (hT.injective h)).2
  rwa [Fin.one_eq_zero_iff, Nat.succ_inj] at h

name: sum_col_lt_num_rows_mul_max_col
statement:
theorem sum_col_lt_num_rows_mul_max_col
    {T : Fin (r + 1) × Fin (c + 1) → ℕ} (hT : IsGoodTable T) (hr : r > 0) (j) :
    ∑ i, T (i, j) < (r + 1) * sup univ (λ i ↦ T (i, j))
proof:
:=
  let f (i : Fin (r + 1)) : ℕ := T (i, j)
  calc ∑ i, T (i, j)
  _ < ∑ i : Fin (r + 1), sup univ f := by
    
    refine sum_lt_sum (λ i _ ↦ le_sup (f := f) (mem_univ i)) ?_
    
    obtain h | h : f 1 < f 0 ∨ f 0 < f 1 := by
      refine Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne λ (h : f 1 = f 0) ↦ ?_
      replace h : (1 : Fin (r + 1)) = 0 := (Prod.mk_inj.mp (hT.injective h)).1
      rw [Fin.one_eq_zero_iff, Nat.add_eq_right] at h
      exact hr.ne.symm h
    
    all_goals exact ⟨_, mem_univ _, h.trans_le (le_sup (mem_univ _))⟩
  _ = (r + 1) * sup univ f := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]

name: exists_mem_ge_card
statement:
theorem exists_mem_ge_card {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : S.Nonempty) (hS0 : 0 ∉ S) :
    ∃ s ∈ S, s ≥ #S
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  replace h : S ⊆ (range #S).erase 0 :=
    subset_erase.mpr ⟨λ s hs ↦ mem_range.mpr (h s hs), hS0⟩
  replace h : #S < #S := calc
    #S ≤ #((range #S).erase 0) := card_le_card h
    _ < #(range #S) := card_erase_lt_of_mem (by rwa [mem_range, card_pos])
    _ = #S := card_range _
  exact h.ne rfl

name: Fin_exists_map_ge_dim
statement:
theorem Fin_exists_map_ge_dim
    {f : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ} (hf : f.Injective) (hf0 : ∀ i, f i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ i, f i ≥ r + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn0⟩ : ∃ n ∈ image f univ, n ≥ #(image f univ) := by
    refine exists_mem_ge_card (image_nonempty.mpr univ_nonempty) ?_
    rw [mem_image, not_exists]
    intro i hi; exact hf0 i hi.2
  obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ : ∃ i ∈ univ, f i = n := mem_image.mp hn
  rw [card_image_of_injective _ hf, card_fin] at hn0
  exact ⟨i, hn0⟩

name: Fin_exists_map_le_div
statement:
theorem Fin_exists_map_le_div
    (hn : n ≠ 0) {f : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ} (hf : f.Injective) (hf0 : ∀ i, f i ∣ n) :
    ∃ i, (r + 1) * f i ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  let g (i) : ℕ := n / f i
  have hg : g.Injective :=
    λ i j h ↦ hf ((Nat.div_eq_iff_eq_of_dvd_dvd hn (hf0 i) (hf0 j)).mp h)
  have hg0 (i) : g i ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.div_ne_zero_iff.mpr ⟨ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hn (hf0 i),
      Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hn) (hf0 i)⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, g i ≥ r + 1 := Fin_exists_map_ge_dim hg hg0
  exact ⟨i, Nat.mul_le_of_le_div (f i) (r + 1) n hi⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    (∃ r c, ∃ T : Fin (r + 1) × Fin (c + 1) → ℕ,
        IsGoodTable T ∧ image T univ = Nat.divisors n)
      ↔ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨?_, λ h ↦ ⟨0, 0, λ _ ↦ 1, IsGoodTable.of_const 1, h.symm ▸ rfl⟩⟩
  
  rintro ⟨r, c, T, hT, hTn⟩
  wlog hrc : r ≤ c generalizing r c T
  · refine this c r (T ∘ Prod.swap) hT.row_col_swap ?_ (Nat.le_of_not_ge hrc)
    rw [← hTn, ← image_image]
    exact congrArg (image T) (image_univ_equiv (Equiv.prodComm _ _))
  
  obtain rfl | hr : r = 0 ∨ r > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r
  · obtain rfl : c = 0 := hT.num_cols_eq_one_of_num_rows_eq_one
    rw [← Nat.divisors_card_eq_one_iff, ← hTn, card_image_of_injective _ hT.injective]; rfl
  
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ← Nat.divisors_eq_empty, ← hTn, image_eq_empty, ← Ne, ← nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    exact univ_nonempty
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p, T p = n := by
    rw [← Set.mem_range, ← mem_image_univ_iff_mem_range, hTn]
    exact Nat.mem_divisors_self n hn
  
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ : ∃ j, (c + 1) * sup univ (λ i ↦ T (i, j)) ≤ n := by
    
    let f (j : Fin (c + 1)) : ℕ := sup univ (λ i ↦ T (i, j))
    change ∃ j, (c + 1) * f j ≤ n
    
    have hf (j) : ∃ i, f j = T (i, j) := by
      obtain ⟨i, -, h0⟩ : ∃ i ∈ univ, f j = T (i, j) :=
        exists_mem_eq_sup _ univ_nonempty _
      exact ⟨i, h0⟩
    
    have hf0 : f.Injective := by
      intro j₁ j₂ h
      obtain ⟨i₁, h₁⟩ : ∃ i₁, f j₁ = T (i₁, j₁) := hf j₁
      obtain ⟨i₂, h₂⟩ : ∃ i₂, f j₂ = T (i₂, j₂) := hf j₂
      rw [h₁, h₂] at h
      exact (Prod.mk_inj.mp (hT.injective h)).2
    
    have hf1 (j) : f j ∣ n := by
      obtain ⟨i, h⟩ : ∃ i, f j = T (i, j) := hf j
      exact h ▸ Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors (hTn ▸ mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_univ _))
    
    exact Fin_exists_map_le_div hn hf0 hf1
  
  have h0 : ∑ i, T (i, j₀) < ∑ i, T (i, p.2) :=
    calc ∑ i, T (i, j₀)
    _ < (r + 1) * sup univ (λ i ↦ T (i, j₀)) :=
      hT.sum_col_lt_num_rows_mul_max_col hr j₀
    _ ≤ (c + 1) * sup univ (λ i ↦ T (i, j₀)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.add_le_add_right hrc 1)
    _ ≤ n := hj₀
    _ = T p := hp.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i, T (i, p.2) :=
      single_le_sum (f := λ i ↦ T (i, p.2)) (λ _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (mem_univ _)
  
  exact absurd (hT.col_spec j₀ p.2) h0.ne

name: final_solution_part1
statement:
theorem final_solution_part1 (n) :
    ∃ a, ∃ b > 0, b ≤ Nat.sqrt n + 1 ∧ b ^ 2 * n ≤ a ^ 2 ∧ a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ n > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n
  · exact ⟨0, 1, Nat.one_pos, Nat.le_refl 1, Nat.le_refl 0, Nat.zero_le _⟩
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, s, hs, rfl⟩ : ∃ r > 0, ∃ s ≤ r + r, r ^ 2 + s = n := by
    refine ⟨Nat.sqrt n, Nat.sqrt_pos.mpr hn, n - Nat.sqrt n ^ 2,
      Nat.sub_le_of_le_add ?_, Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.sqrt_le' n)⟩
    rw [Nat.pow_two, Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.add_assoc]
    exact Nat.sqrt_le_add n
  
  clear hn; rw [Nat.sqrt_add_eq' r hs]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩ : ∃ k, s = 2 * k ∨ s = 2 * k + 1 := Nat.even_or_odd' s
  
  · replace hs : k ≤ r := by rwa [← Nat.two_mul, Nat.mul_le_mul_left_iff Nat.two_pos] at hs
    refine ⟨r ^ 2 + k, r, hr, Nat.le_succ r, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_left_comm, ← Nat.mul_assoc, add_sq]
    exact ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ _, Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hs 2) _⟩
  
  · replace hs : k ≤ r := by
      rw [Nat.succ_le_iff, ← Nat.two_mul, Nat.mul_lt_mul_left Nat.two_pos] at hs
      exact Nat.le_of_lt hs
    refine ⟨r ^ 2 + (2 * k + 1) + (r - k), r + 1, Nat.succ_pos r, Nat.le_refl _, ?_⟩
    replace hr : (r ^ 2 + (2 * k + 1) + (r - k)) ^ 2
        = (r + 1) ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 + (2 * k + 1)) + (r - k) ^ 2 := by
      rw [add_sq, Nat.add_left_inj, Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_right_comm, ← Nat.add_mul]
      refine congrArg (· * _) ?_
      rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_comm, ← Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hs,
        add_sq, Nat.mul_one, Nat.one_pow, Nat.add_assoc]
    replace hs : r - k ≤ r + 1 := Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.sub_lt_succ r k)
    exact hr ▸ ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ _, Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hs 2) _⟩

name: final_solution_part2_explicit
statement:
theorem final_solution_part2_explicit (k) :
    ¬∃ a, ∃ b > 0, b ≤ k ∧ b ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 + 1) ≤ a ^ 2 ∧ a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 + 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  rintro ⟨a, b, h, h0, h1, h2⟩
  refine Nat.not_exists_sq (m := b * k) (n := a ^ 2) ?_ ?_ ⟨a, (Nat.pow_two a).symm⟩
  
  · calc (b * k) * (b * k)
      _ = b ^ 2 * k ^ 2 := by rw [← Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_pow]
      _ < b ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 + 1) := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (Nat.pow_pos h)
      _ ≤ a ^ 2 := h1
  
  · replace h0 : b * b ≤ b * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b h0
    calc a ^ 2
      _ ≤ b ^ 2 * k ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := h2
      _ = (b * k) * (b * k) + b * b + b * b := by
        rw [Nat.pow_two, Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm]
      _ ≤ (b * k) * (b * k) + b * k + b * k :=
        Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add_left h0 _) h0
      _ < (b * k) * (b * k) + b * k + b * k + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self _
      _ = (b * k + 1) * (b * k + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_assoc]

name: final_solution_part2
statement:
theorem final_solution_part2 (N) :
    ∃ n > N, ¬∃ a, ∃ b > 0, b ≤ Nat.sqrt n ∧
      b ^ 2 * n ≤ a ^ 2 ∧ a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨(N + 1) * (N + 1) + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le N.lt_succ_self N.succ.le_mul_self)
  · rw [Nat.sqrt_add_eq N.succ (Nat.le_add_left 1 _), ← Nat.pow_two]
    exact final_solution_part2_explicit N.succ

name: zero_is_good
statement: theorem zero_is_good [Ring R] : good (0 : R → R)
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ ↦ add_zero 0

name: one_sub_is_good
statement: theorem one_sub_is_good [Ring R] : good ((1 : R) - ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y; calc 1 - (1 - x) * (1 - y) + (1 - (x + y))
    _ = 1 - (1 - x - (y - x * y)) + (1 - (x + y)) := by rw [mul_one_sub, one_sub_mul]
    _ = x + y - x * y + (1 - (x + y)) := by rw [sub_sub, sub_sub_cancel, add_sub_assoc]
    _ = 1 - x * y := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel']

name: neg
statement: theorem neg : good (-f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y; calc -f (-f x * -f y) + -f (x + y)
    _ = -(f (f x * f y) + f (x + y)) := by rw [neg_mul_neg, neg_add]
    _ = -f (x * y) := congrArg _ (hf x y)

name: map_map_add_one_mul_add_one_of_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem map_map_add_one_mul_add_one_of_mul_eq_one {x y : R} (h0 : x * y = 1) :
    f (f (x + 1) * f (y + 1)) = 0
proof:
:=
  calc f (f (x + 1) * f (y + 1))
  _ = f ((x + 1) * (y + 1)) - f ((x + 1) + (y + 1)) := eq_sub_of_add_eq (hf _ _)
  _ = f ((1 + x) + (y + 1)) - f ((x + 1) + (y + 1)) := by rw [add_one_mul, mul_add_one, h0]
  _ = 0 := by rw [add_comm 1 x, sub_self]

name: map_map_mul_map_zero_add_map
statement: theorem map_map_mul_map_zero_add_map (x) : f (f x * f 0) + f x = f 0
proof:
:=
  calc f (f x * f 0) + f x
  _ = f (f x * f 0) + f (x + 0) := by rw [add_zero]
  _ = f 0 := by rw [hf, mul_zero]

name: map_map_zero_sq
statement: theorem map_map_zero_sq : f (f 0 ^ 2) = 0
proof:
:=
  have h : (-1 : R) * -1 = 1 := by rw [neg_mul_neg, one_mul]
  calc f (f 0 ^ 2)
    _ = f (f (-1 + 1) * f (-1 + 1)) := by rw [neg_add_cancel, sq]
    _ = 0 := hf.map_map_add_one_mul_add_one_of_mul_eq_one h

name: eq_of_map_zero_of_inj
statement: theorem eq_of_map_zero_of_inj (h0 : f 0 = 1) (h1 : Injective f) : f = (1 - ·)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 (x) : f (f x) + f x = 1 := calc
    _ = f (f x * f 0) + f x := by rw [h0, mul_one]
    _ = 1 := by rw [hf.map_map_mul_map_zero_add_map, h0]
  have h3 (x) : f (f x) = x := h1 (by rw [← add_left_inj (f (f x)), h2, add_comm, h2])
  funext x; rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq' (h2 x), h3]

name: map_map_add_one_mul_map_inv_add_one
statement:
theorem map_map_add_one_mul_map_inv_add_one {x} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    f (f (x + 1) * f (x⁻¹ + 1)) = 0
proof:
:=
  hf.map_map_add_one_mul_add_one_of_mul_eq_one (mul_inv_cancel₀ hx)

name: map_eq_zero_imp_eq_one
statement: theorem map_eq_zero_imp_eq_one (hf0 : f ≠ 0) {c : D} (hc : f c = 0) : c = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  contrapose! hf0
  have hc0 : c - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero_of_ne hf0
  
  replace hf0 : f 0 = 0 := calc
    _ = f (f (c - 1 + 1) * f ((c - 1)⁻¹ + 1)) := by rw [sub_add_cancel, hc, zero_mul]
    _ = 0 := hf.map_map_add_one_mul_map_inv_add_one hc0
  
  funext x; calc f x
    _ = f 0 - f (f x * f 0) := eq_sub_of_add_eq' (hf.map_map_mul_map_zero_add_map x)
    _ = 0 := by rw [hf0, mul_zero, hf0, sub_zero]

name: map_zero_sq_eq_one
statement: theorem map_zero_sq_eq_one (hf0 : f ≠ 0) : f 0 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:=
  hf.map_eq_zero_imp_eq_one hf0 hf.map_map_zero_sq

name: map_zero_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement: theorem map_zero_eq_one_or_neg_one (hf0 : f ≠ 0) : f 0 = 1 ∨ f 0 = -1
proof:
:=
  sq_eq_one_iff.mp (hf.map_zero_sq_eq_one hf0)

name: map_one_eq_zero
statement: theorem map_one_eq_zero : f 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain hf0 | hf0 : f = 0 ∨ f ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne f 0
  · exact congrFun hf0 1
  · rw [← hf.map_zero_sq_eq_one hf0, hf.map_map_zero_sq]

name: map_eq_zero_iff_eq_one
statement: theorem map_eq_zero_iff_eq_one (hf0 : f 0 = 1) {c : D} : f c = 0 ↔ c = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ hf.map_eq_zero_imp_eq_one ?_ h, λ h ↦ h ▸ hf.map_one_eq_zero⟩
  rintro rfl; exact zero_ne_one hf0

name: map_add_one
statement: theorem map_add_one (hf0 : f 0 = 1) (x : D) : f (x + 1) + 1 = f x
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf x 1
  rwa [hf.map_one_eq_zero, mul_zero, hf0, add_comm, mul_one] at h

name: map_sub_one
statement: theorem map_sub_one (hf0 : f 0 = 1) (x : D) : f (x - 1) = f x + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.map_add_one hf0, sub_add_cancel]

name: solution_of_map_zero_eq_one_imp_injective
statement:
theorem solution_of_map_zero_eq_one_imp_injective
    [DivisionRing D] (h : ∀ f : D → D, good f → f 0 = 1 → Injective f) {f : D → D} :
    good f ↔ f = 0 ∨ f = (1 - ·) ∨ f = -(1 - ·)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨?_, λ hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [zero_is_good, one_sub_is_good, one_sub_is_good.neg]
  
  obtain hf0 | hf0 : f = 0 ∨ f ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne _ _
  · left; exact hf0
  
  right; obtain hf1 | hf1 : f 0 = 1 ∨ f 0 = -1 := hf.map_zero_eq_one_or_neg_one hf0
  · left; exact hf.eq_of_map_zero_of_inj hf1 (h f hf hf1)
  
  replace hf : good (-f) := hf.neg
  replace hf1 : (-f) 0 = 1 := (neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp hf1.symm).symm
  right; exact (neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp (hf.eq_of_map_zero_of_inj hf1 (h (-f) hf hf1)))

name: case1_injective
statement:
theorem case1_injective [DivisionRing D] (hD : (2 : D) ≠ 0)
    {f : D → D} (hf : good f) (hf0 : f 0 = 1) : Injective f
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x, f (x - 1) = f x + 1 := hf.map_sub_one hf0
  have h0 {x} : f x = 0 ↔ x = 1 := hf.map_eq_zero_iff_eq_one hf0
  
  have h1 {y} : f (2 * f y) + 1 + f y = f (-y) := calc
    _ = f (f (0 - 1) * f y) + f (y - 1) := by
      rw [h, hf0, one_add_one_eq_two, h, add_right_comm, add_assoc]
    _ = f (f (-1) * f y) + f (-1 + y) := by rw [zero_sub, neg_add_eq_sub]
    _ = f (-y) := by rw [hf, neg_one_mul]
  
  replace h {y} (hy : f (-y) = f y) : y = 0 := by
    rwa [← h1, add_eq_right, ← h, h0, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, ← hf.map_add_one hf0 y,
      mul_add_one, one_add_one_eq_two, add_eq_right, mul_eq_zero,
      or_iff_right hD, h0, add_eq_right] at hy
  
  replace h1 {x y} (hxy : f x = f y) : f (-x) = f (-y) := by rw [← h1, hxy, h1]
  
  intro a b hab
  suffices f (a + -b) = f (b + -a) by
    rw [← sub_eq_add_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_sub] at this
    exact (eq_of_sub_eq_zero (h this)).symm
  have hab0 : f (a * b) = f (b * a) := by rw [← hf, ← hf b, hab, add_comm a]
  replace hab0 : f (a * -b) = f (b * -a) := by rw [mul_neg, h1 hab0, mul_neg]
  rwa [← hf, ← hf b, hab, h1 hab, add_right_inj] at hab0

name: case2_injective
statement:
theorem case2_injective [Field F] [CharP F 2]
    {f : F → F} (hf : good f) (hf0 : f 0 = 1) : Injective f
proof:
:= by
  have hf1 (x) : f (x + 1) = f x + 1 := by rw [← CharTwo.sub_eq_add, hf.map_sub_one hf0]
  have hf2 {x} : f x = 0 ↔ x = 1 := hf.map_eq_zero_iff_eq_one hf0
  
  intro a b hab
  
  have hf3 {x} : f x = 1 ↔ x = 0 := by rw [← CharTwo.add_eq_zero, ← hf1, hf2, add_eq_right]
  obtain rfl | ha : a = 0 ∨ a ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne a 0
  · rwa [hf0, eq_comm, hf3, eq_comm] at hab
  obtain rfl | hb : b = 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne b 0
  · rwa [hf0, hf3] at hab
  /- Now suppose `a, b ≠ 0`. First we prove `f(ab⁻¹ + a + b⁻¹) = f(a + b⁻¹ + 1)`
    and similarly, `f(ba⁻¹ + b + a⁻¹) = f(b + a⁻¹ + 1)`. -/
  have h (c d : F) (hd : d ≠ 0) (h : f c = f d) :
      f (c * d⁻¹ + c + d⁻¹) = f (c + d⁻¹ + 1) := calc
    _ = f ((c + 1) * (d⁻¹ + 1)) + 1 := by
      rw [add_one_mul, mul_add_one, ← add_assoc, hf1, CharTwo.add_cancel_right]
    _ = f (f (c + 1) * f (d⁻¹ + 1)) + f (c + d⁻¹) + 1 := by
      rw [← hf, add_add_add_comm, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, add_zero]
    _ = f (f (d + 1) * f (d⁻¹ + 1)) + f (c + d⁻¹) + 1 := by rw [hf1, hf1 d, h]
    _ = f (c + d⁻¹ + 1) := by rw [hf.map_map_add_one_mul_map_inv_add_one hd, zero_add, hf1]
  have h0 : f (a * b⁻¹ + a + b⁻¹) = f (a + b⁻¹ + 1) := h a b hb hab
  replace h : f (b * a⁻¹ + b + a⁻¹) = f (b + a⁻¹ + 1) := h b a ha hab.symm
  
  replace hab :
      (a * b⁻¹ + a + b⁻¹) * (b * a⁻¹ + b + a⁻¹) = (a + b⁻¹ + 1) * (b + a⁻¹ + 1) := by
    field
  /- Combining with the previous two equalities and the original FE, we get
    `f(ab⁻¹ + a + b⁻¹ + ba⁻¹ + b + a⁻¹) = f(a + b⁻¹ + 1 + b + a⁻¹ + 1)`. -/
  replace h : f ((a * b⁻¹ + a + b⁻¹) + (b * a⁻¹ + b + a⁻¹))
      = f ((a + b⁻¹ + 1) + (b + a⁻¹ + 1)) := by
    rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq' (hf _ _), hab, h, h0, sub_eq_iff_eq_add', hf]
  
  replace h0 : (a * b⁻¹ + a + b⁻¹) + (b * a⁻¹ + b + a⁻¹)
      = (a + b + 1) * (b⁻¹ + a⁻¹ + 1) + 1 := calc
    _ = (a + b + 1) * (b⁻¹ + a⁻¹ + 1) + 1 - (2 + 2) := by field
    _ = (a + b + 1) * (b⁻¹ + a⁻¹ + 1) + 1 := by rw [CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, sub_zero]
  
  replace hab : f ((a + b + 1) * (b⁻¹ + a⁻¹ + 1)) + 1
      = f ((a + b + 1) + (b⁻¹ + a⁻¹ + 1)) := by
    rw [← hf1, ← h0, h, add_add_add_comm, add_add_add_comm a, add_add_add_comm]
  clear h h0
  
  replace hf3 {x} : f (x + 1) = 0 ↔ x = 0 := by rw [hf2, add_eq_right]
  rwa [← hf, add_right_comm, add_eq_right, ← hf1, hf3, mul_eq_zero, hf3, hf3,
    CharTwo.add_eq_zero, CharTwo.add_eq_zero, inv_inj, eq_comm (a := b), or_self] at hab

name: map_zero_eq_one_imp_injective
statement:
theorem map_zero_eq_one_imp_injective [Field F] (f : F → F) :
    good f → f 0 = 1 → Injective f
proof:
:= by
  obtain hF | hF : (2 : F) ≠ 0 ∨ (2 : F) = 0 := ne_or_eq _ _
  · exact case1_injective hF
  · have : CharP F 2 := CharTwo.of_one_ne_zero_of_two_eq_zero one_ne_zero hF
    exact case2_injective

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [Field F] {f : F → F} :
    good f ↔ f = 0 ∨ f = Sub.sub 1 ∨ f = λ x ↦ -(1 - x)
proof:
:=
  solution_of_map_zero_eq_one_imp_injective map_zero_eq_one_imp_injective

name: pow_add_mul_lt_add_pow
statement:
theorem pow_add_mul_lt_add_pow
    {a b : R} (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≥ 2) :
    a ^ n + n * a ^ (n - 1) * b < (a + b) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 2 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn
  have hab : a + b ≥ 0 := add_nonneg ha.le hb.le
  have hb0 : b ^ 2 > 0 := pow_pos hb 2
  have hab0 : 0 ≤ 2 * a + b := calc
    _ ≤ a + (a + b) := add_nonneg ha.le hab
    _ = 2 * a + b := by rw [two_mul, add_assoc]
  calc a ^ (k + 2) + (k + 2 : ℕ) * a ^ (k + 1) * b
    _ < a ^ (k + 2) + (k + 2 : ℕ) * a ^ (k + 1) * b + (k + 1 : ℕ) * a ^ k * b ^ 2 :=
      lt_add_of_pos_right _ (mul_pos (hb := hb0)
        (mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos k)) (pow_pos ha k)))
    _ = (a ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1 : ℕ) * a ^ k * b) * (a + b) := by rw [Nat.cast_succ]; ring
    _ ≤ (a + b) ^ (k + 1) * (a + b) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ha := hab)
        (pow_add_mul_le_add_pow_of_sq_nonneg ha.le hb0.le (pow_nonneg hab 2) hab0 _)
    _ = (a + b) ^ (k + 2) := (pow_succ _ _).symm

name: bernoulli_special1
statement:
theorem bernoulli_special1 {x : R} (hx : x ≥ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (n : R) ^ n * (x + 1) ≤ (x + n) ^ n
proof:
:=
  calc (n : R) ^ n * (x + 1)
  _ = (n : R) ^ n + n * n ^ (n - 1) * x := by
    rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn), mul_add_one, add_comm]
  _ ≤ (n + x) ^ n := by
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ (n : R) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have hnx : 0 ≤ n + x := add_nonneg hn0 hx
    have hnx0 : 0 ≤ 2 * n + x := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hn0) hx
    exact pow_add_mul_le_add_pow_of_sq_nonneg hn0 (pow_nonneg hx 2) (pow_nonneg hnx _) hnx0 _
  _ = (x + n) ^ n := congrArg (· ^ n) (add_comm _ _)

name: bernoulli_special2
statement:
theorem bernoulli_special2 {x : R} (hx : x > 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : n > 1) :
    (n : R) ^ n * (x + 1) < (x + n) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : n > 0 := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn
  calc (n : R) ^ n * (x + 1)
    _ = (n : R) ^ n + n * n ^ (n - 1) * x := by
      rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hn0, mul_add_one, add_comm]
    _ < (n + x) ^ n := pow_add_mul_lt_add_pow (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn0) hx hn
    _ = (x + n) ^ n := congrArg (· ^ n) (add_comm _ _)

name: main_statement
proof:
:= by
  set M : ℕ := ∏ i ∈ I, a i
  have hxa : ∏ i ∈ I, (x + a i) > 0 :=
    prod_pos λ i _ ↦ add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hx (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  
  obtain ha0 | ha0 : M = 0 ∨ M ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne _ _
  · rwa [ha0, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
  
  suffices (M * (x + 1) ^ k) ^ M < (∏ i ∈ I, (x + a i)) ^ M
    from lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ _ hxa.le this
  
  replace ha0 (i) (hi : i ∈ I) : a i ≠ 0 := prod_ne_zero_iff.mp ha0 i hi
  
  replace hk : ∑ i ∈ I, (∏ j ∈ I.erase i, a j) = k * M := by
    suffices ∀ i ∈ I, ((∏ j ∈ I.erase i, a j : ℕ) : ℚ) = (a i : ℚ)⁻¹ * M by
      rw [← Rat.natCast_inj, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_mul, ← hk, sum_mul, sum_congr rfl this]
    intro i hi; have hi0 : (a i : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (ha0 i hi)
    rw [eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hi0, ← Nat.cast_mul, mul_prod_erase _ _ hi]
  /- From Bernoulli's inequality, we have `0 < a_i^{a_i} (x + 1) ≤ (x + a_i)^{a_i}`
    for all `i ∈ I` with the inequality being strict for at least one `i ∈ I`.
    Raise all sides to the power of `∏_{j ≠ i} a_j`. -/
  have X (i) (hi : i ∈ I) (r : R) : (r ^ a i) ^ ∏ j ∈ I.erase i, a j = r ^ M := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_prod_erase _ _ hi]
  have hxa0 (i) (hi : i ∈ I) : a i ^ a i * (x + 1) > 0 :=
    have hai : a i > 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (ha0 i hi)
    mul_pos (pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hai) _) (add_pos hx one_pos)
  have hxa1 (i) (hi : i ∈ I) : a i ^ M * (x + 1) ^ ∏ j ∈ I.erase i, a j ≤ (x + a i) ^ M := by
    rw [← X i hi, ← X i hi, ← mul_pow]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (hxa0 i hi).le (bernoulli_special1 hx.le (ha0 i hi)) _
  have hxa2 : ∃ i ∈ I, a i ^ M * (x + 1) ^ ∏ j ∈ I.erase i, a j < (x + a i) ^ M := by
    rcases ha with ⟨i₀, hi₀, hai₀⟩
    refine ⟨i₀, hi₀, ?_⟩
    rw [← X i₀ hi₀, ← X i₀ hi₀, ← mul_pow]
    exact pow_lt_pow_left₀ (bernoulli_special2 hx hai₀) (hxa0 _ hi₀).le
      (prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr λ j hj ↦ (ha0 j (mem_of_mem_erase hj)))
  replace hxa0 (i) (hi : i ∈ I) : a i ^ M * (x + 1) ^ ∏ j ∈ I.erase i, a j > 0 := by
    rw [← X i hi, ← mul_pow]
    exact pow_pos (hxa0 i hi) _
  clear X
  
  calc (M * (x + 1) ^ k) ^ M
    _ = ∏ i ∈ I, (a i ^ M * (x + 1) ^ ∏ j ∈ I.erase i, a j) := by
      rw [mul_pow, Nat.cast_prod, ← pow_mul, ← hk,
        ← prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, prod_mul_distrib, prod_pow]
    _ < ∏ i ∈ I, (x + a i) ^ M := prod_lt_prod₀ hxa0 hxa1 hxa2
    _ = (∏ i ∈ I, (x + a i)) ^ M := prod_pow _ _ _

name: final_solution
proof:
:= by
  refine (main_statement ?_ hk hx).ne
  contrapose! ha; exact prod_le_one ha

name: nice.zero_left
statement: theorem nice.zero_left (B : Finset R) : nice 0 B
proof:
:=
  λ x hx _ _ ↦ ⟨x, hx, x, hx, x, hx, x, hx, (zero_mul _).trans (sub_self _).symm⟩

name: good.zero_right
statement: theorem good.zero_right [DecidableEq R] : good n (0 : R)
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ ↦ nice.zero_left _

name: nice.neg
statement: theorem nice.neg {q : R} (h : nice q B) : nice (-q) B
proof:
:= by
  
  intro x hx y hy
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, hc, d, hd, h0⟩ := h x hx y hy
  refine ⟨c, hc, d, hd, a, ha, b, hb, ?_⟩
  rw [neg_mul, h0, neg_sub]

name: good.neg
statement: theorem good.neg [DecidableEq R] {q : R} (h : good n q) : good n (-q)
proof:
:=
  λ S hS ↦ (h S hS).neg

name: good.two
statement: theorem good.two [CommRing R] [DecidableEq R] : good n (2 : R)
proof:
:= by
  
  rintro S hS x hx y hy
  obtain ⟨t, ht, u, hu, rfl⟩ : ∃ t ∈ S, ∃ u ∈ S, t - u = x := mem_sub.mp hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv, w, hw, rfl⟩ : ∃ v ∈ S, ∃ w ∈ S, v - w = y := mem_sub.mp hy
  exact ⟨t - w, sub_mem_sub ht hw, u - v, sub_mem_sub hu hv,
    t - v, sub_mem_sub ht hv, u - w, sub_mem_sub hu hw, by ring⟩

name: nice.exists_sq_add_sq_sub_sq_add_sq
statement:
theorem nice.exists_sq_add_sq_sub_sq_add_sq {q : R} (h : nice q B) (hB : 1 ∈ B) :
    ∃ a ∈ B, ∃ b ∈ B, ∃ c ∈ B, ∃ d ∈ B, q = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 - (c ^ 2 + d ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_one] using h 1 hB 1 hB

name: nice.exists_eq_RingHom_apply
statement:
theorem nice.exists_eq_RingHom_apply
    {φ : R →+* S} {q' : S} {B : Finset R} (h : nice q' (B.image φ)) (hB : 1 ∈ B) :
    ∃ q : R, q' = φ q
proof:
:= by
  
  set B' : Finset S := B.image φ
  obtain ⟨a', ha, b', hb, c', hc, d', hd, rfl⟩ :
      ∃ a' ∈ B', ∃ b' ∈ B', ∃ c' ∈ B', ∃ d' ∈ B', q' = a' ^ 2 + b' ^ 2 - (c' ^ 2 + d' ^ 2) :=
    h.exists_sq_add_sq_sub_sq_add_sq (mem_image.mpr ⟨1, hB, φ.map_one⟩)
  obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ : ∃ a ∈ B, φ a = a' := mem_image.mp ha
  obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ : ∃ b ∈ B, φ b = b' := mem_image.mp hb
  obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ : ∃ c ∈ B, φ c = c' := mem_image.mp hc
  obtain ⟨d, -, rfl⟩ : ∃ d ∈ B, φ d = d' := mem_image.mp hd
  
  refine ⟨a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 - (c ^ 2 + d ^ 2), ?_⟩
  simp_rw [φ.map_sub, φ.map_add, φ.map_pow]

name: Finset_image_sub_RingHom
statement:
lemma Finset_image_sub_RingHom [DecidableEq R] (φ : R →+* S) (A : Finset R) :
    (A - A).image φ = A.image φ - A.image φ
proof:
:= by
  refine ext λ a ↦ ?_
  calc a ∈ (A - A).image φ
    _ ↔ ∃ a', (∃ b ∈ A, ∃ c ∈ A, b - c = a') ∧ φ a' = a := by simp_rw [mem_image, mem_sub]
    _ ↔ ∃ b c, (b ∈ A ∧ c ∈ A ∧ True) ∧ φ (b - c) = a := by simp only [↓existsAndEq]
    _ ↔ ∃ b ∈ A, ∃ c ∈ A, φ (b - c) = a := by simp_rw [and_true, and_assoc, exists_and_left]
    _ ↔ ∃ b ∈ A, ∃ c ∈ A, φ b - φ c = a := by simp_rw [φ.map_sub]
    _ ↔ a ∈ A.image φ - A.image φ := by simp_rw [mem_sub, exists_mem_image]

name: good.exists_eq_RingHom_apply
statement:
theorem good.exists_eq_RingHom_apply [Infinite R] [DecidableEq R]
    {φ : R →+* S} (hφ : Injective φ) {q' : S} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≥ 2) (h : good n q') :
    ∃ q : R, q' = φ q
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ : ∃ A : Finset R, {0, 1} ⊆ A ∧ #A = n :=
    Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq _ _ (card_le_two.trans hn)
  replace h : nice q' ((A - A).image φ) :=
    Finset_image_sub_RingHom φ A ▸ h (A.image φ) (A.card_image_of_injective hφ)
  have h0 : 1 ∈ A - A :=
    sub_subset_sub hA hA <| mem_sub.mpr
      ⟨1, mem_insert_of_mem (mem_singleton_self _), 0, mem_insert_self _ _, sub_zero _⟩
  exact h.exists_eq_RingHom_apply h0

name: nice.RingHom_apply
statement:
theorem nice.RingHom_apply {φ : R →+* S} {q : R} {B : Finset R} (h : nice q B) :
    nice (φ q) (B.image φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine forall_mem_image.mpr λ x hx ↦ forall_mem_image.mpr λ y hy ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, hc, d, hd, h0⟩ :
      ∃ a ∈ B, ∃ b ∈ B, ∃ c ∈ B, ∃ d ∈ B, q * (x * y) = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 - (c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) :=
    h x hx y hy
  refine ⟨φ a, mem_image_of_mem _ ha, φ b, mem_image_of_mem _ hb,
    φ c, mem_image_of_mem _ hc, φ d, mem_image_of_mem _ hd, ?_⟩
  simp_rw [← φ.map_mul, ← φ.map_pow, ← φ.map_add, ← φ.map_sub, h0]

name: nice.RingHom_apply_iff
statement:
theorem nice.RingHom_apply_iff {φ : R →+* S} (hφ : Injective φ) {q : R} {B : Finset R} :
    nice (φ q) (B.image φ) ↔ nice q B
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [nice, forall_mem_image, exists_mem_image]
  iterate 2 refine forall_congr' λ _ ↦ imp_congr_right λ _ ↦ ?_
  iterate 4 refine exists_congr λ _ ↦ and_congr_right λ _ ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [← φ.map_mul, ← φ.map_pow, ← φ.map_add]
  rw [← φ.map_sub, hφ.eq_iff]

name: good.of_RingHom_apply
statement:
theorem good.of_RingHom_apply [DecidableEq R]
    {φ : R →+* S} (hφ : Injective φ) {q n} (h : good n (φ q)) : good n q
proof:
:= by
  rintro A rfl
  replace h : nice (φ q) (A.image φ - A.image φ) := h _ (card_image_of_injective _ hφ)
  rwa [← Finset_image_sub_RingHom, nice.RingHom_apply_iff hφ] at h

name: good.exists_eq_good_RingHom_apply
statement:
theorem good.exists_eq_good_RingHom_apply [Infinite R] [DecidableEq R]
    {φ : R →+* S} (hφ : Injective φ) {q' : S} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≥ 2) (h : good n q') :
    ∃ q : R, good n q ∧ q' = φ q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q : R, q' = φ q := h.exists_eq_RingHom_apply hφ hn
  exact ⟨q, h.of_RingHom_apply hφ, rfl⟩

name: good.exists_intCast_of_CharZero
statement:
theorem good.exists_intCast_of_CharZero [CharZero R] [DecidableEq R]
    {q : R} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≥ 2) (h : good n q) : ∃ N : ℤ, good n N ∧ q = N
proof:
:=
  h.exists_eq_good_RingHom_apply (φ := Int.castRingHom R) Int.cast_injective hn

name: nice.Int_le_two
statement: theorem nice.Int_le_two {B : Finset ℤ} (hB : ∃ N ∈ B, N ≠ 0) (h : nice q B) : q ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀0⟩ : ∃ x₀ ∈ B, ∀ x ∈ B, x.natAbs ≤ x₀.natAbs := by
    have hB0 : B.Nonempty := hB.imp λ _ ↦ And.left
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀0⟩ : ∃ x₀ ∈ B, B.sup' hB0 Int.natAbs = x₀.natAbs :=
      exists_mem_eq_sup' hB0 Int.natAbs
    exact ⟨x₀, hx₀, λ x hx ↦ (le_sup' Int.natAbs hx).trans_eq hx₀0⟩
  
  replace hB : 0 < x₀ ^ 2 := by
    rcases hB with ⟨N, hNB, hN⟩
    rw [← Int.natAbs_pow_two, ← Int.natCast_pow, Int.natCast_pos]
    exact Nat.pow_pos ((Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hN).trans_le (hx₀0 _ hNB))
  
  suffices q * x₀ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * x₀ ^ 2 from Int.le_of_mul_le_mul_right this hB
  
  replace hx₀0 (x) (hx : x ∈ B) : x ^ 2 ≤ x₀ ^ 2 := calc
    _ = ((x.natAbs ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) := (Int.natAbs_pow_two _).symm
    _ ≤ (x₀.natAbs ^ 2 : ℕ) := Int.ofNat_le.mpr (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (hx₀0 x hx) 2)
    _ = x₀ ^ 2 := Int.natAbs_pow_two x₀
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, c, -, d, -, h0⟩ :
      ∃ a ∈ B, ∃ b ∈ B, ∃ c ∈ B, ∃ d ∈ B, q * (x₀ * x₀) = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 - (c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) :=
    h _ hx₀ _ hx₀
  
  calc q * x₀ ^ 2
    _ = q * (x₀ * x₀) := congrArg (q * ·) (sq _)
    _ = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 - (c ^ 2 + d ^ 2) := h0
    _ ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 :=
      Int.sub_le_self _ (Int.add_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sq_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ x₀ ^ 2 + x₀ ^ 2 := Int.add_le_add (hx₀0 a ha) (hx₀0 b hb)
    _ = 2 * x₀ ^ 2 := (Int.two_mul _).symm

name: good.Int_le_two
statement: theorem good.Int_le_two (hn : n ≥ 2) {q : ℤ} (h : good n q) : q ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  let A : Finset ℤ := (range n).image Nat.cast
  replace h : nice q (A - A) :=
    h _ ((card_image_of_injective _ λ _ _ ↦ Int.natCast_inj.mp).trans (card_range n))
  have h0 (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) : (i : ℤ) ∈ A := mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_range.mpr hi)
  replace h0 : ∃ N ∈ A - A, N ≠ 0 :=
    ⟨1, mem_sub.mpr ⟨1, h0 1 hn, 0, h0 0 (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn), rfl⟩, Int.one_ne_zero⟩
  refine h.Int_le_two h0

name: not_nice_one_013457
statement: theorem not_nice_one_013457 : ¬nice (1 : ZMod 8) ({0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 7} : Finset (ZMod 8))
proof:
:= by
  
  set B : Finset (ZMod 8) := {0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 7}
  let C : Finset (ZMod 8) := B.image (λ x ↦ x ^ 2)
  
  intro h; replace h : ∃ a ∈ C, ∃ b ∈ C, ∃ c ∈ C, ∃ d ∈ C, 4 = a + b - (c + d) := by
    simpa only [C, exists_mem_image, one_mul] using h 1 (by decide) 4 (by decide)
  
  have hC : C = {0, 1} := by decide
  clear_value C; subst hC
  
  revert h; decide

name: exists_Int_card_eq_ZMod8_image_eq
statement:
theorem exists_Int_card_eq_ZMod8_image_eq (hn : n ≥ 3) :
    ∃ A : Finset ℤ, #A = n ∧ A.image (Int.castRingHom (ZMod 8)) = {0, 1, 4}
proof:
:= by
  
  let f (i : ℕ) : ℤ := 8 * i
  set φ : ℤ →+* ZMod 8 := Int.castRingHom (ZMod 8)
  refine ⟨(range (n - 2)).image f ∪ {1, 4}, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · have h : (8 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by decide
    have hf : f.Injective := λ _ _ h0 ↦ Int.natCast_inj.mp (Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left h h0)
    have hf0 (A : Finset ℕ) : Disjoint (A.image f) {1, 4} := by
      have hf0 : ∀ x ∈ A.image f, 8 ∣ x := forall_mem_image.mpr λ i hi ↦ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      rw [disjoint_insert_right, disjoint_singleton_right]
      refine ⟨λ h0 ↦ ?_, λ h0 ↦ ?_⟩
      all_goals refine absurd (hf0 _ h0) ?_; decide
    calc #((range (n - 2)).image f ∪ {1, 4})
      _ = #((range (n - 2)).image f) + #{1, 4} := card_union_of_disjoint (hf0 _)
      _ = #(range (n - 2)) + 2 := congrArg₂ _ (card_image_of_injective _ hf) rfl
      _ = n := by rw [card_range, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn)]
  
  · have h : φ ∘ f = (λ _ ↦ 0) := funext λ i ↦ (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ 8).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
    replace hn : (range (n - 2)).Nonempty := ⟨0, mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_sub_of_lt hn)⟩
    rw [image_union, image_image, h, image_const hn 0]; rfl

name: not_good_Int_one
statement: theorem not_good_Int_one (hn : n ≥ 3) : ¬good n (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  
  intro h
  
  let φ : ℤ →+* ZMod 8 := Int.castRingHom (ZMod 8)
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hA0⟩ : ∃ A, #A = n ∧ A.image φ = {0, 1, 4} :=
    exists_Int_card_eq_ZMod8_image_eq hn
  
  replace h : nice 1 ((A - A).image φ) := (h _ hA).RingHom_apply
  
  replace hA0 : (A - A).image φ = {0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 7} := by
    rw [Finset_image_sub_RingHom, hA0]; decide
  exact not_nice_one_013457 (hA0 ▸ h)

name: good.Int_eq_zero_or_two_or_neg_two
statement:
theorem good.Int_eq_zero_or_two_or_neg_two (hn : n ≥ 3) {q : ℤ} (h : good n q) :
    q = 0 ∨ q = 2 ∨ q = -2
proof:
:= by
  suffices q = 0 ∨ q.natAbs = 2 from this.imp_right Int.natAbs_eq_natAbs_iff.mp
  
  wlog hq : 0 ≤ q generalizing q
  · exact (this h.neg (Int.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos (Int.le_of_not_le hq))).imp
      Int.neg_eq_zero.mp (Int.natAbs_neg q).symm.trans
  
  refine hq.eq_or_lt.imp Eq.symm λ hq ↦ ?_
  
  obtain rfl | hq : q = 1 ∨ q ≥ 2 := by
    rwa [← Int.add_one_le_iff, Int.zero_add, le_iff_eq_or_lt', ← Int.add_one_le_iff] at hq
  
  exacts [absurd h (not_good_Int_one hn),
    congrArg Int.natAbs (Int.le_antisymm (h.Int_le_two (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn)) hq)]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [CommRing R] [DecidableEq R] [CharZero R] {q : R} (hn : n ≥ 3) :
    good n q ↔ q = 0 ∨ q = 2 ∨ q = -2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · obtain ⟨N, hnN, rfl⟩ : ∃ N : ℤ, good n N ∧ q = N :=
      h.exists_intCast_of_CharZero (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn)
    refine (hnN.Int_eq_zero_or_two_or_neg_two hn).imp ?_ (Or.imp ?_ ?_)
    all_goals rintro rfl; simp
  
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [good.zero_right, good.two, good.two.neg]

name: nice.good_two_mul_three_pow_right

name: good_iff_nice
statement:
theorem good_iff_nice :
    good m n ↔ ∃ p q, nice p q ∧ n = p + q ∧ (m = 3 ^ p ∨ m = 2 * 3 ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨p, q, h, rfl, rfl | rfl⟩
    exacts [h.good_three_pow_left, h.good_two_mul_three_pow_right]
  
  have h0 (n : ℕ) : 0 < (3 : ℤ) ^ n := Int.pow_pos three_pos
  have h1 (n : ℕ) : 0 < (2 : ℤ) * 3 ^ n := Int.mul_pos two_pos (h0 n)
  have hm : 0 < m * (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) := calc
    _ < m ^ 2 + 2 * 3 ^ n := Int.add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (Int.sq_nonneg m) (h1 n)
    _ = m * (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) := h
  replace hm : 0 ≤ m := by
    have h0 : (1 : ℤ) < 2 ^ (n + 1) := one_lt_pow₀ one_lt_two (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
    exact Int.le_of_lt (Int.pos_of_mul_pos_left hm (sub_pos_of_lt h0))
  lift m to ℕ using hm
  
  have h2 {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ∣ 3 ^ n) : ∃ k ≤ n, m = 3 ^ k :=
    (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_three).mp hmn
  have hmn : (m : ℤ) ∣ 2 * 3 ^ n := by
    refine ⟨2 ^ (n + 1) - 1 - m, ?_⟩
    rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq' h, sq, ← mul_sub]
  replace hmn : m ∣ 2 * 3 ^ n := by
    rwa [← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, Int.natCast_mul, Int.natCast_pow]
  
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ | hm : 2 ∣ m ∨ ¬2 ∣ m := dec_em _
  · replace hmn : ∃ q ≤ n, k = 3 ^ q := h2 (Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left Nat.two_pos hmn)
    rcases hmn with ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    replace hq : n = n - q + q := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hq).symm
    refine ⟨n - q, q, ?_, hq, Or.inr rfl⟩
    replace h :
        (2 : ℤ) * 3 ^ q * (3 ^ (n - q) + 2 * 3 ^ q)
          = 2 * 3 ^ q * (2 ^ (n - q + q + 1) - 1) :=
      calc (2 : ℤ) * 3 ^ q * (3 ^ (n - q) + 2 * 3 ^ q)
      _ = (2 * 3 ^ q) ^ 2 + 2 * 3 ^ n := by
        rw [Int.mul_add, sq, Int.mul_assoc, ← Int.pow_add, Nat.add_comm, ← hq, Int.add_comm]
      _ = 2 * 3 ^ q * (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) := h
      _ = 2 * 3 ^ q * (2 ^ (n - q + q + 1) - 1) := by rw [← hq]
    exact Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (h := h) (h1 q).ne.symm
  
  · replace hmn : ∃ p ≤ n, m = 3 ^ p :=
      h2 (((Nat.prime_two.coprime_iff_not_dvd).mpr hm).symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hmn)
    rcases hmn with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    replace hp : n = p + (n - p) := (Nat.add_sub_of_le hp).symm
    refine ⟨p, n - p, ?_, hp, Or.inl rfl⟩
    replace h :
        (3 : ℤ) ^ p * (3 ^ p + 2 * 3 ^ (n - p)) = 3 ^ p * (2 ^ (p + (n - p) + 1) - 1) :=
      calc (3 : ℤ) ^ p * (3 ^ p + 2 * 3 ^ (n - p))
      _ = (3 ^ p) ^ 2 + 2 * 3 ^ n := by
        rw [Int.mul_add, ← sq, Int.mul_left_comm, ← Int.pow_add, ← hp]
      _ = 3 ^ p * (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) := h
      _ = 3 ^ p * (2 ^ (p + (n - p) + 1) - 1) := by rw [← hp]
    exact Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (h0 p).ne.symm h

name: nice.add_le_three_mul_min_add_one
statement: theorem nice.add_le_three_mul_min_add_one (h : nice p q) : p + q ≤ 3 * min p q + 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have X (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (3 : ℤ) ^ n := Int.pow_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg 3)
  have X0 : (0 : ℤ) < 8 := by decide
  
  have h0 : (3 : ℤ) ^ max p q ≤ 3 ^ p + 2 * 3 ^ q := by
    obtain h0 | h0 : max p q = p ∨ max p q = q := Std.MaxEqOr.max_eq_or p q
    · rw [h0, le_add_iff_nonneg_right]
      exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg 2) (X _)
    · rw [h0, Int.two_mul, ← Int.add_assoc, le_add_iff_nonneg_left]
      exact Int.add_nonneg (X _) (X _)
  
  replace h0 : (3 : ℤ) ^ max p q < 2 ^ (p + q + 1) :=
    calc (3 : ℤ) ^ max p q
    _ ≤ 3 ^ p + 2 * 3 ^ q := h0
    _ = 2 ^ (p + q + 1) - 1 := h
    _ < 2 ^ (p + q + 1) := Int.sub_one_lt_of_le (Int.le_refl _)
  
  replace h0 : (8 : ℤ) ^ (3 * max p q) < (8 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (p + q) + 2) :=
    calc (8 : ℤ) ^ (3 * max p q)
    _ ≤ (3 ^ 2 : ℤ) ^ (3 * max p q) := pow_le_pow_left₀ X0.le (by decide) _
    _ = ((3 : ℤ) ^ max p q) ^ 6 := by
      rw [← Int.pow_mul, ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm, Int.pow_mul]
    _ < (2 ^ (p + q + 1)) ^ 6 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ h0 (X _) (by decide)
    _ = (2 ^ 3 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (p + q + 1)) := by
      rw [← Int.pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_assoc 3 2, Int.pow_mul]
  
  replace X0 : (1 : ℤ) < 8 := by decide
  replace h0 : max p q ≤ 2 * min p q + 1 := by
    rwa [pow_lt_pow_iff_right₀ X0, ← max_add_min p q, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_assoc,
      Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at h0
  rwa [← max_add_min p q, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_le_add_iff_right]

name: nice.min_pos
statement: theorem nice.min_pos (h : nice p q) : min p q > 0
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero λ h0 ↦ ?_
  replace h0 : p + q ≤ 1 := calc
    _ ≤ 3 * min p q + 1 := h.add_le_three_mul_min_add_one
    _ = 1 := congrArg (3 * · + 1) h0
  
  have h1 : q ∈ Finset.range 2 := Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mpr (Nat.le_of_add_left_le h0)
  replace h0 : p ∈ Finset.range (2 - q) := by
    rwa [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_sub_iff_add_lt, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
  revert h; revert p; revert q
  unfold nice; decide

name: two_dvd_of_three_dvd_pow_sub_one
statement: theorem two_dvd_of_three_dvd_pow_sub_one (h : (3 : ℤ) ∣ 2 ^ n - 1) : 2 ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  refine Decidable.by_contra λ h0 ↦ ?_
  replace h0 : n % 2 = 1 := Nat.two_dvd_ne_zero.mp h0
  replace h : 2 ≡ 1 [MOD 3] := calc
    _ = 1 ^ (n / 2) * 2 := congrArg (· * 2) (Nat.one_pow _).symm
    _ ≡ 4 ^ (n / 2) * 2 [MOD 3] :=
      have h1 : 1 ≡ 4 [MOD 3] := rfl
      (h1.pow _).mul_right 2
    _ = 2 ^ (2 * (n / 2) + n % 2) := by rw [h0, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.pow_mul]
    _ = 2 ^ n := congrArg (2 ^ ·) (Nat.div_add_mod n 2)
    _ ≡ 1 [MOD 3] := (Nat.modEq_of_dvd h).symm
  revert h; decide

name: emultiplicity_three_four_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_three_four_pow_sub_one (r : ℕ) :
    emultiplicity (3 : ℤ) (4 ^ r - 1) = emultiplicity 3 r + 1
proof:
:=
  calc emultiplicity (3 : ℤ) (4 ^ r - 1)
  _ = emultiplicity (3 : ℤ) (4 ^ r - 1 ^ r) := by rw [Int.one_pow]
  _ = emultiplicity (3 : ℤ) (4 - 1) + emultiplicity 3 r :=
    Int.emultiplicity_pow_sub_pow Nat.prime_three ⟨1, rfl⟩ (dvd_refl 3) (by decide) _
  _ = 1 + emultiplicity 3 r :=
    congrArg (· + _) (FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_self ⟨2, by decide⟩)
  _ = emultiplicity 3 r + 1 := add_comm _ _

name: multiplicity_three_four_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem multiplicity_three_four_pow_sub_one {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    multiplicity (3 : ℤ) (4 ^ r - 1) = multiplicity 3 r + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : 3 ≠ 1 := by decide
  have hr0 : (4 : ℤ) ^ r - 1 > 0 := sub_pos_of_lt (one_lt_pow₀ (by decide) hr)
  replace hr0 : FiniteMultiplicity (3 : ℤ) (4 ^ r - 1) :=
    Int.finiteMultiplicity_iff.mpr ⟨h, hr0.ne.symm⟩
  replace hr : FiniteMultiplicity 3 r := by
    refine Nat.finiteMultiplicity_iff.mpr ⟨h, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr⟩
  rw [← ENat.natCast_inj, ← hr0.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, Nat.cast_succ,
    ← hr.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, emultiplicity_three_four_pow_sub_one]

name: nice.add_succ_even_and_min_le_multiplicity
statement:
theorem nice.add_succ_even_and_min_le_multiplicity (h : nice p q) :
    ∃ r, p + q + 1 = 2 * r ∧ min p q ≤ multiplicity 3 r + 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 : (3 : ℤ) ^ min p q ∣ 3 ^ p := pow_dvd_pow _ (Nat.min_le_left _ _)
  have h1 : (3 : ℤ) ^ min p q ∣ 2 * 3 ^ q :=
    Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (pow_dvd_pow _ (Nat.min_le_right _ _))
  replace h1 : (3 : ℤ) ^ min p q ∣ 2 ^ (p + q + 1) - 1 := calc
    _ ∣ 3 ^ p + 2 * 3 ^ q := Int.dvd_add h0 h1
    _ = 2 ^ (p + q + 1) - 1 := h
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : 2 ∣ p + q + 1 :=
    two_dvd_of_three_dvd_pow_sub_one ((pow_dvd_pow _ h.min_pos).trans h1)
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  
  replace h0 : 0 < (2 : ℤ) ^ (p + q + 1) - 1 :=
    sub_pos_of_lt (one_lt_pow₀ one_lt_two (Nat.succ_ne_zero _))
  replace h0 : FiniteMultiplicity (3 : ℤ) (2 ^ (p + q + 1) - 1) :=
    Int.finiteMultiplicity_iff.mpr ⟨by decide, h0.ne.symm⟩
  replace h1 : min p q ≤ multiplicity (3 : ℤ) (2 ^ (p + q + 1) - 1) :=
    h0.le_multiplicity_of_pow_dvd h1
  replace h0 : r ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact Nat.succ_ne_zero _ hr
  calc min p q
    _ ≤ multiplicity (3 : ℤ) (2 ^ (p + q + 1) - 1) := h1
    _ = multiplicity (3 : ℤ) (4 ^ r - 1) := by rw [hr, Int.pow_mul]; rfl
    _ = multiplicity 3 r + 1 := multiplicity_three_four_pow_sub_one h0

name: nice_iff
statement: theorem nice_iff : nice p q ↔ p = 2 ∧ (q = 1 ∨ q = 3)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ hpq ↦ ?_, λ hpq ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases hpq with ⟨rfl, rfl | rfl⟩
    all_goals rfl
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ : ∃ r, p + q + 1 = 2 * r ∧ min p q ≤ multiplicity 3 r + 1 :=
    hpq.add_succ_even_and_min_le_multiplicity
  
  replace h : 2 * r ≤ 3 * multiplicity 3 r + 5 := calc
    _ = p + q + 1 := hr.symm
    _ ≤ 3 * min p q + 2 := Nat.add_le_add_right hpq.add_le_three_mul_min_add_one 1
    _ ≤ 3 * (multiplicity 3 r + 1) + 2 := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h) 2
  
  replace h : r ≤ 3 := by
    
    contrapose! h
    obtain h0 | h0 : ¬3 ∣ r ∨ 3 ∣ r := dec_em' _
    
    · calc 3 * multiplicity 3 r + 5
      _ = 5 := by rw [multiplicity_eq_zero.mpr h0]
      _ < 2 * r := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h.le
    
    · have h1 : r ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_zero_of_lt h
      replace h : 2 * 3 ≤ r :=
        Nat.mul_le_of_le_div 3 2 r ((Nat.lt_div_iff_mul_lt' h0 1).mpr h)
      replace h0 : multiplicity 3 r ≤ Nat.log 3 r := calc
        _ = padicValNat 3 r := (padicValNat_def h1).symm
        _ ≤ Nat.log 3 r := padicValNat_le_nat_log r
      replace h0 : 3 * multiplicity 3 r ≤ r := calc
        _ ≤ 3 * Nat.log 3 r := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 h0
        _ ≤ 3 ^ Nat.log 3 r := Nat.mul_le_pow Nat.add_one_add_one_ne_one _
        _ ≤ r := Nat.pow_log_le_self 3 h1
      calc 3 * multiplicity 3 r + 5
      _ ≤ r + 5 := Nat.add_le_add_right h0 5
      _ < r + r := Nat.add_lt_add_left h r
      _ = 2 * r := (Nat.two_mul r).symm
  
  replace h : r ∈ Finset.range 4 := Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mpr h
  have hq : q < 2 * r := calc
    _ ≤ p + q := Nat.le_add_left q p
    _ < p + q + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self _
    _ = 2 * r := hr
  replace hq : q ∈ Finset.range (2 * r) := Finset.mem_range.mpr hq
  obtain rfl : p = 2 * r - 1 - q := Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq (Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq hr)
  clear hr; revert q; revert r
  unfold nice; decide

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :

name: const_is_good_of_floor_eq_one

name: map_zero_eq_zero_or_floor_eq_one
statement:
theorem map_zero_eq_zero_or_floor_eq_one [IsOrderedAddMonoid S] {f : R → S} (hf : good f) :
    f 0 = 0 ∨ ⌊f 0⌋ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : f (⌊(0 : R)⌋ • 0) = ⌊f 0⌋ • f 0 := hf 0 0
  rwa [zsmul_zero, eq_comm, ← add_neg_eq_zero,
    ← sub_one_zsmul, zsmul_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero] at h

name: eq_const_of_floor_map_zero_eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_const_of_floor_map_zero_eq_one {f : R → S} (hf : good f) (hf0 : ⌊f 0⌋ = 1) :
    ∃ C, ⌊C⌋ = 1 ∧ f = λ _ ↦ C
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨f 0, hf0, funext λ x ↦ ?_⟩
  have h : f (⌊x⌋ • 0) = ⌊f 0⌋ • f x := hf x 0
  rwa [zsmul_zero, hf0, one_zsmul, eq_comm] at h

name: eq_zero_of_map_zero_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_map_zero_eq_zero
    [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (hR : ∃ α : R, 0 < α ∧ α < 1) [IsStrictOrderedRing S]
    {f : R → S} (hf : good f) (hf0 : f 0 = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases hR with ⟨α, hα0, hα1⟩
  have hα : ⌊α⌋ = 0 := by
    refine Int.le_antisymm ?_ (Int.floor_nonneg.mpr hα0.le)
    rwa [← Int.lt_add_one_iff, Int.floor_lt, Int.zero_add, Int.cast_one]
  replace hα0 : ⌊-α⌋ = -1 := by
    refine Int.le_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · rwa [← Int.lt_add_one_iff, neg_add_cancel, Int.floor_lt, Int.cast_zero, neg_lt_zero]
    · rw [Int.le_floor, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, neg_le_neg_iff]; exact hα1.le
  clear hα1
  
  replace h : ⌊f α⌋ = 0 := by
    have h : f (⌊α⌋ • α) = ⌊f α⌋ • f α := hf α α
    rw [hα, zero_zsmul, hf0, eq_comm, zsmul_eq_zero_iff] at h
    exact h.elim (λ h0 ↦ (congrArg Int.floor h0).trans Int.floor_zero) id
  
  replace h : f (-α) = 0 := by
    have h0 : f (⌊(-1 : R)⌋ • α) = ⌊f α⌋ • f (-1) := hf (-1) α
    rwa [h, zero_zsmul, Int.floor_neg, Int.ceil_one, neg_one_zsmul] at h0
  
  refine funext λ y ↦ ?_
  have h0 : f (⌊-α⌋ • -y) = ⌊f (-y)⌋ • f (-α) := hf (-α) (-y)
  rwa [h, zsmul_zero, hα0, neg_one_zsmul, neg_neg] at h0

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (hR : ∃ α : R, 0 < α ∧ α < 1)
    [IsStrictOrderedRing S] {f : R → S} :
    good f ↔ f = 0 ∨ (∃ C : S, ⌊C⌋ = 1 ∧ f = λ _ ↦ C)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hf ↦ ?_, λ hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact hf.map_zero_eq_zero_or_floor_eq_one.imp
      (hf.eq_zero_of_map_zero_eq_zero hR) hf.eq_const_of_floor_map_zero_eq_one
  · rcases hf with rfl | ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩
    exacts [zero_is_good, const_is_good_of_floor_eq_one hC]

name: good_iff_ZMod
statement: theorem good_iff_ZMod : good n P ↔ (P.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod n))).eval.Injective
proof:
:= by
  set φ : ℤ →+* ZMod n := Int.castRingHom (ZMod n)
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := ZMod.ringHom_surjective φ
  have hφ0 {k m : ℤ} : φ k = φ m ↔ k ≡ m [ZMOD n] := ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff k m n
  rw [good, Function.Injective, hφ.forall₂]
  conv_rhs => ext k m; rw [eval_map_apply, eval_map_apply, hφ0, hφ0]

name: nice_iff_ZMod
statement: theorem nice_iff_ZMod : nice n P ↔ (P.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod n))).eval.Surjective
proof:
:= by
  set φ : ℤ →+* ZMod n := Int.castRingHom (ZMod n)
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := ZMod.ringHom_surjective φ
  have hφ0 {k m : ℤ} : φ k = φ m ↔ k ≡ m [ZMOD n] := ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff k m n
  rw [nice, Function.Surjective, hφ.forall]
  simp_rw [hφ.exists, eval_map_apply, hφ0]

name: good_iff_nice
statement: theorem good_iff_nice [NeZero n] : good n P ↔ nice n P
proof:
:= by
  rw [good_iff_ZMod, nice_iff_ZMod, Finite.injective_iff_surjective]

name: good_one_left
statement: theorem good_one_left (P) : good 1 P
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ _ ↦ Int.modEq_one

name: nice.of_dvd
statement: theorem nice.of_dvd (hm : nice m P) (hnm : n ∣ m) : nice n P
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, P.eval x ≡ y [ZMOD m] := hm y
  exact ⟨x, hx.of_dvd (Int.ofNat_dvd.mpr hnm)⟩

name: good.of_dvd
statement: theorem good.of_dvd [NeZero m] (hm : good m P) (hnm : n ∣ m) : good n P
proof:
:=
  have : NeZero n := ⟨ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero (NeZero.ne m) hnm⟩
  good_iff_nice.mpr ((good_iff_nice.mp hm).of_dvd hnm)

name: eval_map_RingHom_prod
statement:
theorem eval_map_RingHom_prod [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [Semiring T]
    (φ : R →+* S) (ρ : R →+* T) (P : R[X]) (s : S) (t : T) :
    (P.map (φ.prod ρ)).eval (s, t) = ((P.map φ).eval s, (P.map ρ).eval t)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
      iterate 3 rw [Polynomial.map_add, eval_add]
      rw [hp, hq]; rfl
  | monomial n r =>
      iterate 3 rw [map_monomial, eval_monomial]
      rw [RingHom.prod_apply, Prod.pow_mk, Prod.mk_mul_mk]

name: nice_iff_of_coprime
statement:
theorem nice_iff_of_coprime (h : Nat.Coprime k m) :
    nice (k * m) P ↔ nice k P ∧ nice m P
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨λ hP ↦ ⟨hP.of_dvd (Nat.dvd_mul_right k m), hP.of_dvd (Nat.dvd_mul_left m k)⟩,
    λ hP ↦ nice_iff_ZMod.mpr λ y ↦ ?_⟩
  
  let φ : ZMod (k * m) ≃+* ZMod k × ZMod m := ZMod.chineseRemainder h
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, (P.map (Int.castRingHom _)).eval a = (φ y).1 :=
    nice_iff_ZMod.mp hP.1 _
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, (P.map (Int.castRingHom _)).eval b = (φ y).2 :=
    nice_iff_ZMod.mp hP.2 _
  clear_value φ
  replace h : Int.castRingHom (ZMod k × ZMod m)
      = (Int.castRingHom (ZMod k)).prod (Int.castRingHom (ZMod m)) :=
    RingHom.ext_int _ _
  let p : ZMod k × ZMod m := (a, b)
  obtain rfl : φ.symm ((P.map (Int.castRingHom _)).eval p) = y := by
    rw [φ.symm_apply_eq, h, eval_map_RingHom_prod, ha, hb]
  
  clear_value p; clear a b ha hb
  let ρ : ZMod k × ZMod m →+* ZMod (k * m) := φ.symm
  refine ⟨ρ p, ?_⟩
  change eval (ρ p) (map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod (k * m))) P)
    = ρ (eval p (map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod k × ZMod m)) P))
  replace h : Int.castRingHom (ZMod (k * m)) = ρ.comp (Int.castRingHom _) :=
    RingHom.ext_int _ _
  rw [h, eval_map, ← hom_eval₂, eval_map]

name: good_iff_of_coprime
statement:
theorem good_iff_of_coprime (h : Nat.Coprime k m) :
    good (k * m) P ↔ good k P ∧ good m P
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | this_k : k = 0 ∨ NeZero k := eq_zero_or_neZero k
  · obtain rfl : m = 1 := (Nat.coprime_zero_left _).mp h
    exact (and_iff_left (good_one_left _)).symm
  
  obtain rfl | this_m : m = 0 ∨ NeZero m := eq_zero_or_neZero m
  · obtain rfl : k = 1 := (Nat.coprime_zero_right _).mp h
    exact (and_iff_right (good_one_left _)).symm
  
  rw [good_iff_nice, good_iff_nice, good_iff_nice, nice_iff_of_coprime h]

name: good.prime_not_dvd_derivative
statement:
theorem good.prime_not_dvd_derivative (hp : p > 1) (hP : good (p ^ 2) P) (x : ℤ) :
    ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ P.derivative.eval x
proof:
:= by
  
  rintro ⟨t, hx⟩
  
  have h : ((p : ℤ) : ZMod (p ^ 2)) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [Int.cast_natCast, ← Nat.cast_pow, ZMod.natCast_self]
  replace hx : ((P.eval (x + p) : ℤ) : ZMod (p ^ 2)) = P.eval x :=
    calc ((P.eval (x + p) : ℤ) : ZMod (p ^ 2))
    _ = (P.map (Int.castRingHom _)).eval ((x + p : ℤ) : ZMod (p ^ 2)) :=
      (eval_map_apply (Int.castRingHom (ZMod (p ^ 2))) _).symm
    _ = (P.map (Int.castRingHom _)).eval (x : ZMod (p ^ 2))
        + (P.map (Int.castRingHom _)).derivative.eval (Int.castRingHom _ x) * (p : ℤ) := by
      rw [Int.cast_add, eval_add_of_sq_eq_zero _ _ _ h, eq_intCast]
    _ = (P.map (Int.castRingHom _)).eval (x : ZMod (p ^ 2)) + (p : ℤ) * t * (p : ℤ) := by
      rw [derivative_map, eval_map_apply, eq_intCast, hx, Int.cast_mul]
    _ = (P.map (Int.castRingHom _)).eval (x : ZMod (p ^ 2)) := by
      rw [mul_right_comm, ← sq, h, zero_mul, add_zero]
    _ = P.eval x := eval_map_apply (Int.castRingHom (ZMod (p ^ 2))) x
  
  clear t h
  replace hx : x + p ≡ x [ZMOD p ^ 2] := hP _ _ ((ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff _ _ _).mp hx)
  rw [Int.add_modEq_left_iff, ← Int.natCast_pow, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast] at hx
  exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hp) (lt_self_pow₀ hp Nat.one_lt_two) hx

name: good.pow_lift_of_not_dvd_derivative
statement: theorem good.pow_lift_of_not_dvd_derivative (k) : good (p ^ k) P
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | hk : k = 0 ∨ k > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k
  · exact good_one_left P
  
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rwa [Nat.pow_one]
  | succ k hk k_ih => ?_
  
  intro a b hab
  
  replace k_ih : a ≡ b [ZMOD (p ^ k : ℕ)] :=
    k_ih _ _ (hab.of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr ⟨p, rfl⟩))
  replace k_ih : ((p ^ k : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ a - b := k_ih.symm.dvd
  rcases k_ih with ⟨x, hx⟩
  replace hx : a = p ^ k * x + b := by rwa [Int.sub_eq_iff_eq_add, Int.natCast_pow] at hx
  subst hx
  
  suffices (p : ℤ) ∣ x by
    rw [Int.add_modEq_right_iff, Int.natCast_pow, Int.pow_succ]
    exact Int.mul_dvd_mul_left _ this
  
  let φ : ℤ →+* ZMod (p ^ (k + 1)) := Int.castRingHom _
  replace hab : φ (P.eval (p ^ k * x + b)) = φ (P.eval b) :=
    (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff _ _ _).mpr hab
  have h : ((p ^ k : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (k + 1))) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff, ← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_two]
    exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.add_le_add_left hk k)
  replace h : φ (p ^ k * x) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [φ.map_mul, mul_pow, eq_intCast, ← Int.natCast_pow, Int.cast_natCast, h, zero_mul]
  replace h : φ (P.eval (p ^ k * x + b))
      = φ (P.eval b) + (P.derivative.eval b * (p ^ k * x) : ℤ) := by
    rw [← eval_map_apply, φ.map_add, add_comm _ (φ b), eval_add_of_sq_eq_zero _ _ _ h,
      derivative_map, eval_map_apply, eval_map_apply, ← φ.map_mul, eq_intCast, eq_intCast]
  replace hab : (p : ℤ) ^ k * p ∣ p ^ k * (eval b (derivative P) * x) := by
    rwa [h, add_eq_left, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd,
      Int.natCast_pow, Int.mul_left_comm, Int.pow_succ] at hab
  replace hab : (p : ℤ) ∣ P.derivative.eval b * x :=
    Int.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left (h := hab) <|
      Int.pow_ne_zero (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne p))
  exact ((Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.mp Fact.out).dvd_or_dvd hab).resolve_left (hP0 b)

name: good.veryGood_of_not_dvd_derivative
statement: theorem good.veryGood_of_not_dvd_derivative : veryGood P
proof:
:=
  λ N ↦ ⟨p ^ N, Nat.lt_pow_self (Nat.Prime.one_lt Fact.out),
    hP.pow_lift_of_not_dvd_derivative hP0 N⟩

name: eval_X3_sub_mul_X
statement:
theorem eval_X3_sub_mul_X [CommRing R] (b r : R) :
    (X ^ 3 - C b * X).eval r = r ^ 3 - b * r
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_sub, eval_C_mul, eval_X_pow, eval_X]

name: not_good_X3_sub_sq_mul_X_of_lt
statement:
theorem not_good_X3_sub_sq_mul_X_of_lt {n k : ℕ} (hn : n > 0) (hnk : n < k) :
    ¬good k (X ^ 3 - C (n ^ 2 : ℤ) * X)
proof:
:= by
  
  intro hk; specialize hk n 0
  rw [eval_X3_sub_mul_X, ← Int.pow_succ, Int.sub_self,
    eval_X3_sub_mul_X, Int.pow_succ, ← Int.sub_mul, Int.mul_zero] at hk
  replace hk : n ≡ 0 [ZMOD k] := hk (Int.ModEq.refl _)
  rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast] at hk
  exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt hn hnk hk

name: not_veryGood_X3_sub_sq_mul_X
statement:
theorem not_veryGood_X3_sub_sq_mul_X {n : ℕ} (hn : n > 0) :
    ¬veryGood (X ^ 3 - C (n ^ 2 : ℤ) * X)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨k, hkn, hk⟩ : ∃ k > n, good k (X ^ 3 - C (n ^ 2 : ℤ) * X) := h n
  exact not_good_X3_sub_sq_mul_X_of_lt hn hkn hk

name: good_prime_X3_sub_mul_X
statement:
theorem good_prime_X3_sub_mul_X
    {p : ℕ} {b : ℤ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p = 3 ∨ p % 3 = 2) (hpb : (p : ℤ) ∣ b) :
    good p (X ^ 3 - C b * X)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hp0 : Nat.Prime p := Fact.out
  refine good_iff_nice.mpr λ x ↦ ⟨x ^ (2 * ((p + 1) / 3) - 1), ?_⟩
  
  suffices (x : ZMod p) ^ ((2 * ((p + 1) / 3) - 1) * 3) = x by
    calc eval (x ^ (2 * ((p + 1) / 3) - 1)) (X ^ 3 - C b * X)
    _ = (x ^ (2 * ((p + 1) / 3) - 1)) ^ 3 - b * (x ^ (2 * ((p + 1) / 3) - 1)) :=
      eval_X3_sub_mul_X _ _
    _ ≡ x ^ ((2 * ((p + 1) / 3) - 1) * 3) [ZMOD p] := by
      rw [Int.pow_mul, Int.sub_eq_add_neg, Int.add_modEq_left_iff, ← Int.mul_neg]
      exact Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hpb
    _ ≡ x [ZMOD p] := by rw [← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff, Int.cast_pow, this]
  generalize (x : ZMod p) = x
  
  rcases hp with rfl | hp
  · exact ZMod.pow_card _
  
  replace hp : 3 ∣ p + 1 := by rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, ← Nat.mod_add_mod, hp]
  replace hpb : x ^ p = x := ZMod.pow_card _
  have hp0 : p > 0 := (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  calc x ^ ((2 * ((p + 1) / 3) - 1) * 3)
    _ = x ^ (2 * (p + 1) - 3) := by
      rw [Nat.sub_one_mul, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.div_mul_cancel hp]
    _ = x ^ (p + p - 1) := by rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_sub_add_right, Nat.two_mul]
    _ = x * x ^ (p - 1) := by rw [Nat.add_sub_assoc hp0, pow_add, hpb]
    _ = x := by rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hp0, hpb]

name: good_three_mul_prime_X3_sub_sq_mul_X
statement:
theorem good_three_mul_prime_X3_sub_sq_mul_X {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p % 3 = 2) :
    good (3 * p) (X ^ 3 - C ((3 * p) ^ 2 : ℤ) * X)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : Nat.Coprime 3 p := by
    rw [Nat.prime_three.coprime_iff_not_dvd, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, hp]; decide
  refine (good_iff_of_coprime hp0).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine good_prime_X3_sub_mul_X (Or.inl rfl) ⟨3 * p ^ 2, ?_⟩
    rw [Int.mul_pow, sq, Int.mul_assoc]; rfl
  · refine good_prime_X3_sub_mul_X (Or.inr hp) ⟨3 ^ 2 * p, ?_⟩
    rw [Int.mul_pow, sq (p : ℤ), Int.mul_left_comm]

name: final_solution_part1
statement:
theorem final_solution_part1 :
    let P : ℤ[X]
proof:
:= X ^ 3 - C (51 ^ 2) * X
    good 51 P ∧ ¬veryGood P :=
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 17) := ⟨by decide⟩
  ⟨good_three_mul_prime_X3_sub_sq_mul_X (p := 17) rfl,
  not_veryGood_X3_sub_sq_mul_X (Nat.succ_pos 50)⟩

name: map_mul_X3_add_mul_X
statement:
theorem map_mul_X3_add_mul_X (R) [CommRing R] (a b : ℤ) :
    (C a * X ^ 3 + C b * X).map (Int.castRingHom R) = C (a : R) * X ^ 3 + C (b : R) * X
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_mul,
    map_C, map_C, eq_intCast, eq_intCast, Polynomial.map_pow, map_X]

name: derivative_mul_X3_add_mul_X
statement:
theorem derivative_mul_X3_add_mul_X (a b : ℤ) :
    (C a * X ^ 3 + C b * X).derivative = C (3 * a) * X ^ 2 + C b
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivative_add, derivative_C_mul_X_pow, Int.mul_comm, derivative_C_mul_X]; rfl

name: exists_cyclotomic3_eq_of_char_ne3
statement:
theorem exists_cyclotomic3_eq_of_char_ne3 (x : F) :
    ∃ t u : F, t ^ 2 + t * u + u ^ 2 = x
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain hF2 | hF2 : ringChar F = 2 ∨ ringChar F ≠ 2 := eq_or_ne _ _
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ : IsSquare x := FiniteField.isSquare_of_char_two hF2 x
    refine ⟨0, u, ?_⟩
    rw [sq, ← mul_add, zero_mul, zero_add, sq]
  
  obtain ⟨r, s, h⟩ : ∃ r s : F, (X ^ 2).eval r + (C 3 * X ^ 2 - C x).eval s = 0 := by
    have hF : (3 : F) ≠ 0 := CharP.cast_ne_zero_of_ne_of_prime F Nat.prime_three hF3
    have h : (C (3 : F) * X ^ 2).degree = 2 := degree_C_mul_X_pow 2 hF
    replace h : (C (3 : F) * X ^ 2 - C x).degree = 2 :=
      (degree_sub_C (h.trans_gt zero_lt_two)).trans h
    exact FiniteField.exists_root_sum_quadratic
      (degree_X_pow 2) h (FiniteField.odd_card_of_char_ne_two hF2)
  
  replace h : r ^ 2 + 3 * s ^ 2 = x := by
    rwa [eval_X_pow, eval_sub, eval_C, eval_mul_X_pow,
      eval_C, ← add_sub_assoc, sub_eq_zero] at h
  
  refine ⟨r - s, 2 * s, ?_⟩
  subst h; ring

name: exists_cyclotomic3_eq_of_char_ne3'
statement:
theorem exists_cyclotomic3_eq_of_char_ne3' {x : F} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t u : F, t ≠ u ∧ t ^ 2 + t * u + u ^ 2 = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, u, rfl⟩ : ∃ t u, t ^ 2 + t * u + u ^ 2 = x :=
    exists_cyclotomic3_eq_of_char_ne3 hF3 x
  obtain htu | rfl : t ≠ u ∨ t = u := ne_or_eq t u
  · exact ⟨t, u, htu, rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨t + t, -t, λ h ↦ hx ?_, by ring⟩
    rw [sq, ← add_mul, h, neg_mul, neg_add_cancel]

name: good_mul_X3_add_mul_X_iff
statement:
theorem good_mul_X3_add_mul_X_iff {n : ℕ} {a b : ℤ} :
    good n (C a * X ^ 3 + C b * X) ↔ (λ x : ZMod n ↦ a * x ^ 3 + b * x).Injective
proof:
:= by
  rw [good_iff_ZMod, map_mul_X3_add_mul_X]
  simp_rw [eval_add, eval_C_mul, eval_X_pow, eval_X]

name: good.prime_dvd_X3_coeff_or_X_coeff
statement: theorem good.prime_dvd_X3_coeff_or_X_coeff (hp : p ≠ 3) : (p : ℤ) ∣ a ∨ (p : ℤ) ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h0
  
  replace h0 : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0 ∧ (b : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd, Ne] using h0
  obtain ⟨t, u, htu, h1⟩ : ∃ t u : ZMod p, t ≠ u ∧ t ^ 2 + t * u + u ^ 2 = -(b / a) :=
    exists_cyclotomic3_eq_of_char_ne3' ((ZMod.ringChar_zmod_n p).trans_ne hp)
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr (div_ne_zero h0.2 h0.1))
  
  replace h1 : a * (t ^ 3 - u ^ 3) = b * (u - t) :=
    calc a * (t ^ 3 - u ^ 3)
    _ = a * -(t ^ 2 + t * u + u ^ 2) * (u - t) := by ring
    _ = b * (u - t) := by rw [h1, neg_neg, mul_div_cancel₀ _ h0.1]
  replace h1 : a * t ^ 3 + b * t = a * u ^ 3 + b * u := by
    rw [add_comm _ (b * u), ← sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, ← mul_sub, h1, mul_sub]
  
  exact htu (good_mul_X3_add_mul_X_iff.mp h h1)

name: good.prime_not_dvd_X_coeff
statement: theorem good.prime_not_dvd_X_coeff (hp : p % 3 = 1) : ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  
  intro hb; replace hb : (b : ZMod p) = 0 := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd b p).mpr hb
  replace h : Function.Injective (λ x : ZMod p ↦ a * x ^ 3) := by
    simp_rw [good_mul_X3_add_mul_X_iff, hb, zero_mul, add_zero] at h; exact h
  
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : (ZMod p)ˣ, orderOf x = 3 := by
    have h0 : 3 ∣ Fintype.card (ZMod p)ˣ := by
      rw [ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, Nat.totient_prime Fact.out]
      exact (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' NeZero.one_le).mp hp.symm
    exact exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card 3 h0
  
  replace h : x = 1 := by
    refine Units.val_eq_one.mp (h (?_ : (a : ZMod p) * _ = a * _))
    rw [one_pow, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← hx, pow_orderOf_eq_one, Units.val_one]
  rw [h, orderOf_one] at hx
  exact absurd hx.symm (Nat.succ_succ_ne_one 1)

name: good.veryGood_cubic
statement: theorem good.veryGood_cubic (hp : p % 3 = 1) : veryGood (C a * X ^ 3 + C b * X)
proof:
:= by

  have hb : ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ b := h.prime_not_dvd_X_coeff hp
  have hp0 : p ≠ 3 := λ hp1 ↦ absurd hp (hp1.symm ▸ Nat.zero_ne_one)
  have ha : (p : ℤ) ∣ a := (h.prime_dvd_X3_coeff_or_X_coeff hp0).resolve_right hb
  rwa [derivative_mul_X3_add_mul_X, eval_add, eval_C_mul, eval_C,
    Int.mul_right_comm, Int.dvd_add_right (Int.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right ha)]

theorem final_solution_part2 {a b : ℤ} (h : good 2010 (C a * X ^ 3 + C b * X)) :

name: add_right_is_good
statement: lemma add_right_is_good (c k) : good c (· + k)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n; refine ⟨m + n + k + c, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.pow_two, Nat.add_right_comm m, Nat.add_right_comm n, Nat.add_comm n]

name: step1_general
statement: lemma step1_general (ha : p ^ (2 * n + 1) ∣ a) (ha0 : ¬p ^ (2 * n + 2) ∣ a) : p ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨k, hk⟩
  
  rcases ha with ⟨u, rfl⟩
  replace ha0 : ¬p ∣ u := mt (Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (Nat.pow_pos hp.pos)).mpr ha0
  
  replace hk : k ^ 2 = (p ^ n) ^ 2 * (p * (u * b)) := by
    rw [← hk, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm 2, Nat.pow_mul]
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : p ^ n ∣ k := (Nat.pow_dvd_pow_iff (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)).mp ⟨_, hk⟩
  replace hk : m ^ 2 = p * (u * b) := by
    rwa [Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_right_inj (Nat.pow_pos hp.pos).ne.symm] at hk
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : p ∣ m := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow ⟨_, hk⟩
  
  replace hk : p ∣ u * b := by
    refine ⟨t ^ 2, ?_⟩
    rw [← Nat.mul_left_cancel_iff hp.pos, ← hk, Nat.mul_pow, Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_assoc]
  exact (hp.dvd_mul.mp hk).resolve_left ha0

name: step1_modeq
statement: lemma step1_modeq (ha : a ≡ p ^ (2 * n + 1) [MOD p ^ (2 * n + 2)]) : p ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  refine step1_general hp h (n := n) ?_ ?_
  
  · exact (ha.dvd_iff ⟨p, rfl⟩).mpr (Nat.dvd_refl _)
  
  · rw [ha.dvd_iff (Nat.dvd_refl _), Nat.pow_dvd_pow_iff_le_right hp.one_lt]
    exact Nat.not_succ_le_self (2 * n + 1)

name: step1_pow_one
statement: lemma step1_pow_one (ha : a ≡ p [MOD p ^ 2]) : p ∣ b
proof:
:=
  step1_modeq hp h (n := 0) (p.pow_one.symm ▸ ha)

name: exists_add_modeq
statement: lemma exists_add_modeq (hb : 0 < b) (a c) : ∃ n, a + n ≡ c [MOD b]
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(b - 1) * a + c, ?_⟩
  rw [← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_modEq_right_iff,
    Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.add_one_mul, Nat.sub_add_cancel hb]
  exact Nat.dvd_mul_right b a

name: map_modeq_prime_imp_modeq
statement:
lemma map_modeq_prime_imp_modeq
    (hf : good c f) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h : f k ≡ f l [MOD p]) : k ≡ l [MOD p]
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∃ n, p ∣ f n + k + c ∧ p ∣ f n + l + c by
    rcases this with ⟨n, hn⟩
    replace hn : f n + k + c ≡ f n + l + c [MOD p] :=
      (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hn.1).trans (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hn.2).symm
    exact (hn.add_right_cancel' _).add_left_cancel' _
  
  by_cases h0 : f k ≡ f l [MOD p ^ 2]
  
  · obtain ⟨n, h1⟩ : ∃ n, f k + c + n ≡ p [MOD p ^ 2] :=
      exists_add_modeq (Nat.pow_pos hp.pos) _ _
    replace h0 : f l + c + n ≡ p [MOD p ^ 2] :=
      ((h0.add_right c).add_right n).symm.trans h1
    refine ⟨n, step1_pow_one hp (hf k n) ?_, step1_pow_one hp (hf l n) ?_⟩
    all_goals rwa [Nat.add_right_comm]
  
  · obtain ⟨n, h1⟩ : ∃ n, f k + c + n ≡ p ^ 3 [MOD p ^ 4] :=
      exists_add_modeq (Nat.pow_pos hp.pos) _ _
    replace h1 : f k + n + c ≡ p ^ 3 [MOD p ^ 4] := by rwa [Nat.add_right_comm] at h1
    have h2 : f k + n + c ≡ 0 [MOD p ^ 2] :=
      (Nat.ModEq.of_dvd ⟨p ^ 2, Nat.pow_add p 2 2⟩ h1).trans (Nat.mul_mod_right _ p)
    replace h0 : ¬p ^ 2 ∣ f l + n + c := by
      intro h3; replace h3 : f k + n + c ≡ f l + n + c [MOD p ^ 2] :=
        h2.trans (Nat.right_modEq_add_iff.mpr h3)
      exact h0 ((h3.add_right_cancel' _).add_right_cancel' _)
    replace h2 : (f l + n + c) % p = p ^ 3 % p :=
      ((h.symm.add_right _).add_right _).trans (h1.symm.of_mul_left _).symm
    replace h2 : p ^ 1 ∣ f l + n + c := by
      rw [Nat.pow_one, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, h2, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod_left]
    exact ⟨n, step1_modeq hp (hf k n) (n := 1) h1, step1_general hp (hf l n) (n := 0) h2 h0⟩

name: not_modeq_prime_imp
statement:
lemma not_modeq_prime_imp₁
    (h : k ≤ l) (h0 : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → ¬k ≡ l [MOD p]) : l = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, l = k + c := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  obtain rfl | hc : c = 1 ∨ c ≠ 1 := dec_em (c = 1)
  exacts [rfl, absurd (c.minFac_dvd.zero_modEq_nat.add_left k) (h0 _ (Nat.minFac_prime hc))]

name: not_modeq_prime_imp
statement:
lemma not_modeq_prime_imp₂ (h : ∀ p, Nat.Prime p → ¬k ≡ l [MOD p]) :
    l = k + 1 ∨ k = l + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain h0 | h0 : k ≤ l ∨ l ≤ k := Nat.le_total k l
  · left; exact not_modeq_prime_imp₁ h0 h
  · right; exact not_modeq_prime_imp₁ h0 λ p hp h1 ↦ h p hp h1.symm

name: step3
statement:
lemma step3 {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : ∀ {p k l}, Nat.Prime p → f k ≡ f l [MOD p] → k ≡ l [MOD p]) :
    ∃ k, f = (· + k)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hf0 : f.Injective := by
    
    intro k l h
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hp⟩ : ∃ p > max k l, Nat.Prime p :=
      Nat.exists_infinite_primes (max k l).succ
    replace hp0 : k < p ∧ l < p := max_lt_iff.mp hp0
    calc k
      _ = k % p := (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp0.1).symm
      _ = l % p := hf hp (congrArg (· % p) h)
      _ = l := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp0.2
  
  have h (n) : f (n + 1) = f n + 1 ∨ f n = f (n + 1) + 1 := by
    refine not_modeq_prime_imp₂ λ p hp h ↦ Nat.zero_ne_one ?_
    replace h : 0 % p = 1 % p := (hf hp h).add_left_cancel'
    rwa [Nat.zero_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp.one_lt] at h
  
  have h0 {n} (hn : f n = f (n + 1) + 1) : f (n + 1) = f (n + 2) + 1 :=
    (h _).resolve_left λ h0 ↦ (hf0 (h0.trans hn.symm)).not_gt (n + 1).le_succ
  
  replace h0 (n) : f (n + 1) = f n + 1 := by
    refine (h n).resolve_right λ hn ↦ ?_
    replace h0 (k) : f (n + k) = f (n + k + 1) + 1 := by
      induction k with | zero => exact hn | succ k k_ih => exact h0 k_ih
    replace h0 (k) : f n = f (n + k) + k := by
      induction k with | zero => rfl | succ k k_ih => ?_
      rw [k_ih, h0, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_assoc]
    exact (h0 (f n + 1)).not_lt (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  
  refine ⟨f 0, funext λ k ↦ ?_⟩
  induction k with | zero => rw [Nat.zero_add] | succ k k_ih => ?_
  rw [h0, k_ih, Nat.add_right_comm]

name: good_iff
statement: theorem good_iff : good c f ↔ ∃ k, f = (· + k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ step3 (map_modeq_prime_imp_modeq h), λ ⟨_, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ add_right_is_good _ _⟩

name: PNat_square_iff_Nat_square
statement: theorem PNat_square_iff_Nat_square {m : ℕ+} : (∃ k, m = k ^ 2) ↔ (∃ k : ℕ, m = k ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨λ ⟨k, hk⟩ ↦ ⟨k, congrArg PNat.val hk⟩, ?_⟩
  
  rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
  have hk0 : k > 0 := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left (m.pos.trans_eq hk)
  exact ⟨⟨k, hk0⟩, PNat.coe_injective hk⟩

name: exists_Nat_iff_zero_or_exists_PNat
statement:
theorem exists_Nat_iff_zero_or_exists_PNat {P : ℕ → Prop} :
    (∃ n, P n) ↔ P 0 ∨ ∃ n : ℕ+, P n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    obtain rfl | hn0 : n = 0 ∨ n > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n
    · left; exact hn
    · right; exact ⟨⟨n, hn0⟩, hn⟩
  
  · rintro (h | ⟨n, hn⟩)
    exacts [⟨0, h⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {f : ℕ+ → ℕ+} :
    (∀ m n : ℕ+, ∃ k, (f m + n) * (f n + m) = k ^ 2) ↔ f = id ∨ ∃ k : ℕ+, f = (· + k)
proof:
:= by
  let g (n : ℕ) : ℕ := (f n.succPNat).natPred
  let σ : ℕ+ ≃ ℕ := Equiv.pnatEquivNat
  
  calc ∀ m n : ℕ+, ∃ k, (f m + n) * (f n + m) = k ^ 2
    _ ↔ ∀ m n : ℕ+, ∃ k : ℕ, (f m + n) * (f n + m) = k ^ 2 :=
      forall₂_congr λ _ _ ↦ PNat_square_iff_Nat_square
    _ ↔ good 2 g := by
      refine σ.forall₂_congr σ (exists_congr λ k ↦ ?_)
      simp_rw [σ, g, Equiv.pnatEquivNat_apply, PNat.succPNat_natPred,
        Nat.add_add_add_comm _ _ 1 1, PNat.natPred_add_one]
    _ ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, g = (· + k) := good_iff
    _ ↔ g = id ∨ ∃ k : ℕ+, g = (· + k.val) := exists_Nat_iff_zero_or_exists_PNat
    _ ↔ f = id ∨ ∃ k : ℕ+, f = (· + k) := or_congr ?_ (exists_congr λ k ↦ ?_)
  
  · calc g = id
    _ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, (f n.succPNat).natPred = n := funext_iff
    _ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, f n.succPNat = n.succPNat :=
      forall_congr' λ _ ↦ σ.eq_symm_apply.symm
    _ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ+, f n = n := σ.symm.forall_congr λ _ ↦ Iff.rfl
    _ ↔ f = id := funext_iff.symm
  
  · calc g = (· + k.val)
      _ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, (f n.succPNat).natPred = n + k := funext_iff
      _ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, f n.succPNat = n.succPNat + k := by
        refine forall_congr' λ n ↦ ?_
        calc (f n.succPNat).natPred = n + ↑k
          _ ↔ f n.succPNat = (n + k).succPNat := σ.eq_symm_apply.symm
          _ ↔ f n.succPNat = n.succPNat + k := by
            refine Eq.congr_right (PNat.coe_injective ?_)
            rw [Nat.succPNat_coe, PNat.add_coe, Nat.succPNat_coe, Nat.succ_add]
      _ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ+, f n = n + k := σ.symm.forall_congr λ _ ↦ Iff.rfl
      _ ↔ f = (· + k) := funext_iff.symm

name: main_id
proof:
:= by
  ring

name: sub_one_sq
statement: theorem sub_one_sq (x : R) : (x - 1) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 - 2 * x + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_sq, mul_one, one_pow]

name: sum_main_id
statement:
theorem sum_main_id (I : Finset ι) (x : ι → R) :
    4 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 3 - ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 4
      = 6 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 2 - 4 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i + #I - ∑ i ∈ I, ((x i - 1) ^ 2) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  calc 4 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 3 - ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 4
  _ = ∑ i ∈ I, (4 * x i ^ 3 - x i ^ 4) := by rw [sum_sub_distrib, mul_sum]
  _ = ∑ i ∈ I, (6 * x i ^ 2 - 4 * x i + 1 - ((x i - 1) ^ 2) ^ 2) := by simp only [main_id]
  _ = 6 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 2 - 4 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i + #I - ∑ i ∈ I, ((x i - 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sum_sub_distrib, sum_add_distrib, sum_sub_distrib,
      mul_sum, mul_sum, sum_const, nsmul_one]

name: sum_sub_one_sq
statement:
theorem sum_sub_one_sq (I : Finset ι) (x : ι → R) :
    ∑ i ∈ I, (x i - 1) ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 2 - 2 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i + #I
proof:
:=
  calc ∑ i ∈ I, (x i - 1) ^ 2
  _ = ∑ i ∈ I, (x i ^ 2 - 2 * x i + 1) := by simp only [sub_one_sq]
  _ = ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 2 - 2 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i + #I := by
    rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_sub_distrib, mul_sum, sum_const, nsmul_one]

name: general_bound
statement:
theorem general_bound (I : Finset ι) (x : ι → R) :
    let B
proof:
:= 6 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 2 - 4 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i + #I
    let C := (∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 2 - 2 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i + #I) ^ 2
    let L := 4 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 3 - ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 4
    C ≤ #I * (B - L) ∧ B - L ≤ C := by
  intro B C L
  
  have hBL : B - L = ∑ i ∈ I, ((x i - 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    dsimp only [B, L]; rw [sum_main_id, sub_sub_cancel]
  have hC : C = (∑ i ∈ I, (x i - 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
    congrArg (· ^ 2) (sum_sub_one_sq I x).symm
  rw [hBL, hC]; clear * -
  
  exact ⟨sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq, sum_sq_le_sq_sum_of_nonneg λ _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _⟩

name: final_solution
proof:
:= 4 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 3 - ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 4
    36 ≤ L ∧ L ≤ 48 := by
  intro L
  
  have hB : 6 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 2 - 4 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i + #I = 52 := by
    rw [hxI1, hxI2, hI]; norm_num
  have hC : (∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ 2 - 2 * ∑ i ∈ I, x i + #I) ^ 2 = 4 * 4 := by
    rw [hxI1, hxI2, hI]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨h, h0⟩ : 4 * 4 ≤ ((4 : ℕ) : R) * (52 - L) ∧ 52 - L ≤ 4 * 4 := by
    rw [← hI, ← hB, ← hC]; exact general_bound I x
  
  clear * - h h0
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · calc (36 : R) = 52 - 4 * 4 := by norm_num
                _ ≤ L := sub_le_comm.mp h0
  
  · replace h : 4 ≤ 52 - L := le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := 4) h four_pos
    calc  L ≤ 52 - 4 := le_sub_comm.mp h
          _ = 48 := by norm_num

name: c_eq_zero_or_one
statement: theorem c_eq_zero_or_one (hcb : c ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) : c = 0 ∨ c = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold good at h
  
  refine Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp (Nat.le_of_not_gt λ hc ↦ ?_)
  
  have hc0 : c > 0 := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hc
  have hb0 : b > 0 := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hc0 hcb
  have ha0 : a > 0 := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb0 hba
  
  have h0 : (b * c) ^ 2 ≤ 3 * a := by
    refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (Nat.pow_pos ha0 (n := 2))
    calc a ^ 2 * (b * c) ^ 2
      _ = (a * b * c) ^ 2 := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc a, Nat.mul_pow a]
      _ = a ^ 3 + b ^ 3 + c ^ 3 := h.symm
      _ ≤ a ^ 3 + a ^ 3 + a ^ 3 :=
        have X {x y} (h0 : x ≤ y) : x ^ 3 ≤ y ^ 3 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h0 3
        Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add_left (X hba) _) (X (Nat.le_trans hcb hba))
      _ = 3 * a ^ 3 := by rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.two_mul]
      _ = a ^ 2 * (3 * a) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_left_comm]
  
  replace h : a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 3 + c ^ 3 := by
    refine Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.add_pos_left (Nat.pow_pos hb0) _) ?_
    rw [← Nat.dvd_add_right ⟨a, rfl⟩, ← Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc, h, Nat.mul_assoc]
    exact ⟨(b * c) ^ 2, Nat.mul_pow _ _ 2⟩
  replace h : a ^ 2 ≤ 2 * b ^ 3 := calc
    a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 3 + c ^ 3 := h
    _ ≤ b ^ 3 + b ^ 3 := Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hcb 3) _
    _ = 2 * b ^ 3 := (Nat.two_mul _).symm
  
  replace h : c ^ 5 * b ^ 3 ≤ 18 * b ^ 3 := calc
    c ^ 5 * b ^ 3 = c ^ 4 * b ^ 3 * c := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_right_comm]
    _ ≤ c ^ 4 * b ^ 3 * b := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hcb
    _ = b ^ 4 * c ^ 4 := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
    _ = ((b * c) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by rw [← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_pow]
    _ ≤ (3 * a) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h0 _
    _ = 9 * a ^ 2 := Nat.mul_pow 3 a 2
    _ ≤ 9 * (2 * b ^ 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 9 h
    _ = 18 * b ^ 3 := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
  
  replace h : c ^ 5 ≤ 18 := Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h (Nat.pow_pos hb0)
  replace hc : 32 ≤ c ^ 5 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hc 5
  replace h0 : 18 < 32 := by decide
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt h0 (Nat.le_trans hc h)

name: eq_000_of_c_eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_000_of_c_eq_zero (h : good a b 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 {n : Nat} (hn : n ^ 3 = 0) : n = 0 := (Nat.pow_eq_zero.mp hn).1
  rw [good, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff] at h
  exact h.imp h0 h0

name: eq_321_of_c_eq_one
statement: theorem eq_321_of_c_eq_one (h : good a b 1) (hba : b ≤ a) : a = 3 ∧ b = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [good, Nat.mul_one, Nat.one_pow] at h
  
  replace hba : b < a := by
    
    refine Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hba λ h0 ↦ ?_
    rw [h0, ← Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.mul_two, Nat.pow_succ _ 3] at h
    replace h0 : a ^ 3 = 1 := Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one ((Nat.dvd_add_right ⟨2, rfl⟩).mp ⟨a, h⟩)
    obtain rfl : a = 1 := Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_left h0
    revert h; decide
  
  have hba0 : a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 3 + 1 := by
    refine Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos _) ?_
    rw [← Nat.dvd_add_right ⟨a, rfl⟩, ← Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc, h]
    exact ⟨b ^ 2, Nat.mul_pow a b 2⟩
  
  have hba1 : b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * a := by
    refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (Nat.pow_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hba) (n := 2))
    calc a ^ 2 * b ^ 2
      _ = a ^ 3 + (b ^ 3 + 1) := by rw [← Nat.add_assoc, h, Nat.mul_pow]
      _ ≤ a ^ 3 + a ^ 3 :=
        Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.pow_lt_pow_left hba (Nat.succ_ne_zero 2)) _
      _ = a ^ 2 * (2 * a) := by rw [← Nat.two_mul, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_left_comm]
  
  have hb : b ^ 4 ≤ 4 * (b ^ 3 + 1) := calc
    b ^ 4 = (b ^ 2) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_mul b 2 2
    _ ≤ (2 * a) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hba1 2
    _ = 4 * a ^ 2 := Nat.mul_pow 2 a 2
    _ ≤ 4 * (b ^ 3 + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 hba0
  replace hb : (((b = 0 ∨ b = 1) ∨ b = 2) ∨ b = 3) ∨ b = 4 := by
    suffices b ≤ 4 by simpa only [Nat.le_succ_iff, Nat.le_zero] using this
    refine Nat.le_of_not_gt λ hb0 ↦ Nat.not_lt_of_ge hb ?_
    calc 4 * (b ^ 3 + 1)
      _ < 4 * b ^ 3 + b ^ 3 :=
        Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hb0 (Nat.le_pow (Nat.succ_pos 2))) _
      _ = 5 * b ^ 3 := (Nat.succ_mul 4 _).symm
      _ ≤ b * b ^ 3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hb0
      _ = b ^ 4 := Nat.pow_succ'.symm
  
  rcases hb with (((rfl | rfl) | rfl) | rfl) | rfl
  
  · exact absurd h (Nat.succ_ne_zero (a ^ 3))
  
  · refine absurd h (Nat.ne_of_gt ?_)
    calc (a * 1) ^ 2
      _ = a ^ 2 := by rw [Nat.mul_one]
      _ ≤ a ^ 3 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hba) (Nat.le_succ 2)
      _ < a ^ 3 + 2 := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right Nat.two_pos
  
  · refine ⟨Nat.le_antisymm ?_ hba, rfl⟩
    exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_left (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)).mp hba0
  
  · replace hba1 : 5 ≤ a := Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul hba1
    replace hba0 : a ≤ 5 := by
      have h0 : 28 < 36 := by decide
      exact Nat.le_of_not_gt λ h1 ↦ Nat.not_lt_of_ge hba0 <|
        Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h0 (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h1 2)
    obtain rfl : a = 5 := Nat.le_antisymm hba0 hba1
    exfalso; revert h; decide
  
  · replace hba1 : 8 ≤ a := Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul hba1
    replace hba0 : a ≤ 8 := by
      have h0 : 65 < 81 := by decide
      exact Nat.le_of_not_gt λ h1 ↦ Nat.not_lt_of_ge hba0 <|
        Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h0 (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h1 2)
    obtain rfl : a = 8 := Nat.le_antisymm hba0 hba1
    exfalso; revert h; decide

name: eq_000_or_321
statement:
theorem eq_000_or_321 (h : good a b c) (hcb : c ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) :
    (a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0) ∨ (a = 3 ∧ b = 2 ∧ c = 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | rfl : c = 0 ∨ c = 1 := h.c_eq_zero_or_one hcb hba
  · left; rw [and_iff_left rfl]; exact h.eq_000_of_c_eq_zero
  · right; rw [and_iff_left rfl]; exact h.eq_321_of_c_eq_one hba

name: final_solution
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    all_goals rfl
  
  rcases p with ⟨a, b, c⟩
  obtain hcb | hbc : c ≤ b ∨ b ≤ c := Nat.le_total c b
  all_goals obtain hba | hab : b ≤ a ∨ a ≤ b := Nat.le_total b a
  
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ :
        (a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0) ∨ (a = 3 ∧ b = 2 ∧ c = 1) :=
      h.eq_000_or_321 hcb hba
    all_goals trivial
  
  · obtain hac | hca : a ≤ c ∨ c ≤ a := Nat.le_total a c
    
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ :
          (b = 0 ∧ c = 0 ∧ a = 0) ∨ (b = 3 ∧ c = 2 ∧ a = 1) :=
        h.perm012.eq_000_or_321 hac hcb
