      all_goals trivial
    
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ :
          (b = 0 ∧ a = 0 ∧ c = 0) ∨ (b = 3 ∧ a = 2 ∧ c = 1) :=
        h.perm01.eq_000_or_321 hca hab
      all_goals trivial
  
  · obtain hac | hca : a ≤ c ∨ c ≤ a := Nat.le_total a c
    
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ :
          (c = 0 ∧ a = 0 ∧ b = 0) ∨ (c = 3 ∧ a = 2 ∧ b = 1) :=
        h.perm021.eq_000_or_321 hba hac
      all_goals trivial
    
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ :
          (a = 0 ∧ c = 0 ∧ b = 0) ∨ (a = 3 ∧ c = 2 ∧ b = 1) :=
        h.perm12.eq_000_or_321 hbc hca
      all_goals trivial
  
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ :
        (c = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ a = 0) ∨ (c = 3 ∧ b = 2 ∧ a = 1) :=
      h.perm02.eq_000_or_321 hab hbc
    all_goals trivial

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (h : N ≠ 0) {f : Int → Int} :
    (∀ a b : Int, f (N * a) + N * f b = f (f (a + b)))
      ↔ (f = λ _ ↦ 0) ∨ ∃ c : Int, f = (N * · + c)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ h0 a b ↦ ?_, λ h0 ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases h0 with rfl | ⟨c, rfl⟩
    · exact (N * 0).zero_add.trans N.mul_zero
    · rw [Int.add_right_comm, ← Int.mul_add, ← Int.add_assoc, ← Int.mul_add]
  
  have h1 (n) : N * (f (n + 1) - f n) = f N - f 0 := by
    rw [Int.mul_sub, ← Int.add_left_inj (k := N * f n + f 0), ← Int.add_assoc,
      Int.sub_add_cancel, (N * f n).add_comm, ← Int.add_assoc, Int.sub_add_cancel,
      ← N.mul_zero, Int.add_comm, h0, Int.zero_add, n.add_comm, ← h0, N.mul_one]
  
  replace h1 (n) : f (n + 1) = (f 1 - f 0) + f n := by
    rw [← Int.sub_left_inj (k := f n), Int.add_sub_cancel,
      ← Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff h, h1, ← Int.zero_add 1, h1]
  generalize f 1 - f 0 = q at h1
  replace h1 : ∀ n, f n = q * n + f 0 := Extra.LinearSolver.IntInt h1
  
  obtain rfl | h2 : q = N ∨ q ≠ N := Decidable.em _
  · right; exact ⟨f 0, funext h1⟩
  
  left; funext n
  replace h0 : f (N * 0) + N * f n = f (f (0 + n)) := h0 0 n
  rw [N.mul_zero, n.zero_add, h1 (f n), Int.add_comm, Int.add_left_inj,
    ← Int.sub_eq_zero, ← Int.sub_mul, Int.mul_eq_zero, Int.sub_eq_zero] at h0
  exact h0.resolve_left h2.symm

name: good_cond1
statement:
theorem good_cond1 (h : n ≤ a) (h0 : a < b) (h1 : b < c) (h2 : c ≤ 2 * n)
    (h3 : a + b = k ^ 2) (h4 : a + c = l ^ 2) (h5 : b + c = m ^ 2) :
    good n
proof:
:= by
  
  intro x
  rcases Bool.eq_or_eq_not (x a) (x b) with h6 | h6
  · exact ⟨a, b, h, h0, Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt h1) h2, h6, k, h3⟩
  rcases Bool.eq_or_eq_not (x c) (x b) with h7 | h7
  · exact ⟨b, c, Nat.le_trans h (Nat.le_of_lt h0), h1, h2, h7.symm, m, h5⟩
  · exact ⟨a, c, h, Nat.lt_trans h0 h1, h2, h6.trans h7.symm, l, h4⟩

name: good_cond2
statement: theorem good_cond2 (h : n ≤ 2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k) (h0 : k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 8 ≤ n) : good n
proof:
:= by
  
  refine good_cond1 (b := 2 * k ^ 2 + 8 * k + 9) (k := 2 * k + 3)
    (l := 2 * k + 4) (m := 2 * k + 5) h ?_ ?_ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h0) ?_ ?_ ?_
  
  · calc 2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k
    _ ≤ 2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k + 4 * k := Nat.le_add_right _ _
    _ = 2 * k ^ 2 + 8 * k := by rw [Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.add_mul]
    _ < 2 * k ^ 2 + 8 * k + 9 := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (Nat.succ_pos 8)
  
  · calc 2 * k ^ 2 + 8 * k + 9
    _ ≤ 2 * k ^ 2 + 8 * k + 9 + 4 * k := Nat.le_add_right _ _
    _ = 2 * k ^ 2 + 12 * k + 9 := by
      rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc _ (8 * k), ← Nat.add_mul]
    _ < 2 * k ^ 2 + 12 * k + 16 := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (Nat.succ_pos 6)
    _ = 2 * (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 8) := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.mul_assoc]
  
  · calc (2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k) + (2 * k ^ 2 + 8 * k + 9)
    _ = 4 * k ^ 2 + 12 * k + 9 := by
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_add_add_comm, ← Nat.add_mul, ← Nat.add_mul]
    _ = 4 * k ^ 2 + 6 * k + (6 * k + 9) := by
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_assoc (4 * _) (6 * k), ← Nat.add_mul]
    _ = 2 * k * (2 * k + 3) + 3 * (2 * k + 3) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm,
        Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_right_comm 2 k, ← Nat.mul_assoc 3]
    _ = (2 * k + 3) ^ 2 := by rw [Nat.pow_two, Nat.add_mul]
  
  · calc (2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k) + 2 * (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 8)
    _ = 4 * k ^ 2 + 16 * k + 16 := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.add_assoc,
        Nat.add_add_add_comm, ← Nat.add_mul, ← Nat.add_mul]
    _ = 4 * k ^ 2 + 8 * k + (8 * k + 16) := by
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_assoc (4 * _) (8 * k), ← Nat.add_mul]
    _ = 2 * k * (2 * k + 4) + 4 * (2 * k + 4) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm,
        Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_right_comm 2 k, ← Nat.mul_assoc 4 2]
    _ = (2 * k + 4) ^ 2 := by rw [Nat.pow_two, Nat.add_mul]
  
  · calc (2 * k ^ 2 + 8 * k + 9) + 2 * (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 8)
    _ = 4 * k ^ 2 + 20 * k + 25 := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.add_add_add_comm,
        Nat.add_add_add_comm (2 * k ^ 2), ← Nat.add_mul, ← Nat.add_mul]
    _ = 4 * k ^ 2 + 10 * k + (10 * k + 25) := by
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_assoc (4 * _) (10 * k), ← Nat.add_mul]
    _ = 2 * k * (2 * k + 5) + 5 * (2 * k + 5) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm,
        Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_right_comm 2 k, ← Nat.mul_assoc 5]
    _ = (2 * k + 5) ^ 2 := by rw [Nat.pow_two, Nat.add_mul]

name: good_cond2_of_ge99
statement:
theorem good_cond2_of_ge99 {n} (hn : n ≥ 99) :
    ∃ k, n ≤ 2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k ∧ k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 8 ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact ⟨7, Nat.le_add_left 99 27, Nat.le_refl 99⟩
  | succ n hn hn0 => ?_
  
  rcases hn0 with ⟨k, hnk, hnk0⟩
  
  obtain hnk | rfl : n < 2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k ∨ n = 2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k :=
    (Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hnk).symm
  · exact ⟨k, hnk, Nat.le_succ_of_le hnk0⟩
  
  refine ⟨k + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · exact Nat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ k) 2))
      (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Nat.lt_succ_self k) (Nat.succ_pos 3))
  
  · clear hnk hnk0
    replace hn : k ≥ 7 := by
      refine Nat.lt_of_not_ge λ (h : k ≤ 6) ↦ Nat.not_lt_of_le hn ?_
      calc 2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k
        _ ≤ 2 * 6 ^ 2 + 4 * 6 :=
          Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h 2))
            (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 h)
        _ < 99 := by decide
    calc (k + 1) ^ 2 + 6 * (k + 1) + 8
      _ ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 + 6 * (k + 1) + (k + 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.succ_le_succ hn) _
      _ = (k + 1) ^ 2 + 7 * (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.succ_mul]
      _ ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 + k * (k + 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hn) _
      _ = (2 * k + 1) * (k + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.add_mul, Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_right_comm]
      _ = 2 * k ^ 2 + 3 * k + 1 := by
        rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.pow_two,
          Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.add_assoc _ k, ← Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_assoc]
      _ ≤ 2 * k ^ 2 + 4 * k + 1 :=
        Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ 3)) _)

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (hn : n ≥ 99) : good n
proof:
:=
  (good_cond2_of_ge99 hn).elim λ _ h ↦ good_cond2 h.1 h.2

name: Icc_subset_Ici
statement:
theorem Icc_subset_Ici [Preorder α] {a b c : α} (h : c ≤ a) :
    Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.Ici c
proof:
:=
  λ _ hd ↦ Set.mem_Ici.mpr (h.trans (Set.mem_Icc.mp hd).1)

name: Icc_subset_Iic
statement:
theorem Icc_subset_Iic [Preorder α] {a b c : α} (h : b ≤ c) :
    Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.Iic c
proof:
:=
  λ _ hd ↦ Set.mem_Iic.mpr ((Set.mem_Icc.mp hd).2.trans h)

name: ConcaveOn_abs_zero_Ici
statement: theorem ConcaveOn_abs_zero_Ici : ConcaveOn 𝕜 (Ici 0) (λ t ↦ g |t|)
proof:
:=
  hg.congr λ _ hx ↦ congrArg g (abs_of_nonneg (mem_Ici.mp hx)).symm

name: ConcaveOn_abs_zero_Iic
statement: theorem ConcaveOn_abs_zero_Iic : ConcaveOn 𝕜 (Iic 0) (λ t ↦ g |t|)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (-LinearMap.id (R := 𝕜) (M := E)) ⁻¹' Ici 0 = Iic 0 := by
    ext x; change -x ∈ Ici 0 ↔ x ∈ Iic 0
    rw [mem_Ici, mem_Iic, neg_nonneg]
  replace h : ConcaveOn 𝕜 (Iic 0) (λ t ↦ g |-t|) :=
    h ▸ (ConcaveOn_abs_zero_Ici g hg).comp_linearMap (-LinearMap.id)
  simpa only [abs_neg] using h

name: ConcaveOn_abs_sub_Ici
statement: theorem ConcaveOn_abs_sub_Ici (x) : ConcaveOn 𝕜 (Iic x) (λ t ↦ g |x - t|)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (-x + ·) ⁻¹' Iic 0 = Iic x :=
    ext λ x ↦ by rw [preimage_const_add_Iic, sub_neg_eq_add, zero_add, mem_Iic]
  conv => right; ext t; rw [abs_sub_comm, sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact h ▸ (ConcaveOn_abs_zero_Iic g hg).translate_left (-x)

name: ConcaveOn_abs_sub_Iic
statement: theorem ConcaveOn_abs_sub_Iic (x) : ConcaveOn 𝕜 (Ici x) (λ t ↦ g |x - t|)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (-x + ·) ⁻¹' Ici 0 = Ici x :=
    ext λ x ↦ by rw [preimage_const_add_Ici, sub_neg_eq_add, zero_add, mem_Ici]
  conv => right; ext t; rw [abs_sub_comm, sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact h ▸ (ConcaveOn_abs_zero_Ici g hg).translate_left (-x)

name: ConcaveOn_sum
statement: theorem ConcaveOn_sum : ConcaveOn 𝕜 s (∑ i ∈ S, g i)
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact concaveOn_const 0 hs
  | insert i S hiS h =>
      rw [Finset.forall_mem_insert] at hg
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hiS]
      exact hg.1.add (h hg.2)

name: ConcaveOn_of_sum_eq
statement:
theorem ConcaveOn_of_sum_eq {f : E → β} (hf : ∀ x, f x = ∑ i ∈ S, g i x) :
    ConcaveOn 𝕜 s f
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : f = ∑ i ∈ S, g i := funext λ x ↦ (hf x).trans (Finset.sum_apply _ _ _).symm
  exact ConcaveOn_sum S hs g hg

name: ConcaveOn_min_endpoints_le
statement:
theorem ConcaveOn_min_endpoints_le [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜]
    [AddCommGroup β] [LinearOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [Module 𝕜 β]
    [IsStrictOrderedModule 𝕜 β] {f : 𝕜 → β} (hf : ConcaveOn 𝕜 (Set.Icc x y) f)
    (hxz : x ≤ z) (hzy : z ≤ y) : min (f x) (f y) ≤ f z
proof:
:= by
  have h : x ≤ y := hxz.trans hzy
  exact hf.min_le_of_mem_Icc (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr h)
    (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr h) (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hxz, hzy⟩)

name: targetSum_insert_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem targetSum_insert_of_eq_zero
    [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → 𝕜) (hi : x i = 0) :
    targetSum g (insert i S) x = targetSum g S x
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h : i ∈ S ∨ ¬i ∈ S := dec_em _
  
  · rw [insert_eq_of_mem h]
  
  · calc ∑ p ∈ insert i S ×ˢ insert i S, (g |x p.1 + x p.2| - g |x p.1 - x p.2|)
      _ = ∑ j ∈ insert i S, (g |x i + x j| - g |x i - x j|)
          + ∑ j₁ ∈ S, ∑ j₂ ∈ insert i S, (g |x j₁ + x j₂| - g |x j₁ - x j₂|) := by
        rw [sum_product, sum_insert h]
      _ = ∑ j₁ ∈ S, ∑ j₂ ∈ insert i S, (g |x j₁ + x j₂| - g |x j₁ - x j₂|) := by
        refine add_eq_right.mpr (sum_eq_zero λ j _ ↦ ?_)
        rw [hi, zero_add, zero_sub, abs_neg, sub_self]
      _ = ∑ j₁ ∈ S, ∑ j₂ ∈ S, (g |x j₁ + x j₂| - g |x j₁ - x j₂|) := by
        refine sum_congr rfl λ j₁ _ ↦ ?_
        rw [sum_insert h, add_eq_right, hi, add_zero, sub_zero, sub_self]
      _ = ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, (g |x p.1 + x p.2| - g |x p.1 - x p.2|) := by
        rw [sum_product]

name: targetSum_insert_of_add_eq_zero
statement:
theorem targetSum_insert_of_add_eq_zero [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι)
    (hi : Disjoint {i₁, i₂} S) (hi0 : i₁ ≠ i₂) (x : ι → 𝕜) (hi1 : x i₁ + x i₂ = 0) :
    targetSum g ({i₁, i₂} ∪ S) x = targetSum g S x
proof:
:=
  have hi1 : x i₂ = -x i₁ := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hi1
  calc ∑ p ∈ ({i₁, i₂} ∪ S) ×ˢ ({i₁, i₂} ∪ S), (g |x p.1 + x p.2| - g |x p.1 - x p.2|)
  _ = ∑ j₁ ∈ {i₁, i₂}, ∑ j₂ ∈ {i₁, i₂} ∪ S, (g |x j₁ + x j₂| - g |x j₁ - x j₂|)
      + ∑ j₁ ∈ S, ∑ j₂ ∈ {i₁, i₂} ∪ S, (g |x j₁ + x j₂| - g |x j₁ - x j₂|) := by
    rw [sum_product, sum_union hi]
  _ = ∑ j₁ ∈ S, ∑ j₂ ∈ {i₁, i₂} ∪ S, (g |x j₁ + x j₂| - g |x j₁ - x j₂|) := by
    rw [add_eq_right, sum_pair hi0, ← sum_add_distrib]
    refine sum_eq_zero λ j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hi1, ← neg_add', abs_neg, sub_add_sub_cancel',
      neg_add_eq_sub, abs_sub_comm, sub_self]
  _ = ∑ j₁ ∈ S, ∑ j₂ ∈ S, (g |x j₁ + x j₂| - g |x j₁ - x j₂|) := by
    refine sum_congr rfl λ j₁ _ ↦ ?_
    rw [sum_union hi, add_eq_right, sum_pair hi0, hi1, sub_neg_eq_add,
      sub_add_sub_cancel', ← sub_eq_add_neg, abs_sub_comm, sub_self]
  _ = ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, (g |x p.1 + x p.2| - g |x p.1 - x p.2|) := by
    rw [sum_product]

name: exists_targetSum_shift_le_targetSum
statement:
theorem exists_targetSum_shift_le_targetSum
    [DecidableEq ι] {S : Finset ι} (hS : S.Nonempty) (x : ι → 𝕜) :
    ∃ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, targetSum g S (λ i ↦ x i - (x p.1 + x p.2) / 2) ≤ targetSum g S x
proof:
:= by
  
  by_cases hS_pos : ∀ i ∈ S, x i ≥ 0
  · obtain ⟨i, hiS, hi⟩ : ∃ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, x i ≤ x j := S.exists_min_image _ hS
    refine ⟨(i, i), mk_mem_product hiS hiS, sum_le_sum λ p hp ↦ ?_⟩
    replace hi (j) (hj : j ∈ S) : 0 ≤ x j - x i := sub_nonneg.mpr (hi j hj)
    replace hp : p.1 ∈ S ∧ p.2 ∈ S := mem_product.mp hp
    rw [add_self_div_two, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, sub_le_sub_iff_right]
    refine hg _ (abs_nonneg _) _ ?_
    calc |x p.1 + x p.2|
      _ = x p.1 + x p.2 := abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (hS_pos _ hp.1) (hS_pos _ hp.2))
      _ ≥ (x p.1 - x i) + (x p.2 - x i) := by
        have hi0 : 0 ≤ x i := hS_pos i hiS
        exact add_le_add (sub_le_self _ hi0) (sub_le_self _ hi0)
      _ = |(x p.1 - x i) + (x p.2 - x i)| :=
        (abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (hi _ hp.1) (hi _ hp.2))).symm
  
  by_cases hS_neg : ∀ i ∈ S, x i ≤ 0
  · obtain ⟨i, hiS, hi⟩ : ∃ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, x j ≤ x i := S.exists_max_image _ hS
    refine ⟨(i, i), mk_mem_product hiS hiS, sum_le_sum λ p hp ↦ ?_⟩
    replace hi (j) (hj : j ∈ S) : x j - x i ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr (hi j hj)
    replace hp : p.1 ∈ S ∧ p.2 ∈ S := mem_product.mp hp
    rw [add_self_div_two, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, sub_le_sub_iff_right]
    refine hg _ (abs_nonneg _) _ ?_
    calc |x p.1 + x p.2|
      _ = -(x p.1 + x p.2) := abs_of_nonpos (add_nonpos (hS_neg _ hp.1) (hS_neg _ hp.2))
      _ ≥ -((x p.1 - x i) + (x p.2 - x i)) := by
        have hi0 : x i ≤ 0 := hS_neg i hiS
        refine neg_le_neg (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
        all_goals exact (le_sub_self_iff _).mpr hi0
      _ = |(x p.1 - x i) + (x p.2 - x i)| :=
        (abs_of_nonpos (add_nonpos (hi _ hp.1) (hi _ hp.2))).symm
  
  simp_rw [not_forall, not_le] at hS_pos hS_neg
  replace hS_pos : {p ∈ S ×ˢ S | x p.1 + x p.2 ≤ 0}.Nonempty := by
    rcases hS_pos with ⟨i, hi, hi0⟩
    exact ⟨(i, i), mem_filter.mpr ⟨mk_mem_product hi hi, (add_neg hi0 hi0).le⟩⟩
  replace hS_neg : {p ∈ S ×ˢ S | x p.1 + x p.2 ≥ 0}.Nonempty := by
    rcases hS_neg with ⟨i, hi, hi0⟩
    exact ⟨(i, i), mem_filter.mpr ⟨mk_mem_product hi hi, (add_pos hi0 hi0).le⟩⟩
  
  obtain ⟨pₚ, hpₚ, hpₚ0, hpₚ1⟩ :
      ∃ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, x p.1 + x p.2 ≥ 0 ∧
        ∀ q ∈ S ×ˢ S, x q.1 + x q.2 ≥ 0 → x p.1 + x p.2 ≤ x q.1 + x q.2 := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0⟩ := exists_min_image _ (λ p : ι × ι ↦ x p.1 + x p.2) hS_neg
    simp_rw [mem_filter, and_imp] at hp hp0
    exact ⟨p, hp.1, hp.2, hp0⟩
  clear hS_neg
  
  obtain ⟨pₙ, hpₙ, hpₙ0, hpₙ1⟩ :
      ∃ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, x p.1 + x p.2 ≤ 0 ∧
        ∀ q ∈ S ×ˢ S, x q.1 + x q.2 ≤ 0 → x q.1 + x q.2 ≤ x p.1 + x p.2 := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0⟩ := exists_max_image _ (λ p : ι × ι ↦ x p.1 + x p.2) hS_pos
    simp_rw [mem_filter, and_imp] at hp hp0
    exact ⟨p, hp.1, hp.2, hp0⟩
  clear hS_pos
  /- Claim: the target sum with respect to `t ↦ x_i - t/2` is concave on
    the interval `I = [x_{iₙ} + x_{jₙ}, x_{iₚ} + x_{jₚ}]`. -/
  let I : Set 𝕜 := Set.Icc (x pₙ.1 + x pₙ.2) (x pₚ.1 + x pₚ.2)
  have hI : Convex 𝕜 I := convex_Icc _ _
  have h : ConcaveOn 𝕜 I (λ t ↦ targetSum g S (λ i ↦ x i - t / 2)) := by
    refine ConcaveOn_of_sum_eq (S ×ˢ S) hI
      (λ p t ↦ g |x p.1 + x p.2 - t| + -g |x p.1 - x p.2|) ?_ ?_
    
    · intro p hp; apply ConcaveOn.add_const
      obtain h | h : x p.1 + x p.2 ≤ 0 ∨ x p.1 + x p.2 ≥ 0 := le_total _ _
      exacts [(ConcaveOn_abs_sub_Iic g hg0 _).subset (Icc_subset_Ici (hpₙ1 p hp h)) hI,
        (ConcaveOn_abs_sub_Ici g hg0 _).subset (Icc_subset_Iic (hpₚ1 p hp h)) hI]
    
    · intro t; refine sum_congr rfl λ p _ ↦ ?_
      rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, sub_add_sub_comm, add_halves, sub_eq_add_neg]
  
  replace h :
      min (targetSum g S (λ i ↦ x i - (x pₙ.1 + x pₙ.2) / 2))
        (targetSum g S (λ i ↦ x i - (x pₚ.1 + x pₚ.2) / 2))
        ≤ targetSum g S (λ i ↦ x i - 0 / 2) :=
    ConcaveOn_min_endpoints_le (𝕜 := 𝕜) (β := β) h hpₙ0 hpₚ0
  
  simp_rw [zero_div, sub_zero, inf_le_iff] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  exacts [⟨pₙ, hpₙ, h⟩, ⟨pₚ, hpₚ, h⟩]

name: targetSum_nonneg_of_monotone_concave
statement:
theorem targetSum_nonneg_of_monotone_concave [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → 𝕜) :
    targetSum g S x ≥ 0
proof:
:= by
  
  induction S using Finset.strongInduction generalizing x with | H S S_ih => ?_
  
  obtain rfl | hS : S = ∅ ∨ S.Nonempty := S.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · exact le_refl 0
  /- If `S ≠ ∅`, by `exists_targetSum_shift_le_targetSum`, we can find `(i₁, i₂) ∈ S^2`
    such that the target sum with respect to `x_i - (x_{i_1} + x_{i_2})/2` is less than
    those with respect to `x_i`. -/
  obtain ⟨⟨i₁, i₂⟩, hi, h⟩ :
      ∃ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, targetSum g S (λ i ↦ x i - (x p.1 + x p.2) / 2) ≤ targetSum g S x :=
    exists_targetSum_shift_le_targetSum _ hg hg0 hS _
  replace hi : i₁ ∈ S ∧ i₂ ∈ S := mem_product.mp hi
  replace hi : {i₁, i₂} ⊆ S := by
    intro j hj
    rw [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hj
    rcases hj with rfl | rfl
    exacts [hi.1, hi.2]
  
  calc 0
    _ ≤ targetSum g (S \ {i₁, i₂}) (x · - (x i₁ + x i₂) / 2) :=
      S_ih _ (sdiff_ssubset hi ⟨i₁, mem_insert_self _ _⟩) _
    _ = targetSum g ({i₁, i₂} ∪ (S \ {i₁, i₂})) (x · - (x i₁ + x i₂) / 2) := by
      obtain rfl | h1 : i₁ = i₂ ∨ i₁ ≠ i₂ := dec_em _
      
      · rw [pair_eq_singleton]
        refine (targetSum_insert_of_eq_zero _ _ _ ?_).symm
        rw [add_self_div_two, sub_self]
      
      · refine (targetSum_insert_of_add_eq_zero _ _ disjoint_sdiff h1 _ ?_).symm
        rw [sub_add_sub_comm, add_halves, sub_self]
    _ = targetSum g S (x · - (x i₁ + x i₂) / 2) := by
      rw [union_sdiff_self_eq_union, union_eq_right.mpr hi]
    _ ≤ targetSum g S x := h

name: targetSum_nonneg_of_monotone_concave'
statement:
theorem targetSum_nonneg_of_monotone_concave' [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → 𝕜) :
    ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, g |x p.1 - x p.2| ≤ ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, g |x p.1 + x p.2|
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_nonneg, ← sum_sub_distrib]
  exact targetSum_nonneg_of_monotone_concave g hg hg0 S x

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, √|x p.1 - x p.2| ≤ ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, √|x p.1 + x p.2|
proof:
:=
  targetSum_nonneg_of_monotone_concave' _ (λ _ _ _ ↦ Real.sqrt_le_sqrt)
    Real.strictConcaveOn_sqrt.concaveOn S x

name: eq_pow_of_sq_dvd_self_sub_pow
statement:
theorem eq_pow_of_sq_dvd_self_sub_pow {b n : ℕ} (h : ∃ a, (b : ℤ) ^ 2 ∣ b - a ^ n) :
    ∃ A, b = A ^ n
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases h with ⟨a, d, h⟩
  
  replace h : a ^ n = b * (1 - b * d) := by
    rw [mul_one_sub, ← Int.mul_assoc, ← sq, ← h, sub_sub_cancel]
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℤ, Associated (c ^ n) b := by
    refine exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow ?_ h.symm
    
    have h0 : (b : ℤ) ∣ (1 - b * d) - 1 := ⟨-d, by rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, mul_neg]⟩
    rw [gcd_eq_of_dvd_sub_right h0, gcd_one_right]
    exact isUnit_one
  
  rw [Int.associated_iff_natAbs, Int.natAbs_pow, Int.natAbs_natCast] at hc
  exact ⟨c.natAbs, hc.symm⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {b n : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h : ∀ k > 0, ∃ c : ℤ, k ∣ b - c ^ n) :
    ∃ A, b = A ^ n
proof:
:=
  eq_pow_of_sq_dvd_self_sub_pow (h (b ^ 2) (sq_pos_of_pos (Int.natCast_pos.mpr hb)))

name: Fin_sum_add_left
statement:
theorem Fin_sum_add_left [NeZero n] [AddCommMonoid M] (a : Fin n → M) (k) :
    ∑ i, a (k + i) = ∑ i, a i
proof:
:=
  Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addLeft k) _ _ (λ _ ↦ rfl)

name: Fin_sum_add_right
statement:
theorem Fin_sum_add_right [NeZero n] [AddCommMonoid M] (a : Fin n → M) (k) :
    ∑ i, a (i + k) = ∑ i, a i
proof:
:=
  Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight k) _ _ (λ _ ↦ rfl)

name: Fin_castLE_eq_natCast_val
statement:
theorem Fin_castLE_eq_natCast_val [NeZero m] (h : n ≤ m) (i : Fin n) :
    i.castLE h = i.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_castLE, Fin.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (i.2.trans_le h)]

name: main_identity
statement:
theorem main_identity [CommSemiring R] [NeZero n] (hn : n ≥ 5) (x : Fin n → R) :
    ∑ i, (x i ^ 2 + 2 * x i * (x (i + 1) + x (i + 1 + 1)))
      = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * ∑ j : Fin 5, x (i + j.castLE hn)
proof:
:= by
  
  calc ∑ i, (x i ^ 2 + 2 * x i * (x (i + 1) + x (i + 1 + 1)))
    _ = ∑ i, (x i ^ 2 + 2 * x i * (x (i + 1) + x (i + 2))) := by
      conv_lhs => right; ext i; rw [add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two]
    _ = ∑ i, (x (i + 2) * x i + x (i + 1) * x i + x i * x i
        + x i * x (i + 1) + x i * x (i + 2)) :=
      Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ _ ↦ by ring
    _ = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x i + ∑ i, x (i + 1) * x i + ∑ i, x i * x i
        + ∑ i, x i * x (i + 1) + ∑ i, x i * x (i + 2) := by
      iterate 4 rw [sum_add_distrib]
    _ = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 0) + ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 1) + ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 2)
        + ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 3) + ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 4) := ?_
    _ = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + Fin.castLE hn 0)
        + ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + Fin.castLE hn 1)
        + ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + Fin.castLE hn 2)
        + ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + Fin.castLE hn 3)
        + ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + Fin.castLE hn 4) := by
      simp only [Fin_castLE_eq_natCast_val]; rfl
    _ = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * ∑ j : Fin 5, x (i + j.castLE hn) := by
      simp_rw [Fin.sum_univ_five, mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
  
  refine congrArg₂ _ (congrArg₂ _ (congrArg₂ _ (congrArg₂ _ ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
  
  · simp only [add_zero]
  
  · calc ∑ i, x (i + 1) * x i
      _ = ∑ i, x (i + 1 + 1) * x (i + 1) := (Fin_sum_add_right _ 1).symm
      _ = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 1) := by simp_rw [add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two]
  
  · exact (Fin_sum_add_right _ 2).symm
  
  · calc ∑ i, x i * x (i + 1)
      _ = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 2 + 1) := (Fin_sum_add_right _ 2).symm
      _ = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 3) := by simp_rw [add_assoc, two_add_one_eq_three]
  
  · calc ∑ i, x i * x (i + 2)
      _ = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 2 + 2) := (Fin_sum_add_right _ 2).symm
      _ = ∑ i, x (i + 2) * x (i + 4) := by simp_rw [add_assoc, two_add_two_eq_four]

name: main_ineq_identity
statement:
theorem main_ineq_identity [CommSemiring R] [hn : NeZero n] (x : Fin (n + 1) → R) :
    ∑ i, x i * x (i + 1) + x (Fin.last n) * x 1
      = ∑ i : Fin n, x i.succ * x (i + 1).succ + x 0 * (x (Fin.last n) + x 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with | zero => exact absurd rfl (NeZero.ne 0) | succ n => ?_
  calc ∑ i, x i * x (i + 1) + x (Fin.last (n + 1)) * x 1
    _ = x 0 * x 1 + (∑ i : Fin n, x i.castSucc.succ * x (i.castSucc.succ + 1)
        + x (Fin.last n.succ) * x 0) + x (Fin.last (n + 1)) * x 1 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc,
        zero_add, Fin.succ_last, Fin.last_add_one]
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, x i.castSucc.succ * x (i.castSucc.succ + 1)
        + (x (Fin.last (n + 1)) * x 1) + x 0 * (x (Fin.last (n + 1)) + x 1) := by
      rw [add_rotate', mul_comm _ (x 0), ← mul_add, add_right_comm]
    _ = ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), x i.succ * x (i + 1).succ
        + x 0 * (x (Fin.last (n + 1)) + x 1) := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.last_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_last]
      simp_rw [Fin.succ_castSucc, Fin.coeSucc_eq_succ]

name: exists_index_special
statement:
theorem exists_index_special
    [AddCommMonoid G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid G] [AddLeftStrictMono G]
    (hn : n ≥ 5) {x : Fin n → G} (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (j₁ j₂) :
    ∃ i₀, 4 • (x (i₀ + j₁) + x (i₀ + j₂)) ≤ x i₀ + 2 • ∑ i ∈ {i₀}ᶜ, x i
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := NeZero.of_gt hn
  
  by_contra! hx0
  suffices (2 * n) • ∑ i, x i < 9 • ∑ i, x i
    from this.not_ge <| nsmul_le_nsmul_left (sum_nonneg λ i _ ↦ hx i)
      (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hn))
  calc (2 * n) • ∑ i, x i
    _ = ∑ _ : Fin n, 2 • ∑ i, x i := by rw [sum_const, card_fin, mul_nsmul]
    _ = ∑ i₀, (x i₀ + 2 • ∑ i ∈ {i₀}ᶜ, x i + x i₀) := by
      refine Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ i₀ ↦ ?_
      rw [add_right_comm, ← two_nsmul, ← nsmul_add, ← Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_compl]
    _ = ∑ i₀, (x i₀ + 2 • ∑ i ∈ {i₀}ᶜ, x i) + ∑ i, x i := sum_add_distrib
    _ < ∑ i₀, 4 • (x (i₀ + j₁) + x (i₀ + j₂)) + ∑ i, x i :=
      add_lt_add_left (sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty univ_nonempty λ i _ ↦ hx0 i) _
    _ = 4 • (∑ i, x i + ∑ i, x i) + ∑ i, x i := by
      rw [sum_nsmul, sum_add_distrib, Fin_sum_add_right, Fin_sum_add_right]
    _ = 9 • ∑ i, x i := by rw [← two_nsmul, ← mul_nsmul, ← succ_nsmul]

name: main_ineq_Fin4
statement: theorem main_ineq_Fin4 (x : Fin 4 → R) : 4 * ∑ i, x i * x (i + 1) ≤ (∑ i, x i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc 4 * ∑ i, x i * x (i + 1)
    _ = 4 * (x 0 * x 1 + x 1 * x 2 + x 2 * x 3 + x 3 * x 0) :=
      congrArg (4 * ·) (Fin.sum_univ_four _)
    _ = 4 * (x 0 + x 2) * (x 1 + x 3) := by
      rw [mul_comm (x 1), ← add_mul, add_assoc, mul_comm (x 3),
        ← add_mul, add_comm (x 2), ← mul_add, mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ (x 0 + x 2 + (x 1 + x 3)) ^ 2 := four_mul_le_pow_two_add _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ i, x i) ^ 2 := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_four, add_add_add_comm, ← add_assoc]

name: main_ineq
statement:
theorem main_ineq [hn : NeZero n] (hn0 : n ≥ 4) {x : Fin n → R} (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) :
    4 * ∑ i, x i * x (i + 1) ≤ (∑ i, x i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  induction n, hn0 using Nat.le_induction generalizing hn with
  | base => exact main_ineq_Fin4 x
  | succ n hn0 n_ih => ?_
  
  wlog h : 4 • (x (Fin.last n) + x 1) ≤ x 0 + 2 • ∑ i ∈ {0}ᶜ, x i generalizing x
  · 
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ :
        ∃ i₀, 4 • (x (i₀ + Fin.last n) + x (i₀ + 1)) ≤ x i₀ + 2 • ∑ i ∈ {i₀}ᶜ, x i :=
      exists_index_special (Nat.succ_le_succ hn0) hx _ _
    
    calc 4 * ∑ i, x i * x (i + 1)
      _ = 4 * ∑ i, x (i₀ + i) * x (i₀ + i + 1) :=
        congrArg (4 * ·) (Fin_sum_add_left _ _).symm
      _ = 4 * ∑ i, x (i₀ + i) * x (i₀ + (i + 1)) := by simp only [add_assoc]
      _ ≤ (∑ i, x (i₀ + i)) ^ 2 := by
        refine this (λ _ ↦ hx _) <| hi₀.trans_eq <| congrArg₂ (x · + 2 • ·)
          (add_zero _).symm (sum_equiv (Equiv.addLeft i₀) (λ i ↦ ?_) (λ _ _ ↦ rfl)).symm
        rw [mem_compl, mem_singleton, mem_compl,
          mem_singleton, Equiv.coe_addLeft, add_eq_left]
      _ = (∑ i, x i) ^ 2 := congrArg (· ^ 2) (Fin_sum_add_left _ _)
  
  have hn1 : NeZero n := NeZero.of_gt hn0
  specialize n_ih (x := λ i ↦ x i.succ) (λ _ ↦ hx _)
  
  calc 4 * ∑ i, x i * x (i + 1)
    _ ≤ 4 * (∑ i, x i * x (i + 1) + x (Fin.last n) * x 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha := zero_le_four)
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (hx _) (hx _)))
    _ = 4 * ∑ i : Fin n, x i.succ * x (i + 1).succ + x 0 * 4 • (x (Fin.last n) + x 1) := by
      rw [main_ineq_identity, mul_add, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm, Nat.cast_four]
    _ ≤ (∑ i : Fin n, x i.succ) ^ 2 + x 0 * (x 0 + 2 • ∑ i ∈ {0}ᶜ, x i) :=
      add_le_add n_ih (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (hx _))
    _ = (∑ i, x i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Fin.image_succ_univ, sum_image (Set.injOn_of_injective (Fin.succ_injective n)),
        mul_add, ← sq, ← add_assoc, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_two, mul_comm, ← add_sq',
        add_comm, ← Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: general_result
statement:
theorem general_result [NeZero n] (hn : n ≥ 5) (a : Fin n → R) :
    (3 * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  /- Prove `(3 ∑_i a_i^2 a_{i + 1})^2 ≤ (∑_i a_i^2)(∑_i (a_i^2 + 2 a_{i + 1} a_{i + 2})^2)`.
    Thus we only need to prove `∑_i (a_i^2 + 2 a_{i + 1} a_{i + 2})^2 ≤ 2 (∑_i a_i^2)^2`. -/
  calc (3 * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1)) ^ 2
    _ = (∑ i, (a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1) + 2 * (a (i + 1) ^ 2 * a (i + 1 + 1)))) ^ 2 := by
      rw [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, Fin_sum_add_right (λ i ↦ a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1)),
        add_comm, ← add_one_mul, two_add_one_eq_three]
    _ = (∑ i, a (i + 1) * (a i ^ 2 + 2 * a (i + 1) * a (i + 1 + 1))) ^ 2 :=
      congrArg (· ^ 2) (Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ i ↦ by ring)
    _ ≤ (∑ i, a (i + 1) ^ 2) * (∑ i, (a i ^ 2 + 2 * a (i + 1) * a (i + 1 + 1)) ^ 2) :=
      sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ i, a (i + 1) ^ 2) * (2 * (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Fintype.sum_nonneg λ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _)
    _ = 2 * (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ 3 := by
      rw [Fin_sum_add_right (λ i ↦ a i ^ 2), mul_left_comm, ← pow_succ']
  /- Now break up LHS into `∑_i (a_i^4 + 4 a_i^2 a_{i + 1} a_{i + 2})` and
    `4 ∑_{i + 1} a_i^2 a_{i + 1}^2 ≤ (∑_i a_i^2)^2`, so it remains to show that
    `∑_i (a_i^4 + 4 a_i^2 a_{i + 1} a_{i + 2}) ≤ (∑_i a_i^2)^2`. -/
  calc ∑ i, (a i ^ 2 + 2 * a (i + 1) * a (i + 1 + 1)) ^ 2
    _ = ∑ i, ((a i ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * a i ^ 2 * (2 * a (i + 1) * a (i + 1 + 1))
        + 4 * (a (i + 1) ^ 2 * a (i + 1 + 1) ^ 2)) :=
      Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ _ ↦ by ring
    _ = ∑ i, ((a i ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * a i ^ 2 * (2 * a (i + 1) * a (i + 1 + 1)))
        + 4 * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, Fin_sum_add_right (λ i ↦ a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1) ^ 2)]
    _ ≤ (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ 2 + (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
      add_le_add ?_ (main_ineq (Nat.le_of_lt hn) (λ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _))
    _ = 2 * (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ 2 := (two_mul _).symm
  /- Finally, prove `∑_i (a_i^4 + 4 a_i^2 a_{i + 1} a_{i + 2}) ≤ (∑_i a_i^2)^2`. -/
  calc ∑ i, ((a i ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * a i ^ 2 * (2 * a (i + 1) * a (i + 1 + 1)))
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ((a i ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * a i ^ 2 * (a (i + 1) ^ 2 + a (i + 1 + 1) ^ 2)) :=
      sum_le_sum λ i _ ↦ add_le_add_right (a := (a i ^ 2) ^ 2) <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (two_mul_le_add_sq _ _)
          (mul_nonneg zero_le_two (sq_nonneg _))
    _ = ∑ i, a (i + 2) ^ 2 * ∑ j : Fin 5, a (i + j.castLE hn) ^ 2 :=
      main_identity hn _
    _ = ∑ i, a (i + 2) ^ 2 * ∑ j ∈ image (Fin.castLE hn) univ, a (i + j) ^ 2 :=
      Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ i ↦ congrArg (_ * ·)
        (sum_image (f := λ j ↦ a (i + j) ^ 2)
          (Set.injOn_of_injective (Fin.castLE_injective hn))).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i, a (i + 2) ^ 2 * ∑ j, a (i + j) ^ 2 :=
      sum_le_sum λ _ _ ↦ mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg λ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = ∑ i, a (i + 2) ^ 2 * ∑ j, a j ^ 2 :=
      Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ i ↦ congrArg (_ * ·) (Fin_sum_add_left (λ j ↦ a j ^ 2) i)
    _ = (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Fin_sum_add_right (λ i ↦ a i ^ 2 * ∑ j, a j ^ 2), sq, sum_mul]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [NeZero n] (hn : n ≥ 5) {a : Fin n → R} (ha : ∑ i, a i ^ 2 = 1) :
    25 * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1) < 12
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 (Nat.ofNat_nonneg 12) ?_
  calc (25 * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1)) ^ 2
    _ = 25 ^ 2 * (∑ i, a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1)) ^ 2 := mul_pow _ _ _
    _ ≤ 70 * 3 ^ 2 * (∑ i, a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1)) ^ 2 := by
      have h : (25 ^ 2 : R) ≤ 70 * 3 ^ 2 := calc
        _ ≤ (25 ^ 2 : R) + 5 := le_add_of_nonneg_right (Nat.ofNat_nonneg 5)
        _ = 70 * 3 ^ 2 := by norm_num
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = 70 * (3 * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 * a (i + 1)) ^ 2 := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_pow]
    _ ≤ 70 * (2 * (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ 3) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (general_result hn a) (Nat.ofNat_nonneg 70)
    _ = 70 * 2 := by rw [ha, one_pow, mul_one]
    _ < 70 * 2 + 4 := lt_add_of_pos_right _ four_pos
    _ = 12 ^ 2 := by norm_num

name: final_solution_part1
statement:
theorem final_solution_part1 {x : ℕ → G} (hx : Monotone x) (h0 : k ≤ m) (h1 : m ≤ n) :
    a k - a m ≤ 2 • (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (λ i ↦ |x i - a i|)
proof:
:=
  
  let L := (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (λ i ↦ |x i - a i|)
  calc a k - a m
  _ ≤ (a k - x k) + (x m - a m) := by
    rw [sub_add, sub_le_sub_iff_left, ← sub_add, add_le_iff_nonpos_left, sub_nonpos]
    exact le_of_eq_of_le rfl (hx h0)
  _ ≤ |(a k - x k) + (x m - a m)| := le_abs_self _
  _ ≤ |a k - x k| + |x m - a m| := abs_add_le _ _
  _ = |x k - a k| + |x m - a m| := by rw [abs_sub_comm]
  _ ≤ L + L := by
    have h2 (i) (hi : i ≤ n) : |x i - a i| ≤ L :=
      le_sup' (λ i ↦ |x i - a i|) (mem_range_succ_iff.mpr hi)
    exact add_le_add (h2 k (h0.trans h1)) (h2 m h1)
  _ = 2 • L := (two_nsmul L).symm

name: final_solution_part2
statement:
theorem final_solution_part2 (ha : ∀ k m : ℕ, k ≤ m → m ≤ n → a k - a m ≤ 2 • g) :
    ∃ x : ℕ → G, Monotone x ∧
      (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (λ i ↦ |x i - a i|) = g
proof:
:= by
  
  let x (i : ℕ) : G := (range (i + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a - g
  refine ⟨x, ?_, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  
  · intro k m h
    refine sub_le_sub_right (sup'_le _ _ λ i hi ↦ le_sup' _ ?_) g
    rw [mem_range_succ_iff] at hi ⊢
    exact hi.trans h
  
  · refine sup'_le _ _ λ i hi ↦ abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    
    · rw [neg_le_sub_iff_le_add, sub_add_cancel]
      exact le_sup' _ (self_mem_range_succ i)
    
    · obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ :
          ∃ k ∈ range (i + 1), (range (i + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a = a k :=
        exists_mem_eq_sup' _ _
      rw [mem_range_succ_iff] at hi hk
      rw [sub_right_comm, sub_le_iff_le_add, ← two_nsmul, h]
      exact le_of_eq_of_le rfl (ha k i hk hi)
  
  · calc g
      _ ≤ |g| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |(range 1).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a - g - a 0| := by
        simp only [range_one]; rw [sup'_singleton, sub_sub_cancel_left, abs_neg]
      _ ≤ (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (λ i ↦ |x i - a i|) :=
        le_sup' (λ i ↦ |x i - a i|) (mem_range_succ_iff.mpr (Nat.zero_le n))

name: eq_one_iff_forall_NatPrimes_not_dvd
statement:
theorem eq_one_iff_forall_NatPrimes_not_dvd {k : ℕ+} :
    k = 1 ↔ ∀ p : Nat.Primes, ¬(p : ℕ) ∣ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PNat.coe_eq_one_iff, Nat.eq_one_iff_not_exists_prime_dvd]
  exact Iff.symm Subtype.forall

name: modeq_iff_dvd_add_of_dvd_add
statement:
theorem modeq_iff_dvd_add_of_dvd_add (h : n ∣ b + c) :
    a ≡ b [MOD n] ↔ n ∣ a + c
proof:
:=
  calc a ≡ b [MOD n]
  _ ↔ a + c ≡ b + c [MOD n] := (Nat.ModEq.add_iff_right rfl).symm
  _ ↔ n ∣ a + c := by rw [Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]

name: id_is_good
statement: theorem id_is_good : good id
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ _ ↦ Iff.rfl

name: prime_dvd_map_iff_find_min_dvd
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_map_iff_find_min_dvd (p : Nat.Primes) (hpf : ∃ n, (p : ℕ) ∣ f n) :
    (p : ℕ) ∣ f n ↔ (PNat.find hpf : ℕ) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  set d : ℕ+ := PNat.find hpf
  
  induction n using PNat.strongInductionOn with | _ n n_ih => ?_
  
  have hd : (p : ℕ) ∣ f d := PNat.find_spec hpf
  obtain hn | rfl | hn : n < d ∨ n = d ∨ d < n := lt_trichotomy _ _
  
  · exact iff_of_false (PNat.find_min hpf hn)
      (λ h ↦ hn.not_ge (PNat.le_of_dvd (PNat.dvd_iff.mpr h)))
  
  · exact iff_of_true hd (dvd_refl _)
  
  · replace hn : d + (n - d) = n := PNat.add_sub_of_lt hn
    rw [← hn, hf, Nat.dvd_add_right hd, PNat.add_coe, Nat.dvd_add_self_left]
    exact n_ih _ ((PNat.lt_add_left _ _).trans_eq hn)

name: map_modeq_prime_iff_modeq
statement:
theorem map_modeq_prime_iff_modeq
    (p : Nat.Primes) {d : ℕ+} (hpd : ∀ n, (p : ℕ) ∣ f n ↔ (d : ℕ) ∣ n) {m n} :
    f m ≡ f n [MOD p] ↔ m ≡ n [MOD d]
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ+, (d : ℕ) ∣ n + k := by
    have h : (n : ℕ) % d < d := Nat.mod_lt n d.pos
    refine ⟨⟨d - n % d, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt h⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [PNat.mk_coe, ← Nat.add_sub_assoc h.le, Nat.add_comm,
      Nat.add_sub_assoc (Nat.mod_le _ _), Nat.dvd_add_self_left]
    exact Nat.dvd_sub_mod _
  
  have hk0 : (p : ℕ) ∣ f n + f k := by rwa [← PNat.add_coe, ← hpd, hf] at hk
  
  calc f m ≡ f n [MOD p]
  _ ↔ (p : ℕ) ∣ f m + f k := modeq_iff_dvd_add_of_dvd_add hk0
  _ ↔ (p : ℕ) ∣ f (m + k) := (hf p m k).symm
  _ ↔ (d : ℕ) ∣ m + k := hpd _
  _ ↔ m ≡ n [MOD d] := (modeq_iff_dvd_add_of_dvd_add hk).symm

name: map_modeq_prime_iff_modeq_find
statement:
theorem map_modeq_prime_iff_modeq_find (p : Nat.Primes) (hpf : ∃ n, (p : ℕ) ∣ f n) {m n} :
    f m ≡ f n [MOD p] ↔ m ≡ n [MOD (PNat.find hpf)]
proof:
:=
  hf.map_modeq_prime_iff_modeq p λ _ ↦ hf.prime_dvd_map_iff_find_min_dvd p _

name: injective_of_infinite_prime_dvd
statement:
theorem injective_of_infinite_prime_dvd
    (hf0 : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ p : Nat.Primes, N ≤ p ∧ ∃ n, (p : ℕ) ∣ f n) : f.Injective
proof:
:= by
  
  intro m n h
  wlog h0 : n < m generalizing h m n
  · exact (eq_or_lt_of_not_gt h0).elim id λ h1 ↦ (this h.symm h1).symm
  
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n + k = m := ⟨m - n, PNat.add_sub_of_lt h0⟩
  
  obtain ⟨p, hpk, hp⟩ : ∃ p : Nat.Primes, (f k : ℕ) < p ∧ ∃ n, (p : ℕ) ∣ f n := hf0 _
  /- Let `d` be the minimal positive integer such that `p ∣ f(d)`.
    Then `f(n + k) = f(n)` implies `d ∣ k ↔ p ∣ f(k)`; contradiction. -/
  let d : ℕ+ := PNat.find hp
  replace h0 (n) : (p : ℕ) ∣ f n ↔ (d : ℕ) ∣ n :=
    hf.prime_dvd_map_iff_find_min_dvd p hp
  replace h : n + k ≡ n [MOD d] :=
    (hf.map_modeq_prime_iff_modeq p h0).mp (congrArg (λ (n : ℕ+) ↦ (n : ℕ) % p) h)
  rw [Nat.ModEq.comm, Nat.left_modEq_add_iff, ← h0] at h
  exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd (f k).pos h) hpk.not_ge

name: eq_id_of_surjective
statement: theorem eq_id_of_surjective (hf0 : f.Surjective) : f = id
proof:
:= by
  
  have hf1 (p : Nat.Primes) : ∃ n, (p : ℕ) ∣ f n := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, f n = ⟨p.val, p.2.pos⟩ := hf0 _
    exact ⟨n, dvd_of_eq (congrArg PNat.val hn.symm)⟩
  
  have hf2 : f.Injective :=
    hf.injective_of_infinite_prime_dvd λ N ↦
      (Nat.exists_infinite_primes N).elim λ p ⟨hpN, hp⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hpN, hf1 _⟩
  
  have hf3 (p : Nat.Primes) : PNat.find (hf1 p) > 1 := by
    
    refine one_lt_of_ne_one λ h ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, f x = 1 := hf0 1
    
    have h0 : (PNat.find (hf1 p) : ℕ) ∣ x := h ▸ Nat.one_dvd _
    rw [← hf.prime_dvd_map_iff_find_min_dvd, hx] at h0
    exact p.2.not_dvd_one h0
  
  funext n; change f n = n
  induction n using PNat.caseStrongInductionOn with
  | hz =>
      
      refine eq_one_iff_forall_NatPrimes_not_dvd.mpr λ p ↦ ?_
      rw [hf.prime_dvd_map_iff_find_min_dvd p (hf1 p), ← PNat.dvd_iff, PNat.dvd_one_iff]
      exact (hf3 p).ne.symm
  | hi n n_ih =>
      
      obtain hn | hn : f (n + 1) ≤ n ∨ n < f (n + 1) := le_or_gt _ _
      · exact hf2 (n_ih _ hn)
      
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, n + k = f (n + 1) := ⟨f (n + 1) - n, PNat.add_sub_of_lt hn⟩
      
      suffices k = 1 by rw [← hk, this]
      
      refine eq_one_iff_forall_NatPrimes_not_dvd.mpr λ p ↦ ?_
      have h : ¬((n + 1 : ℕ+) : ℕ) ≡ n [MOD (PNat.find (hf1 p))] := by
        rw [PNat.add_coe, Nat.add_modEq_left_iff, ← PNat.dvd_iff, PNat.dvd_one_iff]
        exact (hf3 p).ne.symm
      rwa [← hf.map_modeq_prime_iff_modeq_find, ← hk, PNat.add_coe,
        n_ih n (le_refl n), Nat.add_modEq_left_iff] at h

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution {f} : (good f ∧ f.Surjective) ↔ f = id
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ ⟨hf, hf0⟩ ↦ hf.eq_id_of_surjective hf0,
  λ hf ↦ hf ▸ ⟨id_is_good, Function.surjective_id⟩⟩

name: easy_ineq
statement: theorem easy_ineq (x : F) : 0 ≤ (1 + x ^ 2) / (1 + x ^ 4)
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (add_nonneg zero_le_one (sq_nonneg x))
    (add_nonneg zero_le_one ((even_two_mul 2).pow_nonneg x))

name: sum_easy_ineq
statement:
theorem sum_easy_ineq (x : F) (S : Finset ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, (1 + x ^ (2 * i)) / (1 + x ^ (4 * i))
proof:
:= by
  refine sum_nonneg λ i _ ↦ ?_
  iterate 2 rw [mul_comm, pow_mul]
  exact easy_ineq _

name: main_ineq
statement: theorem main_ineq {x : F} (hx : 0 < x) (hx0 : x < 1) : (1 + x ^ 2) / (1 + x ^ 4) < x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h : 3 ≠ 0 := Nat.succ_ne_zero 2
  replace hx0 : 0 < (x ^ 3 - 1) * (x - 1) :=
    mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr (pow_lt_one₀ hx.le hx0 h)) (sub_neg.mpr hx0)
  replace hx0 : 0 < (x ^ 3 * x + 1) - (x + x ^ 3) := by
    rwa [mul_sub_one, sub_one_mul, sub_sub_sub_eq] at hx0
  replace hx0 : (1 + x ^ 2) * x < 1 + x ^ 4 :=
    calc (1 + x ^ 2) * x
    _ = x + x ^ 3 := by rw [one_add_mul, ← pow_succ]
    _ < x ^ 3 * x + 1 := sub_pos.mp hx0
    _ = 1 + x ^ 4 := by rw [← pow_succ, add_comm]
  rwa [inv_eq_one_div, div_lt_div_iff₀ (add_pos one_pos (pow_pos hx 4)) hx, one_mul]

name: sum_main_ineq
statement:
theorem sum_main_ineq {x : F} (hx : 0 < x) (hx0 : x < 1) (hx1 : 0 < n) :
    ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 n, (1 + x ^ (2 * i)) / (1 + x ^ (4 * i))
        < (1 - x ^ n) / (x ^ n * (1 - x))
proof:
:=
  have hx2 : x ≠ 0 := hx.ne.symm
  calc ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 n, (1 + x ^ (2 * i)) / (1 + x ^ (4 * i))
    _ < ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 n, x⁻¹ ^ i := by
      refine sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty (nonempty_Icc.mpr hx1) (λ i hi ↦ ?_)
      replace hi : i ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (mem_Icc.mp hi).1
      rw [mul_comm, pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, inv_pow]
      exact main_ineq (pow_pos hx _) (pow_lt_one₀ hx.le hx0 hi)
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range n, x⁻¹ ^ (1 + i) := by
      rw [← Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc, sum_Ico_eq_sum_range, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range n, x⁻¹ * x⁻¹ ^ i :=
      sum_congr rfl λ _ _ ↦ by rw [Nat.add_comm, pow_succ']
    _ = x⁻¹ * ((x - 1)⁻¹ * (x - x⁻¹ ^ n * x)) := by
      rw [← mul_sum, geom_sum_inv hx0.ne hx2]
    _ = (x - 1)⁻¹ * (1 - x⁻¹ ^ n) := by
      rw [mul_left_comm, ← one_sub_mul, mul_comm _ x, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hx2]
    _ = (x⁻¹ ^ n - 1) / (1 - x) := by
      rw [inv_mul_eq_div, ← neg_div_neg_eq, neg_sub, neg_sub]
    _ = (1 - x ^ n) / (x ^ n * (1 - x)) := by
      rw [inv_pow, inv_eq_one_div, div_sub_one (pow_ne_zero _ hx2), div_div]

name: final_solution
proof:
:= calc
  _ < (1 - x ^ n) / (x ^ n * (1 - x)) * ((1 - y ^ n) / (y ^ n * (1 - y))) := by
    
    obtain (rfl | hn) : n = 0 ∨ 0 < n := n.eq_zero_or_pos
    · rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, add_eq_left] at h
      exact absurd h one_ne_zero
    
    have X (a b : F) (hb : 0 < b) (h : a ^ n + b ^ n = 1) : a < 1 :=
      lt_of_not_ge λ h1 ↦ h.not_gt (lt_add_of_le_of_pos (one_le_pow₀ h1) (pow_pos hb n))
    exact mul_lt_mul'' (sum_main_ineq hx (X x y hy h) hn)
      (sum_main_ineq hy (X y x hx ((add_comm _ _).trans h)) hn)
      (sum_easy_ineq _ _) (sum_easy_ineq _ _)
  _ = y ^ n / (x ^ n * (1 - x)) * (x ^ n / (y ^ n * (1 - y))) := by
    rw [← eq_sub_of_add_eq h, ← eq_sub_of_add_eq' h]
  _ = (x ^ n * y ^ n) / ((x ^ n * y ^ n) * ((1 - x) * (1 - y))) := by
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_comm]
  _ = 1 / ((1 - x) * (1 - y)) := by
    rw [← div_div, ← mul_pow, div_self (pow_pos (mul_pos hx hy) n).ne.symm]

name: bad_pair.symm
statement: theorem bad_pair.symm (h : bad_pair a x y) : bad_pair a y x
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [bad_pair, ← Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd, Int.mul_right_comm] at h
  rw [bad_pair, ← Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
  
  calc (a * y ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2
  _ ≡ (a * y ^ 2 - (a * y * x) ^ 2) ^ 2 [ZMOD a * y * x - 1] :=
    (((Int.modEq_sub _ _).pow 2).symm.sub_left _).pow 2
  _ ≡ (a * y ^ 2) ^ 2 * (a * x ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 [ZMOD a * y * x - 1] := by
    rw [← Int.neg_sub 1 (a * x ^ 2), neg_sq, ← mul_pow, mul_one_sub,
      mul_mul_mul_comm, ← sq, ← mul_pow, ← mul_pow, mul_assoc]
  _ ≡ (a * y ^ 2) ^ 2 * 0 [ZMOD a * y * x - 1] := h.mul_left _
  _ ≡ 0 [ZMOD a * y * x - 1] := by rw [Int.mul_zero]

name: general_descent
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases h with ⟨t, h⟩
  
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : ∃ z, t = N * z - 1 := by
    
    replace h : 1 ≡ -t [ZMOD N] := calc
      (0 - 1) ^ 2 ≡ (N * x - 1) ^ 2 [ZMOD N] :=
        ((Int.dvd_mul_right N x).zero_modEq_int.sub_right 1).pow 2
      _ ≡ (N * y - 1) * t [ZMOD N] := by rw [h]
      _ ≡ (0 - 1) * t [ZMOD N] :=
        ((Int.dvd_mul_right N y).modEq_zero_int.sub_right 1).mul_right t
      _ ≡ -t [ZMOD N] := by rw [Int.zero_sub, Int.neg_one_mul]
    
    rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd, ← neg_add', Int.dvd_neg] at h
    rcases h with ⟨z, h⟩
    exact ⟨z, eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr h⟩
  
  have hN0 {c} (hc : 0 < c) : N * c - 1 > 0 :=
    sub_pos_of_lt (one_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le hN (by exact hc))
  have hN0y : N * y - 1 > 0 := hN0 (hx.trans hxy)
  
  replace hN : N > 0 := Int.one_pos.trans hN
  
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_, h.symm⟩
  
  · refine lt_of_not_ge λ hz ↦ h.not_gt ?_
    
    replace hz : N * z - 1 < 0 := calc
      N * z - 1 < N * z := sub_one_lt _
      _ ≤ 0 := Int.mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hN.le hz
    
    calc (N * y - 1) * (N * z - 1)
      _ < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hN0y hz
      _ ≤ (N * x - 1) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  
  · 
    replace hxy : N * x - 1 < N * y - 1 :=
      Int.sub_lt_sub_right (Int.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hxy hN) 1
    
    refine lt_of_not_ge λ hxz ↦ h.not_lt ?_
    replace hxz : N * x - 1 ≤ N * z - 1 :=
      Int.sub_le_sub_right (Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxz hN.le) 1
    
    calc (N * x - 1) ^ 2
      _ = (N * x - 1) * (N * x - 1) := sq _
      _ < (N * y - 1) * (N * z - 1) := Int.mul_lt_mul hxy hxz (hN0 hx) hN0y.le

name: bad_pair.descent
statement:
theorem bad_pair.descent (ha : a > 1) (hx : x > 0) (hxy : x < y) (h : bad_pair a x y) :
    ∃ z > 0, z < x ∧ bad_pair a x z
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [bad_pair, sq x, ← Int.mul_assoc] at h
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx, h0⟩ : ∃ z > 0, z < x ∧ _ :=
    general_descent (one_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le ha hx) hx hxy h
  refine ⟨z, hz, hzx, a * x * y - 1, ?_⟩
  rw [sq x, ← Int.mul_assoc, ← h0, Int.mul_comm]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (ha : 1 < a) (hx : x > 0) (hy : y > 0) (h : bad_pair a x y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  
  induction x using Int.strongRec (m := 1) generalizing y with
  | lt x hx0 => exact absurd hx hx0.not_ge
  | ge x hx0 x_ih => ?_
  
  obtain h0 | h0 | h0 : x < y ∨ x = y ∨ y < x := Int.lt_trichotomy x y
  
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx, h1⟩ := h.descent ha hx h0
    exact absurd (x_ih z hzx hz hx h1.symm) hzx.ne
  
  · exact h0
  
  · exact (x_ih y h0 hy hx h.symm).symm

name: padicValNat_add_factorial_of_lt_dvd
statement:
theorem padicValNat_add_factorial_of_lt_dvd
    [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hr : r < p ^ k) (hm : p ^ k ∣ m) :
    padicValNat p (m + r).factorial
      = padicValNat p m.factorial + padicValNat p r.factorial
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p > 0 := hp.out.pos
  
  induction k generalizing r m with
    | zero => rw [Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hr, Nat.factorial_zero, padicValNat_one_right]; rfl
    | succ k k_ih => ?_
  
  obtain ⟨q, s, hs, rfl⟩ : ∃ q, ∃ s < p, q * p + s = r :=
    ⟨r / p, r % p, Nat.mod_lt _ hp0, Nat.div_add_mod' r p⟩
  replace hr : q < p ^ k := Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (Nat.lt_of_add_right_lt hr)
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : p ∣ m := dvd_of_mul_left_dvd hm
  replace hm : p ^ k ∣ n := by rwa [Nat.pow_succ', Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hp0] at hm
  
  rw [← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_comm q p, ← Nat.mul_add, padicValNat_factorial_mul]
  iterate 2 rw [padicValNat_factorial_mul_add _ hs, padicValNat_factorial_mul]
  rw [Nat.add_add_add_comm, k_ih hr hm]

name: one_lt_two_mul_prod_prime
statement: theorem one_lt_two_mul_prod_prime : 1 < 2 * ∏ i, p i
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ <| Nat.pos_of_ne_zero <|
    prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr λ i _ ↦ (hp i).out.ne_zero

name: stdSeq_succ
statement: theorem stdSeq_succ (n) : stdSeq p (n + 1) = (2 * ∏ i, p i) ^ stdSeq p n
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: stdSeq_strictMono
statement: theorem stdSeq_strictMono : StrictMono (stdSeq p)
proof:
:= by
  refine strictMono_of_lt_add_one λ n _ ↦ ?_
  calc stdSeq p n
    _ < (2 * ∏ i, p i) ^ stdSeq p n := Nat.lt_pow_self (one_lt_two_mul_prod_prime p)
    _ = stdSeq p (n + 1) := (stdSeq_succ p n).symm

name: two_mul_stdSeq_le_stdSeq_succ
statement: theorem two_mul_stdSeq_le_stdSeq_succ (n) : 2 * stdSeq p n ≤ stdSeq p (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  calc 2 * stdSeq p n
  _ ≤ 2 ^ stdSeq p n := Nat.mul_le_pow (Nat.succ_ne_self 1) _
  _ ≤ (2 * ∏ i, p i) ^ stdSeq p n :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_left (one_lt_two_mul_prod_prime p) _
  _ = stdSeq p (n + 1) := (stdSeq_succ p n).symm

name: sum_stdSeq_range_lt_stdSeq
statement: theorem sum_stdSeq_range_lt_stdSeq (n) : ∑ j ∈ range n, stdSeq p j < stdSeq p n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with | zero => exact Nat.zero_lt_one | succ n n_ih => ?_
  calc ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), stdSeq p j
    _ = ∑ j ∈ range n, stdSeq p j + stdSeq p n := sum_range_succ _ _
    _ < stdSeq p n + stdSeq p n := Nat.add_lt_add_right n_ih _
    _ = 2 * stdSeq p n := (Nat.two_mul _).symm
    _ ≤ stdSeq p (n + 1) := two_mul_stdSeq_le_stdSeq_succ p n

name: padicValNat_sum_stdSeq
statement:
theorem padicValNat_sum_stdSeq (i : ι) (S : Finset ℕ) :
    padicValNat (p i) (∑ k ∈ S, stdSeq p k).factorial
      = ∑ k ∈ S, padicValNat (p i) (stdSeq p k).factorial
proof:
:= by
  
  induction S using Finset.induction_on_max with
    | empty => exact padicValNat_one_right _
    | insert m S hmS S_ih => ?_
  
  obtain rfl | ⟨n, rfl⟩ : m = 0 ∨ ∃ n, m = n + 1 :=
    (Nat.eq_zero_or_eq_succ_pred m).imp_right λ hm ↦ ⟨Nat.pred m, hm⟩
  · obtain rfl : S = ∅ :=
      eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr λ j hj ↦ Nat.not_lt_zero j (hmS j hj)
    rfl
  
  have hmS0 : n + 1 ∉ S := λ h ↦ Nat.lt_irrefl _ (hmS _ h)
  rw [sum_insert hmS0, sum_insert hmS0, ← S_ih]
  refine padicValNat_add_factorial_of_lt_dvd (k := stdSeq p n) ?_ ?_
  
  · calc ∑ j ∈ S, stdSeq p j
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), stdSeq p j :=
        sum_le_sum_of_subset λ j hj ↦ mem_range.mpr (hmS j hj)
      _ = ∑ j ∈ range n, stdSeq p j + stdSeq p n := sum_range_succ _ _
      _ < stdSeq p n + stdSeq p n := Nat.add_lt_add_right (sum_stdSeq_range_lt_stdSeq _ _) _
      _ = 2 * stdSeq p n := (Nat.two_mul _).symm
      _ ≤ 2 ^ stdSeq p n := Nat.mul_le_pow (Nat.succ_ne_self 1) _
      _ ≤ p i ^ stdSeq p n := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (hp i).out.two_le _
  
  · calc p i ^ stdSeq p n
      _ ∣ (2 * ∏ j, p j) ^ stdSeq p n :=
        pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd (Nat.dvd_mul_left_of_dvd (dvd_prod_of_mem _ (mem_univ _)) _) _
      _ = stdSeq p (n + 1) := (stdSeq_succ p n).symm

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (d) [NeZero d] (N) :
    ∃ n ≥ N, ∀ i, d ∣ padicValNat (p i) (Nat.factorial n)
proof:
:= by
  
  let f (n : ℕ) (i : ι) : Fin d :=
    (∑ j ∈ range (n + N), padicValNat (p i) (stdSeq p j).factorial : ℕ)
  
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hab0⟩ : ∃ a b, a < b ∧ f a = f b :=
    Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem λ _ ↦ Set.mem_univ _
  replace hab : a + N < b + N := Nat.add_lt_add_right hab N
  
  refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Ico (a + N) (b + N), stdSeq p j, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · calc N
      _ ≤ a + N := Nat.le_add_left _ _
      _ ≤ stdSeq p (a + N) := (stdSeq_strictMono p).id_le _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Ico (a + N) (b + N), stdSeq p j :=
        single_le_sum_of_canonicallyOrdered (left_mem_Ico.mpr hab)
  /- Second, for each `i`, we show that `f(a) = f(b)` implies
    `d ∣ ν_{p_i}([∑_{a + N ≤ j < b + N} (stdSeq p j)]!)`. -/
  · intro i
    replace hab0 :
        ∑ j ∈ range (a + N), padicValNat (p i) (stdSeq p j).factorial
            + ∑ j ∈ Ico (a + N) (b + N), padicValNat (p i) (stdSeq p j).factorial
          ≡ ∑ j ∈ range (a + N), padicValNat (p i) (stdSeq p j).factorial [MOD d] := calc
      _ = ∑ j ∈ range (b + N), padicValNat (p i) (stdSeq p j).factorial :=
        sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ (Nat.le_of_lt hab)
      _ ≡ ∑ j ∈ range (a + N), padicValNat (p i) (stdSeq p j).factorial [MOD d] :=
        congrArg Fin.val (congrFun hab0 i).symm
    rwa [Nat.add_modEq_left_iff, ← padicValNat_sum_stdSeq] at hab0

name: sub_add_sub_le_add_sub
statement: theorem sub_add_sub_le_add_sub (m n k : ℕ) : (m - k) + (n - k) ≤ m + n - k
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h : n ≤ k ∨ k ≤ n := Nat.le_total n k
  
  · calc m - k + (n - k)
    _ = m - k := by rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h, Nat.add_zero]
    _ ≤ m + n - k := Nat.sub_le_sub_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _) _
  
  · calc m - k + (n - k)
    _ ≤ m + (n - k) := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.sub_le _ _) _
    _ = m + n - k := (Nat.add_sub_assoc h _).symm

name: sub_right_is_good
statement: theorem sub_right_is_good (C : ℕ) : good (· - C)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n; calc m - C + (n - C - C)
    _ ≤ (m - C) + (n - C) := Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.sub_le _ _) _
    _ ≤ m + n - C := sub_add_sub_le_add_sub _ _ _
    _ ≤ m + n + 1 - C := Nat.sub_le_sub_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _) _

name: ite_dvd_add_one_is_good
statement:
theorem ite_dvd_add_one_is_good (hK : K ≠ 1) :
    good (λ n ↦ if K ∣ n + 1 then n + 1 else n)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n; dsimp only
  by_cases hn : K ∣ n + 1
  
  · apply Nat.le_of_eq
    have hn0 : ¬K ∣ n + 1 + 1 := by rwa [Nat.dvd_add_right hn, Nat.dvd_one]
    calc (if K ∣ m + 1 then m + 1 else m) + _
      _ = (if K ∣ m + 1 then m + 1 else m) + (n + 1) := by
        rw [ite_eq_left hn, ite_eq_right hn0]
      _ = if K ∣ m + 1 then (m + 1) + (n + 1) else m + (n + 1) := ite_add _ _ _ _
      _ = if K ∣ (m + 1) + (n + 1) then (m + 1) + (n + 1) else m + (n + 1) :=
        if_congr (Nat.dvd_add_iff_left hn) rfl rfl
      _ = if K ∣ m + n + (1 + 1) then m + n + (1 + 1) else m + (n + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.add_add_add_comm]
  
  · calc (if K ∣ m + 1 then m + 1 else m) + _
    _ = (if K ∣ m + 1 then m + 1 else m) + n := by rw [ite_eq_right hn, ite_eq_right hn]
    _ ≤ max (m + 1) m + n := Nat.add_le_add_right (ite_le_sup _ _ _) _
    _ = m + 1 + n := congrArg (· + n) (max_eq_left_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self m))
    _ = m + n + 1 := Nat.add_right_comm _ _ _
    _ = min (m + n + 1 + 1) (m + n + 1) := (min_eq_right_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self _)).symm
    _ ≤ if K ∣ m + n + 1 + 1 then m + n + 1 + 1 else m + n + 1 := inf_le_ite _ _ _

name: monotone
statement: theorem monotone : Monotone g
proof:
:= by
  refine monotone_iff_forall_lt.mpr λ x y h ↦ ?_
  calc g x
    _ ≤ g x + g (g (y - (x + 1))) := Nat.le_add_right _ _
    _ ≤ g (x + (y - (x + 1)) + 1) := hg x (y - (x + 1))
    _ = g y := by rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_of_le h]

name: map_zero
statement: theorem map_zero : g 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos λ h0 ↦
    (hg.monotone h0).not_gt ((Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left h0).trans_le (hg 0 0))

name: map_le_add_of_map_pos
statement: theorem map_le_add_of_map_pos (hm : g m > 0) (n) : g n ≤ m + n
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.le_of_not_lt λ h ↦ Nat.not_lt_of_le (hg m n) ?_
  calc g (m + n + 1)
    _ ≤ g (g n) := hg.monotone h
    _ < g m + g (g n) := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left hm

name: map_bound
statement: theorem map_bound (N : ℕ) : g N ≤ N + 1
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Nat.le_of_not_lt λ hN ↦ ?_
  
  have hN0 (m) : g m + (N + 2) ≤ g (m + (N + 1)) := calc
    _ ≤ g m + g N := Nat.add_le_add_left hN _
    _ ≤ g m + g (N + 2) := Nat.add_le_add_left (hg.monotone (Nat.le_add_right _ _)) _
    _ ≤ g m + g (g N) := Nat.add_le_add_left (hg.monotone hN) _
    _ ≤ g (m + (N + 1)) := hg _ _
  
  replace hN0 (m) : (N + 2) * m ≤ g ((N + 1) * m) := by
    induction m with | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _ | succ m m_ih => ?_
    calc (N + 2) * m + (N + 2)
      _ ≤ g ((N + 1) * m) + (N + 2) := Nat.add_le_add_right m_ih _
      _ ≤ g ((N + 1) * m + (N + 1)) := hN0 _
  
  have hN1 : g ((N + 1) * (N + 1)) ≤ N + (N + 1) * (N + 1) :=
    hg.map_le_add_of_map_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hN) _
  replace hN0 : N + (N + 1) * (N + 1) + 1 ≤ g ((N + 1) * (N + 1)) := calc
    _ = (N + 2) * (N + 1) := by rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.succ_mul]
    _ ≤ g ((N + 1) * (N + 1)) := hN0 _
  exact Nat.not_lt_of_le hN1 hN0

name: eq_map_good_iff
statement: theorem eq_map_good_iff : (∃ g, good g ∧ g N = k) ↔ k ≤ N + 1 ∧ (N = 0 → k = 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hg.map_bound N, λ hN ↦ hN ▸ hg.map_zero⟩
  
  rintro ⟨hkN, hkN0⟩
  obtain rfl | hN : N = 0 ∨ N ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne _ _
  · exact ⟨id, sub_right_is_good 0, (hkN0 rfl).symm⟩
  
  obtain hk0 | rfl : k ≤ N ∨ k = N + 1 := Nat.le_or_eq_of_le_succ hkN
  · exact ⟨(· - (N - k)), sub_right_is_good _, Nat.sub_sub_self hk0⟩
  
  exact ⟨λ n ↦ if N + 1 ∣ n + 1 then n + 1 else n,
    ite_dvd_add_one_is_good (Nat.add_one_ne_add_one_iff.mpr hN),
    ite_eq_left (Nat.dvd_refl _)⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {N k : ℕ+} :
    (∃ f : ℕ+ → ℕ+, (∀ m n, f m + f (f n) ≤ f (m + n) + 1) ∧ f N = k)
      ↔ k ≤ N + 1 ∧ (N = 1 → k = 1)
proof:
:=
  let σ : ℕ+ ≃ ℕ := Equiv.pnatEquivNat
  calc (∃ f : ℕ+ → ℕ+, (∀ m n, f m + f (f n) ≤ f (m + n) + 1) ∧ f N = k)
  _ ↔ (∃ g : ℕ → ℕ,
        (∀ m n : ℕ+, σ.symm.conj g m + σ.symm.conj g (σ.symm.conj g n)
          ≤ σ.symm.conj g (m + n) + 1) ∧ σ.symm.conj g N = k) :=
    σ.conj.exists_congr_left
  _ ↔ (∃ g, good g ∧ g N.natPred = k.natPred) := by
    refine exists_congr λ g ↦ and_congr (σ.forall₂_congr σ ?_) σ.symm_apply_eq
    intro x y; let a := σ x; let b := σ y
    calc σ.symm (g a) + σ.symm (g (σ (σ.symm (g b)))) ≤ σ.symm.conj g (x + y) + 1
      _ ↔ g a + 1 + (g (g b) + 1) ≤ g (x + y).natPred + 2 := by
        rw [σ.apply_symm_apply, ← PNat.coe_le_coe]; rfl
      _ ↔ g a + g (g b) ≤ g (x + y).natPred := by
        rw [Nat.add_add_add_comm, Nat.add_le_add_iff_right]
      _ ↔ g a + g (g b) ≤ g (a + b + 1) := by
        suffices (x + y).natPred = a + b + 1 by rw [this]
        change (x + y).natPred = x.natPred + y.natPred + 1
        rw [← Nat.add_left_inj (n := 1), PNat.natPred_add_one, Nat.add_assoc,
          Nat.add_add_add_comm, PNat.natPred_add_one, PNat.natPred_add_one]; rfl
  _ ↔ k.natPred ≤ N.natPred + 1 ∧ (σ N = 0 → σ k = 0) := eq_map_good_iff
  _ ↔ k ≤ N + 1 ∧ (N = 1 → k = 1) := by
    refine and_congr ?_ (imp_congr σ.eq_symm_apply.symm σ.eq_symm_apply.symm)
    rw [PNat.natPred_add_one, ← Nat.add_le_add_iff_right (n := 1), PNat.natPred_add_one]; rfl

name: exists_add_of_lt
statement: theorem exists_add_of_lt {x y : G>0} (h : x < y) : ∃ t, t + x = y
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨y.1 - x.1, sub_pos_of_lt h⟩, Subtype.ext (sub_add_cancel _ _)⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {f : G>0 → G>0} :
    (∀ x y, f (x + f y) = f (x + y) + f y) ↔ ∀ x, f x = x + x
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ hf ↦ ?_, λ hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · intro x y; rw [hf, hf, hf, add_add_add_comm, add_add_add_comm x y, ← add_assoc]
  
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ : ∃ g : G>0 → G>0, g + id = f := by
    
    suffices ∀ y, y < f y
      from ⟨λ x ↦ ⟨f x - x, sub_pos_of_lt (this x)⟩,
        funext λ x ↦ Subtype.ext (sub_add_cancel _ _)⟩
    
    intro y
    obtain hy | hy | hy : y < f y ∨ y = f y ∨ f y < y := lt_trichotomy _ _
    
    · exact hy
    
    · absurd lt_irrefl (f (y + y))
      calc f (y + y)
        _ < f (y + y) + f y := lt_add_of_pos_right _ (f y).2
        _ = f (y + y) := by rw [← hf, ← hy]
    
    · let x : {x : G // 0 < x} := ⟨y - f y, sub_pos.mpr hy⟩
      have h : f y < f (x + f y) := calc
        _ < f (x + y) + f y := lt_add_of_pos_left _ (f _).2
        _ = f (x + f y) := (hf x y).symm
      exact absurd (congrArg f (Subtype.ext (sub_add_cancel _ _))) h.ne.symm
  
  replace hf {t y : G>0} (h : y < t) : g (t + g y) = g t + y := by
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ : ∃ u, u + y = t := exists_add_of_lt h
    replace hf : g (u + (g y + y)) + (u + (g y + y))
        = g (u + y) + (u + y) + (g y + y) := hf u y
    rwa [← add_assoc, add_left_inj, add_comm _ y, ← add_assoc,
      ← add_assoc, add_right_comm _ u, add_left_inj] at hf
  rename ∀ {t y}, y < t → g (t + g y) = g t + y => hg
  
  have hg0 : g.Injective := by
    intro x y h
    
    obtain ⟨t, htx, hty⟩ : ∃ t > x, t > y :=
      ⟨x + y, lt_add_of_pos_right _ y.2, lt_add_of_pos_left _ x.2⟩
    
    rw [← add_right_inj (g t), ← hg htx, h, hg hty]
  
  have hg1 (x y) : g (x + y) = g x + g y := by
    
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, t > x + y := ⟨x + y + x, lt_add_of_pos_right _ x.2⟩
    
    have h : g (t + g (x + y)) = g (t + (g x + g y)) := by
      have htx : x < t := ht.trans' (lt_add_of_pos_right _ y.2)
      have hty : y < t + g x := calc
        y < x + y := lt_add_of_pos_left _ x.2
        _ < t := ht
        _ < t + g x := lt_add_of_pos_right _ (g x).2
      rw [hg ht, ← add_assoc, ← hg htx, ← hg hty, add_assoc]
    
    exact add_right_injective t (hg0 h)
  
  replace hg (t) : g (g t) = t := by
    rw [← add_right_inj (g (t + t)), ← hg1]
    exact hg (lt_add_of_pos_right _ t.2)
  
  replace hg1 : StrictMono g := by
    intro x y h
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, t + x = y := exists_add_of_lt h
    calc g x
      _ < g t + g x := lt_add_of_pos_left _ (g t).2
      _ = g (t + x) := (hg1 t x).symm
  
  intro x; obtain hx | hx | hx : g x < x ∨ g x = x ∨ x < g x := lt_trichotomy _ _
  exacts [absurd (hg x) ((hg1 hx).trans hx).ne, congrArg (· + x) hx,
    absurd (hg x) (hx.trans (hg1 hx)).ne.symm]

name: even_add_iff_mod_two_eq
statement: theorem even_add_iff_mod_two_eq {a b : ℕ} : Even (a + b) ↔ a % 2 = b % 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.even_iff, Nat.add_mod]
  have ha : a % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt _ Nat.two_pos
  have hb : b % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt _ Nat.two_pos
  generalize a % 2 = a' at ha ⊢
  generalize b % 2 = b' at hb ⊢
  revert a' b'; decide

name: infinite_cardFactors_mul_succ_self_not_even
statement:
theorem infinite_cardFactors_mul_succ_self_not_even (N) :
    ∃ n ≥ N, ¬Even (Ω (n * (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  
  by_contra! h
  replace h (n) (hn : n ≥ N + 1) : Ω n % 2 = Ω (n + 1) % 2 := by
    rw [← even_add_iff_mod_two_eq, ← cardFactors_mul (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn) n.succ_ne_zero]
    exact h n (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn)
  
  replace h (n) (hn : n ≥ N + 1) : Ω n % 2 = Ω (N + 1) % 2 := by
    induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => rfl
    | succ n hn h0 => rw [← h0, h n hn]
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0⟩ := Nat.exists_infinite_primes (N + 1)
  replace h : Ω p % 2 = Ω ((N + 1) * (N + 1)) % 2 :=
    (h p hp).trans (h _ (Nat.le_mul_self _)).symm
  
  have hN : N + 1 ≠ 0 := Nat.succ_ne_zero N
  rw [cardFactors_apply_prime hp0, cardFactors_mul hN hN,
    ← Nat.two_mul, Nat.mul_mod_right] at h
  exact Nat.one_ne_zero h

name: final_solution_part1
statement:
theorem final_solution_part1 (N) :
    ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ ∀ k < N, Even (Ω ((a + k) * (b + k)))
proof:
:= by
  
  let f (a : ℕ) (k : Fin N) : Fin 2 := Fin.ofNat 2 (Ω (a + 1 + k))
  obtain ⟨a, b, h, hab⟩ : ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ f a = f b :=
    Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite f
  replace hab (k) (hk : k < N) : Ω (a + 1 + k) % 2 = Ω (b + 1 + k) % 2 :=
    congrArg Fin.val (congrFun hab ⟨k, hk⟩)
  
  refine ⟨a + 1, b.succ, Nat.succ_ne_succ_iff.mpr h, λ k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  have X (c : ℕ) : c + 1 + k ≠ 0 := (c.succ_add k).trans_ne (c + k).succ_ne_zero
  rw [cardFactors_mul (X _) (X _), even_add_iff_mod_two_eq, hab k hk]

name: final_solution_part2
statement: theorem final_solution_part2 (h : ∀ n, Even (Ω ((a + n) * (b + n)))) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  
  wlog h0 : a ≤ b
  · exact (this (λ n ↦ Nat.mul_comm _ _ ▸ h n) (Nat.le_of_not_ge h0)).symm
  
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, b = a + c := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h0
  obtain rfl | hc : c = 0 ∨ c ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne c 0
  · rfl
  
  replace h (k) (hk : k > a) : Even (Ω (k * (k + 1))) := by
    specialize h (k * c - a)
    have hk0 : k * c ≥ a :=
      hk.le.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right k (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hc))
    replace hk : k ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hk
    replace h0 : k + 1 ≠ 0 := Nat.succ_ne_zero k
    rwa [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk0, ← Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm,
      cardFactors_mul (Nat.mul_ne_zero hk h0) (Nat.mul_ne_zero hc hc), Nat.even_add,
      cardFactors_mul hc hc, iff_true_right (Even.add_self _)] at h
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn0⟩ : ∃ n ≥ a + 1, ¬Even (Ω (n * (n + 1))) :=
    infinite_cardFactors_mul_succ_self_not_even _
  exact absurd (h n hn) hn0

name: id_is_good
statement: theorem id_is_good : good (id : R → R)
proof:
:=
  λ x y ↦ (mul_add x x y).trans (add_comm _ _)

name: neg_is_good
statement: theorem neg_is_good : good (λ x : R ↦ -x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y; simp only
  rw [mul_neg, neg_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_add, add_comm]

name: map_zero_mul_self_eq_zero
statement: theorem map_zero_mul_self_eq_zero : f 0 * f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have h : f (f 0 * f (f 0)) = f 0 := calc
    _ = f (f 0 * f (f 0)) + 0 * 0 := by rw [zero_mul, add_zero]
    _ = f 0 := by rw [← hf, zero_mul]
  
  have h0 := hf (f 0) 0
  rwa [add_zero, h, mul_zero, left_eq_add] at h0

name: map_zero
statement: theorem map_zero : f 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  mul_self_eq_zero.mp hf.map_zero_mul_self_eq_zero

name: map_self_mul_map
statement: theorem map_self_mul_map (x : R) : f (x * f x) = x * x
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf x 0
  rwa [add_zero, mul_zero, hf.map_zero, zero_add] at h

name: map_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem map_eq_zero_iff {x : R} : f x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ (congrArg f h).trans hf.map_zero⟩
  have h0 := hf.map_self_mul_map x
  rwa [h, mul_zero, hf.map_zero, zero_eq_mul_self] at h0

name: injective
statement: theorem injective : f.Injective
proof:
:= by
  intro r s h
  
  obtain h0 | h0 : f r = 0 ∨ s - r = 0 := by
    rw [← mul_eq_zero, ← hf.map_eq_zero_iff, ← add_eq_right (b := r * r),
      ← hf, add_sub_cancel, ← h, hf.map_self_mul_map]
  
  · replace h : s = 0 := by rwa [h0, eq_comm, hf.map_eq_zero_iff] at h
    replace h0 : r = 0 := hf.map_eq_zero_iff.mp h0
    exact h0.trans h.symm
  
  · exact (eq_of_sub_eq_zero h0).symm

name: inj
statement: theorem inj {x y : R} : f x = f y ↔ x = y
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ hf.injective h, congrArg f⟩

name: map_neg
statement: theorem map_neg (x : R) : f (-x) = -f x
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | h : x = 0 ∨ f (-x) + f x = 0 := by
    have h : -x * f (-x) = x * f x := by
      rw [← hf.inj, hf.map_self_mul_map, hf.map_self_mul_map, neg_mul_neg]
    rwa [neg_mul, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, ← mul_add, mul_eq_zero] at h
  
  · rw [neg_zero, hf.map_zero, neg_zero]
  
  · exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h

name: neg_apply
statement: theorem neg_apply : good (-f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y; calc -f (x * -f (x + y))
    _ = f (x * f (x + y)) := by rw [mul_neg, hf.map_neg, neg_neg]
    _ = f (f x * y) + x * x := hf x y
    _ = -f (-f x * y) + x * x := by rw [neg_mul, hf.map_neg, neg_neg]

name: map_one_eq
statement: theorem map_one_eq : f 1 = 1 ∨ f 1 = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h : f (f 1) = 1 := by rw [← one_mul (f 1), hf.map_self_mul_map, one_mul]
  have h0 : f 1 * f 1 = 1 := by rw [← hf.map_self_mul_map, h, mul_one, h]
  exact mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp h0

name: map_map_add_one
statement: theorem map_map_add_one (h : f 1 = 1) (y) : f (f (y + 1)) = f y + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_mul (f (y + 1)), add_comm y, hf, h, one_mul, one_mul]

name: case_two_ne_zero_map_one_eq_one
statement: theorem case_two_ne_zero_map_one_eq_one (hf1 : f 1 = 1) : f = id
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 (y) : f (f (y + 1)) = f y + 1 := hf.map_map_add_one hf1 y
  replace h0 (y) : f (y + 2) = f y + 2 := calc
    _ = -(f (f (-1) * (y + 2)) + (-1) * (-1)) + 1 := by
      rw [neg_mul_neg, one_mul, neg_add', sub_add_cancel,
        hf.map_neg, hf1, neg_one_mul, hf.map_neg, neg_neg]
    _ = -f (-f (y + 1)) + 1 := by
      rw [← hf, neg_one_mul, ← one_add_one_eq_two,
        ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, neg_add_cancel_comm]
    _ = f (f (y + 1)) + 1 := by rw [hf.map_neg, neg_neg]
    _ = f y + 2 := by rw [h0, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two]
  
  have h1 : f 2 = 2 := by rw [← zero_add 2, h0, hf.map_zero]
  funext y; have h2 : f (2 * f (2 + y)) = f (f 2 * y) + 2 * 2 := hf 2 y
  replace h2 : 2 * f y = 2 * y := by
    rwa [h1, add_comm, h0, mul_add, two_mul 2, ← add_assoc,
      h0, h0, add_assoc, add_left_inj, hf.inj] at h2
  rwa [← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right hR, sub_eq_zero] at h2

name: case_two_ne_zero
statement: theorem case_two_ne_zero : f = id ∨ f = (λ x ↦ -x)
proof:
:= by
  refine hf.map_one_eq.imp (hf.case_two_ne_zero_map_one_eq_one hR) (λ h ↦ ?_)
  have h0 : ∀ x, -f x = x :=
    congrFun (hf.neg_apply.case_two_ne_zero_map_one_eq_one hR (neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr h))
  funext x; rw [← neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, h0]

name: char_eq2_solution
statement:
theorem char_eq2_solution [Ring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [CharP R 2]
    {f : R → R} (hf : good f) : f = id
proof:
:= by
  
  have hf1 : f 1 = 1 ∨ f 1 = -1 := hf.map_one_eq
  replace hf1 : f 1 = 1 := by rwa [CharTwo.neg_eq, or_self] at hf1
  
  have h (y) : f (f (y + 1)) = f y + 1 := hf.map_map_add_one hf1 y
  
  funext y
  let c : R := f y
  let d : R := f (y + 1)
  have h0 : f c = d + 1 := by rw [← h, CharTwo.add_cancel_right]
  replace h : f d = c + 1 := h y
  
  suffices c = d + 1 by rwa [← h0, hf.inj, eq_comm] at this
  
  have h1 : f c * c = c * f c := by
    rw [← hf.inj, hf.map_self_mul_map, ← CharTwo.add_eq_zero, ← hf,
      CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, hf.map_zero, mul_zero, hf.map_zero]
  replace h1 : c * d = d * c := by
    rw [← CharTwo.add_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr h0, mul_add_one, add_one_mul, h1]
  
  have h2 {c d : R} (h : f d = c + 1) : f ((c + 1) * (d + 1)) = d * d + c + 1 := by
    rw [add_assoc, add_comm (d * d), ← CharTwo.add_eq_iff_eq_add,
      ← h, ← hf, CharTwo.add_cancel_left, hf1, mul_one]
  
  replace h2 : d * d + c = c * c + d := by
    rw [← add_left_inj 1, ← h2 h, ← h2 h0, add_one_mul,
      mul_add_one, h1, mul_add_one, add_one_mul]
  
  replace h2 : (c + d) * (c + d + 1) = 0 := calc
    _ = (c + d) * (c + d) + (c + d) := mul_add_one _ _
    _ = c * c + d * d + (c + d) := by
      rw [add_mul, mul_add, h1, mul_add, add_assoc (c * c), CharTwo.add_cancel_left]
    _ = 0 := by rw [add_comm c, add_add_add_comm, h2, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero]
  
  replace h2 : c = d ∨ c = d + 1 := by
    rwa [mul_eq_zero, CharTwo.add_eq_zero, CharTwo.add_eq_zero,
      CharTwo.add_eq_iff_eq_add, add_comm] at h2
  
  refine h2.elim (λ h3 ↦ ?_) id
  replace h2 : (1 : R) = 0 := by rwa [hf.inj, left_eq_add] at h3
  rw [h2, add_zero, h3]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [Ring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {f : R → R} :
    good f ↔ f = (·) ∨ f = (- ·)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ hf ↦ ?_, λ hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases hf with rfl | rfl
    exacts [id_is_good, neg_is_good]
  
  obtain h | h : (2 : R) ≠ 0 ∨ (2 : R) = 0 := ne_or_eq 2 0
  · exact hf.case_two_ne_zero h
  
  left; obtain h0 | h0 : (1 : R) = 0 ∨ (1 : R) ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne 1 0
  · replace h0 (x : R) : x = 0 := eq_zero_of_zero_eq_one h0.symm x
    funext y; rw [h0 (f y), h0 y]
  
  · have : CharP R 2 := CharTwo.of_one_ne_zero_of_two_eq_zero h0 h
    exact hf.char_eq2_solution

name: const_of_infinite_map_eq_map_zero
statement:
lemma const_of_infinite_map_eq_map_zero (hf0 : ∀ K, ∃ c ≥ K, f c = f 0) :
    ∃ C, ∀ x, f x = C
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨f 0, λ a ↦ ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ : ∃ c > (f 0 - f a).natAbs + a, f c = f 0 := hf0 _
  
  replace hc0 : ((c - a : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ f 0 - f a := by
    rw [← hc0, Int.natCast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_add_left_lt hc))]
    exact hf c a
  
  replace hc : (f 0 - f a).natAbs < c - a := Nat.lt_sub_of_add_lt hc
  
  exact (Int.eq_of_sub_eq_zero (Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs hc0 hc)).symm

name: const_of_finite_prime_divisor
statement:
lemma const_of_finite_prime_divisor (hf0 : ∀ p ≥ K, Nat.Prime p → (∀ c, ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ f c)) :
    ∃ C, ∀ x, f x = C
proof:
:= by
  
  have hf1 : f 0 ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨p, hpK, hp⟩ : ∃ p ≥ K, Nat.Prime p := Nat.exists_infinite_primes K
    exact λ h ↦ hf0 p hpK hp 0 (h ▸ Int.dvd_zero _)
  
  let N : ℕ := 4 * K.factorial * (f 0).natAbs
  have hN : N > 0 :=
    have h : 0 < 4 := Nat.succ_pos 3
    Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos h K.factorial_pos) (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hf1)
  /- By using `const_of_infinite_map_eq_map_zero`,
    it suffices to prove that `f(kN) = f(0)` for all `k ∈ ℕ`. -/
  suffices ∀ k, f (k * N) = f 0
    from const_of_infinite_map_eq_map_zero hf
      λ m ↦ ⟨m * N, Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right m hN, this m⟩
  
  intro k
  have h : ((4 * K.factorial : ℕ) : ℤ) * f 0 ∣ f (k * N) - f 0 := calc
    _ ∣ (k * (4 * K.factorial : ℕ) : ℤ) * (f 0).natAbs :=
      Int.mul_dvd_mul ⟨k, Int.mul_comm _ _⟩ Int.dvd_natAbs_self
    _ = ((k * N : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [← Int.natCast_mul, ← Int.natCast_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ ∣ f (k * N) - f 0 := hf _ _
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : f 0 ∣ f (k * N) := calc
      _ ∣ f (k * N) - f 0 + f 0 := Int.dvd_add (dvd_of_mul_left_dvd h) (Int.dvd_refl _)
      _ = f (k * N) := Int.sub_add_cancel _ _
  
  replace h : ((4 * K.factorial : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ M - 1 := by
    refine Int.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_right hf1 ?_
    rwa [Int.sub_mul, Int.one_mul, Int.mul_comm M, ← hM]
  
  have hM0 (p) (hp : Nat.Prime p) : ¬p ∣ Int.natAbs M := by
    
    intro hpM
    replace hpM : (p : ℤ) ∣ M := Int.natCast_dvd.mpr hpM
    obtain hpK | hpK : p ≥ K ∨ p ≤ K := Nat.le_total _ _
    
    · refine hf0 p hpK hp (k * N) ?_
      calc (p : ℤ)
        _ ∣ M := hpM
        _ ∣ f 0 * M := Int.dvd_mul_left _ _
        _ = f (k * N) := hM.symm
    
    · replace h : (p : ℤ) ∣ M - 1 := calc
        _ ∣ (K.factorial : ℤ) := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Nat.dvd_factorial hp.pos hpK)
        _ ∣ ((4 * K.factorial : ℕ) : ℤ) := ⟨4, by rw [Int.natCast_mul, Int.mul_comm]; rfl⟩
        _ ∣ M - 1 := h
      rw [Int.dvd_iff_dvd_of_dvd_sub h, Int.natCast_dvd] at hpM
      exact hp.not_dvd_one hpM
  
  replace hM0 : M = 1 ∨ M = -1 := by
    rwa [← Int.natAbs_eq_natAbs_iff, Int.natAbs_one, Nat.eq_one_iff_not_exists_prime_dvd]
  rcases hM0 with rfl | rfl
  
  · rw [hM, Int.mul_one]
  
  · replace h : (4 : ℤ) ∣ -2 := calc
      _ ∣ ((4 * K.factorial : ℕ) : ℤ) := ⟨K.factorial, Int.natCast_mul _ _⟩
      _ ∣ -1 - 1 := h
    exact absurd h (by decide : ¬(4 : ℤ) ∣ -2)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (hf0 : ∀ C, ∃ x, f x ≠ C) (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ p ≥ K, Nat.Prime p ∧ ∃ c, (p : ℤ) ∣ f c
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hf0; exact const_of_finite_prime_divisor hf hf0

name: not_isTriangleSideLengths_add_self
statement:
theorem not_isTriangleSideLengths_add_self [Add G] [Preorder G] (g : G) :
    ¬isTriangleSideLengths ![g, g, g + g]
proof:
:=
  λ hg ↦ (hg 2).ne rfl

name: isTriangleSideLengths_of_lt_le_le_add
statement:
theorem isTriangleSideLengths_of_lt_le_le_add
    [Add G] [Preorder G] [AddLeftStrictMono G] [AddRightStrictMono G]
    {x : Fin 3 → G} (hx : x 0 < x 1) (hx0 : x 1 ≤ x 2) (hx1 : x 2 ≤ x 0 + x 0) :
    isTriangleSideLengths x
proof:
:= by
  have hx2 : x 0 < x 2 := hx.trans_le hx0
  intro j; match j with
    | 0 => exact hx2.trans (hx1.trans_lt (add_lt_add hx hx2))
    | 1 => exact (hx0.trans hx1).trans_lt (add_lt_add_left hx2 _)
    | 2 => exact hx1.trans_lt (add_lt_add_right hx _)

name: isTriangleSideLengths_of_pos_of_le
statement:
theorem isTriangleSideLengths_of_pos_of_le
    [AddZeroClass G] [Preorder G] [AddLeftStrictMono G] [AddRightStrictMono G]
    {x : Fin 3 → G} (hx : 0 < x 1) (hx0 : x 1 ≤ x 0) (hx1 : x 2 = x 0) :
    isTriangleSideLengths x
proof:
:= by
  intro j; match j with
  | 0 => exact lt_add_of_pos_of_le hx hx1.ge
  | 1 => exact lt_add_of_le_of_pos (hx0.trans_eq hx1.symm) (hx.trans_le hx0)
  | 2 => exact lt_add_of_le_of_pos hx1.le hx

name: monotone_left
statement: theorem monotone_left (f : GoodFun G n) (j) : Monotone (λ i ↦ f i j)
proof:
:=
  f.monotone_left' j

name: exists_triangle_perm
statement:
theorem exists_triangle_perm (f : GoodFun G n) :
    ∃ σ : Fin 3 → Fin n ≃ Fin n, ∀ i, isTriangleSideLengths (λ j ↦ f (σ j i) j)
proof:
:=
  f.exists_triangle_perm'

name: last_is_triangular
statement:
theorem last_is_triangular [AddLeftMono G] [AddRightMono G] (f : GoodFun G (n + 1)) :
    f.triangular (Fin.last n)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : Fin 3 → Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)),
      ∀ i, isTriangleSideLengths (λ j ↦ f (σ j i) j) :=
    f.exists_triangle_perm
  
  intro j; let i := (σ j).symm (Fin.last n)
  
  calc f (Fin.last n) j
    _ = f (σ j i) j := congrArg (λ i ↦ f i j) ((σ j).apply_symm_apply _).symm
    _ < f (σ (j + 1) i) (j + 1) + f (σ (j + 2) i) (j + 2) := hσ i j
    _ ≤ f (Fin.last n) (j + 1) + f (Fin.last n) (j + 2) :=
      add_le_add (f.monotone_left _ (Fin.le_last _)) (f.monotone_left _ (Fin.le_last _))

name: strictMono
statement: theorem strictMono : StrictMono a
proof:
:=
  a.strictMono'

name: monotone
statement: theorem monotone : Monotone a
proof:
:=
  a.strictMono.monotone

name: map_pos
statement: theorem map_pos (i) : a i > 0
proof:
:=
  a.map_zero_pos'.trans_le (a.monotone i.zero_le)

name: map_nonneg
statement: theorem map_nonneg (i) : a i ≥ 0
proof:
:=
  (a.map_pos i).le

name: map_add_one_le
statement: theorem map_add_one_le {i} (hi : i ≠ Fin.last n) : a (i + 1) ≤ a i + a i
proof:
:=
  a.map_add_one_le' i hi

name: mkFun_apply_zero_of_ne_last
statement: theorem mkFun_apply_zero_of_ne_last (hi : i ≠ Fin.last n) : a.mkFun i 0 = a i
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right hi

name: mkFun_apply_zero_of_lt_last
statement: theorem mkFun_apply_zero_of_lt_last (hi : i < Fin.last n) : a.mkFun i 0 = a i
proof:
:=
  a.mkFun_apply_zero_of_ne_last hi.ne

name: mkFun_last_zero
statement: theorem mkFun_last_zero : a.mkFun (Fin.last n) 0 = a (Fin.last n) + a (Fin.last n)
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left rfl

name: mkFun_strictMono_left
statement: theorem mkFun_strictMono_left (j) : StrictMono (λ i ↦ a.mkFun i j)
proof:
:= by
  
  intro i₁ i₂ hi
  have hi0 : a i₁ < a i₂ := a.strictMono hi
  match j with | 0 => ?_ | 1 => exact hi0 | 2 => exact add_lt_add hi0 hi0
  
  dsimp only
  obtain hi₂ | rfl : i₂ < Fin.last n ∨ i₂ = Fin.last n := i₂.le_last.lt_or_eq
  
  · rwa [a.mkFun_apply_zero_of_lt_last (hi.trans hi₂), a.mkFun_apply_zero_of_lt_last hi₂]
  
  · rw [a.mkFun_apply_zero_of_lt_last hi, a.mkFun_last_zero]
    exact lt_add_of_lt_of_pos hi0 (a.map_pos _)

name: mkFun_monotone_left
statement: theorem mkFun_monotone_left (j) : Monotone (λ i ↦ a.mkFun i j)
proof:
:=
  (a.mkFun_strictMono_left j).monotone

name: mkFun_isTriangleSideLengths
statement:
theorem mkFun_isTriangleSideLengths (i) :
    isTriangleSideLengths
      (λ j ↦ a.mkFun (![Equiv.refl _, Equiv.addRight 1, Equiv.refl _] j i) j)
proof:
:= by
  set Δ : Fin 3 → G := λ j ↦ a.mkFun (![Equiv.refl _, Equiv.addRight 1, Equiv.refl _] j i) j
  obtain hi | rfl : i ≠ Fin.last n ∨ i = Fin.last n := ne_or_eq _ _
  
  · have h : Δ 0 = a i := a.mkFun_apply_zero_of_ne_last hi
    have h0 : i < i + 1 := by rwa [Fin.lt_add_one_iff, Fin.lt_last_iff_ne_last]
    replace h0 : Δ 0 < a (i + 1) := h.trans_lt (a.strictMono h0)
    exact isTriangleSideLengths_of_lt_le_le_add h0
      (a.map_add_one_le hi) (ge_of_eq (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h h))
  
  · have h : Δ 0 = a (Fin.last n) + a (Fin.last n) := a.mkFun_last_zero
    have h0 : a (Fin.last n + 1) ≤ Δ 0 :=
      ((lt_add_of_le_of_pos (a.monotone (Fin.le_last _)) (a.map_pos _)).trans_eq h.symm).le
    exact isTriangleSideLengths_of_pos_of_le (a.map_pos _) h0 h.symm

name: mkGoodFun_apply_zero_of_ne_last
statement:
theorem mkGoodFun_apply_zero_of_ne_last (hi : i ≠ Fin.last n) :
    a.mkGoodFun i = ![a i, a i, a i + a i]
proof:
:=
  congrArg (![·, a i, a i + a i]) (ite_eq_right hi)

name: mkGoodFun_triangular_iff
statement:
theorem mkGoodFun_triangular_iff [AddZeroClass G] [Preorder G] [AddLeftMono G]
    [AddRightMono G] [AddLeftStrictMono G] [AddRightStrictMono G] {a : NiceSeq G n} :
  a.mkGoodFun.triangular i ↔ i = Fin.last n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hi ↦ (eq_or_ne _ _).resolve_right
      λ hi0 ↦ not_isTriangleSideLengths_add_self (a i) ?_,
    λ hi ↦ hi ▸ a.mkGoodFun.last_is_triangular⟩
  rwa [GoodFun.triangular, a.mkGoodFun_apply_zero_of_ne_last hi0] at hi

name: exists_pos_of_nontrivial
statement:
theorem exists_pos_of_nontrivial
    (G) [Nontrivial G] [AddGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [AddLeftStrictMono G] :
    ∃ g : G, g > 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : G, g ≠ 0 := exists_ne 0
  obtain hg0 | hg0 : g > 0 ∨ g < 0 := gt_or_lt_of_ne hg
  exacts [⟨g, hg0⟩, ⟨-g, neg_pos_of_neg hg0⟩]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution
    (G) [Nontrivial G] [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] (n) :
    IsLeast (Set.range λ f : GoodFun G (n + 1) ↦ #{i | f.triangular i}) 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : G, g > 0 := exists_pos_of_nontrivial G
    refine ⟨(NiceSeq.of_pos g hg n).mkGoodFun, ?_⟩
    simp only [NiceSeq.mkGoodFun_triangular_iff]
    rw [filter_eq', ite_eq_left (mem_univ _), card_singleton]
  
  · rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact one_le_card.mpr ⟨Fin.last n, (mem_filter_univ _).mpr f.last_is_triangular⟩

name: not_four_dvd_sq_add_one
statement: theorem not_four_dvd_sq_add_one (n : ℕ) : ¬4 ∣ n ^ 2 + 1
proof:
:= by
  suffices ¬((n % 4) ^ 2 % 4 + 1) % 4 = 0 by
    rwa [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mod, Nat.pow_mod]
  have h : n % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt n (Nat.succ_pos 3)
  generalize n % 4 = k at h ⊢
  revert k; decide

name: pow_two_add_one_modeq_two
statement: theorem pow_two_add_one_modeq_two (x : ℕ) : x ^ 2 + 1 ≡ 2 [MOD x + 1]
proof:
:=
  calc x ^ 2 + 1
  _ ≡ x ^ 2 + 1 + (x + 1) [MOD x + 1] := Nat.left_modEq_add_iff.mpr (Nat.dvd_refl _)
  _ = x * (x + 1) + 2 := by rw [Nat.add_add_add_comm, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.pow_two]
  _ ≡ 2 [MOD x + 1] := Nat.mul_modulus_add_modEq_iff.mpr rfl

name: std_list_is_good
statement: theorem std_list_is_good : good [4, 33, 217, 1384]
proof:
:= by
  decide
