name: good_three_cons_iff
statement:
theorem good_three_cons_iff :
    good (a :: b :: c :: l) ↔ good (b :: c :: l) ∧ (a + 1) * (c + 1) = b ^ 2 + 1
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: good.tail
statement: theorem good.tail (h : good l) : good l.tail
proof:
:=
  match l with
  | [] => trivial
  | [_] => trivial
  | [_, _] => trivial
  | _ :: _ :: _ :: _ => h.1

name: exists_good_length_sub
statement:
theorem exists_good_length_sub (hn : ∃ l, good l ∧ l.length = n) (k) :
    ∃ l, good l ∧ l.length = n - k
proof:
:= by
  
  induction k with | zero => exact hn | succ k k_ih => ?_
  rcases k_ih with ⟨l, hl, hl0⟩
  refine ⟨l.tail, hl.tail, ?_⟩
  rw [length_tail, hl0, Nat.sub_sub]

name: exists_good_length_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_good_length_of_le (hn : ∃ l, good l ∧ l.length = n) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    ∃ l, good l ∧ l.length = m
proof:
:=
  Nat.sub_sub_self hmn ▸ exists_good_length_sub hn (n - m)

name: even_or_even_of_add_one_mul_add_one_eq_sq_add_one
statement: theorem even_or_even_of_add_one_mul_add_one_eq_sq_add_one : Even a ∨ Even c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h0
  
  refine not_four_dvd_sq_add_one b ?_
  obtain ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, ⟨m, hm⟩⟩ : 2 ∣ a + 1 ∧ 2 ∣ c + 1 := by
    rwa [← Nat.even_add_one, even_iff_two_dvd, ← Nat.even_add_one, even_iff_two_dvd] at h0
  rw [← h, hk, hm, Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm]
  exact Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _

name: even_of_add_one_mul_add_one_eq_sq_add_one
statement: theorem even_of_add_one_mul_add_one_eq_sq_add_one (hb : Even b) : Even a
proof:
:= by
  contrapose hb
  
  replace h : Even (b ^ 2 + 1) := by
    rw [← h, Nat.even_mul, Nat.even_add_one]
    left; exact hb
  rwa [Nat.even_add_one, Nat.not_even_iff_odd,
    Nat.odd_pow_iff (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), ← Nat.not_even_iff_odd] at h

name: symm
statement: theorem symm (h : isBadPair x y) : isBadPair y x
proof:
:=
  And.symm h

name: zero_of_zero_left
statement: theorem zero_of_zero_left (h : isBadPair 0 y) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  replace h : y + 1 ∣ 1 := h.2
  rwa [Nat.dvd_one, Nat.succ_inj] at h

name: zero_or_one_of_self
statement: theorem zero_or_one_of_self (h : isBadPair x x) : x = 0 ∨ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rwa [isBadPair, and_self, (pow_two_add_one_modeq_two x).dvd_iff (Nat.dvd_refl _),
    Nat.dvd_prime Nat.prime_two, Nat.succ_inj, Nat.succ_inj] at h

name: even_of_even
statement: theorem even_of_even (h : isBadPair x y) (hx : Even x) : Even y
proof:
:= by
  contrapose hx
  replace hx : Even (y + 1) := Nat.even_add_one.mpr hx
  replace h : Even (x ^ 2 + 1) := h.2.even hx
  rwa [Nat.even_add_one, Nat.even_pow' (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at h

name: exists_lt_of_even
statement:
theorem exists_lt_of_even (h : isBadPair x y) (hxy : x < y) (hx : Even x) :
    ∃ z < x, isBadPair z x ∧ Even z
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases h with ⟨h, l, h0⟩
  obtain rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩ : l = 0 ∨ ∃ k, l = k + 1 :=
    (Nat.eq_zero_or_eq_succ_pred l).imp_right λ hl ↦ ⟨l.pred, hl⟩
  · exact absurd h0 (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
  
  refine ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_not_ge λ hkx ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Nat.ne_of_lt ?_ h0
    calc x ^ 2 + 1
      _ ≤ (x + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (Nat.lt_succ_self x) (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
      _ = (x + 1) * (x + 1) := Nat.pow_two _
      _ < (y + 1) * (k + 1) := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le
        (Nat.succ_lt_succ hxy) (Nat.succ_le_succ hkx) (Nat.succ_pos k)
  
  suffices x + 1 ∣ k ^ 2 + 1 by
    refine (and_iff_left_of_imp λ h1 ↦ h1.symm.even_of_even hx).mpr ⟨⟨y + 1, ?_⟩, this⟩
    rw [h0, Nat.mul_comm]
  
  replace hx : Nat.Coprime (x + 1) 2 := by
    rwa [Nat.coprime_two_right, Nat.odd_add_one, Nat.not_odd_iff_even]
  replace hxy : Nat.Coprime (x + 1) y := by
    have h1 : Nat.Coprime (y ^ 2 + 1) y := by
      rw [Nat.Coprime, Nat.pow_two, Nat.gcd_mul_left_add_left, Nat.gcd_one_left]
    exact h1.coprime_dvd_left h
  
  replace h0 : (y + 1) * (k + 1) ≡ 2 [MOD x + 1] :=
    h0 ▸ pow_two_add_one_modeq_two x
  have h1 : 2 * (y * (k + 1)) ≡ 2 * (y + 1) [MOD x + 1] := calc
    _ = 2 * y * (k + 1) := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ ≡ (y ^ 2 + 1) * (k + 1) + 2 * y * (k + 1) [MOD x + 1] :=
      Nat.right_modEq_add_iff.mpr (Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd h _)
    _ = (y + 1) * (k + 1) * (y + 1) := by
      rw [← Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_right_comm,
        ← Nat.pow_two, add_sq', Nat.mul_one, Nat.one_pow]
    _ ≡ 2 * (y + 1) [MOD x + 1] := h0.mul_right _
  replace h1 : y * (k + 1) ≡ y + 1 [MOD x + 1] :=
    h1.cancel_left_of_coprime hx
  replace h1 : y * k ≡ 1 [MOD x + 1] := by
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm y] at h1
    exact h1.add_right_cancel' y
  suffices x + 1 ∣ y ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 + 1) from (hxy.pow_right 2).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  rw [Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd, Nat.add_comm _ (y ^ 2)]
  calc y ^ 2 + (y * k) ^ 2
    _ ≡ y ^ 2 + 1 [MOD x + 1] := (h1.pow 2).add_left (y ^ 2)
    _ ≡ 0 [MOD x + 1] := Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mpr h

name: even_imp_zero
statement: theorem even_imp_zero (h : isBadPair x y) (hx : Even x) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  by_contra h0
  induction x using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing y with | h x x_ih => ?_
  
  obtain rfl | hxy : y = x ∨ x < y := by
    refine Nat.eq_or_lt_of_not_lt λ hyx ↦ x_ih y hyx h.symm (h.even_of_even hx) ?_
    rintro rfl; exact hyx.ne.symm h.symm.zero_of_zero_left
  
  · exact h.zero_or_one_of_self.elim h0 λ hy ↦ Nat.not_even_one (hy ▸ hx)
  
  · obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzx0, hz⟩ : ∃ z < x, isBadPair z x ∧ Even z :=
      h.exists_lt_of_even hxy hx
    obtain rfl | hz0 : z = 0 ∨ z ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne z 0
    exacts [h0 hzx0.zero_of_zero_left, x_ih z hzx hzx0 hz hz0]

name: length_five_not_good
statement: theorem length_five_not_good (a b c d e) : ¬good [a, b, c, d, e]
proof:
:= by
  
  intro h
  replace h : ((c + 1 : ℕ) * (e + 1) = d ^ 2 + 1 ∧ (b + 1 : ℕ) * (d + 1) = c ^ 2 + 1)
      ∧ (a + 1 : ℕ) * (c + 1) = b ^ 2 + 1 := by
    simp_rw [good, ← PNat.coe_inj] at h; rwa [true_and] at h
  
  have hb : Even (b : ℕ) := by
    
    obtain h0 | h0 : Even (b : ℕ) ∨ Even (d : ℕ) :=
      even_or_even_of_add_one_mul_add_one_eq_sq_add_one h.1.2
    · exact h0
    
    replace h0 : Even (c : ℕ) := even_of_add_one_mul_add_one_eq_sq_add_one h.1.1 h0
    exact even_of_add_one_mul_add_one_eq_sq_add_one h.1.2 h0
  
  replace h : isBadPair b c :=
    ⟨⟨d + 1, h.1.2.symm⟩, ⟨a + 1, h.2.symm.trans (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩⟩
  
  replace hb : (b : ℕ) = 0 := h.even_imp_zero hb
  exact absurd hb b.ne_zero

name: good.length_le_four
statement: theorem good.length_le_four (hl : good l) : l.length ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.le_of_not_lt λ hl0 ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨l', hl', hl'0⟩ : ∃ l, good l ∧ l.length = 5 :=
    exists_good_length_of_le (n := l.length) ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ hl0
  cases l' with | nil => exact absurd hl'0 (Nat.zero_ne_add_one 4) | cons a l'' => ?_
  rw [length_cons, Nat.succ_inj, length_eq_four] at hl'0
  rcases hl'0 with ⟨b, c, d, e, rfl⟩
  exact length_five_not_good _ _ _ _ _ hl'

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : (∃ l, good l ∧ l.length = n) ↔ n ≤ 4
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ ⟨_, hl, hl0⟩ ↦ hl0.symm.trans_le hl.length_le_four,
  exists_good_length_of_le ⟨[4, 33, 217, 1384], std_list_is_good, rfl⟩⟩

name: periodicOrbit_eq_iff_mem_periodicOrbit
statement:
lemma periodicOrbit_eq_iff_mem_periodicOrbit (ha₀ : a₀ ∈ periodicPts T) :
    periodicOrbit T a = periodicOrbit T a₀ ↔ a ∈ periodicOrbit T a₀
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · suffices a ∈ periodicPts T from h ▸ self_mem_periodicOrbit this
    simpa only [← minimalPeriod_pos_iff_mem_periodicPts,
      ← periodicOrbit_length, h] using ha₀
  
  · rw [mem_periodicOrbit_iff ha₀] at h
    rcases h with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact periodicOrbit_apply_iterate_eq ha₀ n

name: nth_fixed_pts_spec
statement: theorem nth_fixed_pts_spec (hn : n > 0) : a ∈ T.nth_fixed_pts n ↔ IsPeriodicPt T n a
proof:
:=
  T.nth_fixed_pts_spec' n hn a

name: period_zero_pts
statement: lemma period_zero_pts : T.period_n_pts 0 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [period_n_pts, T.nth_fixed_pts_zero, filter_empty]

name: period_n_pts_spec
statement:
lemma period_n_pts_spec (hn : n > 0) :
    a ∈ T.period_n_pts n ↔ minimalPeriod T a = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [period_n_pts, mem_filter, T.nth_fixed_pts_spec hn]
  exact and_iff_right_iff_imp.mpr λ h ↦ h ▸ iterate_minimalPeriod

name: period_n_pts_spec2
statement: lemma period_n_pts_spec2 : a ∈ T.period_n_pts n ↔ n > 0 ∧ minimalPeriod T a = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ n > 0 := n.eq_zero_or_pos
  · rw [T.period_zero_pts, gt_iff_lt, lt_self_iff_false, false_and, iff_false]
    exact notMem_empty a
  · rw [and_iff_right hn, T.period_n_pts_spec hn]

name: mem_periodicPts_of_mem_period_n_pts
statement:
theorem mem_periodicPts_of_mem_period_n_pts (ha : a ∈ T.period_n_pts n) :
    a ∈ periodicPts T
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ n > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n
  · exact absurd (T.period_zero_pts ▸ ha) (notMem_empty a)
  · rwa [← minimalPeriod_pos_iff_mem_periodicPts, (T.period_n_pts_spec hn).mp ha]

name: pos_of_mem_period_n_pts
statement: lemma pos_of_mem_period_n_pts (ha : a ∈ T.period_n_pts n) : n > 0
proof:
:=
  (T.period_n_pts_spec2.mp ha).1

name: iterate_apply_mem_period_n_pts
statement:
lemma iterate_apply_mem_period_n_pts (ha : a ∈ T.period_n_pts n) (k) :
    T^[k] a ∈ T.period_n_pts n
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ n > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n
  · exact absurd (T.period_zero_pts ▸ ha) (notMem_empty a)
  · have h : minimalPeriod T (T^[k] a) = minimalPeriod T a :=
      minimalPeriod_apply_iterate (mem_periodicPts_of_mem_period_n_pts T ha) k
    simpa only [T.period_n_pts_spec hn, h] using ha

name: mem_nth_fixed_pts_iff_mem_period_n_pts_divisors
statement:
theorem mem_nth_fixed_pts_iff_mem_period_n_pts_divisors (n) :
    a ∈ T.nth_fixed_pts n ↔ ∃ d ∈ n.divisors, a ∈ T.period_n_pts d
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ n > 0 := n.eq_zero_or_pos
  
  · rw [T.nth_fixed_pts_zero, Nat.divisors_zero, exists_mem_empty_iff, iff_false]
    exact notMem_empty a
  
  · rw [T.nth_fixed_pts_spec hn, isPeriodicPt_iff_minimalPeriod_dvd]
    conv => right; congr; ext d; rw [T.period_n_pts_spec2, ← and_assoc, Nat.mem_divisors,
      and_iff_left hn.ne.symm, and_iff_left_of_imp (λ h ↦ Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos h hn)]
    exact Iff.symm exists_eq_right'

name: period_n_pts_PairwiseDisjoint
statement: theorem period_n_pts_PairwiseDisjoint (S : Set ℕ) : S.PairwiseDisjoint T.period_n_pts
proof:
:= by
  rintro k - m - h
  refine disjoint_left.mpr λ a hak ham ↦ ?_
  rw [T.period_n_pts_spec2] at hak ham
  exact h (hak.2.symm.trans ham.2)

name: nth_fixed_pts_eq_disjiUnion_divisors_period_n_pts
statement:
theorem nth_fixed_pts_eq_disjiUnion_divisors_period_n_pts (n) :
    T.nth_fixed_pts n = n.divisors.disjiUnion T.period_n_pts
      (T.period_n_pts_PairwiseDisjoint _)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.ext λ a ↦ ?_
  rw [T.mem_nth_fixed_pts_iff_mem_period_n_pts_divisors, mem_disjiUnion]

name: card_nth_fixed_pts_eq_sum_card_period_n_pts
statement:
theorem card_nth_fixed_pts_eq_sum_card_period_n_pts (n : ℕ) :
    #(T.nth_fixed_pts n) = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, #(T.period_n_pts d)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = #(n.divisors.disjiUnion T.period_n_pts
      (T.period_n_pts_PairwiseDisjoint _)) :=
    congrArg card (T.nth_fixed_pts_eq_disjiUnion_divisors_period_n_pts n)
  _ = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, #(T.period_n_pts d) :=
    card_disjiUnion _ _ _

name: periodicOrbit_length_of_mem_period_n_pts
statement:
theorem periodicOrbit_length_of_mem_period_n_pts
    (T : NiceFun α) (ha : a ∈ T.period_n_pts n) :
    (periodicOrbit T a).length = n
proof:
:= by
  rwa [periodicOrbit_length, ← T.period_n_pts_spec (T.pos_of_mem_period_n_pts ha)]

name: card_period_n_pts_eq_n_mul_card_periodicOrbits
statement:
theorem card_period_n_pts_eq_n_mul_card_periodicOrbits (n) :
    #(T.period_n_pts n) = n * #((T.period_n_pts n).image (periodicOrbit T))
proof:
:= by
  
  let Bn : Finset α := T.period_n_pts n
  let f : α → Cycle α := periodicOrbit T
  
  suffices ∀ C : Cycle α, C ∈ Bn.image f → #({a ∈ Bn | f a = C}) = n by
    calc #Bn
    _ = ∑ C ∈ Bn.image f, #{a ∈ Bn | f a = C} := card_eq_sum_card_image f Bn
    _ = n * #(Bn.image f) := by rw [sum_const_nat this, Nat.mul_comm]
  
  intro C hC
  rw [mem_image] at hC; rcases hC with ⟨a₀, ha₀, rfl⟩
  
  suffices {a ∈ Bn | f a = f a₀} = (f a₀).toFinset by
    calc #({a ∈ Bn | f a = f a₀})
    _ = (f a₀).toMultiset.dedup.card := congrArg card this
    _ = (f a₀).toMultiset.card :=
      Multiset.dedup_card_eq_card_iff_nodup.mpr nodup_periodicOrbit
    _ = n := T.periodicOrbit_length_of_mem_period_n_pts ha₀
  
  have ha₀0 : a₀ ∈ periodicPts T := mem_periodicPts_of_mem_period_n_pts T ha₀
  ext a; rw [mem_filter, ← Cycle.toFinset_toMultiset, Multiset.mem_toFinset,
    periodicOrbit_eq_iff_mem_periodicOrbit ha₀0]
  refine and_iff_right_iff_imp.mpr λ h ↦ ?_
  
  rw [mem_periodicOrbit_iff ha₀0] at h
  rcases h with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  exact iterate_apply_mem_period_n_pts T ha₀ k

name: n_dvd_card_period_n_pts
statement: theorem n_dvd_card_period_n_pts (n) : n ∣ #(T.period_n_pts n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, T.card_period_n_pts_eq_n_mul_card_periodicOrbits n⟩

name: card_nth_fixed_pts_modeq_prime
statement:
theorem card_nth_fixed_pts_modeq_prime (hq : Nat.Prime q) (n : ℕ) :
    #(T.nth_fixed_pts (n * q)) ≡ #(T.nth_fixed_pts n) [MOD q]
proof:
:= by
  /- It suffices to show the following claim: for each `d` dividing `nq` but not `n`,
    the number of `T`-period `d` points is divisible by `q`. -/
  calc #(T.nth_fixed_pts (n * q)) % q
    _ = (∑ d ∈ (n * q).divisors, #(T.period_n_pts d) % q) % q := by
      rw [card_nth_fixed_pts_eq_sum_card_period_n_pts, sum_nat_mod]
    _ = (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, #(T.period_n_pts d) % q) % q :=
      congrArg (· % q) (sum_congr_of_eq_on_inter ?_ ?_ λ _ _ _ ↦ rfl)
    _ = #(T.nth_fixed_pts n) % q := by
      rw [← sum_nat_mod, ← card_nth_fixed_pts_eq_sum_card_period_n_pts]
  
  · intro d hdnq hdn
    rw [Nat.mem_divisors] at hdn hdnq
    refine Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp (Nat.dvd_trans ?_ (T.n_dvd_card_period_n_pts d))
    
    by_contra h
    refine hdn ⟨?_, Nat.ne_zero_of_mul_ne_zero_left hdnq.2⟩
    replace hdn : q.Coprime d := hq.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr h
    exact hdn.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdnq.1
  /- Another claim we need to show is that similar statement holds
    if `d ∣ n` but `d ∤ nq`... which is trivially true. -/
  · intro d hdn hdnq
    rw [Nat.mem_divisors] at hdn hdnq
    refine absurd ?_ hdnq
    exact ⟨Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd hdn.1 q, Nat.mul_ne_zero hdn.2 hq.ne_zero⟩

name: final_solution
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨P, hP⟩
  
  have h (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0) : P.eval ↑n = P.eval 0 := by
    
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0⟩ : ∃ q > (P.eval ↑n - P.eval 0).natAbs, Nat.Prime q :=
      Nat.exists_infinite_primes _
    
    suffices P.eval ↑n ≡ P.eval 0 [ZMOD q]
      from Int.eq_of_sub_eq_zero (Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs this.symm.dvd hq)
    
    calc P.eval ↑n % q
      _ = ↑(#(T.nth_fixed_pts n) % q) := congrArg (· % _) (hP n hn).symm
      _ = ↑(#(T.nth_fixed_pts (n * q)) % q) := by
        rw [T.card_nth_fixed_pts_modeq_prime hq0 n]
      _ = (P.eval ((n * q : ℕ) : ℤ)) % q := by
        rw [Int.natCast_emod, ← hP _ (Nat.mul_pos hn hq.pos)]
      _ = P.eval 0 % q := by
        rw [← Int.ModEq, Int.modEq_comm, Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
        refine dvd_trans ?_ (sub_dvd_eval_sub _ _ P)
        rw [sub_zero, Int.natCast_mul]
        exact Int.dvd_mul_left _ _
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, P.eval 0 = ↑N := by
    refine Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le (?_ : P.eval 0 ≥ 0)
    rw [← h 1 Nat.one_pos, ← hP 1 Nat.one_pos]
    exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
  
  refine ⟨N, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← Int.natCast_inj, ← hN, hP n hn, h n hn]

name: g_cons
statement:
theorem g_cons₂ (k m : Γ → Nat) (p i l) :
    (g k m p (i :: l)).2 = k i * (g k m p l).1 + m i * (g k m p l).2
proof: := rfl

name: g_add
statement:
theorem g_add (k m : Γ → Nat) (x y z w) :
    ∀ l, (g k m (x + y, z + w) l).1 = (g k m (x, z) l).1 + (g k m (y, w) l).1 ∧
      (g k m (x + y, z + w) l).2 = (g k m (x, z) l).2 + (g k m (y, w) l).2
proof:
:= by
  refine List.rec ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ λ a l h ↦ ⟨h.2, ?_⟩
  rw [g_cons₂, g_cons₂, g_cons₂, Nat.add_add_add_comm,
    ← Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.mul_add, h.1, h.2]

name: g_add
statement:
theorem g_add₂ (k m : Γ → Nat) (x y z w l) :
    (g k m (x + y, z + w) l).2 = (g k m (x, z) l).2 + (g k m (y, w) l).2
proof:
:=
  (g_add k m x y z w l).2

name: g_mul
statement:
theorem g_mul (k m : Γ → Nat) (c x y) :
    ∀ l, (g k m (c * x, c * y) l).1 = c * (g k m (x, y) l).1 ∧
      (g k m (c * x, c * y) l).2 = c * (g k m (x, y) l).2
proof:
:= by
  refine List.rec ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ λ a l h ↦ ⟨h.2, ?_⟩
  rw [g_cons₂, g_cons₂, h.1, h.2, c.mul_add, c.mul_left_comm, c.mul_left_comm]

name: g_mul
statement:
theorem g_mul₂ (k m : Γ → Nat) (c x y l) :
    (g k m (c * x, c * y) l).2 = c * (g k m (x, y) l).2
proof:
:=
  (g_mul k m c x y l).2

name: g_append_singleton
statement:
theorem g_append_singleton (k m : Γ → Nat) (p i l) :
    g k m p (l ++ [i]) = g k m (p.2, k i * p.1 + m i * p.2) l
proof:
:=
  foldr_append

name: g_reverse
statement:
theorem g_reverse {k m : Γ → Nat} (h : ∀ i, k i * X + m i * Y = Z) :
    ∀ l : List Γ, (g k m (Y, Z) l.reverse).2 = (g k m (Y, Z) l).2
  | [] => rfl
  | [i] => rfl
  | j :: i :: l => calc
      _ = (g k m (k j * X + m j * Y, k j * Y + m j * Z) (i :: l).reverse).2
proof:
:= by
        rw [reverse_cons, g_append_singleton, ← h j]
      _ = k j * (g k m (Y, Z) l.reverse).2 + m j * (g k m (Y, Z) (i :: l).reverse).2 := by
        rw [g_add₂, g_mul₂, g_mul₂, reverse_cons, g_append_singleton, h]
      _ = k j * (g k m (Y, Z) l).2 + m j * (g k m (Y, Z) (i :: l)).2 := by
        rw [g_reverse h l, g_reverse h (i :: l)]

name: f_eq_g
statement: theorem f_eq_g : f = g (Bool.rec 2 3) (Bool.rec 3 1) (1, 7)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (foldr · (1, 7)) (funext (Bool.rec rfl (by simp only [Nat.one_mul])))

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : ∀ l, (f l.reverse).2 = (f l).2
proof:
:=
  f_eq_g ▸ g_reverse (X := 2) (Bool.rec rfl rfl)

name: natDegree_comp_X_sub_one
statement:
theorem natDegree_comp_X_sub_one [Ring R] (P : R[X]) :
    (P.comp (X - 1)).natDegree = P.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP : P.leadingCoeff = 0
  · rw [leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp hP, zero_comp]
  · have : Nontrivial R := ⟨⟨P.leadingCoeff, 0, hP⟩⟩
    replace hP : P.leadingCoeff * (X - C 1 : R[X]).leadingCoeff ^ P.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
      rwa [leadingCoeff_X_sub_C, one_pow, mul_one]
    rw [← C_1, natDegree_comp_eq_of_mul_ne_zero hP, natDegree_X_sub_C, Nat.mul_one]

name: natDegree_comp_X_add_one
statement:
theorem natDegree_comp_X_add_one [Semiring R] (P : R[X]) :
    (P.comp (X + 1)).natDegree = P.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP : P.leadingCoeff = 0
  · rw [leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp hP, zero_comp]
  · have : Nontrivial R := ⟨⟨P.leadingCoeff, 0, hP⟩⟩
    replace hP : P.leadingCoeff * (X + C 1 : R[X]).leadingCoeff ^ P.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
      rwa [leadingCoeff_X_add_C, one_pow, mul_one]
    rw [← C_1, natDegree_comp_eq_of_mul_ne_zero hP, natDegree_X_add_C, Nat.mul_one]

name: comp_X_sub_one_comp_X_add_one
statement:
theorem comp_X_sub_one_comp_X_add_one [CommRing R] (P : R[X]) :
    (P.comp (X - 1)).comp (X + 1) = P
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_assoc, sub_comp, X_comp, one_comp, add_sub_cancel_right, comp_X]

name: comp_X_add_one_comp_X_sub_one
statement:
theorem comp_X_add_one_comp_X_sub_one [CommRing R] (P : R[X]) :
    (P.comp (X + 1)).comp (X - 1) = P
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_assoc, add_comp, X_comp, one_comp, sub_add_cancel, comp_X]

name: division_algo_comp_add_one
statement:
theorem division_algo_comp_add_one [CommRing R] (P : R[X]) :
    ∃ (Q : R[X]) (c : R), P = Q.comp (X + 1) * X + C c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P.divX.comp (X - 1), P.coeff 0, ?_⟩
  rw [comp_X_sub_one_comp_X_add_one, divX_mul_X_add]

name: divX_mul_X
statement: theorem divX_mul_X [Semiring R] (P : R[X]) : (P * X).divX = P
proof:
:= by
  have h : (P * X).divX * X + C ((P * X).coeff 0) = P * X := (P * X).divX_mul_X_add
  rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, eval_mul_X, mul_zero, C_0, add_zero] at h
  exact isRegular_X.right h

name: divX_mul_X_add_C
statement: theorem divX_mul_X_add_C [Semiring R] (P : R[X]) (c : R) : (P * X + C c).divX = P
proof:
:= by
  rw [divX_add, divX_mul_X, divX_C, add_zero]

name: deg_mul_X_add_C_eq_add_one_imp
statement:
theorem deg_mul_X_add_C_eq_add_one_imp [Semiring R]
    {P : R[X]} (h : (P * X + C c).natDegree = n + 1) : P.natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hP : P = 0 ∨ P ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne _ _
  · rw [zero_mul, zero_add, natDegree_C] at h
    exact absurd h.symm (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  · have : Nontrivial R := ⟨⟨P.leadingCoeff, 0, leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hP⟩⟩
    rwa [natDegree_add_C, natDegree_mul_X hP, Nat.succ_inj] at h

name: deg_comp_X_add_one_mul_X_add_C_eq_add_one_imp
statement:
theorem deg_comp_X_add_one_mul_X_add_C_eq_add_one_imp [Semiring R]
    {P : R[X]} (h : (P.comp (X + 1) * X + C c).natDegree = n + 1) : P.natDegree = n
proof:
:=
  (natDegree_comp_X_add_one P).symm.trans (deg_mul_X_add_C_eq_add_one_imp h)

name: coeff_mul_X_add_C_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_X_add_C_zero [Semiring R] (P : R[X]) (c : R) :
    (P * X + C c).coeff 0 = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_add, coeff_mul_X_zero, zero_add, coeff_C_zero]

name: eval_neg_one_X_add_one
statement: theorem eval_neg_one_X_add_one [Ring R] : (X + 1 : R[X]).eval (-1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_add, eval_X, eval_one, neg_add_cancel]

name: eval_X_sub_one
statement: theorem eval_X_sub_one [Ring R] (r : R) : (X - 1 : R[X]).eval r = r - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_one]

name: map_X_add_one
statement:
theorem map_X_add_one [Semiring R] [Semiring S] (φ : R →+* S) :
    (X + 1).map φ = X + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.map_add, map_X, Polynomial.map_one]

name: companion_of_natDegree_eq_zero
statement:
theorem companion_of_natDegree_eq_zero {P : R[X]} (hP : P.natDegree = 0) :
    companion P = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [companion, dite_eq_left hP]

name: companion_const
statement: theorem companion_const (c : R) : companion (C c) = 0
proof:
:=
  companion_of_natDegree_eq_zero (natDegree_C c)

name: companion_zero
statement: theorem companion_zero : companion (0 : R[X]) = 0
proof:
:=
  companion_of_natDegree_eq_zero rfl

name: companion_general_formula
statement:
theorem companion_general_formula (P : R[X]) :
    companion P = (companion (P.divX.comp (X - 1))).comp (X + 1) * (X + 1)
      + C ((P.divX.comp (X - 1)).coeff 0 + (companion (P.divX.comp (X - 1))).eval (-1))
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain hP | hP : P.natDegree ≠ 0 ∨ P.natDegree = 0 := ne_or_eq _ _
  · rw [companion, dite_eq_right hP]
  
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, P = C c := ⟨P.coeff 0, eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hP⟩
  rw [companion_const, divX_C, zero_comp, companion_zero, zero_comp,
    zero_mul, zero_add, coeff_zero, eval_zero, add_zero, C_0]

name: companion_X_mul_comp_add_one_add_const
statement:
theorem companion_X_mul_comp_add_one_add_const (Q : R[X]) (c : R) :
    companion (Q.comp (X + 1) * X + C c)
      = (companion Q).comp (X + 1) * (X + 1) + C (companionConstant Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [companionConstant, companion_general_formula,
    divX_mul_X_add_C, comp_X_add_one_comp_X_sub_one]

name: companion_main_formula
statement:
theorem companion_main_formula (P : R[X]) :
    companion P * X = P + (companion P).comp (X - 1) - C (companionConstant P)
proof:
:= by
  unfold companionConstant
  induction hP : P.natDegree generalizing P with
  | zero =>
      rw [companion_of_natDegree_eq_zero hP, zero_mul, zero_comp, add_zero,
        eval_zero, add_zero, ← eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hP, sub_self]
  | succ n n_ih =>
      obtain ⟨Q, c, rfl⟩ : ∃ (Q : R[X]) (c : R), P = Q.comp (X + 1) * X + C c :=
        division_algo_comp_add_one P
      replace hP : Q.natDegree = n := deg_comp_X_add_one_mul_X_add_C_eq_add_one_imp hP
      replace n_ih :
          companion Q * X = Q + (companion Q).comp (X - 1) - C (companionConstant Q) :=
        n_ih Q hP
      replace hP : companion (Q.comp (X + 1) * X + C c) = Q.comp (X + 1) + companion Q := by
        rw [companion_X_mul_comp_add_one_add_const, ← mul_X_comp, n_ih, sub_comp,
          C_comp, sub_add_cancel, add_comp, comp_X_sub_one_comp_X_add_one]
      rw [hP, add_mul, add_assoc, add_sub_assoc, add_right_inj, coeff_mul_X_add_C_zero,
        C_add, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, add_comp, comp_X_add_one_comp_X_sub_one, eval_add,
        eval_comp, eval_neg_one_X_add_one, n_ih, ← coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]; rfl

name: companion_second_formula
statement:
theorem companion_second_formula (P : R[X]) :
    companion P * X - (companion P).comp (X - 1) + C (companionConstant P) = P
proof:
:= by
  rw [companion_main_formula, sub_right_comm, sub_add_cancel, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: map_companion
statement: theorem map_companion : companion (P.map φ) = (companion P).map φ
proof:
:= by
  induction hP : P.natDegree generalizing P with
  | zero =>
      have hP0 : (P.map φ).natDegree = 0 :=
        Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (natDegree_map_le.trans_eq hP)
      rw [companion_of_natDegree_eq_zero hP, Polynomial.map_zero,
        companion_of_natDegree_eq_zero hP0]
  | succ n n_ih =>
      obtain ⟨Q, c, rfl⟩ : ∃ (Q : R[X]) (c : R), P = Q.comp (X + 1) * X + C c :=
        division_algo_comp_add_one P
      replace hP : Q.natDegree = n := deg_comp_X_add_one_mul_X_add_C_eq_add_one_imp hP
      replace n_ih : companion (Q.map φ) = (companion Q).map φ := n_ih Q hP
      replace hP : companionConstant (Q.map φ) = φ (companionConstant Q) := by
        unfold companionConstant
        rw [n_ih, coeff_map, φ.map_add, ← eval_map_apply, φ.map_neg, φ.map_one]
      calc companion ((Q.comp (X + 1) * X + C c).map φ)
        _ = companion ((Q.map φ).comp (X + 1) * X + C (φ c)) := by
          rw [Polynomial.map_add, map_C, Polynomial.map_mul, map_comp, map_X_add_one, map_X]
        _ = ((companion Q).map φ).comp (X + 1) * (X + 1) + C (φ (companionConstant Q)) := by
          rw [companion_X_mul_comp_add_one_add_const, n_ih, hP]
        _ = ((companion Q).comp (X + 1) * (X + 1) + C (companionConstant Q)).map φ := by
          rw [Polynomial.map_add, map_C, Polynomial.map_mul, map_comp, map_X_add_one]
        _ = (companion (Q.comp (X + 1) * X + C c)).map φ := by
          rw [companion_X_mul_comp_add_one_add_const]

name: map_companionConstant
statement: theorem map_companionConstant : companionConstant (P.map φ) = φ (companionConstant P)
proof:
:= by
  unfold companionConstant
  rw [map_companion, coeff_map, φ.map_add, ← eval_map_apply, φ.map_neg, φ.map_one]

name: sum_factorial_range_le_factorial
statement:
theorem sum_factorial_range_le_factorial (n) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, i.factorial ≤ n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  
  cases n with | zero => exact Nat.zero_le 1 | succ n => ?_
  
  induction n with | zero => exact Nat.le_refl 1 | succ n n_ih => ?_
  
  calc ∑ i ∈ range (n + 2), i.factorial
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), i.factorial + (n + 1).factorial := sum_range_succ _ _
    _ ≤ (n + 1).factorial + (n + 1).factorial := Nat.add_le_add_right n_ih _
    _ = 2 * (n + 1).factorial := (Nat.two_mul _).symm
    _ ≤ (n + 2) * (n + 1).factorial := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

name: sum_factorial_range_succ_le_two_mul_factorial
statement:
theorem sum_factorial_range_succ_le_two_mul_factorial (n) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), i.factorial ≤ 2 * n.factorial
proof:
:=
  calc ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), i.factorial
  _ = ∑ i ∈ range n, i.factorial + n.factorial := sum_range_succ _ _
  _ ≤ n.factorial + n.factorial :=
    Nat.add_le_add_right (sum_factorial_range_le_factorial n) _
  _ = 2 * n.factorial := (Nat.two_mul _).symm

name: right_eq_zero_of_factorial_dvd_add_sum_factorial_mul
statement:
theorem right_eq_zero_of_factorial_dvd_add_sum_factorial_mul
    {x y : ℤ} (h : ∀ n : ℕ, (n.factorial : ℤ) ∣ x + (∑ i ∈ range n, i.factorial : ℕ) * y) :
    y = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  let N : ℕ := x.natAbs + 2 * y.natAbs
  replace h {n : ℕ} (hn : N ≤ n) : x + (∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), i.factorial : ℕ) * y = 0 := by
    
    refine Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs (h (n + 1)) ?_
    have hn0 : 0 < n.factorial := n.factorial_pos
    calc (x + (∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), i.factorial : ℕ) * y).natAbs
      _ ≤ x.natAbs + ((∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), i.factorial : ℕ) * y).natAbs :=
        Int.natAbs_add_le _ _
      _ = x.natAbs + (∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), i.factorial) * y.natAbs := by
        rw [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast]
      _ ≤ n.factorial * x.natAbs + 2 * n.factorial * y.natAbs :=
        Nat.add_le_add (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hn0)
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (sum_factorial_range_succ_le_two_mul_factorial n))
      _ = N * n.factorial := by rw [Nat.mul_right_comm, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.add_mul]
      _ < (n + 1) * n.factorial := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn) hn0
  
  have h0 : x + (∑ i ∈ range (N + 1), i.factorial : ℕ) * y = 0 := h (Nat.le_refl N)
  replace h : x + (∑ i ∈ range (N + 2), i.factorial : ℕ) * y = 0 := h (Nat.le_succ N)
  rwa [sum_range_succ, Int.natCast_add, Int.add_mul, ← Int.add_assoc, h0, Int.zero_add,
    Int.mul_eq_zero, Int.natCast_eq_zero, or_iff_right (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)] at h

name: good_iff_companionConstant_eq_zero
statement: theorem good_iff_companionConstant_eq_zero : good P ↔ companionConstant P = 0
proof:
:= by
  /- First show that `Q` satisfies the recursion of `(a_n)_{n ≥ 0}`...
    minus a constant: `(n + 1) Q(n + 1) = Q(n) + P(n + 1) - c`. -/
  let Q : ℤ[X] := companion P
  set c : ℤ := companionConstant P
  have hP (n : ℕ) :
      (n + 1 : ℕ) * Q.eval ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
        = Q.eval (n : ℤ) + P.eval ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - c := by
    rw [Int.mul_comm, ← eval_mul_X, companion_main_formula, eval_sub, eval_C, eval_add,
      Int.add_comm, eval_comp, eval_X_sub_one, Nat.cast_succ, Int.add_sub_cancel]
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ hP0 ↦ ⟨λ n ↦ Q.eval (n : ℤ), λ n ↦ ?_⟩, λ hP0 ↦ ?_⟩
  · dsimp only; rw [hP, hP0, sub_zero]
  
  rcases hP0 with ⟨a, ha⟩
  let b (n : ℕ) : ℤ := a n - Q.eval (n : ℤ)
  replace ha (n : ℕ) : (n + 1 : ℕ) * b (n + 1) = b n + c := by
    rw [Int.mul_sub, ha, hP, ← sub_add, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
  
  replace ha (n : ℕ) : n.factorial * b n = b 0 + (∑ i ∈ range n, i.factorial : ℕ) * c := by
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        change 1 * b 0 = b 0 + 0 * c
        rw [Int.one_mul, Int.zero_mul, Int.add_zero]
    | succ n n_ih =>
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Int.natCast_mul, Int.mul_right_comm, ha, Int.mul_comm,
          Int.mul_add, n_ih, sum_range_succ, Int.natCast_add, Int.add_mul, Int.add_assoc]
  
  replace ha (n) : (n.factorial : ℤ) ∣ b 0 + (∑ i ∈ range n, i.factorial : ℕ) * c :=
    ⟨b n, (ha n).symm⟩
  exact right_eq_zero_of_factorial_dvd_add_sum_factorial_mul ha

name: companionConstant_
statement:
theorem companionConstant_𝔽₄_value (P : 𝔽₄[X]) :
    P.eval 𝔽₄.X * 𝔽₄.X + P.eval 𝔽₄.Y * 𝔽₄.Y = companionConstant P
proof:
:=
  let c : 𝔽₄ := companionConstant P
  let Q : 𝔽₄[X] := companion P
  calc P.eval 𝔽₄.X * 𝔽₄.X + P.eval 𝔽₄.Y * 𝔽₄.Y
  _ = (Q * X - Q.comp (X - 1) + C c).eval 𝔽₄.X * 𝔽₄.X
      + (Q * X - Q.comp (X - 1) + C c).eval 𝔽₄.Y * 𝔽₄.Y := by
    rw [companion_second_formula]
  _ = (Q.eval 𝔽₄.X * 𝔽₄.X - Q.eval 𝔽₄.Y + c) * 𝔽₄.X
      + (Q.eval 𝔽₄.Y * 𝔽₄.Y - Q.eval 𝔽₄.X + c) * 𝔽₄.Y := by
    refine congrArg₂ (· + ·) ?_ ?_
    all_goals rw [eval_add, eval_C, eval_sub, eval_comp, eval_X_sub_one, eval_mul_X]; rfl
  _ = Q.eval 𝔽₄.X * (𝔽₄.X * 𝔽₄.X - 𝔽₄.Y)
      + Q.eval 𝔽₄.Y * (𝔽₄.Y * 𝔽₄.Y - 𝔽₄.X)
      + c * (𝔽₄.X + 𝔽₄.Y) := by ring
  _ = Q.eval 𝔽₄.X * 0 + Q.eval 𝔽₄.Y * 0 + c * 1 := rfl
  _ = c := by rw [← add_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, mul_one]

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (k : ℕ) (hk : good (X ^ k)) : 3 ∣ k + 1
proof:
:= by
  replace hk : companionConstant (X ^ k : 𝔽₄[X]) = 0 := calc
    _ = companionConstant ((X ^ k : ℤ[X]).map (Int.castRingHom 𝔽₄)) := by
      rw [Polynomial.map_pow, map_X]
    _ = 0 := by rw [map_companionConstant, good_iff_companionConstant_eq_zero.mp hk]; rfl
  rwa [← companionConstant_𝔽₄_value, eval_pow, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_X,
    ← pow_succ, ← pow_succ, 𝔽₄.X_pow_add_Y_pow_eq_zero_iff] at hk

name: card_choose_le_nat_sum
statement: theorem card_choose_le_nat_sum (S : Finset ℕ) : Nat.choose #S 2 ≤ ∑ s ∈ S, s
proof:
:= by
  
  induction S using Finset.induction_on_max with | empty => rfl | insert m S hmS hS => ?_
  
  have hmS0 : #S ≤ m := calc
    #S ≤ #(range m) := card_le_card λ k hk ↦ mem_range.mpr (hmS k hk)
    _ = m := card_range m
  replace hmS : m ∉ S := λ h ↦ Nat.lt_irrefl m (hmS _ h)
  
  calc Nat.choose #(insert m S) 2
    _ = Nat.choose (#S + 1) 2 := by rw [card_insert_of_notMem hmS]
    _ = #S + Nat.choose #S 2 := by
      rw [Nat.choose_succ_left _ _ Nat.two_pos, Nat.choose_one_right]
    _ ≤ m + ∑ s ∈ S, s := Nat.add_le_add hmS0 hS
    _ = ∑ s ∈ insert m S, s := (sum_insert hmS (f := id)).symm

name: card_choose_le_sum_of_inj
statement:
theorem card_choose_le_sum_of_inj {f : ι → ℕ} (hf : f.Injective) (I : Finset ι) :
    Nat.choose #I 2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, f i
proof:
:= calc
  _ = Nat.choose #(I.image f) 2 := by rw [card_image_of_injective I hf]
  _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I.image f, i := card_choose_le_nat_sum (I.image f)
  _ = ∑ i ∈ I, f i := sum_image λ _ _ _ _ h ↦ hf h

name: fin_cast_sub_two_mul_injective
statement:
theorem fin_cast_sub_two_mul_injective (k : ℕ) :
    (λ i : Fin k ↦ 2 * (k - 1 - i.val)).Injective
proof:
:= by
  match k with | 0 => exact λ x _ ↦ x.elim0 | k + 1 => ?_
  have h : 2 ≠ 0 := Nat.succ_ne_zero 1
  intro a b h0; rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.mul_right_inj h] at h0
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, ← Nat.add_right_inj (n := k - a.val),
    Nat.sub_add_cancel a.is_le, h0, Nat.sub_add_cancel b.is_le]

name: nonempty_of_card_le
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_card_le [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (hι : Nonempty (GoodTripleFn n ι)) (h : Fintype.card κ ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    Nonempty (GoodTripleFn n κ)
proof:
:=
  (Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le h).elim λ f ↦ hι.elim λ X ↦ ⟨ofEmbedding f X⟩

name: card_bound
statement:
theorem card_bound [Fintype ι] (X : GoodTripleFn n ι) :
    Fintype.card ι ≤ 2 * n / 3 + 1
proof:
:= by
  
  let k : ℕ := Fintype.card ι
  
  have h : 3 * Nat.choose k 2 ≤ k * n := calc
    _ = ∑ _ : Fin 3, Nat.choose #(univ : Finset ι) 2 := (sum_const _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ i : ι, X.toFun j i :=
      sum_le_sum λ j _ ↦ card_choose_le_sum_of_inj (X.toFun_inj j) _
    _ = ∑ i : ι, ∑ j : Fin 3, X.toFun j i := sum_comm
    _ = ∑ _ : ι, n := Fintype.sum_congr _ _ X.toFun_sum
    _ = k * n := sum_const _
  
  replace h : k * ((k - 1) * 3) ≤ k * (2 * n) := calc
    _ = 3 * (k * (k - 1)) := by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm]
    _ = 3 * Nat.choose k 2 * 2 := by
      have h0 : (k * (k - 1)) / 2 * 2 = k * (k - 1) :=
        Nat.div_mul_cancel (even_iff_two_dvd.mp (Nat.even_mul_pred_self k))
      rw [Nat.choose_two_right, Nat.mul_assoc, h0]
    _ ≤ k * n * 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right 2 h
    _ = k * (2 * n) := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm n 2]
  
  obtain h0 | h0 : k = 0 ∨ 0 < k := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos _
  · exact h0.trans_le (Nat.zero_le _)
  · refine Nat.le_add_of_sub_le ((Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Nat.succ_pos 2)).mpr ?_)
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left h h0

name: nonempty_of_le_bound
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_le_bound [Fintype ι] (h : Fintype.card ι ≤ 2 * n / 3 + 1) :
    Nonempty (GoodTripleFn n ι)
proof:
:= by
  have three_pos : 0 < 3 := Nat.succ_pos 2
  
  obtain ⟨k, r, hr, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, ∃ r < 3, n = 3 * k + r :=
    ⟨n / 3, n % 3, Nat.mod_lt n three_pos, (n.div_add_mod 3).symm⟩
  
  have fin_sum_fin_card (a b) : Fintype.card (Fin a ⊕ Fin b) = a + b := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
  replace hr : (r = 0 ∨ r = 1) ∨ r = 2 := by
    rwa [Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.le_succ_iff, Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one] at hr
  rcases hr with (rfl | rfl) | rfl
  
  · refine nonempty_of_card_le ⟨default_of_0mod3 k⟩ (h.trans_eq ?_)
    rw [fin_sum_fin_card, Nat.add_right_comm, ← Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_zero (3 * k),
      Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ three_pos]
  
  · refine nonempty_of_card_le ⟨default_of_1mod3 k⟩ (h.trans_eq ?_)
    rw [fin_sum_fin_card, Nat.add_right_comm, ← Nat.two_mul,
      Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_add_div three_pos]
  
  · refine nonempty_of_card_le ⟨default_of_2mod3 k⟩ (h.trans_eq ?_)
    rw [fin_sum_fin_card, ← Nat.two_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_left_comm,
      Nat.mul_add_div three_pos, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_succ 2 k]

name: nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_iff [Fintype ι] :
    Nonempty (GoodTripleFn n ι) ↔ Fintype.card ι ≤ 2 * n / 3 + 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ h.elim λ X ↦ X.card_bound, GoodTripleFn.nonempty_of_le_bound⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    IsGreatest {k | Nonempty (GoodTripleFn n (Fin k))} (2 * n / 3 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  conv => left; right; ext k; rw [GoodTripleFn.nonempty_iff, Fintype.card_fin]
  exact ⟨Nat.le_refl _, λ _ ↦ id⟩

name: AMove.y_le_r
statement:
theorem AMove.y_le_r [PartialOrder G] [AddLeftMono G] {r : G} {hr : r ≥ 0}
    (A : AMove r hr) (i) : A.y i ≤ r
proof:
:=
  calc A.y i
  _ ≤ ∑ j, A.y j := Finset.single_le_sum (λ i _ ↦ A.y_nonneg i) (Finset.mem_univ _)
  _ = r := A.y_sum

name: applyBMove_board_index
statement: theorem applyBMove_board_index : (X.applyBMove B).board B.index = 0
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left (Or.inl rfl)

name: applyBMove_board_index_add_one
statement: theorem applyBMove_board_index_add_one : (X.applyBMove B).board (B.index + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left (Or.inr rfl)

name: applyBMove_board_index_add_two
statement:
theorem applyBMove_board_index_add_two :
    (X.applyBMove B).board (B.index + 2) = X.board (B.index + 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ite_eq_right ?_
  rw [add_eq_left, add_right_inj]

name: applyBMove_board_index_add_three
statement:
theorem applyBMove_board_index_add_three :
    (X.applyBMove B).board (B.index + 3) = X.board (B.index + 3)
proof:
:= by
  refine ite_eq_right ?_

statement:

name: init_is_good
statement:
theorem init_is_good [AddLeftMono G] {r : G} {hr : r ≥ 0} (isPlayerATurn) :
    good (GameState.init r hr) isPlayerATurn
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, (zero_add 0).trans_le hr, hr, ?_⟩
  cases isPlayerATurn with | true => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | false => ?_
  have hr2 : 2 • r ≥ 0 := nsmul_nonneg hr 2
  exact ⟨hr2, hr2⟩

name: good.not_isLost
statement:
theorem good.not_isLost [AddLeftMono G] {r : G} {hr : r ≥ 0}
    {X : GameState r hr} (hX : good X isPlayerATurn) : ¬isLost X
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨i, h24, h3, h01⟩
  
  replace h01 : X.board i ≤ 2 • r ∧ X.board (i + 1) ≤ 2 • r := by
    cases isPlayerATurn with | false => exact h01 | true => ?_
    have hr2 : 2 • r ≥ 0 := nsmul_nonneg hr 2
    exact ⟨h01.1.trans_le hr2, h01.2.trans_le hr2⟩
  have h0 : X.board (i + 0) ≤ 2 • r := (add_zero i).symm ▸ h01.1
  
  rintro ⟨j, h⟩; revert h
  suffices X.board (i + (j - i)) ≤ 2 • r from (add_sub_cancel i j ▸ this).not_gt
  
  have hr2 : r ≤ 2 • r := calc
    _ ≤ r + r := le_add_of_nonneg_right hr
    _ = 2 • r := (two_nsmul r).symm
  replace h24 : X.board (i + 2) + X.board (i + 4) ≤ 2 • r := h24.trans hr2
  match j - i with
    | 0 => exact h0
    | 1 => exact h01.2
    | 2 => exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right (X.board_nonneg _)).trans h24
    | 3 => exact h3.trans hr2
    | 4 => exact (le_add_of_nonneg_left (X.board_nonneg _)).trans h24

name: good.exists_BMove
statement:
theorem good.exists_BMove {r : G} {hr : r ≥ 0} {X : GameState r hr} (hX : good X false) :
    ∃ B, good (X.applyBMove B) true
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨B_index, h24, h3, h01⟩
  refine ⟨⟨B_index⟩, B_index, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [applyBMove_board_index_add_two, applyBMove_board_index_add_four]
  · rwa [applyBMove_board_index_add_three]
  · rw [Bool.cond_true, applyBMove_board_index, applyBMove_board_index_add_one, and_self]

name: good.forall_AMove
statement:
theorem good.forall_AMove {X : GameState r hr} (hX : good X true) (A : AMove r hr) :
    good (X.applyAMove A) false
proof:
:= by
  set Z : GameState r hr := X.applyAMove A
  /- Choose an index`i` with `x_{i + 2} + x_{i + 4} ≤ r`,
    `x_{i + 3} ≤ r`, and `x_i = x_{i + 1} = 0`. -/
  rcases hX with ⟨i, hi24, hi3, hi0, hi1⟩
  
  replace hi3 : Z.board (i + 3) ≤ 2 • r :=
    calc X.board (i + 3) + A.y (i + 3)
    _ ≤ r + r := add_le_add hi3 (A.y_le_r _)
    _ = 2 • r := (two_nsmul r).symm
  
  have h : (Z.board (i + 4) + Z.board (i + 1)) + (Z.board i + Z.board (i + 2)) ≤ 2 • r := by
    
    have h : (A.y (i + 4) + A.y (i + 1)) + (A.y i + A.y (i + 2)) + A.y (i + 3) = r := calc
      _ = A.y (i + 0) + A.y (i + 1) + A.y (i + 2) + A.y (i + 3) + A.y (i + 4) := by
        rw [add_zero, add_add_add_comm, add_assoc _ (A.y i), add_rotate, ← add_assoc]
      _ = ∑ j, A.y (i + j) := (Fin.sum_univ_five (λ j ↦ A.y (i + j))).symm
      _ = ∑ j, A.y j := Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addLeft i) _ _ λ _ ↦ rfl
      _ = r := A.y_sum
    
    calc ((X.board (i + 4) + A.y (i + 4)) + (X.board (i + 1) + A.y (i + 1)))
        + ((X.board i + A.y i) + (X.board (i + 2) + A.y (i + 2)))
    _ = ((X.board (i + 4) + X.board (i + 1)) + (A.y (i + 4) + A.y (i + 1)))
        + ((X.board i + X.board (i + 2)) + (A.y i + A.y (i + 2))) := by
      apply congrArg₂ (· + ·) <;> exact add_add_add_comm _ _ _ _
    _ = ((X.board (i + 4) + X.board (i + 1))) + (X.board i + X.board (i + 2))
        + ((A.y (i + 4) + A.y (i + 1)) + (A.y i + A.y (i + 2))) :=
      add_add_add_comm _ _ _ _
    _ = (X.board (i + 2) + X.board (i + 4))
        + ((A.y (i + 4) + A.y (i + 1)) + (A.y i + A.y (i + 2))) := by
      rw [hi0, hi1, add_zero, zero_add, add_comm (X.board (i + 4))]
    _ ≤ r + (((A.y (i + 4) + A.y (i + 1)) + (A.y i + A.y (i + 2))) + A.y (i + 3)) :=
      add_le_add hi24 (le_add_of_nonneg_right (A.y_nonneg _))
    _ = 2 • r := by rw [h, two_nsmul]
  
  replace h : Z.board (i + 4) + Z.board (i + 1) ≤ r ∨ Z.board i + Z.board (i + 2) ≤ r := by
    contrapose! h; exact two_nsmul r ▸ add_lt_add h.1 h.2
  rcases h with hi41 | hi02
  
  · refine ⟨i + 2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    
    · rwa [add_assoc, add_assoc]
    
    · calc Z.board (i + 2 + 3)
        _ = X.board i + A.y i := congrArg Z.board ((add_assoc i 2 3).trans (add_zero i))
        _ = A.y i := by rw [hi0, zero_add]
        _ ≤ r := A.y_le_r _
    
    · replace hi24 : X.board (i + 2) ≤ r :=
        le_of_add_le_of_nonneg_left hi24 (X.board_nonneg _)
      calc X.board (i + 2) + A.y (i + 2)
        _ ≤ r + r := add_le_add hi24 (A.y_le_r _)
        _ = 2 • r := (two_nsmul r).symm
    
    · rwa [add_assoc]
  
  · refine ⟨i + 3, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    
    · calc Z.board (i + 3 + 2) + Z.board (i + 3 + 4)
        _ = Z.board (i + 0) + Z.board (i + 2) := by rw [add_assoc, add_assoc]; rfl
        _ = Z.board i + Z.board (i + 2) := by rw [add_zero]
        _ ≤ r := hi02
    
    · calc Z.board (i + 3 + 3)
        _ = X.board (i + 1) + A.y (i + 1) := congrArg Z.board (add_assoc i 3 3)
        _ = A.y (i + 1) := by rw [hi1, zero_add]
        _ ≤ r := A.y_le_r _
    
    · exact hi3
    
    · replace hi24 : X.board (i + 4) ≤ r :=
        le_of_add_le_of_nonneg_right hi24 (X.board_nonneg _)
      calc Z.board (i + 3 + 1)
        _ = X.board (i + 4) + A.y (i + 4) := congrArg Z.board (add_assoc i 3 1)
        _ ≤ r + r := add_le_add hi24 (A.y_le_r _)
        _ = 2 • r := (two_nsmul r).symm

name: isLosing.not_good
statement:
theorem isLosing.not_good {X : GameState r hr} (hXb : isLosing X isPlayerATurn) :
    ¬good X isPlayerATurn
proof:
:= by
  intro hX0; induction hXb with
  | ofLost X hX isPlayerATurn => exact hX0.not_isLost hX
  | ofBMove X hX X_ih => exact hX0.exists_BMove.elim X_ih
  | ofAMove X A hXA X_ih => exact X_ih (hX0.forall_AMove A)

name: not_isLosing_init
statement: theorem not_isLosing_init (isPlayerATurn) : ¬(GameState.init r hr).isLosing isPlayerATurn
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ h.not_good (init_is_good isPlayerATurn)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [AddLeftStrictMono G]
    {r : G} {hr : r ≥ 0} : ¬(GameState.init r hr).isLosing true
proof:
:=
  GameState.not_isLosing_init true

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (f : R → R) :
    ¬∀ x y, f (x - f y) ≤ y * f x + x
proof:
:= by
  intro hf

  
  have hf1 (y) : f y ≤ y + f 0 := by
    specialize hf (y + f 0) 0
    rwa [zero_mul, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right] at hf

  
  have hf2 (y) (hy : 0 < y) : -(f 0 + 1) ≤ f y := by
    replace hf : f (f y - f y) ≤ y * f (f y) + (y + f 0) :=
      (hf (f y) y).trans (add_le_add_right (hf1 y) _)
    rw [sub_self, ← add_assoc, le_add_iff_nonneg_left, ← mul_add_one y,
      mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hy, ← neg_le_iff_add_nonneg] at hf
    rw [neg_add, neg_add_le_iff_le_add, add_comm]
    exact hf.trans (hf1 _)

  
  replace hf2 (y) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (x) : y * f x ≤ 1 := by
    
    refine (lt_or_ge 0 (f x)).elim (λ h ↦ ?_)
      (λ h ↦ (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hy h).trans zero_le_one)
    
    let A : R := x + (f 0 + 1)
    replace hf (y) : y * f x ≤ A := by
      
      obtain ⟨C, h0, h1⟩ : ∃ C ≥ y, f 0 < x + C := by
        refine ⟨max y (f 0 + 1 - x), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
        rw [← max_add_add_left, add_sub_cancel, lt_max_iff, lt_add_iff_pos_right]
        right; exact zero_lt_one
      
      replace h1 : 0 < x - f (-C) :=
        sub_pos_of_lt ((hf1 _).trans_lt (neg_add_lt_iff_lt_add'.mpr h1))
      
      replace h1 : -(f 0 + 1) ≤ -C * f x + x := calc
        _ ≤ f (x - f (-C)) := hf2 _ h1
        _ ≤ -C * f x + x := hf _ _
      
      rw [neg_le_iff_add_nonneg, add_assoc, neg_mul, le_neg_add_iff_add_le, add_zero] at h1
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h0 h.le).trans h1
    
    replace hf1 : A > 0 := h.trans_le ((one_mul (f x)).symm.trans_le (hf 1))
    specialize hf (A * y)
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_le_iff_le_one_right hf1] at hf

  
  replace hf2 (x) : 3 * f x ≤ 1 := hf2 3 zero_le_three x

  
  let B := -(3 * f (-1) + 2)
  replace hf (y : R) (hy : y ≥ 0) : y ≤ B := by
    
    have h : f (-1) ≤ y * (f y - 1 + f 0) + (f y - 1) := calc
      f (-1) = f (f y - 1 - f y) := by rw [sub_sub_cancel_left]
      _ ≤ y * f (f y - 1) + (f y - 1) := hf (f y - 1) y
      _ ≤ y * (f y - 1 + f 0) + (f y - 1) :=
        add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf1 (f y - 1)) hy) _
    
    replace h : 3 * f (-1) ≤ -y - 2 := by
      calc 3 * f (-1)
        _ ≤ 3 * (y * (f y - 1 + f 0) + (f y - 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h zero_le_three
        _ = y * (3 * f y - 3 + 3 * f 0) + (3 * f y - 3) := by
          rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, Commute.ofNat_left 3, mul_assoc, mul_add, mul_sub_one]
        _ ≤ y * (-2 + 1) + (-2) := ?_
        _ = -y - 2 := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_left_inj, ← one_add_one_eq_two,
          neg_add_rev, neg_add_cancel_right, mul_neg, mul_one]
      
      replace h : 3 * f y - 3 ≤ -2 := calc
        _ ≤ 1 - 3 := sub_le_sub_right (hf2 y) 3
        _ = -2 := by rw [← two_add_one_eq_three, sub_add_cancel_right]
      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h (hf2 0)) hy) h
    
    rwa [le_sub_iff_add_le, ← neg_le_neg_iff, neg_neg] at h

  
  specialize hf (max 0 (B + 1)) (le_max_left 0 (B + 1))
  exact hf.not_gt (lt_max_of_lt_right (lt_add_one B))

name: sqrt_add_sqrt_le_sqrt_two_mul_add
statement:
theorem sqrt_add_sqrt_le_sqrt_two_mul_add (a b : ℝ≥0) :
    sqrt a + sqrt b ≤ sqrt (2 * (a + b))
proof:
:=
  le_sqrt_iff_sq_le.mpr (add_sq_le.trans_eq (by simp only [sq_sqrt]))

name: ineq1
statement:
theorem ineq1 {a b : ℝ≥0} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    sqrt ((a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (a + b)) + sqrt 2 * sqrt (a⁻¹ + b⁻¹)⁻¹ ≤ sqrt (2 * (a + b))
proof:
:=
  calc sqrt ((a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (a + b)) + sqrt 2 * sqrt (a⁻¹ + b⁻¹)⁻¹
  _ = sqrt ((a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (a + b)) + sqrt (2 / (a⁻¹ + b⁻¹)) := by
    rw [← sqrt_mul, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  _ ≤ sqrt (2 * ((a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (a + b) + 2 / (a⁻¹ + b⁻¹))) :=
    sqrt_add_sqrt_le_sqrt_two_mul_add _ _
  _ = sqrt (2 * (a + b)) := by
    refine congrArg (λ x ↦ sqrt (2 * x)) ?_
    rw [inv_add_inv ha hb, ← div_mul, ← mul_div_right_comm, ← add_div,
      ← mul_assoc, ← add_sq', sq, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (add_ne_zero.mpr (Or.inl ha))]

name: H
statement:
theorem Hölder_one_and_half
    (I : Finset ι) {x y z : ι → ℝ≥0} (h : ∀ i ∈ I, z i ^ 3 = x i * y i) :
    sqrt ((∑ i ∈ I, z i) ^ 3) ≤ (∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (x i)) * sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, y i)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain hz | hz : ∑ i ∈ I, z i = 0 ∨ ∑ i ∈ I, z i > 0 := eq_zero_or_pos _
  · rw [hz, pow_succ, mul_zero, sqrt_zero]
    exact zero_le
  
  refine le_of_mul_le_mul_of_pos_right ?_ (sqrt_pos.mpr hz)
  
  calc sqrt ((∑ i ∈ I, z i) ^ 3) * sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, z i)
    _ = (∑ i ∈ I, z i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sqrt_mul, ← pow_succ, pow_mul _ 2 2, sqrt_sq]
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (x i)) * ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (y i) * sqrt (z i) := by
      refine sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul _
        (λ _ _ ↦ zero_le) (λ _ _ ↦ zero_le) (λ i hi ↦ le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [← sqrt_mul, ← sqrt_mul, eq_comm, sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq,
        ← pow_mul, pow_succ, h i hi, mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (x i)) * (sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, y i) * sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, z i)) :=
      mul_le_mul_right (sum_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le I y z) _
    _ = (∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (x i)) * sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, y i) * sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, z i) :=
      (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: ineq2
statement:
theorem ineq2 (I : Finset ι) {x : ι → ℝ≥0} (hx : ∀ i ∈ I, x i ≠ 0) :
    #I * sqrt (#I / ∑ i ∈ I, x i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (x i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [sqrt_div, ← mul_div_assoc]
  refine div_le_of_le_mul ?_
  
  calc (#I : ℝ≥0) * sqrt (#I)
    _ = sqrt ((∑ i ∈ I, 1) ^ 3) := by
      rw [sum_const, nsmul_one, pow_succ, sqrt_mul, sqrt_sq]
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (x i)⁻¹) * sqrt (∑ i ∈ I, x i) :=
      Hölder_one_and_half I λ i hi ↦ by rw [one_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ (hx i hi)]

name: general_ineq
statement:
theorem general_ineq (I : Finset ι) {x y : ι → ℝ≥0}
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ I, x i ≠ 0) (hy : ∀ i ∈ I, y i ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + y i ^ 2) / (x i + y i))
        + #I * sqrt (2 * #I / ∑ i ∈ I, ((x i)⁻¹ + (y i)⁻¹))
      ≤ sqrt 2 * ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (x i + y i)
proof:
:=
  calc ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + y i ^ 2) / (x i + y i))
        + #I * sqrt (2 * #I / ∑ i ∈ I, ((x i)⁻¹ + (y i)⁻¹))
  _ = ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + y i ^ 2) / (x i + y i))
      + sqrt 2 * (#I * sqrt (#I / ∑ i ∈ I, ((x i)⁻¹ + (y i)⁻¹))) := by
    rw [mul_left_comm, ← sqrt_mul, mul_div_assoc]
  _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + y i ^ 2) / (x i + y i))
      + sqrt 2 * ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt ((x i)⁻¹ + (y i)⁻¹)⁻¹ :=
    add_le_add_right (a := _) <| mul_le_mul_right (a := _) <|
      ineq2 _ λ i hi ↦ add_ne_zero.mpr (Or.inl (inv_ne_zero (hx i hi)))
  _ = ∑ i ∈ I, (sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + y i ^ 2) / (x i + y i))
      + sqrt 2 * sqrt ((x i)⁻¹ + (y i)⁻¹)⁻¹) := by
    rw [mul_sum, sum_add_distrib]
  _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (2 * (x i + y i)) :=
    sum_le_sum λ i hi ↦ ineq1 (hx i hi) (hy i hi)
  _ = ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt 2 * sqrt (x i + y i) :=
    sum_congr rfl λ i _ ↦ sqrt_mul _ _
  _ = sqrt 2 * ∑ i ∈ I, sqrt (x i + y i) :=
    (mul_sum _ _ _).symm

name: ineq3
statement:
theorem ineq3 {x : Fin n → ℝ≥0} (hx : ∀ i, x i ≠ 0) (j : Fin n) :
    ∑ i, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + x (i + j) ^ 2) / (x i + x (i + j))) + n * sqrt (n / ∑ i, (x i)⁻¹)
      ≤ sqrt 2 * ∑ i, sqrt (x i + x (i + j))
proof:
:=
  let I : Finset (Fin n) := univ
  calc ∑ i, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + x (i + j) ^ 2) / (x i + x (i + j)))
      + n * sqrt (n / ∑ i, (x i)⁻¹)
  _ = ∑ i, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + x (i + j) ^ 2) / (x i + x (i + j)))
      + #I * sqrt ((2 * #I) / ∑ i, ((x i)⁻¹ + (x (i + j))⁻¹)) := by
    cases n with
    | zero => simp_rw [I, univ_eq_empty, card_empty, sum_empty, div_zero]
    | succ n => ?_
    
    have h : ∑ i, (x (i + j))⁻¹ = ∑ i, (x i)⁻¹ :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight j) _ _ (λ _ ↦ rfl)
    rw [add_right_inj, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, sum_add_distrib,
      h, ← two_mul, mul_div_mul_left _ _ two_ne_zero]
  _ ≤ sqrt 2 * ∑ i, sqrt (x i + x (i + j)) :=
    general_ineq (x := x) (y := λ i ↦ x (i + j)) univ (λ i _ ↦ hx i) (λ i _ ↦ hx (i + j))

name: main_ineq
statement:
theorem main_ineq [NeZero n] {x : Fin n → ℝ≥0}
    (hx : ∀ i, x i > 0) (hx0 : ∑ i, (x i)⁻¹ ≤ n) (j) :
    ∑ i, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + x (i + j) ^ 2) / (x i + x (i + j))) + n
      ≤ sqrt 2 * ∑ i, sqrt (x i + x (i + j))
proof:
:=
  calc ∑ i, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + x (i + j) ^ 2) / (x i + x (i + j))) + n
  _ ≤ ∑ i, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + x (i + j) ^ 2) / (x i + x (i + j)))
      + n * sqrt (n / ∑ i, (x i)⁻¹) := by
    have h : 0 < ∑ i, (x i)⁻¹ :=
      Fintype.sum_pos (lt_of_strongLT λ i ↦ inv_pos.mpr (hx i))
    refine add_le_add_right (a := _) (le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.cast_nonneg n) ?_)
    rwa [one_le_sqrt, one_le_div h]
  _ ≤ sqrt 2 * ∑ i, sqrt (x i + x (i + j)) := ineq3 (λ i ↦ (hx i).ne.symm) j

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {x : Fin 3 → ℝ≥0} (hx : ∀ i, x i > 0) (hx0 : ∑ i, (x i)⁻¹ ≤ 3) :
    ∑ i, sqrt ((x i ^ 2 + x (i + 1) ^ 2) / (x i + x (i + 1))) + 3
      ≤ sqrt 2 * ∑ i, sqrt (x i + x (i + 1))
proof:
:=
  main_ineq (n := 3) hx hx0 1

name: main_lemma
statement:
theorem main_lemma {a : Fin (Nat.succ k) → ℤ} (ha : ∀ i, a i * a (i + 1) ≡ a i [ZMOD n]) :
    ∀ i j, a i ≡ a j [ZMOD n]
proof:
:= by
  
  have h (i : Fin k.succ) (m : ℕ) : a i * (a (i + ((m + 1) : ℕ))) ≡ a i [ZMOD n] := by
    induction m with | zero => exact ha i | succ m m_ih => ?_
    calc a i * a (i + (m + 1 + 1 : ℕ))
      _ = a i * a (i + (m + 1 : ℕ) + 1) := by rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_assoc]
      _ ≡ a i * a (i + (m + 1 : ℕ)) * a (i + (m + 1 : ℕ) + 1) [ZMOD n] :=
        m_ih.symm.mul_right _
      _ = a i * (a (i + (m + 1 : ℕ)) * a (i + (m + 1 : ℕ) + 1)) := Int.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ ≡ a i * a (i + (m + 1 : ℕ)) [ZMOD n] := (ha _).mul_left _
      _ ≡ a i [ZMOD n] := m_ih
  
  replace h (i j : Fin k.succ) : a i * a j ≡ a i [ZMOD n] := by
    have h0 := h i (j - i - 1 : Fin k.succ)
    rwa [Nat.cast_succ, Fin.cast_val_eq_self, sub_add_cancel, add_sub_cancel] at h0
  
  intro i j; calc a i
    _ ≡ a i * a j [ZMOD n] := (h i j).symm
    _ = a j * a i := by rw [mul_comm]
    _ ≡ a j [ZMOD n] := h j i

name: final_solution
proof:
:= by
  
  intro ha1
  replace ha1 (i) : a i * a (i + 1) ≡ a i [ZMOD n] := by
    specialize ha1 i
    rwa [Int.mul_sub, Int.mul_one, ← Int.modEq_iff_dvd, Int.modEq_comm] at ha1
  replace ha1 : (a 1 - 1) % n = (a 0 - 1) % n := (main_lemma ha1 1 0).sub_right _
  
  replace ha0 (i) : (a i - 1) % n = a i - 1 :=
    Int.emod_eq_of_lt (Int.le_sub_one_of_lt (ha0 i).1) (Int.sub_one_lt_of_le (ha0 i).2)
  replace ha1 : a 1 = a 0 := by rwa [ha0, ha0, Int.sub_left_inj] at ha1
  exact absurd (ha ha1) (λ h ↦ hk.ne.symm (Fin.one_eq_zero_iff.mp h))

name: CauchySchwarzEngel2
statement:
theorem CauchySchwarzEngel2 (a b : F) (hc : c > 0) (hd : d > 0) :
    (a + b) ^ 2 / (c + d) ≤ a ^ 2 / c + b ^ 2 / d
proof:
:=
  suffices (a + b) ^ 2 ≤ (a ^ 2 / c + b ^ 2 / d) * (c + d)
    from (div_le_iff₀ (add_pos hc hd)).mpr this
  calc (a + b) ^ 2
    _ = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + 2 * (a * b) := by rw [add_sq', mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + (a ^ 2 / c * d + b ^ 2 / d * c) :=
      have h : (a * b) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 / c * d * (b ^ 2 / d * c) := by
        rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, div_mul_div_comm, ← mul_pow, mul_comm d]
        exact (div_mul_cancel₀ _ (mul_pos hc hd).ne.symm).symm
      add_le_add_right (a := a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) <|
        two_mul_le_add_of_sq_le_mul (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) hc.le) hd.le)
          (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg b) hd.le) hc.le) h.le
    _ = a ^ 2 / c * c + a ^ 2 / c * d + (b ^ 2 / d * d + b ^ 2 / d * c) := by
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc.ne.symm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hd.ne.symm, add_add_add_comm]
    _ = (a ^ 2 / c + b ^ 2 / d) * (c + d) := by
      rw [← mul_add, ← mul_add, add_comm d, ← add_mul]

name: two_term_estimate
statement:
theorem two_term_estimate {a b c d : F} (hacb : a + c + b > 0) (hacd : a + c + d > 0) :
    2 * (a - c) ^ 2 / (2 * (a + c) + (b + d))
      - 3 * (a - c) * (b - d) / 2 * ((a + c) / ((a + c + b) * (a + c + d)))
      ≤ (a - b) * (a - c) / (a + b + c) + (c - d) * (c - a) / (c + d + a)
proof:
:=
  calc 2 * (a - c) ^ 2 / (2 * (a + c) + (b + d))
        - 3 * (a - c) * (b - d) / 2 * ((a + c) / ((a + c + b) * (a + c + d)))
    _ = ((a - c) + (a - c)) ^ 2 / (2 * ((a + c + b) + (a + c + d)))
        - 3 * (a - c) * (b - d) / 2 * ((a + c) / ((a + c + b) * (a + c + d))) := by
      rw [sub_left_inj, ← two_mul, mul_pow, add_add_add_comm, ← two_mul, sq 2, mul_assoc]
      exact (mul_div_mul_left _ _ two_ne_zero).symm
    _ = (((a - c) + (a - c)) ^ 2 / ((a + c + b) + (a + c + d))
        - 3 * (a - c) * (b - d) * (a + c) / ((a + c + b) * (a + c + d))) / 2 := by
      rw [mul_comm 2, ← div_div, div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm 2, ← div_div, sub_div]
    _ ≤ ((a - c) ^ 2 / (a + c + b) + (a - c) ^ 2 / (a + c + d)
        - 3 * (a - c) * (b - d) * (a + c) / ((a + c + b) * (a + c + d))) / 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hc := zero_le_two)
        (sub_le_sub_right (CauchySchwarzEngel2 _ _ hacb hacd) _)
    _ = (a - b) * (a - c) / (a + c + b) + (c - d) * (c - a) / (a + c + d) := by
      field
    _ = (a - b) * (a - c) / (a + b + c) + (c - d) * (c - a) / (c + d + a) := by
      rw [add_right_comm a b c, add_rotate a c d]

name: div_add_mul_add_lt
statement:
theorem div_add_mul_add_lt {a b c : F} (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0) (hc : c > 0) :
    a / ((a + b) * (a + c)) < (a + (b + c))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h : (a + b) * (a + c) > 0 := mul_pos (add_pos ha hb) (add_pos ha hc)
  have h0 : a + (b + c) > 0 := add_pos ha (add_pos hb hc)
  have h1 : (a + b) * (a + c) - a * (a + (b + c)) = b * c := by ring1
  rw [← one_div, div_lt_div_iff₀ h h0, one_mul, ← sub_pos, h1]
  exact mul_pos hb hc

name: abs_sub_estimate
proof:
:= by
  have hx02 : x 0 + x 2 > 0 := add_pos (hx 0) (hx 2)
  have hx13 : x 1 + x 3 > 0 := add_pos (hx 1) (hx 3)
  refine abs_sub_lt_of_nonneg_of_lt
    (div_pos hx02 (mul_pos (add_pos hx02 (hx 1)) (add_pos hx02 (hx 3)))).le
    (div_add_mul_add_lt hx02 (hx 1) (hx 3))
    (div_pos hx13 (mul_pos (add_pos hx13 (hx 2)) (add_pos hx13 (hx 0)))).le
    ((div_add_mul_add_lt hx13 (hx 2) (hx 0)).trans_eq ?_)
  rw [add_comm (x 2), add_comm]

name: main_ineq
statement:
theorem main_ineq {x : Fin 4 → F} (hx : ∀ i, x i > 0) :
    let ε₁ : F
proof:
:= x 0 - x 2
    let ε₂ : F := x 1 - x 3
    let y : F := x 0 + x 2
    let z : F := x 1 + x 3
    let S : F := y + z
    (4 * (|ε₁| + |ε₂|) ^ 2 - 9 * (|ε₁| * |ε₂|)) / (6 * S) ≤ targetSum x := by
  intro ε₁ ε₂ y z S
  have X2 : (2 : F) > 0 := two_pos
  have hy : y > 0 := add_pos (hx _) (hx _)
  have hz : z > 0 := add_pos (hx _) (hx _)
  calc targetSum x
    _ = ((x 0 - x 1) * (x 0 - x 2) / (x 0 + x 1 + x 2)
          + (x 2 - x 3) * (x 2 - x 0) / (x 2 + x 3 + x 0))
          + ((x 1 - x 2) * (x 1 - x 3) / (x 1 + x 2 + x 3)
            + (x 3 - x 0) * (x 3 - x 1) / (x 3 + x 0 + x 1)) := by
      rw [targetSum, add_assoc, add_add_add_comm]
    _ ≥ (2 * ε₁ ^ 2 / (2 * y + z) - 3 * ε₁ * ε₂ / 2 * (y / ((y + x 1) * (y + x 3))))
        + (2 * ε₂ ^ 2 / (2 * z + (x 2 + x 0))
          - 3 * ε₂ * (x 2 - x 0) / 2 * (z / ((z + x 2) * (z + x 0)))) :=
      add_le_add (two_term_estimate (add_pos hy (hx _)) (add_pos hy (hx _)))
        (two_term_estimate (add_pos hz (hx _)) (add_pos hz (hx _)))
    _ = 2 * (|ε₁| ^ 2 / (2 * y + z) + |ε₂| ^ 2 / (2 * z + y))
        - 3 * ε₁ * ε₂ / 2 * (y / ((y + x 1) * (y + x 3)) - z / ((z + x 2) * (z + x 0))) := by
      rw [sq_abs, sq_abs]; ring1
    _ ≥ 2 * ((|ε₁| + |ε₂|) ^ 2 / (2 * y + z + (2 * z + y)))
        - |3 * ε₁ * ε₂ / 2 * (y / ((y + x 1) * (y + x 3)) - z / ((z + x 2) * (z + x 0)))| :=
      sub_le_sub (hcd := le_abs_self _) <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha := X2.le) <|
        CauchySchwarzEngel2 _ _ (add_pos (mul_pos X2 hy) hz) (add_pos (mul_pos X2 hz) hy)
    _ = 2 * 2 * (|ε₁| + |ε₂|) ^ 2 / (2 * (2 + 1) * S)
        - |3 * ε₁ * ε₂ / 2| * |y / ((y + x 1) * (y + x 3)) - z / ((z + x 2) * (z + x 0))| := by
      rw [abs_mul, sub_left_inj, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_div_mul_left _ _ X2.ne.symm,
        add_add_add_comm, ← mul_add, add_comm z, mul_div_assoc, ← add_one_mul]
    _ ≥ 2 * 2 * (|ε₁| + |ε₂|) ^ 2 / (2 * (2 + 1) * S) - |3 * ε₁ * ε₂ / 2| * S⁻¹ :=
      sub_le_sub_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_sub_estimate hx).le (abs_nonneg _)) _
    _ = 4 * (|ε₁| + |ε₂|) ^ 2 / (2 * 3 * S) - 3 * |ε₁| * |ε₂| / 2 * (3 / (3 * S)) := by
      have X3 : (3 : F) > 0 := three_pos
      rw [two_add_one_eq_three, two_mul, two_add_two_eq_four, sub_right_inj, abs_div, abs_mul,
        abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg X3.le, abs_of_nonneg X2.le, div_mul_cancel_left₀ X3.ne.symm]
    _ = (4 * (|ε₁| + |ε₂|) ^ 2 - 9 * (|ε₁| * |ε₂|)) / (6 * S) := by
      have X6 : (2 : F) * 3 = 6 := by norm_num
      have X9 : (3 : F) * 3 = 9 := by norm_num
      rw [div_mul_div_comm, ← mul_assoc, X6, mul_assoc 3, mul_right_comm, X9, sub_div]

name: bound_weakening
statement:
theorem bound_weakening (x y : F) :
    (x + y) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (x + y) ^ 2 - 9 * (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : 4 * (4 * (x + y) ^ 2 - 9 * (x * y) - (x + y) ^ 2)
      = 3 * (x + y) ^ 2 + (3 * (x - y)) ^ 2 := by ring1
  rw [← sub_nonneg, ← mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left four_pos, h]
  exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_three (sq_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _)

name: final_solution_part1
statement: theorem final_solution_part1 {x : Fin 4 → F} (hx : ∀ i, x i > 0) : 0 ≤ targetSum x
proof:
:=
  (main_ineq hx).trans' <| div_nonneg ((sq_nonneg _).trans (bound_weakening _ _)) <|
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num : 0 ≤ (6 : F)) <|
      add_nonneg (add_pos (hx 0) (hx 2)).le (add_pos (hx 1) (hx 3)).le

name: final_solution_part2
statement:
theorem final_solution_part2 {x : Fin 4 → F} (hx : ∀ i, x i > 0) :
    targetSum x = 0 ↔ x 0 = x 2 ∧ x 1 = x 3
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp_rw [targetSum, h.1, h.2, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_div, add_zero]
  
  let ε₁ : F := x 0 - x 2
  let ε₂ : F := x 1 - x 3
  let T : F := 6 * ((x 0 + x 2) + (x 1 + x 3))
  have hT : T > 0 :=
    mul_pos (by norm_num) (add_pos (add_pos (hx 0) (hx 2)) (add_pos (hx 1) (hx 3)))
  replace h : (4 * (|ε₁| + |ε₂|) ^ 2 - 9 * (|ε₁| * |ε₂|)) / T ≤ 0 := (main_ineq hx).trans h.le
  replace h : 4 * (|ε₁| + |ε₂|) ^ 2 - 9 * (|ε₁| * |ε₂|) ≤ 0 := by
    rwa [div_nonpos_iff, or_iff_right λ h0 ↦ hT.not_ge h0.2, and_iff_left hT.le] at h
  replace h : (|ε₁| + |ε₂|) ^ 2 = 0 :=
    le_antisymm ((bound_weakening _ _).trans h) (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [sq_eq_zero_iff, add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)] at h
  exact h.imp eq_of_abs_sub_eq_zero eq_of_abs_sub_eq_zero

name: g_ne_id
statement: theorem g_ne_id [hα : Nonempty α] [Preorder α] (X : SpanishCouple α) : X.g ≠ id
proof:
:=
  hα.elim λ x h ↦ (X.spec x).ne (h ▸ rfl)

name: g_iter_le_f
statement:
theorem g_iter_le_f [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] (X : SpanishCouple α) (k x) :
    X.g^[k] x ≤ X.f x
proof:
:= by
  
  induction k generalizing x with | zero => exact X.f_strictMono.id_le x | succ k hk => ?_
  /- For induction step, notice that `g^k(x) < f(x)` for all `x` implies
    `g^{k + 2}(x) ≤ f(g^2(x)) < g(f(x))` for all `x`. -/
  have h : X.g (X.g^[k + 1] x) < X.g (X.f x) := calc
    _ = X.g^[k] (X.g (X.g x)) := (X.g.iterate_succ_apply' _ _).symm
    _ ≤ X.f (X.g (X.g x)) := hk _
    _ < X.g (X.f x) := X.spec _
  exact (X.g_strictMono.lt_iff_lt.mp h).le

name: final_solution_part1
statement: theorem final_solution_part1 : IsEmpty (SpanishCouple ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨λ X ↦ ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, n < X.g n := by
    by_contra! h; exact X.g_ne_id (funext λ n ↦ (h n).antisymm (X.g_strictMono.id_le n))
  
  replace hn : ∀ k, n + k ≤ X.g^[k] n :=
    Nat.rec n.le_refl λ k hk ↦ hk.trans_lt (X.g_strictMono.iterate k hn)
  
  exact (X.g_iter_le_f (X.f n + 1) n).not_gt (Nat.le_of_add_left_le (hn _))

name: ProdShearLex_strictMono
statement:
theorem ProdShearLex_strictMono [Preorder α] [Preorder β]
    {f : α → α} (hf : StrictMono f) {g : α → β → β} (hg : ∀ a : α, StrictMono (g a)) :
    StrictMono (toLex.conj (ProdShear f g))
proof:
:= by
  refine Lex.rec λ (a₁, b₁) ↦ Lex.rec λ (a₂, b₂) ↦ ?_
  rw [Prod.Lex.lt_iff, Prod.Lex.lt_iff]
  change (a₁ < a₂ ∨ a₁ = a₂ ∧ b₁ < b₂) → (f a₁ < f a₂ ∨ f a₁ = f a₂ ∧ g a₁ b₁ < g a₂ b₂)
  exact Or.imp (λ h ↦ hf h) (λ h ↦ h.1 ▸ ⟨rfl, hg _ h.2⟩)

name: ProdMapLex_strictMono
statement:
theorem ProdMapLex_strictMono [Preorder α] [Preorder β]
    {f : α → α} {g : β → β} (hf : StrictMono f) (hg : StrictMono g) :
    StrictMono (toLex.conj (Prod.map f g))
proof:
:=
  ProdShearLex_strictMono hf λ _ ↦ hg

name: triangleArea_alt
statement:
lemma triangleArea_alt (p q r) :
    triangleArea ![p, q, r] =
      mkRat ((p.1 - q.1) * (q.2 - r.2) + (p.2 - q.2) * (r.1 - q.1)).natAbs 2
proof:
:= by
  refine congrArg (λ n ↦ mkRat (Int.natAbs n) 2) ?_
  calc p.1 * q.2 + q.1 * r.2 + r.1 * p.2 - (p.2 * q.1 + q.2 * r.1 + r.2 * p.1)
    _ = p.1 * q.2 + r.1 * p.2 - (p.2 * q.1 + q.2 * r.1) + (q.1 - p.1) * r.2 := by
      rw [Int.add_right_comm, add_sub_add_comm, Int.sub_mul, Int.mul_comm p.1 r.2]
    _ = p.1 * q.2 - p.2 * q.1 + (p.2 - q.2) * r.1 + (q.1 - p.1) * r.2 := by
      rw [add_sub_add_comm, Int.sub_mul p.2, Int.mul_comm r.1]
    _ = (p.1 - q.1) * q.2 - (p.2 - q.2) * q.1 + (p.2 - q.2) * r.1 + (q.1 - p.1) * r.2 := by
      rw [Int.sub_mul p.1, Int.sub_mul _ _ q.1, Int.mul_comm q.1, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
    _ = (p.1 - q.1) * q.2 + (p.2 - q.2) * (r.1 - q.1) + (q.1 - p.1) * r.2 := by
      rw [← add_sub_right_comm, Int.add_sub_assoc, ← Int.mul_sub]
    _ = (p.1 - q.1) * (q.2 - r.2) + (p.2 - q.2) * (r.1 - q.1) := by
      rw [Int.add_right_comm, ← Int.neg_sub p.1,
        Int.neg_mul, Int.add_neg_eq_sub, ← Int.mul_sub]

name: friends_iff
statement:
theorem friends_iff {k : ℕ} {p q : ℤ × ℤ} :
    friends k p q ↔ Int.gcd (p.1 - q.1) (p.2 - q.2) ∣ 2 * k
proof:
:= calc
  _ ↔ ∃ r s, triangleArea ![p, q, (r, s)] = k := Prod.exists'
  _ ↔ ∃ r s, ((p.1 - q.1) * (q.2 - s) + (p.2 - q.2) * (r - q.1)).natAbs = 2 * k := by
    refine exists₂_congr λ r s ↦ ?_
    rw [triangleArea_alt, ← Rat.intCast_natCast, ← Rat.mkRat_one,
      Rat.mkRat_eq_iff (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1) Nat.one_ne_zero, Int.natCast_one,
      Int.mul_one, ← Int.natCast_mul, Int.natCast_inj, Nat.mul_comm k 2]
  _ ↔ ∃ r s, ((p.1 - q.1) * s + (p.2 - q.2) * r).natAbs = 2 * k := by
    refine ⟨λ ⟨r, s, h⟩ ↦ ⟨r - q.1, q.2 - s, h⟩, λ ⟨r, s, h⟩ ↦ ⟨r + q.1, q.2 - s, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [sub_sub_cancel, Int.add_sub_cancel, h]
  _ ↔ ∃ s r, (2 * k : ℕ) = (p.1 - q.1) * s + (p.2 - q.2) * r := by
    refine ⟨λ ⟨r, s, h⟩ ↦ ?_, λ ⟨r, s, h⟩ ↦ ⟨s, r, congrArg Int.natAbs h.symm⟩⟩
    obtain h0 | h0 :
        (p.1 - q.1) * s + (p.2 - q.2) * r = (2 * k : ℕ)
          ∨ (p.1 - q.1) * s + (p.2 - q.2) * r = -(2 * k : ℕ) := Int.natAbs_eq_iff.mp h
    · exact ⟨s, r, h0.symm⟩
    · refine ⟨-s, -r, ?_⟩
      rw [Int.mul_neg, Int.mul_neg, ← Int.neg_add, h0, Int.neg_neg]
  _ ↔ Int.gcd (p.1 - q.1) (p.2 - q.2) ∣ 2 * k := Int.gcd_dvd_iff.symm

name: friends_coord_comm
statement: theorem friends_coord_comm : friends k (p₁, p₂) (q₁, q₂) ↔ friends k (p₂, p₁) (q₂, q₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [friends_iff, friends_iff, Int.gcd_comm]

name: exist_dvd_gcd_of_sq_lt_card
statement:
theorem exist_dvd_gcd_of_sq_lt_card (hm : m > 0) {S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)} (hS : m ^ 2 < #S) :
    ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ q ∈ S, p ≠ q ∧ m ∣ Int.gcd (p.1 - q.1) (p.2 - q.2)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero m := NeZero.of_pos hm
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hpq, h⟩ : ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ q ∈ S, p ≠ q ∧
      ((p.1, p.2) : ZMod m × ZMod m) = ((q.1, q.2) : ZMod m × ZMod m) := by
    refine exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_image_lt ?_
    calc #(S.image λ x : ℤ × ℤ ↦ ((x.1, x.2) : ZMod m × ZMod m))
      _ ≤ Fintype.card (ZMod m × ZMod m) := card_le_univ _
      _ = m ^ 2 := by rw [Fintype.card_prod, ZMod.card, Nat.pow_two]
      _ < #S := hS
  
  refine ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hpq, ?_⟩
  rw [Int.dvd_gcd_iff, ← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub, eq_comm,
    ← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub, eq_comm (a := (q.2 : ZMod m))]
  exact Prod.mk_inj.mp h

name: clique_card_le_sq_of_not_dvd_two_mul
statement:
theorem clique_card_le_sq_of_not_dvd_two_mul
    (hm : m > 0) (h : ¬m ∣ 2 * k) {S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)} (hS : clique k S) : #S ≤ m ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hpq, h0⟩ :
      ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ q ∈ S, p ≠ q ∧ m ∣ Int.gcd (p.1 - q.1) (p.2 - q.2) :=
    exist_dvd_gcd_of_sq_lt_card hm h
  exact h0.trans (friends_iff.mp (hS p hp q hq hpq))

name: range_sq_is_clique
statement:
theorem range_sq_is_clique {N k : ℕ} (hN : ∀ m > 0, m ≤ N → m ∣ 2 * k) :
    clique k (Icc 0 (N : ℤ) ×ˢ Icc 0 (N : ℤ) : Finset _)
proof:
:= by
  
  rintro ⟨p₁, p₂⟩ hp ⟨q₁, q₂⟩ hq hpq
  rw [mem_coe, mem_product] at hp hq
  replace hpq : p₁ ≠ q₁ ∨ p₂ ≠ q₂ := by rwa [Ne, Prod.ext_iff, not_and_or] at hpq
  
  wlog hpq₁ : p₁ ≠ q₁ generalizing p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂
  · exact friends_coord_comm.mp <|
      this p₂ p₁ hp.symm q₂ q₁ hq.symm hpq.symm (hpq.resolve_left hpq₁)
  
  replace hpq₁ : p₁ - q₁ ≠ 0 := λ h ↦ hpq₁ (Int.eq_of_sub_eq_zero h)
  replace hp : 0 ≤ p₁ ∧ p₁ ≤ N := mem_Icc.mp hp.1
  replace hq : 0 ≤ q₁ ∧ q₁ ≤ N := mem_Icc.mp hq.1
  replace hpq : (p₁ - q₁).natAbs ≤ N := by
    rw [← Int.ofNat_le, Int.natCast_natAbs]
    exact abs_sub_le_of_nonneg_of_le hp.1 hp.2 hq.1 hq.2
  exact friends_iff.mpr <| hN _ (Int.gcd_pos_of_ne_zero_left _ hpq₁)
    ((Int.gcd_le_natAbs_left _ hpq₁).trans hpq)

name: exists_clique_card_lt_iff
statement:
theorem exists_clique_card_lt_iff :
    (∃ S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ), clique k S ∧ #S > N) ↔ ∀ m > 0, m ≤ N.sqrt → m ∣ 2 * k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · rcases h with ⟨S, hS, hSN⟩
    intro m hm hm0; contrapose! hSN
    exact (clique_card_le_sq_of_not_dvd_two_mul hm hSN hS).trans (Nat.le_sqrt'.mp hm0)
  
  · refine ⟨Icc 0 (N.sqrt : ℤ) ×ˢ Icc 0 (N.sqrt : ℤ), range_sq_is_clique h, ?_⟩
    rw [card_product, Int.card_Icc, Int.sub_zero, Int.toNat_natCast_add_one]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_sqrt N

name: exists_clique_card_lt_iff2
statement:
theorem exists_clique_card_lt_iff2 :
    (∃ S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ), clique k S ∧ #S > N) ↔ (range N.sqrt).lcm Nat.succ ∣ 2 * k
proof:
:=
  calc ∃ S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ), clique k S ∧ #S > N
  _ ↔ ∀ m > 0, m ≤ N.sqrt → m ∣ 2 * k := exists_clique_card_lt_iff
  _ ↔ ∀ m < N.sqrt, Nat.succ m ∣ 2 * k := by
    refine ⟨λ h m hm ↦ h _ m.succ_pos hm, λ h m hm hm0 ↦ ?_⟩
    cases m with | zero => exact absurd rfl hm.ne | succ l => exact h l hm0
  _ ↔ (range N.sqrt).lcm Nat.succ ∣ 2 * k := by simp_rw [Finset.lcm_dvd_iff, mem_range]

name: two_dvd_lcm_range_succ
statement: theorem two_dvd_lcm_range_succ (hk : k ≥ 2) : 2 ∣ (range k).lcm Nat.succ
proof:
:=
  dvd_lcm (mem_range.mpr hk)

name: lcm_range_succ_pos
statement: theorem lcm_range_succ_pos (k) : 0 < (range k).lcm Nat.succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff]
  rintro x -; exact Nat.succ_ne_zero x

name: final_solution
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : 2 ∣ (range N.sqrt).lcm Nat.succ :=
    two_dvd_lcm_range_succ (Nat.le_sqrt'.mpr hN)
  have hK0 : 0 < 2 * K := (lcm_range_succ_pos _).trans_eq hK
  replace hK0 : 0 < K := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left hK0
  replace hN : 2 > 0 := Nat.two_pos
  simp_rw [exists_clique_card_lt_iff2, hK,
    Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hN, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left K hN]
  exact ⟨⟨hK0, Nat.dvd_refl K⟩, λ k ⟨hk, hk0⟩ ↦ Nat.le_of_dvd hk hk0⟩

name: sq_modeq_sq_of_add_eq
statement: theorem sq_modeq_sq_of_add_eq (h : k + m = n) : k ^ 2 ≡ m ^ 2 [MOD n]
proof:
:= by
  subst h; refine (Nat.ModEq.refl (k * m)).add_right_cancel ?_
  rw [Nat.pow_two, Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.add_mul,
    Nat.ModEq, Nat.mul_mod_left, Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_mod_right]

name: dvd_sub_sq_add_of_le
statement:
theorem dvd_sub_sq_add_of_le
    {k n : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) (h0 : n ∣ k ^ 2 + c) : n ∣ (n - k) ^ 2 + c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, ← Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp h0]
  exact (sq_modeq_sq_of_add_eq (Nat.sub_add_cancel h)).add_right c

name: exists_two_mul_le_of_exists_dvd_sq_add
statement:
theorem exists_two_mul_le_of_exists_dvd_sq_add (hnc : ∃ m, n ∣ m ^ 2 + c) :
    ∃ m, 2 * m ≤ n ∧ n ∣ m ^ 2 + c
proof:
:= by
  rcases hnc with ⟨m, hm⟩
  
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ n > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n
  · rw [Nat.zero_dvd, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff] at hm
    exact ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 0, hm.2.symm ▸ Nat.dvd_refl 0⟩
  
  wlog hm0 : m < n generalizing m
  · refine this (m % n) ?_ (Nat.mod_lt _ hn.pos)
    simpa only [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mod_mod] using hm
  
  obtain hm1 | hm1 : 2 * m ≤ n ∨ n ≤ 2 * m := Nat.le_total _ _
  · exact ⟨m, hm1, hm⟩
  
  replace hm1 : 2 * (n - m) ≤ n := calc
    _ = n + n - 2 * m := by rw [Nat.mul_sub, Nat.two_mul]
    _ ≤ n + n - n := Nat.sub_le_sub_left hm1 _
    _ = n := Nat.add_sub_cancel _ _
  exact ⟨n - m, hm1, dvd_sub_sq_add_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hm0) hm⟩

name: exists_two_mul_le_and_dvd_sq_add_one
statement:
theorem exists_two_mul_le_and_dvd_sq_add_one (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hp0 : p ≡ 1 [MOD 4]) :
    ∃ n, 2 * n ≤ p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime p) := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : IsSquare (-1 : ZMod p) := by
    rw [FiniteField.isSquare_neg_one_iff, ZMod.card, hp0]; decide
  replace hc : p ∣ c.val ^ 2 + 1 := by
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff, Nat.cast_add_one, Nat.cast_pow,
      ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id, sq, ← hc, neg_add_cancel]
  exact exists_two_mul_le_of_exists_dvd_sq_add ⟨c.val, hc⟩

name: sq_modeq_one_eight_of_odd
statement: theorem sq_modeq_one_eight_of_odd (hn : Odd n) : n ^ 2 ≡ 1 [MOD 8]
proof:
:= by
  replace hn : n % 2 = 1 := Nat.odd_iff.mp hn
  change n ^ 2 % 8 = 1
  
  wlog hn0 : n < 8
  · replace h : n % 8 % 2 = 1 := (Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ ⟨4, rfl⟩).trans hn
    rw [Nat.pow_mod, this h (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.succ_pos 7))]
  
  revert hn; revert n; decide

name: exists_two_mul_add_sqrt_10_mul_lt_and_dvd_sq_add_one
statement:
theorem exists_two_mul_add_sqrt_10_mul_lt_and_dvd_sq_add_one
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hp0 : p ≡ 1 [MOD 8]) :
    ∃ n, 2 * n + Nat.sqrt (10 * n) < p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : Odd p := Nat.odd_iff.mpr (hp0.of_dvd ⟨4, rfl⟩ : p ≡ 1 [MOD 2])
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn0⟩ : ∃ n, 2 * n ≤ p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 :=
    exists_two_mul_le_and_dvd_sq_add_one hp (hp0.of_dvd ⟨2, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨n, ?_, hn0⟩
  
  replace hn0 : p ∣ (2 * n) ^ 2 + 4 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.mul_succ]
    exact Nat.dvd_mul_left_of_dvd hn0 4
  replace hn0 : p ∣ (p - 2 * n) ^ 2 + 4 :=
    dvd_sub_sq_add_of_le hn hn0
  
  rcases hn0 with ⟨r, hr⟩
  have hr0 : r ≡ 5 [MOD 8] := calc
    r = 1 * r := (Nat.one_mul r).symm
    _ ≡ p * r [MOD 8] := hp0.symm.mul_right r
    _ = (p - 2 * n) ^ 2 + 4 := hr.symm
    _ ≡ 1 + 4 [MOD 8] := by
      have h : Odd (p - 2 * n) := (Nat.odd_sub hn).mpr (iff_of_true hp1 (even_two_mul n))
      exact (sq_modeq_one_eight_of_odd h).add_right 4
  replace hr0 : r ≥ 5 := hr0.symm.trans_le (Nat.mod_le _ _)
  
  have hn0 : 2 * n < p :=
    Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hn λ h ↦ Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hp1 (h ▸ even_two_mul n)
  replace hl : (2 * n + 1) * 5 < (p - 2 * n) ^ 2 + 5 := calc
    _ ≤ p * r := Nat.mul_le_mul hn0 hr0
    _ = (p - 2 * n) ^ 2 + 4 := hr.symm
    _ < (p - 2 * n) ^ 2 + 5 := Nat.lt_succ_self _
  rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right, Nat.mul_right_comm, ← Nat.sqrt_lt'] at hl
  exact Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub' hl

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (N) :
    ∃ n ≥ N, ∃ p, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2 * n + Nat.sqrt (10 * n) < p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0, hp1⟩ : ∃ p, Nat.Prime p ∧ N ^ 2 < p ∧ p ≡ 1 [MOD 8] :=
    Nat.exists_prime_gt_modEq_one _ (Nat.succ_ne_zero 7)
  
  obtain ⟨n, hnp, hnp0⟩ : ∃ n, 2 * n + Nat.sqrt (10 * n) < p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 :=
    exists_two_mul_add_sqrt_10_mul_lt_and_dvd_sq_add_one hp hp1
  
  have hn : N ^ 2 < n ^ 2 + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hp0 (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos _) hnp0)
  have hn : n ≥ N := by
    rwa [Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_left (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at hn
  
  exact ⟨n, hn, p, hp, hnp, hnp0⟩

name: two_mul_sum_equiv_fin
statement:
theorem two_mul_sum_equiv_fin [NeZero n] (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    2 * ∑ i ∈ range n, (σ i : ℕ) = n * (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∑ i ∈ range n, (σ i : ℕ) = ∑ i ∈ range n, i := calc
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, (σ (i : ℕ) : ℕ) := (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range _ _).symm
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, (σ i : ℕ) := by simp_rw [Fin.cast_val_eq_self]
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, (i : ℕ) := Equiv.sum_comp _ _
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range n, i := Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range id _
  rw [h, Nat.mul_comm, sum_range_id_mul_two]

name: two_mul_sum_equiv_fin_succ
statement:
theorem two_mul_sum_equiv_fin_succ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) :
    2 * ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), (σ i : ℕ) = (n + 1) * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_mul_sum_equiv_fin, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: snoc_castSucc_inverse
statement:
theorem snoc_castSucc_inverse {f g : Fin n → Fin n} (h : ∀ j, f (g j) = j) (i) :
    Fin.snoc (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) (Fin.castSucc ∘ f) (Fin.last n)
      (Fin.snoc (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) (Fin.castSucc ∘ g) (Fin.last n) i) = i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ | rfl : (∃ j : Fin n, i = j.castSucc) ∨ i = Fin.last n :=
    i.eq_castSucc_or_eq_last
  · rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc, comp_apply, Fin.snoc_castSucc, comp_apply, h]
  · rw [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_last]

name: cons_last_snoc_zero_inverse
statement:
theorem cons_last_snoc_zero_inverse {f g : Fin n → Fin n} (h : ∀ j, f (g j) = j) (i) :
    Fin.cons (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) (Fin.last n) (Fin.castSucc ∘ f)
      (Fin.snoc (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) (Fin.succ ∘ g) 0 i) = i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ | rfl : (∃ j : Fin n, i = j.castSucc) ∨ i = Fin.last n :=
    i.eq_castSucc_or_eq_last
  · rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc, comp_apply, Fin.cons_succ, comp_apply, h]
  · rw [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.cons_zero]

name: snoc_zero_cons_last_inverse
statement:
theorem snoc_zero_cons_last_inverse {f g : Fin n → Fin n} (h : ∀ j, f (g j) = j) (i) :
    Fin.snoc (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) (Fin.succ ∘ f) 0
      (Fin.cons (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) (Fin.last n) (Fin.castSucc ∘ g) i) = i
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩ : i = 0 ∨ ∃ j : Fin n, i = j.succ := i.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · rw [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.snoc_last]
  · rw [Fin.cons_succ, comp_apply, Fin.snoc_castSucc, comp_apply, h]

name: equiv_map_castSucc_ne_of_map_zero
statement:
theorem equiv_map_castSucc_ne_of_map_zero
    {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} (hσ : σ 0 = j) (i : Fin n) : (σ i.succ) ≠ j
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ Fin.succ_ne_zero i (σ.injective (h.trans hσ.symm))

name: equiv_map_castSucc_ne_of_map_last
statement:
theorem equiv_map_castSucc_ne_of_map_last
    {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} (hσ : σ (Fin.last n) = j) (i : Fin n) :
    (σ i.castSucc) ≠ j
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ Fin.castSucc_ne_last i (σ.injective (h.trans hσ.symm))

name: snoc_zero_equiv_apply_castSucc
statement:
theorem snoc_zero_equiv_apply_castSucc (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :
    snoc_zero_equiv σ i.castSucc = (σ i).succ
proof:
:=
  Fin.snoc_castSucc (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) _ _ i

name: snoc_last_equiv_apply_castSucc
statement:
theorem snoc_last_equiv_apply_castSucc (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :
    snoc_last_equiv σ i.castSucc = (σ i).castSucc
proof:
:=
  Fin.snoc_castSucc (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) _ _ i

name: snoc_zero_equiv_apply_last
statement:
theorem snoc_zero_equiv_apply_last (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    snoc_zero_equiv σ (Fin.last n) = 0
proof:
:=
  Fin.snoc_last (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) _ _

name: snoc_last_equiv_apply_last
statement:
theorem snoc_last_equiv_apply_last (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    snoc_last_equiv σ (Fin.last n) = Fin.last n
proof:
:=
  Fin.snoc_last (α := λ _ ↦ Fin (n + 1)) _ _

name: snoc_equiv_apply_last
statement:
theorem snoc_equiv_apply_last (p : Bool × Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    snoc_equiv p (Fin.last n) = bif p.1 then Fin.last n else 0
proof:
:=
  match p with
  | (false, σ) => snoc_zero_equiv_apply_last σ
  | (true, σ) => snoc_last_equiv_apply_last σ

name: snoc_zero_equiv_injective
statement: theorem snoc_zero_equiv_injective {n} : (snoc_zero_equiv (n := n)).Injective
proof:
:= by
  intro σ τ h; refine Equiv.ext λ i ↦ ?_
  rw [← Fin.succ_inj, ← snoc_zero_equiv_apply_castSucc, h, snoc_zero_equiv_apply_castSucc]

name: snoc_last_equiv_injective
statement: theorem snoc_last_equiv_injective {n} : (snoc_last_equiv (n := n)).Injective
proof:
:= by
  intro σ τ h; refine Equiv.ext λ i ↦ ?_
  rw [← Fin.castSucc_inj, ← snoc_last_equiv_apply_castSucc,
    h, snoc_last_equiv_apply_castSucc]

name: snoc_equiv_injective
statement: theorem snoc_equiv_injective [NeZero n] : (snoc_equiv (n := n)).Injective
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨b, σ⟩ ⟨c, τ⟩ h
  have h0 : Fin.last n ≠ 0 := mt Fin.last_eq_zero_iff.mp (NeZero.ne n)
