  match b, c with
  | false, false => exact Prod.mk_right_inj.mpr (snoc_zero_equiv_injective h)
  | false, true =>
      refine absurd (Equiv.congr_fun h (Fin.last n)) ?_
      simpa [snoc_equiv_apply_last] using h0.symm
  | true, false =>
      refine absurd (Equiv.congr_fun h (Fin.last n)) ?_
      simpa [snoc_equiv_apply_last] using h0
  | true, true => exact Prod.mk_right_inj.mpr (snoc_last_equiv_injective h)

name: snoc_zero_equiv_inverse
statement: theorem snoc_zero_equiv_inverse : snoc_zero_equiv (snoc_zero_inverse hσ) = σ
proof:
:= by
  ext i; obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ | rfl : (∃ j : Fin n, i = j.castSucc) ∨ i = Fin.last n :=
    i.eq_castSucc_or_eq_last
  · rw [snoc_zero_equiv_apply_castSucc, snoc_zero_inverse, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Fin.succ_pred]
  · rw [snoc_zero_equiv_apply_last, hσ]

name: snoc_last_equiv_inverse
statement: theorem snoc_last_equiv_inverse : snoc_last_equiv (snoc_last_inverse hσ) = σ
proof:
:= by
  ext i; obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ | rfl : (∃ j : Fin n, i = j.castSucc) ∨ i = Fin.last n :=
    i.eq_castSucc_or_eq_last
  · rw [snoc_last_equiv_apply_castSucc, snoc_last_inverse,
      Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Fin.castSucc_castPred]
  · rw [snoc_last_equiv_apply_last, hσ]

name: eq_snoc_zero_equiv_iff
statement:
theorem eq_snoc_zero_equiv_iff {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} :
    (∃ τ, snoc_zero_equiv τ = σ) ↔ σ (Fin.last n) = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ ⟨τ, hτ⟩ ↦ hτ ▸ snoc_zero_equiv_apply_last τ,
  λ hσ ↦ ⟨snoc_zero_inverse hσ, snoc_zero_equiv_inverse hσ⟩⟩

name: eq_snoc_last_equiv_iff
statement:
theorem eq_snoc_last_equiv_iff {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} :
    (∃ τ, snoc_last_equiv τ = σ) ↔ σ (Fin.last n) = Fin.last n
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ ⟨τ, hτ⟩ ↦ hτ ▸ snoc_last_equiv_apply_last τ,
  λ hσ ↦ ⟨snoc_last_inverse hσ, snoc_last_equiv_inverse hσ⟩⟩

name: eq_snoc_equiv_iff
statement:
theorem eq_snoc_equiv_iff {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} :
    (∃ p, snoc_equiv p = σ) ↔ σ (Fin.last n) = 0 ∨ σ (Fin.last n) = Fin.last n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Prod.exists, Bool.exists_bool]
  exact or_congr eq_snoc_zero_equiv_iff eq_snoc_last_equiv_iff

name: perm_zero_is_nice
statement: theorem perm_zero_is_nice (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 0)) : nice σ
proof:
:=
  trivial

name: nice_def
statement:
theorem nice_def [NeZero n] {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} :
    nice σ ↔ ∀ k ≤ n, k ∣ 2 * ∑ i ∈ range k, (σ i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with | zero => exact absurd rfl (NeZero.ne 0) | succ n => rfl

name: snoc_zero_equiv_nice_iff_nice
statement:
theorem snoc_zero_equiv_nice_iff_nice {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} :
    nice (snoc_zero_equiv σ) ↔ nice σ
proof:
:= by
  cases n with | zero => decide +revert | succ m => ?_
  let n := m + 1
  
  set τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 2)) := snoc_zero_equiv σ
  simp_rw [nice_def, Nat.le_add_one_iff (n := m + 1), or_imp, forall_and, forall_eq]
  refine (and_iff_left ⟨n, two_mul_sum_equiv_fin_succ _⟩).trans
    (forall_congr' λ k ↦ imp_congr_right λ hk ↦ ?_)
  
  suffices ∀ i ∈ range k, (τ i : ℕ) = σ i + 1 by
    rw [sum_congr rfl this, sum_add_distrib, sum_const, nsmul_one, Nat.cast_id,
      card_range, Nat.mul_add, Nat.dvd_add_left (Nat.dvd_mul_left k 2)]
  intro i hi; replace hi : i < n := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (mem_range.mp hi) hk
  lift i to Fin n using hi
  rw [Fin.coe_eq_castSucc, Fin.cast_val_eq_self, snoc_zero_equiv_apply_castSucc]; rfl

name: snoc_last_equiv_nice_iff_nice
statement:
theorem snoc_last_equiv_nice_iff_nice {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} :
    nice (snoc_last_equiv σ) ↔ nice σ
proof:
:= by
  cases n with | zero => decide +revert | succ m => ?_
  let n := m + 1
  
  set τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)) := snoc_last_equiv σ
  unfold nice; simp_rw [Nat.le_add_one_iff (n := m + 1), or_imp, forall_and, forall_eq]
  refine (and_iff_left ⟨n, two_mul_sum_equiv_fin_succ _⟩).trans
    (forall_congr' λ k ↦ imp_congr_right λ hk ↦ ?_)
  
  suffices ∀ i ∈ range k, (τ i : ℕ) = σ i by rw [sum_congr rfl this]
  intro i hi; replace hi : i < n := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (mem_range.mp hi) hk
  lift i to Fin n using hi
  rw [Fin.coe_eq_castSucc, Fin.cast_val_eq_self, snoc_last_equiv_apply_castSucc]; rfl

name: snoc_equiv_nice_iff_nice
statement:
theorem snoc_equiv_nice_iff_nice {p : Bool × Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} :
    nice (snoc_equiv p) ↔ nice p.2
proof:
:=
  match p with
  | (false, _) => snoc_zero_equiv_nice_iff_nice
  | (true, _) => snoc_last_equiv_nice_iff_nice

name: nice.map_last_eq_zero_or_last
statement:
theorem nice.map_last_eq_zero_or_last {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} (hσ : nice σ) :
    σ (Fin.last n) = 0 ∨ σ (Fin.last n) = Fin.last n
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 1 ≤ n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn
  
  obtain ⟨k, h⟩ : n ∣ 2 * σ (Fin.last n) := by
    rw [← Fin.natCast_eq_last, Nat.dvd_add_iff_right (hσ n (Nat.le_succ n)),
      ← Nat.mul_add, ← sum_range_succ, two_mul_sum_equiv_fin_succ]
    exact ⟨n + 1, Nat.mul_comm _ _⟩
  
  obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : k = 0 ∨ k = 2 ∨ k = 1 := by
    suffices k ≤ 2 by
      rwa [or_left_comm, ← Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one, ← Nat.le_succ_iff_eq_or_le]
    refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ hn0
    rw [Nat.mul_comm, ← h]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Fin.is_le _)
  
  · rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at h
    left; exact Fin.val_eq_zero_iff.mp h
  
  · rw [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_inj (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at h
    right; exact Fin.eq_of_val_eq h
  
  replace h : (2 : ℕ) * σ (Fin.last n) = n := h.trans (Nat.mul_one _)
  have h0 : 2 * ∑ i ∈ range n, (σ i : ℕ) = n * n := by
    refine Nat.add_right_cancel (m := 2 * σ (Fin.last n)) ?_
    calc 2 * ∑ i ∈ range n, (σ i : ℕ) + 2 * σ (Fin.last n)
      _ = 2 * ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), (σ i : ℕ) := by
        rw [sum_range_succ, Fin.natCast_eq_last, Nat.mul_add]
      _ = (n + 1) * n := two_mul_sum_equiv_fin σ
      _ = n * n + 2 * σ (Fin.last n) := by rw [Nat.succ_mul, h]
  
  replace h0 : 2 * σ (n - 1 : ℕ) ≡ 2 * σ (Fin.last n) [MOD n - 1] := calc
    _ ≡ 2 * σ (n - 1 : ℕ) + 2 * ∑ i ∈ range (n - 1), (σ i : ℕ) [MOD n - 1] :=
      let h : n - 1 ≤ n + 1 := (Nat.sub_le n 1).trans (Nat.le_succ n)
      Nat.left_modEq_add_iff.mpr (hσ _ h)
    _ = 2 * ∑ i ∈ range n, (σ i : ℕ) := by
      rw [← Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_comm, ← sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hn0]
    _ = n * n := h0
    _ ≡ 1 * n [MOD n - 1] := (Nat.modEq_sub hn0).mul_right n
    _ = 2 * σ (Fin.last n) := by rw [Nat.one_mul, h]
  
  replace h0 : (σ (n - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ) ≡ σ (Fin.last n) [MOD n - 1] := by
    have h1 : Nat.gcd (n - 1) 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← Nat.Coprime, Nat.coprime_two_right, Nat.odd_sub' hn0]
      exact iff_of_true odd_one (even_iff_two_dvd.mpr ⟨σ (Fin.last n), h.symm⟩)
    exact h0.cancel_left_of_coprime h1
  
  exfalso; clear hσ
  have hn1 : n < 2 * (n - 1) := calc
    _ = n - 1 + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hn0).symm
    _ < n - 1 + (n - 1) := Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.lt_sub_of_add_lt hn) _
    _ = 2 * (n - 1) := (Nat.two_mul _).symm
  
  obtain h1 | h1 | h1 :
      (σ (n - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ) < σ (Fin.last n) ∨ (σ (n - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ) = σ (Fin.last n)
        ∨ (σ (n - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ) > σ (Fin.last n) :=
    Nat.lt_trichotomy _ _
  
  · replace h0 : n - 1 ≤ σ (Fin.last n) := Nat.le_of_add_left_le (h0.add_le_of_lt h1)
    exact Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h0) (hn1.trans_eq' h.symm)
  
  · rw [Fin.val_inj, σ.apply_eq_iff_eq, ← Fin.val_inj, Fin.val_natCast, Fin.val_last] at h1
    revert h1; exact Nat.ne_of_lt ((Nat.mod_le _ _).trans_lt (Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt hn))
  
  · replace h0 : (σ (Fin.last n) : ℕ) + (n - 1) ≤ σ (n - 1 : ℕ) := h0.symm.add_le_of_lt h1
    refine Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h0) ?_
    calc (2 : ℕ) * σ (n - 1 : ℕ)
      _ ≤ 2 * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Fin.is_le _)
      _ = n + n := Nat.two_mul n
      _ < n + 2 * (n - 1) := Nat.add_lt_add_left hn1 n
      _ = 2 * (σ (Fin.last n) + (n - 1)) := by rw [Nat.mul_add, h]

name: nice_iff_exists_snoc_equiv_nice
statement:
theorem nice_iff_exists_snoc_equiv_nice {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} :
    nice σ ↔ ∃ p : Bool × Equiv.Perm (Fin n), nice p.2 ∧ snoc_equiv p = σ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hσ ↦ ?_, λ hσ ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p, snoc_equiv p = σ :=
      eq_snoc_equiv_iff.mpr (hσ.map_last_eq_zero_or_last hn)
    exact ⟨p, snoc_equiv_nice_iff_nice.mp hσ, rfl⟩
  
  · rcases hσ with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact snoc_equiv_nice_iff_nice.mpr hp

name: filter_nice_eq_image_snoc_equiv
statement:
theorem filter_nice_eq_image_snoc_equiv :
    ({σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)) | nice σ} : Finset _)
      = (univ ×ˢ ({σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) | nice σ} : Finset _)).image snoc_equiv
proof:
:= by
  refine ext λ σ ↦ ?_
  rw [mem_filter_univ, nice_iff_exists_snoc_equiv_nice hn, mem_image]
  conv => right; right; ext τ
          rw [mem_product, and_iff_right (mem_univ _), mem_filter_univ]

name: card_nice_perm_of_ge_three
statement:
theorem card_nice_perm_of_ge_three :
    #{σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)) | nice σ} = 2 * #{σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) | nice σ}
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := NeZero.of_gt hn
  rw [filter_nice_eq_image_snoc_equiv hn, card_image_of_injective _ snoc_equiv_injective,
    card_product, card_univ, Fintype.card_bool]

name: card_nice_perm_add_three
statement:
theorem card_nice_perm_add_three (m) :
    #{σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 3)) | nice σ} = 6 * 2 ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with | zero => decide | succ m m_ih => ?_
  rw [card_nice_perm_of_ge_three (Nat.le_add_left 3 m),
    m_ih, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.pow_succ']

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (n) :
    #{σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) | nice σ} =
      match n with
      | 0 => 1
      | 1 => 1
      | 2 => 2
      | m + 3 => 6 * 2 ^ m
proof:
:= by
  match n with
  | 0 => decide
  | 1 => decide
  | 2 => decide
  | m + 3 => exact card_nice_perm_add_three m

name: odd_of_dvd_Int
statement: theorem odd_of_dvd_Int {a b : ℤ} (ha : Odd b) (hab : a ∣ b) : Odd a
proof:
:= by
  rcases hab with ⟨c, rfl⟩
  exact Int.Odd.of_mul_left ha

name: mul_eq_one_Nat
statement: theorem mul_eq_one_Nat : m * n = 1 ↔ m = 1 ∧ n = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_right h, Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_left h⟩,
  λ ⟨h, h0⟩ ↦ congrArg₂ Nat.mul h h0⟩

name: odd_prod_Int
statement:
theorem odd_prod_Int {f : ι → ℤ} {I : Finset ι} :
    Odd (∏ i ∈ I, f i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ I, Odd (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction I using Finset.induction with
  | empty => rw [forall_mem_empty_iff, iff_true]; exact odd_one
  | insert i₀ I hi₀ hI =>
      rw [prod_insert hi₀, Int.odd_mul, forall_mem_insert]
      exact and_congr_right' hI

name: odd_prod_Int_Fintype
statement:
theorem odd_prod_Int_Fintype [Fintype ι] {f : ι → ℤ} :
    Odd (∏ i, f i) ↔ ∀ i, Odd (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [odd_prod_Int, mem_univ, forall_const]

name: prod_eq_one_Nat
statement:
theorem prod_eq_one_Nat {f : ι → ℕ} {I : Finset ι} :
    ∏ i ∈ I, f i = 1 ↔ ∀ i ∈ I, f i = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction I using Finset.induction with
  | empty => rw [forall_mem_empty_iff, iff_true, prod_empty]
  | insert i₀ I hi₀ hI =>
      rw [prod_insert hi₀, mul_eq_one_Nat, forall_mem_insert]
      exact and_congr_right' hI

name: prod_eq_one_Nat_Fintype
statement:
theorem prod_eq_one_Nat_Fintype [Fintype ι] {f : ι → ℕ} :
    ∏ i, f i = 1 ↔ ∀ i, f i = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [prod_eq_one_Nat, mem_univ, forall_const]

name: natAbs_prod_Int
statement:
theorem natAbs_prod_Int (f : ι → ℤ) (I : Finset ι) :
    (∏ i ∈ I, f i).natAbs = ∏ i ∈ I, (f i).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  induction I using Finset.induction with
  | empty => rfl
  | insert i₀ I hi₀ hI => rw [prod_insert hi₀, prod_insert hi₀, Int.natAbs_mul, hI]

name: map_add_eq_of_map_eq
statement: theorem map_add_eq_of_map_eq (hx0 : x i = x j) (k) : x (i + k) = x (j + k)
proof:
:= by
  have h {i j} (h : x i = x j) : x (i + 1) = x (j + 1) := by
    specialize hx i j
    rwa [h, Int.add_right_inj, Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff hp] at hx
  replace h (k : ℕ) : x (i + k) = x (j + k) := by
    induction k with | zero => rwa [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, add_zero] | succ k hk => ?_
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc]
    exact h hk
  simpa only [Fin.cast_val_eq_self] using h k

name: map_add_nat_mul_of_map_add_nat_eq
statement:
theorem map_add_nat_mul_of_map_add_nat_eq {j : ℕ} (hx0 : x (i + j) = x i) (k) :
    x (i + (j * k : ℕ)) = x i
proof:
:= by
  induction k with | zero => rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] | succ k hk => ?_
  rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.cast_add, ← add_assoc,
    add_right_comm, hx.map_add_eq_of_map_eq hp hx0, hk]

name: const_of_exists_map_add_one_eq
statement: theorem const_of_exists_map_add_one_eq (hx0 : ∃ i, x (i + 1) = x i) : ∃ C, ∀ i, x i = C
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx0 with ⟨i, hi⟩
  refine ⟨x i, λ j ↦ ?_⟩
  replace hi : x (i + (1 * (j - i).val : ℕ)) = x i :=
    hx.map_add_nat_mul_of_map_add_nat_eq hp hi _
  rwa [Nat.one_mul, Fin.cast_val_eq_self, add_sub_cancel] at hi

name: const_of_exists_map_add_two_eq
statement:
theorem const_of_exists_map_add_two_eq
    (hm : Odd m) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hx : good m n p x) (hx0 : ∃ i, x (i + 2) = x i) :
    ∃ C, ∀ i, x i = C
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx0 with ⟨i, hi⟩
  refine hx.const_of_exists_map_add_one_eq hp ⟨i, ?_⟩
  replace hm : 2 ∣ m + 1 := by
    rwa [← even_iff_two_dvd, Nat.even_add_one, Nat.not_even_iff_odd]
  replace hi : x (i + (2 * ((m + 1) / 2) : ℕ)) = x i :=
    hx.map_add_nat_mul_of_map_add_nat_eq hp hi _
  rwa [Nat.mul_div_cancel' hm, Nat.cast_succ, Fin.natCast_self, zero_add] at hi

name: const_of_exp_eq_zero_p_ne_zero
statement:
theorem const_of_exp_eq_zero_p_ne_zero (hp : p ≠ 0) (hx : good m 0 p x) :
    ∃ C, ∀ i, x i = C
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨x 0, λ i ↦ ?_⟩
  specialize hx (i - 1) (-1)
  rwa [Int.pow_zero, Int.pow_zero, Int.add_right_inj, sub_add_cancel,
    neg_add_cancel, Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff hp] at hx

name: neg_of_exp_odd
statement: theorem neg_of_exp_odd {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m n p x) : good m n p (-x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  iterate 2 rw [Pi.neg_apply, Pi.neg_apply, hn.neg_pow, Int.mul_neg, ← Int.neg_add]
  exact neg_inj.mpr (hx i j)

name: const_of_exp_odd_p_nonpos
statement:
theorem const_of_exp_odd_p_nonpos (hp : p ≤ 0) {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m n p x) :
    ∃ C, ∀ i, x i = C
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | hp0 : p = 0 ∨ p < 0 := hp.eq_or_lt
  · refine ⟨x 0, λ i ↦ hn.pow_inj.mp ?_⟩
    simpa only [Int.zero_mul, Int.add_zero] using hx i 0
  
  wlog hx0 : x 0 ≤ x 1 generalizing x
  · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C, ∀ i, -x i = C :=
      this (hx.neg_of_exp_odd hn) (Int.neg_le_neg_iff.mpr (Int.le_of_not_le hx0))
    exact ⟨-C, λ i ↦ neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp (hC i)⟩
  
  replace hx0 (i : ℕ) : x i ≤ x (i + 1) := by
    induction i with | zero => rwa [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add] | succ i hi => ?_
    rwa [← Int.mul_le_mul_left_of_neg hp0, ← Int.add_le_add_iff_left (x i ^ n),
      Nat.cast_succ, hx i (i + 1), Int.add_le_add_iff_right, hn.pow_le_pow]
  replace hx0 (i) : x i ≤ x (i + 1) := by
    simpa only [Fin.cast_val_eq_self] using hx0 i
  
  replace hx0 (i) (j : ℕ) : x i ≤ x (i + j) := by
    induction j with | zero => rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] | succ j hj => ?_
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, ← add_assoc]
    exact hj.trans (hx0 _)
  
  replace hx0 (i j) : x i ≤ x j := by
    simpa only [Fin.cast_val_eq_self, add_sub_cancel] using hx0 i (j - i).val
  exact ⟨x 0, λ i ↦ (hx0 i 0).antisymm (hx0 0 i)⟩

name: two_periodic_of_exp_odd_p_pos
statement:
theorem two_periodic_of_exp_odd_p_pos (hp : p > 0) {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m n p x) (i) :
    x (i + 2) = x i
proof:
:= by
  
  wlog hx0 : x i ≤ x (i + 2) generalizing x
  · have h : -x (i + 2) = -x i :=
      this (hx.neg_of_exp_odd hn) (Int.neg_le_neg_iff.mpr (Int.le_of_not_le hx0))
    exact neg_inj.mp h
  
  have h {j k} (hjk : x j ≤ x k) : x (k + 1) ≤ x (j + 1) := by
    rwa [← Int.mul_le_mul_left hp, ← Int.add_le_add_iff_left (x j ^ n),
      hx j k, Int.add_le_add_iff_right, hn.pow_le_pow]
  
  replace h (j : ℕ) : x (i + (2 * j : ℕ)) ≤ x (i + (2 * (j + 1) : ℕ)) := by
    induction j with | zero => rwa [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, Nat.cast_two] | succ j hj => ?_
    replace hj : x (i + (2 * j : ℕ) + 1 + 1) ≤ x (i + (2 * (j + 1) : ℕ) + 1 + 1) := h (h hj)
    rw [add_assoc _ 1 1, add_assoc _ 1 1, one_add_one_eq_two] at hj
    iterate 2 rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.cast_add, ← add_assoc]
    rwa [Nat.cast_two]
  
  replace h (j : ℕ) : x (i + 2) ≤ x (i + (2 * (j + 1) : ℕ)) := by
    induction j with | zero => rw [Nat.cast_two] | succ j hj => exact hj.trans (h _)
  
  specialize h (m - 1)
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel NeZero.one_le, Nat.two_mul,
    Nat.cast_add, Fin.natCast_self, add_zero, add_zero] at h
  exact h.antisymm hx0

name: const_of_exp_odd_length_odd
statement:
theorem const_of_exp_odd_length_odd (hm : Odd m) {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m n p x) :
    ∃ C, ∀ i, x i = C
proof:
:= by
  obtain hp | hp : p ≤ 0 ∨ p > 0 := (Int.lt_or_le 0 p).symm
  exacts [const_of_exp_odd_p_nonpos hn hp hx,
    hx.const_of_exists_map_add_two_eq hm hp.ne.symm
      ⟨0, hx.two_periodic_of_exp_odd_p_pos hn hp 0⟩]

name: formula_of_exp_two_mul
statement:
theorem formula_of_exp_two_mul {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m (2 * k) p x) :
    (∏ i, (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k)) * ∏ i, (x i ^ k - x (i + 1) ^ k)
      = (-p) ^ m * ∏ i, (x i - x (i + 1))
proof:
:= calc
  _ = ∏ i, ((x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) * (x i ^ k - x (i + 1) ^ k)) := prod_mul_distrib.symm
  _ = ∏ i, (-p * (x (i + 1) - x (i + 1 + 1))) := by
    refine prod_congr rfl λ i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← sq_sub_sq, ← Int.pow_mul, ← Int.pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Int.neg_mul, ← Int.mul_neg,
      Int.neg_sub, Int.mul_sub, sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, hx i (i + 1), Int.add_comm]
  _ = (-p) ^ m * ∏ i, (x (i + 1) - x (i + 1 + 1)) := by
    rw [prod_mul_distrib, prod_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  _ = (-p) ^ m * ∏ i, (x i - x (i + 1)) :=
    congrArg ((-p) ^ m * ·) (Fintype.prod_equiv (Equiv.addRight 1) _ _ λ _ ↦ rfl)

name: formula_of_exp_two_mul2
statement:
theorem formula_of_exp_two_mul2
    {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m (2 * k) p x) (hx0 : ∀ i, x (i + 1) ≠ x i) :
    (∏ i, (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k)) * ∏ i, (x i ^ k - x (i + 1) ^ k) / (x i - x (i + 1))
      = (-p) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∏ i, (x i - x (i + 1)) ≠ 0 :=
    prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr λ i _ ↦ sub_ne_zero_of_ne (hx0 i).symm
  have h0 : (∏ i, (x i ^ k - x (i + 1) ^ k) / (x i - x (i + 1))) * ∏ i, (x i - x (i + 1))
      = ∏ i, (x i ^ k - x (i + 1) ^ k) :=
    prod_mul_distrib.symm.trans <| prod_congr rfl λ i _ ↦
      Int.ediv_mul_cancel (sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow _ _ k)
  rw [← Int.mul_eq_mul_right_iff h, Int.mul_assoc, h0, hx.formula_of_exp_two_mul]

name: dvd_of_exp_two_mul
statement:
theorem dvd_of_exp_two_mul
    {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m (2 * k) p x) (hx0 : ∀ i, x (i + 1) ≠ x i) :
    ∏ i, (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) ∣ p ^ m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(-1) ^ m * ∏ i, (x i ^ k - x (i + 1) ^ k) / (x i - x (i + 1)), ?_⟩
  rw [Int.mul_left_comm, hx.formula_of_exp_two_mul2 hx0,
    ← Int.mul_pow, Int.neg_one_mul, Int.neg_neg]

name: const_of_exp_two_mul_and_p_odd
statement:
theorem const_of_exp_two_mul_and_p_odd
    {k p} (hm : Odd m) (hp : Odd p) {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m (2 * k) p x) :
    ∃ C, ∀ i, x i = C
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain hx0 | hx0 : (∃ i, x (i + 1) = x i) ∨ (∀ i, x (i + 1) ≠ x i) :=
    Classical.exists_or_forall_not _
  · exact hx.const_of_exists_map_add_one_eq (λ hp0 ↦ Int.not_odd_zero (hp0 ▸ hp)) hx0
  
  replace hx0 : Odd (∏ i, (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k)) :=
    odd_of_dvd_Int (Int.odd_pow.mpr (Or.inl hp)) (hx.dvd_of_exp_two_mul hx0)
  replace hx0 (i) : (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) % 2 = 1 :=
    Int.odd_iff.mp (odd_prod_Int_Fintype.mp hx0 i)
  
  refine absurd ?_ Int.zero_ne_one
  calc 0
    _ = (∑ i, x i ^ k + ∑ i, x i ^ k) % 2 := by rw [← Int.two_mul, Int.mul_emod_right]
    _ = (∑ i, x i ^ k + ∑ i, x (i + 1) ^ k) % 2 :=
      congrArg (λ n ↦ (_ + n) % 2) (Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight 1) _ _ λ _ ↦ rfl).symm
    _ = (∑ i, (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) % 2) % 2 := by rw [← sum_add_distrib, sum_int_mod]
    _ = (∑ i : Fin m, 1) % 2 := congrArg (· % 2) (sum_congr rfl λ i _ ↦ hx0 i)
    _ = m % 2 := by rw [sum_const, nsmul_one, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    _ = 1 := by rwa [← Int.odd_iff, Int.odd_coe_nat]

name: neg_of_exp_even
statement:
theorem neg_of_exp_even {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m (2 * k) p x) :
    good m (2 * k) (-p) (-x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j; simp_rw [Pi.neg_apply, Int.neg_mul_neg, Int.neg_pow (n := 2 * k)]
  rw [Nat.mul_mod_right, Int.pow_zero, Int.one_mul, Int.one_mul, hx i j]

name: const_of_exp_two_mul_and_abs_p_eq_two
statement:
theorem const_of_exp_two_mul_and_abs_p_eq_two
    {k p} (hm : Odd m) (hp : p.natAbs = 2) {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m (2 * k) p x) :
    ∃ C, ∀ i, x i = C
proof:
:= by
  
  wlog hp0 : p = 2 generalizing p x
  · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C, ∀ i, -x i = C :=
      this (p.natAbs_neg.trans hp) hx.neg_of_exp_even
        ((Int.natAbs_eq_iff.mp hp).elim hp0.elim neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr)
    exact ⟨-C, λ i ↦ neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp (hC i)⟩
  subst hp0; replace hp : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by decide
  
  obtain hx0 | hx0 : (∃ i, x (i + 1) = x i) ∨ (∀ i, x (i + 1) ≠ x i) :=
    Classical.exists_or_forall_not _
  · exact hx.const_of_exists_map_add_one_eq hp hx0
  
  replace h (i j) : 2 ∣ x i ^ k + x j ^ k := by
    have h : x i ^ (2 * k) - x j ^ (2 * k) = 2 * (x (j + 1) - x (i + 1)) := by
      rw [Int.mul_sub, sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, hx i j, Int.add_comm]
    replace h : 2 ∣ x i ^ (2 * k) - x j ^ (2 * k) := ⟨x (j + 1) - x (i + 1), h⟩
    rw [← even_iff_two_dvd, Int.even_sub, Int.even_pow, Int.even_pow,
      Nat.mul_ne_zero_iff, and_iff_right (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at h
    rwa [← even_iff_two_dvd, Int.even_add, Int.even_pow, Int.even_pow]
  
  have h0 : 2 ^ m * ∏ i, (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) / 2 ∣ 2 ^ m := calc
    _ = ∏ i, 2 * ((x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) / 2) := by
      rw [prod_mul_distrib, prod_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    _ = ∏ i, (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) :=
      prod_congr rfl λ i _ ↦ Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (h i (i + 1))
    _ ∣ 2 ^ m := hx.dvd_of_exp_two_mul hx0
  replace h0 : ∏ i, (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) / 2 ∣ 1 := by
    rwa [← Int.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (Int.pow_ne_zero hp (m := m)), Int.mul_one]
  
  replace h0 : ∀ i, ((x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) / 2).natAbs = 1 := by
    rwa [← Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs, Int.natAbs_one, Nat.dvd_one,
      natAbs_prod_Int, prod_eq_one_Nat_Fintype] at h0
  replace h0 (i) : (x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k).natAbs = 2 := by
    rw [← Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (h _ _), Int.natAbs_mul, h0]; rfl
  
  replace h (i) : x (i + 2) ^ k = x i ^ k
      ∨ x (i + 1) ^ k + x (i + 2) ^ k = -(x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) := by
    rw [← Int.add_right_inj (x (i + 1) ^ k), ← one_add_one_eq_two, ← add_assoc,
      Int.add_comm _ (x i ^ k), ← Int.natAbs_eq_natAbs_iff, h0, h0]
  
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ | h1 : (∃ i, x (i + 2) ^ k = x i ^ k) ∨ (∀ i, x (i + 2) ^ k ≠ x i ^ k) :=
    Classical.exists_or_forall_not _
  · refine hx.const_of_exists_map_add_two_eq hm hp ⟨i + 1, ?_⟩
    replace h := hx (i + 2) i
    rwa [Nat.mul_comm 2 k, Int.pow_mul, Int.pow_mul, hi,
      Int.add_right_inj, add_right_comm, Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff hp] at h
  
  replace h (i) : x (i + 1) ^ k + x (i + 2) ^ k = -(x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k) :=
    (h i).resolve_left (h1 i)
  
  replace h (i : ℕ) : x i ^ k + x (i + 1) ^ k = (-1) ^ i * (x 0 ^ k + x 1 ^ k) := by
    induction i with
    | zero => rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, Int.pow_zero, Int.one_mul]
    | succ i hi => rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two,
        h, hi, ← Int.neg_mul, Int.pow_succ, Int.mul_neg_one]
  
  replace h : x 0 ^ k + x 1 ^ k = -(x 0 ^ k + x 1 ^ k) := calc
    _ = x m ^ k + x (m + 1) ^ k := by rw [Fin.natCast_self, zero_add]
    _ = -(x 0 ^ k + x 1 ^ k) := by rw [h, hm.neg_one_pow, Int.neg_one_mul]
  
  replace h : x 0 ^ k + x 1 ^ k = 0 := self_eq_neg.mp h
  replace h0 : (x 0 ^ k + x (0 + 1) ^ k).natAbs = 2 := h0 0
  rw [zero_add, h, Int.natAbs_zero] at h0
  exact absurd h0.symm (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {m n p} [NeZero m] (hm : Odd m) (hp : Odd p ∨ p.natAbs = 2)
    {x : Fin m → ℤ} (hx : good m n p x) : ∃ C, ∀ i, x i = C
proof:
:= by
  obtain hn | ⟨k, rfl⟩ : Odd n ∨ 2 ∣ n :=
    (Nat.even_or_odd n).symm.imp_right even_iff_two_dvd.mp
  exacts [hx.const_of_exp_odd_length_odd hn hm,
    hp.elim (hx.const_of_exp_two_mul_and_p_odd hm)
      (hx.const_of_exp_two_mul_and_abs_p_eq_two hm)]

name: exists_lt_pow_mod_eq
statement: theorem exists_lt_pow_mod_eq : ∃ a, ∃ b > a, k ^ a % m = k ^ b % m
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero m := NeZero.of_pos hm
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, h⟩ : ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ ((k ^ a : ℕ) : Fin m) = (k ^ b : ℕ) :=
    Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite _
  obtain hab | hab : a < b ∨ b < a := Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hab
  exacts [⟨a, b, hab, congrArg Fin.val h⟩, ⟨b, a, hab, congrArg Fin.val h.symm⟩]

name: exists_lt_dvd_pow_sub_pow
statement: theorem exists_lt_dvd_pow_sub_pow : ∃ a, ∃ b > a, (m : ℤ) ∣ k ^ b - k ^ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, h⟩ : ∃ a, ∃ b > a, k ^ a % m = k ^ b % m := exists_lt_pow_mod_eq k hm
  refine ⟨a, b, hab, ?_⟩
  rw [Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, ← Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero,
    ← Int.natCast_pow, ← Int.natCast_emod, ← Int.natCast_pow, ← Int.natCast_emod, h]

name: exists_lt_dvd_pow_add_sub_pow
statement: theorem exists_lt_dvd_pow_add_sub_pow : ∃ N, ∃ d > 0, (m : ℤ) ∣ k ^ (N + d) - k ^ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, h⟩ : ∃ a, ∃ b > a, (m : ℤ) ∣ k ^ b - k ^ a :=
    exists_lt_dvd_pow_sub_pow k hm
  refine ⟨a, b - a, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hab, ?_⟩
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Nat.le_of_lt hab)]

name: exists_lt_pow_eq_pow_add_mul
statement: theorem exists_lt_pow_eq_pow_add_mul : ∃ N, ∃ d > 0, ∃ t, k ^ (N + d) = m * t + k ^ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hk : k = 0 ∨ k > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k
  · exact ⟨1, 1, Nat.one_pos, 0, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N, d, hd, t, ht⟩ : ∃ N, ∃ d > 0, (m : ℤ) ∣ k ^ (N + d) - k ^ N :=
    exists_lt_dvd_pow_add_sub_pow k hm
  refine ⟨N, d, hd, t.natAbs, ?_⟩
  replace hd : k ^ N ≤ k ^ (N + d) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hk (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  replace ht : ((k ^ (N + d) - k ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) = m * t := by
    rwa [← Int.natCast_pow, ← Int.natCast_pow, ← Int.natCast_sub hd] at ht
  refine Nat.eq_add_of_sub_eq hd ?_
  have ht0 : t ≥ 0 :=
    Int.nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right ((Nat.cast_nonneg _).trans_eq ht) (Int.natCast_pos.mpr hm)
  rw [← Int.natCast_inj, ht, Int.natCast_mul, Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_of_nonneg ht0]

name: nthDecimalDigit_add
statement:
theorem nthDecimalDigit_add (b) (r : R) (n d) :
    nthDecimalDigit b r (n + d) = nthDecimalDigit b (b ^ d * r) n
proof:
:= by
  unfold nthDecimalDigit; rw [Nat.add_right_comm, pow_add, mul_assoc]

name: nthDecimalDigit_alt_formula
statement:
theorem nthDecimalDigit_alt_formula (b : ℕ) (r : R) (n : ℕ) :
    nthDecimalDigit b r n = ⌊b ^ (n + 1) * r⌋ - b * ⌊b ^ n * r⌋
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hb : b = 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne _ _
  · rw [nthDecimalDigit, Int.natCast_zero, Int.zero_mul, Int.sub_zero, Int.emod_zero]
  · rw [nthDecimalDigit, Int.emod_def, sub_right_inj, pow_succ',
      mul_assoc, Int.natCast_mul_floor_div_cancel hb]

name: nthDecimalDigit_floor_sum_formula
statement:
theorem nthDecimalDigit_floor_sum_formula (b : ℕ) (r : R) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, b ^ (n - (i + 1)) * nthDecimalDigit b r i
      = ⌊b ^ n * r⌋ - b ^ n * ⌊r⌋
proof:
:=
  let f (i : ℕ) : ℤ := b ^ (n - i) * ⌊b ^ i * r⌋
  calc ∑ i ∈ range n, b ^ (n - (i + 1)) * nthDecimalDigit b r i
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range n, (f (i + 1) - f i) := by
      refine sum_congr rfl λ i hi ↦ ?_
      rw [nthDecimalDigit_alt_formula, Int.mul_sub, Int.sub_right_inj, ← Int.mul_assoc,
        ← Int.pow_succ, ← Nat.succ_sub (mem_range.mp hi), Nat.succ_sub_succ]
    _ = b ^ (n - n) * ⌊b ^ n * r⌋ - b ^ n * ⌊b ^ 0 * r⌋ := sum_range_sub _ _
    _ = ⌊b ^ n * r⌋ - b ^ n * ⌊r⌋ := by
      rw [Nat.sub_self, Int.pow_zero, Int.one_mul, pow_zero, one_mul]

name: nthDecimalDigit_fract_sum_formula
statement:
theorem nthDecimalDigit_fract_sum_formula (b : ℕ) (r : R) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, b ^ (n - (i + 1)) * nthDecimalDigit b r i
      = b ^ n * Int.fract r - Int.fract (b ^ n * r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.fract, mul_sub, Int.fract, ← sub_add, sub_sub_cancel_left,
    neg_add_eq_sub, nthDecimalDigit_floor_sum_formula, Int.cast_sub,
    Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_natCast]

name: nthDecimalDigit_fract_sum_formula2
statement:
theorem nthDecimalDigit_fract_sum_formula2 (b : ℕ) (r : R) (n : ℕ) :
    b ^ n * Int.fract r = Int.fract (b ^ n * r)
      + ∑ i ∈ range n, b ^ (n - (i + 1)) * nthDecimalDigit b r i
proof:
:= by
  rw [nthDecimalDigit_fract_sum_formula, add_sub_cancel]

name: infinitesimal_of_nthDecimalDigit_eq
statement:
theorem infinitesimal_of_nthDecimalDigit_eq (hb : b > 1)
    {r s : R} (hrs : nthDecimalDigit b r = nthDecimalDigit b s) (n : ℕ) :
    n • |Int.fract r - Int.fract s| < 1
proof:
:=
  calc n • |Int.fract r - Int.fract s|
  _ ≤ b ^ n • |Int.fract r - Int.fract s| :=
    nsmul_le_nsmul_left (abs_nonneg _) (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_pow_self hb))
  _ = |b ^ n * Int.fract r - b ^ n * Int.fract s| := by
    rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_pow, Nat.abs_cast, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_pow]
  _ < 1 := by
    refine Int.abs_sub_lt_one_of_floor_eq_floor ?_
    iterate 2 rw [nthDecimalDigit_fract_sum_formula2,
      Int.floor_add_intCast, Int.floor_fract, Int.zero_add]
    rw [hrs]

name: sub_eq_intCast_of_nthDecimalDigit_eq
statement:
theorem sub_eq_intCast_of_nthDecimalDigit_eq [Archimedean R] (hb : b > 1)
    {r s : R} (hrs : nthDecimalDigit b r = nthDecimalDigit b s) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, r - s = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h : |Int.fract r - Int.fract s| = 0 ∨ 0 < |Int.fract r - Int.fract s| :=
    eq_or_lt_of_le' (abs_nonneg _)
  
  · refine ⟨⌊r⌋ - ⌊s⌋, ?_⟩
    rw [Int.cast_sub, sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub]
    exact eq_of_abs_sub_eq_zero h
  
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, 1 ≤ n • |Int.fract r - Int.fract s| := Archimedean.arch _ h
    exact absurd hn (infinitesimal_of_nthDecimalDigit_eq hb hrs n).not_ge

name: isRational.nthDecimalDigit_eventually_periodic
statement:
theorem isRational.nthDecimalDigit_eventually_periodic {r : R} (hr : isRational r) (b) :
    ∃ N, ∃ d > 0, ∀ n ≥ N, nthDecimalDigit b r (n + d) = nthDecimalDigit b r n
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases hr with ⟨m, hm, T, hr⟩
  
  obtain ⟨N, d, hd, z, hz⟩ : ∃ N, ∃ d > 0, (m : ℤ) ∣ b ^ (N + d) - b ^ N :=
    exists_lt_dvd_pow_add_sub_pow b hm
  
  refine ⟨N, d, hd, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  
  replace hz : b ^ (N + d) * r = (T * z : ℤ) + b ^ N * r :=
    calc b ^ (N + d) * r
    _ = ((b ^ (N + d) : ℤ) : R) * r := by rw [Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_natCast]
    _ = (m * z + (b ^ N : ℤ)) * r := by
      rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq hz, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
    _ = m * z * r + b ^ N * r := by rw [add_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_natCast]
    _ = (T * z : ℤ) + b ^ N * r := by rw [mul_right_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, hr, Int.cast_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = N + k := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  calc ⌊b ^ (N + k + d + 1) * r⌋ % b
    _ = ⌊b ^ (N + d) * r * b ^ (k + 1)⌋ % b := by
      rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_add_add_comm, pow_add, mul_right_comm]
    _ = ⌊((T * z : ℤ) + b ^ N * r) * b ^ (k + 1)⌋ % b := by rw [hz]
    _ = ⌊(T * z : ℤ) * b ^ (k + 1) + b ^ (N + k + 1) * r⌋ % b := by
      rw [add_mul, Nat.add_assoc, mul_right_comm, ← pow_add]
    _ = ⌊(T * z * b ^ (k + 1) : ℤ) + b ^ (N + k + 1) * r⌋ % b := by
      rw [Int.cast_mul (T * z), Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_natCast]
    _ = (T * z * b ^ k * b + ⌊b ^ (N + k + 1) * r⌋) % b := by
      rw [Int.floor_intCast_add, Int.pow_succ, ← Int.mul_assoc]
    _ = ⌊b ^ (N + k + 1) * r⌋ % b := Int.mul_add_emod_self_right _ _ _

name: isRational_of_nthDecimalDigit_eventually_periodic
statement:
theorem isRational_of_nthDecimalDigit_eventually_periodic
    [Archimedean R] (hb : b > 1) {r : R}
    (hr : ∃ N, ∃ d > 0, ∀ n ≥ N, nthDecimalDigit b r (n + d) = nthDecimalDigit b r n) :
    isRational r
proof:
:= by
  /- Pick `N` and `d` such that `(n + d)`th decimal digit and
    `n`th decimal digit of `r` in base `b` are equal for all `n ≥ N`. -/
  rcases hr with ⟨N, d, hd, h⟩
  
  replace h : nthDecimalDigit b (b ^ (N + d) * r) = nthDecimalDigit b (b ^ N * r) := by
    funext n; rw [← nthDecimalDigit_add, ← nthDecimalDigit_add,
      ← Nat.add_assoc, h _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)]
  
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : ℤ, ↑b ^ (N + d) * r - ↑b ^ N * r = z :=
    sub_eq_intCast_of_nthDecimalDigit_eq hb h
  replace h : b ^ N < b ^ (N + d) := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right hb (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right hd)
  replace hz : (b ^ (N + d) - b ^ N) • r = z := by
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt h), Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_pow, sub_mul, hz]
  
  exact ⟨_, Nat.zero_lt_sub_of_lt h, z, hz⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [Archimedean R] (hb : b > 1) {x y : R} (hx : isRational x)
    (hyx : ∀ n, nthDecimalDigit b y n = nthDecimalDigit b x (2 ^ n)) :
    isRational y
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨N, d, hd, hx0⟩ :
      ∃ N, ∃ d > 0, ∀ n ≥ N, nthDecimalDigit b x (n + d) = nthDecimalDigit b x n :=
    hx.nthDecimalDigit_eventually_periodic b
  replace hx0 {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≥ N) (t) :
      nthDecimalDigit b x (n + d * t) = nthDecimalDigit b x n := by
    induction t with | zero => rfl | succ t t_ih =>
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc, hx0 _ (Nat.le_add_right_of_le hn), t_ih]
  
  obtain ⟨M, c, hc, t, ht⟩ : ∃ M, ∃ c > 0, ∃ t, 2 ^ (M + c) = d * t + 2 ^ M :=
    exists_lt_pow_eq_pow_add_mul 2 hd
  
  refine isRational_of_nthDecimalDigit_eventually_periodic hb ⟨M + N, c, hc, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = M + k := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_of_add_right_le hn)
  replace hn : N ≤ 2 ^ (M + k) := calc
    N ≤ k := Nat.add_le_add_iff_left.mp hn
    _ ≤ M + k := Nat.le_add_left k M
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (M + k) := Nat.le_of_lt Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  calc nthDecimalDigit b y (M + k + c)
    _ = nthDecimalDigit b x (2 ^ (M + c) * 2 ^ k) := by
      rw [hyx, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.pow_add]
    _ = nthDecimalDigit b x (2 ^ (M + k) + d * (t * 2 ^ k)) := by
      rw [ht, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.pow_add, Nat.add_comm]
    _ = nthDecimalDigit b x (2 ^ (M + k)) := hx0 hn _
    _ = nthDecimalDigit b y (M + k) := (hyx _).symm

name: sum_div_eq_sum_card_divisors
statement:
theorem sum_div_eq_sum_card_divisors (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, n / k = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, #k.divisors
proof:
:= by
  
  induction n with | zero => rfl | succ n n_ih => ?_
  
  calc ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n + 1), (n + 1) / k
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n + 1), (n / k + if k ∣ n + 1 then 1 else 0) :=
      sum_congr rfl λ _ _ ↦ Nat.succ_div
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n + 1), n / k + ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n + 1), if k ∣ n + 1 then 1 else 0 :=
      sum_add_distrib
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, n / k + #{k ∈ Icc 1 (n + 1) | k ∣ n + 1} := by
      refine congrArg₂ _ ?_ (card_filter (· ∣ n + 1) _).symm
      rw [sum_Icc_succ_top n.succ_pos, Nat.div_eq_of_lt n.lt_succ_self, Nat.add_zero]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n + 1), #k.divisors := by
      rw [n_ih, sum_Icc_succ_top n.succ_pos, ← Ico_succ_right_eq_Icc]; rfl

name: f_lt_f_of_sum_div
statement:
theorem f_lt_f_of_sum_div
    {m n : ℕ} (h : m * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, #k.divisors < n * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 m, #k.divisors) :
    f n < f m
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | hm : m = 0 ∨ 0 < m := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m
  · rw [Nat.zero_mul, Icc_eq_empty_of_lt Nat.one_pos, sum_empty, Nat.mul_zero] at h
    exact absurd rfl h.ne
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ 0 < n := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n
  · rw [Nat.zero_mul, Icc_eq_empty_of_lt Nat.one_pos, sum_empty, Nat.mul_zero] at h
    exact absurd rfl h.ne
  
  unfold f
  replace hm : 0 < (m : ℤ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  replace hn : 0 < (n : ℤ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  rwa [← Rat.not_le, Rat.divInt_le_divInt hm hn, ← Int.natCast_mul, ← Int.natCast_mul,
    Int.not_le, Nat.cast_lt, sum_div_eq_sum_card_divisors, sum_div_eq_sum_card_divisors,
    Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_comm _ n]

name: exists_infinite_map_lt_of_lt_of_unbounded
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_map_lt_of_lt_of_unbounded {g : ℕ → ℕ} (hg : ∀ M, ∃ n, M < g n) (N) :
    ∃ n ≥ N, ∀ k < n, g k < g n
proof:
:= by
  
  contrapose! hg
  refine ⟨(range (N + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one g, λ n ↦ ?_⟩
  
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h n n_ih => ?_
  obtain hn | hn : n ≤ N ∨ n ≥ N := Nat.le_total _ _
  · exact le_sup' _ (mem_range_succ_iff.mpr hn)
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hk0⟩ : ∃ k < n, g n ≤ g k := hg _ hn
    exact hk0.trans (n_ih k hk)

name: exists_infinite_card_divisors_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_card_divisors_lt_of_lt (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ n ≥ N, ∀ k < n, #k.divisors < #n.divisors
proof:
:=
  have h (M) : ∃ n : ℕ, M < #n.divisors := by
    refine ⟨2 ^ M, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.divisors_prime_pow Nat.prime_two, card_map, card_range]
    exact Nat.lt_add_one M
  exists_infinite_map_lt_of_lt_of_unbounded h N

name: f_pred_lt_of_card_divisors
statement:
theorem f_pred_lt_of_card_divisors (hn : n > 0) (hn0 : ∀ k < n, #k.divisors < #n.divisors) :
    f (n - 1) < f n
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | hn1 : 1 = n ∨ 1 < n := Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hn
  · decide
  
  refine f_lt_f_of_sum_div ?_
  have hn2 : n - 1 + 1 = n := Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hn
  calc n * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n - 1), #k.divisors
    _ = (n - 1) * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n - 1), #k.divisors + ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n - 1), #k.divisors := by
      rw [← Nat.add_one_mul, hn2]
    _ < (n - 1) * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n - 1), #k.divisors + ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n - 1), #n.divisors :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_left (k := _) <| sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty
        ⟨1, left_mem_Icc.mpr (Nat.le_pred_of_lt hn1)⟩
        (λ k hk ↦ hn0 _ (Nat.lt_of_le_pred hn (mem_Icc.mp hk).2))
    _ = (n - 1) * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n - 1), #k.divisors + (n - 1) * #(n - 1 + 1).divisors := by
      rw [hn2, sum_const, Nat.card_Icc, hn2]; rfl
    _ = (n - 1) * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, #k.divisors := by
      rw [← Nat.mul_add, ← sum_Icc_succ_top (Nat.succ_pos _), hn2]

name: final_solution_part1
statement: theorem final_solution_part1 (N : ℕ) : ∃ n ≥ N, f n < f (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht, ht0⟩ : ∃ t > N, ∀ k < t, #k.divisors < #t.divisors :=
    exists_infinite_card_divisors_lt_of_lt _
  
  refine ⟨t - 1, Nat.le_pred_of_lt ht, ?_⟩
  have ht1 : t > 0 := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt ht
  calc f (t - 1)
    _ < f t := f_pred_lt_of_card_divisors ht1 ht0
    _ = f (t - 1 + 1) := congrArg f (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos ht1).symm

name: one_lt_card_divisors
statement: theorem one_lt_card_divisors {n : ℕ} (hn : n > 1) : #n.divisors > 1
proof:
:= calc
  1 < #n.properDivisors + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left (card_pos.mpr ⟨1, Nat.one_mem_properDivisors_iff_one_lt.mpr hn⟩)
  _ = #(insert n n.properDivisors) :=
    (card_insert_of_notMem Nat.self_notMem_properDivisors).symm
  _ = #n.divisors := congrArg card (Nat.insert_self_properDivisors (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn))

name: two_mul_lt_sum_divisors
statement:
theorem two_mul_lt_sum_divisors {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≥ 6) :
    2 * n < ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, #k.divisors
proof:
:= by
  
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with | base => decide | succ n hn n_ih => ?_
  replace hn : 1 < n + 1 := Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn)
  calc 2 * n + 2
    _ < ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, #k.divisors + #(n + 1).divisors :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le n_ih (one_lt_card_divisors hn)
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (n + 1), #k.divisors := (sum_Icc_succ_top hn.le _).symm

name: f_lt_pred_of_prime
statement: theorem f_lt_pred_of_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p > 6) (hp0 : p.Prime) : f p < f (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine f_lt_f_of_sum_div ?_
  have hp1 : p - 1 + 1 = p := Nat.succ_pred_prime hp0
  calc (p - 1) * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 p, #k.divisors
    _ = (p - 1) * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (p - 1 + 1), #k.divisors := by rw [hp1]
    _ = (p - 1) * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (p - 1), #k.divisors + 2 * (p - 1) := by
      rw [sum_Icc_succ_top (Nat.le_add_left _ _), hp1, hp0.divisors,
        card_pair hp0.ne_one.symm, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_comm _ 2]
    _ < (p - 1) * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (p - 1), #k.divisors + ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (p - 1), #k.divisors :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_left (two_mul_lt_sum_divisors (Nat.le_pred_of_lt hp)) _
    _ = p * ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (p - 1), #k.divisors := by rw [← Nat.add_one_mul, hp1]

name: final_solution_part2
statement: theorem final_solution_part2 (N : ℕ) : ∃ n ≥ N, f (n + 1) < f n
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0⟩ : ∃ p > max 6 N, Nat.Prime p := Nat.exists_infinite_primes _
  replace hp : p > 6 ∧ p > N := Nat.max_lt.mp hp
  
  refine ⟨p - 1, Nat.le_pred_of_lt hp.2, ?_⟩
  calc f (p - 1 + 1)
    _ = f p := congrArg f (Nat.sub_add_cancel hp0.pos)
    _ < f (p - 1) := f_lt_pred_of_prime hp.1 hp0

name: floor_f_abs_le_floor_abs
statement: theorem floor_f_abs_le_floor_abs (r : R) : |⌊f r⌋| ≤ |⌊r⌋|
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ Int.fract r := Int.fract_nonneg r
  have hr1 : Int.fract r ≤ 1 := (Int.fract_lt_one r).le
  obtain hr | hr : 0 ≤ r ∨ r ≤ 0 := le_total 0 r
  
  · have hr2 : 0 ≤ ⌊r⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr hr
    replace hr : (0 : R) ≤ ⌊r⌋ := Int.cast_nonneg hr2
    replace hr0 : 0 ≤ ⌊f r⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hr hr0)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hr2, abs_of_nonneg hr0, ← Int.cast_le (R := R)]
    exact (Int.floor_le (f r)).trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right hr hr1)
  
  · have hr2 : ⌊r⌋ ≤ 0 := Int.floor_nonpos hr
    replace hr : (⌊r⌋ : R) ≤ 0 := Int.cast_nonpos.mpr hr2
    replace hr0 : ⌊f r⌋ ≤ 0 := Int.floor_nonpos (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hr hr0)
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hr2, abs_of_nonpos hr0, neg_le_neg_iff, Int.le_floor]
    exact le_mul_of_le_one_right hr hr1

name: floor_f_iter_converges
statement: theorem floor_f_iter_converges (r : R) : ∃ (C N : ℕ), ∀ n ≥ N, ⌊f^[n] r⌋ = -C
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨C, N, h⟩ : ∃ C N, ∀ n ≥ N, ⌊f^[n] r⌋.natAbs = C := by
    have h : Antitone (λ n ↦ ⌊f^[n] r⌋.natAbs) :=
      antitone_nat_of_succ_le λ n ↦ by
        simpa [f.iterate_succ_apply', ← Int.ofNat_le] using floor_f_abs_le_floor_abs _
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ⌊f^[N] r⌋.natAbs = ⌊f^[n] r⌋.natAbs :=
      WellFoundedLT.antitone_chain_condition h
    exact ⟨⌊f^[N] r⌋.natAbs, N, λ n hn ↦ (hN n hn).symm⟩
  
  refine ⟨C, N, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  
  refine (Int.natAbs_eq_iff.mp (h n hn)).elim (λ h0 ↦ ?_) id
  obtain rfl | hC : C = 0 ∨ 0 < C := C.eq_zero_or_pos
  · exact h0
  
  refine absurd ?_ (h (n + 1) (Nat.le_succ_of_le hn)).not_lt
  replace hC : 0 < (C : R) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hC
  rw [← Int.natAbs_natCast C, f.iterate_succ_apply', f, h0, Int.cast_natCast]
  exact Int.natAbs_lt_natAbs_of_nonneg_of_lt
    (Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hC.le (Int.fract_nonneg _)))
    (by simpa [Int.floor_lt] using mul_lt_of_lt_one_right hC (Int.fract_lt_one _))

name: f_iter_alt_of_floor_f_iter_lim_one
statement:
theorem f_iter_alt_of_floor_f_iter_lim_one {r : R} (h : ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ⌊f^[n] r⌋ = -1) :
    ∃ s, (0 < s ∧ s < 1) ∧ ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, f^[n] r = if n % 2 = 0 then -s else s - 1
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases h with ⟨N, h⟩
  replace h {n} (hn : 2 * N ≤ n) : ⌊f^[n] r⌋ = -1 :=
    h n ((Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left N Nat.zero_lt_two).trans hn)
  refine ⟨-f^[2 * N] r, ?_, 2 * N, ?_⟩
  
  · obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ : -1 ≤ f^[2 * N] r ∧ f^[2 * N] r < 0 := by
      simpa [Int.floor_eq_iff] using h (Nat.le_refl _)
    
    refine ⟨neg_pos.mpr h1, neg_lt.mpr (h0.lt_of_ne' λ h2 ↦ ?_)⟩
    replace h0 : ⌊f^[2 * N + 1] r⌋ = -1 := h (Nat.le_succ _)
    replace h : Int.fract (-1 : R) = 0 := Int.fract_neg_eq_zero.mpr Int.fract_one
    rw [f.iterate_succ_apply', h2, f, h, mul_zero, Int.floor_zero] at h0
    exact absurd h0 (Int.zero_ne_negSucc 0)
  
  · intro n hn; induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => rw [ite_eq_left (Nat.mul_mod_right _ _), neg_neg]
    | succ n hn hn0 => ?_
    
    simp_rw [Nat.succ_mod_two_eq_zero_iff, ← Nat.mod_two_ne_zero]
    rw [f.iterate_succ_apply', f, Int.fract, h hn, hn0, ite_not, neg_neg,
      Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, sub_neg_eq_add, ite_add, mul_ite,
      neg_one_mul, sub_add_cancel, neg_add', neg_mul_neg, one_mul]

name: f_formula_of_floor_eq_neg
statement:
theorem f_formula_of_floor_eq_neg {r : R} {C : ℕ} (h : ⌊r⌋ = -C) :
    (C + 1) * f r + C ^ 2 = (-C) * ((C + 1) * r + C ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [f, Int.fract, h, Int.cast_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, Int.cast_natCast]
  generalize (C : R) = s; clear C h
  rw [neg_mul, neg_mul, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← neg_add', mul_neg,
    neg_inj, ← mul_assoc, add_one_mul, mul_add, mul_add, add_assoc,
    ← mul_assoc, mul_add_one, add_right_inj, sq, add_mul, mul_assoc]

name: f_formula_of_archimedean_of_floor_eq_neg_nat
statement:
theorem f_formula_of_archimedean_of_floor_eq_neg_nat
    {r : R} {C : ℕ} (hC : 2 ≤ C) (h : ∀ k, ⌊f^[k] r⌋ = -C) :
    (C + 1) * r + C ^ 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  set s : R := (C + 1) * r + C ^ 2
  refine ((abs_nonneg _).eq_or_lt'.imp_left abs_eq_zero.mp).resolve_right λ h0 ↦ ?_
  
  have h1 (k : ℕ) : |(C + 1) * f^[k] r + C ^ 2| = C ^ k • |s| := by
    
    induction k with | zero => exact (one_nsmul _).symm | succ k hk => ?_
    rw [f.iterate_succ_apply', f_formula_of_floor_eq_neg (h k), abs_mul,
      hk, abs_neg, Nat.abs_cast, ← nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_nsmul, ← Nat.pow_succ]
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, (C : R) + 1 + |s| < C ^ k • |s| := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, (C : R) + 1 + |s| < k • |s| := exists_lt_nsmul h0 _
    exact ⟨k, hk.trans (nsmul_lt_nsmul_left h0 (Nat.lt_pow_self hC))⟩
  
  replace hk : (C + 1 : R) < |(C + 1) * (f^[k] r - r)| := by
    rw [← h1, ← lt_sub_iff_add_lt] at hk
    refine hk.trans_le ((abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub _ _).trans_eq ?_)
    rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← mul_sub]
  
  replace h1 : 0 < (C : R) + 1 :=
    add_pos (two_pos.trans_le (Nat.ofNat_le_cast.mpr hC)) one_pos
  rw [abs_mul, abs_eq_self.mpr h1.le, lt_mul_iff_one_lt_right h1] at hk
  exact hk.not_gt (Int.abs_sub_lt_one_of_floor_eq_floor ((h k).trans (h 0).symm))

name: f_formula2_of_archimedean_of_floor_eq_neg_nat
statement:
theorem f_formula2_of_archimedean_of_floor_eq_neg_nat
    {r : R} {C : ℕ} (hC : 2 ≤ C) (h : ∀ n ≥ N, ⌊f^[n] r⌋ = -C) :
    (C + 1) * f^[N] r + C ^ 2 = 0
proof:
:=
  f_formula_of_archimedean_of_floor_eq_neg_nat hC
    λ k ↦ f.iterate_add_apply k N r ▸ h _ (Nat.le_add_left N k)

name: f_iter_converges_or_alt
statement:
theorem f_iter_converges_or_alt (r : R) :
    (∃ r₀ N, ∀ n ≥ N, f^[n] r = r₀) ∨
      (∃ s : R, (0 < s ∧ s < 1) ∧
        ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, f^[n] r = if n % 2 = 0 then -s else s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, h⟩ := floor_f_iter_converges r
  obtain rfl | rfl | hC : C = 0 ∨ C = 1 ∨ 2 ≤ C :=
    C.eq_zero_or_pos.imp_right eq_or_lt_of_le'
  
  · left; rcases h with ⟨N, h⟩
    refine ⟨0, N + 1, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn), f.iterate_succ_apply',
      f, h _ (Nat.le_pred_of_lt hn), Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, Int.cast_zero, zero_mul]
  
  · right; exact f_iter_alt_of_floor_f_iter_lim_one h
  
  · left; rcases h with ⟨N, h⟩
    refine ⟨f^[N] r, N, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    replace h : (C + 1) * f^[n] r + C ^ 2 = (C + 1) * f^[N] r + C ^ 2 :=
      (f_formula2_of_archimedean_of_floor_eq_neg_nat hC λ k hk ↦ h _ (hn.trans hk)).trans
        (f_formula2_of_archimedean_of_floor_eq_neg_nat hC h).symm
    replace hC : 0 < (C : R) + 1 :=
      add_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hC)) one_pos
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hC.ne.symm (add_right_cancel h)

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (r : R) : ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, f^[n + 2] r = f^[n] r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r₀, N, h⟩ | ⟨s, -, N, h⟩ := f_iter_converges_or_alt r
  
  · exact ⟨N, λ n hn ↦ (h _ (Nat.le_add_right_of_le hn)).trans (h n hn).symm⟩
  
  · refine ⟨N, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [h _ (Nat.le_add_right_of_le hn), Nat.add_mod_right, h n hn]

name: comm
statement: theorem comm (x y : A) : α x y = α y x
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain hxy | hxy : x.1 = y ∨ x.1 ≠ y := eq_or_ne x.1 y.1
  · rw [SetCoe.ext hxy]
  
  have h := hα x y x
  rw [sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, ← smul_neg, neg_sub,
    Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def] at h
  exact Units.val_injective (smul_left_injective R (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hxy) h)

name: eq_trans
statement: theorem eq_trans (hxy : α x y = β) (hyz : α y z = β) (hxz : x ≠ z) : α x z = β
proof:
:= by
  replace hxz : x.1 ≠ z.1 := Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hxz
  have h := hα x y z
  rw [hxy, hyz, ← smul_add, sub_add_sub_cancel, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg,
    ← smul_neg, neg_sub, hα.comm, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def] at h
  exact Units.val_injective (smul_left_injective R (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hxz) h).symm

name: good_of_forall_mem_eq
statement:
theorem good_of_forall_mem_eq [hG : Nonempty G] [AddCommGroup M] [SMul G M]
    {A : Set M} (hA : ∀ x y : A, x = y) : good G A
proof:
:=
  hG.elim λ g _ _ ↦ ⟨g, λ x y ↦ absurd (hA x y)⟩

name: good_of_card_units_le_two
statement:
theorem good_of_card_units_le_two
    {R} [Ring R] [IsDomain R] [Fintype Rˣ] (hR : Fintype.card Rˣ ≤ 2)
    {M} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] (A : Set M) :
    good Rˣ A
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain hA | ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ : (∀ x y : A, x = y) ∨ (∃ x y : A, x ≠ y) := by
    simpa only [← not_forall] using em _
  · exact good_of_forall_mem_eq hA
  
  intro α hα; refine ⟨α x y, λ z w hzw ↦ ?_⟩
  
  wlog hyz : y = z generalizing x y z w
  · rw [this _ _ hyz _ _ hzw rfl, this _ _ hxy _ _ hyz rfl]
  
  subst hyz; rename y ≠ w => hyw
  obtain rfl | hwx : w = x ∨ w ≠ x := eq_or_ne _ _
  · exact hα.comm y w
  
  obtain h | h | h : α x y = α y w ∨ α x y = α w x ∨ α y w = α w x := by
    rw [← Nat.not_lt, Fintype.two_lt_card_iff] at hR
    simp_rw [Ne, not_exists, ← not_or, not_not] at hR
    exact hR _ _ _
  exacts [h.symm, hα.eq_trans (hα.comm y x) (h.trans (hα.comm w x)).symm hyw,
    (hα.eq_trans ((hα.comm x w).trans h.symm) (hα.comm w y) hxy).symm]

name: card_le_natDegree_of_eval_sub_eval_dvd_sub
statement:
theorem card_le_natDegree_of_eval_sub_eval_dvd_sub
    {f : R[X]} (hf : f.natDegree ≥ 2) {A : Finset R} (hA : good Rˣ (A : Set R))
    (hfA : ∀ x y : A, f.eval x.1 - f.eval y.1 ∣ x - y) :
    A.card ≤ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  /- It suffices to find `β ∈ Rˣ` and `c ∈ R` such that all
    elements of `A` are roots of `g(X) = f(X) - (βX + c)`. -/
  suffices ∃ β : Rˣ, ∃ c, ∀ x : A, (f - (C β.val * X + C c)).IsRoot x by
    rcases this with ⟨β, c, h⟩
    set g : R[X] := f - (C β.val * X + C c)
    have hg : g.natDegree = f.natDegree := by
      refine natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt ?_
      rwa [natDegree_add_C, natDegree_C_mul_X _ β.ne_zero]
    have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
      intro hg0; rw [← hg, hg0] at hf
      exact hf.not_gt Nat.two_pos
    replace h : A ⊆ g.roots.toFinset := by
      intro x hxS
      rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots hg0]
      exact h ⟨x, hxS⟩
    calc A.card
      _ ≤ g.roots.toFinset.card := Finset.card_le_card h
      _ ≤ g.roots.card := g.roots.toFinset_card_le
      _ ≤ g.natDegree := g.card_roots'
      _ = f.natDegree := hg
  
  replace hfA (x y : A) : ∃ α : Rˣ, f.eval x.1 - f.eval y.1 = α • (x - y) := by
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : Associated (x.1 - y) (f.eval x.1 - f.eval y.1) :=
      associated_of_dvd_dvd (f.sub_dvd_eval_sub x.1 y.1) (hfA x y)
    exact ⟨α, hα.symm.trans (mul_comm _ _)⟩
  
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α : A → A → Rˣ, ∀ x y, f.eval x.1 - f.eval y.1 = α x y • (x - y) :=
    ⟨λ x y ↦ Classical.choose (hfA x y), λ x y ↦ Classical.choose_spec (hfA x y)⟩
  
  replace hfA : admissible Rˣ (A : Set R) α := by
    intro x y z; rw [← hα, ← hα, ← hα, sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_self]
  
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β, ∀ x y : A, x ≠ y → α x y = β := hA α hfA
  refine ⟨β, ?_⟩
  
  obtain rfl | ⟨z, hz⟩ : A = ∅ ∨ A.Nonempty := A.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · exact ⟨0, λ ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ absurd hx (Finset.notMem_empty x)⟩
  
  lift z to ↑A using hz
  refine ⟨f.eval z.1 - β * z, λ x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [IsRoot.def, eval_sub, eval_add, eval_C, eval_C_mul, eval_X]
  obtain rfl | hxz : x = z ∨ x ≠ z := eq_or_ne x z
  · rw [add_sub_cancel, sub_self]
  · rw [← sub_sub, sub_sub_sub_comm, ← mul_sub, sub_eq_zero, hα, hβ _ _ hxz]; rfl

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [Fintype Rˣ] (hR : Fintype.card Rˣ ≤ 2)
    {f : R[X]} (hf : f.natDegree ≥ 2) (k) :
    (f.comp^[k] X - X).roots.toFinset.card ≤ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  
  cases k with
  | zero => rw [iterate_zero_apply, sub_self, roots_zero]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ k => ?_
  
  set g : R[X] := f.comp^[k + 1] X - X
  set A : Finset R := g.roots.toFinset
  refine card_le_natDegree_of_eval_sub_eval_dvd_sub hf (good_of_card_units_le_two hR _) ?_
  have h (z : A) : (f.comp^[k] X).eval (f.eval z.1) = z :=
    calc (f.comp^[k] X).eval (f.eval z.1)
    _ = f.eval^[k + 1] z.1 := by rw [iterate_comp_eval, eval_X, iterate_succ_apply]
    _ = (f.comp^[k + 1] X).eval z.1 := by rw [iterate_comp_eval, eval_X]
    _ = (f.comp^[k + 1] X - X + X).eval z.1 := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
    _ = (f.comp^[k + 1] X - X).eval z.1 + z := by rw [eval_add, eval_X]
    _ = z := by rw [add_eq_right, isRoot_of_mem_roots (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp z.2)]
  intro x y; calc f.eval x.1 - f.eval y.1
    _ ∣ (f.comp^[k] X).eval (f.eval x.1) - (f.comp^[k] X).eval (f.eval y.1) := by
      exact sub_dvd_eval_sub _ _ _
    _ = x.1 - y := congrArg₂ (· - ·) (h x) (h y)

name: FiniteField_prime_geom_sum_eq_zero_imp
statement:
theorem FiniteField_prime_geom_sum_eq_zero_imp [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) {x : F} (hx : x ≠ 1) (hx0 : ∑ i ∈ range p, x ^ i = 0) :
    Fintype.card F ≡ 1 [MOD p]
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  replace hx0 : x ^ p = 1 := by rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← geom_sum_mul, hx0, zero_mul]
  lift x to Fˣ using IsUnit.mk0 x ((pow_ne_zero_iff hp.ne_zero).mp (hx0.trans_ne one_ne_zero))
  replace hx1 : orderOf x = p :=
    orderOf_eq_prime (Units.val_inj.mp hx0) (mt Units.val_inj.mpr hx)
  replace hx1 : p ∣ Fintype.card Fˣ := hx1.symm.dvd.trans orderOf_dvd_card
  rwa [Fintype.card_eq_card_units_add_one, Nat.add_modEq_right_iff]

name: Nat_prime_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp
statement:
theorem Nat_prime_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q) {x : ℤ} (hx : (p : ℤ) ∣ ∑ i ∈ range q, x ^ i) :
    p = q ∨ p ≡ 1 [MOD q]
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  
  replace hx : ∑ i ∈ range q, (x : ZMod p) ^ i = 0 :=
    calc ∑ i ∈ range q, (x : ZMod p) ^ i
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range q, ((x ^ i : ℤ) : ZMod p) :=
      sum_congr rfl λ i _ ↦ (Int.cast_pow x i).symm
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range q, (x ^ i : ℤ) := (Int.cast_sum _ _).symm
    _ = 0 := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ p).mpr hx
  
  generalize (x : ZMod p) = x at hx
  obtain rfl | hx0 : x = 1 ∨ x ≠ 1 := eq_or_ne _ _
  
  · replace hx : (q : ZMod p) = 0 := calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ range q, 1 := by rw [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_one]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ range q, (1 : ZMod p) ^ i := sum_congr rfl λ _ _ ↦ (one_pow _).symm
      _ = 0 := hx
    left; rwa [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff, Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hq] at hx
  
  · right; calc p
      _ = Fintype.card (ZMod p) := (ZMod.card p).symm
      _ ≡ 1 [MOD q] := FiniteField_prime_geom_sum_eq_zero_imp hq hx0 hx

name: Nat_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp
statement:
theorem Nat_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) {d : ℕ} {x : ℤ} (hx : (d : ℤ) ∣ ∑ i ∈ range p, x ^ i) :
    p ∣ d ∨ d ≡ 1 [MOD p]
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Decidable.or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr λ hd ↦ ?_
  
  have h (q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ Nat.primeFactorsList d) : q ≡ 1 [MOD p] := by
    obtain ⟨hq0, hqd, -⟩ : Nat.Prime q ∧ q ∣ d ∧ d ≠ 0 := Nat.mem_primeFactorsList'.mp hq
    replace hx : (q : ℤ) ∣ ∑ i ∈ range p, x ^ i := (Int.ofNat_dvd.mpr hqd).trans hx
    exact (Nat_prime_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp hq0 hp hx).resolve_left
      (λ h ↦ hd (h.symm.dvd.trans hqd))
  
  calc d
    _ = d.primeFactorsList.prod :=
      (Nat.prod_primeFactorsList λ h ↦ hd ⟨0, h.trans p.mul_zero.symm⟩).symm
    _ ≡ 1 [MOD p] := Nat.ModEq.listProd_one h

name: Int_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp
statement:
theorem Int_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) {d : ℤ} (hd : d ≥ 0) {x : ℤ} (hx : (d : ℤ) ∣ ∑ i ∈ range p, x ^ i) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ d ∨ d ≡ 1 [ZMOD p]
proof:
:= by
  lift d to ℕ using hd
  exact (Nat_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp hp hx).imp Int.ofNat_dvd.mpr Int.natCast_modEq_iff.mpr

name: Int_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp_ZMod
statement:
theorem Int_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp_ZMod
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) {d : ℤ} (hd : d ≥ 0) {x : ℤ} (hx : (d : ℤ) ∣ ∑ i ∈ range p, x ^ i) :
    (d : ZMod p) = 0 ∨ (d : ZMod p) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (Int_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp hp hd hx).imp
    (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mpr λ h ↦ ?_
  rwa [← Int.cast_one, ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff']

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hp0 : p > 3) (x y : ℤ) :
    ¬∑ i ∈ range p, x ^ i = y ^ (p - 2) - 1
proof:
:= by
  
  intro h
  
  have hp1 : p > 2 := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hp0
  have hp2 : Odd p := hp.eq_two_or_odd'.resolve_left hp1.ne.symm
  have hp3 : Odd (p - 2) := by
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hp1.le, Nat.odd_add] at hp2
    exact hp2.mpr even_two
  
  have hy : 0 < y ^ (p - 2) - 1 := hp2.geom_sum_pos.trans_eq h
  have h0 : y > 0 := hp3.pow_pos_iff.mp (Int.zero_lt_one.trans (Int.lt_of_sub_pos hy))
  
  replace h {d} (hd : d ≥ 0) (hy : d ∣ y ^ (p - 2) - 1) :
      (d : ZMod p) = 0 ∨ (d : ZMod p) = 1 :=
    Int_dvd_prime_geom_sum_imp_ZMod hp hd (hy.trans h.symm.dvd)
  
  replace h0 : ((y - 1 : ℤ) : ZMod p) = 0 ∨ ((y - 1 : ℤ) : ZMod p) = 1 :=
    h (Int.sub_nonneg_of_le h0) (sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one y _)
  
  have hp4 : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ← Nat.cast_ofNat, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt Nat.two_pos hp1
  have hp5 : (2 : ZMod p) ≠ -1 := by
    rw [Ne, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, two_add_one_eq_three,
      ← Nat.cast_ofNat, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.succ_pos 2) hp0
  rcases h0 with h0 | h0
  
  · replace h0 : (y : ZMod p) = 1 := by rwa [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one, sub_eq_zero] at h0
    
    let T : ZMod p := (∑ i ∈ range (p - 2), y ^ i : ℤ)
    
    replace hT : T = -2 := calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ range (p - 2), ((y ^ i : ℤ) : ZMod p) := Int.cast_sum _ _
      _ = ∑ i ∈ range (p - 2), 1 := sum_congr rfl λ _ _ ↦ by rw [Int.cast_pow, h0, one_pow]
      _ = (p - 2 : ℕ) := by rw [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_one]
      _ = -2 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hp1.le, CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_sub, Nat.cast_two]
    
    replace h : T = 0 ∨ T = 1 := h hp3.geom_sum_pos.le ⟨y - 1, (geom_sum_mul y _).symm⟩
    
    clear_value T; subst hT
    rcases h with h | h
    exacts [hp4 (neg_eq_zero.mp h), hp5 (neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp h)]
  
  · have : Fact (Nat.Prime p) := ⟨hp⟩
    replace h0 : (y : ZMod p) = 2 := by
      rwa [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, one_add_one_eq_two] at h0
    
    specialize h hy.le (Int.dvd_refl _)
    replace h : (2 ^ (p - 2) - 1 : ZMod p) = 0 ∨ (2 ^ (p - 2) - 1 : ZMod p) = 1 := by
      rwa [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_pow, h0] at h
    replace h0 : (2 : ZMod p) * (2 ^ (p - 2) - 1) = -1 := calc
      _ = (2 : ZMod p) ^ (p - 2 + 1) - (1 + 1) := by rw [mul_sub, ← pow_succ', two_mul]
      _ = (2 : ZMod p) ^ (p - 1) - (1 + 1) :=
        congrArg (λ n ↦ (2 : ZMod p) ^ n - (1 + 1)) (Nat.sub_add_cancel hp.pred_pos)
      _ = -1 := by rw [ ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one hp4, sub_add_cancel_right]
    rcases h with h | h
    
    · replace h : (-1 : ZMod p) = 0 := by rw [← h0, h, mul_zero]
      exact one_ne_zero (neg_eq_zero.mp h)
    
    · replace h : (-1 : ZMod p) = 2 := by rw [← h0, h, mul_one]
      exact hp5 h.symm

name: exists_ne_pow_modeq
statement:
theorem exists_ne_pow_modeq {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (b : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∃ k > 0, k < n ∧ b ^ (M + k) ≡ b ^ M [MOD n]
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨M, h⟩ | h : (∃ M, n ∣ b ^ M) ∨ (∀ M, ¬n ∣ b ^ M) :=
    Classical.exists_or_forall_not _
  · refine ⟨M, 1, Nat.one_pos, hn, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.ModEq, Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.mod_mul_mod,
      Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_mod]
  /- If `n ∤ b^M` for any `M`, then apply pigeonhole principle
    and find `x, y < n` distinct with `b^x ≡ b^y (mod n)`. -/
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, h0⟩ :
      ∃ x ∈ range n, ∃ y ∈ range n, x ≠ y ∧ b ^ x ≡ b ^ y [MOD n] := by
    replace hn : 0 < n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn
    have h0 : #({x ∈ range n | x ≠ 0}) < #(range n) :=
      card_lt_card (filter_ssubset.mpr ⟨0, mem_range.mpr hn, λ h ↦ h rfl⟩)
    have h1 : Set.MapsTo (b ^ · % n) (range n) ↑({x ∈ range n | x ≠ 0}) := by
      rintro M -
      rw [mem_coe, mem_filter, mem_range]
      exact ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ hn, λ h1 ↦ h M (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h1)⟩
    exact exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to (t := (range n).filter (· ≠ 0)) h0 h1
  
  wlog h1 : x < y
  · exact this hn b h y hy x hx hxy.symm h0.symm (hxy.lt_or_gt.resolve_left h1)
  refine ⟨x, y - x, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt h1, (y.sub_le x).trans_lt (mem_range.mp hy), ?_⟩
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h1.le, Nat.ModEq.comm]

name: exists_mod_eq_mul_add_of_dvd
statement:
theorem exists_mod_eq_mul_add_of_dvd {n a b d : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (h : a ≡ b [MOD d]) :
    ∃ t, a + d * t ≡ b [MOD n]
proof:
:= by
  obtain h0 | h0 : a ≤ b ∨ b ≤ a := Nat.le_total a b
  
  · refine ⟨(b - a) / d, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' ((Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' h0).mp h), Nat.add_sub_cancel' h0]
  
  · refine ⟨(n - 1) * ((a - b) / d), Nat.ModEq.add_right_cancel' (a - b) ?_⟩
    replace h : d ∣ a - b := (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' h0).mp h.symm
    calc a + d * ((n - 1) * ((a - b) / d)) + (a - b)
      _ = a + n * (a - b) := by rw [Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_div_cancel' h,
          Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.add_one_mul, Nat.sub_add_cancel hn]
      _ ≡ a [MOD n] := Nat.add_modulus_mul_modEq_iff.mpr rfl
      _ = b + (a - b) := (Nat.add_sub_cancel' h0).symm

name: general_claim
statement: theorem general_claim {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (b N r) : ∃ m ≥ N, b ^ m + m ≡ r [MOD n]
proof:
:= by
  
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing N r with | h n n_ih => ?_
  obtain rfl | hn0 : 1 = n ∨ 1 < n := Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hn
  · exact ⟨N, Nat.le_refl N, Nat.modEq_one⟩
  
  obtain ⟨M, k, hk, hk0, h⟩ : ∃ M, ∃ k > 0, k < n ∧ b ^ (M + k) ≡ b ^ M [MOD n] :=
    exists_ne_pow_modeq hn0 b
  
  specialize n_ih k hk0 hk (max M N) r
  rcases n_ih with ⟨m', hm', h0⟩
  replace hm' : M ≤ m' ∧ N ≤ m' := Nat.max_le.mp hm'
  
  replace h : b ^ (m' + k) ≡ b ^ m' [MOD n] := by
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_cancel' hm'.1, Nat.pow_add b M, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.pow_add]
    exact h.mul_right _
  replace h (s) : b ^ (m' + k * s) ≡ b ^ m' [MOD n] := by
    induction s with | zero => rfl | succ s hs => ?_
    calc b ^ (m' + k * (s + 1))
      _ = b ^ (m' + k * s) * b ^ k := by rw [Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.pow_add]
      _ ≡ b ^ m' * b ^ k [MOD n] := hs.mul_right _
      _ = b ^ (m' + k) := (Nat.pow_add _ _ _).symm
      _ ≡ b ^ m' [MOD n] := h
  
  replace h0 : ∃ s, b ^ m' + m' + k * s ≡ r [MOD n] := exists_mod_eq_mul_add_of_dvd hn h0
  rcases h0 with ⟨s, hs⟩
  
  refine ⟨m' + k * s, Nat.le_add_right_of_le hm'.2, ((h s).add_right _).trans ?_⟩
  rwa [← Nat.add_assoc]

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (hn : 0 < n) (b) : ∃ m, n ∣ b ^ m + m
proof:
:=
  (general_claim hn b 0 0).imp λ _ h ↦ Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h.2

name: a_zero
statement: lemma a_zero : a F 0 = -1
proof: := by rw [a]

name: a_succ
statement: lemma a_succ (n) : a F (n + 1) = -∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), a F i / (n + 2 - i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [a, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]

name: a_one
statement: lemma a_one : a F 1 = 2⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [a, Fin.sum_univ_one, Fin.val_zero, a_zero, neg_div, neg_neg, one_div]; rfl

name: a_rec
statement: lemma a_rec (hn : 0 < n) : ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), a F i / (n + 1 - i : ℕ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hn, sum_range_succ, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg',
    ← a_succ, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Nat.cast_one, div_one]

name: main_formula
statement:
lemma main_formula (hn : 0 < n) :
    (n + 2 : ℕ) * a F (n + 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), a F i * ((n + 1 : ℕ) / (n + 1 - i : ℕ)
        - (n + 2 : ℕ) / ((n + 2 - i) : ℕ))
proof:
:=
  calc (n + 2 : ℕ) * a F (n + 1)
  _ = (n + 1 : ℕ) * ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), a F i / (n + 1 - i : ℕ)
      - (n + 2 : ℕ) * ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), a F i / (n + 2 - i : ℕ) := by
    rw [a_rec hn, mul_zero, zero_sub, ← mul_neg, ← a_succ]
  _ = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), ((n + 1 : ℕ) * (a F i / (n + 1 - i : ℕ))
      - (n + 2 : ℕ) * (a F i / (n + 2 - i : ℕ))) := by
    rw [sum_sub_distrib, mul_sum, mul_sum]
  _ = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), a F i * ((n + 1 : ℕ) / (n + 1 - i : ℕ)
        - (n + 2 : ℕ) / ((n + 2 - i) : ℕ)) := by
    refine sum_congr rfl λ i h ↦ ?_
    simp only [mul_div_left_comm _ (a F i), mul_sub]

name: coeff_pos
statement:
lemma coeff_pos (hi : 0 < i) (hin : i < n) :
    ((n + 1 : ℕ) / (n + 1 - i : ℕ) : F) < n / (n - i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 < ((n - i : ℕ) : F) := by rwa [Nat.cast_pos, Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt]
  have h0 : ((n - i : ℕ) : F) < (n + 1 - i : ℕ) :=
    Nat.cast_lt.mpr (Nat.sub_lt_sub_right hin.le n.lt_succ_self)
  calc ((n + 1 : ℕ) / (n + 1 - i : ℕ) : F)
  _ = (1 : F) + (i : ℕ) / (n + 1 - i : ℕ) := by
    rw [one_add_div (h.trans h0).ne.symm, ← Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_succ_of_le hin.le)]
  _ < (1 : F) + (i : ℕ) / (n - i : ℕ) :=
    add_lt_add_right (div_lt_div_of_pos_left (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hi) h h0) 1
  _ = _ := by rw [one_add_div h.ne.symm, ← Nat.cast_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hin.le]

name: a_succ_pos
statement: theorem a_succ_pos (n) : 0 < a F (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h n n_ih => ?_
  
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ 0 < n := n.eq_zero_or_pos
  · rw [a_one, inv_pos]; exact two_pos
  
  let b (i) := a F i * ((n + 1 : ℕ) / (n + 1 - i : ℕ) - (n + 2 : ℕ) / ((n + 2 - i) : ℕ))
  
  suffices 0 < ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), b i from
    pos_of_mul_pos_right (this.trans_eq (main_formula hn).symm) (n + 2).cast_nonneg
  
  have h : b 0 = 0 := by
    have X (k : ℕ) : (k.succ : F) / ((k + 1 - 0 : ℕ) : F) = 1 :=
      div_self (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr k.succ_ne_zero)
    dsimp only [b]; rw [X, X, sub_self, mul_zero]
  
  replace n_ih {i} (hi : i < n) : 0 < b (i + 1) :=
    mul_pos (n_ih i hi) (sub_pos.mpr (coeff_pos i.succ_pos (Nat.succ_lt_succ hi)))
  
  rw [sum_range_succ', h, add_zero]
  exact sum_pos (λ i hi ↦ n_ih (mem_range.mp hi)) (nonempty_range_iff.mpr hn.ne.symm)

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution {n} (hn : n > 0) : a F n > 0
proof:
:=
  match n with | Nat.zero => absurd hn (Nat.lt_irrefl 0) | Nat.succ n => a_succ_pos n

name: factorMultiset_inj
statement: theorem factorMultiset_inj {m n : ℕ+} : m.factorMultiset = n.factorMultiset ↔ m = n
proof:
:=
  PNat.factorMultisetEquiv.apply_eq_iff_eq (x := m) (y := n)

name: factorMultiset_eq_iff_eq_prod
statement:
theorem factorMultiset_eq_iff_eq_prod {m : ℕ+} {S : PrimeMultiset} :
    m.factorMultiset = S ↔ m = S.prod
proof:
:=
  (PNat.factorMultisetEquiv.eq_symm_apply (x := S) (y := m)).symm

name: PrimeMultiset_prod_sum
statement:
theorem PrimeMultiset_prod_sum (S : ι → PrimeMultiset) (I : Finset ι) :
    (∑ i ∈ I, S i).prod = ∏ i ∈ I, (S i).prod
proof:
:= by
  change (PrimeMultiset.coePNatMonoidHom _).prod
    = ∏ i ∈ I, (PrimeMultiset.coePNatMonoidHom _).prod
  rw [map_sum, Multiset.prod_sum]

name: sum_factorMultiset_eq_factorMultiset_prod
statement:
theorem sum_factorMultiset_eq_factorMultiset_prod (n : ι → ℕ+) (I : Finset ι) :
    ∑ i ∈ I, (n i).factorMultiset = (∏ i ∈ I, n i).factorMultiset
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, factorMultiset_eq_iff_eq_prod, PrimeMultiset_prod_sum]
  simp only [PNat.prod_factorMultiset]

name: good_of_const
statement: lemma good_of_const (C) : good (λ _ ↦ C)
proof:
:=
  λ m k ↦ ⟨C, by rw [sum_const, card_range]; rfl⟩

name: nice_of_const
statement:
lemma nice_of_const (C) : nice (λ _ ↦ C) where
  is_good
proof:
:= good_of_const C
  is_geo_good := λ m k ↦ ⟨C, by rw [prod_const, card_range]⟩

name: good.ModEq
statement: lemma good.ModEq (ha : good a) (m k) : a (m + k) ≡ a m [MOD k]
proof:
:= calc
  _ ≡ a (m + k) + ∑ i ∈ range k, a (m + i) [MOD k] := (ha m k).zero_modEq_nat.add_left _
  _ ≡ a m + ∑ i ∈ range k, a (m + 1 + i) [MOD k] := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm, ← sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ', Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_zero]
    conv => left; right; right; ext; rw [← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_comm]
  _ ≡ _ [MOD k] := (ha (m + 1) k).modEq_zero_nat.add_left _

name: good.const_of_infinite_fiber
statement:
lemma good.const_of_infinite_fiber (ha : good a) (hv : ∀ N, ∃ n ≥ N, a n = v) (k) :
    a k = v
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨N, hNk, hNv⟩ : ∃ N, a k < N ∧ v < N :=
    ⟨a k + v + 1, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _),
      Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_add_left _ _)⟩
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ : ∃ n ≥ N, a (k + n) = v := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ : ∃ n ≥ k + N, a n = v := hv _
    obtain ⟨n', rfl⟩ : ∃ n', n = k + n' :=
      Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_of_add_right_le hn)
    exact ⟨n', Nat.add_le_add_iff_left.mp hn, rfl⟩
  
  exact ((ha.ModEq k n).eq_of_lt_of_lt (hNv.trans_le hn) (hNk.trans_le hn)).symm

name: PNat_good_padic_eq_of_shift
statement:
lemma PNat_good_padic_eq_of_shift {a : ℕ → ℕ+} (ha : good λ n ↦ a n) (p k m) :
    (a (m + k * p ^ ((a m).factorMultiset.count p + 1))).factorMultiset.count p
      = (a m).factorMultiset.count p
proof:
:= by
  
  set v : ℕ := (a m).factorMultiset.count p
  have h : a (m + k * p ^ (v + 1)) ≡ a m [MOD p ^ (v + 1)] :=
    (ha.ModEq m (k * p ^ (v + 1))).of_mul_left _
  
  have hp : ((p : ℕ+) : ℕ) = p.1 := rfl
  
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  
  · 
    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt λ h0 ↦ v.lt_irrefl ?_
    
    rw [← Nat.succ_le_iff, ← PNat.count_factorMultiset,
      PNat.dvd_iff, PNat.pow_coe, hp] at h0 ⊢
    exact (h.dvd_iff (Nat.dvd_refl _)).mp h0
  
  · 
    have hv : v ≤ (a m).factorMultiset.count p := v.le_refl
    rw [← PNat.count_factorMultiset, PNat.dvd_iff, PNat.pow_coe, hp] at hv ⊢
    exact (h.dvd_iff ⟨p, rfl⟩).mpr hv

name: nice.padic_is_good
statement:
lemma nice.padic_is_good (ha : nice a) (p : Nat.Primes) :
    good (λ n ↦ (a n).factorMultiset.count p)
proof:
:= by
  intro m k
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G, ∏ i ∈ range k, a (m + i) = G ^ k := ha.is_geo_good m k
  
  refine ⟨G.factorMultiset.count p, ?_⟩
  rw [← Multiset.count_nsmul, ← PNat.factorMultiset_pow, ← Multiset.count_sum']
  revert p; rw [← Multiset.ext, sum_factorMultiset_eq_factorMultiset_prod, hG]

name: nice.is_const
statement: lemma nice.is_const (ha : nice a) : ∃ C, a = λ _ ↦ C
proof:
:= by
  /- By the results that we have proved above, the sequence
    `(ν_p(a_n))_{n ≥ 0}` is constant for each prime `p`. -/
  have h (p) : ∀ n, (a n).factorMultiset.count p = (a 0).factorMultiset.count p :=
    (ha.padic_is_good p).const_of_infinite_fiber
      λ N ↦ ⟨N * p ^ ((a 0).factorMultiset.count p + 1),
        Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right N (Nat.pow_pos p.2.pos),
        Nat.zero_add (N * _) ▸ PNat_good_padic_eq_of_shift ha.is_good p _ _⟩
  
  refine ⟨a 0, funext λ n ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← factorMultiset_inj, Multiset.ext]
  exact λ p ↦ h p n

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution {a : ℕ → ℕ+} : nice a ↔ ∃ C, a = λ _ ↦ C
proof:
:=
  ⟨nice.is_const, λ ⟨C, hC⟩ ↦ hC ▸ nice_of_const C⟩

name: good.add_two_mul_int
statement: lemma good.add_two_mul_int {α : R} (hα : good α) (N : ℤ) : good (α + (2 * N : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  intro n; specialize hα n
  
  conv => arg 2; arg 2; ext; rw [← natCast_zsmul, zsmul_add, natCast_zsmul,
    zsmul_eq_mul, ← Int.cast_mul, Int.floor_add_intCast]
  rw [sum_add_distrib, dvd_add_right hα, ← sum_mul, ← Nat.cast_sum, ← mul_assoc,
    ← Nat.cast_two, ← Int.natCast_mul, sum_range_id_mul_two, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
    Int.natCast_mul, mul_right_comm]
  exact ⟨n.succ * N, mul_comm _ _⟩

name: good.sub_two_mul_int
statement: lemma good.sub_two_mul_int {α : R} (hα : good α) (N : ℤ) : good (α - (2 * N : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Int.mul_neg, Int.cast_neg, sub_eq_add_neg] using hα.add_two_mul_int (-N)

name: zero_is_good
statement: lemma zero_is_good : good (0 : R)
proof:
:=
  λ n ↦ ⟨0, by simp_rw [nsmul_zero]; rw [Int.floor_zero, sum_const_zero, mul_zero]⟩

name: two_mul_is_good
statement: lemma two_mul_is_good (N : ℤ) : good ((2 * N : ℤ) : R)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [zero_add] using zero_is_good.add_two_mul_int (R := R) N

name: zero_of_floor_eq_zero
statement: lemma zero_of_floor_eq_zero (hα0 : ⌊α⌋ = 0) : α = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∀ n : ℕ, ⌊n • α⌋ = 0 by
    
    refine (Int.floor_eq_zero_iff.mp hα0).1.eq_of_not_lt' λ hα1 ↦ ?_
    
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, 1 < k • α := exists_lt_nsmul hα1 _
    exact hk.asymm (Int.floor_eq_zero_iff.mp (this k)).2
  
  intro n; induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h n n_ih => ?_
  
  cases n with | zero => rw [zero_nsmul, Int.floor_zero] | succ m => ?_
  cases m with | zero => rwa [one_nsmul] | succ k => ?_
  
  replace hα : ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ ⌊(k + 2) • α⌋ := by
    specialize hα (k + 2)
    rwa [sum_range_succ, sum_eq_zero λ m hm ↦ n_ih m (mem_range.mp hm), zero_add] at hα
  
  replace n_ih : ⌊(k + 2) • α⌋ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [succ_nsmul, ← sub_nonpos]
    apply (Int.le_floor_add_floor _ _).trans_eq
    rw [hα0, n_ih _ k.succ.lt_succ_self, Int.zero_add]
  
  refine Int.le_antisymm (Int.le_of_lt_add_one (n_ih.lt_of_ne λ hα1 ↦ ?_))
    (Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (nsmul_nonneg (Int.floor_nonneg.mp hα0.ge) _))
  rw [hα1, Int.natCast_dvd] at hα
  exact absurd (Nat.dvd_one.mp hα) k.succ_succ_ne_one

name: floor_ne_neg_one
statement: lemma floor_ne_neg_one : ⌊α⌋ ≠ -1
proof:
:= by
  
  intro hα0; have hα1 : α < 0 := Int.floor_le_neg_one_iff.mp hα0.le
  
  suffices ∀ n : ℕ, ⌊(n + 1) • α⌋ = -1 by
    
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, k • α < -1 := exists_nsmul_lt hα1 _
    
    apply (this k).not_lt
    rw [Int.floor_lt, succ_nsmul, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, ← add_zero (-1)]
    exact add_lt_add hk hα1
  
  intro n; induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h n n_ih => ?_
  
  cases n with | zero => rwa [one_nsmul] | succ k => ?_
  
  replace hα : ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ ⌊(k + 2) • α⌋ + 1 := by
    suffices ⌊(k + 2) • α⌋ + 1 = ∑ k ∈ range (k + 2 + 1), ⌊k • α⌋ + ↑(k + 2)
      by rw [this, dvd_add_self_right]; exact hα (k + 2)
    
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, ← add_assoc, add_left_inj, sum_range_succ, add_right_comm,
      right_eq_add, sum_range_succ', zero_nsmul, Int.floor_zero, add_zero,
      sum_congr rfl λ m hm ↦ n_ih m (mem_range.mp hm), sum_const, card_range,
      neg_nsmul, nsmul_one, neg_add_cancel]
  
  replace n_ih : -2 ≤ ⌊(k + 2) • α⌋ := calc
    _ = ⌊(k + 1) • α⌋ + ⌊α⌋ := congrArg₂ (· + ·) (n_ih k k.lt_succ_self).symm hα0.symm
    _ ≤ ⌊(k + 1) • α + α⌋ := Int.le_floor_add _ _
    _ = ⌊(k + 2) • α⌋ := by rw [succ_nsmul α (k + 1)]
  
  refine Int.le_antisymm (Int.floor_le_neg_one_iff.mpr (nsmul_neg hα1 k.succ.succ_ne_zero))
    (Int.add_one_le_of_lt (n_ih.lt_of_ne λ hα2 ↦ ?_))
  rw [← hα2, Int.natCast_dvd] at hα
  exact absurd (Nat.dvd_one.mp hα) k.succ_succ_ne_one

name: eq_two_mul_int
statement: lemma eq_two_mul_int : ∃ N : ℤ, α = (2 * N : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN | hN⟩ : ∃ N, ⌊α⌋ = 2 * N ∨ ⌊α⌋ = 2 * N + 1 := Int.even_or_odd' ⌊α⌋
  
  · 
    replace hα : good (α - (2 * N : ℤ)) := hα.sub_two_mul_int N
    replace hα0 : ⌊α - (2 * N : ℤ)⌋ = 0 := by
      rw [Int.floor_sub_intCast, hN, Int.sub_self]
    exact ⟨N, eq_of_sub_eq_zero (hα.zero_of_floor_eq_zero hα0)⟩
  
  · 
    replace hα : good (α - (2 * (N + 1) : ℤ)) := hα.sub_two_mul_int (N + 1)
    replace hα0 : ⌊α - (2 * (N + 1) : ℤ)⌋ = -1 := by
      rw [Int.floor_sub_intCast, hN, Int.mul_add, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]; rfl
    exact absurd hα0 hα.floor_ne_neg_one

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution [Archimedean R] {α : R} : good α ↔ ∃ N : ℤ, α = (2 * N : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨good.eq_two_mul_int, λ ⟨N, hN⟩ ↦ hN ▸ two_mul_is_good N⟩

name: self_coprime_mul_succ
statement: lemma self_coprime_mul_succ (a b : ℕ) : a.Coprime (a * b + 1)
proof: := by simp

name: pow_totient_mul_succ_mul_modeq_one
statement:
lemma pow_totient_mul_succ_mul_modeq_one (a b k) :
    a ^ ((a * b + 1).totient * k) ≡ 1 [MOD a * b + 1]
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.one_pow, a.pow_mul] using
    (Nat.ModEq.pow_totient (self_coprime_mul_succ _ _)).pow k

name: mul_succ_dvd_pow_add_of_pow_succ_modeq_one
statement:
lemma mul_succ_dvd_pow_add_of_pow_succ_modeq_one (h : a ^ (n + 1) ≡ 1 [MOD a * b + 1]) :
    a * b + 1 ∣ a ^ n + b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (self_coprime_mul_succ a b).symm.dvd_mul_left,
    Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.pow_succ', Nat.add_comm _ (a * b)]
  exact ((h.add_left _).dvd_iff (Nat.dvd_refl _)).mpr (Nat.dvd_refl _)

name: eq_one_of_mul_succ_right_dvd_succ
statement:
lemma eq_one_of_mul_succ_right_dvd_succ
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (h : a * b + 1 ∣ b + 1) : a = 1
proof:
:=
  ha.succ_le.antisymm' <| (mul_le_iff_le_one_left hb).mp <|
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.le_of_dvd b.succ_pos h)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (∃ g N, ∀ n ≥ N, (a ^ n + b).gcd (b ^ n + a) = g) ↔ (a = 1 ∧ b = 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨2, 0, λ n _ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [h.1, h.2, Nat.one_pow, Nat.gcd_self]
  
  rcases h with ⟨g, N, h⟩
  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀, hn₀a, hn₀b⟩ :
      ∃ n₀ ≥ N, a ^ (n₀ + 1) ≡ 1 [MOD a * b + 1] ∧ b ^ (n₀ + 1) ≡ 1 [MOD a * b + 1] := by
    
    have h0 : 0 < (a * b + 1).totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos _)
    refine ⟨(a * b + 1).totient * (N + 1) - 1,
      Nat.le_sub_of_add_le (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ h0), ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.mul_pos h0 N.succ_pos)]
    exact ⟨pow_totient_mul_succ_mul_modeq_one _ _ _,
      a.mul_comm b ▸ pow_totient_mul_succ_mul_modeq_one _ _ _⟩
  
  have h0 : a * b + 1 ∣ g := by
    rw [← h _ hn₀, Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
    refine ⟨mul_succ_dvd_pow_add_of_pow_succ_modeq_one hn₀a, ?_⟩
    rw [a.mul_comm b] at hn₀b ⊢
    exact mul_succ_dvd_pow_add_of_pow_succ_modeq_one hn₀b
  
  rw [← h _ (Nat.le_succ_of_le hn₀), Nat.dvd_gcd_iff] at h0
  revert h0; refine And.imp (λ h0 ↦ ?_) (λ h0 ↦ ?_)
  · rw [(hn₀a.add_right b).dvd_iff (Nat.dvd_refl _), Nat.add_comm 1] at h0
    exact eq_one_of_mul_succ_right_dvd_succ ha hb h0
  · rw [(hn₀b.add_right a).dvd_iff (Nat.dvd_refl _), a.mul_comm, Nat.add_comm 1] at h0
    exact eq_one_of_mul_succ_right_dvd_succ hb ha h0

name: Finset_sum_rpow_le_rpow_sum
statement:
theorem Finset_sum_rpow_le_rpow_sum {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (I : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ p ≤ (∑ i ∈ I, x i) ^ p
proof:
:=
  have hp0 : p - 1 + 1 = p := sub_add_cancel p 1
  have hp1 : p - 1 + 1 ≠ 0 := hp0.trans_ne (one_pos.trans_le hp).ne.symm
  calc ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ p
    _ = ∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ (p - 1) * x i :=
      sum_congr rfl λ i _ ↦ by rw [← rpow_add_one' hp1, hp0]
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, (∑ j ∈ I, x j) ^ (p - 1) * x i := by
      
      refine sum_le_sum λ i hi ↦ mul_le_mul_left ?_ _
      exact rpow_le_rpow (single_le_sum_of_canonicallyOrdered hi) (sub_nonneg_of_le hp)
    _ = (∑ i ∈ I, x i) ^ p := by rw [← mul_sum, ← rpow_add_one' hp1, hp0]

name: exists_N_forall_target_lt_eps_of_card_ge_N.
statement:
theorem exists_N_forall_target_lt_eps_of_card_ge_N.{u}
    {p q : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqp : q < p) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N, ∀ (ι : Type u) (_ : DecidableEq ι) (I : Finset ι) (_ : #I ≥ N)
      (x : ι → ℝ≥0) (_ : ∀ i ∈ I, 1 ≤ x i),
        (∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ q) / (∑ i ∈ I, x i) ^ p < ε
proof:
:= by
  replace hqp : q - p < 0 := sub_neg.mpr hqp
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < (N : ℝ≥0) ∧ (N : ℝ≥0) ^ (q - p) < ε := by
    
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, ε ^ ((q - p)⁻¹) < N := exists_nat_gt _
    
    refine ⟨N, hN.trans_le' (Subtype.property _), ?_⟩
    calc (N : ℝ≥0) ^ (q - p)
      _ < (ε ^ ((q - p)⁻¹)) ^ (q - p) := rpow_lt_rpow_of_neg (rpow_pos hε) hN hqp
      _ = ε := by rw [← rpow_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hqp.ne, rpow_one]
  
  refine ⟨N, λ i _ I hI x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  
  calc (∑ i ∈ I, x i ^ q) / (∑ i ∈ I, x i) ^ p
    _ ≤ (∑ i ∈ I, x i) ^ q / (∑ i ∈ I, x i) ^ p :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset_sum_rpow_le_rpow_sum hq I x) (Subtype.property _)
    _ = (∑ i ∈ I, x i) ^ (q - p) := (rpow_sub' hqp.ne _).symm
    _ ≤ N ^ (q - p) := rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hN ?_ hqp.le
    _ < ε := hN0
  
  calc (N : ℝ≥0)
    _ ≤ #I := Nat.cast_le.mpr hI
    _ = #I • (1 : ℝ≥0) := (nsmul_one _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, x i := card_nsmul_le_sum I x 1 hx

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ≥0, ∀ n ≥ N,
      (∑ i ∈ range n, (3 : ℝ≥0) ^ (a i : ℝ))
        / (∑ i ∈ range n, 2 ^ (a i : ℝ)) ^ (2 : ℝ) < ε
proof:
:= by
  
  have X0lt3 : (0 : ℝ) < 3 := three_pos
  have X1lt2 : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := one_lt_two
  have X2powq : (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ Real.logb 2 3 = 3 :=
    Subtype.coe_injective (Real.rpow_logb two_pos X1lt2.ne.symm X0lt3)
  have X1leq : 1 ≤ Real.logb 2 3 :=
    (Real.le_logb_iff_rpow_le X1lt2 X0lt3).mpr (by norm_num)
  have Xqle2 : Real.logb 2 3 < 2 :=
