    (Real.logb_lt_iff_lt_rpow X1lt2 X0lt3).mpr (by norm_num)
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_N_forall_target_lt_eps_of_card_ge_N.{0} X1leq Xqle2 hε
  
  refine ⟨N, λ a n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  
  calc (∑ i ∈ range n, (3 : ℝ≥0) ^ (a i : ℝ)) / (∑ i ∈ range n, 2 ^ (a i : ℝ)) ^ (2 : ℝ)
    _ = (∑ i ∈ range n, ((2 : ℝ≥0) ^ (a i : ℝ)) ^ Real.logb 2 3)
        / (∑ i ∈ range n, (2 : ℝ≥0) ^ (a i : ℝ)) ^ (2 : ℝ) := by
      refine congrArg (· / _) (sum_congr rfl λ i _ ↦ ?_)
      rw [← X2powq, ← rpow_mul, mul_comm, rpow_mul]
    _ < ε :=
      hN ℕ instDecidableEqNat _ (hn.trans_eq (card_range n).symm)
        _ (λ i _ ↦ one_le_rpow X1lt2.le (a i).2)

name: of_Subsingleton
statement: theorem of_Subsingleton (R) [Ring R] [Subsingleton R] : IsBoolean R
proof:
:=
  λ _ ↦ Subsingleton.allEq _ _

name: ZMod2
statement: theorem ZMod2 : IsBoolean (ZMod 2)
proof:
:=
  λ r ↦ match r with | 0 => rfl | 1 => rfl

name: const_one_not_good
statement: theorem const_one_not_good : ¬good (λ _ : R ↦ 1)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_, _, c, h⟩
  refine h 0 ?_
  rw [sq, ← mul_assoc, ← add_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, mul_one_sub, ← sq, hR, sub_self]

name: not_nice
statement: theorem not_nice : ¬nice R
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ hR.const_one_not_good (by simpa only [eval_one] using h 1)

name: not_nice_ZMod1
statement: theorem not_nice_ZMod1 : ¬nice (ZMod 1)
proof:
:=
  (IsBoolean.of_Subsingleton _).not_nice

name: not_nice_ZMod2
statement: theorem not_nice_ZMod2 : ¬nice (ZMod 2)
proof:
:=
  IsBoolean.ZMod2.not_nice

name: ZMod4_exists_mul_sub_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ZMod4_exists_mul_sub_ne_zero₂ :
    ∀ a b : ZMod 4, ∃ c, c * (a - c) ≠ 0 ∧ c * (b - c) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: ZMod4_good
statement: theorem ZMod4_good (f : ZMod 4 → ZMod 4) : good f
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨u, hc0, hc2⟩ : ∃ u, u * (f 0 - u) ≠ 0 ∧ u * (f 2 - u) ≠ 0 :=
    ZMod4_exists_mul_sub_ne_zero₂ (f 0) (f 2)
  
  obtain ⟨v, hd1, hd3⟩ : ∃ v, v * (f 1 - v) ≠ 0 ∧ v * (f 3 - v) ≠ 0 :=
    ZMod4_exists_mul_sub_ne_zero₂ (f 1) (f 3)
  
  refine ⟨v - u, 0, u, λ r ↦ ?_⟩
  have h (y) : ((v - u) * 0 + u) * (y - ((v - u) * 0 + u)) = u * (y - u) := by
    rw [mul_zero, zero_add]
  have h0 (y) : ((v - u) * 1 + u) * (y - ((v - u) * 1 + u)) = v * (y - v) := by
    rw [mul_one, sub_add_cancel]
  rw [zero_mul, add_zero]
  match r with
  | 0 => exact (h (f 0)).trans_ne hc0
  | 1 => exact (h0 (f 1)).trans_ne hd1
  | 2 => exact (h (f 2)).trans_ne hc2
  | 3 => exact (h0 (f 3)).trans_ne hd3

name: ZMod4_nice
statement: theorem ZMod4_nice : nice (ZMod 4)
proof:
:=
  λ P ↦ ZMod4_good P.eval

name: good.of_Polynomial_map
statement: theorem good.of_Polynomial_map (P : R[X]) (hP : good (P.map φ).eval) : good P.eval
proof:
:= by
  rcases hP with ⟨a', b', c', h⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, φ a = a' := hφ a'
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, φ b = b' := hφ b'
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, φ c = c' := hφ c'
  replace h (r : R) :
      φ ((a * r ^ 2 + b * r + c) * (P.eval r - (a * r ^ 2 + b * r + c))) ≠ 0 :=
    calc φ ((a * r ^ 2 + b * r + c) * (P.eval r - (a * r ^ 2 + b * r + c)))
    _ = φ (a * r ^ 2 + b * r + c) * ((P.map φ).eval (φ r) - φ (a * r ^ 2 + b * r + c)) := by
      rw [φ.map_mul, φ.map_sub, eval_map_apply]
    _ = (φ a * φ r ^ 2 + φ b * φ r + φ c)
        * ((P.map φ).eval (φ r) - (φ a * φ r ^ 2 + φ b * φ r + φ c)) := by
      rw [φ.map_add, φ.map_add, φ.map_mul, φ.map_mul, φ.map_pow]
    _ ≠ 0 := h (φ r)
  exact ⟨a, b, c, λ r hr ↦ h r ((congrArg φ hr).trans φ.map_zero)⟩

name: nice.of_surjection
statement: theorem nice.of_surjection (hS : nice S) : nice R
proof:
:=
  λ P ↦ (hS (P.map φ)).of_Polynomial_map φ hφ P

name: ZMod_nice_of_dvd
statement: theorem ZMod_nice_of_dvd (hk : nice (ZMod k)) (hkn : k ∣ n) : nice (ZMod n)
proof:
:=
  hk.of_surjection (ZMod.castHom hkn (ZMod k)) (ZMod.castHom_surjective hkn)

name: good.shift
statement: theorem good.shift (hf : good f) (v : R) : good (λ x ↦ f (x + v))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨a, b, c, h⟩
  refine ⟨a, a * (2 * v) + b, a * v ^ 2 + b * v + c, λ r ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [add_mul _ _ r, ← add_assoc (a * r ^ 2), mul_assoc, ← mul_add, ← add_assoc,
    add_add_add_comm, ← mul_add, ← mul_add, mul_right_comm, ← add_sq]
  exact h (r + v)

name: good_shift_iff
statement: theorem good_shift_iff {v : R} : good (λ x ↦ f (x + v)) ↔ good f
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ hf ↦ by simpa only [neg_add_cancel_right] using hf.shift (-v), λ hf ↦ hf.shift v⟩

name: good.scale
statement: theorem good.scale (hf : good f) (u : R) : good (λ x ↦ f (u * x))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨a, b, c, h⟩
  refine ⟨a * u ^ 2, b * u, c, λ r ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_assoc]
  exact h (u * r)

name: good_scale_iff
statement: theorem good_scale_iff {u : Rˣ} : good (λ x ↦ f (u * x)) ↔ good f
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ hf ↦ by simpa only [Units.mul_inv_cancel_left] using hf.scale ↑u⁻¹, λ hf ↦ hf.scale u⟩

name: good_shift_scale_iff
statement: theorem good_shift_scale_iff {u : Rˣ} {v : R} : good (λ x ↦ f (u * x + v)) ↔ good f
proof:
:=
  (good_scale_iff (f := λ x ↦ f (x + v)) (u := u)).trans good_shift_iff

name: good_of_good_map_ite_zero
statement:
theorem good_of_good_map_ite_zero [Ring R] [IsDomain R] [DecidableEq R]
    {f g : R → R} (hfg : ∀ r, g r = if f r = 0 then 1 else f r) (hg : good g) : good f
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases hg with ⟨a, b, c, h⟩
  refine ⟨a, b, c, λ r ↦ ?_⟩
  specialize h r
  by_cases hr : f r = 0
  
  · rw [hr, zero_sub, mul_neg, neg_ne_zero, mul_self_ne_zero]
    exact left_ne_zero_of_mul h
  
  · rwa [hfg, ite_eq_right hr] at h

name: linear_transform_solver
statement:
theorem linear_transform_solver [DivisionRing F] {a b c d : F} (h : a ≠ b) (h0 : c ≠ d) :
    ∃ u : Fˣ, ∃ v : F, u * c + v = a ∧ u * d + v = b
proof:
:= by
  
  replace h : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero_of_ne h.symm
  replace h0 : d - c ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero_of_ne h0.symm
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : Fˣ, ↑u = (b - a) / (d - c) :=
    ⟨Units.mk0 ((b - a) / (d - c)) (div_ne_zero h h0), rfl⟩
  refine ⟨u, a - u * c, add_sub_cancel _ _, ?_⟩
  rw [add_sub_left_comm, ← mul_sub, hu, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h0, add_sub_cancel]

name: good_of_map_ne_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem good_of_map_ne_of_ne_zero [Ring R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    {u : R} (hu : u ≠ 0) {f : R → R} (hf : ∀ r, f r ≠ u) : good f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, 0, u, λ r ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← mul_add, zero_mul, zero_add, mul_ne_zero_iff, sub_ne_zero]
  exact ⟨hu, hf r⟩

name: FiniteField.good_of_forall_map_pair_eq_of_image_eq_units
statement:
theorem FiniteField.good_of_forall_map_pair_eq_of_image_eq_units
    [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {a b : F} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hF : ∀ f : F → F, f a = f b → (∀ r, f r ≠ 0) → (∀ x ≠ 0, ∃ r, f r = x) → good f)
    (f : F → F) : good f
proof:
:= by
  
  wlog hf : ∀ r, f r ≠ 0 generalizing f
  · refine good_of_good_map_ite_zero (λ _ ↦ rfl) (this _ λ r ↦ ?_)
    split_ifs with hr
    exacts [one_ne_zero, hr]
  
  wlog hf0 : f a = f b generalizing f
  · 
    obtain ⟨c, d, hcd, hcd0⟩ : ∃ c d, f c = f d ∧ c ≠ d := by
      have h : ¬f.Surjective := λ h ↦ (h 0).elim hf
      replace h : ¬f.Injective := Finite.surjective_of_injective.mt h
      simpa only [Function.Injective, not_forall, exists_prop] using h
    
    obtain ⟨u, v, rfl, rfl⟩ : ∃ u : Fˣ, ∃ v : F, u * c + v = a ∧ u * d + v = b :=
      linear_transform_solver hab hcd0
    
    refine (good_shift_scale_iff (u := u⁻¹) (v := u⁻¹ * -v)).mp (this _ (λ _ ↦ hf _) ?_)
    iterate 2 rw [← mul_add, add_neg_cancel_right, Units.inv_mul_cancel_left]
    exact hcd
  
  by_cases h : ∀ x ≠ 0, ∃ r, f r = x
  · exact hF f hf0 hf h
  
  simp_rw [not_forall, exists_prop, not_exists] at h
  rcases h with ⟨u, hu, hu0⟩
  exact good_of_map_ne_of_ne_zero hu hu0

name: exists_ne_map_ne_of_four
statement:
theorem exists_ne_map_ne_of_four [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] {f : S → S}
    {a b c d : S} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hcd : c ≠ d)
    (hab0 : f a = f b) (hcd0 : f c = f d) (x) :
    ∃ y ≠ x, ∀ z, f z ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  
  wlog had : a ≠ d generalizing a b
  · exact this hab.symm hbc hac hab0.symm λ h ↦ had (hab.trans_eq h)
  
  have h : ({c, a}ᶜ : Finset S).card < ({x}ᶜ : Finset S).card := by
    rw [card_compl {x}, card_singleton, ← card_singleton a, ← card_compl, compl_insert]
    refine card_erase_lt_of_mem ?_
    rwa [mem_compl, mem_singleton, eq_comm]
  
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ : ∃ y ≠ x, ∀ z ≠ c, z ≠ a → f z ≠ y := by
    replace h : ¬Set.SurjOn f ({c, a}ᶜ : Finset S) ({x}ᶜ : Finset S) :=
      λ h0 ↦ h.not_ge (card_le_card_of_surjOn f h0)
    rw [Set.SurjOn, Set.subset_def, not_forall] at h
    rcases h with ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [Classical.not_imp, mem_coe, mem_compl, mem_singleton, Set.mem_image, not_exists] at hy
    refine ⟨y, hy.1, λ z ↦ ?_⟩
    replace hy : ¬(z ∈ (({c, a}ᶜ : Finset S) : Set S) ∧ f z = y) := hy.2 z
    rw [not_and, mem_coe, mem_compl, mem_insert, not_or, mem_singleton] at hy
    exact λ h h0 ↦ hy ⟨h, h0⟩
  
  refine ⟨y, hy, λ z ↦ ?_⟩
  clear h hy
  
  obtain rfl | hza : z = a ∨ z ≠ a := dec_em _
  · exact hab0.trans_ne (hy0 b hbc hab.symm)
  obtain rfl | hzc : z = c ∨ z ≠ c := dec_em _
  · exact hcd0.trans_ne (hy0 d hcd.symm had.symm)
  · exact hy0 z hzc hza

name: good_of_char_ne_two
statement: theorem good_of_char_ne_two (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) : ∀ f : F → F, good f
proof:
:= by
  
  refine good_of_forall_map_pair_eq_of_image_eq_units (a := -1) (b := 1)
    (Ring.neg_one_ne_one_of_char_ne_two hF) (λ f hf hf0 hf1 ↦ ?_)
  
  replace hf0 : f 0 ≠ 0 := hf0 0
  
  obtain ⟨r', hr⟩ : ∃ r' : F, ¬IsSquare r' := FiniteField.exists_nonsquare hF
  
  replace hf1 : ∃ y, f y = (1 - r') * f 0 :=
    hf1 _ (mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr λ hr0 ↦ hr (hr0 ▸ IsSquare.one)) hf0)
  rcases hf1 with ⟨y, hy⟩
  
  have hr' : r' ≠ 0 := λ hr' ↦ hr (hr' ▸ IsSquare.zero)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; rw [eq_comm, mul_eq_right₀ hf0, sub_eq_self] at hy
    exact hr' hy
  
  let r : F := y ^ 2 / r'
  replace hr : ¬IsSquare r := by
    refine λ hr0 ↦ hr ?_
    simpa only [r, div_div_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hy0)] using (IsSquare.sq y).div hr0
  replace hr (x) : x ^ 2 - r ≠ 0 :=
    λ hr0 ↦ hr ⟨x, by rw [← sq, eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, hr0]⟩
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩ : ∃ a ≠ 0, ∀ x, f x / (x ^ 2 - r) ≠ a := by
    have X : (1 : F) ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero
    refine exists_ne_map_ne_of_four (a := -1) (b := 1) (c := 0) (d := y)
      (Ring.neg_one_ne_one_of_char_ne_two hF) (neg_ne_zero.mpr X) X hy0.symm ?_ ?_ _
    
    · rw [hf, neg_sq]
    
    · rw [hy, div_eq_div_iff (hr _) (hr _), zero_pow Nat.two_pos.ne.symm, zero_sub,
        mul_right_comm, mul_neg, one_sub_mul, neg_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hr', mul_comm]
  
  refine ⟨a, 0, a * (-r), λ x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [zero_mul, add_zero, ← mul_add, ← sub_eq_add_neg, mul_ne_zero_iff, sub_ne_zero]
  exact ⟨mul_ne_zero ha (hr x), λ h0 ↦ ha0 x (div_eq_of_eq_mul (hr x) h0)⟩

name: nice_of_char_ne_two
statement: theorem nice_of_char_ne_two (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) : nice F
proof:
:=
  λ P ↦ good_of_char_ne_two hF P.eval

name: ZMod_nice_of_prime_ne_two
statement: theorem ZMod_nice_of_prime_ne_two (p) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hp : p ≠ 2) : nice (ZMod p)
proof:
:=
  FiniteField.nice_of_char_ne_two ((ZMod.ringChar_zmod_n p).trans_ne hp)

name: ZMod_two_pow_nice_iff
statement: theorem ZMod_two_pow_nice_iff {k : ℕ} : nice (ZMod (2 ^ k)) ↔ 1 < k
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ hk ↦ ?_, λ hk ↦ Nat.lt_of_not_le λ hk0 ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact ZMod_nice_of_dvd ZMod4_nice (Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 hk)
  
  obtain rfl | rfl : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 := Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hk0
  exacts [not_nice_ZMod1 hk, not_nice_ZMod2 hk]

name: ZMod_nice_iff
statement: theorem ZMod_nice_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : n > 0) : nice (ZMod n) ↔ n > 2
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hpn, hp0⟩ :
      (∃ k, n = 2 ^ k) ∨ (∃ p, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ∧ Odd p) :=
    Nat.eq_two_pow_or_exists_odd_prime_and_dvd n
  · rw [ZMod_two_pow_nice_iff, ← Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right Nat.one_lt_two]
  
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime p) := ⟨hp⟩
  replace hp0 : p ≠ 2 := λ h ↦ Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hp0 (h ▸ even_two)
  have hp1 : p > 2 := hp.two_le.lt_of_ne' hp0
  replace hp0 : nice (ZMod p) := ZMod_nice_of_prime_ne_two p hp0
  exact iff_of_true (ZMod_nice_of_dvd hp0 hpn) (hp1.trans_le (Nat.le_of_dvd hn hpn))

name: natGood_iff
statement:
theorem natGood_iff :
    natGood n f ↔ ∃ a ≠ 0, ∃ b c,
      ∀ k, ¬(n : ℤ) ∣ (a * k ^ 2 + b * k + c) * (f k - (a * k ^ 2 + b * k + c))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, c, h⟩
    refine ⟨-a, Int.neg_ne_zero.mpr ha, -b, -c, λ k ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [neg_mul, neg_mul, ← neg_add, ← neg_add, neg_mul, dvd_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]
    exact h k
  
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, c, h⟩
    refine ⟨-a, Int.neg_ne_zero.mpr ha, -b, -c, λ k ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [neg_mul, neg_mul, ← neg_add, ← neg_add, neg_mul, dvd_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact h k

name: natGood_iff_of_pos
statement:
theorem natGood_iff_of_pos (hn : n > 0) :
    natGood n f ↔ ∃ a b c, ∀ k,
      ¬(n : ℤ) ∣ (a * k ^ 2 + b * k + c) * (f k - (a * k ^ 2 + b * k + c))
proof:
:= by
  
  refine natGood_iff.trans ⟨λ h ↦ h.elim λ a ha ↦ ⟨a, ha.2⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
  
  obtain ha0 | rfl : a ≠ 0 ∨ a = 0 := ne_or_eq a 0
  · exact ⟨a, ha0, ha⟩
  
  rcases ha with ⟨b, c, h⟩
  simp only [zero_mul, zero_add] at h
  refine ⟨n, Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne.symm, b, c, λ k ↦ ?_⟩
  have h0 : ((n * k ^ 2 + b * k + c : ℤ) : ZMod n) = (b * k + c : ℤ) := by
    rw [Int.add_assoc, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast,
      CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_sub, h0,
    ← Int.cast_sub, ← Int.cast_mul,ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact h k

name: natGood_polynomial_iff_good
statement:
theorem natGood_polynomial_iff_good (hn : n > 0) (P : ℤ[X]) :
    natGood n P.eval ↔ good (P.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod n))).eval
proof:
:= by
  set φ : ℤ →+* ZMod n := Int.castRingHom (ZMod n)
  have hφ : (φ : ℤ → ZMod n).Surjective := ZMod.ringHom_surjective φ
  rw [natGood_iff_of_pos hn, good, hφ.exists₃]
  conv_rhs =>
    right; ext a; right; ext b; right; ext c
    rw [hφ.forall]; intro x
    rw [← φ.map_pow, ← φ.map_mul, ← φ.map_mul, ← φ.map_add, ← φ.map_add, eval_map_apply,
      ← φ.map_sub, ← φ.map_mul, eq_intCast, Ne, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (hn : n > 0) : (∀ P : ℤ[X], natGood n P.eval) ↔ n > 2
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← ZMod_nice_iff hn, natGood_polynomial_iff_good hn]
  exact Iff.symm (map_surjective _ (ZMod.ringHom_surjective _)).forall

name: Int_add_modeq_right_iff
statement: theorem Int_add_modeq_right_iff : a + d ≡ b + d [ZMOD c] ↔ a ≡ b [ZMOD c]
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ h.add_right_cancel', λ h ↦ h.add_right d⟩

name: filter_image_two_mul_translate
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x, 2 * x + c ≡ 2 * m + c [ZMOD D * 2] ↔ x ≡ m [ZMOD D]
    by simp_rw [filter_image, this]
  intro x; rw [Int_add_modeq_right_iff, Int.mul_comm D,
    Int.ModEq.mul_left_cancel_iff' (by decide : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0)]

name: filter_image_two_mul_translate_of_mod_two_ne
statement:
theorem filter_image_two_mul_translate_of_mod_two_ne {a b : ℤ} (hab : a % 2 ≠ b % 2) :
    {s ∈ S.image (2 * · + a) | ¬s ≡ 2 * m + b [ZMOD D * 2]} = S.image (2 * · + a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_eq_self, forall_mem_image]
  rintro x - h
  replace h : (2 * x + a) % 2 = (2 * m + b) % 2 := h.of_mul_left D
  iterate 2 rw [Int.mul_add_emod_self_left] at h
  exact hab h

name: empty
statement: theorem empty : isWinning ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [isWinning, strongInduction_eq]
  exact Or.inl rfl

name: iff_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem iff_of_nonempty {S : Finset ℤ} (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    isWinning S ↔ ∃ n ∈ S, ∃ k : ℕ, ¬isWinning {s ∈ S | ¬s ≡ n [ZMOD 2 ^ k]}
proof:
:= by
  rw [isWinning, strongInduction_eq, or_iff_right (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp hS)]
  simp only [exists_prop]

name: of_move
statement:
theorem of_move (hnS : n ∈ S) (hnS0 : ¬isWinning {s ∈ S | ¬s ≡ n [ZMOD 2 ^ k]}) :
    isWinning S
proof:
:=
  (iff_of_nonempty ⟨n, hnS⟩).mpr ⟨n, hnS, k, hnS0⟩

name: not_singleton
statement: theorem not_singleton (n) : ¬isWinning {n}
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iff_of_nonempty (singleton_nonempty n), mem_singleton]
  rintro ⟨n, rfl, k, h⟩
  have h0 : {s ∈ ({n} : Finset ℤ) | ¬s ≡ n [ZMOD 2 ^ k]} = ∅ :=
    filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr λ m hm ↦ by rw [not_not, mem_singleton.mp hm]
  exact h (h0 ▸ empty)

name: insert_of_not_isWinning
statement:
theorem insert_of_not_isWinning (hS : ¬isWinning S) (hnS : n ∉ S) :
    isWinning (insert n S)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨e, hen, heS⟩ : ∃ e, n.natAbs < 2 ^ e ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, x.natAbs < 2 ^ e := by
    let e := (insert n S).sup' (S.insert_nonempty n) Int.natAbs
    exact ⟨e, (forall_mem_insert n S (λ x ↦ x.natAbs < 2 ^ e)).mp
      λ x hx ↦ (le_sup' Int.natAbs hx).trans_lt Nat.lt_two_pow_self⟩
  
  refine of_move (mem_insert_self n S) (k := e + 1) ?_
  suffices {s ∈ insert n S | ¬s ≡ n [ZMOD 2 ^ (e + 1)]} = S from this.symm ▸ hS
  
  rw [filter_insert, ite_eq_right (not_not.mpr (Int.ModEq.refl _)), filter_eq_self]
  
  intro x hxS h0
  replace h0 : ((2 : ℤ) ^ (e + 1)).natAbs ≤ (x - n).natAbs :=
    Int.natAbs_le_of_dvd_ne_zero h0.symm.dvd (sub_ne_zero_of_ne λ h1 ↦ hnS (h1 ▸ hxS))
  have h1 : (x - n).natAbs < ((2 : ℤ) ^ (e + 1)).natAbs := calc
    _ ≤ x.natAbs + n.natAbs := Int.natAbs_sub_le x n
    _ < 2 ^ e + 2 ^ e := Nat.add_lt_add (heS x hxS) hen
    _ = ((2 : ℤ) ^ (e + 1)).natAbs := by rw [Int.natAbs_pow, ← Nat.mul_two]; rfl
  exact h0.not_gt h1

name: two_mul_translate_iff
statement: theorem two_mul_translate_iff : isWinning (S.image (2 * · + d)) ↔ isWinning S
proof:
:= by
  
  induction S using Finset.strongInduction with | H S hS => ?_
  obtain rfl | hS0 : S = ∅ ∨ S.Nonempty := S.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · exact ⟨λ _ ↦ isWinning.empty, λ _ ↦ empty⟩
  /- For induction step, the move `(k, 2n + d)` wins for `2S + d`
    if and only if `(max{k - 1, 0}, n)` wins for `S`. -/
  rw [iff_of_nonempty (hS0.image _), iff_of_nonempty hS0, exists_mem_image]
  refine exists_congr λ n ↦ and_congr_right λ hnS ↦ ?_
  conv_lhs =>
    congr; ext k; rw [filter_image, hS _ (filter_ssubset.mpr ⟨n, hnS, not_not.mpr rfl⟩)]
    simp only [Int_add_modeq_right_iff]
  
  have X : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · rintro ⟨k, h⟩
    refine ⟨k - 1, ?_⟩
    cases k with
    | zero => simpa only [Nat.zero_sub, Int.pow_zero, Int.modEq_one] using h
    | succ k => simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Int.pow_succ',
        Int.ModEq.mul_left_cancel_iff' X] using h
  
  · rintro ⟨k, h⟩
    refine ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [Int.pow_succ', Int.ModEq.mul_left_cancel_iff' X]

name: two_mul_iff
statement: theorem two_mul_iff : isWinning (S.image (2 * ·)) ↔ isWinning S
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [add_zero] using two_mul_translate_iff (d := 0)

name: translate_iff
statement: theorem translate_iff : isWinning (S.image (· + d)) ↔ isWinning S
proof:
:= by
  have h : (2 * ·) ∘ (· + d) = λ x ↦ 2 * x + 2 * d := funext λ x ↦ Int.mul_add 2 x d
  rw [← two_mul_iff, image_image, h, two_mul_translate_iff]

name: binary_merge_of_left_not_isWinning
statement:
theorem binary_merge_of_left_not_isWinning (hS : ¬isWinning S) (hT : T.Nonempty) :
    isWinning (S.image (2 * · + a) ∪ T.image (2 * · + b))
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases hT with ⟨t, ht⟩
  refine of_move (n := 2 * t + b) (k := 1) (mem_union_right _ (mem_image_of_mem _ ht)) ?_
  simp_rw [filter_union, filter_image, Int.ModEq,
    Int.pow_one, Int.mul_add_emod_self_left, filter_const]
  rwa [ite_eq_left hab, ite_eq_right (not_not.mpr trivial),
    image_empty, union_empty, two_mul_translate_iff]

name: binary_merge_of_right_not_isWinning
statement:
theorem binary_merge_of_right_not_isWinning (hS : S.Nonempty) (hT : ¬isWinning T) :
    isWinning (S.image (2 * · + a) ∪ T.image (2 * · + b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [union_comm]; exact binary_merge_of_left_not_isWinning hab.symm hT hS

name: binary_merge_self_not_isWinning
statement:
theorem binary_merge_self_not_isWinning (hS : isWinning S) (hS0 : S.Nonempty) :
    ¬isWinning (S.image (2 * · + a) ∪ S.image (2 * · + b))
proof:
:= by
  
  induction S using Finset.strongInduction with | H S S_ih => ?_
  
  rw [iff_of_nonempty (union_nonempty.mpr (Or.inl (hS0.image _))), not_exists]
  intro n; rw [not_and, mem_union, mem_image, mem_image, ← not_forall, not_not]
  intro hn k; wlog hn' : ∃ s ∈ S, 2 * s + a = n generalizing a b
  · have h (T : Finset ℤ) : T.image (2 * · + a) ∪ T.image (2 * · + b)
        = T.image (2 * · + b) ∪ T.image (2 * · + a) := union_comm _ _
    exact h S ▸ this hab.symm (λ t ↦ h t ▸ S_ih t) hn.symm (hn.resolve_left hn')
  clear hn; rcases hn' with ⟨m, hmS, rfl⟩
  
  obtain rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩ : k = 0 ∨ ∃ j, k = j + 1 :=
    (Nat.eq_zero_or_eq_succ_pred k).imp_right λ h ↦ ⟨k.pred, h⟩
  · rw [Int.pow_zero, filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr λ x _ ↦ not_not.mpr Int.modEq_one]
    exact empty
  
  rw [filter_union, Int.pow_succ, filter_image_two_mul_translate,
    filter_image_two_mul_translate_of_mod_two_ne _ _ _ hab.symm]
  
  set T : Finset ℤ := {s ∈ S | ¬s ≡ m [ZMOD 2 ^ j]}
  obtain hT | hT : T = ∅ ∨ T.Nonempty := eq_empty_or_nonempty _
  · rwa [hT, image_empty, empty_union, two_mul_translate_iff]
  
  have hmS0 : 2 * m + b ∈ T.image (2 * · + a) ∪ S.image (2 * · + b) :=
    mem_union_right _ (mem_image_of_mem _ hmS)
  obtain hT0 | hT0 : ¬isWinning T ∨ isWinning T := em' _
  · refine of_move (n := 2 * m + b) hmS0 (k := 1) ?_
    rwa [filter_union, Int.pow_succ, filter_image_two_mul_translate,
      filter_image_two_mul_translate_of_mod_two_ne _ _ _ hab, Int.pow_zero,
      filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr λ _ _ ↦ not_not.mpr Int.modEq_one,
      image_empty, union_empty, two_mul_translate_iff]
  
  · refine of_move (n := 2 * m + b) hmS0 (k := j + 1) ?_
    rw [filter_union, Int.pow_succ, filter_image_two_mul_translate,
      filter_image_two_mul_translate_of_mod_two_ne _ _ _ hab]
    exact S_ih _ (filter_ssubset.mpr ⟨m, hmS, not_not.mpr rfl⟩) hT0 hT

name: binary_merge_self_not_isWinning_iff
statement:
theorem binary_merge_self_not_isWinning_iff (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ¬isWinning (S.image (2 * · + a) ∪ S.image (2 * · + b)) ↔ isWinning S
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ hS0 ↦ by_contra λ hS1 ↦ hS0 (binary_merge_of_left_not_isWinning hab hS1 hS),
  λ hS0 ↦ binary_merge_self_not_isWinning hab hS0 hS⟩

name: binary_merge_Ico_zero_two_mul
statement:
theorem binary_merge_Ico_zero_two_mul (N : ℕ) :
    Ico 0 ((2 * N : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (Ico 0 (N : ℤ)).image (2 * · + 0) ∪ (Ico 0 (N : ℤ)).image (2 * · + 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext n; rw [mem_Ico, mem_union, mem_image, mem_image, ← exists_or]
  conv_rhs => congr; ext a; rw [← and_or_left, mem_Ico]
  have X : (2 : ℤ) > 0 := by decide
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · rintro ⟨hn, hnN⟩
    refine ⟨n / 2, ⟨Int.ediv_nonneg hn X.le,
      Int.ediv_lt_of_lt_mul X (Int.mul_comm _ _ ▸ hnN)⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq', ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq', ← Int.emod_def]
    exact (Int.emod_two_eq n).imp Eq.symm Eq.symm
  
  · rintro ⟨a, ⟨ha, haN⟩, h⟩
    have h2a : 0 ≤ 2 * a := Int.mul_nonneg X.le ha
    rcases h with rfl | rfl
    · rw [Int.add_zero]; exact ⟨h2a, Int.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left haN X⟩
    · refine ⟨Int.add_nonneg h2a Int.one_nonneg, ?_⟩
      calc 2 * a + 1
        _ < 2 * a + 1 + 1 := Int.lt_add_of_pos_right _ Int.one_pos
        _ = 2 * (a + 1) := by rw [Int.mul_add, Int.add_assoc, Int.two_mul 1]
        _ ≤ 2 * N := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Int.add_one_le_of_lt haN) X.le

name: binary_merge_Ico_zero_two_mul_add_one
statement:
theorem binary_merge_Ico_zero_two_mul_add_one (N : ℕ) :
    Ico 0 ((2 * N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (Ico 0 ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).image (2 * · + 0) ∪ (Ico 0 (N : ℤ)).image (2 * · + 1)
proof:
:= by
  iterate 2 rw [Int.natCast_succ, ← insert_Ico_right_eq_Ico_add_one (Int.natCast_nonneg _)]
  rw [image_insert, insert_union, binary_merge_Ico_zero_two_mul]; rfl

name: Ico_zero_two_mul_not_isWinning_iff
statement:
theorem Ico_zero_two_mul_not_isWinning_iff {N : ℕ} (hN : N > 0) :
    ¬isWinning (Ico 0 (2 * N : ℕ)) ↔ isWinning (Ico 0 N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [binary_merge_Ico_zero_two_mul]
  refine isWinning.binary_merge_self_not_isWinning_iff (by decide) ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rwa [left_mem_Ico, Int.natCast_pos]

name: Ico_zero_four_mul_isWinning_iff
statement:
theorem Ico_zero_four_mul_isWinning_iff {N : ℕ} :
    isWinning (Ico 0 (4 * N : ℕ)) ↔ isWinning (Ico 0 N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hN : N = 0 ∨ N > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N
  
  · rfl
  
  · rw [Nat.mul_assoc 2 2 N, ← Ico_zero_two_mul_not_isWinning_iff hN,
      ← Ico_zero_two_mul_not_isWinning_iff (Nat.mul_pos Nat.two_pos hN), not_not]

name: Ico_zero_one_not_isWinning
statement: theorem Ico_zero_one_not_isWinning : ¬isWinning (Ico 0 1)
proof:
:=
  isWinning.not_singleton 0

name: Ico_zero_two_mul_add_one_isWinning
statement:
theorem Ico_zero_two_mul_add_one_isWinning {N : ℕ} (hN : N > 0) :
    isWinning (Ico 0 (2 * N + 1 : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hN0 : isWinning (Ico 0 N)
  
  · rw [Int.natCast_succ, ← insert_Ico_right_eq_Ico_add_one (Int.natCast_nonneg _)]
    exact isWinning.insert_of_not_isWinning ((Ico_zero_two_mul_not_isWinning_iff hN).mpr hN0)
      right_notMem_Ico
  
  · rw [binary_merge_Ico_zero_two_mul_add_one]
    refine isWinning.binary_merge_of_right_not_isWinning (by decide) ⟨0, ?_⟩ hN0
    rw [left_mem_Ico, Int.natCast_pos]
    exact Nat.succ_pos N

name: Ico_zero_isWinning_iff_of_odd
statement:
theorem Ico_zero_isWinning_iff_of_odd {N : ℕ} (hN : Odd N) :
    isWinning (Ico 0 N) ↔ N ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hN with ⟨n, rfl⟩
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ n > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n
  exacts [iff_of_false Ico_zero_one_not_isWinning (not_not.mpr rfl),
    iff_of_true (Ico_zero_two_mul_add_one_isWinning hn)
      (Nat.succ_ne_succ_iff.mpr (Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1) hn.ne.symm))]

name: Ico_zero_isWinning_iff_of_not_four_dvd
statement:
theorem Ico_zero_isWinning_iff_of_not_four_dvd {N : ℕ} (hN : ¬4 ∣ N) :
    isWinning (Ico 0 N) ↔ N = 2 ∨ (N ≠ 1 ∧ Odd N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain hN0 | hN0 : Odd N ∨ Even N := (Nat.even_or_odd N).symm
  
  · rw [and_iff_left hN0, or_iff_right_of_imp λ h ↦ h ▸ by decide]
    exact Ico_zero_isWinning_iff_of_odd hN0
  
  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : 2 ∣ N := even_iff_two_dvd.mp hN0
    replace hN : ¬2 ∣ n := by rwa [← Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left Nat.two_pos]
    have hn : Odd n := by rwa [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd, even_iff_two_dvd]
    have hn0 : n > 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero λ h ↦ Nat.not_odd_zero (h ▸ hn)
    rw [or_iff_left λ h ↦ Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr h.2 hN0, ← not_iff_not,
      Ico_zero_two_mul_not_isWinning_iff hn0, Ico_zero_isWinning_iff_of_odd hn,
      Ne, ← Nat.mul_right_inj (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)]; rfl

name: Ico_zero_isWinning_iff
statement:
theorem Ico_zero_isWinning_iff {N : ℕ} (hN : N > 0) :
    isWinning (Ico 0 N) ↔ ∃ t, (t = 2 ∨ (t ≠ 1 ∧ Odd t)) ∧ ∃ k, N = t * 4 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h N N_ih => ?_
  obtain hN0 | ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ¬4 ∣ N ∨ 4 ∣ N := dec_em' _
  
  · refine (Ico_zero_isWinning_iff_of_not_four_dvd hN0).trans
      ⟨λ hN1 ↦ ⟨N, hN1, 0, (Nat.mul_one N).symm⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨t, ht, k, rfl⟩
    obtain rfl : k = 0 := by
      refine (Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k).resolve_right λ hk ↦ hN0 ⟨t * 4 ^ (k - 1), ?_⟩
      rw [Nat.mul_left_comm, ← Nat.pow_add_one', Nat.sub_one_add_one_eq_of_pos hk]
    rwa [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  
  · replace hN : n > 0 := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left hN
    have hn : n < 4 * n := (Nat.lt_mul_iff_one_lt_left hN).mpr (by decide : 1 < 4)
    rw [Ico_zero_four_mul_isWinning_iff, N_ih _ hn hN]
    refine exists_congr λ t ↦ and_congr_right λ ht ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.pow_add_one']
    
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      replace ht : ¬4 ∣ t := by
        rcases ht with rfl | ⟨-, ht⟩
        · decide
        · have h0 : 2 ∣ 4 := by decide
          exact λ h1 ↦ ht.not_two_dvd_nat (h0.trans h1)
      obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := by
        rw [Nat.exists_eq_add_one, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
        rintro rfl; rw [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.mul_one] at hk
        exact ht ⟨n, hk.symm⟩
      have X : 4 ≠ 0 := by decide
      rw [Nat.pow_add_one', Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_right_inj X] at hk
      exact ⟨k', hk⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {N : ℕ} (hN : N > 0) :
    isWinning (Icc 1 N) ↔ ∃ t, (t = 2 ∨ (t ≠ 1 ∧ Odd t)) ∧ ∃ k, N = t * 4 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have h : Icc (1 : ℤ) N = (Ico (0 : ℤ) N).image (· + 1) := by
    rw [image_add_right_Ico, Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc]; rfl
  rw [h, isWinning.translate_iff, Ico_zero_isWinning_iff hN]

name: not_prime_nine
statement: theorem not_prime_nine : ¬Nat.Prime 9
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: good_two_pow_imp
statement: theorem good_two_pow_imp {k} (hk : good (2 ^ k)) : k ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Nat.le_of_not_lt λ hk0 ↦ ?_
  
  replace hk : 9 ∣ 2 ^ k := (hk 8 (Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 hk0)).resolve_right not_prime_nine
  
  replace hk : 3 ∣ 2 ^ k := (by decide : 3 ∣ 9).trans hk
  replace hk : 3 ∣ 2 := Nat.prime_three.dvd_of_dvd_pow hk
  revert hk; decide

name: not_prime_two_pow_add_one_of_odd
statement:
theorem not_prime_two_pow_add_one_of_odd (hl : l > 1) (hl0 : Odd l) :
    ¬Nat.Prime (2 ^ l + 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hl1 : 3 ∣ 2 ^ l + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, ← Nat.div_add_mod l 2, Nat.odd_iff.mp hl0, Nat.pow_succ,
      Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.mod_add_mod, ← Nat.mod_mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow]
  exact Nat.not_prime_of_dvd_of_lt (m := 3) (n := 2 ^ l + 1) hl1
    (Nat.le_succ 2) (Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right Nat.one_lt_two hl))

name: two_pow_add_one_not_dvd_two_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem two_pow_add_one_not_dvd_two_pow_sub_one (hj : j ≠ 0) (h : j ≤ k) :
    ¬2 ^ k + 1 ∣ 2 ^ j - 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Nat.one_lt_two_pow hj)) ?_
  calc 2 ^ j - 1
  _ ≤ 2 ^ j := Nat.sub_le (2 ^ j) 1
  _ ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.two_pos h
  _ < 2 ^ k + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self (2 ^ k)

name: eq_two_of_pow_pred_add_one_dvd_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem eq_two_of_pow_pred_add_one_dvd_pow_sub_one
    (hk : k > 0) (hk0 : 2 ^ (k - 1) + 1 ∣ 2 ^ k - 1) : k = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 < 2 * 2 ^ (k - 1) :=
    Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right 2 (Nat.two_pow_pos (k - 1))
  
  replace hk0 : 2 * 2 ^ (k - 1) - 1 = 2 ^ (k - 1) + 1 := by
    refine Nat.eq_of_dvd_of_lt_two_mul ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact Nat.sub_ne_zero_of_lt hk1
    · rwa [← Nat.pow_add_one', Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
    · exact (Nat.sub_lt_add_one _ _).trans (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  
  rw [Nat.sub_eq_iff_eq_add hk1.le, Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_inj] at hk0
  exact Nat.pred_eq_succ_iff.mp (Nat.pow_right_injective (Nat.le_refl 2) hk0)

name: good_two_pow_mul_odd_imp
statement:
theorem good_two_pow_mul_odd_imp (hm : Odd m) (hm0 : m > 1) (h : good (2 ^ k * m)) :
    k = 2 ∧ m = 3
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ : ∃ j ≤ k, m = 2 ^ j - 1 := by
    
    have h0 : m + 1 ∣ 2 ^ k * m :=
      (h m (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)).resolve_right λ h0 ↦
        hm0.ne.symm (Nat.succ_injective (h0.even_iff.mp hm.add_one))
    replace h0 : m + 1 ∣ 2 ^ k := (Nat.dvd_add_right h0).mp (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)
    
    obtain ⟨j, hj, h1⟩ : ∃ j ≤ k, m + 1 = 2 ^ j :=
      (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two).mp h0
    exact ⟨j, hj, Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq h1⟩
  
  obtain hk | hk : k ≤ 2 ∨ 2 < k := le_or_gt k 2
  · replace hm0 : 2 ≤ j :=
      (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right Nat.one_lt_two).mp (Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub hm0)
    obtain rfl : j = 2 := (hj.trans hk).antisymm hm0
    exact ⟨hk.antisymm hj, rfl⟩
  
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := λ hj0 ↦ hm0.not_ge (hj0 ▸ Nat.zero_le 1)
  clear hm hm0
  
  have h0 {l} (hl : l > 1) (hl0 : Odd l) (hl1 : l ≤ k) : 2 ^ l + 1 ∣ 2 ^ j - 1 := by
    
    obtain h0 | h0 : 2 ^ l + 1 ∣ 2 ^ k * (2 ^ j - 1) ∨ Nat.Prime (2 ^ l + 1) :=
      h (2 ^ l) (Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd (Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 hl1) _)
    
    · have h1 : Nat.Coprime (2 ^ l + 1) 2 := by
        rw [← Nat.coprime_pow_right_iff (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hl), Nat.coprime_self_add_left]
        exact Nat.coprime_one_left (2 ^ l)
      exact (h1.pow_right k).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h0
    /- If `2^l + 1` is prime, then we get contradiction, since `l > 1` is odd.
      (See `not_prime_two_pow_add_one_of_odd`.) -/
    · exact absurd h0 (not_prime_two_pow_add_one_of_odd hl hl0)
  
  have hk1 : ¬Odd k := by
    intro h1; replace h1 : 2 ^ k + 1 ∣ 2 ^ j - 1 :=
      h0 (Nat.lt_of_add_left_lt hk) h1 (Nat.le_refl k)
    exact absurd h1 (two_pow_add_one_not_dvd_two_pow_sub_one hj0 hj)
  
  replace h0 : 2 ^ (k - 1) + 1 ∣ 2 ^ j - 1 := by
    refine h0 (Nat.lt_sub_of_add_lt hk) ?_ (Nat.sub_le k 1)
    rwa [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd, ← Nat.even_add_one,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_of_lt hk), ← Nat.not_odd_iff_even]
  
  replace hj : j = k := hj.eq_of_not_lt λ h1 ↦
    two_pow_add_one_not_dvd_two_pow_sub_one hj0 (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt h1) h0
  /- Then `2^{k - 1} + 1 ∣ 2^k - 1`, forcing `k = 2`; impossible.
    (See `eq_two_of_pow_pred_add_one_dvd_pow_sub_one`.) -/
  subst j; replace h0 : k = 2 :=
    eq_two_of_pow_pred_add_one_dvd_pow_sub_one (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk) h0
  exact absurd h0 hk.ne.symm

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (hn : n > 0) : good n ↔ (n = 1 ∨ n = 2 ∨ n = 4) ∨ n = 12
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    intro d hd
    have h : d ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd hn hd
    revert hd; revert d
    rcases h with (rfl | rfl | rfl) | rfl
    all_goals decide
  
  obtain ⟨k, m, hm, rfl⟩ : ∃ k m, Odd m ∧ n = 2 ^ k * m :=
    Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd hn.ne.symm
  
  clear hn
  refine (Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hm.pos).imp (λ hm0 ↦ ?_) (λ (hm0 : m > 1) ↦ ?_)
  
  · subst hm0; rw [Nat.mul_one] at h ⊢
    replace h : k ≤ 2 := good_two_pow_imp h
    revert k; decide
  
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : k = 2 ∧ m = 3 := good_two_pow_mul_odd_imp hm hm0 h
    rfl

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [AddCommGroup G] (hG : ∀ x : G, ∃ y, 2 • y = x)
    [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {f g : G → R}
    (hf : ∀ x y, g x - g y ≤ f (x + y) * f (x - y))
    (hf0 : ∃ x₀ y₀, g x₀ - g y₀ < f (x₀ + y₀) * f (x₀ - y₀)) :
    (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) ∨ (∀ x, f x ≤ 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, f t + f (-t) ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hf0 with ⟨x₀, y₀, h⟩
    refine ⟨x₀ - y₀, right_ne_zero_of_mul (a := f (x₀ + y₀)) (ne_of_gt ?_)⟩
    simpa only [neg_sub, mul_add, sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_self, add_comm y₀]
      using add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le h (hf y₀ x₀)
  
  replace hf (s) : 0 ≤ f s * (f t + f (-t)) := by
    
    obtain ⟨x, y, rfl, rfl⟩ : ∃ x y, s = x + y ∧ t = x - y := by
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, 2 • v = s := hG s
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, 2 • w = t := hG t
      refine ⟨v + w, v - w, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [add_add_sub_cancel, two_nsmul]
      · rw [add_sub_sub_cancel, two_nsmul]
    
    simpa only [neg_sub, mul_add, sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_self, add_comm y]
      using add_le_add (hf x y) (hf y x)
  
  exact ht.symm.lt_or_gt.imp
    (λ h x ↦ nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left (hf x) h)
    (λ h x ↦ nonpos_of_mul_nonneg_left (hf x) h)

name: two_mul_le_add_of_sq_le_mul
statement:
theorem two_mul_le_add_of_sq_le_mul
    [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [ExistsAddOfLE R]
    {a b r : R} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hr : r ^ 2 ≤ a * b) : 2 * r ≤ a + b
proof:
:= by
  refine nonneg_le_nonneg_of_sq_le_sq (add_nonneg ha hb) ?_
  calc 2 * r * (2 * r)
    _ = 4 * r ^ 2 := by rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, two_mul, two_add_two_eq_four, sq]
    _ ≤ 4 * (a * b) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (zero_le_four)
    _ = 4 * a * b := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ (a + b) ^ 2 := four_mul_le_pow_two_add a b
    _ = (a + b) * (a + b) := sq _

name: general_result
statement:
theorem general_result
    [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [ExistsAddOfLE R]
    {a b : ℕ → R} (ha : ∀ k, a k > 0) (hb : ∀ k, b k ≥ 0)
    (hab : ∀ k, b (k + 1) ≤ a k + b k) (hab0 : ∀ k, a k * b k = k)
    (hn : n ≥ 2) : n ≤ ∑ i ∈ range n, a i
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : b 0 = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero_iff_left (ha 0).ne.symm ).mp ((hab0 0).trans Nat.cast_zero)
  
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with | base => ?_ | succ n hn n_ih => ?_
  · calc (2 : R)
    _ = 2 * 1 := (mul_one _ ).symm
    _ ≤ a 1 + b 1 :=
      have h : 1 ^ 2 = a 1 * b 1 := by rw [hab0, Nat.cast_one, one_pow]
      two_mul_le_add_of_sq_le_mul (ha _).le (hb _) h.le
    _ ≤ a 1 + (a 0 + b 0) := add_le_add_right (hab 0) _
    _ = a 0 + a 1 := by rw [hb0, add_zero, add_comm]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range 2, a i := by rw [sum_range_succ, sum_range_one]
  
  set T : R := ∑ i ∈ range n, a i
  calc ((n + 1 : ℕ) : R)
    _ = n + 1 := Nat.cast_succ _
    _ ≤ T + a n := ?_
    _ = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), a i := (sum_range_succ a n).symm
  
  obtain hn0 | hn0 : a n ≥ 1 ∨ a n ≤ 1 := le_total _ _
  · exact add_le_add n_ih hn0
  
  replace n_ih : 1 ≤ T := n_ih.trans' (Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.one_le_of_lt hn))
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ : ∃ c ≥ 0, a n + c = 1 := exists_nonneg_add_of_le hn0
  
  replace hab (k) : b k ≤ ∑ i ∈ range k, a i := by
    induction k with | zero => rw [hb0, sum_range_zero] | succ k k_ih => ?_
    calc b (k + 1)
      _ ≤ a k + b k := hab k
      _ ≤ a k + ∑ i ∈ range k, a i := add_le_add_right k_ih _
      _ = ∑ i ∈ range (k + 1), a i := (sum_range_succ_comm a k).symm
  replace hab : b n ≤ T := hab n
  
  calc (n : R) + 1
    _ = a n * b n + c + a n := by rw [hab0, add_assoc, add_comm c, hc0]
    _ ≤ a n * T + c * T + a n :=
      add_le_add_left (a := a n) <| add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (ha n).le) (le_mul_of_one_le_right hc n_ih)
    _ = T + a n := by rw [← add_mul, hc0, one_mul]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution
    [Semifield F] [LinearOrder F] [IsStrictOrderedRing F] [ExistsAddOfLE F] {a : ℕ → F}
    (ha : ∀ k, a k > 0) (ha0 : ∀ k, (k + 1 : ℕ) * a k / (a k ^ 2 + k) ≤ a (k + 1))
    (hn : n ≥ 2) : n ≤ ∑ i ∈ range n, a i
proof:
:= by
  replace ha0 (k) : (k + 1 : ℕ) / a (k + 1) ≤ a k + k / a k := by
    have h : a k ^ 2 + ↑k > 0 := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (pow_pos (ha k) 2) k.cast_nonneg'
    rw [add_div' _ _ _ (ha k).ne.symm, div_le_div_iff₀ (ha _) (ha k), ← sq, ← div_le_iff₀' h]
    exact ha0 k
  exact general_result (b := λ k ↦ k / a k) ha (λ k ↦ div_nonneg k.cast_nonneg' (ha k).le)
    ha0 (λ k ↦ mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ha k).ne.symm) hn

name: good.of_ge
statement: theorem good.of_ge (hf : good k f) (htk : t ≥ k) : good t f
proof:
:=
  λ m n h ↦ (hf m n h).trans htk

name: not_good_one
statement: theorem not_good_one (f) : ¬good 1 f
proof:
:= by
  
  intro h
  replace h (m n) (hmn : m ≠ n) : (f m + n).val % 2 = 1 ∨ (f n + m).val % 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.two_dvd_ne_zero, ← Nat.two_dvd_ne_zero, ← not_and_or, ← Nat.dvd_gcd_iff,
      ← PNat.gcd_coe, le_one_iff_eq_one.mp (h m n hmn), Nat.two_dvd_ne_zero]; rfl
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, (f (2 * m) : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := by
    obtain h0 | h0 : (f 2 + 4 : ℕ) % 2 = 1 ∨ (f 4 + 2 : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := h 2 4 (by decide)
    exacts [⟨1, (Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right _ 2 2).symm.trans h0⟩,
      ⟨2, (Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right _ 1 2).symm.trans h0⟩]
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, (f (2 * n + 1) : ℕ) % 2 = 0 := by
    obtain h0 | h0 : (f 3 + 5 : ℕ) % 2 = 1 ∨ (f 5 + 3 : ℕ) % 2 = 1 := h 3 5 (by decide)
    · rw [Nat.succ_mod_two_eq_one_iff, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right _ 2 2] at h0
      exact ⟨1, h0⟩
    · rw [Nat.succ_mod_two_eq_one_iff, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right _ 1 2] at h0
      exact ⟨2, h0⟩
  
  refine Nat.zero_ne_one ?_
  obtain h0 | h0 :
      (f (2 * m) + (2 * n + 1) : ℕ) % 2 = 1 ∨ (f (2 * n + 1) + 2 * m : ℕ) % 2 = 1 :=
    h (2 * m) (2 * n + 1) λ h0 ↦ Nat.two_mul_ne_two_mul_add_one (PNat.coe_inj.mpr h0)
  · rwa [← Nat.mod_add_mod, hm, Nat.add_left_comm, ← Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_mod_right] at h0
  · rwa [← Nat.mod_add_mod, hn, Nat.zero_add, Nat.mul_mod_right] at h0

name: goodHelperNat_zero
statement: theorem goodHelperNat_zero : goodHelperNat 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: goodHelperNat_succ
statement:
theorem goodHelperNat_succ (n) :
    goodHelperNat (n + 1) = (2 ^ (goodHelperNat n + 1)).factorial
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ n 1

name: goodHelperNat_strictMono
statement: theorem goodHelperNat_strictMono : StrictMono goodHelperNat
proof:
:= by
  refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ λ n ↦ ?_
  let N := goodHelperNat n
  calc N
    _ < N + 1 := N.lt_succ_self
    _ < 2 ^ (N + 1) := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
    _ ≤ (2 ^ (N + 1)).factorial := Nat.self_le_factorial (2 ^ (N + 1))
    _ = goodHelperNat (n + 1) := (goodHelperNat_succ n).symm

name: goodHelperNat_gt_self
statement: theorem goodHelperNat_gt_self (n) : goodHelperNat n > n
proof:
:=
  calc n
  _ < n + goodHelperNat 0 := Nat.lt_succ_self n
  _ ≤ goodHelperNat n := goodHelperNat_strictMono.add_le_nat n 0

name: goodHelperNat_pos
statement: theorem goodHelperNat_pos (n) : goodHelperNat n > 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (goodHelperNat_gt_self n)

name: succ_lt_two_pow_goodHelperNat_succ
statement: theorem succ_lt_two_pow_goodHelperNat_succ (n) : n + 1 < 2 ^ (goodHelperNat n + 1)
proof:
:=
  calc n + 1
  _ < goodHelperNat n + 1 := Nat.succ_lt_succ (goodHelperNat_gt_self n)
  _ < 2 ^ (goodHelperNat n + 1) := Nat.lt_two_pow_self

name: goodFnNat_spec
statement: theorem goodFnNat_spec (n) : goodFnNat n + (n + 1) = 2 ^ (goodHelperNat n + 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.sub_add_cancel (succ_lt_two_pow_goodHelperNat_succ n).le

name: goodFnNat_pos
statement: theorem goodFnNat_pos (n) : goodFnNat n > 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (succ_lt_two_pow_goodHelperNat_succ n)

name: goodFnNat_add_self_mod_four_eq_three
statement: theorem goodFnNat_add_self_mod_four_eq_three (n) : (goodFnNat n + n) % 4 = 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : 4 ∣ 2 ^ (goodHelperNat n + 1) :=
    Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (Nat.succ_le_succ (goodHelperNat_pos n))
  rw [← Nat.add_mod_right, ← Nat.add_assoc _ 1 3, Nat.add_assoc _ n,
    goodFnNat_spec, hk, Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left]

name: not_four_dvd_gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add
statement:
theorem not_four_dvd_gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add (m n) :
    ¬4 ∣ (goodFnNat m + n).gcd (goodFnNat n + m)
proof:
:= by
  
  intro h
  replace h : 4 ∣ (goodFnNat m + n) + (goodFnNat n + m) :=
    h.trans (Nat.dvd_add (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _) (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))
  
  rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_comm _ m, Nat.add_add_add_comm,
    Nat.add_comm n, Nat.add_mod, goodFnNat_add_self_mod_four_eq_three,
    goodFnNat_add_self_mod_four_eq_three] at h
  exact Nat.succ_ne_zero 1 h

name: odd_dvd_gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add_imp
statement:
theorem odd_dvd_gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add_imp (h : m ≠ n) (ht : Odd t)
    (h0 : t ∣ (goodFnNat m + n).gcd (goodFnNat n + m)) : t = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  wlog h1 : m > n
  · exact this h.symm ht (Nat.gcd_comm _ _ ▸ h0) ((Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne h).resolve_right h1)
  
  replace h : t ∣ goodFnNat n + m := h0.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
  
  replace h0 : 2 ^ (goodHelperNat m + 1) + 2 ^ (goodHelperNat n + 1) ≡ 2 [MOD t] := calc
    _ = (goodFnNat m + m + 1) + (goodFnNat n + n + 1) := by
      iterate 2 rw [Nat.add_assoc _ _ 1, goodFnNat_spec]
    _ = (goodFnNat m + n) + (goodFnNat n + m) + 2 := by
      rw [Nat.add_add_add_comm, Nat.add_comm _ n, Nat.add_add_add_comm _ m, Nat.add_comm m]
    _ ≡ 0 + 2 [MOD t] :=
      ((h0.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)).modEq_zero_nat.add h.modEq_zero_nat).add_right 2
  
  replace h : Nat.totient t ≤ 2 ^ (goodHelperNat (m - 1) + 1) := calc
    Nat.totient t ≤ t := Nat.totient_le t
    _ ≤ goodFnNat n + m := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.add_pos_left (goodFnNat_pos n) m) h
    _ = m - (n + 1) + 2 ^ (goodHelperNat n + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.add_comm, goodFnNat, ← Nat.sub_add_comm h1,
        ← Nat.add_sub_assoc (succ_lt_two_pow_goodHelperNat_succ n).le]
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (goodHelperNat (m - (n + 1) + n) + 1) := by
      have h2 : StrictMono (λ t ↦ 2 ^ (goodHelperNat t + 1)) :=
        (pow_right_strictMono₀ Nat.one_lt_two).comp
          (add_left_strictMono.comp goodHelperNat_strictMono)
      exact h2.add_le_nat _ _
    _ = 2 ^ (goodHelperNat (m - 1) + 1) := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_add_comm h1, Nat.succ_eq_one_add, Nat.add_sub_add_right]
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : Nat.totient t ∣ goodHelperNat m := calc
    Nat.totient t ∣ (2 ^ (goodHelperNat (m - 1) + 1)).factorial :=
      Nat.dvd_factorial (Nat.totient_pos.mpr ht.pos) h
    _ = goodHelperNat (m - 1 + 1) := (goodHelperNat_succ _).symm
    _ = goodHelperNat m := by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_of_lt h1)]
  
  replace ht : Nat.Coprime 2 t := Nat.coprime_two_left.mpr ht
  
  replace h : 2 ^ (goodHelperNat m + 1) ≡ 2 [MOD t] := by
    rw [hK, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm _ K, Nat.pow_mul]
    exact (Nat.ModEq.pow_totient (ht.pow_left _)).mul_right 2
  
  replace h0 : t ∣ 2 ^ (goodHelperNat n + 1) :=
    Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (h.add_left_cancel h0)
  
  exact (ht.symm.pow_right _).eq_one_of_dvd h0

name: gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add_eq_two_pow
statement:
theorem gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add_eq_two_pow (h : m ≠ n) :
    ∃ k, (goodFnNat m + n).gcd (goodFnNat n + m) = 2 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, t, ht, h1⟩ :
      ∃ k t, Odd t ∧ (goodFnNat m + n).gcd (goodFnNat n + m) = 2 ^ k * t :=
    Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd
      (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (Nat.add_pos_left (goodFnNat_pos m) n)).ne.symm
  obtain rfl : t = 1 :=
    odd_dvd_gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add_imp h ht ⟨2 ^ k, h1.trans (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩
  exact ⟨k, h1.trans (Nat.mul_one _)⟩

name: gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add_le_two
statement:
theorem gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add_le_two (h : m ≠ n) :
    (goodFnNat m + n).gcd (goodFnNat n + m) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, (goodFnNat m + n).gcd (goodFnNat n + m) = 2 ^ k :=
    gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add_eq_two_pow h
  replace h : ¬2 ^ 2 ∣ (goodFnNat m + n).gcd (goodFnNat n + m) :=
    not_four_dvd_gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add m n
  have h0 : 1 < 2 := Nat.one_lt_two
  rw [hk, Nat.pow_dvd_pow_iff_le_right h0, Nat.not_le, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at h
  exact hk.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le h0 h)

name: good_two_goodFn
statement: theorem good_two_goodFn : good 2 goodFn
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ h ↦ gcd_goodFnNat_cross_add_le_two (mt PNat.eq h)

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : (∃ f, good k f) ↔ k ≥ 2
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ ⟨f, hf⟩ ↦ one_lt_of_ne_one λ hk ↦ not_good_one f (hk ▸ hf),
  λ hk ↦ ⟨goodFn, good_two_goodFn.of_ge hk⟩⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {f : Int → Int} :
    (∀ x y, f (x - f y) = f (f x) - f y - 1) ↔ (f = λ _ ↦ -1) ∨ f = (· + 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ hf x y ↦ ?_, λ hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases hf with rfl | rfl
    · rfl
    · dsimp only; rw [← Int.sub_sub, Int.sub_add_cancel, Int.sub_sub, Int.add_assoc,
        Int.add_assoc, y.add_comm (1 + 1), ← Int.sub_sub, Int.add_sub_cancel]
  
  have h : f (-f (f 0)) = -1 := by
    simpa only [Int.sub_self, Int.zero_sub] using hf 0 (f 0)
  
  have h0 (x) : f (x + 1) = f (f x) := by
    simpa only [Int.sub_neg, Int.add_sub_cancel, h] using hf x (-f (f 0))
  
  replace hf : ∀ n, f n = (f (-1) + 1) * n + f 0 := by
    refine Extra.LinearSolver.IntInt λ n ↦ ?_
    suffices f (n + 1) - f n - 1 = f (-1) by simpa only [Int.sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
    calc f (n + 1) - f n - 1
      _ = f (n - f n) := by rw [h0, hf]
      _ = f (f (n - f n - 1)) := by rw [← h0, Int.sub_add_cancel]
      _ = f (f (n - 1 - f n)) := by rw [Int.sub_sub, Int.sub_sub, Int.add_comm]
      _ = f (-1) := by rw [hf, ← h0, Int.sub_add_cancel, Int.sub_self, Int.zero_sub]
  
  refine (Decidable.em (f (-1) + 1 = 0)).imp
    (λ h1 ↦ funext λ x ↦ ?_) (λ h1 ↦ funext λ x ↦ ?_)
  
  · simp only [h1, Int.zero_mul, Int.zero_add] at hf
    rw [hf, ← h, hf (-f _)]
  
  · replace h0 : f (x + 1) = f (f x) := h0 x
    rwa [hf, hf (f x), Int.add_left_inj, Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff h1, eq_comm] at h0

name: id_is_good
statement: theorem id_is_good : good (id : R → R)
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ ↦ rfl

name: two_sub_is_good
statement: theorem two_sub_is_good : good (λ x : R ↦ 2 - x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  have h : x + (2 - (x + y)) = 2 - y := by rw [← add_sub_assoc, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
  calc 2 - (x + (2 - (x + y))) + (2 - x * y)
    _ = y + 2 - x * y := by rw [h, sub_sub_cancel, add_sub_assoc]
    _ = 2 * y + (2 - y) - x * y := by rw [two_mul, add_add_sub_cancel]
    _ = 2 - y + (2 - x) * y := by rw [add_sub_assoc, add_sub_left_comm, sub_mul]
    _ = x + (2 - (x + y)) + (2 - x) * y := by rw [h]

name: map_add_map_add_one_fixed
statement:
theorem map_add_map_add_one_fixed {f : R → R} (hf : good f) (x) :
    f (x + f (x + 1)) = x + f (x + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf x 1
  rwa [mul_one, mul_one, add_left_inj] at h

name: map_map_add_map_zero
statement:
theorem map_map_add_map_zero {f : R → R} (hf : good f) (y) :
    f (f y) + f 0 = f y + f 0 * y
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf 0 y
  rwa [zero_add, zero_add, zero_mul] at h

name: fixed_point_formula
statement:
theorem fixed_point_formula {f : R → R} (hf : good f) (hy : f y = y) :
    f 0 * (1 - y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf.map_map_add_map_zero y
  rwa [hy, hy, add_right_inj, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_one_sub] at h

name: fixed_point_eq_one
statement: theorem fixed_point_eq_one (hy : f y = y) : y = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : f 0 * (1 - y) = 0 := hf.fixed_point_formula hy
  rwa [mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right hf0, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at h

name: eq_two_sub_of_map_zero_ne_zero
statement: theorem eq_two_sub_of_map_zero_ne_zero : f = (λ x ↦ 2 - x)
proof:
:= by
  
  funext x
  have h : x - 1 + f (x - 1 + 1) = 1 :=
    hf.fixed_point_eq_one hf0 (hf.map_add_map_add_one_fixed _)
  rwa [sub_add_cancel, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq', sub_sub_eq_add_sub, one_add_one_eq_two] at h

name: neg_one_fixed_of_zero_fixed
statement:
theorem neg_one_fixed_of_zero_fixed {f : R → R} (hf : good f) (hf0 : f 0 = 0) :
    f (-1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h : f (-1 + f (-1 + 1)) = -1 + f (-1 + 1) := hf.map_add_map_add_one_fixed (-1)
  rwa [neg_add_cancel, hf0, add_zero] at h

name: map_one_of_twoNZD_map_zero
statement:
theorem map_one_of_twoNZD_map_zero (hR : ∀ x y : R, 2 * x = 2 * y → x = y)
    {f : R → R} (hf : good f) (hf0 : f 0 = 0) : f 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf 1 (-1)
  rw [add_neg_cancel, hf0, add_zero, one_mul, hf.neg_one_fixed_of_zero_fixed hf0,
    mul_neg_one, add_neg_eq_iff_eq_add, add_right_comm, eq_add_neg_iff_add_eq,
    ← two_mul, ← two_mul] at h
  exact hR _ _ h

name: map_self_add_map_self
statement: theorem map_self_add_map_self (x) : f (x + f x) + f 0 = x + f x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [add_zero, mul_zero] using hf x 0

name: map_one_add_map_add_one_of_map_one
statement:
theorem map_one_add_map_add_one_of_map_one (hf1 : f 1 = 1) (y) :
    f (1 + f (y + 1)) + f y = 1 + f (y + 1) + y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [add_comm y 1, one_mul, hf1] using hf 1 y

name: fixed_pt_add_two_of_map_one
statement:
theorem fixed_pt_add_two_of_map_one
    (hf1 : f 1 = 1) (hy : f y = y) (hy1 : f (y + 1) = y + 1) :
    f (y + 2) = y + 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : f (1 + f (y + 1)) + f y = 1 + f (y + 1) + y :=
    hf.map_one_add_map_add_one_of_map_one hf1 y
  rwa [hy1, hy, add_left_inj, add_left_comm, one_add_one_eq_two] at h

name: map_neg_of_map_zero_map_one
statement:
theorem map_neg_of_map_zero_map_one (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (hf1 : f 1 = 1) (x) :
    f (-x) = -f x
proof:
:= by
  
  have h : f (x + f (x - 1) - (1 + 1)) = x + f (x - 1) - (1 + 1) := by
    have h := hf.map_add_map_add_one_fixed (x - 1 - 1)
    rwa [sub_add_cancel, sub_sub, ← add_sub_right_comm] at h
  
  have h0 : f (x + f (x - 1) - (1 + 1) + 1) = x + f (x - 1) - (1 + 1) + 1 := by
    rw [← sub_sub, sub_add_cancel, add_sub_right_comm,
      eq_sub_of_add_eq (hf.map_self_add_map_self _), hf0, sub_zero]
  
  replace h : f (x + f (x - 1)) = x + f (x - 1) := by
    have h1 := hf.fixed_pt_add_two_of_map_one hf1 h h0
    rwa [one_add_one_eq_two, sub_add_cancel] at h1
  
  replace h0 : f (x + f (x + -1)) + f (x * -1) = x + f (x + -1) + f x * -1 := hf x (-1)
  rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg, h, add_right_inj, mul_neg_one, mul_neg_one] at h0

name: two_mul_map_of_map_zero_eq_zero
statement:
theorem two_mul_map_of_map_zero_eq_zero (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (hf1 : f 1 = 1) (y) :
    2 * f y = 2 * y
proof:
:= by
  
  have hf2 (x) : f (-x) = -f x := hf.map_neg_of_map_zero_map_one hf0 hf1 x
  
  have h : f (1 + f (y + 1)) + f y = 1 + f (y + 1) + y :=
    hf.map_one_add_map_add_one_of_map_one hf1 y
  
  have h0 : -f (1 + f (y + 1)) + f y = -(1 + f (y + 1)) + y := by
    have h0 := hf (-1) (-y)
    rwa [← neg_add_rev, hf2, ← neg_add, hf2, hf2, hf1, neg_mul_neg, one_mul] at h0
  
  replace h : _ + _ = _ + _ := congrArg₂ (· + ·) h h0
  iterate 2 rw [← add_assoc, add_neg_cancel_comm, ← two_mul] at h
  exact h

name: eq_id_of_map_zero_eq_zero2
statement:
theorem eq_id_of_map_zero_eq_zero2 (hR : ∀ x y : R, 2 * x = 2 * y → x = y)
    {f : R → R} (hf : good f) (hf0 : f 0 = 0) : f = id
proof:
:=
  funext λ y ↦ hR _ _
    (hf.two_mul_map_of_map_zero_eq_zero hf0 (map_one_of_twoNZD_map_zero hR hf hf0) y)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [DecidableEq R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (hR : (2 : R) ≠ 0) {f : R → R} :
    good f ↔ f = (λ x ↦ 2 - x) ∨ f = id
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hf ↦ ?_, λ hf ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · refine (Decidable.em (f 0 = 0)).symm.imp hf.eq_two_sub_of_map_zero_ne_zero
      (hf.eq_id_of_map_zero_eq_zero2 λ x y h ↦ ?_)
    
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h.resolve_left hR
  
  · rcases hf with rfl | rfl
    exacts [two_sub_is_good, id_is_good]

name: main_claim
statement: theorem main_claim (h : 2 * c ∣ m - 3) (h0 : 2 * c ∣ f m - 3) : 2 * (2 * c) ∣ m - 3
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | hc : c = 0 ∨ c ≠ 0 := Decidable.em _
  · exact h
  
  rcases h with ⟨d, hd⟩
  obtain rfl : m = 2 * c * d + 3 := Int.sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd
  
  replace h : f (2 * c * d + 3) = (2 * c * d + 3) * (c * d + 1) := by
    refine congrArg ((2 * c * d + 3) * ·) ?_
    calc (2 * c * d + (2 + 1)) / 2
      _ = (2 * (c * d + 1) + 1) / 2 := by
        rw [Int.mul_add, Int.add_assoc, Int.mul_one, Int.mul_assoc]
      _ = c * d + 1 + 0 := Int.mul_add_ediv_left _ _ (by decide)
      _ = c * d + 1 := Int.add_zero _
  
  replace hd : c * 2 ∣ c * ((2 + 1) * d) := by
    rwa [h, Int.add_mul, Int.mul_assoc, Int.add_sub_assoc, Int.dvd_self_mul_add,
      Int.mul_add, Int.mul_one, Int.add_sub_cancel, Int.mul_left_comm, Int.mul_comm] at h0
  replace hd : 2 ∣ d := by
    rwa [Int.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hc, Int.add_mul, Int.one_mul, Int.dvd_self_mul_add] at hd
  
  rw [Int.add_sub_cancel, Int.mul_comm]
  exact Int.mul_dvd_mul_left _ hd

name: f_iterate_odd_iff
statement: theorem f_iterate_odd_iff : (∀ k : ℕ, ¬2 ∣ f^[k] M) ↔ M = 3
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨?_, λ hM ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro rfl k
    rw [Function.iterate_fixed (rfl : f 3 = 3)]
    decide
  
  replace hM (k) : 2 ∣ f^[k] M - 3 := by
    obtain hk | hk : f^[k] M % 2 = 0 ∨ f^[k] M % 2 = 1 := Int.emod_two_eq _
    · exact absurd (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero hk) (hM k)
    · calc (2 : Int)
      _ ∣ f^[k] M - 1 + 2 * (-1) :=
        Int.dvd_add_self_mul.mpr (Int.dvd_self_sub_of_emod_eq hk)
      _ = f^[k] M - 3 := by rw [Int.mul_neg, ← Int.sub_eq_add_neg, Int.sub_sub]; rfl
  
  replace hM (n k) : 2 ^ (n + 1) ∣ f^[k] M - 3 := by
    induction n generalizing k with | zero => exact hM k | succ n n_ih => ?_
    replace n_ih (k) : 2 * 2 ^ n ∣ f^[k] M - 3 := Int.pow_succ' _ _ ▸ n_ih k
    rw [Int.pow_succ', Int.pow_succ']
    exact main_claim (n_ih k) (f.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ ▸ n_ih _)
  
  replace hM : 2 ^ ((M - 3).natAbs + 1) ∣ M - 3 := hM _ 0
  exact Int.eq_of_sub_eq_zero (Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs hM
    (Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self _) Nat.lt_two_pow_self))

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : (∃ k : ℕ, 2 ∣ f^[k] M) ↔ M ≠ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_not_comm, not_exists, f_iterate_odd_iff]

name: Pi_posPart_mul_inf
statement: lemma Pi_posPart_mul_inf : f⁺ * (g₁ ⊓ g₂) = f⁺ * g₁ ⊓ f⁺ * g₂
proof:
:=
  funext λ i ↦ mul_min_of_nonneg (g₁ i) (g₂ i) (posPart_nonneg f i)

name: Pi_posPart_mul_sup
statement: lemma Pi_posPart_mul_sup : f⁺ * (g₁ ⊔ g₂) = f⁺ * g₁ ⊔ f⁺ * g₂
proof:
:=
  funext λ i ↦ mul_max_of_nonneg (g₁ i) (g₂ i) (posPart_nonneg f i)

name: Pi_inf_mul_posPart
statement: lemma Pi_inf_mul_posPart : (g₁ ⊓ g₂) * f⁺ = g₁ * f⁺ ⊓ g₂ * f⁺
proof:
:=
  funext λ i ↦ min_mul_of_nonneg (g₁ i) (g₂ i) (posPart_nonneg f i)

name: Pi_sup_mul_posPart
statement: lemma Pi_sup_mul_posPart : (g₁ ⊔ g₂) * f⁺ = g₁ * f⁺ ⊔ g₂ * f⁺
proof:
:=
  funext λ i ↦ max_mul_of_nonneg (g₁ i) (g₂ i) (posPart_nonneg f i)

name: InfClosure_imp_MetaClosure
statement: lemma InfClosure_imp_MetaClosure (ha : BinOpClosure Min.min P a) : MetaClosure P a
proof:
:= by
  induction ha with
  | ofMem a ha => exact MetaClosure.ofMem a ha
  | ofOp a b _ _ ha hb => exact MetaClosure.ofMin a b ha hb

name: SupInfClosure_imp_MetaClosure
statement:
lemma SupInfClosure_imp_MetaClosure
    (ha : BinOpClosure Max.max (BinOpClosure Min.min P) a) : MetaClosure P a
proof:
:= by
  induction ha with
  | ofMem a ha => exact InfClosure_imp_MetaClosure P ha
  | ofOp a b _ _ ha hb => exact MetaClosure.ofMax a b ha hb

name: MetaClosure_imp_SupInfClosure
statement:
lemma MetaClosure_imp_SupInfClosure (ha : MetaClosure P a) :
    BinOpClosure Max.max (BinOpClosure Min.min P) a
proof:
:= by
  induction ha with
    | ofMem a ha => exact ofMem a (ofMem a ha)
    | ofMin a b ha' hb' ha hb => ?_
    | ofMax a b ha' hb' ha hb => exact ofOp a b ha hb
  clear ha' hb'
  induction ha with
    | ofMem c hc => ?_
    | ofOp c d _ _ hc hd => rw [inf_sup_right]; exact ofOp _ _ hc hd
  induction hb with
    | ofMem d hd => exact ofMem (c ⊓ d) (ofOp c d hc hd)
    | ofOp d e _ _ hd he => rw [inf_sup_left]; exact ofOp _ _ hd he

name: SupInfClosure_eq_MetaClosure
statement:
theorem SupInfClosure_eq_MetaClosure :
    BinOpClosure Max.max (BinOpClosure Min.min P) = MetaClosure P
proof:
:=
  funext λ _ ↦ propext ⟨SupInfClosure_imp_MetaClosure P, MetaClosure_imp_SupInfClosure P⟩

name: zero_mem
statement: lemma zero_mem : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) 0
proof:
:=
  ofMem 0 S.zero_mem

name: posPart_mem
statement: lemma posPart_mem (ha : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) a) : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) a⁺
proof:
:=
  ofMax a 0 ha (zero_mem S)

name: add_mem
statement:
lemma add_mem (ha : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) a) (hb : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) b) :
    MetaClosure (· ∈ S) (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  induction ha with
    | ofMem a ha => ?_
    | ofMin a c _ _ ha hc => rw [inf_add]; exact ofMin _ _ ha hc
    | ofMax a c _ _ ha hc => rw [sup_add]; exact ofMax _ _ ha hc
  induction hb with
    | ofMem b hb => exact ofMem (a + b) (S.add_mem ha hb)
    | ofMin b c _ _ hb hc => rw [add_inf]; exact ofMin _ _ hb hc
    | ofMax b c _ _ hb hc => rw [add_sup]; exact ofMax _ _ hb hc

name: neg_mem
statement: lemma neg_mem (ha : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) a) : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) (-a)
proof:
:= by
  induction ha with
  | ofMem a ha => exact ofMem (-a) (S.neg_mem ha)
  | ofMin a b _ _ ha hb => rw [neg_inf]; exact ofMax _ _ ha hb
  | ofMax a b _ _ ha hb => rw [neg_sup]; exact ofMin _ _ ha hb

name: sub_mem
statement:
lemma sub_mem (ha : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) a) (hb : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) b) :
    MetaClosure (· ∈ S) (a - b)
proof:
:=
  (sub_eq_add_neg a b) ▸ add_mem S ha (neg_mem S hb)

name: posPart_mul_posPart_main_formula
statement:
lemma posPart_mul_posPart_main_formula
    [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] (a b : R) :
    a⁺ * b⁺ = (min (a * b) (min (max a (a * b ^ 2)) (max b (a ^ 2 * b))))⁺
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ha | ha : a ≤ 0 ∨ a ≥ 0 := le_total a 0
  · rw [posPart_eq_zero.mpr ha, zero_mul, eq_comm, posPart_eq_zero, min_le_iff, min_le_iff]
    right; left; exact max_le ha (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ha (sq_nonneg b))
  
  obtain hb | hb : b ≤ 0 ∨ b ≥ 0 := le_total b 0
  · rw [posPart_eq_zero.mpr hb, mul_zero, eq_comm, posPart_eq_zero]
    exact min_le_of_left_le (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha hb)
  
  calc a⁺ * b⁺
    _ = a * b := by rw [posPart_of_nonneg ha, posPart_of_nonneg hb]
    _ = (a * b)⁺ := (posPart_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hb)).symm
    _ = (min (a * b) (min (max a (a * b ^ 2)) (max b (a ^ 2 * b))))⁺ :=
      congrArg _ (min_eq_left ?_).symm
  
  have X (t : R) : t ≤ max 1 (t ^ 2) :=
    (le_total t 1).elim le_max_of_le_left λ ht ↦
      le_max_of_le_right (Bound.le_self_pow_of_pos ht Nat.two_pos)
  have h : a * b ≤ max a (a * b ^ 2) := calc
    a * b ≤ a * max 1 (b ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (X b) ha
    _ = max a (a * b ^ 2) := by rw [mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ ha, mul_one]
  have h0 : a * b ≤ max b (a ^ 2 * b) := calc
    a * b ≤ max 1 (a ^ 2) * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (X a) hb
    _ = max b (a ^ 2 * b) := by rw [max_mul_of_nonneg _ _ hb, one_mul]
  exact le_min h h0

name: Pi_one_mem
statement: lemma Pi_one_mem : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) 1
proof:
:=
  ofMem 1 S.one_mem

name: Pi_posPart_mul_posPart_main_formula
statement:
lemma Pi_posPart_mul_posPart_main_formula (f g : (i : I) → R i) :
    f⁺ * g⁺ = ((f * g) ⊓ ((f ⊔ f * g ^ 2) ⊓ (g ⊔ f ^ 2 * g)))⁺
proof:
:=
  funext λ i ↦ posPart_mul_posPart_main_formula (f i) (g i)

name: Pi_posPart_mul_posPart_mem
statement:
theorem Pi_posPart_mul_posPart_mem (hf : f ∈ S) (hg : g ∈ S) :
    MetaClosure (· ∈ S) (f⁺ * g⁺)
proof:
:=
  (Pi_posPart_mul_posPart_main_formula f g).symm ▸
    posPart_mem S.toAddSubgroup <| ofMin _ _ (ofMem _ (S.mul_mem hf hg)) <| ofMin _ _
      (ofMax _ _ (ofMem _ hf) (ofMem _ <| S.mul_mem hf (S.pow_mem hg 2)))
      (ofMax _ _ (ofMem _ hg) (ofMem _ <| S.mul_mem (S.pow_mem hf 2) hg))

name: Pi_closure_posPart_mul_closure_posPart_mem
statement:
theorem Pi_closure_posPart_mul_closure_posPart_mem
    (hf : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) f) (hg : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) g) :
    MetaClosure (· ∈ S) (f⁺ * g⁺)
proof:
:= by
  induction hg with
    | ofMem g hg => ?_
    | ofMin g₁ g₂ _ _ hg₁ hg₂ =>
        rw [posPart_min, Pi_posPart_mul_inf]; exact ofMin _ _ hg₁ hg₂
    | ofMax g₁ g₂ _ _ hg₁ hg₂ =>
        rw [posPart_max, Pi_posPart_mul_sup]; exact ofMax _ _ hg₁ hg₂
  induction hf with
    | ofMem f hf => exact Pi_posPart_mul_posPart_mem S hf hg
    | ofMin f₁ f₂ _ _ hf₁ hf₂ =>
        rw [posPart_min, Pi_inf_mul_posPart]; exact ofMin _ _ hf₁ hf₂
    | ofMax f₁ f₂ _ _ hf₁ hf₂ =>
        rw [posPart_max, Pi_sup_mul_posPart]; exact ofMax _ _ hf₁ hf₂

name: Pi_mul_mem
statement:
theorem Pi_mul_mem (hf : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) f) (hg : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) g) :
    MetaClosure (· ∈ S) (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← posPart_sub_negPart f, sub_mul, ← posPart_sub_negPart g, mul_sub, mul_sub]
  let T := S.toAddSubgroup
  have hf₀ : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) (-f) := neg_mem T hf
  have hg₀ : MetaClosure (· ∈ S) (-g) := neg_mem T hg
  apply sub_mem T <;> apply sub_mem T <;> apply Pi_closure_posPart_mul_closure_posPart_mem
  all_goals assumption

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (σ R) [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] :
    ∃ T : Subring ((σ → R) → R), T.carrier =
      Set.ofPred (BinOpClosure Max.max (BinOpClosure Min.min (· ∈ MvPolynomial_image σ R)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨PiSubring_mk (MvPolynomial_image σ R),
  congrArg Set.ofPred (SupInfClosure_eq_MetaClosure _).symm⟩

name: prime_not_dvd_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem prime_not_dvd_ascFactorial (hp : Nat.Prime p) (k : ℕ) (hr : r < p) :
    ¬p ∣ (p * k + 1).ascFactorial r
proof:
:= by
  
  induction r with | zero => exact hp.not_dvd_one | succ r r_ih => ?_
  refine hp.not_dvd_mul ?_ (r_ih (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hr))
  rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.dvd_add_right ⟨k, rfl⟩]
  exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.succ_pos r) hr

name: prime_choose_not_dvd
statement:
theorem prime_choose_not_dvd (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ¬(p * k) ∣ (p * k).choose p
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 : p * k.pred + p = p * k := by rw [← Nat.mul_succ, Nat.succ_pred hk]
  replace h : p * (p * k) ∣ (p * k.pred + 1).ascFactorial (p - 1) * (p * k) := calc
    _ ∣ p.factorial * (p * k).choose p :=
      Nat.mul_dvd_mul (Nat.dvd_factorial hp.pos (Nat.le_refl p)) h
    _ = p.factorial * (p * k.pred + p).choose p := by rw [h0]
    _ = (p * k.pred + 1).ascFactorial (p - 1 + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.ascFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose, Nat.sub_add_cancel hp.one_le]
    _ = (p * k.pred + 1).ascFactorial (p - 1) * (p * k) := by
      rw [Nat.ascFactorial_succ, Nat.add_assoc,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel' hp.one_le, h0, Nat.mul_comm]
  replace h : p ∣ (p * k.pred + 1).ascFactorial (p - 1) :=
    Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_right (Nat.mul_pos hp.pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk)) h
  exact prime_not_dvd_ascFactorial hp k.pred (Nat.pred_lt hp.ne_zero) h

name: prime_is_good
statement: theorem prime_is_good (hp : Nat.Prime p) : good p
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩ : p = 2 ∨ Odd p := hp.eq_two_or_odd'
  · intro n hn
    obtain rfl | rfl : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 := Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hn
    all_goals exact Nat.dvd_refl _
  
  intro n hnk
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ n > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n
  · exact Nat.dvd_refl 0
  
  replace hnk : n ≤ k := by rwa [Nat.mul_add_div Nat.two_pos] at hnk
  replace hnk : 2 * n ≤ 2 * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hnk
  
  have h : n ∣ n.choose (2 * k + 1 - 2 * n) * (2 * k + 1 - 2 * n) := by
    refine ⟨n.pred.choose (2 * k - 2 * n), ?_⟩
    replace hn : n.pred.succ = n := Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hn
    calc n.choose (2 * k + 1 - 2 * n) * (2 * k + 1 - 2 * n)
      _ = n.pred.succ.choose (2 * k - 2 * n + 1) * (2 * k - 2 * n + 1) := by
        rw [hn, Nat.sub_add_comm hnk]
      _ = n * n.pred.choose (2 * k - 2 * n) := by
        rw [← Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq, ← Nat.succ_eq_add_one, hn]
  
  have h0 : Nat.Coprime (2 * k + 1 - 2 * n) n := by
    replace hnk : 2 * n ≤ 2 * k + 1 := hnk.trans (Nat.le_succ _)
    have hnk0 : n < 2 * k + 1 := calc
      n < 2 * n := (Nat.lt_mul_iff_one_lt_left hn).mpr Nat.one_lt_two
      _ ≤ 2 * k + 1 := hnk
    rw [← Nat.coprime_add_mul_right_left _ _ 2,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel hnk, hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd]
    exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt hn hnk0
  
  exact h0.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right h

name: good_two_mul_imp
statement: theorem good_two_mul_imp (hk : good (2 * k)) : k = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  specialize hk k (Nat.mul_div_right k Nat.two_pos).ge
  rwa [Nat.sub_self, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.dvd_one] at hk

name: good_prime_mul_odd_imp
statement:
theorem good_prime_mul_odd_imp (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hpk : good (p * (2 * k + 1))) :
    k = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  by_contra hk
  
  specialize hpk (p * k) ?_
  · calc p * k
      _ = p * ((2 * k + 1) / 2) := by rw [Nat.mul_add_div Nat.two_pos]; rfl
      _ ≤ p * (2 * k + 1) / 2 := Nat.mul_div_le_mul_div_assoc _ _ _
  
  replace hpk : p * k ∣ (p * k).choose p := by
    rwa [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at hpk
  
  exact prime_choose_not_dvd hp hk hpk

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (hm : 1 < m) : good m ↔ Nat.Prime m
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨λ hm0 ↦ ?_, prime_is_good⟩
  
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ | hm1 : 2 ∣ m ∨ ¬2 ∣ m := dec_em _
  · obtain rfl : k = 1 := good_two_mul_imp hm0
    exact Nat.prime_two
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, l, rfl⟩ : ∃ p, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ m :=
    Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hm.ne.symm
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, l = 2 * k + 1 := by
    rw [← even_iff_two_dvd, Nat.not_even_iff_odd, Nat.odd_mul] at hm1
    exact hm1.2
  
  obtain rfl : k = 0 := good_prime_mul_odd_imp hp hm0
  rwa [Nat.mul_one]

name: perm231
statement: theorem perm231 : HeronTriple b c a
proof:
:= by
  rw [HeronTriple, ← add_rotate, h, add_rotate]

name: perm312

proof:

  h.perm231.perm231

name: perm213

proof:
:= by
  rw [HeronTriple, add_comm (b ^ 2), h, add_right_comm, mul_comm a, mul_comm c, mul_comm b c]

name: perm321

proof:
:=
  h.perm231.perm213

name: perm132
statement: theorem perm132 : HeronTriple a c b

name: mul_left
statement: theorem mul_left (r : R) : HeronTriple (r * a) (r * b) (r * c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HeronTriple
  iterate 3 rw [mul_pow, mul_mul_mul_comm r _ r]
  iterate 4 rw [← mul_add]
  rw [h, mul_left_comm, sq]

name: RingHom_apply
statement: theorem RingHom_apply [CommSemiring R₀] (φ : R →+* R₀) : HeronTriple (φ a) (φ b) (φ c)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [HeronTriple, ← φ.map_pow, ← φ.map_mul, ← φ.map_add]
  rw [h, φ.map_mul, map_ofNat]

name: alt_def
statement: theorem alt_def {a b c : R} : HeronTriple a b c ↔ (c - (a + b)) ^ 2 = 2 ^ 2 * a * b
proof:
:=
  calc a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a)
  _ ↔ c ^ 2 + (a + b) ^ 2 = 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) + 2 * a * b := by
    rw [add_sq', add_left_comm, ← add_assoc, add_left_inj]
  _ ↔ c ^ 2 + (a + b) ^ 2 = (2 + 2) * (a * b) + 2 * (c * (a + b)) := by
    apply Eq.congr_right; rw [add_assoc, mul_comm b, ← mul_add c,
      mul_add, add_comm b, add_right_comm, mul_assoc, ← add_mul]
  _ ↔ (c - (a + b)) ^ 2 = 2 ^ 2 * a * b := by
    rw [← two_mul, ← sq, sub_sq', sub_eq_iff_eq_add, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]

name: squares_of_add_eq_zero
statement:
theorem squares_of_add_eq_zero {a b c : R} (h : a + b + c = 0) :
    HeronTriple (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2) (c ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h, neg_sq, alt_def,
    add_sq', add_sub_cancel_left, mul_pow, mul_pow]

name: eq_zero_of_const
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_const (hR : (3 : R) ≠ 0) {c : R} (hc : HeronTriple c c c) : c = 0
proof:
:= by
  rwa [HeronTriple, sq, two_mul, right_eq_add, ← two_mul, ← add_one_mul,
    mul_eq_zero, two_add_one_eq_three, or_iff_right hR, mul_self_eq_zero] at hc

name: iff_eq_of_zero_right
statement: theorem iff_eq_of_zero_right {x y : R} : HeronTriple x y 0 ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [HeronTriple, sq 0, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_mul,
    add_zero, ← mul_assoc, ← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_sq', sq_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero]

name: iff_eq_mul_add_or_sub_sq
statement:
theorem iff_eq_mul_add_or_sub_sq {r x y z : R} :
    HeronTriple (r * x ^ 2) (r * y ^ 2) z ↔ z = r * (x + y) ^ 2 ∨ z = r * (x - y) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [alt_def, ← mul_add, mul_assoc, mul_mul_mul_comm, ← sq, ← mul_pow,
    ← mul_pow, ← mul_pow, mul_left_comm, ← mul_assoc,sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg]
  apply or_congr
  · rw [add_sq', sub_eq_iff_eq_add', mul_assoc, ← mul_add, mul_assoc]
  · rw [sub_sq', sub_eq_iff_eq_add', mul_assoc, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← mul_sub, mul_assoc]

name: iff_of_left_mid_eq
statement: theorem iff_of_left_mid_eq {r z : R} : HeronTriple r r z ↔ z = r * 2 ^ 2 ∨ z = 0
proof:
:= calc
  _ ↔ HeronTriple (r * 1 ^ 2) (r * 1 ^ 2) z := by rw [one_pow, mul_one]
  _ ↔ z = r * (1 + 1) ^ 2 ∨ z = r * (1 - 1) ^ 2 := iff_eq_mul_add_or_sub_sq
  _ ↔ z = r * 2 ^ 2 ∨ z = 0 := by
    rw [one_add_one_eq_two, sub_self, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), mul_zero]

name: sq_is_good
statement: theorem sq_is_good [CommRing R] : good (λ r : R ↦ r ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ _ ↦ squares_of_add_eq_zero

statement:
theorem smul_left [AddZero G] [CommSemiring R]
    {f : G → R} (hf : good f) (r : R) : good (r • f)

:=
  λ a b c h ↦ (hf a b c h).mul_left r

name: comp_AddMonoidHom
statement:
theorem comp_AddMonoidHom [AddZero G₀] [AddZero G] [CommSemiring R]
    {f : G → R} (hf : good f) (φ : G₀ →+ G) : good (f ∘ φ)
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ _ h ↦ hf _ _ _ (by rw [← φ.map_add, ← φ.map_add, h, φ.map_zero])

name: RingHom_comp
statement:
theorem RingHom_comp [AddZero G] [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring R₀]
    {f : G → R} (hf : good f) (φ : R →+* R₀) : good (φ ∘ f)
proof:
:=

name: ZMod2_Semiring_is_good
statement: theorem ZMod2_Semiring_is_good [CommSemiring R] : good (![0, 1] : ZMod 2 → R)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : ℕ →+* R := Nat.castRingHom R
  have h : φ ∘ ![0, 1] = ![0, 1] :=
    funext λ x ↦ match x with | 0 => φ.map_zero | 1 => φ.map_one
  simpa only [h] using ZMod2_01_is_good.RingHom_comp φ

name: ZMod4_Semiring_is_good
statement: theorem ZMod4_Semiring_is_good [CommSemiring R] : good (![0, 1, 4, 1] : ZMod 4 → R)

  have h : φ ∘ ![0, 1, 4, 1] = ![0, 1, 4, 1] :=
    funext λ x ↦ match x with
      | 0 => φ.map_zero | 1 => φ.map_one | 2 => map_ofNat φ 4 | 3 => φ.map_one
  simpa only [h] using ZMod4_0141_is_good.RingHom_comp φ

name: map_zero_of_three_ne_zero
statement: theorem map_zero_of_three_ne_zero (hR : (3 : R) ≠ 0) {f : G → R} (hf : good f) : f 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  (hf 0 0 0 ((add_zero _).trans (add_zero _))).eq_zero_of_const hR

name: map_neg_of_map_zero
statement: theorem map_neg_of_map_zero (x) : f (-x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  have h : HeronTriple (f (-x)) (f x) (f 0) :=
    hf (-x) x 0 ((add_zero _).trans (neg_add_cancel x))
  rwa [hf0, iff_eq_of_zero_right] at h

name: def_of_map_zero
statement: theorem def_of_map_zero (x y : G) : HeronTriple (f x) (f y) (f (x + y))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hf.map_neg_of_map_zero hf0] using hf x y (-(x + y)) (add_neg_cancel _)

name: map_add_of_map_eq_zero
statement: theorem map_add_of_map_eq_zero {c : G} (hc : f c = 0) (x) : f (x + c) = f x
proof:
:= by
  have h : HeronTriple (f (x + c)) (f x) (f c) := (hf.def_of_map_zero hf0 x c).perm312
  rwa [hc, iff_eq_of_zero_right] at h

name: map_nsmul_of_map_eq_zero
statement: theorem map_nsmul_of_map_eq_zero {c : G} (hc : f c = 0) (n : ℤ) : f (n • c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [zero_zsmul, hf0]
  | succ n n_ih => rw [add_one_zsmul, hf.map_add_of_map_eq_zero hf0 hc, n_ih]
  | pred n n_ih =>
      replace hc : f (-c) = 0 := (hf.map_neg_of_map_zero hf0 c).trans hc
      rw [sub_one_zsmul, hf.map_add_of_map_eq_zero hf0 hc, n_ih]

name: Int_map_ZMod_of_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Int_map_ZMod_of_map_eq_zero {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : f N = 0) (n : ℤ) :
    f (n : ZMod N).val = f n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : (N : ℤ) ∣ n - (n : ZMod N).val := by
    rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd, Int.cast_sub, ZMod.natCast_val,
      ZMod.intCast_cast, ZMod.cast_intCast (Nat.dvd_refl _), sub_self]
  calc f (n : ZMod N).val
    _ = f ((n : ZMod N).val + k * N) :=
      (hf.map_add_of_map_eq_zero hf0 (hf.map_nsmul_of_map_eq_zero hf0 hN k) _).symm
    _ = f n := by rw [Int.mul_comm, ← hk, add_sub_cancel]

name: Int_map_two_eq
statement: theorem Int_map_two_eq : f 2 = f 1 * 2 ^ 2 ∨ f 2 = 0
proof:
:=
  iff_of_left_mid_eq.mp (hf.def_of_map_zero hf0 1 1)

name: Int_eq_smul_ZMod2_01_of_map_two
statement:
theorem Int_eq_smul_ZMod2_01_of_map_two (hf1 : f 2 = 0) :
    f = λ n : ℤ ↦ f 1 * ![0, 1] (n : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x : ZMod 2, f x.val = f 1 * ![0, 1] x
    | 0 => hf0.trans (mul_zero _).symm
    | 1 => (mul_one _).symm
  funext n; rw [← hf.Int_map_ZMod_of_map_eq_zero hf0 hf1 _, h]

name: Int_map_three_eq_of_map_two
statement:
theorem Int_map_three_eq_of_map_two (hf1 : f 2 = f 1 * 2 ^ 2) :
    f 3 = f 1 * 3 ^ 2 ∨ f 3 = f 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : HeronTriple (f 1 * 2 ^ 2) (f 1 * 1 ^ 2) (f 3) := by
    rw [one_pow, mul_one, ← hf1]; exact hf.def_of_map_zero hf0 2 1
  rwa [iff_eq_mul_add_or_sub_sq, two_add_one_eq_three,
    sub_eq_of_eq_add one_add_one_eq_two.symm, one_pow, mul_one] at h

name: Int_eq_smul_sq_of_map_three
statement:
theorem Int_eq_smul_sq_of_map_three (hf1 : f 2 = f 1 * 2 ^ 2) (hf2 : f 3 = f 1 * 3 ^ 2) :
    f = λ n : ℤ ↦ f 1 * n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∀ n : ℕ, f n = f 1 * n ^ 2 by
    funext n; have h : f n = f n.natAbs := by
      obtain hn | hn : n = n.natAbs ∨ n = -n.natAbs := n.natAbs_eq
      exacts [congrArg f hn, (congrArg f hn).trans (hf.map_neg_of_map_zero hf0 _)]
    rw [h, this, ← Int.cast_natCast, ← Int.cast_pow, Int.natAbs_sq, Int.cast_pow]
  
  intro n; induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h n n_ih => ?_
  have hf3 : f 1 = f 1 * 1 ^ 2 := by rw [one_pow, mul_one]
  match n with
    | 0 => rw [Int.natCast_zero, hf0, Nat.cast_zero, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), mul_zero]
    | 1 => rw [Int.natCast_one, Nat.cast_one, ← hf3]
    | 2 => exact hf1
    | 3 => exact hf2
    | n + 4 => ?_
  change f (n + 4) = _
  
  obtain h | h :
      f (n + 4) = f 1 * ((n + 3 : ℕ) + 1) ^ 2 ∨ f (n + 4) = f 1 * ((n + 3 : ℕ) - 1) ^ 2 := by
    have h := hf.def_of_map_zero hf0 (n + 3 : ℕ) 1
    rwa [hf3, n_ih (n + 3) (Nat.lt_succ_self _), iff_eq_mul_add_or_sub_sq] at h
  · rw [Nat.cast_succ, h]
  
  obtain h0 | h0 :
      f (n + 4) = f 1 * ((n + 2 : ℕ) + 2) ^ 2 ∨ f (n + 4) = f 1 * ((n + 2 : ℕ) - 2) ^ 2 := by
    have h0 := hf.def_of_map_zero hf0 (n + 2 : ℕ) 2
    rwa [hf1, n_ih _ (Nat.le_add_right _ 1), iff_eq_mul_add_or_sub_sq] at h0
  · rw [Nat.cast_add (n + 2) 2, Nat.cast_two, h0]
  
  replace h0 : f (n + 4) = f 1 * n ^ 2 := by
    rwa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_two, add_sub_cancel_right] at h0
  replace h : f (n + 4) = f 1 * (n + 2) ^ 2 := by
    rwa [Nat.cast_succ, add_sub_cancel_right, Nat.cast_add] at h
  
  replace h : f 1 = 0 ∨ (n + 2 : R) ^ 2 = n ^ 2 := by
    rwa [h0, eq_comm, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, or_comm] at h
  
  rcases h with h | h
  · rw [h0, h, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  
  replace h : (2 : R) = 0 ∨ (n + 1 : R) = 0 := by
    rwa [add_sq, add_assoc, add_eq_left, mul_right_comm, ← sq, ← mul_add_one,
      mul_eq_zero, pow_eq_zero_iff (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at h
  
  rcases h with h | h
  · rw [h0, Nat.cast_add _ 2, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_two, h, add_zero, add_zero]
  
  replace h0 : f (n + 1 : ℕ) = 0 := by
    rw [n_ih (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_right _ 2), Nat.cast_succ, h, sq, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  calc f (n + 4 : ℕ)
    _ = f (3 + (n + 1 : ℕ)) := by rw [Nat.cast_add _ 3, add_comm, Nat.cast_three]
    _ = f 3 := hf.map_add_of_map_eq_zero hf0 h0 3
    _ = f 1 * 3 ^ 2 := hf2
    _ = f 1 * (n + 4 : ℕ) ^ 2 := by rw [Nat.cast_add _ 3, Nat.cast_succ, h, zero_add]; rfl

name: Int_eq_smul_ZMod4_0141_of_map_three
statement:
theorem Int_eq_smul_ZMod4_0141_of_map_three (hf0 : f 2 = f 1 * 2 ^ 2) (hf1 : f 3 = f 1) :
    f = λ n : ℤ ↦ f 1 * ![0, 1, 4, 1] (n : ZMod 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hR0 : (2 : R) ^ 2 = 4 := by rw [sq, mul_two, two_add_two_eq_four]
  have hf2 : f 0 = 0 := hf.map_zero_of_three_ne_zero hR
  
  suffices f 4 = 0 by
    have h : ∀ x : ZMod 4, f x.val = f 1 * ![0, 1, 4, 1] x
      | 0 =>  hf2.trans (mul_zero _).symm
      | 1 =>  (mul_one _).symm
      | 2 =>  hf0.trans (congrArg (f 1 * ·) hR0)
      | 3 =>  hf1.trans (mul_one _).symm
    funext n; rw [← hf.Int_map_ZMod_of_map_eq_zero hf2 this _, h]
  
  obtain hf3 | hf3 : f 4 = 0 ∨ f 4 = f 1 * 2 ^ 2 := by
    have h : HeronTriple (f 3) (f 1) (f 4) := hf.def_of_map_zero hf2 3 1
    rwa [hf1, iff_of_left_mid_eq, or_comm] at h
  · exact hf3
  
  obtain hf4 | hf4 : f 4 = 0 ∨ f 4 = f 2 * 2 ^ 2 :=
    (iff_of_left_mid_eq.mp (hf.def_of_map_zero hf2 2 2)).symm
  · exact hf4
  
  rwa [hf0, ← hf3, eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub_one, hR0, mul_eq_zero,
    sub_eq_of_eq_add three_add_one_eq_four.symm, or_iff_left hR] at hf4

name: Int_solution_of_char_ne_three
statement:
theorem Int_solution_of_char_ne_three :
    (∃ c, f = λ n : ℤ ↦ c * ![0, 1] n) ∨ (∃ c, f = λ n : ℤ ↦ c * ![0, 1, 4, 1] n)
      ∨ (∃ c : R, f = λ n : ℤ ↦ c * n ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := hf.map_zero_of_three_ne_zero hR
  exact (hf.Int_map_two_eq hf0).symm.imp
    (λ hf1 ↦ ⟨f 1, hf.Int_eq_smul_ZMod2_01_of_map_two hf0 hf1⟩)
    (λ hf1 ↦ (hf.Int_map_three_eq_of_map_two hf0 hf1).symm.imp
      (λ hf2 ↦ ⟨f 1, hf.Int_eq_smul_ZMod4_0141_of_map_three hR hf1 hf2⟩)
      (λ hf2 ↦ ⟨f 1, hf.Int_eq_smul_sq_of_map_three hf0 hf1 hf2⟩))

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [CommRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (hR : (3 : R) ≠ 0) {f : ℤ → R} :
    good f ↔ (∃ c, f = λ n : ℤ ↦ c * ![0, 1] n) ∨ (∃ c, f = λ n : ℤ ↦ c * ![0, 1, 4, 1] n)
      ∨ (∃ c, f = λ n : ℤ ↦ c * (n : R) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hf ↦ hf.Int_solution_of_char_ne_three hR, ?_⟩
  rintro (⟨c, rfl⟩ | ⟨c, rfl⟩ | ⟨c, rfl⟩)
  · exact (ZMod2_Semiring_is_good.comp_AddMonoidHom (Int.castAddHom (ZMod 2))).smul_left c
  · exact (ZMod4_Semiring_is_good.comp_AddMonoidHom (Int.castAddHom (ZMod 4))).smul_left c
  · have h : (c • Int.castRingHom R ∘ fun r ↦ r ^ 2) = λ n : ℤ ↦ c * (n : R) ^ 2 :=
      funext λ n ↦ congrArg (c * ·) (Int.cast_pow n 2)
    simpa only [h] using (sq_is_good.RingHom_comp (Int.castRingHom R)).smul_left c

name: Finset_card_fiber_product_eq_fiberwise
proof:
:=
  calc #{x ∈ A ×ˢ B | f x.1 = g x.2}
  _ = ∑ x ∈ A ×ˢ B, if f x.1 = g x.2 then 1 else 0 := (sum_boole _ _).symm
  _ = ∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ B, if f a = g b then 1 else 0 := sum_product _ _ _
  _ = ∑ k, ∑ a ∈ A with f a = k, ∑ b ∈ B, if f a = g b then 1 else 0 :=
    (sum_fiberwise _ _ _).symm
  _ = ∑ k, #{a ∈ A | f a = k} * #{b ∈ B | g b = k} :=
    
    Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ k ↦
      calc ∑ a ∈ A with f a = k, ∑ b ∈ B, if f a = g b then 1 else 0
      _ = ∑ a ∈ A with f a = k, ∑ b ∈ B, if g b = k then 1 else 0 :=
        sum_congr rfl λ a ha ↦ sum_congr rfl λ _ _ ↦
          if_congr (by rw [eq_comm, (mem_filter.mp ha).2]) rfl rfl
      _ = #{a ∈ A | f a = k} * #{b ∈ B | g b = k} := by
