        rw [sum_const, smul_eq_mul, sum_boole, Nat.cast_id]

name: Fintype_card_fiber_product_eq_fiberwise
proof:
:=
  Finset_card_fiber_product_eq_fiberwise univ univ f g

name: Fintype_card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
statement: theorem Fintype_card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise : Fintype.card ι = ∑ k, #{i | f i = k}
proof:
:=
  card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise λ _ _ ↦ mem_univ _

name: Fintype_card_eqpair_eq_fiberwise
statement:
theorem Fintype_card_eqpair_eq_fiberwise :
    #{x : ι × ι | f x.1 = f x.2} = ∑ k, #{i | f i = k} ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  conv => right; right; ext; rw [sq]
  exact Fintype_card_fiber_product_eq_fiberwise f f

name: Fintype_card_image_CauchySchwarz
statement:
theorem Fintype_card_image_CauchySchwarz :
    Fintype.card ι ^ 2 ≤ #{k | ∃ i, f i = k} * ∑ k, #{i | f i = k} ^ 2
proof:
:=
  calc Fintype.card ι ^ 2
  _ = (∑ k with #{i | f i = k} ≠ 0, #{i | f i = k}) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sum_filter_ne_zero, ← Fintype_card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise]
  _ ≤ #{k | #{i | f i = k} ≠ 0} * ∑ k with #{i | f i = k} ≠ 0, #{i | f i = k} ^ 2 :=
    sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
  _ = #{k | ∃ i, f i = k} * ∑ k, #{i | f i = k} ^ 2 :=
    congrArg₂ _ (by simp only [mem_filter_univ, card_ne_zero, Finset.Nonempty])
      (by rw [sum_filter_of_ne λ x _ ↦ by exact Nat.ne_zero_of_mul_ne_zero_right])

name: Fintype_quad_fiber_product_double_count
proof:
:=
  calc ∑ x, #{p : α × α | f p.1 - f p.2 = x} * #{p : β × β | g p.1 - g p.2 = x}
  _ = ∑ x, #{p : α × α | f p.1 - f p.2 = x} * #{p : β × β | g p.2 - g p.1 = x} :=
    Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ x ↦ congrArg (_ * ·) <|
      card_equiv (Equiv.prodComm β β) λ p ↦ by simp only [mem_filter_univ]; rfl
  _ = #{p : (α × α) × (β × β) | f p.1.1 - f p.1.2 = g p.2.2 - g p.2.1} :=
    (Fintype_card_fiber_product_eq_fiberwise
      (λ p : α × α ↦ f p.1 - f p.2) (λ p : β × β ↦ g p.2 - g p.1)).symm
  _ = #{p : (α × α) × (β × β) | f p.1.1 + g p.2.1 = f p.1.2 + g p.2.2} := by
    conv => left; congr; congr; ext; rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, add_comm (g _)]
  _ = #{p : (α × β) × (α × β) | f p.1.1 + g p.1.2 = f p.2.1 + g p.2.2} :=
    card_equiv (Equiv.prodProdProdComm α α β β) λ ((a, a'), (b, b')) ↦ by
      simp only [Equiv.prodProdProdComm_apply, mem_filter_univ]
  _ = ∑ x, #{p : α × β | f p.1 + g p.2 = x} ^ 2 :=
    Fintype_card_eqpair_eq_fiberwise (λ p : α × β ↦ f p.1 + g p.2)

name: Fintype_quad_fiber_product_CauchySchwarz
statement:
theorem Fintype_quad_fiber_product_CauchySchwarz (f : α → G) (g : β → G) :
    (Fintype.card α * Fintype.card β) ^ 2 ≤
      #{x | ∃ a b, f a + g b = x} *
        ∑ x, #{p : α × α | f p.1 - f p.2 = x} * #{p : β × β | g p.1 - g p.2 = x}
proof:
:=
  calc (Fintype.card α * Fintype.card β) ^ 2
  _ = Fintype.card (α × β) ^ 2 := by rw [Fintype.card_prod]
  _ ≤ #{x | ∃ p : α × β, f p.1 + g p.2 = x} * ∑ x, #{p : α × β | f p.1 + g p.2 = x} ^ 2 :=
    Fintype_card_image_CauchySchwarz _
  _ = #{x | ∃ a b, f a + g b = x} * _ :=
    congrArg₂ _ (by simp only [Prod.exists])
      (Fintype_quad_fiber_product_double_count _ _).symm

name: card_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem card_mul_eq_zero [Ring R] [IsDomain R] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] :
    #{p : R × R | p.1 * p.2 = 0} = 2 * Fintype.card R - 1
proof:
:=
  calc #{p : R × R | p.1 * p.2 = 0}
  _ = #({(0 : R)} ×ˢ univ ∪ univ ×ˢ {(0 : R)}) := by
    refine congrArg card (ext λ (a, b) ↦ ?_)
    rw [mem_filter_univ, mul_eq_zero, mem_union]
    simp only [mem_product, mem_singleton, mem_univ, true_and, and_true]
  _ = #({(0 : R)} ×ˢ (univ : Finset R)) + #((univ : Finset R) ×ˢ {(0 : R)})
      - #({(0 : R)} ×ˢ univ ∩ univ ×ˢ {(0 : R)}) :=
    card_union _ _
  _ = 2 * Fintype.card R - 1 := by
    rw [card_product, card_product, product_inter_product, inter_univ, univ_inter,
      card_product, card_singleton, card_univ, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_one, Nat.two_mul]

name: card_group_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem card_group_antidiagonal [Group G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] (g : G) :
    #{p : G × G | p.1 * p.2 = g} = Fintype.card G
proof:
:=
  calc #{p : G × G | p.1 * p.2 = g}
  _ = ∑ p : G × G, if p.1 * p.2 = g then 1 else 0 := (sum_boole _ _).symm
  _ = ∑ a, ∑ b, if a * b = g then 1 else 0 := Fintype.sum_prod_type _
  _ = ∑ a, ∑ b, if a⁻¹ * g = b then 1 else 0 := by
    conv => right; right; ext; right; ext; congr; rw [inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul, eq_comm]
  _ = ∑ a : G, 1 := Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ a ↦ Fintype.sum_ite_eq _ _
  _ = Fintype.card G := Fintype.card_eq_sum_ones.symm

name: card_mul_eq_unit
statement:
theorem card_mul_eq_unit [CommRing R] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] (r : Rˣ) :
    #{p : R × R | p.1 * p.2 = r} = Fintype.card Rˣ
proof:
:= by
  /- Consider the map `f : Rˣ → R × R` defined by `x ↦ (x, x⁻¹ r)`.
    It suffices to show that `f` is a bijection to `{(a, b) : R × R | ab = r}`. -/
  refine (card_nbij (λ x : Rˣ ↦ (x.val, (x⁻¹ * r).val)) ?_ ?_ ?_).symm
  
  · rintro x -; rw [mem_coe, mem_filter_univ, ← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left]
  
  · rintro x - y - h; exact Units.val_inj.mp (congrArg Prod.fst h)
  
  · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ h
    rw [mem_coe, mem_filter_univ] at h
    
    lift a to Rˣ using IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (b * r⁻¹) (by rw [← mul_assoc, h, r.mul_inv])
    refine ⟨a, mem_univ _, Prod.ext rfl ?_⟩
    
    dsimp only; rw [Units.val_mul, ← h, Units.inv_mul_cancel_left]

name: FiniteField_card_mul_fiber
statement:
theorem FiniteField_card_mul_fiber (r : F) :
    #{p : F × F | p.1 * p.2 = r} = if r = 0 then 2 * q - 1 else q - 1
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  
  · exact h ▸ card_mul_eq_zero
  
  · lift r to Fˣ using isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h
    rw [card_mul_eq_unit, Fintype.card_units]

name: FiniteField_card_sq_sub_sq_fiber_of_two_ne_zero
statement:
theorem FiniteField_card_sq_sub_sq_fiber_of_two_ne_zero (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) (r : F) :
    #{p : F × F | p.1 ^ 2 - p.2 ^ 2 = r} = if r = 0 then 2 * q - 1 else q - 1
proof:
:= by
  replace hF (a : F) : (a + a) / 2 = a := by
    rw [← two_mul, mul_div_cancel_left₀ a (Ring.two_ne_zero hF)]
  
  let e : F × F ≃ F × F :=
    { toFun p := (p.1 + p.2, p.1 - p.2)
      invFun p := ((p.1 + p.2) / 2, (p.1 - p.2) / 2)
      left_inv p := by dsimp only; rw [add_add_sub_cancel, hF, add_sub_sub_cancel, hF]
      right_inv p := by dsimp only; rw [← add_div, add_add_sub_cancel, hF,
        ← sub_div, add_sub_sub_cancel, hF] }
  
  refine (card_equiv e λ p ↦ ?_).trans (FiniteField_card_mul_fiber r)
  rw [mem_filter_univ, mem_filter_univ, sq_sub_sq]; rfl

name: FiniteField_card_sq_sub_sq_fiber_of_two_ne_zero'
statement:
theorem FiniteField_card_sq_sub_sq_fiber_of_two_ne_zero' (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) (r : F) :
    #{p : F × F | p.1 ^ 2 - p.2 ^ 2 = r} = q - 1 + if r = 0 then q else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteField_card_sq_sub_sq_fiber_of_two_ne_zero hF, add_ite,
    Nat.add_zero, ← Nat.self_add_sub_one, Nat.add_comm]

name: card_sq_add_fn_fiber_lower_bound
statement:
theorem card_sq_add_fn_fiber_lower_bound (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) (f : F → F) :
    q ^ 3 ≤ #{r | ∃ a b, a ^ 2 + f b = r} *
      ((q - 1) * q + #{p : F × F | f p.1 = f p.2})
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right (c := q) ?_ Fintype.card_pos
  
  calc q ^ 4
    _ = (q * q) ^ 2 := by rw [← Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.pow_mul]
    _ ≤ #{r | ∃ a b, a ^ 2 + f b = r} *
          ∑ r, #{p : F × F | p.1 ^ 2 - p.2 ^ 2 = r} * #{p : F × F | f p.1 - f p.2 = r} :=
      Fintype_quad_fiber_product_CauchySchwarz _ f
    _ = _ * (((q - 1) * q + #{p : F × F | f p.1 = f p.2}) * q) := congrArg (_ * ·) ?_
    _ = _ := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
  
  calc ∑ r, #{p : F × F | p.1 ^ 2 - p.2 ^ 2 = r} * #{p : F × F | f p.1 - f p.2 = r}
    _ = ∑ r, ((q - 1) * #{p : F × F | f p.1 - f p.2 = r} +
          if 0 = r then q * #{p : F × F | f p.1 - f p.2 = r} else 0) := by
      refine Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ r ↦ ?_
      rw [FiniteField_card_sq_sub_sq_fiber_of_two_ne_zero' hF,
        Nat.add_mul, ite_zero_mul, if_congr eq_comm rfl rfl]
    _ = (q - 1) * ∑ r, #{p : F × F | f p.1 - f p.2 = r} +
          q * #{p : F × F | f p.1 - f p.2 = 0} := by
      rw [sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, Fintype.sum_ite_eq]
    _ = (q - 1) * (q * q) + #{p : F × F | f p.1 = f p.2} * q :=
      congrArg₂ _ (by rw [← Fintype_card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise, Fintype.card_prod])
        (by simp only [Nat.mul_comm q, sub_eq_zero])
    _ = ((q - 1) * q + #{p : F × F | f p.1 = f p.2}) * q := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_assoc]

name: card_Polynomial_fiber_le_degree
statement:
theorem card_Polynomial_fiber_le_degree {P : F[X]} (hP : 0 < P.natDegree) (r : F) :
    #{a : F | P.eval a = r} ≤ P.natDegree
proof:
:=
  have hP0 : 0 < P.degree := natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mp hP
  calc #{a | P.eval a = r}
  _ ≤ (P - C r).roots.card :=
    Multiset.card_le_card <| val_le_iff_val_subset.mpr λ a ↦ by
      rw [mem_val, mem_filter_univ, mem_roots_sub_C hP0]; exact id
  _ ≤ P.natDegree := card_roots_sub_C' hP0

name: card_Polynomial_eqpair_le_of_degree_mul_q
statement:
theorem card_Polynomial_eqpair_le_of_degree_mul_q {P : F[X]} (hP : 0 < P.natDegree) :
    #{p : F × F | P.eval p.1 = P.eval p.2} ≤ P.natDegree * q
proof:
:=
  calc #{p : F × F | P.eval p.1 = P.eval p.2}
  _ = ∑ r, #{a | P.eval a = r} * #{b | P.eval b = r} :=
    Fintype_card_fiber_product_eq_fiberwise P.eval P.eval
  _ ≤ ∑ r, P.natDegree * #{b | P.eval b = r} :=
    sum_le_sum λ r _ ↦ Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (card_Polynomial_fiber_le_degree hP r)
  _ = P.natDegree * q := by rw [← mul_sum, ← Fintype_card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise]

name: card_sq_add_Polynomial_fiber_lower_bound
statement:
theorem card_sq_add_Polynomial_fiber_lower_bound
    (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) {P : F[X]} (hP : 0 < P.natDegree) :
    q ^ 2 ≤ #{r | ∃ a b, a ^ 2 + P.eval b = r} * (q + (P.natDegree - 1))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hq : 1 ≤ q := Fintype.card_pos
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right (c := q) ?_ hq
  
  calc q ^ 3
    _ ≤ #{r | ∃ a b, a ^ 2 + P.eval b = r} *
          ((q - 1) * q + #{p : F × F | P.eval p.1 = P.eval p.2}) :=
      card_sq_add_fn_fiber_lower_bound hF P.eval
    _ ≤ _ * ((q - 1) * q + P.natDegree * q) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _
        (Nat.add_le_add_left (card_Polynomial_eqpair_le_of_degree_mul_q hP) _)
    _ = _ * (q - 1 + P.natDegree) * q := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.add_mul]
    _ = _ * (q + (P.natDegree - 1)) * q := by
      rw [Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.add_sub_assoc hq, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_sub_assoc hP]

name: card_sq_add_Polynomial_fiber_lower_bound_simple
statement:
theorem card_sq_add_Polynomial_fiber_lower_bound_simple
    (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) {P : F[X]} (hP : 1 < P.natDegree) :
    q < #{r | ∃ a b, a ^ 2 + P.eval b = r} + (P.natDegree - 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  set n' : ℕ := P.natDegree - 1
  have hn' : 0 < n' := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hP
  
  refine Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (a := q + n') ?_
  
  calc q * (q + n')
    _ = q ^ 2 + q * n' := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.pow_two]
    _ < #{r | ∃ a b, a ^ 2 + P.eval b = r} * (q + n') + (q + n') * n' :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt
        (card_sq_add_Polynomial_fiber_lower_bound hF (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hP))
        (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right hn') hn')
    _ = _ := by rw [Nat.mul_comm _ n', Nat.add_mul]

name: card_sq_add_Polynomial_not_fiber_upper_bound
statement:
theorem card_sq_add_Polynomial_not_fiber_upper_bound
    (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) {P : F[X]} (hP : 1 < P.natDegree) :
    #{r | ¬∃ a b, a ^ 2 + P.eval b = r} < P.natDegree - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left, card_filter_add_card_filter_not]
  exact card_sq_add_Polynomial_fiber_lower_bound_simple hF hP

name: card_sq_add_pow_not_fiber_upper_bound
statement:
theorem card_sq_add_pow_not_fiber_upper_bound (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) (hn : 1 < n) :
    #{r : F | ¬∃ a b, a ^ 2 + b ^ n = r} < n - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (X ^ n : F[X]).natDegree = n := natDegree_X_pow n
  simpa only [eval_pow, eval_X, hn0] using
    card_sq_add_Polynomial_not_fiber_upper_bound hF (hn.trans_eq hn0.symm)

name: card_sq_add_pow_not_unit_fiber_upper_bound
statement:
theorem card_sq_add_pow_not_unit_fiber_upper_bound (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) (hn : 1 < n) :
    #{r : Fˣ | ¬∃ a b, a ^ 2 + b ^ n = r.val} < n - 1
proof:
:=
  calc #{r : Fˣ | ¬∃ a b, a ^ 2 + b ^ n = r.val}
  _ ≤ #{r : F | ¬∃ a b, a ^ 2 + b ^ n = r} :=
    card_le_card_of_injOn Units.val
      (λ r hr ↦ by simpa only [mem_coe, mem_filter_univ] using hr)
      (Set.injOn_of_injective Units.val_injective)
  _ < n - 1 := card_sq_add_pow_not_fiber_upper_bound hF hn

name: orbit_zpowers_PairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem orbit_zpowers_PairwiseDisjoint
    [Group G] [DecidableEq G] (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] :
    (Set.range λ b : G ↦ image (λ a : H ↦ a * b) univ).PairwiseDisjoint id
proof:
:= by
  
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, rfl⟩ h
  refine disjoint_right.mpr λ a ha ha0 ↦ h (ext λ g ↦ ?_)
  simp only [id, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and] at ha ha0 ⊢
  rcases ha with ⟨z, rfl⟩; rcases ha0 with ⟨w, h⟩
  
  replace h : ((z⁻¹ * w : H) : G) * x = y := by
    rwa [← inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc] at h
  generalize z⁻¹ * w = v at h
  subst h; clear z w
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩; refine ⟨a * v⁻¹, (?_ : a * (v : G)⁻¹ * _ = a * x)⟩
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc _ _ x, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact ⟨a * v, mul_assoc _ _ _⟩

name: image_mul_zpowers_eq_self_of_mul_invariant
statement:
theorem image_mul_zpowers_eq_self_of_mul_invariant :
    image₂ (λ (x : Subgroup.zpowers x₀) (s : G) ↦ x * s) univ S = S
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp only [mem_image₂, mem_univ, true_and, Subgroup.exists_zpowers]
  exact ⟨λ ⟨m, y, hy, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ hS m y hy, λ hx ↦ ⟨0, x, hx, by rw [zpow_zero, one_mul]⟩⟩

name: order_dvd_card_Finset_of_mul_invariant
statement: theorem order_dvd_card_Finset_of_mul_invariant : orderOf x₀ ∣ #S
proof:
:=
  calc orderOf x₀
  _ = Fintype.card (Subgroup.zpowers x₀) := Fintype.card_zpowers.symm
  _ ∣ #(image₂ (λ (x : Subgroup.zpowers x₀) (s : G) ↦ x * s) univ S) :=
    card_dvd_card_image₂_left (λ b _ x y h ↦ by simpa using h)
      (Set.PairwiseDisjoint.subset (orbit_zpowers_PairwiseDisjoint _)
        (Set.image_subset_range _ _))
  _ = #S := congrArg card (image_mul_zpowers_eq_self_of_mul_invariant hS)

name: dvd_card_sq_add_pow_not_unit_fiber
statement:
theorem dvd_card_sq_add_pow_not_unit_fiber :
    (q - 1) / (q - 1).gcd (2 * n) ∣ #{r : Fˣ | ¬∃ a b, a ^ 2 + b ^ n = r.val}
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : Fˣ, ∀ x : Fˣ, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g := IsCyclic.exists_generator
  /- Reduce calculation to showing that the bad set of elements not of the form
    `a^2 + b^5` is invariant under left multiplication by `x₀^{2n}`. -/
  calc (q - 1) / (q - 1).gcd (2 * n)
    _ = orderOf (g ^ (2 * n)) := by
      rw [orderOf_pow, orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers hg,
        Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_units]
    _ ∣ _ := order_dvd_card_Finset_of_mul_invariant λ k r hr ↦ ?_
  
  rw [mem_filter_univ] at hr ⊢
  rintro ⟨a, b, h⟩
  refine hr ⟨(g⁻¹ ^ k) ^ n * a, (g⁻¹ ^ k) ^ 2 * b, ?_⟩
  calc ((g⁻¹ ^ k) ^ n * a) ^ 2 + ((g⁻¹ ^ k) ^ 2 * b) ^ n
    _ = (g⁻¹ ^ k) ^ (2 * n) * ((g ^ (2 * n)) ^ k * r : Fˣ) := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, ← mul_add, h]
    _ = (g⁻¹ ^ k : Fˣ) ^ (2 * n) * (((g ^ (2 * n)) ^ k * r) : Fˣ) := by
      rw [← Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]
    _ = ((g⁻¹ ^ k) ^ ((2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((g ^ ((2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ)) ^ k * r) : Fˣ) := rfl
    _ = (g⁻¹ ^ (k * (2 * n : ℕ)) * g ^ ((2 * n : ℕ) * k) * r : Fˣ) := by
      rw [← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ = r := by rw [Int.mul_comm, ← mul_zpow, inv_mul_cancel, one_zpow, one_mul]

name: dvd_two_mul_exp_mul_card_sq_add_pow_not_unit_fiber
statement:
theorem dvd_two_mul_exp_mul_card_sq_add_pow_not_unit_fiber (hn : 0 < n) :
    q - 1 ∣ 2 * n * #{r : Fˣ | ¬∃ a b, a ^ 2 + b ^ n = r.val}
proof:
:= by
  have h : (q - 1).gcd (2 * n) ∣ q - 1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _
  have h0 : 0 < (q - 1).gcd (2 * n) :=
    Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ (Nat.mul_pos Nat.two_pos hn)
  rw [← Nat.dvd_gcd_mul_iff_dvd_mul, ← Nat.div_dvd_iff_dvd_mul h h0]
  exact dvd_card_sq_add_pow_not_unit_fiber

name: exists_eq_sq_add_pow
statement:
theorem exists_eq_sq_add_pow (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) (hn : 1 < n) (h : 2 * n * (n - 1) < q) :
    ∀ r : F, ∃ a b : F, a ^ 2 + b ^ n = r
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∀ r : Fˣ, ∃ a b : F, a ^ 2 + b ^ n = r by
    intro r; obtain rfl | hr : r = 0 ∨ r ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne r 0
    · refine ⟨0, 0, ?_⟩
      rw [zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), zero_add, zero_pow (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn)]
    · lift r to Fˣ using Ne.isUnit hr
      exact this r
  
  let N : ℕ := #{r : Fˣ | ¬∃ a b, a ^ 2 + b ^ n = r.val}
  suffices N = 0 by
    simpa only [N, card_filter_eq_zero_iff, mem_univ, forall_const, not_not] using this
  
  have hn0 : 0 < n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn
  replace hn : N < n - 1 := card_sq_add_pow_not_unit_fiber_upper_bound hF hn
  have h0 : q - 1 ∣ 2 * n * N := dvd_two_mul_exp_mul_card_sq_add_pow_not_unit_fiber hn0
  
  replace hn0 : 0 < 2 * n := Nat.mul_pos Nat.two_pos hn0
  replace h0 : 2 * n * N = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h0 <| by
    calc 2 * n * N
      _ < 2 * n * (n - 1) := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hn hn0
      _ ≤ q - 1 := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt h
  exact (Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_left hn0.ne.symm

name: exists_eq_sq_add_pow_five
statement:
theorem exists_eq_sq_add_pow_five (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) (hF0 : 40 < q) :
    ∀ r : F, ∃ a b : F, a ^ 2 + b ^ 5 = r
proof:
:=
  exists_eq_sq_add_pow hF (n := 5) (Nat.one_lt_succ_succ 3) hF0

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 40 < p) (r : ℤ) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, a ^ 2 + b ^ 5 ≡ r [ZMOD p]
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : ringChar (ZMod p) ≠ 2 := by
    rw [ZMod.ringChar_zmod_n p]
    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (hp.trans' (by norm_num))
  obtain ⟨a, b, h0⟩ : ∃ a b : ZMod p, a ^ 2 + b ^ 5 = r :=
    exists_eq_sq_add_pow_five hp0 (hp.trans_eq (ZMod.card p).symm) r
  exact ⟨a.val, b.val, (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff _ _ _).mp (by simpa using h0)⟩

name: four_mul_add_one_is_friendly
statement: theorem four_mul_add_one_is_friendly (hk : 0 < k) : friendly (4 * k + 1)
proof:
:=
  have h : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 2 := Int.zero_le_ofNat 2
  ⟨2 * k + 1, Int.lt_add_one_of_le (Int.mul_nonneg h (Int.le_of_lt hk)), k, hk, by ring⟩

name: card_Icc_friendly
statement: theorem card_Icc_friendly (N : ℕ) : N ≤ #{a ∈ Icc 1 (4 * (N + 1)) | friendly a}
proof:
:=
  calc N
  _ = #(range N) := (card_range N).symm
  _ = #((range N).image λ n ↦ 4 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) := by
    have h : (4 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by decide
    have h0 : (λ n : ℕ ↦ 4 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1).Injective := by
      intro m n h0
      rwa [Int.add_left_inj, Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff h, Int.natCast_inj, Nat.succ_inj] at h0
    exact (card_image_of_injective _ h0).symm
  _ ≤ #{a ∈ Icc 1 (4 * (N + 1)) | friendly a} := by
    refine card_le_card (image_subset_iff.mpr λ n hnN ↦ ?_)
    replace hnN : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) < N + 1 :=
      Int.ofNat_lt_ofNat_of_lt (Nat.succ_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hnN))
    have hn : 0 < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := Int.ofNat_succ_pos n
    have h : 0 < (4 : ℤ) := by decide
    have h0 : 1 ≤ 4 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 :=
      Int.le_add_of_nonneg_left (Int.mul_nonneg h.le hn.le)
    have h1 : 4 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 ≤ 4 * (N + 1) :=
      Int.add_one_le_of_lt (Int.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hnN h)
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h0, h1⟩, four_mul_add_one_is_friendly hn⟩

name: final_solution_part1
statement: theorem final_solution_part1 : 500 ≤ #{a ∈ Icc 1 2012 | friendly a}
proof:
:=
  calc 500
  _ ≤ 502 := by decide
  _ ≤ #{a ∈ Icc 1 2012 | friendly a} := card_Icc_friendly 502

name: add_one_eq_two_mul_sq_add_eight_mul_is_square
statement:
theorem add_one_eq_two_mul_sq_add_eight_mul_is_square
    {a b c : ℤ} (hb : b > 0) (hba : b ≤ a) (habc : a ^ 2 + 8 * b = c ^ 2) :
    a + 1 = 2 * b
proof:
:= by
  have X2 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 2 := by decide
  have X4 : (4 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by decide
  have X8 : (0 : ℤ) < 8 := by decide
  
  wlog hc : c ≥ 0 generalizing c
  · refine this (habc.trans (neg_sq _).symm) (Int.neg_nonneg_of_nonpos (Int.le_of_not_le hc))
  
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : 2 ∣ c - a := by
    have h (n : ℤ) : Even (n ^ 2) ↔ Even n :=
      Int.even_pow.trans (and_iff_left (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1))
    have h0 : Even (8 : ℤ) := ⟨4, rfl⟩
    rw [← even_iff_two_dvd, Int.even_sub, ← h, ← habc, Int.even_add, h]
    exact iff_true_right (h0.mul_right b)
  replace hd : c = 2 * d + a := Int.sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd
  subst hd
  
  replace hc : a < 2 * d + a := by
    refine lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 hc ?_
    calc a ^ 2
      _ < a ^ 2 + 8 * b := Int.lt_add_of_pos_right _ (Int.mul_pos X8 hb)
      _ = (2 * d + a) ^ 2 := habc
  replace hc : 0 < d := Int.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left ((lt_add_iff_pos_left a).mp hc) X2
  
  replace habc : 4 * (2 * b) = 4 * ((d + a) * d) := calc
    _ = 8 * b := (Int.mul_assoc 4 2 b).symm
    _ = (2 * d + a) ^ 2 - a ^ 2 := eq_sub_of_add_eq' habc
    _ = (2 * d + 2 * a) * (2 * d) := by
      rw [sq_sub_sq, Int.add_sub_cancel, Int.add_assoc, ← Int.two_mul]
    _ = (2 * 2) * ((d + a) * d) := by rw [← Int.mul_add, mul_mul_mul_comm]
  replace habc : 2 * b = (d + a) * d := (Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff X4).mp habc
  
  obtain rfl | hd : 1 = d ∨ d ≥ 2 := by
    rwa [Int.lt_iff_add_one_le, Int.le_iff_eq_or_lt, Int.lt_iff_add_one_le] at hc
  
  · rwa [Int.mul_one, Int.add_comm, eq_comm] at habc
  
  · refine absurd habc (Int.ne_of_lt ?_)
    calc 2 * b
      _ ≤ d * a := Int.mul_le_mul hd hba hb.le hc.le
      _ < d * d + d * a := Int.lt_add_of_pos_left _ (Int.mul_pos hc hc)
      _ = (d + a) * d := by rw [← Int.mul_add, Int.mul_comm]

name: final_solution_part2
statement: theorem final_solution_part2 : ¬friendly 2
proof:
:= by
  
  rintro ⟨m, hm, n, hn, h⟩
  
  have hmn : 0 < 2 * (m - n) ^ 3 := by
    have h0 {a b : ℤ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < a ^ 2 + b :=
      Int.add_pos (Int.pow_pos ha) hb
    exact (Int.mul_pos (h0 hm hn) (h0 hn hm)).trans_eq h
  replace hmn : 0 < m - n := by
    have h0 : (0 : ℤ) < 2 := by decide
    have h1 : Odd 3 := by decide
    exact h1.pow_pos_iff.mp (Int.pos_of_mul_pos_right hmn h0)
  
  have h0 : (m ^ 2 + n + n ^ 2 + m) ^ 2 = (m - n) ^ 2 * ((m + n - 1) ^ 2 + 8 * (m - n)) :=
    calc  _ = (m - n) ^ 2 * (m + n - 1) ^ 2 + 4 * ((m ^ 2 + n) * (n ^ 2 + m)) := by ring
          _ = (m - n) ^ 2 * (m + n - 1) ^ 2 + 4 * (2 * (m - n) ^ 3) := by rw [h]
          _ = _ := by rw [← mul_assoc, pow_succ _ 2, mul_left_comm, ← mul_add]; rfl
  
  obtain ⟨c, h1⟩ : m - n ∣ m ^ 2 + n + n ^ 2 + m :=
    (Int.pow_dvd_pow_iff (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)).mp ⟨_, h0⟩
  replace h0 : c ^ 2 = (m + n - 1) ^ 2 + 8 * (m - n) := by
    rwa [h1, Int.mul_pow, Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff (Int.pow_ne_zero hmn.ne.symm)] at h0
  
  replace h1 : m - n ≤ m + n - 1 := by
    rw [Int.le_sub_one_iff, Int.sub_lt_iff, Int.add_assoc, lt_add_iff_pos_right]
    exact Int.add_pos hn hn
  replace h0 : m + n - 1 + 1 = 2 * (m - n) :=
    add_one_eq_two_mul_sq_add_eight_mul_is_square hmn h1 h0.symm
  replace h0 : m = 3 * n := by
    rwa [Int.sub_add_cancel, Int.mul_sub, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, Int.add_assoc,
      ← one_add_mul, Int.two_mul m, Int.add_right_inj, eq_comm] at h0
  
  subst h0; refine Int.ne_of_gt ?_ h
  calc 2 * (3 * n - n) ^ 3
    _ = 2 * (3 - 1) ^ 3 * n ^ 3 := by rw [← sub_one_mul, Int.mul_pow, Int.mul_assoc]
    _ < 3 ^ 3 * n ^ 3 := Int.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by decide) (Int.pow_pos hn)
    _ = (3 * n) ^ 2 * (3 * n) := by rw [← Int.mul_pow, Int.pow_succ]
    _ < ((3 * n) ^ 2 + n) * (n ^ 2 + 3 * n) :=
      mul_lt_mul'' (Int.lt_add_of_pos_right _ hn)
        (Int.lt_add_of_pos_left _ (Int.pow_pos hn)) (sq_nonneg _) hm.le

name: isOneOpReachable.bdd_of_bdd
statement:
theorem isOneOpReachable.bdd_of_bdd (h : isOneOpReachable y x) (hx : ∀ k, x k ≤ M) (k) :
    y k ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases h with ⟨i, j, hij, hij0, h, h0, h1⟩
  obtain hki | rfl : k ≠ i ∨ k = i := ne_or_eq _ _
  
  · obtain rfl | hkj : k = j ∨ k ≠ j := eq_or_ne _ _
    exacts [h.trans_le (hx i), (h1 k hki hkj).trans_le (hx k)]
  
  · rcases h0 with h0 | h0
    exacts [h0.trans_le ((hx k).trans' hij0), h0.trans_le ((Nat.sub_le _ _).trans (hx k))]

name: Nat_rearrangement_two
statement:
theorem Nat_rearrangement_two {a b c d : ℕ} (h : a < b) (h0 : c < d) :
    a * d + b * c < a * c + b * d
proof:
:=
  calc a * d + b * c
  _ = a * c + b * c + a * (d - c) := by
    rw [Nat.add_right_comm, ← Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' h0.le]
  _ < a * c + b * c + b * (d - c) :=
    Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt h0)) _
  _ = a * c + b * d := by
    rw [Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' h0.le]

name: isOneOpReachable.sum_mul_lt
statement:
theorem isOneOpReachable.sum_mul_lt{y x : Fin n → ℕ} (h : isOneOpReachable y x) :
    ∑ k, k * x k < ∑ k, k * y k
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases h with ⟨i, j, hij, hij0, h, h0, h1⟩
  replace h1 {k} (hk : k ∈ ({i, j} : Finset _)ᶜ) : y k = x k := by
    rw [mem_compl, mem_insert, mem_singleton, not_or] at hk
    exact h1 _ hk.1 hk.2
  
  replace h0 : x j ≤ y i :=
    h0.elim (λ h0 ↦ Nat.le_of_succ_le h0.ge)
      (λ h0 ↦ (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hij0).trans_eq h0.symm)
  replace h0 : i * x i + j * x j < i * y i + j * y j :=
    calc i * x i + j * x j
    _ < i * x j + j * x i := Nat_rearrangement_two hij hij0
    _ ≤ i * y i + j * x i := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h0) _
    _ = i * y i + j * y j := by rw [h]
  
  calc ∑ k, k * x k
    _ = i * x i + j * x j + ∑ k ∉ {i, j}, k * x k := by
      rw [← sum_add_sum_compl {i, j}, sum_pair hij.ne]
    _ < i * y i + j * y j + ∑ k ∉ {i, j}, k * y k :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le h0 <| Nat.le_of_eq <|
        sum_congr rfl λ k hk ↦ congrArg (_ * ·) (h1 hk).symm
    _ = ∑ k, k * y k := by
      rw [← sum_add_sum_compl {i, j}, sum_pair hij.ne]

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (x : Fin n → ℕ) : isLosing x
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, ∀ i, x i ≤ M := ⟨univ.sup x, λ _ ↦ le_sup (mem_univ _)⟩
  
  induction h : ∑ k, k * x k using Nat.strong_decreasing_induction generalizing x with
  | base =>
      refine ⟨∑ k : Fin n, k * M, λ m hmM x hx hxm ↦ absurd ?_ (Nat.not_le_of_lt hmM)⟩
      exact (sum_le_sum λ _ _ ↦ Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hx _)).trans_eq' hxm
  | step T hT =>
      refine isLosing.of_forall_isOneOpReachable λ y hyx ↦ ?_
      exact hT _ (hyx.sum_mul_lt.trans_eq' h) y (hyx.bdd_of_bdd hM) rfl

name: pow_add_mul_lt_add_pow
statement:
theorem pow_add_mul_lt_add_pow
    {a b : R} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : 0 ≤ a + b) (hb : b ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    a ^ n + n * a ^ (n - 1) * b < (a + b) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 2 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn
  calc a ^ (k + 2) + (k + 2 : ℕ) * a ^ (k + 1) * b
    _ < a ^ (k + 2) + (k + 2 : ℕ) * a ^ (k + 1) * b + (k + 1 : ℕ) * a ^ k * b ^ 2 :=
      lt_add_of_pos_right _ (mul_pos (hb := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hb)
        (mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos k)) (pow_pos ha k)))
    _ = (a ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1 : ℕ) * a ^ k * b) * (a + b) := by rw [Nat.cast_succ]; ring
    _ ≤ (a + b) ^ (k + 1) * (a + b) := by
      have h : 0 ≤ 2 * a + b := calc
        _ ≤ a + (a + b) := add_nonneg ha.le hab
        _ = 2 * a + b := by rw [two_mul, add_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_add_mul_le_add_pow ha.le h _) hab
    _ = (a + b) ^ (k + 2) := (pow_succ _ _).symm

name: bernoulli_special1
statement:
theorem bernoulli_special1 {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ 1 + x) (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 2 : ℕ) ^ (n + 2) * x ≤ (n + 1 : ℕ) ^ (n + 1) * (1 + x) ^ (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_mul_le_mul_of_pos_left ?_ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n))
  calc (n + 1 : ℕ) * ((n + 2 : ℕ) ^ (n + 2) * x)
    _ = (n + 2 : ℕ) ^ (n + 2)
        + (n + 2 : ℕ) * (n + 2 : ℕ) ^ (n + 1) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) * x - 1) := by
      rw [← pow_succ', mul_sub_one, add_sub_cancel, mul_left_comm]
    _ ≤ ((n + 2 : ℕ) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) * x - 1)) ^ (n + 2) := by
      have h : (0 : R) ≤ (n + 2 : ℕ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      have h0 : 0 ≤ 2 * (n + 2 : ℕ) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) * x - 1) := calc
        _ ≤ (n + 2 : ℕ) + (n + 1 : ℕ) * (1 + x) :=
          add_nonneg h (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hx)
        _ = 2 * (n + 2 : ℕ) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) * x - 1) := by
          rw [two_mul, add_assoc, add_right_inj, Nat.cast_succ (n + 1),
            add_add_sub_cancel, mul_one_add]
      exact pow_add_mul_le_add_pow h h0 (n + 2)
    _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) * (1 + x)) ^ (n + 2) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_add_sub_cancel, mul_one_add]
    _ = (n + 1 : ℕ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) ^ (n + 1) * (1 + x) ^ (n + 2)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, pow_succ', mul_assoc]

name: bernoulli_special2
statement:
theorem bernoulli_special2 {x : R} (hx : 0 ≤ 1 + x) {n : ℕ} (hx0 : (n + 1 : ℕ) * x ≠ 1) :
    (n + 2 : ℕ) ^ (n + 2) * x < (n + 1 : ℕ) ^ (n + 1) * (1 + x) ^ (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h : (0 : R) ≤ (n + 1 : ℕ) := Nat.cast_nonneg (n + 1)
  refine lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left ?_ h
  calc (n + 1 : ℕ) * ((n + 2 : ℕ) ^ (n + 2) * x)
    _ = (n + 2 : ℕ) ^ (n + 2)
        + (n + 2 : ℕ) * (n + 2 : ℕ) ^ (n + 1) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) * x - 1) := by
      rw [← pow_succ', mul_sub_one, add_sub_cancel, mul_left_comm]
    _ < ((n + 2 : ℕ) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) * x - 1)) ^ (n + 2) := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ (n + 2 : ℕ) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) * x - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_add_sub_cancel, ← mul_one_add]
        exact mul_nonneg h hx
      exact pow_add_mul_lt_add_pow (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos _))
        h0 (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hx0) (Nat.le_add_left 2 n)
    _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) * (1 + x)) ^ (n + 2) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_add_sub_cancel, mul_one_add]
    _ = (n + 1 : ℕ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) ^ (n + 1) * (1 + x) ^ (n + 2)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, pow_succ', mul_assoc]

name: main_statement
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ range n, ((i + 1 : ℕ) : R) ^ (i + 1) :=
    prod_nonneg λ i _ ↦ pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _
  refine lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left ?_ h
  calc (∏ i ∈ range n, ↑(i + 1) ^ (i + 1)) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) ^ (n + 1) * ∏ i ∈ range n, x i)
    _ = (∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), ↑(i + 1) ^ (i + 1)) * ∏ i ∈ range n, x i := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, prod_range_succ]
    _ = ∏ i ∈ range n, ↑(i + 2) ^ (i + 2) * x i := by
      rw [prod_mul_distrib, prod_range_succ', Nat.cast_one, one_pow, mul_one]
    _ < ∏ i ∈ range n, ↑(i + 1) ^ (i + 1) * (1 + x i) ^ (i + 2) := by
      have h0 {i} (hi : i ∈ range n) : 0 ≤ 1 + x i := add_nonneg zero_le_one (hxn i hi).le
      exact prod_lt_prod₀
        (λ i hi ↦ mul_pos (pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos _)) _) (hxn i hi))
        (λ i hi ↦ bernoulli_special1 (h0 hi) _)
        (hxn0.imp λ k ⟨hk, hk0⟩ ↦ ⟨hk, bernoulli_special2 (h0 hk) hk0⟩)
    _ = (∏ i ∈ range n, ↑(i + 1) ^ (i + 1)) * ∏ i ∈ range n, (1 + x i) ^ (i + 2) :=
      prod_mul_distrib

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution
    {x : ℕ → R} (hn : 1 < n) (hxn : ∀ i ∈ range n, 0 < x i) (hxn0 : ∏ i ∈ range n, x i = 1) :
    (n + 1 : ℕ) ^ (n + 1) < ∏ i ∈ range n, (1 + x i) ^ (i + 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∃ i ∈ range n, ↑(i + 1) * x i ≠ 1 by
    calc ((n + 1 : ℕ) : R) ^ (n + 1)
    _ = (n + 1 : ℕ) ^ (n + 1) * ∏ i ∈ range n, x i := by rw [hxn0, mul_one]
    _ < ∏ i ∈ range n, (1 + x i) ^ (i + 2) := main_statement hxn this
  
  by_contra! h
  replace h : (∏ i ∈ range n, (i + 1 : ℕ) : R) = 1 := by
    rw [← prod_eq_one h, prod_mul_distrib, hxn0, mul_one]
  replace h : ∏ i ∈ range n, (i + 1) = 1 := by
    rwa [← Nat.cast_prod, Nat.cast_eq_one] at h
  
  have h0 : 2 ∣ ∏ i ∈ range n, (i + 1) := dvd_prod_of_mem _ (mem_range.mpr hn)
  exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt Nat.one_pos Nat.one_lt_two (h ▸ h0)

name: T_alt_formula
statement: theorem T_alt_formula : T S = ∑ p ∈ S, #{j | (p.1, j) ∉ S} * #{i | (i, p.2) ∉ S}
proof:
:=
  calc #{p : (ι × ι) × (ι × ι) | p.1 ∈ S ∧ (p.2.1, p.1.2) ∉ S ∧ (p.1.1, p.2.2) ∉ S}
  _ = ∑ p : (ι × ι) × (ι × ι) with p.1 ∈ S ∧ (p.2.1, p.1.2) ∉ S ∧ (p.1.1, p.2.2) ∉ S, 1 :=
    card_eq_sum_ones _
  _ = ∑ p : (ι × ι) × (ι × ι),
        if p.1 ∈ S ∧ (p.2.1, p.1.2) ∉ S ∧ (p.1.1, p.2.2) ∉ S then 1 else 0 :=
    sum_filter _ _
  _ = ∑ p : ι × ι, ∑ q : ι × ι, if p ∈ S ∧ (q.1, p.2) ∉ S ∧ (p.1, q.2) ∉ S then 1 else 0 :=
    Fintype.sum_prod_type _
  _ = ∑ p ∈ S, ∑ q : ι × ι, if (q.1, p.2) ∉ S ∧ (p.1, q.2) ∉ S then 1 else 0 := by
    simp_rw [ite_and (_ ∈ S), sum_ite_irrel]
    rw [sum_const_zero, Fintype.sum_ite_mem]
  _ = ∑ p ∈ S, #{j | (p.1, j) ∉ S} * #{i | (i, p.2) ∉ S} := by
    refine sum_congr rfl λ p _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← sum_filter, ← card_eq_sum_ones, Nat.mul_comm,
      ← card_product, ← filter_product, univ_product_univ]

name: T_ineq1
proof:
:=
  calc 2 * T S
  _ = ∑ p ∈ S, 2 * (#{j | (p.1, j) ∉ S} * #{i | (i, p.2) ∉ S}) := by
    rw [T_alt_formula, mul_sum]
  _ = ∑ p ∈ S, 2 * #{j | (p.1, j) ∉ S} * #{i | (i, p.2) ∉ S} := by simp_rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
  _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ S, (#{j | (p.1, j) ∉ S} ^ 2 + #{i | (i, p.2) ∉ S} ^ 2) :=
    sum_le_sum λ p _ ↦ two_mul_le_add_sq _ _
  _ = ∑ p ∈ S, #{j | (p.1, j) ∉ S} ^ 2 + ∑ p ∈ S, #{i | (i, p.2) ∉ S} ^ 2 :=
    sum_add_distrib
  _ = ∑ i, #{j | (i, j) ∈ S} * #{j | (i, j) ∉ S} ^ 2
      + ∑ j, #{i | (i, j) ∈ S} * #{i | (i, j) ∉ S} ^ 2 := by
    refine congrArg₂ _ ?_ ?_
    · have h (p : ι × ι) : p ∈ S ↔ p.1 ∈ univ ∧ p.2 ∈ ({j | (p.1, j) ∈ S} : Finset _) := by
        rw [mem_filter_univ, and_iff_right (mem_univ _)]
      exact (sum_finset_product S univ (λ i ↦ {j | (i, j) ∈ S}) h).trans
        (Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ i ↦ sum_const_nat λ _ _ ↦ rfl)
    · have h (p : ι × ι) : p ∈ S ↔ p.2 ∈ univ ∧ p.1 ∈ ({i | (i, p.2) ∈ S} : Finset _) := by
        rw [mem_filter_univ, and_iff_right (mem_univ _)]
      exact (sum_finset_product_right S univ (λ j ↦ {i | (i, j) ∈ S}) h).trans
        (Fintype.sum_congr _ _ λ i ↦ sum_const_nat λ _ _ ↦ rfl)

name: AMGM3_ineq
statement: theorem AMGM3_ineq (a b : ℕ) : 27 * (a * b ^ 2) ≤ 4 * (a + b) ^ 3
proof:
:=
  have h : 2 * (2 * a) * b ≤ (2 * a) ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := two_mul_le_add_sq _ _
  calc 27 * (a * b ^ 2)
    _ = 11 * (a * b ^ 2) + 4 * b * (2 * (2 * a) * b) := by ring
    _ ≤ 11 * (a * b ^ 2) + 4 * b * ((2 * a) ^ 2 + b ^ 2) :=
      Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h) _
    _ = a * (2 * (2 * a) * b) + (11 * (a * b ^ 2) + 12 * (a ^ 2 * b) + 4 * b ^ 3) := by ring
    _ ≤ a * ((2 * a) ^ 2 + b ^ 2) + (11 * (a * b ^ 2) + 12 * (a ^ 2 * b) + 4 * b ^ 3) :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h) _
    _ = 4 * (a + b) ^ 3 := by ring

name: T_ineq2
statement: theorem T_ineq2 : 27 * T S ≤ 4 * Fintype.card ι ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ Nat.two_pos
  calc 2 * (27 * T S)
    _ = 27 * (2 * T S) := Nat.mul_left_comm _ _ _
    _ ≤ 27 * (∑ i, #{j | (i, j) ∈ S} * #{j | (i, j) ∉ S} ^ 2
        + ∑ j, #{i | (i, j) ∈ S} * #{i | (i, j) ∉ S} ^ 2) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (T_ineq1 S)
    _ = ∑ i, 27 * (#{j | (i, j) ∈ S} * #{j | (i, j) ∉ S} ^ 2)
        + ∑ j, 27 * (#{i | (i, j) ∈ S} * #{i | (i, j) ∉ S} ^ 2) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, mul_sum, mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, 4 * (#{j | (i, j) ∈ S} + #{j | (i, j) ∉ S}) ^ 3
        + ∑ j, 4 * (#{i | (i, j) ∈ S} + #{i | (i, j) ∉ S}) ^ 3 :=
      Nat.add_le_add (sum_le_sum λ _ _ ↦ AMGM3_ineq _ _)
        (sum_le_sum λ _ _ ↦ AMGM3_ineq _ _)
    _ = 2 * (4 * Fintype.card ι ^ 4) := by
      simp_rw [card_filter_add_card_filter_not]
      rw [← Nat.two_mul, sum_const, card_univ,
        Nat.pow_succ' (n := 3), Nat.mul_left_comm 4]; rfl

name: T_image_equiv
statement:
theorem T_image_equiv [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) :
    T (S.image (e.prodCongr e)) = T S
proof:
:= by
  set e₂ := e.prodCongr e
  set S₂ := S.image e₂
  refine (card_equiv (e₂.prodCongr e₂) ?_).symm
  rintro ⟨⟨i₀, i₁⟩, ⟨i₂, i₃⟩⟩
  iterate 2 rw [mem_filter_univ]
  change (i₀, i₁) ∈ S ∧ (i₂, i₁) ∉ S ∧ (i₀, i₃) ∉ S
    ↔ e₂ (i₀, i₁) ∈ S₂ ∧ e₂ (i₂, i₁) ∉ S₂ ∧ e₂ (i₀, i₃) ∉ S₂
  refine and_congr ?_ (and_congr ?_ ?_)
  all_goals simp only [S₂, mem_image, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, exists_eq_right]

name: T_product_univ_right
statement:
theorem T_product_univ_right
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (S : Finset (κ × κ)) (ι) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    T {p : (κ × ι) × (κ × ι) | (p.1.1, p.2.1) ∈ S} = T S * Fintype.card ι ^ 4
proof:
:=
  calc T {p : (κ × ι) × (κ × ι) | (p.1.1, p.2.1) ∈ S}
    _ = #{p : ((κ × ι) × (κ × ι)) × ((κ × ι) × (κ × ι)) |
          (p.1.1.1, p.1.2.1) ∈ S ∧ (p.2.1.1, p.1.2.1) ∉ S ∧ (p.1.1.1, p.2.2.1) ∉ S} := by
      simp_rw [T, mem_filter_univ]
    _ = #{p : ((κ × κ) × (κ × κ)) × ((ι × ι) × (ι × ι)) |
          p.1.1 ∈ S ∧ (p.1.2.1, p.1.1.2) ∉ S ∧ (p.1.1.1, p.1.2.2) ∉ S} := by
      let e := Equiv.prodProdProdComm κ ι κ ι
      refine card_equiv ((e.prodCongr e).trans (Equiv.prodProdProdComm _ _ _ _)) λ i ↦ ?_
      rw [mem_filter_univ, mem_filter_univ]; rfl
    _ = T S * Fintype.card ((ι × ι) × (ι × ι)) := by
      rw [← card_univ, T, ← card_product]
      refine congrArg card (ext λ i ↦ ?_)
      rw [mem_filter_univ, mem_product, mem_filter_univ, and_iff_left (mem_univ _)]
    _ = T S * Fintype.card ι ^ 4 := by
      rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_prod, ← Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.pow_mul]

name: T_Fin3_diag
statement: theorem T_Fin3_diag : T (diag univ : Finset (Fin 3 × Fin 3)) = 12
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [T, mem_diag, mem_univ, true_and]; rfl

name: T_Fin3_diag_product
proof:
:=
  calc T {p : (Fin 3 × ι) × (Fin 3 × ι) | (p.1.1, p.2.1) ∈ diag univ}
  _ = T (diag univ : Finset (Fin 3 × Fin 3)) * Fintype.card ι ^ 4 :=
    T_product_univ_right {p : Fin 3 × Fin 3 | p.1 = p.2} ι
  _ = 12 * Fintype.card ι ^ 4 := congrArg (· * _) T_Fin3_diag

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (N) : IsGreatest (Set.range (T (ι := Fin (3 * N)))) (12 * N ^ 4)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · let κ := Fin 3 × Fin N
    obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (κ ≃ Fin (3 * N)) := by
      rw [← Fintype.card_eq, Fintype.card_prod]
      iterate 3 rw [Fintype.card_fin]
    use image (e.prodCongr e) {p : κ × κ | (p.1.1, p.2.1) ∈ diag univ}
    rw [T_image_equiv, T_Fin3_diag_product, Fintype.card_fin]
  
  · rintro _ ⟨S, rfl⟩
    refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (Nat.succ_pos 26 : 0 < 27)
    calc 27 * T S
      _ ≤ 4 * (Fintype.card (Fin (3 * N))) ^ 4 := T_ineq2 S
      _ = 4 * 3 ^ 4 * N ^ 4 := by rw [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.mul_pow, Nat.mul_assoc]
      _ = 27 * (12 * N ^ 4) := Nat.mul_assoc 27 12 _

name: prime_dvd_sq_sub_one_of_dvd_two_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_sq_sub_one_of_dvd_two_pow_sub_one
    {p x : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hp0 : p % 4 = 3) (hpx : p ∣ x ^ (2 ^ n) - 1) :
    p ∣ x ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | hx : x = 0 ∨ x > 0 := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x
  · rwa [Nat.zero_pow (Nat.two_pow_pos n)] at hpx
  
  replace hpx : (x : ZMod p) ^ (2 ^ n) = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ← Nat.cast_one, ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff]
    exact ((Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' (Nat.pow_pos hx)).mpr hpx).symm
  
  have hx0 : (x : ZMod p) ^ (p - 1) = 1 := by
    have : Fact (Nat.Prime p) := ⟨hp⟩
    refine ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one λ h ↦ zero_ne_one' (ZMod p) ?_
    rwa [h, zero_pow (Nat.two_pow_pos n).ne.symm] at hpx
  replace hpx : orderOf (x : ZMod p) ∣ Nat.gcd (2 ^ n) (p - 1) :=
    Nat.dvd_gcd (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hpx) (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hx0)
  
  replace hx0 : Nat.gcd (2 ^ n) (p - 1) ∣ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ : ∃ i ≤ n, Nat.gcd (2 ^ n) (p - 1) = 2 ^ i :=
      (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two).mp (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    suffices i ≤ 1 from (dvd_of_eq hi).trans (Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 this)
    refine Nat.le_of_not_gt λ hi0 ↦ ?_
    replace hi : 4 ∣ p - 1 := calc
      _ ∣ 2 ^ i := Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 hi0
      _ = Nat.gcd (2 ^ n) (p - 1) := hi.symm
      _ ∣ p - 1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _
    replace hi : 3 = 1 := hp0.symm.trans ((Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hp.one_le).mpr hi).symm
    revert hi; decide
  
  replace hpx : (x : ZMod p) ^ 2 = 1 := orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one.mp (hpx.trans hx0)
  rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ← Nat.cast_one, ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at hpx
  exact (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' (Nat.pow_pos hx)).mp hpx.symm

name: factorization_eq_of_modeq_of_lt
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_of_modeq_of_lt (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : a ≡ b [MOD c]) (h0 : Nat.factorization b p < Nat.factorization c p) :
    Nat.factorization a p = Nat.factorization b p
proof:
:= by
  
  have hp : Nat.Prime p :=
    by_contra λ h1 ↦ Nat.ne_zero_of_lt h0 (Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime c h1)
  refine eq_of_le_of_not_lt' ?_ (λ h1 ↦ ?_)
  
  · have h1 : ordProj[p] b ∣ c := Nat.pow_dvd_of_le_of_pow_dvd h0.le (Nat.ordProj_dvd c p)
    replace h : ordProj[p] b ∣ a := (h.symm.dvd_iff h1).mp (Nat.ordProj_dvd b p)
    exact (hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization ha).mp h
  
  · set t := b.factorization p
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl; exact Nat.ne_zero_of_lt h0 (Finsupp.ext_iff.mp Nat.factorization_zero p)
    replace h1 : p ^ (t + 1) ∣ a := (hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization ha).mpr h1
    replace h0 : p ^ (t + 1) ∣ c := (hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hc).mpr h0
    replace h : p ^ (t + 1) ∣ b := (h.dvd_iff h0).mp h1
    exact Nat.pow_succ_factorization_not_dvd hb hp h

name: Nat_prod_pow_range_factorization
statement:
lemma Nat_prod_pow_range_factorization {m n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hnm : n < m) :
    ∏ p ∈ range m, p ^ Nat.factorization n p = n
proof:
:= by
  
  refine (prod_congr_of_eq_on_inter ?_ ?_ ?_).trans
    (Nat.prod_pow_prime_padicValNat _ hn _ hnm)
  
  · intro p hp hp0
    replace hp0 : ¬Nat.Prime p := by rwa [mem_filter, and_iff_right hp] at hp0
    rw [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp0, Nat.pow_zero]
  
  · intro p hp; exact absurd (mem_of_mem_filter p hp)
  
  · rintro p - hp; exact congrArg (p ^ ·) (Nat.factorization_def n (mem_filter.mp hp).2)

name: exists_infinite_prime_3mod4_dvd_two_pow_mul_add_one
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_prime_3mod4_dvd_two_pow_mul_add_one {y : ℕ} (hy : y > 0) (N) :
    ∃ p ≥ N, Nat.Prime p ∧ p % 4 = 3 ∧ ∃ n, p ∣ 2 ^ n * y + 1
proof:
:= by
  
  wlog hy0 : ¬2 ∣ y
  · replace hy : y ≠ 0 := hy.ne.symm
    
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0, hp1, n, hn⟩ :
        ∃ p ≥ max N (y + 1), Nat.Prime p ∧ p % 4 = 3 ∧ ∃ n, p ∣ 2 ^ n * ordCompl[2] y + 1 :=
      this (Nat.ordCompl_pos _ hy) _ (Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl Nat.prime_two hy)
    
    refine ⟨p, le_of_max_le_left hp, hp0, hp1, n - y.factorization 2, ?_⟩
    have hn0 : y.factorization 2 ≤ n := by
      have hn0 : y + 1 ≤ 2 ^ n * ordCompl[2] y + 1 :=
        (le_of_max_le_right hp).trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos _) hn)
      replace hn0 : ordProj[2] y * ordCompl[2] y ≤ 2 ^ n * ordCompl[2] y :=
        (Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self y 2).trans_le (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hn0)
      rwa [Nat.mul_le_mul_right_iff (Nat.ordCompl_pos 2 hy),
        Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right Nat.one_lt_two] at hn0
    
    calc p
      _ ∣ 2 ^ n * ordCompl[2] y + 1 := hn
      _ = 2 ^ (n - y.factorization 2) * ordProj[2] y * ordCompl[2] y + 1 := by
        rw [← Nat.pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hn0]
      _ = 2 ^ (n - y.factorization 2) * y + 1 := by
        rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self]
  replace hy0 : y ≡ 1 [MOD 2] := Nat.two_dvd_ne_zero.mp hy0
  
  by_contra! hy1
  
  replace hy1 (p) (hp : p ≥ N) (hp0 : p % 4 ≠ 1) (n) :
      Nat.factorization (2 ^ (n + 1) * y + 1) p = 0 := by
    
    obtain hp1 | hp1 : ¬Nat.Prime p ∨ Nat.Prime p := dec_em' _
    · exact Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp1
    
    obtain rfl | hp2 : p = 2 ∨ p ≠ 2 := eq_or_ne _ _
    · rw [Nat.pow_succ', Nat.mul_assoc]
      exact Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (Nat.not_two_dvd_bit1 _)
    
    replace hp2 : p % 4 = 1 ∨ p % 4 = 3 := by
      rwa [← hp1.mod_two_eq_one_iff_ne_two, Nat.odd_mod_four_iff] at hp2
    exact Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (hy1 p hp hp1 (hp2.resolve_left hp0) _)
  
  let V : ℕ := 2 * y + 1
  let T : ℕ := V * ordCompl[2] (Nat.factorial N)
  let U : ℕ := 2 ^ (Nat.totient T + 1) * y + 1
  
  have hN : N.factorial ≠ 0 := Nat.factorial_ne_zero N
  have hT : Odd T := by
    refine Nat.odd_mul.mpr ⟨odd_two_mul_add_one y, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.odd_iff, ← Nat.mod_two_not_eq_zero, ← Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
    exact Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl Nat.prime_two hN
  have hT0 : U ≡ V [MOD T] :=
    calc 2 ^ (Nat.totient T + 1) * y + 1
    _ = 2 ^ Nat.totient T * (2 * y) + 1 := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ ≡ 1 * (2 * y) + 1 [MOD T] :=
      ((Nat.ModEq.pow_totient (Nat.coprime_two_left.mpr hT)).mul_right _).add_right 1
    _ = 2 * y + 1 := by rw [Nat.one_mul]
  
  have X (n) : n + 1 ≠ 0 := Nat.succ_ne_zero _
  replace hT0 (p) (hp : p ≤ N) : U.factorization p = V.factorization p := by
    
    obtain hp0 | hp0 : ¬Nat.Prime p ∨ Nat.Prime p := dec_em' _
    · iterate 2 rw [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp0]
    
    obtain rfl | hp1 : p = 2 ∨ p ≠ 2 := dec_em _
    · have h (n) : (2 * n + 1).factorization 2 = 0 :=
        (Nat.factorization_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Nat.not_two_dvd_bit1 n)))
      dsimp only [U, V]
      rw [h, Nat.pow_succ', Nat.mul_assoc, h]
    
    refine factorization_eq_of_modeq_of_lt (X _) (X _) hT0 ?_
    rw [Nat.factorization_mul (X _) (Nat.ordCompl_pos _ hN).ne.symm, Finsupp.add_apply,
      Nat.lt_add_right_iff_pos, Nat.factorization_ordCompl,
        Finsupp.erase_apply, ite_eq_right hp1]
    exact hp0.factorization_pos_of_dvd hN (Nat.dvd_factorial hp0.pos hp)
  
  replace hT0 (A : ℕ) :
      ∏ p ∈ range A, ((p ^ Nat.factorization U p : ℕ) : ZMod 4)
        = ∏ p ∈ range A, ((p ^ Nat.factorization V p : ℕ) : ZMod 4) := by
    refine prod_congr rfl λ p _ ↦ ?_
    
    obtain hp | hp : p ≤ N ∨ p ≥ N := Nat.le_total p N
    · exact congrArg (λ e ↦ ((p ^ e : ℕ) : ZMod 4)) (hT0 p hp)
    
    obtain hp0 | hp0 : p % 4 ≠ 1 ∨ p % 4 = 1 := ne_or_eq _ _
    · specialize hy1 p hp hp0
      exact congrArg (λ e ↦ ((p ^ e : ℕ) : ZMod 4)) ((hy1 _).trans (hy1 0).symm)
    
    replace hp0 : (p : ZMod 4) = 1 := ZMod.val_injective _ hp0
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_pow, hp0, one_pow, one_pow]
  replace hT0 : (U : ZMod 4) = V := by
    obtain ⟨A, hAU, hAV⟩ : ∃ A > U, A > V :=
      ⟨max U V + 1, max_lt_iff.mp (Nat.lt_succ_self _)⟩
    calc (U : ZMod 4)
      _ = (∏ p ∈ range A, p ^ Nat.factorization U p : ℕ) :=
        congrArg Nat.cast (Nat_prod_pow_range_factorization (X _) hAU).symm
      _ = ∏ p ∈ range A, ((p ^ Nat.factorization U p : ℕ) : ZMod 4) := prod_natCast _ _
      _ = ∏ p ∈ range A, ((p ^ Nat.factorization V p : ℕ) : ZMod 4) := hT0 A
      _ = (∏ p ∈ range A, p ^ Nat.factorization V p : ℕ) := (prod_natCast _ _).symm
      _ = V := congrArg Nat.cast (Nat_prod_pow_range_factorization (X _) hAV)
  replace hT0 : U ≡ V [MOD 4] := congrArg ZMod.val hT0
  
  clear hN X hy1 hy
  replace hT : T.totient > 0 := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hT.pos
  replace hT : 4 ∣ 2 ^ (Nat.totient T + 1) := Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (Nat.succ_le_succ hT)
  replace hT0 : 1 ≡ 3 [MOD 4] := calc
    1 ≡ 2 ^ (Nat.totient T + 1) * y + 1 [MOD 4] :=
      Nat.right_modEq_add_iff.mpr (Nat.dvd_mul_right_of_dvd hT _)
    _ ≡ 2 * y + 1 [MOD 4] := hT0
    _ ≡ 3 [MOD 4] := (hy0.mul_left' 2).add_right 1
  revert hT0; decide

name: eq_one_of_two_pow_mul_add_one_dvd_pow_two_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_two_pow_mul_add_one_dvd_pow_two_pow_sub_one
    (hx : x > 0) (hy : y > 0) (h : ∀ n, 2 ^ n * y + 1 ∣ x ^ (2 ^ n) - 1) : x = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0, hp1, n, hpn⟩ :
      ∃ p > x ^ 2 - 1, Nat.Prime p ∧ p % 4 = 3 ∧ ∃ n, p ∣ 2 ^ n * y + 1 :=
    exists_infinite_prime_3mod4_dvd_two_pow_mul_add_one hy _
  
  replace h : p ∣ x ^ (2 ^ n) - 1 := hpn.trans (h n)
  replace h : p ∣ x ^ 2 - 1 := prime_dvd_sq_sub_one_of_dvd_two_pow_sub_one hp0 hp1 h
  
  replace h : x ^ 2 - 1 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h hp
  rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le, Nat.pow_le_one_iff (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at h
  exact Nat.le_antisymm h hx

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {x y : ℕ} (hx : x > 0) (hy : y > 0)
    (h : ∀ n > 0, 2 ^ n * y + 1 ∣ x ^ (2 ^ n) - 1) : x = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  replace h (n) : 2 ^ n * (2 * y) + 1 ∣ (x ^ 2) ^ (2 ^ n) - 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_succ']
    exact h (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
  
  replace h : x ^ 2 = 1 :=
    eq_one_of_two_pow_mul_add_one_dvd_pow_two_pow_sub_one
      (Nat.pow_pos hx) (Nat.mul_pos Nat.two_pos hy) h
  exact (Nat.pow_eq_one.mp h).resolve_right (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)

name: good_iff_good'
statement: theorem good_iff_good' {f : R → S} : good f ↔ good' (f · + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine forall₂_congr λ x y ↦ ?_
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right, add_sub_cancel_right, ← add_assoc, add_left_inj]

name: RingHom_is_good'
statement: theorem RingHom_is_good' (φ : R →+* S) : good' φ
proof:
:= by
  intro x y; rw [φ.map_add, φ.map_one, φ.map_mul, sub_one_mul, mul_sub_one, sub_sub,
    ← add_sub_assoc, ← sub_add, φ.map_add, add_right_comm, sub_add_cancel]

name: eq2_map_one_sub
statement:
theorem eq2_map_one_sub [Ring R] [Ring S] {g : R → S} (hg : good' g) (x) :
    g (1 - x) = (g (-1) - 1) * (g x - 1) + g (x - 1)
proof:
:=
  calc g (1 - x)
  _ = g (-1 * x + 1) := by rw [neg_one_mul, sub_eq_neg_add]
  _ = (g (-1) - 1) * (g x - 1) + g (-1 + x) := hg (-1) x
  _ = (g (-1) - 1) * (g x - 1) + g (x - 1) := by rw [neg_add_eq_sub]

name: map_one_eq_one
statement: theorem map_one_eq_one : g 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := hg.eq2_map_one_sub 1
  rw [sub_self, right_eq_add, mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h.resolve_left hg0

name: map_zero_eq_zero
statement: theorem map_zero_eq_zero : g 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hg.eq2_map_one_sub 0
  rw [sub_zero, zero_sub, hg.map_one_eq_one hg0, eq_comm, mul_sub_one, sub_add,
    sub_sub_cancel_left, sub_neg_eq_add, add_eq_right, mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h.resolve_left hg0

name: eq3_map_one_add_add_map_one_sub
statement: theorem eq3_map_one_add_add_map_one_sub (x) : g (1 + x) + g (1 - x) = 2
proof:
:= by
  
  have hg1 (x) : g (-x) = (g (-1) - 1) * (g (1 + x) - 1) + g x := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel_left, add_sub_cancel_left] using hg.eq2_map_one_sub (1 + x)
  
  replace hg1 : (g (-1) - 1) * (g (1 + x) - 1 + (g (1 - x) - 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [mul_add, ← sub_eq_of_eq_add (hg1 x), sub_eq_add_neg 1 x,
      ← sub_eq_of_eq_add (hg1 (-x)), neg_neg, sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_self]
  rwa [mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero, or_iff_right hg0,
    ← add_sub_add_comm, sub_eq_zero, one_add_one_eq_two] at hg1

name: Real_odd
statement: theorem Real_odd (x) : g (-x) = -g x
proof:
:= by
  
  have hg1 (t) : g (1 + t) + g (1 - t) = 2 := hg.eq3_map_one_add_add_map_one_sub hg0 t
  
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ : ∃ c, ∀ u, g (u * (1 - u) + 1 + 2) - g (u * (1 - u) + 1) = c := by
    refine ⟨g 3 - g 1, λ u ↦ sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub.mp ?_⟩
    calc g (u * (1 - u) + 1 + 2) - g 3
      _ = g ((1 + (1 - u)) * (1 + u) + 1) - g ((1 + (1 - u)) + (1 + u)) :=
        congrArg₂ (g · - g ·) (by ring) (by ring)
      _ = (g (1 + (1 - u)) - 1) * (g (1 + u) - 1) := sub_eq_of_eq_add (hg _ _)
      _ = (2 - g (1 - (1 - u)) - 1) * (2 - g (1 - u) - 1) := by
        iterate 2 rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq (hg1 _)]
      _ = (g u - 1) * (g (1 - u) - 1) := by
        have h (a : S) : 2 - a - 1 = -(a - 1) := by
          rw [← one_add_one_eq_two, sub_sub, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, neg_sub]
        rw [sub_sub_cancel, h, h, neg_mul_neg]
      _ = g (u * (1 - u) + 1) - g 1 := by
        rw [hg, add_sub_cancel, add_sub_cancel_right]
  
  replace h (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≤ 0) : g (t + 2) - g t = c := by
    
    suffices ht : ∃ u, u * (1 - u) + 1 = t
      by rcases ht with ⟨u, rfl⟩; exact h u
    refine ⟨2⁻¹ + √(5 / 4 - t), ?_⟩
    replace ht : 0 ≤ 5 / 4 - t := sub_nonneg_of_le (ht.trans (by norm_num))
    ring_nf; rw [Real.sq_sqrt ht, sub_sub_cancel]
  
  obtain rfl : c = 2 := by
    have h0 : g 0 = 0 := hg.map_zero_eq_zero hg0
    have h1 : g 2 = 2 := calc
      _ = g (1 + 1) + g (1 - 1) := by rw [one_add_one_eq_two, sub_self, h0, add_zero]
      _ = 2 := hg1 1
    rw [← h 0 (le_refl 0), zero_add, h1, h0, sub_zero]
  
  wlog hx : x ≤ 0 generalizing x
  · replace hx : -x ≤ 0 := Right.neg_nonpos_iff.mpr (le_of_not_ge hx)
    rw [← neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, ← this _ hx, neg_neg]
  
  calc g (-x)
    _ = g (1 - (1 + x)) := by rw [sub_add_cancel_left]
    _ = 2 - g (1 + (1 + x)) := by rw [← hg1 (1 + x), add_sub_cancel_left]
    _ = g (x + 2) - g x - g (2 + x) := by rw [h x hx, ← add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two]
    _ = -g x := by rw [add_comm, sub_sub_cancel_left]

name: Real_is_hom
statement: theorem Real_is_hom : ∃ φ : ℝ →+* S, g = φ
proof:
:= by
  have h : g 1 = 1 := hg.map_one_eq_one hg0
  have h0 (x) : g (-x) = -g x := hg.Real_odd hg0 x
  
  replace hg0 : (2 : S) ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [h0, h, Ne, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, one_add_one_eq_two] at hg0
  
  have h1 (x y) : g (x * y + 1) = g x * g y + 1 + (g (x + y) - (g x + g y)) := by
    rw [hg, sub_one_mul, mul_sub_one, ← sub_add,
      sub_sub, ← add_sub_right_comm, ← add_comm_sub]
  
  replace h0 (x y) : g (x + y) = g x + g y := by
    
    have h2 := h1 (-x) (-y)
    rwa [neg_mul_neg, h0, h0, neg_mul_neg, ← neg_add, ← neg_add, sub_neg_eq_add,
      h1, add_right_inj, h0, neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero,
      ← two_mul, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right hg0, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at h2
  
  replace h1 (x y) : g (x * y) = g x * g y := by
    specialize h1 x y; rwa [h0, h0, sub_self, add_zero, h, add_left_inj] at h1
  
  exact ⟨RingHom.mk' ⟨⟨g, h⟩, h1⟩ h0, rfl⟩

name: good'_Real_iff
statement:
theorem good'_Real_iff [Ring S] [IsDomain S] {g : ℝ → S} :
    (good' g ∧ g (-1) ≠ 1) ↔ ∃ φ : ℝ →+* S, g = φ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, h0⟩; exact good'.Real_is_hom h h0
  · rintro ⟨φ, rfl⟩; refine ⟨RingHom_is_good' φ, λ hφ ↦ one_ne_zero' S ?_⟩
    replace hφ : φ 2 = 0 := calc
      _ = φ 1 + φ 1 := by rw [← φ.map_add, one_add_one_eq_two]
      _ = 1 - φ (-1) := by rw [φ.map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, φ.map_one]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hφ, sub_self]
    replace hφ : φ 2 * φ 2⁻¹ = 0 := mul_eq_zero_of_left hφ _
    rwa [← φ.map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, φ.map_one] at hφ

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [Ring S] [IsDomain S] {f : ℝ → S} :
    (good f ∧ f (-1) ≠ 0) ↔ ∃ φ : ℝ →+* S, f = (φ · - 1)
proof:
:=
  calc good f ∧ f (-1) ≠ 0
  _ ↔ good' (f · + 1) ∧ f (-1) + 1 ≠ 1 := by rw [good_iff_good', add_ne_right]
  _ ↔ ∃ φ : ℝ →+* S, f + 1 = φ := good'_Real_iff
  _ ↔ ∃ φ : ℝ →+* S, f = φ - 1 := by simp only [eq_sub_iff_add_eq]

name: admissible_ideal
statement: theorem admissible_ideal [CommSemiring R] (I : Ideal R) : admissible (I : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v h h0 r
  rw [sq, sq, add_assoc, ← add_mul]
  exact I.add_mem (I.mul_mem_left u h) (I.mul_mem_left _ h0)

name: mul_sq_mem
statement: theorem mul_sq_mem (hz : z ∈ A) (r : R) : r * z ^ 2 ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  convert hA z z hz hz (r - 2) using 1
  rw [add_right_comm, ← two_mul, mul_assoc, ← sq, ← add_mul, add_sub_cancel]

name: add_sq_mem
statement: theorem add_sq_mem (hx : x ∈ A) (hy : y ∈ A) : (x + y) ^ 2 ∈ A
proof:
:=
  add_sq x y ▸ hA x y hx hy 2

name: one_mem_imp
statement: theorem one_mem_imp (hA0 : 1 ∈ A) (z : R) : z ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [one_pow, mul_one] using hA.mul_sq_mem hA0 z

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [CommRing R] {x y : R} :
    (∀ A : Set R, admissible A → x ∈ A → y ∈ A → ∀ z : R, z ∈ A) ↔ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hxy ↦ ?_, λ hxy A hA hx hy ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · rw [IsCoprime, ← Ideal.mem_span_pair]
    exact hxy (Ideal.span {x, y}) (admissible_ideal _)
      (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert x _))
      (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem x rfl)) 1
  
  · apply hA.one_mem_imp
    obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ : IsCoprime (x ^ 2) (y ^ 2) := IsCoprime.pow hxy
    simpa only [h, one_pow] using hA.add_sq_mem (hA.mul_sq_mem hx a) (hA.mul_sq_mem hy b)

name: good_two_mul_add_one
statement:
theorem good_two_mul_add_one [Field F] [CharZero F] (h : good F k c) :
    good F (k + 1) (2 * c + 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  intro n h0
  obtain ⟨t, rfl | rfl⟩ : ∃ t, n = 2 * t ∨ n = 2 * t + 1 := n.even_or_odd'
  
  · 
    obtain ⟨T, rfl, h1, h2⟩ : ∃ T : Multiset ℕ, T.card = k ∧ (∀ m ∈ T, 0 < m) ∧
        ((t + c : ℕ) : F) / t = (T.map λ m ↦ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : F) / m).prod :=
      h t (Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left h0)
    replace h0 : 0 < t + c := t.add_pos_left (Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left h0) c
    
    refine ⟨(2 * (t + c)) ::ₘ T, T.card_cons _,
      forall_mem_cons.mpr ⟨Nat.mul_pos Nat.two_pos h0, h1⟩, ?_⟩
    
    calc ((2 * t + (2 * c + 1) : ℕ) : F) / (2 * t : ℕ)
    _ = (2 * (t + c) + 1 : ℕ) / (2 * t : ℕ) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_assoc]
    _ = (2 * (t + c) + 1 : ℕ) / (2 * (t + c) : ℕ) * ((t + c : ℕ) / t) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, ← div_div, ← div_div,
        div_mul_div_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr h0.ne.symm)]
    _ = ((2 * (t + c) ::ₘ T).map λ (m : ℕ) ↦ (m.succ : F) / m).prod := by
      rw [map_cons, prod_cons, ← h2]
  
  · 
    obtain ⟨T, rfl, h1, h2⟩ : ∃ T : Multiset ℕ, T.card = k ∧ (∀ m ∈ T, 0 < m) ∧
        ((t + 1 + c : ℕ) : F) / (t + 1 : ℕ) = (T.map λ m ↦ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : F) / m).prod :=
      h (t + 1) t.succ_pos
    
    refine ⟨(2 * t + 1) ::ₘ T, T.card_cons _, forall_mem_cons.mpr ⟨h0, h1⟩, ?_⟩
    
    calc ((2 * t + 1 + (2 * c + 1) : ℕ) : F) / (2 * t + 1 : ℕ)
    _ = (2 * (t + c + 1) : ℕ) / (2 * t + 1 : ℕ) := by
      rw [Nat.add_add_add_comm, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_add]
    _ = (2 * (t + 1) : ℕ) / (2 * t + 1 : ℕ) * ((t + c + 1 : ℕ) / (t + 1 : ℕ)) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc, mul_assoc,
        div_mul_div_cancel₀' (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr t.succ_ne_zero)]
    _ = (((2 * t + 1) ::ₘ T).map λ (m : ℕ) ↦ (m.succ : F) / m).prod := by
      rw [map_cons, prod_cons, ← h2, Nat.add_right_comm]; rfl

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (F) [Field F] [CharZero F] (k) : good F k (2 ^ k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro n hn; exact ⟨0, rfl, λ m h ↦ absurd h (notMem_zero m),
        div_self (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne.symm)⟩
  | succ k hk =>
      suffices 2 ^ (k + 1) - 1 = 2 * (2 ^ k - 1) + 1 from this ▸ good_two_mul_add_one hk
      have h : 1 ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.one_le_two_pow
      rw [Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel h,
        Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_two, Nat.sub_add_comm h]

name: general_result
statement:
theorem general_result [LinearOrder α]
    (f : ℕ → α) (hf : ∀ n, f ((n + 1) ^ 2) = max (f n) (f (n + 1))) (N) :
    ∃ n ≥ N, f (n ^ 2) = f ((n + 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  by_contra h
  
  replace h (n) (hn : N ≤ n) (hn0 : f n ≤ f (n + 1)) : f (n + 1) < f (n + 2) := by
    
    refine not_le.mp λ h0 ↦ h ⟨n + 1, Nat.le_succ_of_le hn, ?_⟩
    rw [hf, hf, max_eq_right hn0, max_eq_left h0]
  
  replace h (n) (hn : N ≤ n) : f (n + 1) < f n := by
    
    refine not_le.mp λ hn0 ↦ ?_
    
    replace hf : f ((n + 2) ^ 2) = f (n + 2) := by
      rw [hf, max_eq_right (h n hn hn0).le]
    
    replace h : ∀ k > n, f k < f (k + 1) :=
      Nat.le_induction (h n hn hn0) λ k hnk hk ↦ h k ((Nat.le_succ_of_le hn).trans hnk) hk.le
    replace h : ∀ k > n, ∀ m > k, f k < f m :=
      λ k hk ↦ Nat.le_induction (h k hk) λ m hm ↦ (h m (hk.trans hm)).trans'
    
    replace hn : f (n + 2) < f ((n + 2) ^ 2) := by
      refine h _ (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right Nat.two_pos) _ (?_ : n + 2 < (n + 2) ^ 2)
      calc n + 2
        _ = (n + 2) ^ 1 := (Nat.pow_one _).symm
        _ < (n + 2) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (Nat.one_lt_succ_succ n) Nat.one_lt_two
    
    exact hn.ne hf.symm
  
  have h0 (n) (h0 : N ≤ n) : ∀ k, n ≤ k → f k ≤ f n :=
    Nat.le_induction (le_refl _) (λ k h1 ↦ (h k (h0.trans h1)).le.trans)
  
  replace h : f (N + 1) < f N :=
    h _ (Nat.le_refl N)
  replace h0 : f ((N + 1) ^ 2) ≤ f (N + 1) :=
    h0 _ (Nat.le_succ N) _ (Nat.le_self_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1) _)
  replace hf : f N ≤ f ((N + 1) ^ 2) :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans_eq (hf N).symm
  exact (hf.trans h0).not_gt h

name: foldr_max_zero_append
statement:
theorem foldr_max_zero_append (l l' : List ℕ) :
    (l ++ l').foldr max 0 = max (l.foldr max 0) (l'.foldr max 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing l' with
  | nil => exact (Nat.zero_max _).symm
  | cons a l ih => rw [List.cons_append, List.foldr_cons, List.foldr_cons, ih, max_assoc]

name: special_formula
proof:
:=
  let s : ℕ := n ^ 2 + n + 1
  have hn : (n + 1) ^ 2 = s + n := by
    rw [Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.succ_mul,
      Nat.add_comm n, ← Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.pow_two]
  calc ((n + 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 + (n + 1) ^ 2 + 1
  _ = (s + (n + 1)) * (n + 1) ^ 2 + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.add_one_mul, hn, Nat.add_assoc]
  _ = s * (n + 1) ^ 2 + ((n + 1) * (s + n) + 1) := by
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_assoc, ← hn]
  _ = s * (n + 1) ^ 2 + (s * (n + 1) + s) := by
    rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_comm _ s, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.succ_mul n, ← Nat.pow_two]
  _ = s * ((n + 1) ^ 2 + (n + 1) + 1) := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_assoc]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    ∀ N, ∃ n ≥ N, (n ^ 4 + n ^ 2 + 1).primeFactorsList.foldr max 0
      = ((n + 1) ^ 4 + (n + 1) ^ 2 + 1).primeFactorsList.foldr max 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nat.pow_mul _ 2 2]
  refine general_result (λ n ↦ (n ^ 2 + n + 1).primeFactorsList.foldr max 0) ?_
  have h0 (n) : n ^ 2 + n + 1 ≠ 0 := Nat.succ_ne_zero _
  intro n; rw [special_formula, ← foldr_max_zero_append]
  exact (Nat.perm_primeFactorsList_mul (h0 n) (h0 (n + 1))).foldr_eq _

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {f : ℕ+ → ℕ+} :
    (∀ m n : ℕ+, m * m + f n ∣ m * f m + n) ↔ f = id
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h m n ↦ h ▸ dvd_refl _⟩
  
  refine funext λ n ↦ le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  
  · apply PNat.le_of_dvd
    replace h : (f n : ℕ) ∣ f n * f (f n) + n :=
      PNat.dvd_iff.mp <| (Dvd.intro (f n + 1) rfl).trans (h (f n) n)
    rwa [Nat.dvd_add_right ⟨_, rfl⟩, ← PNat.dvd_iff] at h
  
  · 
    obtain rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩ : n = 1 ∨ ∃ k, n = k + 1 :=
      (eq_or_ne n 1).imp_right PNat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_one
    
    · exact one_le
    
    · replace h := PNat.le_of_dvd (h (k + 1) (k + 1))
      rw [add_one_mul k, add_right_comm, add_assoc, add_one_mul k, add_assoc] at h
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left' (le_of_add_le_add_right h)

name: d_strictAnti
statement:
theorem d_strictAnti {z : ℕ → ℤ} (hz : StrictMono z) :
    StrictAnti (λ n ↦ ∑ i ∈ range (n + 2), z i - (n + 1 : ℕ) * z (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine strictAnti_nat_of_succ_lt λ n ↦ ?_
  rw [sum_range_succ, add_sub_right_comm, sub_add, Int.sub_lt_sub_left_iff,
    Int.natCast_succ (n + 1), Int.add_mul _ _ (z (n + 2)), Int.one_mul, Int.add_sub_cancel]
  exact Int.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hz (Nat.lt_succ_self _))
    (Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n))

name: existsUnique_d_pos_d_succ_neg
statement:
theorem existsUnique_d_pos_d_succ_neg {d : ℕ → ℤ} (hd : StrictAnti d) (hd0 : d 0 > 0) :
    ∃! n, d n > 0 ∧ d (n + 1) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique ?_ ?_
  
  · by_contra! hd1
    replace hd1 : ∀ n, d n > 0 := Nat.rec hd0 hd1
    replace hd (n) : d n ≤ d 0 - n := by
      induction n with | zero => exact Int.le.intro 0 rfl | succ n n_ih => ?_
      rw [Int.natCast_succ, ← Int.sub_sub, Int.le_sub_one_iff]
      exact (hd (Nat.lt_add_one n)).trans_le n_ih
    lift d 0 to ℕ using hd0.le with k hk
    exact Int.not_le_of_gt (hd1 k) ((hd _).trans_eq (Int.sub_self _))
  
  · rintro n N ⟨hn, hn0⟩ ⟨hN, hN0⟩
    replace hd : Antitone d := hd.antitone
    by_contra h; obtain h0 | h0 : n < N ∨ N < n := Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne h
    exacts [Int.not_le_of_gt hN ((hd h0).trans hn0), Int.not_le_of_gt hn ((hd h0).trans hN0)]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {z : ℕ → ℤ} (hz : StrictMono z) (hz0 : z 0 > 0) :
    ∃! n > 0, n * z n < ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), z i ∧
      ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), z i ≤ n * z (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  let d (n : ℕ) : ℤ := ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), z i - n * z n
  
  suffices ∃! n > 0, 0 < d n ∧ d (n + 1) ≤ 0 by
    conv at this =>
      right; ext n; right; rw [Int.sub_pos]
      right; rw [← not_lt, Int.sub_pos, Int.natCast_succ, sum_range_succ,
        Int.add_mul, Int.one_mul, Int.add_lt_add_iff_right, not_lt]
    exact this
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn0⟩ : ∃! n, d (n + 1) > 0 ∧ d (n + 2) ≤ 0 := by
    refine existsUnique_d_pos_d_succ_neg (d_strictAnti hz) (?_ : _ - _ > (0 : ℤ))
    rwa [sum_range_succ, sum_range_one, Int.natCast_one, Int.one_mul, add_sub_cancel_right]
  
  refine ⟨n + 1, ⟨Nat.succ_pos n, hn⟩, λ y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ : ∃ N, y = N + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hy.1.ne.symm
  exact congrArg (· + 1) (hn0 N hy.2)

name: case_odd
statement: theorem case_odd (hn : n > 1) (h : n % 2 = 1) (k) : n ^ (n ^ k) / n ^ k % 2 = 1
proof:
:=
  calc n ^ (n ^ k) / n ^ k % 2
  _ = n ^ (n ^ k - k) % 2 :=
    congrArg (· % 2) (Nat.pow_div (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_pow_self hn)) (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn))
  _ = 1 := by rw [Nat.pow_mod, h, Nat.one_pow]

name: div_odd_of_even_mod_eq_one
statement: theorem div_odd_of_even_mod_eq_one (ha : 2 ∣ a) (hab : a % b = 1) : a / b % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain hb | hb : b % 2 = 0 ∨ b % 2 = 1 := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one b
  
  · rcases ha with ⟨c, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : 2 ∣ b := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hb
    replace hab : 2 ∣ 1 := ⟨c % d, hab.symm.trans (Nat.mul_mod_mul_left _ _ _)⟩
    have h : ¬2 ∣ 1 := by decide
    exact absurd hab h
  
  · calc a / b % 2
    _ = (b * (a / b) + a % b + 1) % 2 := by
      rw [Nat.add_assoc, hab, Nat.add_mod_right, ← Nat.mod_mul_mod, hb, Nat.one_mul]
    _ = 1 := by rw [Nat.div_add_mod, ← Nat.mod_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd ha]

name: case_two
statement: theorem case_two (hk : k > 0) : 2 ^ (3 * 4 ^ k) / (3 * 4 ^ k) % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have hk0 : 2 * k < 3 * 4 ^ k :=
    Nat.mul_lt_mul'' (Nat.lt_succ_self 2) (Nat.lt_pow_self (by decide))
  let e : Nat := 3 * 4 ^ k - 2 * k
  have he : e > 0 := Nat.zero_lt_sub_of_lt hk0
  have he0 : 2 ∣ e := by
    refine Nat.dvd_sub (Nat.dvd_mul_left_of_dvd ⟨2 * 4 ^ (k - 1), ?_⟩ _) ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_add_one', Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
  replace he0 : 2 ^ e % 3 = 1 := calc
    _ = 4 ^ (e / 2) % 3 := by rw [← Nat.pow_mul 2 2, Nat.mul_div_cancel' he0]
    _ = 1 := by rw [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow]
  
  calc 2 ^ (3 * 4 ^ k) / (3 * 4 ^ k) % 2
    _ = 2 ^ e / 3 % 2 := by
      rw [← Nat.pow_div (Nat.le_of_lt hk0) Nat.two_pos,
        Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, Nat.pow_mul 2 2, Nat.mul_comm _ 3]
    _ = 1 := div_odd_of_even_mod_eq_one (Nat.div_pow_of_pos _ _ he) he0

name: pow_mod_eq_of_modeq_mul_pow_add_one
statement:
theorem pow_mod_eq_of_modeq_mul_pow_add_one (hk : k > 0) (n m b : ℕ) :
    (m * n ^ k + 1) ^ b ≡ m * b * n ^ k + 1 [MOD n ^ (k + 1)]
proof:
:= by
  
  induction b with
  | zero => rw [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_mul]
  | succ b b_ih => ?_
  
  calc (m * n ^ k + 1) ^ b * (m * n ^ k + 1)
    _ ≡ (m * b * n ^ k + 1) * (m * n ^ k + 1) [MOD n ^ (k + 1)] := b_ih.mul_right _
    _ = m * b * n ^ k * (m * n ^ k) + (m * (b + 1) * n ^ k + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_assoc,
        Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_assoc]
    _ = m * b * m * n ^ (k - 1) * n ^ (k + 1) + (m * (b + 1) * n ^ k + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.add_left_inj, Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm, ← Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_assoc (_ * m),
        ← Nat.pow_add, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
    _ ≡ m * (b + 1) * n ^ k + 1 [MOD n ^ (k + 1)] := Nat.mul_modulus_add_modEq_iff.mpr rfl

name: pow_modeq_one_of_modeq_one
statement:
theorem pow_modeq_one_of_modeq_one (hk : k > 0) (h : a ≡ 1 [MOD n ^ k]) :
    a ^ n ≡ 1 [MOD n ^ (k + 1)]
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | zero =>
      replace h : n ^ k ∣ 1 := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h.symm
      rw [Nat.dvd_one, Nat.pow_eq_one, or_iff_left hk.ne.symm] at h
      rw [h, Nat.one_pow]; rfl
  | succ b =>
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : n ^ k ∣ b := Nat.add_modEq_right_iff.mp h
      calc (n ^ k * m + 1) ^ n
        _ = (m * n ^ k + 1) ^ n := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]
        _ ≡ m * n * n ^ k + 1 [MOD n ^ (k + 1)] :=
          pow_mod_eq_of_modeq_mul_pow_add_one hk _ _ _
        _ ≡ 1 [MOD n ^ (k + 1)] := by
          rw [Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_add_one', Nat.add_modEq_right_iff]
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _

name: pow_pow_modeq_one_of_modeq_one
statement:
theorem pow_pow_modeq_one_of_modeq_one (hk : k > 0) (h : a ≡ 1 [MOD n ^ k]) (t) :
    a ^ (n ^ t) ≡ 1 [MOD n ^ (k + t)]
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => rwa [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.pow_one, Nat.add_zero]
  | succ t t_ih => calc a ^ (n ^ t * n)
      _ = (a ^ (n ^ t)) ^ n := Nat.pow_mul _ _ _
      _ ≡ 1 [MOD n ^ (k + t + 1)] := pow_modeq_one_of_modeq_one (Nat.add_pos_left hk t) t_ih

name: add_one_pow_pow_modeq_one
statement: theorem add_one_pow_pow_modeq_one (n k) : (n + 1) ^ (n ^ k) ≡ 1 [MOD n ^ (k + 1)]
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.add_comm k 1 ▸ pow_pow_modeq_one_of_modeq_one Nat.one_pos ?_ k
  rw [Nat.pow_one, Nat.add_modEq_right_iff]

name: add_one_pow_pow_mod_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem add_one_pow_pow_mod_pow_eq_one (hn : n > 1) (hk : k > 0) :
    (n + 1) ^ (n ^ k) % n ^ k = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc (n + 1) ^ (n ^ k) % n ^ k
    _ = 1 % n ^ k := (add_one_pow_pow_modeq_one _ _).of_dvd ⟨n, rfl⟩
    _ = 1 := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.one_lt_pow (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hk) hn)

name: case_even
statement:
theorem case_even (hn : n > 1) (hn0 : 2 ∣ n + 1) (hk : k > 0) :
    (n + 1) ^ (n ^ k) / n ^ k % 2 = 1
proof:
:=
  div_odd_of_even_mod_eq_one
    (Nat.dvd_trans hn0 (Nat.div_pow_of_pos _ _ (Nat.pow_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn))))
    (add_one_pow_pow_mod_pow_eq_one hn hk)

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (hn : n > 1) (N) : ∃ k > N, n ^ k / k % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain hn0 | hn0 : n % 2 = 1 ∨ n % 2 = 0 := (Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one n).symm
  · exact ⟨n ^ N, Nat.lt_pow_self hn, case_odd hn hn0 N⟩
  
  obtain rfl | hn1 : 2 = n ∨ n > 2 := Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hn
  · refine ⟨3 * 4 ^ (N + 1), ?_, case_two (Nat.succ_pos N)⟩
    calc N
      _ < 4 ^ N := Nat.lt_pow_self (by decide)
      _ ≤ 12 * 4 ^ N := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by decide)
      _ = 3 * 4 ^ (N + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ', ← Nat.mul_assoc]
  
  cases n with | zero => exact absurd hn1 (Nat.not_lt_zero _) | succ n => ?_
  replace hn1 : n > 1 := Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hn1
  exact ⟨n ^ (N + 1), Nat.lt_of_add_right_lt (Nat.lt_pow_self hn1),
    case_even hn1 (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hn0) (Nat.succ_pos N)⟩

name: exists_le_card_eq_of_card_le
statement:
theorem exists_le_card_eq_of_card_le {M : Multiset α} (hnM : n ≤ M.card) :
    ∃ S ≤ M, S.card = n
proof:
:= by
  
  induction M using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => exact ⟨0, zero_le _, (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hnM).symm⟩
  | cons a M M_ih => ?_
  
  obtain h | h : (a ::ₘ M).card = n ∨ n < (a ::ₘ M).card := hnM.eq_or_lt'
  · exact ⟨a ::ₘ M, le_refl _, h⟩
  
  rw [card_cons, Nat.lt_add_one_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨S, hSM, hSn⟩ : ∃ S ≤ M, S.card = n := M_ih h
  exact ⟨S, hSM.trans (M.le_cons_self a), hSn⟩

name: AM_GM_Multiset_Nat_card_eq_two_pow
statement:
theorem AM_GM_Multiset_Nat_card_eq_two_pow {M : Multiset ℕ} (h : M.card = 2 ^ n) :
    (2 ^ n) ^ (2 ^ n) * M.prod ≤ M.sum ^ (2 ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  
  induction n generalizing M with | zero => ?_ | succ n n_ih => ?_
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, M = {k} := card_eq_one.mp h
    rw [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.pow_one, Nat.one_mul, Nat.pow_one, prod_singleton, sum_singleton]
  
  replace h : M.card = 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by rw [h, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
  obtain ⟨S, hT, hS⟩ : ∃ S ≤ M, S.card = 2 ^ n :=
    exists_le_card_eq_of_card_le ((Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans_eq h.symm)
  obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ : ∃ T, M = S + T := Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mp hT
  replace hT : T.card = 2 ^ n := by rwa [card_add, hS, Nat.add_right_inj] at h
  clear h
  
  calc (2 ^ (n + 1)) ^ 2 ^ (n + 1) * (S + T).prod
    _ = (4 * (2 ^ n * 2 ^ n)) ^ (2 ^ n) * (S + T).prod := by
      rw [Nat.pow_succ', Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_pow, ← Nat.pow_two]
    _ = 4 ^ (2 ^ n) * (((2 ^ n) ^ (2 ^ n) * S.prod) * ((2 ^ n) ^ (2 ^ n) * T.prod)) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_pow, Nat.mul_pow, Nat.mul_assoc, prod_add, mul_mul_mul_comm]
    _ ≤ 4 ^ (2 ^ n) * (S.sum ^ (2 ^ n) * T.sum ^ (2 ^ n)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul (n_ih hS) (n_ih hT))
    _ = (4 * S.sum * T.sum) ^ (2 ^ n) := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_pow, Nat.mul_pow]
    _ ≤ ((S.sum + T.sum) ^ 2) ^ (2 ^ n) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (four_mul_le_sq_add _ _) _
    _ = (S + T).sum ^ 2 ^ (n + 1) := by rw [sum_add, Nat.pow_succ' (n := n), Nat.pow_mul]

name: card_eq
statement: theorem card_eq (h : good M N) : M.card = N.card
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨T, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩
  iterate 2 rw [card_add, card_pair]

name: chain_card_eq
statement:
theorem chain_card_eq (hMl : List.IsChain good (M :: l)) (hMk : M.card = k) :
    ((M :: l).getLast (l.cons_ne_nil M)).card = k
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing M with
  | nil => exact hMk
  | cons N l l_ih => exact l_ih hMl.of_cons (hMl.rel.card_eq.symm.trans hMk)

name: four_mul_prod_le
statement: theorem four_mul_prod_le (h : good M N) : 4 * M.prod ≤ N.prod
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨T, a, b, rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [prod_add, prod_pair, prod_add, prod_pair,
    ← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_two]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (four_mul_le_pow_two_add a b)

name: chain_four_pow_prod_le
statement:
theorem chain_four_pow_prod_le (hMl : List.IsChain good (M :: l)) :
    4 ^ l.length * M.prod ≤ ((M :: l).getLast (l.cons_ne_nil M)).prod
proof:
:= by
  
  induction l generalizing M with
  | nil => exact Nat.le_of_eq (Nat.one_mul _)
  | cons N l l_ih => ?_
  
  calc 4 ^ (l.length + 1) * M.prod
    _ = 4 ^ l.length * (4 * M.prod) := Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _
    _ ≤ 4 ^ l.length * N.prod := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hMl.rel.four_mul_prod_le
    _ ≤ ((N :: l).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)).prod := l_ih hMl.of_cons
    _ = ((M :: N :: l).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)).prod :=
      congrArg prod (List.getLast_cons _).symm

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {m l} (hm : m > 0) (hlm : l.length = m * 2 ^ (m - 1))
    (hlm0 : List.IsChain good (replicate (2 ^ m) 1 :: l)) :
    4 ^ m ≤ ((replicate (2 ^ m) 1 :: l).getLast (l.cons_ne_nil _)).sum
proof:
:= by
  
  set M : Multiset ℕ := replicate (2 ^ m) 1
  set L : Multiset ℕ := (M :: l).getLast (l.cons_ne_nil _)
  
  have h : (2 ^ m) ^ (2 ^ m) ≤ L.prod := calc
    _ = 4 ^ l.length * M.prod := by
      rw [prod_replicate, Nat.one_pow, Nat.mul_one, hlm, ← Nat.pow_mul,
        ← Nat.pow_mul 2 2, Nat.mul_left_comm, ← Nat.pow_add_one', Nat.sub_add_cancel hm]
    _ ≤ L.prod := good.chain_four_pow_prod_le hlm0
  
  replace h : (4 ^ m) ^ (2 ^ m) ≤ L.sum ^ (2 ^ m) := calc
    _ = (2 ^ m) ^ (2 ^ m) * (2 ^ m) ^ (2 ^ m) := by rw [Nat.mul_pow 2 2, Nat.mul_pow]
    _ ≤ (2 ^ m) ^ (2 ^ m) * L.prod := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h
    _ ≤ L.sum ^ (2 ^ m) :=
      AM_GM_Multiset_Nat_card_eq_two_pow (good.chain_card_eq hlm0 (card_replicate _ _))
  exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_left (Nat.two_pow_pos _).ne.symm).mp h

name: f_of_lt_invOf_two
statement: theorem f_of_lt_invOf_two {x : R} (hx : x < ⅟2) : f x = x + ⅟2
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left hx

name: f_of_invOf_two_le
statement: theorem f_of_invOf_two_le {x : R} (hx : ⅟2 ≤ x) : f x = x ^ 2
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right hx.not_gt

name: f_pos
statement: theorem f_pos {x : R} (hx : x > 0) : f x > 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold f; split_ifs
  exacts [add_pos hx (invOf_pos.mp two_pos), pow_pos hx 2]

name: f_iterate_pos
statement: theorem f_iterate_pos {x : R} (hx : x > 0) (n : ℕ) : f^[n] x > 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with | zero => exact hx | succ n n_ih => exact n_ih (f_pos hx)

name: f_lt_one
statement: theorem f_lt_one {x : R} (hx0 : x < 1) : f x < 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold f; split_ifs with hx1
  · rwa [← invOf_two_add_invOf_two, add_lt_add_iff_right]
  · replace hx1 : 0 ≤ x := (invOf_nonneg.mpr zero_le_two).trans (not_lt.mp hx1)
    exact pow_lt_one₀ hx1 hx0 (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)

name: f_iterate_lt_one
statement: theorem f_iterate_lt_one {x : R} (hx : x < 1) (n : ℕ) : f^[n] x < 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with | zero => exact hx | succ n n_ih => exact n_ih (f_lt_one hx)

name: f_sub_f_of_lt_invOf_two
statement:
theorem f_sub_f_of_lt_invOf_two {a b : R} (ha : a < ⅟2) (hb : b < ⅟2) :
    f b - f a = b - a
proof:
:= by
  rw [f_of_lt_invOf_two ha, f_of_lt_invOf_two hb, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]

name: f_sub_f_of_invOf_two_le
statement:
theorem f_sub_f_of_invOf_two_le {a b : R} (ha : ⅟2 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (b - a) + (b - a) ^ 2 ≤ f b - f a
proof:
:= calc
  _ = (b - a) * (1 + (b - a)) := by rw [sq, mul_one_add]
  _ ≤ (b - a) * (a + a + (b - a)) :=
    have ha0 : 1 ≤ a + a := invOf_two_add_invOf_two.symm.trans_le (add_le_add ha ha)
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add_left ha0 _) (sub_nonneg_of_le hab)
  _ = b ^ 2 - a ^ 2 := by rw [sq_sub_sq, add_add_sub_cancel, add_comm, mul_comm]
  _ = f b - f a := by rw [f_of_invOf_two_le ha, f_of_invOf_two_le (ha.trans hab)]

name: main_lemma
statement:
theorem main_lemma
    {a b : R} (ha : a > 0) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b < 1) (h : 0 ≤ (f a - a) * (f b - b)) :
    (b - a + (b - a) ^ 2 ≤ f b - f a) ∨
      (f b - f a = b - a ∧ b - a + (b - a) ^ 2 ≤ f (f b) - f (f a))
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : b > 0 := ha.trans_le hab
  
  refine (le_or_gt ⅟2 a).imp (λ ha0 ↦ f_sub_f_of_invOf_two_le ha0 hab) (λ ha0 ↦ ?_)
  
  obtain hb1 | hb1 : ⅟2 ≤ b ∨ b < ⅟2 := le_or_gt _ _
  · refine absurd (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ?_ ?_) h.not_gt
    
    · rw [f_of_lt_invOf_two ha0, add_sub_cancel_left, invOf_pos]
      exact zero_lt_two
    
    · rw [f_of_invOf_two_le hb1, sq, ← mul_sub_one]
      exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hb0 (sub_neg.mpr hb)
  
  replace h : f b - f a = b - a := f_sub_f_of_lt_invOf_two ha0 hb1
  have h0 : ⅟2 ≤ f a := calc
    _ ≤ a + ⅟2 := le_add_of_nonneg_left ha.le
    _ = f a := (f_of_lt_invOf_two ha0).symm
  have h1 : f a ≤ f b := by rwa [← sub_nonneg, h, sub_nonneg]
  exact ⟨h, h ▸ f_sub_f_of_invOf_two_le h0 h1⟩

name: exists_diff_iterate_mul_diff_iterate_neg
statement:
theorem exists_diff_iterate_mul_diff_iterate_neg :
    ∃ n, (f^[n + 1] a - f^[n] a) * (f^[n + 1] b - f^[n] b) < 0
proof:
:= by
  replace ha (n : ℕ) : f^[n] a > 0 := f_iterate_pos ha n
  replace hb (n : ℕ) : f^[n] b < 1 := f_iterate_lt_one hb n
  
  by_contra! h
  
  let d (n : ℕ) : R := f^[n] b - f^[n] a
  /- First, `d_n ≥ 0` implies either (1). `d_{n + 1} ≥ d_n + d_n^2`; or
    (2). `d_{n + 1} = d_n` and `d_{m + 2} ≥ d_n + d_n^2`. -/
  replace h (n) (hn : 0 ≤ d n) :
      d n + d n ^ 2 ≤ d (n + 1) ∨ (d (n + 1) = d n ∧ d n + d n ^ 2 ≤ d (n + 2)) := by
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ (f (f^[n] a) - f^[n] a) * (f (f^[n] b) - f^[n] b) := by
      simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] using h n
    simp_rw [d, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact main_lemma (ha n) (sub_nonneg.mp hn) (hb n) hn0
  
  have hd : d 0 > 0 := sub_pos.mpr hab
  have hd0 (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 ≤ d n) : d n ≤ d (n + 1) := by
    obtain hn0 | ⟨hn0, -⟩ : d n + d n ^ 2 ≤ d (n + 1) ∨ (d (n + 1) = d n ∧ _) := h n hn
    exacts [le_of_add_le_of_nonneg_left hn0 (sq_nonneg _), hn0.ge]
  replace hd0 : Monotone d := by
    refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ λ n ↦ hd0 n ?_
    induction n with | zero => exact hd.le | succ n n_ih => exact n_ih.trans (hd0 n n_ih)
  have hd1 (n : ℕ) : d n ≥ 0 := hd.le.trans (hd0 (Nat.zero_le n))
  
  replace h (n) : d n + d 0 ^ 2 ≤ d (n + 2) := calc
    _ ≤ d n + d n ^ 2 := add_le_add_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ hd.le (hd0 (Nat.zero_le n)) 2) _
    _ ≤ d (n + 2) := (h n (hd1 n)).elim (hd0 (Nat.le_succ _)).trans' And.right
  
  replace h (n) : n • d 0 ^ 2 < d (2 * n) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => rwa [zero_nsmul]
    | succ n n_ih =>
        calc (n + 1) • d 0 ^ 2
        _ = n • d 0 ^ 2 + d 0 ^ 2 := succ_nsmul _ _
        _ < d (2 * n) + d 0 ^ 2 := add_lt_add_left n_ih _
        _ ≤ d (2 * (n + 1)) := h _
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N, N • d 0 ^ 2 ≥ 1 := Archimedean.arch _ (pow_pos hd 2)
  
  refine hN.not_gt ?_
  calc N • d 0 ^ 2
    _ < f^[2 * N] b - f^[2 * N] a := h _
    _ < 1 - 0 := sub_lt_sub (hb _) (ha _)
    _ = 1 := sub_zero _

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : ∃ n > 0, (f^[n] a - f^[n - 1] a) * (f^[n] b - f^[n - 1] b) < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, (f^[n + 1] a - f^[n] a) * (f^[n + 1] b - f^[n] b) < 0 :=
    exists_diff_iterate_mul_diff_iterate_neg ha hab hb
  exact ⟨n + 1, Nat.succ_pos n, hn⟩

name: refl
statement: @[refl] protected lemma refl (X) : X ==> X
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [replicate_zero, Multiset.add_zero] using manip_zeroes X 0 0

name: trans
statement: @[trans] protected lemma trans (h : X ==> Y) (h0 : Y ==> Z) : X ==> Z
proof:
:=
  trans' X Y Z h h0

name: add_right
