statement: theorem add_right (h : X ==> Y) (Z) : X + Z ==> Y + Z
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | manip_zeroes X m n => simpa only [add_right_comm X _ Z] using manip_zeroes (X + Z) m n
  | trans' _ _ _ _ _ h h0 => exact h.trans h0
  | op a b c X => simpa only [cons_add] using canReach.op a b c (X + Z)

name: add_left
statement: theorem add_left (X) (h : Y ==> Z) : X + Y ==> X + Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [X.add_comm, X.add_comm]
  exact h.add_right X

name: cons
statement: theorem cons (h : X ==> Y) (n) : n ::ₘ X ==> n ::ₘ Y
proof:
:=
  h.add_left {n}

name: add_zeroes
statement: theorem add_zeroes (X n) : X ==> X + replicate n 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [replicate_zero, Multiset.add_zero] using manip_zeroes X 0 n

name: delete_zeroes
statement: theorem delete_zeroes (X n) : X + replicate n 0 ==> X
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [replicate_zero, Multiset.add_zero] using manip_zeroes X n 0

name: cons_zero
statement: theorem cons_zero (X) : X ==> 0 ::ₘ X
proof:
:=
  calc X
  _ ==> X + replicate 1 0 := add_zeroes X 1
  _ = 0 ::ₘ X := by rw [replicate_one, add_comm, singleton_add]

name: delete_zero
statement: theorem delete_zero (X) : 0 ::ₘ X ==> X
proof:
:=
  calc 0 ::ₘ X
  _ = X + replicate 1 0 := by rw [replicate_one, add_comm, singleton_add]
  _ ==> X := delete_zeroes X 1

name: pile_doubling
statement: theorem pile_doubling (X a b) : (a + b) ::ₘ b ::ₘ X ==> a ::ₘ (2 * b) ::ₘ X
proof:
:=
  calc (a + b) ::ₘ b ::ₘ X
  _ = (a + b) ::ₘ (0 + b) ::ₘ X := by rw [Nat.zero_add]
  _ ==> 2 * b ::ₘ a ::ₘ 0 ::ₘ X := op a 0 b X
  _ = 0 ::ₘ a ::ₘ (2 * b) ::ₘ X := by rw [cons_swap, cons_swap (2 * b), cons_swap]
  _ ==> a ::ₘ (2 * b) ::ₘ X := delete_zero _

name: pile_merge
statement: theorem pile_merge (X a) : a ::ₘ a ::ₘ X ==> 2 * a ::ₘ X
proof:
:=
  calc a ::ₘ a ::ₘ X
  _ = (0 + a) ::ₘ a ::ₘ X := by rw [Nat.zero_add]
  _ ==> 0 ::ₘ (2 * a) ::ₘ X := pile_doubling X 0 a
  _ ==> (2 * a) ::ₘ X := delete_zero _

name: sum_eq
statement: theorem sum_eq (h : X ==> Y) : X.sum = Y.sum
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | manip_zeroes X m n => simp only [sum_add, sum_replicate, nsmul_zero]
  | trans' _ _ _ _ _ h h0 => exact h.trans h0
  | op a b c X =>
      repeat rw [sum_cons]
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_add_add_comm, ← Nat.two_mul,
        Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc]

name: odd_not_dvd
statement: theorem odd_not_dvd (ht : Odd t) (h : X ==> Y) (hX : ∃ a ∈ X, ¬t ∣ a) : ∃ a ∈ Y, ¬t ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | manip_zeroes X m n =>
      rcases hX with ⟨a, haX, hta⟩
      refine ⟨a, ?_, hta⟩
      rw [mem_add, mem_replicate] at haX ⊢
      left; exact haX.resolve_right λ ⟨h, h0⟩ ↦ hta ⟨0, h0⟩
  | trans' X Y Z h h0 hXY hYZ => exact hYZ (hXY hX)
  | op a b c X =>
      
      rcases hX with ⟨x, hxX, htx⟩
      
      obtain htc | htc : ¬t ∣ c ∨ t ∣ c := dec_em' _
      · refine ⟨2 * c, mem_cons_self _ _, λ hnc0 ↦ htc ?_⟩
        exact (Nat.coprime_two_right.mpr ht).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hnc0
      
      rw [mem_cons, mem_cons] at hxX
      rcases hxX with rfl | rfl | hxX
      
      · refine ⟨a, mem_cons_of_mem (mem_cons_self a _), ?_⟩
        rwa [Nat.dvd_add_left htc] at htx
      
      · refine ⟨b, mem_cons_of_mem (mem_cons_of_mem (X.mem_cons_self b)), ?_⟩
        rwa [Nat.dvd_add_left htc] at htx
      
      · exact ⟨x, mem_cons_of_mem (mem_cons_of_mem (mem_cons_of_mem hxX)), htx⟩

name: deconstruct_succ
statement: theorem deconstruct_succ (a X) : 2 ::ₘ (a + 1) ::ₘ X ==> 2 ::ₘ a ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ X
proof:
:=
  calc 2 ::ₘ (a + 1) ::ₘ X
  _ ==> 2 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ a ::ₘ X := op 1 a 1 X
  _ = 2 ::ₘ a ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ X := by rw [cons_swap 1 a]

name: deconstruct_add
statement:
theorem deconstruct_add (a b X) :
    2 ::ₘ (a + b) ::ₘ X ==> 2 ::ₘ a ::ₘ (replicate b 1 + X)
proof:
:= by
  induction b generalizing X with
  | zero => rw [replicate_zero, zero_add, Nat.add_zero]
  | succ b hb =>
      calc 2 ::ₘ (a + b + 1) ::ₘ X
        _ ==> 2 ::ₘ (a + b) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ X := deconstruct_succ (a + b) X
        _ ==> 2 ::ₘ a ::ₘ (replicate b 1 + (1 ::ₘ X)) := hb _
        _ = 2 ::ₘ a ::ₘ (replicate (b + 1) 1 + X) := by
          rw [replicate_succ, add_cons, cons_add]

name: two_nsmul_to_map_two_mul
statement: theorem two_nsmul_to_map_two_mul (X) : 2 • X ==> X.map (2 * ·)
proof:
:= by
  
  induction X using Multiset.induction with | empty => rfl | cons a X hX => ?_
  
  calc 2 • (a ::ₘ X)
    _ = a ::ₘ a ::ₘ 2 • X := by
      rw [nsmul_cons, two_nsmul, singleton_add, cons_add, singleton_add]
    _ ==> 2 * a ::ₘ 2 • X := pile_merge _ _
    _ ==> 2 * a ::ₘ X.map (2 * ·) := hX.cons _
    _ = (a ::ₘ X).map (2 * ·) := (X.map_cons _ _).symm

name: replicate_two_mul_left_to_right
statement:
theorem replicate_two_mul_left_to_right (n a) :
    replicate (2 * n) a ==> replicate n (2 * a)
proof:
:=
  calc replicate (2 * n) a
    _ = 2 • replicate n a := (nsmul_replicate 2 _).symm
    _ ==> (replicate n a).map (2 * ·) := two_nsmul_to_map_two_mul _
    _ = replicate n (2 * a) := map_replicate _ _ _

name: replicate_two_pow_mul_left_to_right
statement:
theorem replicate_two_pow_mul_left_to_right (k n a) :
    replicate (2 ^ k * n) a ==> replicate n (2 ^ k * a)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing a with
  | zero => rw [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.one_mul, Nat.one_mul]
  | succ k hk =>
      calc replicate (2 ^ (k + 1) * n) a
      _ = replicate (2 * (2 ^ k * n)) a := by rw [Nat.pow_succ', Nat.mul_assoc]
      _ ==> replicate (2 ^ k * n) (2 * a) := replicate_two_mul_left_to_right _ _
      _ ==> replicate n (2 ^k * (2 * a)) := hk _
      _ = replicate n (2 ^ (k + 1) * a) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]

name: replicate_two_pow_of_one_to_singleton
statement: theorem replicate_two_pow_of_one_to_singleton (k) : replicate (2 ^ k) 1 ==> {2 ^ k}
proof:
:=
  calc replicate (2 ^ k) 1
    _ = replicate (2 ^ k * 1) 1 := by rw [Nat.mul_one]
    _ ==> replicate 1 (2 ^ k * 1) := replicate_two_pow_mul_left_to_right _ _ _
    _ = {2 ^ k} := by rw [Nat.mul_one, replicate_one]

name: replicate_two_pow_add_of_one_to_doubleton
statement:
theorem replicate_two_pow_add_of_one_to_doubleton (h : m ≤ 2 ^ k) :
    replicate (2 ^ k + m) 1 ==> {m, 2 ^ k}
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : replicate (2 ^ k) 1 ==> {2 ^ k} := replicate_two_pow_of_one_to_singleton k
  
  cases m with | zero => exact h0.trans (cons_zero _) | succ m' => ?_
  cases m' with | zero => exact h0.cons 1 | succ m'' => ?_
  
  obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := by
    apply Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero
    rintro rfl; exact h.not_gt (Nat.lt_of_sub_eq_succ rfl)
  
  let k := k' + 1
  let m := m'' + 2
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, m + r = 2 ^ k := Nat.le.dest h
  
  calc 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ replicate (2 ^ k + m'') 1
    _ ==> 2 ::ₘ (replicate (2 ^ k + m'') 1) := pile_merge _ _
    _ = 2 ::ₘ (replicate (2 ^ k) 1 + replicate m'' 1) := by rw [replicate_add]
    _ ==> 2 ::ₘ 2 ^ k ::ₘ replicate m'' 1 := (h0.add_right _).cons 2
    _ = 2 ::ₘ (m + r) ::ₘ replicate m'' 1 := by rw [hr]
    _ ==> 2 ::ₘ m ::ₘ (replicate r 1 + replicate m'' 1) := deconstruct_add m r _
    _ = m ::ₘ 2 ::ₘ replicate (2 * (2 ^ k' - 1)) 1 := by
      rw [cons_swap, ← replicate_add, Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_sub_one,
        ← Nat.pow_succ', ← hr, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    _ ==> m ::ₘ 2 ::ₘ replicate (2 ^ k' - 1) 2 :=
      ((replicate_two_mul_left_to_right _ 1).cons 2).cons m
    _ = m ::ₘ replicate (2 ^ k' * 1) 2 := by
      rw [← replicate_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel Nat.one_le_two_pow, Nat.mul_one]
    _ ==> {m, 2 ^ k' * 2} := (replicate_two_pow_mul_left_to_right _ _ _).cons m
    _ = {m, 2 ^ k} := by rw [← Nat.pow_succ]

name: replicate_ones_to_doubleton
statement:
theorem replicate_ones_to_doubleton (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    replicate n 1 ==> {n - 2 ^ n.log2, 2 ^ n.log2}
proof:
:=
  calc replicate n 1
  _ = replicate (2 ^ n.log2 + (n - 2 ^ n.log2)) 1 := by
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Nat.log2_self_le hn)]
  _ ==> {n - 2 ^ n.log2, 2 ^ n.log2} := by
    refine replicate_two_pow_add_of_one_to_doubleton (Nat.sub_le_of_le_add ?_)
    rw [← Nat.mul_two, ← Nat.pow_succ]
    exact Nat.lt_log2_self.le

name: isPowerOfTwo_iff_two_pow_log2_eq
statement: lemma isPowerOfTwo_iff_two_pow_log2_eq (n) : (∃ k, n = 2 ^ k) ↔ n = 2 ^ (Nat.log2 n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ ⟨k, hk⟩ ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ⟨n.log2, h⟩⟩
  rw [hk, Nat.log2_two_pow]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (n) :
    IsLeast (card '' {X | replicate n 1 ==> X})
      (if n = 0 then 0 else if ∃ k, n = 2 ^ k then 1 else 2)
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hn0 hn2
  
  · exact ⟨⟨0, hn0 ▸ canReach.refl _, rfl⟩, λ s _ ↦ s.zero_le⟩
  
  · rcases hn2 with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨{2 ^ k}, replicate_two_pow_of_one_to_singleton k, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    
    rintro s ⟨X, hX : replicate (2 ^ k) 1 ==> X, rfl⟩
    replace hX : X.sum ≠ 0 := calc
      X.sum = (replicate (2 ^ k) 1).sum := hX.sum_eq.symm
      _ = 2 ^ k * 1 := sum_replicate _ _
      _ = 2 ^ k := Nat.mul_one _
      _ ≠ 0 := hn0
    rw [Nat.succ_le_iff, card_pos]
    rintro rfl; exact hX rfl
  
  · refine ⟨⟨{n - 2 ^ n.log2, 2 ^ n.log2}, replicate_ones_to_doubleton hn0, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    
    rintro s ⟨X, hX : replicate _ 1 ==> X, rfl⟩
    
    refine le_of_not_gt λ hX0 ↦ ?_
    obtain rfl : X = {n} := by
      
      have hX1 : X.sum = n := calc
        X.sum = (replicate n 1).sum := hX.sum_eq.symm
        _ = n * 1 := sum_replicate _ _
        _ = n := Nat.mul_one n
      
      rw [Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one,
        card_eq_zero, card_eq_one] at hX0
      rcases hX0 with rfl | ⟨a, rfl⟩
      exacts [absurd hX1.symm hn0, congrArg _ hX1]
    
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpn, hp0⟩ : ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n ∧ Odd p :=
      (Nat.eq_two_pow_or_exists_odd_prime_and_dvd n).resolve_left hn2
    
    obtain ⟨N, hNX, hpN⟩ : ∃ N ∈ ({n} : Multiset ℕ), ¬p ∣ N :=
      hX.odd_not_dvd hp0 ⟨1, mem_replicate.mpr ⟨hn0, rfl⟩, hp.not_dvd_one⟩
    exact hpN (mem_singleton.mp hNX ▸ hpn)

name: pow_odd'_eq_self_of_zero_or_one_or_neg_one
statement:
theorem pow_odd'_eq_self_of_zero_or_one_or_neg_one
    {a : ℤ} (ha : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 ∨ a = -1) (n) :
    a ^ (2 * n + 1) = a
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · rw [Int.pow_succ, Int.mul_zero]
  · rw [Int.pow_succ, pow_mul, sq_eq_one_iff.mpr ha, Int.one_pow, Int.one_mul]

name: jacobiSym_pow_odd'_eq_self
statement: theorem jacobiSym_pow_odd'_eq_self (a b n) : J(a | b) ^ (2 * n + 1) = J(a | b)
proof:
:=
  pow_odd'_eq_self_of_zero_or_one_or_neg_one (jacobiSym.trichotomy a b) n

name: jacobiSym_pow_left_odd'_eq_self
statement: theorem jacobiSym_pow_left_odd'_eq_self (a b n) : J(a ^ (2 * n + 1) | b) = J(a | b)
proof:
:=
  (jacobiSym.pow_left a _ b).trans (jacobiSym_pow_odd'_eq_self a b n)

name: jacobiSym_two_five
statement: theorem jacobiSym_two_five : J(2 | 5) = -1
proof:
:=
  jacobiSym.at_two (Nat.odd_iff.mpr rfl)

name: jacobiSym_of_modeq
statement: theorem jacobiSym_of_modeq {a b : ℤ} {c : ℕ} (h : a ≡ b [ZMOD c]) : J(a | c) = J(b | c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobiSym.mod_left, h, ← jacobiSym.mod_left]

name: jacobiSym_of_modeq_nat
statement: theorem jacobiSym_of_modeq_nat {a b c : ℕ} (h : a ≡ b [MOD c]) : J(a | c) = J(b | c)
proof:
:=
  jacobiSym_of_modeq (Int.natCast_modEq_iff.mpr h)

name: five_not_modeq_three_mod_two_add_N
statement: theorem five_not_modeq_three_mod_two_add_N (hN : 0 < N) : ¬5 ≡ 3 [MOD 2 + N]
proof:
:=
  
  λ h0 ↦ Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt Nat.two_pos (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right hN)
    ((Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' (by norm_num : 3 ≤ 5)).mp h0.symm)

name: twenty_five_pow_not_modeq_nine_mod_four_pow_add_N
statement:
theorem twenty_five_pow_not_modeq_nine_mod_four_pow_add_N (hN : N % 3 = 2) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ¬25 ^ k ≡ 9 ^ k [MOD 4 ^ k + N]
proof:
:= by
  
  replace hN : 3 ∣ 4 ^ k + N := by
    rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mod, hN, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow]
  
  suffices ¬25 ^ k ≡ 9 ^ k [MOD 3] from mt (Nat.ModEq.of_dvd hN) this
  
  calc 25 ^ k % 3
    _ = 1 := by rw [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow]
    _ ≠ 0 := Nat.one_ne_zero
    _ = 9 ^ k % 3 := by rw [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.zero_pow hk]

name: five_pow_not_modeq_three_pow_mod_two_pow_add_N
statement:
theorem five_pow_not_modeq_three_pow_mod_two_pow_add_N (hn : 0 < n) (hN : N % 60 = 5) :
    ¬5 ^ n ≡ 3 ^ n [MOD 2 ^ n + N]
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = 2 * k ∨ n = 2 * k + 1 := Nat.even_or_odd' n
  · replace hN : N % 3 = 2 := by rw [← Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd N ⟨20, rfl⟩, hN]
    replace hn : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left hn
    rw [Nat.pow_mul, Nat.pow_mul, Nat.pow_mul]
    exact twenty_five_pow_not_modeq_nine_mod_four_pow_add_N hN hn
  
  obtain rfl | hk : k = 0 ∨ 0 < k := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k
  · replace hN : 0 < N := calc
      0 < 5 := Nat.succ_pos 4
      _ = N % 60 := hN.symm
      _ ≤ N := Nat.mod_le N 60
    exact five_not_modeq_three_mod_two_add_N hN
  /- Finally, suppose that `n = 2k + 1` with `k > 1`.
    Then by Jacobi symbol computation, `5^n ≡ 3^n (mod 2^n + N)` implies `-1 = 1`. -/
  intro h0
  set n : ℕ := 2 * k + 1
  suffices (-1 : ℤ) = 1 from absurd this (by norm_num)
  calc -1
    _ = J((2 : ℕ) | 5) := jacobiSym_two_five.symm
    _ = J((2 ^ n : ℕ) | 5) := by rw [Int.natCast_pow, jacobiSym_pow_left_odd'_eq_self]
    _ = J((2 ^ n + N : ℕ) | 5) := by
      
      replace hN : N ≡ 0 [MOD 5] := by rw [Nat.ModEq, ← Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd N ⟨12, rfl⟩, hN]
      exact jacobiSym_of_modeq_nat (hN.symm.add_left _)
    _ = J((5 : ℕ) | 2 ^ n + N) := by
      
      replace hN : (2 ^ n + N) % 2 = 1 := by
        rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_add_mod', ← Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd N ⟨30, rfl⟩, hN]
      exact jacobiSym.quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four' (Nat.odd_iff.mpr hN) rfl
    _ = J((5 ^ n : ℕ) | 2 ^ n + N) := by
      rw [Int.natCast_pow, jacobiSym_pow_left_odd'_eq_self]
    _ = J((3 ^ n : ℕ) | 2 ^ n + N) := jacobiSym_of_modeq_nat h0
    _ = J((3 : ℕ) | 2 ^ n + N) := by rw [Int.natCast_pow, jacobiSym_pow_left_odd'_eq_self]
    _ = J((2 ^ n + N : ℕ) | 3) := by
      
      replace hn : 4 ∣ 2 ^ n :=
        Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.mul_pos Nat.two_pos hk))
      replace hN : (2 ^ n + N) % 4 = 1 := by
        rw [← Nat.mod_add_mod, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp hn,
          Nat.zero_add, ← Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd N ⟨15, rfl⟩, hN]
      exact jacobiSym.quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four' (Nat.odd_iff.mpr rfl) hN
    _ = J((1 : ℕ) | 3) := by
      
      replace hN : N % 3 = 2 := by rw [← Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd N ⟨20, rfl⟩, hN]
      replace hN : (2 ^ n + N) % 3 = 1 := by
        rw [Nat.add_mod, hN, Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.mod_mul_mod,
          Nat.pow_mul, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow]
      exact jacobiSym_of_modeq_nat hN
    _ = 1 := jacobiSym.one_left 3

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (hn : 0 < n) : ¬5 ^ n ≡ 3 ^ n [MOD 2 ^ n + 65]
proof:
:=
  five_pow_not_modeq_three_pow_mod_two_pow_add_N hn rfl

name: eq_two_of_le_four_modeq_three
statement: theorem eq_two_of_le_four_modeq_three : ∀ {k}, (hk : k ≤ 4) → (hk0 : k % 3 = 2) → k = 2
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: eq_zero_of_three_mul_add_two_dvd_12
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_three_mul_add_two_dvd_12 (hq : 3 * q + 2 ∣ 12) : q = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : 3 * q < 12 := calc
    3 * q < 3 * q + 2 := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right Nat.two_pos
    _     ≤ 12 := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos 11) hq
  replace hq0 : q < 4 := Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left hq0
  revert hq; revert q; decide

name: q_eq_zero_or_d_eq_six_of_Diophantine
statement:
theorem q_eq_zero_or_d_eq_six_of_Diophantine
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hp0 : p % 6 = 1) (h : (3 * q + 2) * d = 12 * p) :
    q = 0 ∨ d = 6
proof:
:= by
  
  apply (Nat.coprime_or_dvd_of_prime hp d).symm.imp (λ h0 ↦ ?_) (λ h0 ↦ ?_)
  
  · 
    replace hp : 0 < d :=
      Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left ((Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ 11) hp.pos).trans_eq h.symm)
    replace h : (3 * q + 2) * d ∣ 12 * d := h.dvd.trans (Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left 12 h0)
    replace h : 3 * q + 2 ∣ 12 := Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_right hp h
    exact eq_zero_of_three_mul_add_two_dvd_12 h
  
  · 
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : 3 ∣ d := by
      replace h0 : Nat.Coprime 3 (3 * q + 2) := by
        rw [Nat.Coprime, Nat.gcd_mul_left_add_right]; rfl
      exact h0.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left ⟨4 * p, h.trans (Nat.mul_assoc 3 4 p)⟩
    
    replace h : (3 * q + 2) * t = 4 * p := by
      rw [← Nat.mul_right_inj (Nat.succ_ne_zero 2), Nat.mul_left_comm, h, ← Nat.mul_assoc]
    
    replace h0 : p.Coprime t := h0.coprime_mul_left_right
    replace h0 : t ∣ 4 := h0.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ⟨_, h.symm.trans (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩
    replace h0 : t ≤ 4 := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos 3) h0
    
    replace h : (2 * t) % 3 = 1 :=
      calc (2 * t) % 3
      _ = ((3 * q + 2) % 3 * t) % 3 := by rw [Nat.mul_add_mod]
      _ = (4 * p) % 3 := by rw [Nat.mod_mul_mod, h]
      _ = p % 3 := by rw [← Nat.mod_mul_mod, Nat.one_mul]
      _ = (p % 6) % 3 := (Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ ⟨2, rfl⟩).symm
      _ = 1 % 3 := congrArg (· % 3) hp0
    replace h : t % 3 = 2 := by
      calc t % 3
      _ = (4 * t) % 3 := by rw [← Nat.mod_mul_mod, Nat.one_mul]
      _ = 2 := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc 2 2, ← Nat.mul_mod_mod, h]
    
    exact congrArg (3 * ·) (eq_two_of_le_four_modeq_three h0 h)

name: divisor_pos
statement: theorem divisor_pos (i) : 0 < X.divisor i
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (X.divisor_spec i) hN

name: divisor_le
statement: theorem divisor_le (i) : X.divisor i ≤ N
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_of_dvd hN (X.divisor_spec i)

name: divisor_quot_spec
statement: theorem divisor_quot_spec (i) : X.divisor_quot i * X.divisor i = N
proof:
:=
  Nat.div_mul_cancel (X.divisor_spec i)

name: divisor_quot_pos
statement: theorem divisor_quot_pos (i) : 0 < X.divisor_quot i
proof:
:=
  Nat.div_pos (X.divisor_le hN i) (X.divisor_pos hN i)

name: divisor_quot0lt1
statement: theorem divisor_quot0lt1 : X.divisor_quot 0 < X.divisor_quot 1
proof:
:=
  (Nat.div_lt_div_left hN.ne.symm (X.divisor_spec 0) (X.divisor_spec 1)).mpr X.divisor1lt0

name: divisor_quot1lt2
statement: theorem divisor_quot1lt2 : X.divisor_quot 1 < X.divisor_quot 2
proof:
:=
  (Nat.div_lt_div_left hN.ne.symm (X.divisor_spec 1) (X.divisor_spec 2)).mpr X.divisor2lt1

name: two_le_divisor_quot1
statement: theorem two_le_divisor_quot1 : 2 ≤ X.divisor_quot 1
proof:
:= calc
  1 ≤ X.divisor_quot 0 := X.divisor_quot_pos hN 0
  _ < X.divisor_quot 1 := X.divisor_quot0lt1 hN

name: divisor0_eq_one_of_13N_lt_12n
statement:
theorem divisor0_eq_one_of_13N_lt_12n
    (hN : 0 < N) (h : 13 * N < 12 * n) (X : Norwegian n N) :
    X.divisor_quot 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Nat.eq_of_le_of_lt_succ (X.divisor_quot_pos hN 0) (Nat.lt_of_not_le λ h0 ↦ ?_)
  
  have h1 : 3 ≤ X.divisor_quot 1 := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h0 (X.divisor_quot0lt1 hN)
  have h2 : 4 ≤ X.divisor_quot 2 := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h1 (X.divisor_quot1lt2 hN)
  
  apply h.not_ge
  calc 12 * n
  _ = 12 * (X.divisor 0 + X.divisor 1 + X.divisor 2) := by rw [X.divisor_sum]
  _ = 12 * X.divisor 0 + 12 * X.divisor 1 + 12 * X.divisor 2 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add]
  _ = 6 * (2 * X.divisor 0) + 4 * (3 * X.divisor 1) + 3 * (4 * X.divisor 2) := by
    iterate 3 rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
  _ ≤ 6 * (X.divisor_quot 0 * X.divisor 0) + 4 * (X.divisor_quot 1 * X.divisor 1)
      + 3 * (X.divisor_quot 2 * X.divisor 2) := by
    refine Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add ?_ ?_) ?_
    all_goals exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by assumption))
  _ = 6 * N + 4 * N + 3 * N := by iterate 3 rw [X.divisor_quot_spec]
  _ = 13 * N := by rw [← Nat.add_mul, ← Nat.add_mul]

name: divisor1_le_three_of_3N_le_2n
statement:
theorem divisor1_le_three_of_3N_le_2n (hN : 0 < N) (h : 3 * N ≤ 2 * n) (X : Norwegian n N) :
    X.divisor_quot 1 ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Nat.le_of_not_lt λ (h0 : 4 ≤ X.divisor_quot 1) ↦ ?_
  have h1 : 4 < X.divisor_quot 2 := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h0 (X.divisor_quot1lt2 hN)
  
  apply (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h).not_gt
  calc 2 * (2 * n)
  _ = 4 * (X.divisor 0 + X.divisor 1 + X.divisor 2) := by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, X.divisor_sum]
  _ = 4 * X.divisor 0 + 4 * X.divisor 1 + 4 * X.divisor 2 := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add]
  _ < 4 * N + X.divisor_quot 1 * X.divisor 1 + X.divisor_quot 2 * X.divisor 2 := by
    refine Nat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (Nat.add_le_add ?_ ?_) ?_
    exacts [Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 (X.divisor_le hN 0), Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h0,
      Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 (X.divisor_pos hN 2)]
  _ = 4 * N + N + N := by rw [X.divisor_quot_spec, X.divisor_quot_spec]
  _ = 6 * N := by rw [← Nat.succ_mul, ← Nat.succ_mul]
  _ = 2 * (3 * N) := Nat.mul_assoc 2 3 N

name: divisor2_le_five_of_3N_lt_2n_and_divisor1_eq_three
statement:
theorem divisor2_le_five_of_3N_lt_2n_and_divisor1_eq_three
    (hN : 0 < N) (h : 3 * N < 2 * n) (X : Norwegian n N) (hXq1 : X.divisor_quot 1 = 3) :
    X.divisor_quot 2 ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Nat.le_of_not_lt λ h0 ↦ h.not_ge (Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (Nat.succ_pos 2))
  
  calc 3 * (2 * n)
    _ = 6 * n := (Nat.mul_assoc 3 2 n).symm
    _ = 6 * (X.divisor 0 + X.divisor 1 + X.divisor 2) := by rw [X.divisor_sum]
    _ = 6 * X.divisor 0 + 6 * X.divisor 1 + 6 * X.divisor 2 := by simp_rw [Nat.mul_add]
    _ ≤ 6 * N + 2 * N + N := by
      
      refine Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add ?_ ?_) ?_
      · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (X.divisor_le hN 0)
      · calc _ = 2 * (3 * X.divisor 1) := Nat.mul_assoc 2 3 _
             _ = 2 * N := by simp_rw [← hXq1, X.divisor_quot_spec]
             _ ≤ 2 * N := Nat.le_refl _
      · exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h0).trans_eq (X.divisor_quot_spec 2)
    _ = 3 * (3 * N) := by rw [← Nat.add_mul, ← Nat.succ_mul, ← Nat.mul_assoc]

name: divisor2_ne_four_of_divisor01_eq_one_three
statement:
theorem divisor2_ne_four_of_divisor01_eq_one_three (hn19 : ¬19 ∣ n)
    (X : Norwegian n N) (hXq0 : X.divisor_quot 0 = 1) (hXq1 : X.divisor_quot 1 = 3) :
    X.divisor_quot 2 ≠ 4
proof:
:= by
  
  intro hXq2
  replace hXq0 : X.divisor 0 = N := by simp_rw [← X.divisor_quot_spec 0, hXq0, Nat.one_mul]
  replace hXq1 : 3 * X.divisor 1 = N := by simp_rw [← X.divisor_quot_spec 1, hXq1]
  replace hXq2 : 4 * X.divisor 2 = N := by simp_rw [← X.divisor_quot_spec 2, hXq2]
  
  have h : 12 * n = 19 * N := calc
    _ = 12 * (X.divisor 0 + X.divisor 1 + X.divisor 2) := by rw [X.divisor_sum]
    _ = 12 * X.divisor 0 + 12 * X.divisor 1 + 12 * X.divisor 2 := by simp_rw [Nat.mul_add]
    _ = 12 * X.divisor 0 + 4 * (3 * X.divisor 1) + 3 * (4 * X.divisor 2) := by
      rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = 19 * N := by rw [hXq0, hXq1, hXq2, ← Nat.add_mul, ← Nat.add_mul]
  
  refine hn19 (Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mpr ?_)
  calc n % 19
  _ = 8 * (12 * n) % 19 := by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.mod_mul_mod, Nat.one_mul]
  _ = 0 := by rw [h, ← Nat.mul_mod_mod, Nat.mul_mod_right]

name: divisor2_ne_five_of_divisor01_eq_one_three
statement:
theorem divisor2_ne_five_of_divisor01_eq_one_three (hn23 : ¬23 ∣ n)
    (X : Norwegian n N) (hXq0 : X.divisor_quot 0 = 1) (hXq1 : X.divisor_quot 1 = 3) :
    X.divisor_quot 2 ≠ 5
proof:
:= by
  
  intro hXq2
  replace hXq0 : X.divisor 0 = N := by simp_rw [← X.divisor_quot_spec 0, hXq0, Nat.one_mul]
  replace hXq1 : 3 * X.divisor 1 = N := by simp_rw [← X.divisor_quot_spec 1, hXq1]
  replace hXq2 : 5 * X.divisor 2 = N := by simp_rw [← X.divisor_quot_spec 2, hXq2]
  
  have h : 15 * n = 23 * N := calc
    _ = 15 * (X.divisor 0 + X.divisor 1 + X.divisor 2) := by rw [X.divisor_sum]
    _ = 15 * X.divisor 0 + 15 * X.divisor 1 + 15 * X.divisor 2 := by simp_rw [Nat.mul_add]
    _ = 15 * X.divisor 0 + 5 * (3 * X.divisor 1) + 3 * (5 * X.divisor 2) := by
      rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ = 23 * N := by rw [hXq0, hXq1, hXq2, ← Nat.add_mul, ← Nat.add_mul]
  
  refine hn23 (Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mpr ?_)
  calc n % 23
  _ = 20 * (15 * n) % 23 := by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.mod_mul_mod, Nat.one_mul]
  _ = 0 := by rw [h, ← Nat.mul_mod_mod, Nat.mul_mod_right]

name: divisor01_eq_of_3N_le_2n_of_19_and_23_not_dvd_n
statement:
theorem divisor01_eq_of_3N_le_2n_of_19_and_23_not_dvd_n
    (hN : 0 < N) (h : 3 * N < 2 * n) (hn19 : ¬19 ∣ n) (hn23 : ¬23 ∣ n) (X : Norwegian n N) :
    X.divisor_quot 0 = 1 ∧ X.divisor_quot 1 = 2
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 : X.divisor_quot 0 = 1 := by
    refine X.divisor0_eq_one_of_13N_lt_12n hN ?_
    calc 13 * N
    _ < 18 * N := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by decide) hN
    _ = 6 * (3 * N) := Nat.mul_assoc 6 3 N
    _ ≤ 6 * (2 * n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 6 h.le
    _ = 12 * n := (Nat.mul_assoc 6 2 n).symm
  
  refine ⟨h0, ((X.two_le_divisor_quot1 hN).eq_of_not_lt λ h1 ↦ ?_).symm⟩
  
  replace h1 : X.divisor_quot 1 = 3 := (X.divisor1_le_three_of_3N_le_2n hN h.le).antisymm h1
  
  obtain h2 | h2 | h2 :
      X.divisor_quot 2 = 4 ∨ X.divisor_quot 2 = 5 ∨ 5 < X.divisor_quot 2 := by
    have h2 : 4 ≤ X.divisor_quot 2 := h1.symm.trans_lt (X.divisor_quot1lt2 hN)
    exact h2.eq_or_lt'.imp_right λ (h3 : 5 ≤ _) ↦ h3.eq_or_lt'
  
  exacts [X.divisor2_ne_four_of_divisor01_eq_one_three hn19 h0 h1 h2,
    X.divisor2_ne_five_of_divisor01_eq_one_three hn23 h0 h1 h2,
    h2.not_ge (X.divisor2_le_five_of_3N_lt_2n_and_divisor1_eq_three hN h h1)]

name: divisor01_eq_of_n_eq_six_times_prime
statement:
theorem divisor01_eq_of_n_eq_six_times_prime (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hp0 : 23 < p)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hN0 : N < 4 * p) (X : Norwegian (6 * p) N) :
    X.divisor_quot 0 = 1 ∧ X.divisor_quot 1 = 2
proof:
:= by
  refine X.divisor01_eq_of_3N_le_2n_of_19_and_23_not_dvd_n hN ?_ ?_ ?_
  
  · calc 3 * N
      _ < 3 * (4 * p) := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hN0 (Nat.succ_pos 2)
      _ = 2 * (6 * p) := by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.mul_assoc]
  
  · have h19 : Nat.Prime 19 := by decide
    replace hp0 : 19 < p := (by decide : 19 < 23).trans hp0
    exact h19.not_dvd_mul (by decide) λ h ↦ hp0.ne ((hp.dvd_iff_eq (by decide)).mp h).symm
  
  · have h23 : Nat.Prime 23 := by decide
    exact h23.not_dvd_mul (by decide) λ h ↦ hp0.ne ((hp.dvd_iff_eq (by decide)).mp h).symm

name: eq_Norwegian_std_six_times_6k_add_one
statement:
theorem eq_Norwegian_std_six_times_6k_add_one
    (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hp0 : 23 < p) (hp1 : p % 6 = 1)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hN0 : N < 4 * p) (X : Norwegian (6 * p) N) :
    N = 4 * (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h : 3 * N + 2 * X.divisor 2 = 12 * p := by
    
    obtain ⟨hXq0, hXq1⟩ : X.divisor_quot 0 = 1 ∧ X.divisor_quot 1 = 2 :=
      X.divisor01_eq_of_n_eq_six_times_prime hp hp0 hN hN0
    
    calc 3 * N + 2 * X.divisor 2
    _ = 2 * (X.divisor_quot 0 * X.divisor 0)
        + X.divisor_quot 1 * X.divisor 1 + 2 * X.divisor 2 := by
      rw [X.divisor_quot_spec, X.divisor_quot_spec, Nat.succ_mul]
    _ = 2 * X.divisor 0 + 2 * X.divisor 1 + 2 * X.divisor 2 := by
      rw [hXq0, hXq1, Nat.one_mul]
    _ = 2 * (6 * p) := by rw [← Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.mul_add, X.divisor_sum]
    _ = 12 * p := (Nat.mul_assoc 2 6 _).symm
  
  suffices X.divisor 2 = 6 by
    replace h : 3 * N = 12 * p - 2 * X.divisor 2 := Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq h
    rwa [this, ← Nat.mul_pred, Nat.mul_assoc 3 4,
      Nat.mul_left_cancel_iff (Nat.succ_pos 2)] at h
  
  replace h : (3 * X.divisor_quot 2 + 2) * X.divisor 2 = 12 * p := by
    rwa [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_assoc, X.divisor_quot_spec]
  /- We have shown separately that this equation forces `q_2 = 0` or `d_2 = 2`.
    But `q_2 > 0`, so `d_2 = 2`. -/
  exact (q_eq_zero_or_d_eq_six_of_Diophantine hp hp1 h).resolve_left
    (X.divisor_quot_pos hN 2).ne.symm

name: IsLeast_Norwegian_prime_one_mod_six
statement:
theorem IsLeast_Norwegian_prime_one_mod_six (hk : Nat.Prime (6 * k + 1)) (hk0 : 4 ≤ k) :
    IsLeast {N > 0 | Nonempty (Norwegian (6 * (6 * k + 1)) N)} (24 * k)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hk1 : 0 < k := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk0
    exact ⟨Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos 23) hk1, ⟨Norwegian_std_six_times_6k_add_one k hk1⟩⟩
  
  rintro N ⟨hN, ⟨X⟩⟩
  
  suffices 4 * (6 * k) ≤ N by rwa [Nat.mul_assoc 4 6 k]
  
  obtain h | h : 4 * (6 * k + 1) ≤ N ∨ N < 4 * (6 * k + 1) := le_or_gt _ _
  · exact Nat.le_of_add_right_le h
  
  · replace hk0 : 23 < 6 * k + 1 := calc
      _ < 25 := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right Nat.two_pos
      _ ≤ 6 * k + 1 := Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 6 hk0)
    have hk1 : (6 * k + 1) % 6 = 1 := Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left _ _ _
    refine (X.eq_Norwegian_std_six_times_6k_add_one hk hk0 hk1 hN h).ge

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : IsLeast {N > 0 | Nonempty (Norwegian 2022 N)} 1344
proof:
:=
  IsLeast_Norwegian_prime_one_mod_six (k := 56) (by norm_num) (by decide)

name: quadratic_formula
statement: theorem quadratic_formula (a b : ℤ) : a ^ 2 + -(a + b) * a + a * b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_one, ← Int.add_mul, Int.mul_comm,
    ← Int.mul_add, Int.add_right_comm, Int.add_right_neg, Int.mul_zero]

name: Int_sq_sub_sq
statement: theorem Int_sq_sub_sq (u v : ℤ) : u ^ 2 - v ^ 2 = (u + v) * (u - v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.mul_sub, Int.add_mul, Int.add_mul, ← Int.sub_sub, Int.mul_comm v,
    Int.add_sub_cancel, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_one, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_one]

name: is_quad_root_of_f
statement: theorem is_quad_root_of_f (p) : is_quad_root_of (f p) p
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨u, v⟩
  refine ⟨quadratic_formula u v, ?_⟩
  rw [f, Int.add_comm u, Int.mul_comm u]
  exact quadratic_formula v u

name: is_quad_root_of_iff_eq_f
statement:
theorem is_quad_root_of_iff_eq_f {p q : ℤ × ℤ} (hp : q.1 ≠ q.2) :
    is_quad_root_of p q ↔ p = f q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ h ▸ is_quad_root_of_f q⟩
  rcases p with ⟨a, b⟩
  rcases q with ⟨u, v⟩
  rcases h with ⟨h, h0⟩
  
  replace h0 : a = -(u + v) := by
    rw [← h, eq_comm, Int.add_left_inj, ← Int.sub_eq_iff_eq_add, Int.add_sub_assoc,
      ← Int.mul_sub, ← Int.sub_eq_zero, Int.add_comm, Int.add_sub_assoc, Int_sq_sub_sq,
      ← Int.add_mul, Int.mul_eq_zero, Int.sub_eq_zero, or_iff_left hp, Int.add_comm] at h0
    exact (Int.neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero h0).symm
  
  rw [h0, ← quadratic_formula u v, Int.add_right_inj] at h
  exact Prod.ext h0 h

name: discriminant_nonneg_of_f
statement: theorem discriminant_nonneg_of_f {p q} (h : f p = q) : q.1 ^ 2 - 4 * q.2 ≥ 0
proof:
:= by
  calc q.1 ^ 2 - 2 * 2 * q.2
  _ = (-(p.1 + p.2)) ^ 2 - 2 * 2 * (p.1 * p.2) := by rw [← h, f]
  _ = (p.1 + p.2) ^ 2 - 2 * 2 * (p.1 * p.2) := by rw [Int.neg_pow, Int.pow_zero, Int.one_mul]
  _ = (p.1 - p.2) ^ 2 := by rw [sub_eq_iff_comm, Int_sq_sub_sq, add_add_sub_cancel,
    add_sub_sub_cancel, ← Int.two_mul, ← Int.two_mul, mul_mul_mul_comm]
  _ ≥ 0 := Int.sq_nonneg _

name: of_const_one_neg_two
statement: theorem of_const_one_neg_two : good (λ _ ↦ (1, -2))
proof:
:=
  λ _ ↦ ⟨(by decide : (1 : ℤ) ≠ -2), is_quad_root_of_f (1, -2)⟩

name: map_eq_f_map_succ
statement: theorem map_eq_f_map_succ (i) : s i = f (s (i + 1))
proof:
:=
  let ⟨h, h0⟩ := hs i; (is_quad_root_of_iff_eq_f h).mp h0

name: eq_const_one_neg_two_of_b0_ne_zero
statement: theorem eq_const_one_neg_two_of_b0_ne_zero (hs0 : (s 0).2 ≠ 0) : s = λ _ ↦ (1, -2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs1 (i) : s i = f (s (i + 1)) := hs.map_eq_f_map_succ i
  have hs1' (i) : (s i).2.natAbs = (s (i + 1)).1.natAbs * (s (i + 1)).2.natAbs := by
    rw [hs1, f, Int.natAbs_mul]
  
  replace hs0 : ∀ i, (s i).2 ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.rec hs0 λ i hi hi0 ↦ hi (hs1 i ▸ (Int.mul_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inr hi0)))
  have hs0' (i) : (s i).2.natAbs > 0 := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr (hs0 i)
  
  obtain ⟨N, hs2⟩ : ∃ N, ∀ i ≥ N, (s N).2.natAbs = (s i).2.natAbs := by
    refine WellFoundedLT.antitone_chain_condition <| antitone_nat_of_succ_le λ i ↦
      Nat.le_of_dvd (hs0' i) ⟨(s (i + 1)).1.natAbs, (hs1' i).trans (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩
  
  replace hs2 {i} (hi : i > N) : (s i).1 = 1 ∨ (s i).1 = -1 := by
    have h : (s (i - 1)).2.natAbs = (s i).2.natAbs :=
      (hs2 _ (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hi)).symm.trans (hs2 i hi.le)
    rw [hs1', Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_of_lt hi),
      Nat.mul_eq_right (hs0' i).ne.symm] at h
    exact Int.natAbs_eq_natAbs_iff.mp h
  
  replace hs1' (i) : (s i).1 = -((s (i + 1)).1 + (s (i + 1)).2) := congrArg Prod.fst (hs1 i)
  
  replace hs2 {i} (hi : i ≥ N + 2) : (s i).1 = 1 := by
    
    refine (hs2 (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hi)).resolve_right λ hj ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, i = j + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hi)
    rename j + 1 > N + 1 => hj0; replace hj0 : j > N := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj0
    
    obtain hj1 | hj1 : (s j).1 = 1 ∨ (s j).1 = -1 := hs2 hj0
    
    · rw [hs1', Int.neg_eq_comm, hj, left_eq_add] at hj1
      exact hs0 (j + 1) hj1
    
    · replace hj1 : f (s (j + 2)) = (-1, 2) := by
        rw [hs1', Int.neg_inj, hj, neg_add_eq_iff_eq_add] at hj1
        exact (hs1 _).symm.trans (Prod.ext hj hj1)
      exact (discriminant_nonneg_of_f hj1).not_gt (by decide)
  
  replace hs2 {i} (hi : i ≥ N + 3) : s i = (1, -2) := by
    have hi0 : (s i).1 = 1 := hs2 (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi)
    have hi1 : (s (i - 1)).1 = -((s i).1 + (s i).2) := by
      rw [hs1', Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_of_lt hi)]
    rw [hs2 (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hi), hi0, Int.eq_neg_comm, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq'] at hi1
    exact Prod.ext hi0 hi1
  
  clear hs0 hs0' hs1'
  funext i; refine (Nat.le_total i (N + 3)).elim (λ hi ↦ ?_) hs2
  induction hi using Nat.decreasingInduction with
    | self => exact hs2 (Nat.le_refl _)
    | of_succ k _ hk => rw [hs1, hk]; rfl

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (hp : p.2 ≠ 0) : (∃ s, good s ∧ s 0 = p) ↔ p = (1, -2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, λ hp0 ↦ ⟨λ _ ↦ (1, -2), good.of_const_one_neg_two, hp0.symm⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩; exact congrFun (hs.eq_const_one_neg_two_of_b0_ne_zero hp) 0

name: eq_of_dvd_of_dvd_sub
statement:
theorem eq_of_dvd_of_dvd_sub {a b n : ℕ+}
    (han : a ∣ n) (hbn : b ∣ n) (h : (n : ℤ) ∣ a - b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  wlog hab : (b : ℤ) ≤ (a : ℤ)
  · refine (this hbn han ?_ (Int.le_of_not_le hab)).symm
    rwa [← Int.neg_sub, Int.dvd_neg]
  have h0 : (a : ℤ) - b < n :=
    Int.lt_of_lt_of_le (Int.sub_lt_self _ (Int.natCast_pos.mpr b.pos))
      (Int.ofNat_le.mpr (PNat.le_of_dvd han))
  replace h0 : (a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ) = 0 :=
    Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_nonneg_of_lt (Int.sub_nonneg_of_le hab) h0 h
  rwa [Int.sub_eq_zero, Int.natCast_inj, PNat.coe_inj] at h0

name: eq_of_dvd_of_dvd_sub'
statement: theorem eq_of_dvd_of_dvd_sub' {n : ℕ+} (a b : {d | d ∣ n}) (h : (n : ℤ) ∣ a - b) : a = b
proof:
:=
  Subtype.coe_injective (eq_of_dvd_of_dvd_sub a.2 b.2 h)

name: neg_is_good
statement: theorem neg_is_good : good (λ n ↦ -n)
proof:
:=
  λ _ d h ↦ ⟨d, h, 0, (add_neg_cancel _).trans (Int.mul_zero _).symm⟩

name: exists_divisor_perm
statement:
theorem exists_divisor_perm (n : ℕ+) :
    ∃ g : Equiv.Perm {d | d ∣ n}, ∀ e, (n : ℤ) ∣ e + f (g e)
proof:
:= by
  
  let S := Set.Elem {d | d ∣ n}
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : S → S, ∀ d : S, (n : ℤ) ∣ d + f (g d) :=
    Classical.axiom_of_choice (r := λ d e : S ↦ (n : ℤ) ∣ d + f e)
      (λ d ↦ (hf n d.1 d.2).elim λ e he ↦ ⟨⟨e, he.1⟩, he.2⟩)
  suffices g.Bijective from ⟨Equiv.ofBijective g this, hg⟩
  
  have hg0 : g.Injective :=
    λ a b h ↦ eq_of_dvd_of_dvd_sub' a b <| calc
        _ ∣ (a + f (g a)) - (b + f (g b)) := Int.dvd_sub (hg a) (hg b)
        _ = a - b := by rw [h, Int.add_sub_add_right]
  
  have : Finite S := by
    let T : Set ℕ := Finset.range (n + 1)
    have hT : T.Finite := Finset.finite_toSet _
    have hT0 : {d | d ∣ n}.InjOn PNat.val := Set.injOn_of_injective PNat.coe_injective
    have hT1 : {d | d ∣ n}.MapsTo PNat.val T :=
      λ d hd ↦ Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mpr (PNat.le_of_dvd hd)
    exact Set.finite_coe_iff.mpr (hT.of_injOn hT1 hT0)
  exact hg0.bijective_of_finite

name: injective
statement: theorem injective : f.Injective
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  
  let c := a * b
  let S := Set.Elem {d | d ∣ c}
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : S ≃ S, ∀ e, (c : ℤ) ∣ e + f (g e) := hf.exists_divisor_perm _
  replace hg (e : S) : (c : ℤ) ∣ g.symm e + f e := by
    simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hg (g.symm e)
  
  let a₀ : S := ⟨a, dvd_mul_right _ _⟩
  let b₀ : S := ⟨b, dvd_mul_left _ _⟩
  have h : (c : ℤ) ∣ g.symm a₀ - g.symm b₀ := calc
    _ ∣ (g.symm a₀ + f a) - (g.symm b₀ + f b) := Int.dvd_sub (hg a₀) (hg b₀)
    _ = g.symm a₀ - g.symm b₀ := by rw [h, Int.add_sub_add_right]
  
  replace h : g.symm a₀ = g.symm b₀ := eq_of_dvd_of_dvd_sub' _ _ h
  rwa [EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, ← Subtype.coe_inj] at h

name: forall_right_exists_left
statement:
theorem forall_right_exists_left {n e : ℕ+} (he : e ∣ n) :
    ∃ d, d ∣ n ∧ (n : ℤ) ∣ d + f e
proof:
:= by
  let S := Set.Elem {d | d ∣ n}
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : S ≃ S, ∀ e, (n : ℤ) ∣ e + f (g e) :=
    hf.exists_divisor_perm n
  let e₀ : S := ⟨e, he⟩
  let d₀ : S := g.symm e₀
  refine ⟨d₀.1, d₀.2, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hg (g.symm e₀)

name: map_eq_zero_or_neg_divisor
statement: theorem map_eq_zero_or_neg_divisor {m} (hm : f m ≠ 0) : ∃ d, d ∣ m ∧ f m = -d
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∀ k : ℕ+, k > 2 * (f m).natAbs → ∃ d, d ∣ k * m ∧ f m = -d by
    
    set N : ℕ := 2 * (f m).natAbs
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hd0⟩ : ∃ d, d ∣ N.succPNat * m ∧ f m = -d := this _ N.lt_add_one
    obtain ⟨e, he, he0⟩ : ∃ e, e ∣ (N.succPNat + 1) * m ∧ f m = -e :=
      this _ (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right Nat.two_pos)
    
    refine ⟨d, ?_, hd0⟩
    obtain rfl : d = e := by rwa [hd0, Int.neg_inj, Int.natCast_inj, PNat.coe_inj] at he0
    rw [PNat.dvd_iff] at hd he ⊢
    rwa [add_one_mul, PNat.add_coe, Nat.dvd_add_right hd] at he
  
  rintro ⟨k, h⟩ (hk : k > 2 * (f m).natAbs)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hd0⟩ : ∃ d, d ∣ ⟨k, h⟩ * m ∧ _ ∣ d + f m :=
    hf.forall_right_exists_left (dvd_mul_left m _)
  refine ⟨d, hd, Eq.symm <| Int.neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero <|
    Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs hd0 ?_⟩
  
  let N : ℕ := k * m
  change (N : ℤ) ∣ d + f m at hd0
  replace hk : 2 * (f m).natAbs < N := hk.trans_le (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ m.pos)
  
  replace hd : 2 * d ≤ N := by
    
    rcases hd with ⟨t, ht⟩
    obtain ht0 | rfl : t > 1 ∨ t = 1 := (eq_one_or_one_lt t).symm
    · calc 2 * (d : ℕ)
        _ ≤ t * d := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ((PNat.coe_lt_coe _ _).mp ht0)
        _ = N := by rw [Nat.mul_comm, ← PNat.mul_coe, ← ht]; rfl
    
    replace ht : N = d := (congrArg PNat.val ht).trans d.1.mul_one
    replace hd0 : (N : ℤ) ∣ f m := by rwa [← ht, Int.dvd_add_right (Int.dvd_refl _)] at hd0
    replace hd0 : N ≤ (f m).natAbs :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hm) (Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mp hd0)
    exact absurd (hd0.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ Nat.two_pos)) hk.not_ge
  
  replace h : 2 * (d + (f m).natAbs) < 2 * N := by
    rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.two_mul N]
    exact Nat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hd hk
  exact (Int.natAbs_add_le _ _).trans_lt (Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h)

name: map_eq_neg
statement: theorem map_eq_neg (n) : f n = -n
proof:
:= by
  
  have h (k) (hk : k > 1) : ∃ e, e ∣ k * n ∧ f e = -n := by
    
    obtain ⟨e, he, he0⟩ : ∃ e, e ∣ k * n ∧ ↑↑(k * n) ∣ n + f e :=
      hf (k * n) n (dvd_mul_left n k)
    refine ⟨e, he, ?_⟩
    
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hd0⟩ : ∃ d, d ∣ e ∧ f e = -d := by
      refine hf.map_eq_zero_or_neg_divisor λ he1 ↦ ?_
      rw [he1, Int.add_zero, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, ← PNat.dvd_iff] at he0
      exact (PNat.le_of_dvd he0).not_gt (lt_mul_of_one_lt_left' n hk)
    
    rw [hd0, Int.add_neg_eq_sub] at he0
    rw [eq_of_dvd_of_dvd_sub (dvd_mul_left n k) (hd.trans he) he0, hd0]
  
  obtain ⟨e, he, he0⟩ : ∃ e, e ∣ 2 * n ∧ f e = -n := h 2 (by decide)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hd0⟩ : ∃ d, d ∣ 3 * n ∧ f d = -n := h 3 (by decide)
  obtain rfl : e = d := hf.injective (he0.trans hd0.symm)
  clear hd0
  
  replace hd : e ∣ n := by
    rw [PNat.dvd_iff, PNat.mul_coe, PNat.val_ofNat] at he hd
    rwa [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.dvd_add_right he, ← PNat.dvd_iff] at hd
  
  replace he : f e ≠ 0 := by
    rw [he0, Int.neg_ne_zero, Int.natCast_ne_zero]
    exact n.ne_zero
  replace he : n ∣ e := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ : ∃ c, c ∣ e ∧ f e = -c := hf.map_eq_zero_or_neg_divisor he
    rw [he0, Int.neg_inj, Int.natCast_inj, PNat.coe_inj] at hc0
    rwa [hc0]
  
  rwa [PNat.dvd_antisymm hd he] at he0

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : good f ↔ f = λ n : ℕ+ ↦ -(n : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ hf ↦ funext hf.map_eq_neg, λ hf ↦ hf ▸ neg_is_good⟩

name: f_triple_pos
statement: theorem f_triple_pos (hx : triple_pos x) : triple_pos (f x)
proof:
:=
  hx.imp (Nat.add_pos_left · _) (And.imp (Nat.add_pos_left · _) (Nat.add_pos_left · _))

name: triple_pos.f_iter
statement: theorem triple_pos.f_iter (hx : triple_pos x) (N) : triple_pos (f^[N] x)
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn N hx λ _ ↦ f.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ ▸ f_triple_pos

name: triple_pos.of_nsmul
statement: theorem triple_pos.of_nsmul {n : ℕ} (h : triple_pos (n • x)) : triple_pos x
proof:
:=
  h.imp Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left (And.imp Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left)

name: triple_pos.of_f_iter_nsmul
statement:
theorem triple_pos.of_f_iter_nsmul (h : triple_pos x) {k : ℕ} (h0 : f^[N] x = k • y) :
    triple_pos y
proof:
:=
  (h0 ▸ h.f_iter N).of_nsmul

name: f_nsmul
statement: theorem f_nsmul (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : f (n • x) = n • f x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨a, b, c⟩
  have h (a b c : ℕ) : n • (a + b.gcd c) = n • a + (n • b).gcd (n • c) := by
    change n * (a + b.gcd c) = n * a + (n * b).gcd (n * c)
    rw [Nat.gcd_mul_left, Nat.mul_add]
  simp only [f, Prod.smul_mk, h]

name: f_iter_nsmul
statement: theorem f_iter_nsmul (N n : ℕ) (x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : f^[N] (n • x) = n • f^[N] x
proof:
:= by
  induction N with | zero => rfl | succ N N_ih =>
    rw [f.iterate_succ_apply', N_ih, f_nsmul, f.iterate_succ_apply']

name: triple_pos_356
statement: theorem triple_pos_356 : triple_pos (3, 5, 6)
proof:
:= by
  unfold triple_pos; decide

name: f_iter3N_356
proof:
:= by
  induction N with | zero => rfl | succ N N_ih => ?_
  calc f^[3 * (N + 1)] (3, 5, 6)
    _ = 2 • f^[3 * N] (3, 5, 6) := f_iter_nsmul (3 * N) 2 (3, 5, 6)
    _ = (2 * (2 ^ N * 3), 2 * (2 ^ N * 5), 2 * (2 ^ N * 6)) := congrArg (2 • ·) N_ih
    _ = (2 ^ (N + 1) * 3, 2 ^ (N + 1) * 5, 2 ^ (N + 1) * 6) :=
      have h (a) : 2 * (2 ^ N * a) = 2 ^ (N + 1) * a := by rw [Nat.pow_succ', Nat.mul_assoc]
      Prod.ext (h 3) (Prod.ext (h 5) (h 6))

name: f_iterN_356
proof:
:= by
  rw [← f_iter_nsmul, ← f_iter3N_356, ← f.iterate_add_apply, Nat.mod_add_div]

name: f_iterN_356_fst_of_lt_three
statement: theorem f_iterN_356_fst_of_lt_three (hN : N < 3) : (f^[N] (3, 5, 6)).1 = 3 + N
proof:
:= by
  match N with | 0 => rfl | 1 => rfl | 2 => rfl

name: f_iterN_356_fst
proof:
:=
  (congrArg Prod.fst (f_iterN_356 N)).trans <| congrArg (2 ^ (N / 3) * ·) <|
    f_iterN_356_fst_of_lt_three (Nat.mod_lt N (Nat.succ_pos 2))

name: gcd_mod_two
statement: theorem gcd_mod_two (b c : ℕ) : b.gcd c % 2 = if b % 2 = 0 ∧ c % 2 = 0 then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : b % 2 = 0 ∧ c % 2 = 0
  
  · rw [ite_eq_left h, ← Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
    exact ⟨Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h.1, Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h.2⟩
  
  · rw [ite_eq_right h, ← Nat.mod_two_ne_zero, Ne, ← Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
    exact λ h0 ↦ h (h0.imp Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd)

name: add_gcd_Fin2_eq_g
statement: theorem add_gcd_Fin2_eq_g (a b c : ℕ) : ((a + b.gcd c : ℕ) : Fin 2) = g_1 a b c
proof:
:= by
  suffices (a + b.gcd c) % 2 = (g_1 a b c).val from Fin.val_inj.mp this
  calc (a + b.gcd c) % 2
    _ = (a % 2 + if b % 2 = 0 ∧ c % 2 = 0 then 0 else 1) % 2 := by
      rw [Nat.add_mod, gcd_mod_two]
    _ = ((a : Fin 2) + if (b : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (c : Fin 2) = 0 then 0 else 1) % 2 := by
      simp only [← Fin.val_inj (b := 0)]; rfl
    _ = (g_1 a b c : ℕ) := by
      generalize (a : Fin 2) = x, (b : Fin 2) = y, (c : Fin 2) = z
      unfold g_1; revert x y z; decide

name: triple_to_Fin2_semiconj_f_to_g
statement: theorem triple_to_Fin2_semiconj_f_to_g : triple_to_Fin2.Semiconj f g
proof:
:=
  λ _ ↦ Prod.ext (add_gcd_Fin2_eq_g _ _ _)
    (Prod.ext (add_gcd_Fin2_eq_g _ _ _) (add_gcd_Fin2_eq_g _ _ _))

name: g_iter3_eq_zero
statement: theorem g_iter3_eq_zero (x) : g^[3] x = (0, 0, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨a, b, c⟩
  revert a b c; decide

name: triple_to_Fin2_f_iter3_eq_zero
statement: theorem triple_to_Fin2_f_iter3_eq_zero (x) : triple_to_Fin2 (f^[3] x) = (0, 0, 0)
proof:
:=
  (triple_to_Fin2_semiconj_f_to_g.iterate_right 3 _).trans (g_iter3_eq_zero _)

name: f_iter3_exists_two_nsmul
statement: theorem f_iter3_exists_two_nsmul (x) : ∃ y, f^[3] x = 2 • y
proof:
:= by
  have h {a : ℕ} (ha : (a : Fin 2) = 0) : a = 2 * (a / 2) :=
    (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero (congrArg Fin.val ha))).symm
  let p := f^[3] x
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ : (p.1 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (p.2.1 : Fin 2) = 0 ∧ (p.2.2 : Fin 2) = 0 := by
    simpa only [Prod.ext_iff, triple_to_Fin2] using triple_to_Fin2_f_iter3_eq_zero _
  exact ⟨(p.1 / 2, p.2.1 / 2, p.2.2 / 2), Prod.ext (h h0) (Prod.ext (h h1) (h h2))⟩

name: f_iter3N_exists_two_pow_N_nsmul
statement: theorem f_iter3N_exists_two_pow_N_nsmul (x N) : ∃ y, f^[3 * N] x = 2 ^ N • y
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨x, (?_ : x = (1 * _, 1 * _, 1 * _))⟩
      simp only [Nat.one_mul]
  | succ N N_ih =>
      rcases N_ih with ⟨z, hz⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨a, b, c⟩, hy⟩ : ∃ y, f^[3] z = 2 • y := f_iter3_exists_two_nsmul z
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm, f.iterate_add_apply, hz, f_iter_nsmul, hy]
      have h (t) : 2 ^ N * (2 * t) = 2 ^ (N + 1) * t := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      exact ⟨⟨a, b, c⟩, Prod.ext (h _) (Prod.ext (h _) (h _))⟩

name: f_fst_of_triple_pos
statement: theorem f_fst_of_triple_pos (hx : triple_pos x) : x.1 + 1 ≤ (f x).1
proof:
:=
  Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left x.2.2 hx.2.1)

name: f_iter_fst_of_triple_pos
statement: theorem f_iter_fst_of_triple_pos (N : ℕ) (hx : triple_pos x) : x.1 + N ≤ (f^[N] x).1
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn N (Nat.le_refl _)
    λ n hn ↦ f.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ ▸
      Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hn (f_fst_of_triple_pos (hx.f_iter n))

name: four_le_f_iter3_fst_of_triple_pos
statement: theorem four_le_f_iter3_fst_of_triple_pos (hx : triple_pos x) : 4 ≤ (f^[3] x).1
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hx.1 3) (f_iter_fst_of_triple_pos 3 hx)

name: f_iter6_form_of_triple_pos
statement:
theorem f_iter6_form_of_triple_pos (hx : triple_pos x) :
    ∃ z, f^[6] x = 4 • z ∧ 3 ≤ z.1
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, f^[3] x = 2 • y := f_iter3_exists_two_nsmul x
  have hy0 : triple_pos y := hx.of_f_iter_nsmul hy
  have hy1 : 2 ≤ y.1 :=
    Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hc := Nat.two_pos)
      (Nat.le_trans (four_le_f_iter3_fst_of_triple_pos hx) (hy ▸ Nat.le_refl _))
  
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, f^[3] y = 2 • z := f_iter3_exists_two_nsmul y
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · rw [f.iterate_add_apply 3 3, hy, f_iter_nsmul, hz]
    have h (a) : 2 * (2 * a) = 4 * a := (Nat.mul_assoc 2 2 a).symm
    exact Prod.ext (h _) (Prod.ext (h _) (h _))
  
  · have hz0 : 5 ≤ 2 * z.1 := calc
      _ ≤ y.1 + 3 := Nat.add_le_add_right hy1 3
      _ ≤ (f^[3] y).1 := f_iter_fst_of_triple_pos 3 hy0
      _ = 2 * z.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hz
    exact Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (a := 2) hz0

name: f_iter3N_div_two_pow_N_fst
statement:
theorem f_iter3N_div_two_pow_N_fst
    (hx : triple_pos x) (hx0 : 3 ≤ x.1) (hy : f^[3 * N] x = 2 ^ N • y) : 3 ≤ y.1
proof:
:= by
  induction N generalizing y with
    | zero => subst hy; exact Nat.one_mul y.1 ▸ hx0
    | succ N N_ih => ?_
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, f^[3 * N] x = 2 ^ N • z := f_iter3N_exists_two_pow_N_nsmul x N
  have hz0 : triple_pos z := hx.of_f_iter_nsmul hz
  replace N_ih : 6 ≤ (f^[3] z).1 := calc
    _ ≤ z.1 + 3 := Nat.add_le_add_right (N_ih hz) 3
    _ ≤ (f^[3] z).1 := f_iter_fst_of_triple_pos 3 hz0
  replace hy : 2 ^ N * (f^[3] z).1 = 2 ^ (N + 1) * y.1 :=
    calc (2 ^ N • f^[3] z).1
    _ = (f^[3] (f^[3 * N] x)).1 := by rw [hz, f_iter_nsmul]
    _ = (f^[3 * (N + 1)] x).1 := by rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm, f.iterate_add_apply]
    _ = 2 ^ (N + 1) * y.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hy
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (Nat.two_pow_pos (N + 1))
  calc 2 ^ (N + 1) * 3
    _ = 2 ^ N * 6 := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ 2 ^ N * (f^[3] z).1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ N_ih
    _ = 2 ^ (N + 1) * y.1 := hy

name: f_iterN_of_three_le_fst
statement:
theorem f_iterN_of_three_le_fst {x} (hx : triple_pos x) (hx0 : 3 ≤ x.1) (N) :
    2 ^ (N / 3) * (3 + N % 3) ≤ (f^[N] x).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, f^[3 * (N / 3)] x = 2 ^ (N / 3) • y :=
    f_iter3N_exists_two_pow_N_nsmul _ _
  calc 2 ^ (N / 3) * (3 + N % 3)
    _ ≤ (2 ^ (N / 3) • f^[N % 3] y).1 :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ <| Nat.le_trans
        (Nat.add_le_add_right (f_iter3N_div_two_pow_N_fst hx hx0 hy) _)
        (f_iter_fst_of_triple_pos _ (hx.of_f_iter_nsmul hy))
    _ = (f^[N] x).1 := by
      rw [← f_iter_nsmul, ← hy, ← f.iterate_add_apply, Nat.mod_add_div]

name: f_iterN_fst_of_ge_six
statement:
theorem f_iterN_fst_of_ge_six (hN : N ≥ 6) (hx : triple_pos x) :
    2 ^ (N / 3) * (3 + N % 3) ≤ (f^[N] x).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, rfl⟩ : ∃ K, N = K + 6 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hN
  obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz⟩ : ∃ z, f^[6] x = 4 • z ∧ 3 ≤ z.1 := f_iter6_form_of_triple_pos hx
  rw [f.iterate_add_apply, hz0, f_iter_nsmul, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left _ 3 2,
    Nat.add_mul_div_left K 2 (Nat.succ_pos 2), Nat.add_comm, Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_assoc]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (f_iterN_of_three_le_fst (hx.of_f_iter_nsmul hz0) hz K)

name: general_result
statement:
theorem general_result (hN : N ≥ 6) :
    IsLeast ((Set.ofPred triple_pos).image λ x ↦ (f^[N] x).1) (2 ^ (N / 3) * (3 + N % 3))
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨(3, 5, 6), triple_pos_356, f_iterN_356_fst N⟩,
  λ _ ⟨_, hx, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ f_iterN_fst_of_ge_six hN hx⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (hN : N ≥ 2) :
    IsLeast ((Set.ofPred triple_pos).image λ x ↦ (f^[3 * N] x).1) (2 ^ N * 3)

name: add_sq_le_two_mul_imp
statement:
lemma add_sq_le_two_mul_imp [ExistsAddOfLE R] {x y : R} (h : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 2 * x * y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  have X {x c : R} (h : x ^ 2 + (x + c) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * x * (x + c)) : c = 0 := by
    rw [add_sq, sq, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, ← two_mul,
      ← mul_assoc, ← mul_add, add_le_iff_nonpos_right] at h
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (h.antisymm (sq_nonneg c))
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ | ⟨c, rfl⟩ : (∃ c, y = x + c) ∨ (∃ c, x = y + c) :=
    (le_total x y).imp exists_add_of_le exists_add_of_le
  · rw [X h, add_zero]
  · rw [add_comm, mul_right_comm] at h
    rw [X h, add_zero]

name: weakGood_iff
statement: theorem weakGood_iff [ExistsAddOfLE R] {f : R → R} : weakGood f ↔ ∀ x > 0, x * f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hf ↦ ?_, λ hf x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · have hf0 {x} (hx : 0 < x) : x * f x ≤ 1 := by
      obtain ⟨y, ⟨hy, hy0⟩, h⟩ := hf x hx
      suffices x = y by
        rwa [← mul_one 2, ← this, ← two_mul, mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left two_pos] at hy0
      by_contra h0
      have h1 : 1 < x * f x := by
        rw [← mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_left two_pos, mul_one, two_mul]
        exact lt_of_not_ge λ h1 ↦ h0 (h x ⟨hx, h1⟩)
      have h2 : 1 < y * f y := by
        rw [← mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_left two_pos, mul_one, two_mul]
        refine lt_of_not_ge λ h2 ↦ h0 ((hf y hy).unique ⟨hx, ?_⟩ ⟨hy, h2⟩)
        rwa [add_comm] at hy0
      refine hy0.not_gt (lt_of_mul_lt_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (mul_pos hx hy).le)
      calc
        _ = 2 * x * y := (mul_assoc 2 x y).symm
        _ ≤ x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := two_mul_le_add_sq x y
        _ < x ^ 2 * (y * f y) + y ^ 2 * (x * f x) :=
          add_lt_add (lt_mul_of_one_lt_right (pow_pos hx 2) h2)
            (lt_mul_of_one_lt_right (pow_pos hy 2) h1)
        _ = x * y * (x * f y) + y * x * (y * f x) := by
          apply congrArg₂ <;> rw [sq, mul_mul_mul_comm]
        _ = _ := by rw [mul_comm y x, ← mul_add, mul_comm]
    replace hf {x y} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (h : x * f y + y * f x ≤ 2) : x = y := by
      refine (hf x hx).unique ⟨hx, ?_⟩ ⟨hy, h⟩
      have h0 := hf0 hx; exact (add_le_add h0 h0).trans_eq one_add_one_eq_two
    intro x hx; have h := hf0 hx
    obtain ⟨M, h0⟩ : ∃ M, 1 = x * f x + M := exists_add_of_le h
    suffices (1 + M) * x = x by
      rw [one_add_mul, add_eq_left, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_left hx.ne.symm] at this
      rw [h0, this, add_zero]
    replace h : 0 ≤ M := by rwa [h0, le_add_iff_nonneg_right] at h
    have h1 : 0 < 1 + M := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg one_pos h
    have h2 : 0 < (1 + M) * x := mul_pos h1 hx
    have h3 : x * f ((1 + M) * x) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left h1, ← mul_assoc, mul_one]
      exact le_add_of_le_of_nonneg (hf0 h2) h
    have h4 : (1 + M) * x * f x ≤ 1 := by calc
      _ ≤ (1 + M) * x * f x + M ^ 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg M)
      _ = x * f x + M * (x * f x) + M ^ 2 := by rw [mul_assoc, one_add_mul]
      _ = x * f x + M * (x * f x + M) := by rw [add_assoc, sq, mul_add]
      _ = 1 := by rw [← h0, mul_one, ← h0]
    exact hf h2 hx ((add_le_add h4 h3).trans_eq one_add_one_eq_two)
  
  · refine ⟨x, ⟨hx, hf x hx ▸ one_add_one_eq_two.le⟩, λ y hy ↦ add_sq_le_two_mul_imp ?_⟩
    calc
      _ = x ^ 2 * (y * f y) + y ^ 2 * (x * f x) := by
        rw [add_comm, hf x hx, hf y hy.1, mul_one, mul_one]
      _ = x * y * (x * f y) + y * x * (y * f x) := by
        apply congrArg₂ <;> rw [sq, mul_mul_mul_comm]
      _ = (x * f y + y * f x) * (y * x) := by
        rw [mul_comm x, ← mul_add, mul_comm]
      _ ≤ 2 * (y * x) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hy.2 (mul_pos hy.1 hx).le
      _ = _ := (mul_assoc 2 y x).symm

name: posSubtypeExt_spec
statement:
lemma posSubtypeExt_spec (f : {x : R // 0 < x} → {x : R // 0 < x}) (x : {x : R // 0 < x}) :
    posSubtypeExt f x.1 = f x
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left _

name: good_iff_posSubtypeExt_weakGood
statement:
lemma good_iff_posSubtypeExt_weakGood {f : {x : R // 0 < x} → {x : R // 0 < x}} :
    good f ↔ weakGood (posSubtypeExt f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hf x hx ↦ ?_, λ hf x ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · lift x to {x : R // 0 < x} using hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ := hf x
    refine ⟨y.1, ⟨y.2, ?_⟩, λ z hz ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [posSubtypeExt_spec, posSubtypeExt_spec]; exact hy
    · rcases hz with ⟨hz, hz0⟩; lift z to {x : R // 0 < x} using hz
      rw [posSubtypeExt_spec, posSubtypeExt_spec] at hz0
      exact congrArg _ (hy0 z hz0)
  
  · obtain ⟨y, ⟨hy, hy0⟩, hy1⟩ := hf x.1 x.2
    lift y to {x : R // 0 < x} using hy
    refine ⟨y, ?_, λ z hz ↦ ?_⟩
    · rwa [posSubtypeExt_spec, posSubtypeExt_spec] at hy0
    · refine Subtype.ext (hy1 z.1 ⟨z.2, ?_⟩)
      rwa [posSubtypeExt_spec, posSubtypeExt_spec]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [ExistsAddOfLE R] {f : {x : R // 0 < x} → {x : R // 0 < x}} :
    good f ↔ ∀ x, x * f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [good_iff_posSubtypeExt_weakGood, weakGood_iff]
  refine ⟨λ h x ↦ ?_, λ h x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  · specialize h x.1 x.2
    rw [posSubtypeExt_spec] at h
    exact Subtype.ext h
  · lift x to {x : R // 0 < x} using hx
    rw [posSubtypeExt_spec]; exact congrArg (λ x ↦ x.1) (h x)

name: mem_of_add_eq
statement: theorem mem_of_add_eq (hx : x = v + w) : x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  hx ▸ hS.add_mem _ hv _ hw

name: mem_of_sup_eq
statement: theorem mem_of_sup_eq (hx : x = v ⊔ w) : x ∈ S

name: Finset_range_sup_mem
statement:
theorem Finset_range_sup_mem {f : ℕ → α} (hf : ∀ k, f k ∈ S) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (Finset.range n.succ).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one f ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec ?_ λ n hn ↦ ?_
  · simpa only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sup'_singleton] using hf 0
  · simp only [Finset.range_add_one (n := n.succ)]
    rw [Finset.sup'_insert Finset.nonempty_range_add_one]
    exact hS.sup_mem _ (hf n.succ) _ hn

name: mem_of_Finset_range_sup_eq
statement:
theorem mem_of_Finset_range_sup_eq {f : ℕ → α} (hf : ∀ k, f k ∈ S) {x : α}
    (hx : x = (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one f) : x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  hx ▸ Finset_range_sup_mem hS hf n

name: Fin_univ_sup_mem
statement:
theorem Fin_univ_sup_mem {f : Fin (n + 1) → α} (hf : ∀ k, f k ∈ S) :
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty f ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Finset.range n.succ).image (λ k : ℕ ↦ (k : Fin (n + 1))) = Finset.univ :=
    Finset.eq_univ_of_forall λ k ↦ Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨k.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr k.isLt, k.cast_val_eq_self⟩
  simp only [← h, ← Finset.sup'_comp_eq_image Finset.nonempty_range_add_one]
  exact Finset_range_sup_mem hS (λ k ↦ hf k) n

name: mem_of_Fin_univ_sup_eq
statement:
theorem mem_of_Fin_univ_sup_eq {f : Fin (n + 1) → α} (hf : ∀ k, f k ∈ S)
    {x : α} (hx : x = Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty f) : x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  hx ▸ hS.Fin_univ_sup_mem hf

name: smul_mem_of_pos
statement: theorem smul_mem_of_pos (hv : v ∈ S) : ∀ n > 0, n • v ∈ S
proof:
:=

    λ n _ hn ↦ hS.mem_of_add_eq hn hv (succ_nsmul v n)

name: add_smul_mem
statement:
theorem add_smul_mem (hv : v ∈ S) (hw : w ∈ S) : ∀ n : ℕ, v + n • w ∈ S
  | 0 => by rwa [zero_nsmul, add_zero]
  | n + 1 => hS.add_mem _ hv _ (hS.smul_mem_of_pos hw _ n.succ_pos)

name: mem_of_add_smul_eq
statement: theorem mem_of_add_smul_eq (hv : v ∈ S) (hw : w ∈ S) {n : ℕ} (hx : x = v + n • w) : x ∈ S

  hx ▸ hS.add_smul_mem hv hw n

name: univ
statement:
theorem univ [Add α] [Max α] : AddMaxClosed (Set.univ : Set α) where
  add_mem
proof:
:= λ _ _ _ _ ↦ Set.mem_univ _
  sup_mem := λ _ _ _ _ ↦ Set.mem_univ _

name: ofNonnegHalf

theorem ofNonnegHalf (i : ι) : AddMaxClosed {v : ι → ℤ | 0 ≤ v i} where

  sup_mem := λ _ hv _ _ ↦ hv.trans (Int.le_max_left _ _)

theorem ofNonposHalf (i : ι) : AddMaxClosed {v : ι → ℤ | v i ≤ 0} where
