  sup_mem := λ _ hv _ hw ↦ Set.mem_ofPred_eq.mpr (sup_le_iff.mpr ⟨hv, hw⟩)

name: ofSlopedHalf
statement:
theorem ofSlopedHalf {x y : ℤ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (i j : ι) :
    AddMaxClosed {v : ι → ℤ | x * v i ≤ y * v j} where
  add_mem
proof:
:= λ v hv w hw ↦ by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Pi.add_apply, Int.mul_add]
    exact Int.add_le_add hv hw
  sup_mem := λ v hv w hw ↦ by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Pi.sup_apply]
    rw [mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ hx, mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ hy]
    exact max_le_max hv hw

name: ofPreimage
statement:
theorem ofPreimage {S : Set (α → ℤ)} (hS : AddMaxClosed S) (i : α → β) :
    AddMaxClosed ((· ∘ i) ⁻¹' S) where
  add_mem
proof:
:= λ _ hv _ hw ↦ hS.add_mem _ hv _ hw
  sup_mem := λ _ hv _ hw ↦ hS.sup_mem _ hv _ hw

name: Nat_Finsupp_mem_of_zero_single_mem
proof:
:= by
  
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact hS0
  | add _ _ hf hg => exact hS.add_mem _ hf _ hg
  | single i k => ?_
  obtain rfl | h : k = 0 ∨ 0 < k := k.eq_zero_or_pos
  · rw [Finsupp.single_zero]; exact hS0
  · have h0 : (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ) ∘ ⇑(Finsupp.single i k) = k • ⇑(Finsupp.single i 1) := by
      funext j; rw [Function.comp_apply, Pi.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul]
      obtain rfl | h0 : i = j ∨ i ≠ j := eq_or_ne i j
      · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, Finsupp.single_eq_same, mul_one]
      · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne' h0, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne' h0, Int.mul_zero]; rfl
    exact h0 ▸ hS.smul_mem_of_pos (hS1 i) k h

name: Nat_mem_of_zero_single_mem
statement: theorem Nat_mem_of_zero_single_mem (v : ι → ℕ) : Nat.cast ∘ v ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat_Finsupp_mem_of_zero_single_mem hS hS0 (λ i ↦ ?_)
    (Finsupp.onFinset Finset.univ v λ _ _ ↦ Finset.mem_univ _)
  rw [Finsupp.single, Finsupp.coe_mk]; convert hS1 i

name: Int_mem_of_zero_single_mem
statement: theorem Int_mem_of_zero_single_mem {v : ι → ℤ} (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i) : v ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  lift v to ι → ℕ using hf; exact Nat_mem_of_zero_single_mem hS hS0 hS1 v

name: eq_univ_of_neg_one_and_single_mem
statement: theorem eq_univ_of_neg_one_and_single_mem (hS2 : -1 ∈ S) : S = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.eq_univ_of_forall λ v ↦ ?_
  suffices ∃ (w : ι → ℤ) (n : ℕ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧ n > 0 ∧ v = w + n • -1 by
    rcases this with ⟨w, n, hw, hn, rfl⟩
    exact hS.add_mem _ (hS.Int_mem_of_zero_single_mem hS0 hS1 hw)
      _ (hS.smul_mem_of_pos hS2 _ hn)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i, -v i ≤ N := by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (Finset.univ.image λ i ↦ (v i).natAbs).exists_le
    refine ⟨N, λ i ↦ (neg_le_abs _).trans ?_⟩
    rw [← Int.natCast_natAbs, Int.ofNat_le]
    exact hN _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _))
  refine ⟨v - (N + 1) • (-1), N + 1, λ i ↦ ?_, N.succ_pos, (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm⟩
  show 0 ≤ v i - (N + 1) * (-1)
  rw [mul_neg_one, sub_neg_eq_add, ← neg_le_iff_add_nonneg']
  exact Int.le_add_one (hN i)

name: univ
statement: lemma univ [Fintype α] [Add α] [Max α] : AddSupGenerator (Finset.univ : Finset α)
proof:
:=
  λ S hS _ ↦ by rwa [Finset.coe_univ, Set.univ_subset_iff] at hS

name: ofSubset
statement:
lemma ofSubset [Add α] [Max α] {A B : Finset α} (hA : AddSupGenerator A) (hAB : A ⊆ B) :
    AddSupGenerator B
proof:
:=
  λ S hS ↦ hA S λ _ h ↦ hS (hAB h)

name: ofEmbedding
statement:
lemma ofEmbedding [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    {A : Finset (α → ℤ)} (hA : AddSupGenerator A) (ι : β ↪ α) :
    AddSupGenerator (A.image λ f ↦ f ∘ ι)
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS hS0
  rw [Finset.coe_image, Set.image_subset_iff] at hS
  specialize hA _ hS (hS0.ofPreimage _)
  have h : (λ f : α → ℤ ↦ f ∘ ι).Surjective := ι.2.surjective_comp_right
  rwa [Set.preimage_eq_univ_iff, Set.range_eq_univ.mpr h, Set.univ_subset_iff] at hA

name: empty_not_AddSupGenerator
statement:
theorem empty_not_AddSupGenerator [Add α] [Max α] [Nonempty α] :
    ¬AddSupGenerator (∅ : Finset α)
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ Set.empty_ne_univ (h ∅ (λ _ hf ↦ Set.mem_toFinset.mp hf) AddMaxClosed.empty)

name: not_AddSupGenerator_of_subset_NonnegHalf
statement:
theorem not_AddSupGenerator_of_subset_NonnegHalf
    {S : Finset (ι → ℤ)} (hS : (S : Set (ι → ℤ)) ⊆ {v | 0 ≤ v i}) :
    ¬AddSupGenerator S
proof:
:= by
  intro h; have h0 : -1 ∈ {v : ι → ℤ | 0 ≤ v i} :=
    h _ hS (AddMaxClosed.ofNonnegHalf i) ▸ Set.mem_univ _
  exact (Int.negSucc_not_nonneg 0).mp h0

name: not_AddSupGenerator_of_subset_NonposHalf
statement:
theorem not_AddSupGenerator_of_subset_NonposHalf
    {S : Finset (ι → ℤ)} (hS : (S : Set (ι → ℤ)) ⊆ {v | v i ≤ 0}) :
    ¬AddSupGenerator S
proof:
:= by
  intro h; have h0 : 1 ∈ {v : ι → ℤ | v i ≤ 0} :=
    h _ hS (AddMaxClosed.ofNonposHalf i) ▸ Set.mem_univ _
  exact (Int.negSucc_not_nonneg 0).mp h0

name: singleton_not_AddSupGenerator
statement:
theorem singleton_not_AddSupGenerator [hι : Nonempty ι] (v : ι → ℤ) :
    ¬AddSupGenerator {v}
proof:
:= by
  intro h; rcases hι with ⟨i⟩
  obtain h0 | h0 : 0 ≤ v i ∨ v i ≤ 0 := le_total _ _
  exacts [not_AddSupGenerator_of_subset_NonnegHalf (Finset.singleton_subset_set_iff.mpr h0) h,
    not_AddSupGenerator_of_subset_NonposHalf (Finset.singleton_subset_set_iff.mpr h0) h]

name: Fin2_AddSupGenerator
statement: theorem Fin2_AddSupGenerator : AddSupGenerator {![-1, 1], ![1, -2]}
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS hS0; replace hS : ![-1, 1] ∈ S ∧ ![1, -2] ∈ S := by
    rw [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton] at hS
    exact ⟨hS (Set.mem_insert _ _), hS (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)⟩
  have h : ![0, -1] ∈ S := hS0.mem_of_add_eq hS.1 hS.2 (by decide)
  have h0 : ![-1, 0] ∈ S := hS0.mem_of_add_eq h hS.1 (by decide)
  have h1 : Pi.single 1 1 ∈ S := hS0.mem_of_sup_eq h hS.1 (by decide)
  replace hS : ∀ i : Fin 2, Pi.single i 1 ∈ S
    | 1 => h1 | 0 => hS0.mem_of_sup_eq h0 hS.2 (by decide)
  replace h : -1 ∈ S := hS0.mem_of_add_eq h h0 (by decide)
  replace h0 : 1 ∈ S := hS0.mem_of_add_eq (hS 0) (hS 1) (by decide)
  replace h1 : 0 ∈ S := hS0.mem_of_add_eq h h0 (by decide)
  exact AddMaxClosed.eq_univ_of_neg_one_and_single_mem hS0 h1 hS h

name: doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp
statement: theorem doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp₁ (i) : v i * w i < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_le, mul_nonneg_iff]
  rintro (⟨h0, h1⟩ | ⟨h0, h1⟩)
  
  · refine not_AddSupGenerator_of_subset_NonnegHalf (i := i) ?_ h
    rw [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton]
    rintro _ (rfl | rfl); exacts [h0, h1]
  
  · refine not_AddSupGenerator_of_subset_NonposHalf (i := i) ?_ h
    rw [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton]
    rintro _ (rfl | rfl); exacts [h0, h1]

name: doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp
statement: theorem doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp₂ (h0 : i ≠ j) : v i * v j < 0
proof:
:= by
  
  wlog hvi : 0 < v i generalizing h v w
  · specialize this (Finset.pair_comm v w ▸ h)
      (pos_of_mul_neg_right (doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp₁ h i) (not_lt.mp hvi))
    refine neg_of_mul_pos_left ?_ this.le
    rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_pos_iff]
    have h2 := doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp₁ h
    right; exact ⟨h2 i, h2 j⟩
  
  refine mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hvi (lt_of_not_ge λ hvj ↦ ?_)
  replace hvj : 0 < v j :=
    hvj.lt_of_ne λ h1 ↦ (doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp₁ h j).ne (by rw [← h1, zero_mul])
  have hwi : w i < 0 := neg_of_mul_neg_right (doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp₁ h i) hvi.le
  have hwj : w j < 0 := neg_of_mul_neg_right (doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp₁ h j) hvj.le
  
  wlog h1 : v j * w i ≤ v i * w j generalizing i j
  · exact this h0.symm hvj hvi hwj hwi (Int.le_of_not_le h1)
  
  have h2 : {x : ι → ℤ | v j * x i ≤ v i * x j} = Set.univ := by
    refine h _ ?_ (AddMaxClosed.ofSlopedHalf hvj.le hvi.le i j)
    rw [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton]
    rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [Int.le_of_eq (mul_comm _ _), h1]
  replace h2 : Pi.single i 1 ∈ {x : ι → ℤ | v j * x i ≤ v i * x j} := h2 ▸ Set.mem_univ _
  rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Pi.single_eq_same, mul_one,
    Pi.single_eq_of_ne h0.symm, mul_zero] at h2
  exact hvj.not_ge h2

name: Fin3_doubleton_not_AddSupGenerator
statement: theorem Fin3_doubleton_not_AddSupGenerator (v w : Fin 3 → ℤ) : ¬AddSupGenerator {v, w}
proof:
:= by
  have X : ∀ i : Fin 3, i ≠ i + 1 := by decide
  intro h; replace h (i) := doubleton_AddSupGenerator_imp₂ h (X i)
  have h0 : (v 0 * v 1) * (v 1 * v 2) * (v 2 * v 0) < 0 :=
    mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (h 0) (h 1)) (h 2)
  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_rotate (v 0), ← sq] at h0
  exact h0.not_ge (sq_nonneg _)

name: Fin_general_AddSupGenerator
statement:
theorem Fin_general_AddSupGenerator (n : ℕ) :
    AddSupGenerator {-1, λ k ↦ k.1, λ k : Fin (n + 1) ↦ 1 - (k.1 : ℤ) ^ 2}
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS hS0
  
  rw [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.subset_def] at hS
  simp only [Set.forall_mem_insert, Set.mem_singleton_iff, forall_eq] at hS
  rcases hS with ⟨hS, h⟩
  replace h (k : Fin n.succ) : (λ j : Fin n.succ ↦ 1 - (j.1 - k.1 : ℤ) ^ 2) ∈ S := by
    apply hS0.mem_of_add_smul_eq (hS0.add_smul_mem h.2 h.1 (2 * k)) hS (n := k.1 ^ 2)
    funext j; show 1 - (j.1 - k.1 : ℤ) ^ 2 = 1 - j.1 ^ 2 + 2 * k * j + k ^ 2 * -1
    rw [mul_neg_one, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_add, sub_sub, sub_sq, Int.mul_right_comm]
  
  have h0 : 0 ∈ S := by
    refine hS0.mem_of_add_eq hS (hS0.mem_of_Fin_univ_sup_eq h ?_) (neg_add_cancel _).symm
    funext k; rw [Pi.one_apply, Finset.sup'_apply]
    apply le_antisymm
    exacts [Finset.le_sup'_of_le _ (Finset.mem_univ k) (sub_self (k.1 : ℤ) ▸ Int.le_refl 1),
      Finset.sup'_le Finset.univ_nonempty _ λ j _ ↦ sub_le_self _ (sq_nonneg _)]
  
  replace h (k) : Pi.single k 1 ∈ S := by
    refine hS0.mem_of_sup_eq h0 (h k) (funext λ j ↦ ?_)
    show Pi.single k 1 j = max 0 (1 - (j.1 - k.1 : ℤ) ^ 2)
    obtain rfl | h1 : k = j ∨ k ≠ j := eq_or_ne k j
    · rw [Pi.single_eq_same, sub_self]; rfl
    · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne h1.symm, eq_comm, max_eq_left_iff, sub_nonpos]
      refine Int.add_one_le_of_lt (a := 0) (Int.natAbs_sq _ ▸ pow_pos ?_ 2)
      rw [Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_pos, sub_ne_zero, ne_eq, Int.ofNat_inj, Fin.val_inj]
      exact h1.symm
  exact AddMaxClosed.eq_univ_of_neg_one_and_single_mem hS0 h0 h hS

name: of_Nat_le
statement: theorem of_Nat_le (h : n ≤ k) : good ι n → good ι k
proof:
:=
  λ ⟨I, hI, hI0⟩ ↦ ⟨I, hI.trans h, hI0⟩

name: iff_of_self_and_succ
statement:
theorem iff_of_self_and_succ (hN : ¬good ι N) (hN0 : good ι N.succ) :
    good ι n ↔ N.succ ≤ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ Nat.lt_of_not_le λ h0 ↦ hN (h.of_Nat_le h0), hN0.of_Nat_le⟩

name: of_Fintype_card_le
statement: theorem of_Fintype_card_le (h : Fintype.card β ≤ Fintype.card α) : good α n → good β n
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨A, hA, hA0⟩
  obtain ⟨ι⟩ : Nonempty (β ↪ α) := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le h
  exact ⟨A.image (· ∘ ι), Finset.card_image_le.trans hA, hA0.ofEmbedding ι⟩

name: iff_Fintype_card_eq
statement: theorem iff_Fintype_card_eq (h : Fintype.card α = Fintype.card β) : good α n ↔ good β n
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ hn ↦ hn.of_Fintype_card_le h.symm.le, λ hn ↦ hn.of_Fintype_card_le h.le⟩

name: good_Empty_iff
statement: theorem good_Empty_iff : good Empty n ↔ 1 ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  refine good.iff_of_self_and_succ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨I, hI, hI0⟩
    rw [Nat.le_zero, Finset.card_eq_zero] at hI
    subst hI; exact empty_not_AddSupGenerator hI0
  · refine ⟨{0}, Nat.le_refl 1, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.singleton_eq_univ]; exact AddSupGenerator.univ

name: not_good_one_of_Nonempty
statement: theorem not_good_one_of_Nonempty [hι : Nonempty ι] : ¬good ι 1
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨I, hI, hI0⟩
  rw [Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one, Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.card_eq_one] at hI
  rcases hI with rfl | ⟨v, rfl⟩
  exacts [empty_not_AddSupGenerator hI0, singleton_not_AddSupGenerator v hI0]

name: good_Fin2_two
statement: theorem good_Fin2_two : good (Fin 2) 2
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, Finset.card_le_two, Fin2_AddSupGenerator⟩

name: not_good_Fin3_two
statement: theorem not_good_Fin3_two : ¬good (Fin 3) 2
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨I, hI, hI0⟩
  rw [Nat.le_succ_iff, Finset.card_eq_two] at hI
  rcases hI with hI | ⟨x, y, -, rfl⟩
  exacts [not_good_one_of_Nonempty ⟨I, hI, hI0⟩, Fin3_doubleton_not_AddSupGenerator _ _ hI0]

name: good_Fin_three
statement: theorem good_Fin_three (n : ℕ) : good (Fin n.succ) 3
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, Finset.card_le_three, Fin_general_AddSupGenerator n⟩

name: good_Fintype_iff
statement: theorem good_Fintype_iff₁ (hι : Fintype.card ι = 0) : good ι n ↔ 1 ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [good.iff_Fintype_card_eq (β := Empty) hι, good_Empty_iff]

name: good_Fintype_iff
statement:
theorem good_Fintype_iff₂ (hι : Fintype.card ι ≠ 0) (hι0 : Fintype.card ι ≤ 2) :
    good ι n ↔ 2 ≤ n
proof:
:=
  have : Nonempty ι := (isEmpty_or_nonempty ι).resolve_left λ _ ↦ hι Fintype.card_eq_zero
  good.iff_of_self_and_succ not_good_one_of_Nonempty
    (good_Fin2_two.of_Fintype_card_le (α := Fin 2) hι0)

name: good_Fintype_iff
statement: theorem good_Fintype_iff₃ (hι : 3 ≤ Fintype.card ι) : good ι n ↔ 3 ≤ n
proof:
:=
  good.iff_of_self_and_succ
    (λ h ↦ not_good_Fin3_two (h.of_Fintype_card_le hι))
    ((good_Fin_three (Fintype.card ι)).of_Fintype_card_le <|
      (Nat.le_succ _).trans_eq (Fintype.card_fin _).symm)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    good ι n ↔ n ≥ if Fintype.card ι = 0 then 1 else
      if Fintype.card ι ≤ 2 then 2 else 3
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h h0
  exacts [good_Fintype_iff₁ h, good_Fintype_iff₂ h h0,
    good_Fintype_iff₃ (Nat.lt_of_not_le h0)]

name: ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext [Add G] {f g : InfectiousFun G} : (∀ x, f x = g x) → f = g
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext _ _

name: infectious_def
statement: theorem infectious_def [Add G] (f : InfectiousFun G) (x y) : f (x + f y) = f x + f y
proof:
:=
  f.infectious_def' x y

name: infectious_sub
statement: theorem infectious_sub (x y) : f (x - f y) = f x - f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← f.infectious_def, sub_add_cancel]

name: map_zsmul_map_zero
statement: theorem map_zsmul_map_zero (k : ℤ) : f (k • f 0) = (k + 1) • f 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, h⟩ : k • f 0 ∈ rangeSubgroup f := f.rangeSubgroup.zsmul_mem ⟨0, rfl⟩ k
  rw [← zero_add (k • _), Int.add_comm, one_add_zsmul, ← h, f.infectious_def]

name: gcd_addOrderOf_dvd_iff
statement:
lemma gcd_addOrderOf_dvd_iff [AddGroup G] {g : G} {a b : ℤ} :
    a.gcd (addOrderOf g) ∣ b.natAbs ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, (a * k) • g = b • g
proof:
:= by
  have h : b.natAbs = b ∨ b.natAbs = -b := b.natAbs_eq.imp Eq.symm Int.eq_neg_comm.mp
  simp_rw [← addOrderOf_dvd_sub_iff_zsmul_eq_zsmul, Int.gcd_dvd_iff]
  generalize (b.natAbs : ℤ) = c at h ⊢
  rcases h with rfl | rfl
  
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, y, rfl⟩; refine ⟨x, -y, ?_⟩
      rw [sub_add_cancel_left, mul_neg]
    · rintro ⟨k, y, h⟩; refine ⟨k, -y, ?_⟩
      rw [mul_neg, ← h, neg_sub, add_sub_cancel]
  
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, y, h⟩; refine ⟨-x, y, ?_⟩
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, h, mul_neg, neg_add_cancel_left]
    · intro ⟨k, y, h⟩; refine ⟨-k, y, ?_⟩
      rw [← h, mul_neg, ← add_sub_assoc, neg_add_cancel, zero_sub]

name: imp_good
statement:
theorem imp_good [AddGroup G] (h : ∀ g : G, (m - n).gcd (addOrderOf g) ∣ m.natAbs) :
    good G m n
proof:
:= by
  intro f; replace h := gcd_addOrderOf_dvd_iff.mp (h (f 0))
  rcases h with ⟨k, h⟩; refine ⟨-k • f 0, ?_⟩
  rw [f.map_zsmul_map_zero, ← mul_zsmul, ← mul_zsmul, mul_add_one, add_zsmul, Int.mul_neg,
    neg_zsmul, neg_add_eq_iff_eq_add, Int.mul_neg, neg_zsmul, ← sub_zsmul, ← sub_mul, h]

name: good_mk_of_repFn_prop
statement:
theorem good_mk_of_repFn_prop
    (φ : G ⧸ H → H) (rep : G ⧸ H → G) (hrep : ∀ x, (rep x : G ⧸ H) = x) :
    ∃ (j : G ⧸ H) (h : H), (m - n) • h = -(m • φ j) + n • rep j
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : G, m • (↑(φ z) + (-rep ↑z + z)) = n • z :=
    h (InfectiousFun.mk_of_repFn H φ rep hrep)
  
  refine ⟨z, ⟨-rep z + z, by rw [← QuotientAddGroup.eq, hrep]⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [eq_neg_add_iff_add_eq, sub_zsmul, ← add_assoc, ← zsmul_add, hz,
    ← zsmul_neg, neg_add_rev, neg_neg, ← zsmul_add, add_neg_cancel_left]

name: good_mk_of_Quot_prop
statement:
theorem good_mk_of_Quot_prop (φ : G ⧸ H → H) :
    ∃ (j : G ⧸ H) (h : H), (m - n) • h = -(m • φ j) + n • Quot.out j
proof:
:=
  good_mk_of_repFn_prop h H φ Quot.out Quot.out_eq

name: good_m_zsmul_eq_sub_zsmul
statement: theorem good_m_zsmul_eq_sub_zsmul (a : H) : ∃ b : H, (m - n) • (b : G) = m • a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, b, h0⟩ := good_mk_of_Quot_prop h H
    λ j ↦ if (∃ h : H, (m - n) • h = n • Quot.out j) then a else 0
  split_ifs at h0 with h1
  
  · rcases h1 with ⟨c, h1⟩; refine ⟨c - b, ?_⟩
    rw [AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub, zsmul_sub, h1, h0, sub_add_cancel_right, neg_neg]
  
  · rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, smul_zero, neg_zero, zero_add] at h0
    exact absurd ⟨b, h0⟩ h1

name: good_imp
statement:
theorem good_imp [AddCommGroup G] (h : good G m n) (g : G) :
    (m - n).gcd (addOrderOf g) ∣ m.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ :=
    good_m_zsmul_eq_sub_zsmul h _ ⟨g, AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples g⟩
  exact gcd_addOrderOf_dvd_iff.mpr ⟨k, (mul_zsmul _ _ _).trans hk⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [AddCommGroup G] :
    good G m n ↔ ∀ g : G, (m - n).gcd (addOrderOf g) ∣ m.natAbs
proof:
:=
  ⟨good_imp, imp_good⟩

name: main_ineq
statement:
lemma main_ineq {a b c : R} (h : 1 ≤ a) (h0 : 1 < b)
    (h1 : 0 ≤ c) (h2 : b ^ 2 + a * c ≤ a + c) : b < a
proof:
:=
  lt_of_add_lt_add_right <| h2.trans_lt' <|
    add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (lt_self_pow₀ h0 (Nat.lt_succ_self 1))
      (le_mul_of_one_le_left h1 h)

name: main_ineq2
statement:
lemma main_ineq2 {a b c : R} (h : 0 ≤ a) (h0 : 1 < b)
    (h1 : 1 ≤ c) (h2 : b ^ 2 + a * c ≤ a + c) : b < c
proof:
:=
  lt_of_add_lt_add_left <| h2.trans_lt' <| (add_comm a b).trans_lt <|
    add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (lt_self_pow₀ h0 (Nat.lt_succ_self 1))
      (le_mul_of_one_le_right h h1)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {a : ℕ → R} (h : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (h0 : ∀ i, a (i + 1) ^ 2 + a i * a (i + 2) ≤ a i + a (i + 2))
    (N : ℕ) (h1 : 2 ≤ N) : a N ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have h2 (i : ℕ) (h1 : 1 < a (i + 1)) (h2 : 1 < a (i + 2)) : False :=
    (main_ineq h1.le h2 (h _) (h0 _)).asymm (main_ineq2 (h i) h1 h2.le (h0 _))
  
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' h1 with ⟨n, rfl⟩
  refine le_of_not_gt λ h1 ↦ (h0 (n + 1)).not_gt ?_
  rw [← sub_lt_iff_lt_add, add_sub_assoc, ← one_sub_mul]
  exact (one_lt_pow₀ h1 (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)).trans_le' <|
    add_le_of_le_sub_left <| mul_le_of_le_one_right
      (sub_nonneg_of_le <| le_of_not_gt λ h3 ↦ h2 _ h3 h1)
      (le_of_not_gt (h2 _ h1))

name: exists_ne_pow_eq
statement: theorem exists_ne_pow_eq (h : k ≠ 0) (b : ℤ) : ∃ m n, m ≠ n ∧ b ^ m % k = b ^ n % k
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ m ∈ range k.natAbs.succ, ∃ n ∈ range k.natAbs.succ,
      m ≠ n ∧ b ^ m % k = b ^ n % k by
    rcases this with ⟨m, -, n, -, h0⟩; exact ⟨m, n, h0⟩
  apply exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to (t := image Nat.cast (range k.natAbs))
  · apply card_image_le.trans_lt
    rw [card_range, card_range]
    exact k.natAbs.lt_succ_self
  · rintro n -; simp only [coe_image, coe_range, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Iio]
    have h0 := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg (b ^ n) h)
    refine ⟨(b ^ n % k).natAbs, ?_, h0⟩
    rw [← Int.ofNat_lt, h0, Int.natCast_natAbs]
    exact (Int.emod_lt _ h).trans_eq k.natCast_natAbs

name: linear_good
statement: theorem linear_good (k m : ℤ) : good (k + 1) (k * m) (k * · + m)
proof:
:= λ x y ↦ by
  rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, Int.mul_add, add_sub_cancel_left, Int.add_mul, Int.one_mul,
    add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← Int.mul_sub, add_sub_cancel_right, ← Int.mul_add]

name: map_map_zero_add
statement: theorem map_map_zero_add (y : ℤ) : f (y + f 0) = c + f y
proof:
:=
  by rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add, h, Int.mul_zero, sub_self, zero_add]

name: map_mul_map_zero_add
statement: theorem map_mul_map_zero_add (y k : ℤ) : f (y + f 0 * k) = c * k + f y
proof:
:= by
  have h0 n : f (y + f 0 * (n + 1)) = c + f (y + f 0 * n) := by
    rw [Int.mul_add, Int.mul_one, ← Int.add_assoc, map_map_zero_add h]
  replace h0 := Extra.LinearSolver.IntInt (f := λ n ↦ f (y + f 0 * n)) h0 k
  rwa [Int.mul_zero, Int.add_zero] at h0

name: map_b_pow_mul_eq_of_map_eq
statement:
theorem map_b_pow_mul_eq_of_map_eq (h0 : f x = f y) :
    ∀ k, f (b ^ k * x) = f (b ^ k * y)
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec (by rwa [pow_zero, one_mul, one_mul]) λ k h1 ↦ ?_
  have h2 := h (b ^ k * y) 0
  rwa [← h1, h, add_left_inj, sub_left_inj, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ'] at h2

name: map_is_linear
statement: theorem map_is_linear : ∀ n : ℤ, f n = (b - 1) * n + f 0
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices f.Injective from λ n ↦ by
    have h2 := eq_add_of_sub_eq' (h 0 (b * n))
    rw [Int.mul_zero, sub_self, zero_add, ← sub_left_inj (a := f n),
      add_sub_right_comm, ← h n n, sub_left_inj] at h2
    rw [Int.sub_mul, Int.one_mul, ← add_sub_right_comm, this h2, add_sub_cancel_left]
  
  have h2 : f 0 ≠ 0 := λ h2 ↦ by
    have h3 := map_map_zero_add h 0
    rw [zero_add, h2, h2, add_zero] at h3
    exact h1 h3.symm
  obtain ⟨m, n, h3, h4⟩ := exists_ne_pow_eq h2 b
  rw [Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero, ← Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero] at h4
  rcases h4 with ⟨N, h4⟩
  
  intro x y h5
  apply map_b_pow_mul_eq_of_map_eq h at h5
  have h6 := h5 m
  have h7 := map_mul_map_zero_add h
  rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq' h4, Int.add_mul, mul_assoc, h7, Int.add_mul,
    mul_assoc, h7, h5, add_left_inj, Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff h1] at h6
  refine (Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff λ h8 ↦ ?_).mp h6
  rw [h8, Int.mul_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h4
  exact h3 (Int.pow_right_injective h0 h4)

name: c_eq_b_sub_one_mul_map_zero
statement: theorem c_eq_b_sub_one_mul_map_zero : c = (b - 1) * f 0
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := h 0 0
  rwa [zero_add, Int.mul_zero, sub_self, zero_add,
    map_is_linear h h0 h1, add_sub_cancel_right, eq_comm] at h3

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {b c : ℤ} (h : 1 < b.natAbs) (h0 : c ≠ 0) :
    good b c f ↔ b - 1 ∣ c ∧ f = ((b - 1) * · + c / (b - 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hf ↦ ?_, λ hf ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · have h1 := c_eq_b_sub_one_mul_map_zero hf h h0
    refine ⟨⟨f 0, h1⟩, funext λ n ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [map_is_linear hf h h0, h1, add_right_inj]
    refine (Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ λ h2 ↦ h0 ?_).symm
    rw [h1, h2, Int.zero_mul]
  
  · rw [← sub_add_cancel b 1]
    rcases hf with ⟨⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine (Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left m λ h1 ↦ h0 ?_).symm ▸ linear_good (b - 1) m
    rw [h1, Int.zero_mul]

name: Multiset_mem_sum
statement:
theorem Multiset_mem_sum [DecidableEq α] {P : Multiset (Multiset α)} {a : α} :
    a ∈ P.sum ↔ ∃ M ∈ P, a ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_eq_sum_toEnumFinset, Multiset.mem_sum]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨M, n⟩, h, h0⟩
    exact ⟨M, count_pos.mp (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt ((mem_toEnumFinset _ _).mp h)), h0⟩
  · rintro ⟨M, h, h0⟩
    refine ⟨⟨M, 0⟩, ?_, h0⟩
    rwa [mem_toEnumFinset, count_pos]

name: sum_replicate_map_inv
statement:
theorem sum_replicate_map_inv (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ((replicate n n).map λ x : ℕ ↦ (x : ℚ)⁻¹).sum = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_replicate, sum_replicate, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn)]

name: sum_replicate_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_replicate_two_mul (n : ℕ) :
    ((replicate 2 (2 * n)).map λ x : ℕ ↦ (x : ℚ)⁻¹).sum = (n : ℚ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_replicate, sum_replicate, Nat.cast_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_inv,
    mul_inv_cancel_left₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1))]

name: sum_map_sum
statement:
theorem sum_map_sum [AddCommMonoid M] (P : Multiset (Multiset α)) (f : α → M) :
    (P.map λ i ↦ (i.map f).sum).sum = (P.sum.map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  revert P; refine Multiset.induction ?_ λ i P hP ↦ ?_
  · simp only [Multiset.map_zero, sum_zero]
  · rw [map_cons, sum_cons, hP, sum_cons, Multiset.map_add, sum_add]

name: sum_map_replicate_two
statement:
theorem sum_map_replicate_two (C : Multiset ℕ) :
    ∀ N, replicate (C.count 0) 0 + sum ((range N).map λ i ↦
      replicate (C.count (2 * i + 1)) (2 * i + 1)
        + replicate (count (2 * i.succ) C) (2 * i.succ)) = C.filter λ n ↦ n ≤ 2 * N
  | 0 => by
      rw [range_zero, Multiset.map_zero, sum_zero, add_zero, mul_zero]
      simp only [nonpos_iff_eq_zero]; exact (filter_eq' C 0).symm
  | N + 1 => by
      rw [range_succ, map_cons, sum_cons, add_left_comm, sum_map_replicate_two]
      ext x; rw [count_add, count_add, count_replicate,
        count_replicate, count_filter, count_filter, Nat.mul_succ]
      obtain h | h : x ≤ 2 * N ∨ 2 * N < x
proof:
:= le_or_gt x (2 * N)
      · have h0 : x < 2 * N + 2 := h.trans_lt (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right Nat.two_pos)
        rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left h0.le, add_eq_right, add_eq_zero]
        exact ⟨ite_eq_right (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h).ne.symm, ite_eq_right h0.ne.symm⟩
      rw [ite_eq_right h.not_ge, add_zero]
      rw [Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le, le_iff_eq_or_lt, Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le, le_iff_eq_or_lt] at h
      rcases h with rfl | rfl | h
      · rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right (2 * N + 1).succ_ne_self,
          add_zero, ite_eq_left (2 * N).succ.le_succ]
      · rw [ite_eq_right (2 * N + 1).succ_ne_self.symm, zero_add, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left (le_refl _)]
      · rw [ite_eq_right (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt h).ne, zero_add, ite_eq_right h.ne, ite_eq_right h.not_ge]

name: nonempty_add_replicate_self
statement:
theorem nonempty_add_replicate_self (h : Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N C)) (k) :
    Nonempty (CapeTownPartition (N + 1) (C + replicate k k))
proof:
:=
  h.elim λ P ↦ ⟨add_replicate_self P k⟩

name: nonempty_append_zeroes
statement:
theorem nonempty_append_zeroes (h : Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N C)) (k) :
    Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N (C + replicate k 0))
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨part', card_part', rfl, total_bound'⟩
  obtain ⟨G₀, part'', rfl⟩ : ∃ G part'', part' = G ::ₘ part'' := by
    obtain ⟨G, h0⟩ : ∃ G, G ∈ part' :=
      card_pos_iff_exists_mem.mp (N.succ_pos.trans_eq card_part'.symm)
    exact ⟨G, exists_cons_of_mem h0⟩
  refine ⟨(G₀ + replicate k 0) ::ₘ part'', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [card_cons, ← card_part', card_cons]
  · rw [sum_cons, sum_cons, add_right_comm]
  · refine forall_mem_cons.mpr ⟨?_, λ G hG ↦ total_bound' G (mem_cons_of_mem hG)⟩
    rw [Multiset.map_add, map_replicate, Nat.cast_zero,
      inv_zero, sum_add, sum_replicate, nsmul_zero, add_zero]
    exact total_bound' G₀ (mem_cons_self G₀ part'')

name: nonempty_cons_zero
statement:
theorem nonempty_cons_zero (h : Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N C)) :
    Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N (0 ::ₘ C))
proof:
:= by
  replace h := nonempty_append_zeroes h 1
  rwa [replicate_one, add_comm, singleton_add] at h

name: nonempty_merge
statement:
theorem nonempty_merge (h : Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N (n ::ₘ C)))
    {C' : Multiset ℕ} (h0 : (C'.map λ x : ℕ ↦ (x : ℚ)⁻¹).sum = (n : ℚ)⁻¹) :
    Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N (C + C'))
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨part', card_part', sum_part', total_bound'⟩
  obtain ⟨G₀, part'', rfl⟩ : ∃ G part'', part' = (n ::ₘ G) ::ₘ part'' := by
    obtain ⟨G, h, h0⟩ : ∃ G ∈ part', n ∈ G :=
      Multiset_mem_sum.mp (sum_part' ▸ mem_cons_self n C)
    obtain ⟨G', rfl⟩ : ∃ G', G = n ::ₘ G' := exists_cons_of_mem h0
    exact ⟨G', exists_cons_of_mem h⟩
  refine ⟨(G₀ + C') ::ₘ part'', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [card_cons, ← card_part', card_cons]
  · rw [sum_cons, cons_add, cons_inj_right] at sum_part'
    rw [sum_cons, ← sum_part', add_right_comm]
  · refine forall_mem_cons.mpr ⟨?_, λ G hG ↦ total_bound' G (mem_cons_of_mem hG)⟩
    apply (total_bound' (n ::ₘ G₀) (mem_cons_self _ _)).trans_eq'
    rw [Multiset.map_add, sum_add, h0, add_comm, map_cons, sum_cons]

name: nonempty_replicate_two_mul
statement:
theorem nonempty_replicate_two_mul (h : Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N (n ::ₘ C))) :
    Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N (C + replicate 2 (2 * n)))
proof:
:=
  nonempty_merge h (sum_replicate_two_mul n)

name: nonempty_of_restricted
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_restricted (hC : 0 ∉ C) (hC0 : ∀ n ≠ 0, C.count n < n)
    (hC1 : ∀ n, C.count (2 * n) ≤ 1) (hC2 : ∀ n ∈ C, n ≤ 2 * N.succ) :
    Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N C)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(range N.succ).map λ i ↦
    replicate (C.count (2 * i + 1)) (2 * i + 1)
      + replicate (C.count (2 * i.succ)) (2 * i.succ), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [card_map, card_range]
  · have h := sum_map_replicate_two C N.succ
    rwa [count_eq_zero_of_notMem hC, replicate_zero, zero_add, filter_eq_self.mpr hC2] at h
  · intro G h; simp only [mem_map, mem_range] at h
    rcases h with ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
    rw [Multiset.map_add, sum_add, map_replicate, map_replicate, sum_replicate, sum_replicate]
    have h0 : C.count (2 * i + 1) ≤ 2 * i := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (hC0 _ (2 * i).succ_ne_zero)
    have X (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (n : ℚ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr n.cast_nonneg
    apply (add_le_add (nsmul_le_nsmul_left (X _) h0) (nsmul_le_nsmul_left (X _) (hC1 _))).trans
    replace X : 0 < ((2 * i).succ : ℚ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (2 * i).succ_pos
    rw [one_nsmul, ← mul_inv_cancel₀ X.ne.symm,
      ← nsmul_eq_mul, succ_nsmul, add_le_add_iff_left]
    exact inv_anti₀ X (Nat.cast_le.mpr (2 * i).succ.le_succ)

name: nonempty_of_sum_le
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_sum_le {N : ℕ} (h : (map (λ x : ℕ ↦ (x : ℚ)⁻¹) C).sum ≤ N + 2⁻¹) :
    Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N C)
proof:
:= by
  
  generalize hK : card C = K
  induction K using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing C N with | h K K_ih => ?_
  subst hK
  
  by_cases hC : 0 ∈ C
  · obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ : ∃ C', C = 0 ::ₘ C' := exists_cons_of_mem hC
    refine nonempty_cons_zero (K_ih (card C) ?_ ?_ rfl)
    · rw [card_cons]; exact (card C).lt_succ_self
    · rwa [map_cons, Nat.cast_zero, inv_zero, sum_cons, zero_add] at h
  
  by_cases hC0 : ∃ n ≠ 0, n ≤ C.count n
  · rcases hC0 with ⟨n, h0, h1⟩
    rw [le_count_iff_replicate_le, Multiset.le_iff_exists_add] at h1
    rcases h1 with ⟨C, rfl⟩
    rw [Multiset.map_add, sum_add, sum_replicate_map_inv h0, add_comm] at h
    obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ : ∃ N' : ℕ, N = N'.succ := by
      apply Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero; rintro rfl
      refine h.not_gt (add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt ?_ (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ one_lt_two))
      refine sum_nonneg λ x h1 ↦ ?_
      rw [mem_map] at h1; rcases h1 with ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
      exact inv_nonneg.mpr y.cast_nonneg
    rw [add_comm]; refine nonempty_add_replicate_self (K_ih (card C) ?_ ?_ rfl) n
    · rw [card_add, card_replicate]
      exact Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero h0)
    · rwa [N.cast_succ, add_right_comm, add_le_add_iff_right] at h
  simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_le] at hC0
  
  by_cases hC1 : ∃ n, 1 < C.count (2 * n)
  · rcases hC1 with ⟨n, h0⟩
    rw [← Nat.succ_le_iff, le_count_iff_replicate_le, Multiset.le_iff_exists_add] at h0
    rcases h0 with ⟨C, rfl⟩
    rw [add_comm]; refine nonempty_replicate_two_mul (K_ih (card _) ?_ (h.trans_eq' ?_) rfl)
    · rw [card_cons, card_add, card_replicate, Nat.add_comm 2]
      exact (card C).succ.lt_succ_self
    · rw [map_cons, sum_cons, Multiset.map_add, sum_add, sum_replicate_two_mul, add_comm]
  simp only [not_exists, not_lt] at hC1
  
  by_cases hC2 : ∃ n ∈ C, 2 * N.succ < n
  · rcases hC2 with ⟨n, h0, h1⟩
    obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ : ∃ C', C = n ::ₘ C' := exists_cons_of_mem h0
    obtain ⟨part', card_part', rfl, total_bound'⟩ : Nonempty (CapeTownPartition N C) := by
      refine K_ih (card C) ?_ (h.trans' ?_) rfl
      · rw [card_cons]; exact (card C).lt_succ_self
      · rw [map_cons, sum_cons, le_add_iff_nonneg_left, inv_nonneg]
        exact n.cast_nonneg
    clear K_ih h0
    
    obtain ⟨G, hG, hG0⟩ :
        ∃ G ∈ part', (G.map λ x : ℕ ↦ (x : ℚ)⁻¹).sum ≤ 1 - ((2 * N.succ : ℕ) : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
      by_contra h0; simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_le] at h0
      have h2 : part' ≠ ∅ := by rw [empty_eq_zero, ← card_pos, card_part']; exact N.succ_pos
      apply (sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty h2 h0).not_ge
      replace h2 : (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ + 2⁻¹ = 1 := by rw [inv_eq_one_div, add_halves]
      rw [map_const', sum_replicate, card_part', nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one_sub, Nat.cast_mul,
        mul_inv_rev, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr N.succ_ne_zero),
        N.cast_succ, ← h2, add_sub_assoc, Nat.cast_two, add_sub_cancel_right, sum_map_sum]
      apply h.trans'
      rw [map_cons, sum_cons]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (inv_nonneg.mpr n.cast_nonneg)
    obtain ⟨part'', rfl⟩ : ∃ part'', part' = G ::ₘ part'' := exists_cons_of_mem hG
    
    refine ⟨(n ::ₘ G) ::ₘ part'', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [card_cons, ← card_part', card_cons]
    · rw [sum_cons, cons_add, sum_cons]
    · refine forall_mem_cons.mpr ⟨?_, λ G' hG' ↦ total_bound' G' (mem_cons_of_mem hG')⟩
      rw [map_cons, sum_cons, ← le_sub_iff_add_le']
      refine hG0.trans (sub_le_sub_left (inv_anti₀ ?_ (Nat.cast_le.mpr h1.le)) _)
      rw [Nat.cast_pos, Nat.mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left Nat.two_pos]; exact N.succ_pos
  simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_lt] at hC2
  
  exact nonempty_of_restricted hC hC0 hC1 hC2

name: good_swap
statement: lemma good_swap (h : good x y) : good y x
proof:
:= by
  rw [good, sub_add_comm, mul_right_comm, h, abs_sub_comm]

name: good_iff
statement:
lemma good_iff (x y : ℤ) :
    good x y ↔ (x + y) ^ 2 = (|x - y| - 2) ^ 2 * (4 * |x - y| + 1)
proof:
:= by calc
  _ ↔ 7 * x ^ 2 - 13 * x * y + 7 * y ^ 2 = (|x - y| + 1) ^ 3 := Iff.rfl
  _ ↔ 4 * (7 * x ^ 2 - 13 * x * y + 7 * y ^ 2) - 27 * (x - y) ^ 2
      = 4 * (|x - y| + 1) ^ 3 - 27 * |x - y| ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq_abs, sub_left_inj, mul_left_cancel_iff_of_pos four_pos]
  _ ↔ _ := by apply Eq.congr <;> ring

name: square_lemma
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Iff.symm ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨m, h, rfl⟩
    rw [← sq_abs, h, sq_abs]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨k, h0⟩ : ∃ k, k ^ 2 = 4 * d + 1 := by
    obtain rfl | h0 : d = 2 ∨ d - 2 ≠ 0 :=
      (eq_or_ne (d - 2) 0).imp_left (Int.eq_of_sub_eq_zero)
    · exact ⟨3, rfl⟩
    
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : d - 2 ∣ a := (Int.pow_dvd_pow_iff (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)).mp ⟨_, h⟩
    rw [mul_pow, Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff (pow_ne_zero 2 h0)] at h
    exact ⟨k, h⟩
  
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, 2 * m + 1 = k := by
    refine ⟨k / 2, Int.two_mul_ediv_two_add_one_of_odd ?_⟩
    rw [← Int.odd_pow' (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), h0, Int.odd_iff]
    show (2 * 2 * d + 1) % 2 = 1
    rw [Int.mul_assoc, Int.add_comm, Int.add_mul_emod_self_left, Int.one_emod_two]
  
  rw [← h0, ← mul_pow, sq_eq_sq_iff_abs_eq_abs] at h
  obtain rfl : d = m ^ 2 + m := by
    rw [add_sq, mul_one, one_pow, add_left_inj, mul_pow,
      ← mul_assoc, sq, ← Int.mul_add, eq_comm] at h0
    exact (Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff four_ne_zero).mp h0
  exact ⟨m, h, rfl⟩

name: add_eq_sub_eq_iff
statement:
lemma add_eq_sub_eq_iff {a b x y : ℤ} :
    (x + y = 2 * a ∧ x - y = 2 * b) ↔ a + b = x ∧ a - b = y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · have X {x y : ℤ} : 2 * x = 2 * y ↔ x = y :=
      Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← X, Int.mul_add, ← h.1, ← h.2, add_add_sub_cancel, Int.two_mul]
    · rw [← X, Int.mul_sub, ← h.1, ← h.2, add_sub_sub_cancel, Int.two_mul]
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [add_add_sub_cancel, add_sub_sub_cancel]
    exact ⟨a.two_mul.symm, b.two_mul.symm⟩

name: good_iff_of_y_le_x
statement:
lemma good_iff_of_y_le_x (h : y ≤ x) :
    good x y ↔ ∃ m, x = m ^ 3 + 2 * m ^ 2 - m - 1 ∧ y = m ^ 3 + m ^ 2 - 2 * m - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [good_iff, square_lemma, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg_of_le h)]
  simp only [abs_eq_abs, or_and_right, ← add_eq_sub_eq_iff (a := x)]
  have X {x y : ℤ} : 2 * x = 2 * y ↔ x = y :=
    Int.mul_eq_mul_left_iff (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩; rintro ⟨m, ⟨h0, h1⟩ | ⟨h0, h1⟩⟩
  
  · refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← X, ← h0]; ring
    · rw [← X, ← h1]; ring
  
  · refine ⟨-(m + 1), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← X, ← h0]; ring
    · rw [← X, ← h1]; ring
  
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨m, Or.inl ⟨by ring, by ring⟩⟩

name: special_pair_is_good
statement:
lemma special_pair_is_good (m) :
    good (m ^ 3 + 2 * m ^ 2 - m - 1) (m ^ 3 + m ^ 2 - 2 * m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  suffices m ^ 3 + m ^ 2 - 2 * m - 1 ≤ m ^ 3 + 2 * m ^ 2 - m - 1
    from (good_iff_of_y_le_x this).mpr ⟨m, rfl, rfl⟩
  suffices 0 ≤ m ^ 2 + m by calc
    _ ≤ (m ^ 3 + m ^ 2 - 2 * m - 1) + (m ^ 2 + m) := Int.le_add_of_nonneg_right this
    _ = m ^ 3 + 2 * m ^ 2 - m - 1 := by ring
  rw [sq, ← mul_add_one]
  obtain h | h : 0 ≤ m ∨ m < 0 := le_or_gt 0 m
  · exact Int.mul_nonneg h (Int.add_nonneg h Int.one_nonneg)
  · exact Int.mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos h.le h

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    good x y ↔ (∃ m, (x, y) = (m ^ 3 + 2 * m ^ 2 - m - 1, m ^ 3 + m ^ 2 - 2 * m - 1)) ∨
      (∃ m, (x, y) = (m ^ 3 + m ^ 2 - 2 * m - 1, m ^ 3 + 2 * m ^ 2 - m - 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]; refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine (le_total y x).imp (λ h0 ↦ (good_iff_of_y_le_x h0).mp h) (λ h0 ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨m, rfl, rfl⟩ := (good_iff_of_y_le_x h0).mp (good_swap h)
    exact ⟨m, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨m, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨m, rfl, rfl⟩
    exacts [special_pair_is_good m, good_swap (special_pair_is_good m)]

name: weight_cons
statement: theorem weight_cons (w v S) : weight w (v ::ₘ S) = w.1 ^ v.1 * w.2 ^ v.2 + weight w S
proof:
:= by
  unfold weight; rw [map_cons, sum_cons]

name: weight_add
statement: theorem weight_add (w S T) : weight w (S + T) = weight w S + weight w T
proof:
:= by
  unfold weight; rw [Multiset.map_add, sum_add]

name: weight_sum
statement:
theorem weight_sum (w) (P : Multiset (Multiset (ℕ × ℕ))) :
    weight w P.sum = (P.map (weight w)).sum
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on P rfl λ p P h ↦ by rw [sum_cons, weight_add, h, map_cons, sum_cons]

name: weight_translate
statement:
theorem weight_translate (w s S) :
    weight w (S.map λ p ↦ s + p) = w.1 ^ s.1 * w.2 ^ s.2 * weight w S
proof:
:= by
  refine Multiset.induction_on S rfl λ p S h ↦ ?_
  rw [map_cons, weight_cons, weight_cons, Nat.mul_add, ← h,
    Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add]; rfl

name: weight_T4Filter_BaseSkewT4_mod32
statement:
theorem weight_T4Filter_BaseSkewT4_mod32 :
    ∀ i j, weight (T4Filter i) (BaseSkewT4 j) % 32 = 16 * if i = j then 1 else 0
  | 1, 1 => rfl
  | 1, 2 => rfl
  | 1, 3 => rfl
  | 1, 4 => rfl
  | 2, 1 => rfl
  | 2, 2 => rfl
  | 2, 3 => rfl
  | 2, 4 => rfl
  | 3, 1 => rfl
  | 3, 2 => rfl
  | 3, 3 => rfl
  | 3, 4 => rfl
  | 4, 1 => rfl
  | 4, 2 => rfl
  | 4, 3 => rfl
  | 4, 4 => rfl

name: T4Filter_fst_mod2
statement:
theorem T4Filter_fst_mod2 : ∀ i, (T4Filter i).1 % 2 = 1
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl
  | 3 => rfl
  | 4 => rfl

name: T4Filter_snd_mod2
statement:
theorem T4Filter_snd_mod2 : ∀ i, (T4Filter i).2 % 2 = 1
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl

  | 4 => rfl

name: weight_T4Filter_SkewT4_mod32
statement:
theorem weight_T4Filter_SkewT4_mod32 (i q) :
    weight (T4Filter i) (SkewT4 q) % 32 = 16 * if i = q.1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [SkewT4, weight_translate, ← Nat.mul_mod_mod, weight_T4Filter_BaseSkewT4_mod32]
  split_ifs
  · rw [Nat.mul_one, Nat.mul_mod_mul_right 16 _ 2, ← Nat.mod_mul_mod,
      Nat.pow_mod, T4Filter_fst_mod2, Nat.one_pow, ← Nat.mul_mod_mod,
      Nat.pow_mod, T4Filter_snd_mod2, Nat.one_pow]
  · rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_mod]

name: weight_T4Filter_sum_SkewT4_mod32
statement:
theorem weight_T4Filter_sum_SkewT4_mod32 (i : Fin 4) (P : Multiset (Fin 4 × ℕ × ℕ)) :
    weight (T4Filter i) (P.map SkewT4).sum % 32 = 16 * ((P.map Prod.fst).count i % 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weight_sum, map_map, sum_nat_mod, map_map]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, weight_T4Filter_SkewT4_mod32]
  refine Multiset.induction_on P rfl λ p P h ↦ ?_
  rw [map_cons, sum_cons, ← Nat.add_mod_mod, h, ← Nat.mul_add, add_comm,
    Nat.mul_mod_mul_left 16 _ 2, Nat.mod_add_mod, map_cons, count_cons]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (h : (map SkewT4 P).sum = (map SkewT4 Q).sum) (i : Fin 4) :
    (P.map Prod.fst).count i % 2 = (Q.map Prod.fst).count i % 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.mul_right_inj (Nat.succ_ne_zero 15), ← weight_T4Filter_sum_SkewT4_mod32,
    ← weight_T4Filter_sum_SkewT4_mod32, h]

name: good_const
statement: theorem good_const (C : ℤ) : good (λ _ ↦ C)

name: good_floor
statement: theorem good_floor : good Int.floor
proof:
:= λ x a b hb ↦ by
  refine Int.floor_congr λ n ↦ ?_
  replace hb : 0 < (b : ℚ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hb
  rw [← Int.cast_add, ← Int.floor_add_intCast, le_div_iff₀ hb, le_div_iff₀ hb,
    ← Int.cast_natCast, ← Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_le, Int.le_floor]

name: good_neg_map_neg
statement: theorem good_neg_map_neg (hf : good f) : good (λ x ↦ -f (-x))
proof:
:= λ x a b hb ↦ by
  rw [Int.cast_neg, neg_inj, ← neg_div, neg_add, neg_neg,
    ← a.cast_neg, hf _ _ b hb, Int.cast_neg, ← neg_add, neg_div]

name: good_ceil
statement: theorem good_ceil : good Int.ceil
proof:
:=
  good_neg_map_neg good_floor

name: const_of_not_int_id
statement: lemma const_of_not_int_id {n : ℤ} (h : f n ≠ n) : ∃ C, f = λ _ ↦ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_ne_zero] at h
  have h0 (k : ℤ) : f (k + ↑(f n - n) / |f n - n|) = f k := by
    specialize hf n (k * |f n - n| - n) _ (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr h)
    rw [← abs_ne_zero, ← Int.cast_ne_zero (α := ℚ)] at h
    rwa [Int.cast_sub, add_sub_cancel, Int.cast_mul, add_sub_left_comm,
      Nat.cast_natAbs, add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ h, ← Int.cast_sub] at hf
  replace h0 (k : ℤ) : f (k + 1) = f k := by
    generalize f n - n = t at h h0
    have h1 : (t : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr h
    obtain h2 | h2 := le_total 0 t
    · specialize h0 k; rwa [abs_eq_self.mpr h2, div_self h1] at h0
    · specialize h0 (k + 1)
      rwa [abs_eq_neg_self.mpr h2, Int.cast_neg, div_neg, div_self h1,
        Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, add_neg_cancel_right, eq_comm] at h0
  replace h0 (k : ℤ) : f k = f 0 := by
    refine Int.inductionOn' k 0 rfl (λ k _ h ↦ ?_) (λ k _ h ↦ ?_)
    · rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, h0, h]
    · rw [← h0, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one, sub_add_cancel, h]
  
  refine ⟨f 0, funext λ x ↦ ?_⟩
  specialize hf x 0 1 Nat.one_pos
  rwa [Nat.cast_one, div_one, div_one, Int.cast_zero, add_zero, h0, add_zero, eq_comm] at hf

name: int_id_map_add_int
statement: lemma int_id_map_add_int (x : ℚ) (a : ℤ) : f (x + a) = f x + a
proof:
:= by
  specialize hf x a 1 Nat.one_pos
  rwa [Nat.cast_one, div_one, div_one, ← Int.cast_add, h, eq_comm] at hf

name: eq_floor_of_map_half_nonpos
statement: lemma eq_floor_of_map_half_nonpos (h0 : f 2⁻¹ ≤ 0) : f = Int.floor
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x : ℚ, 0 ≤ x → x < 1 → f x = 0 from funext λ x ↦ by
    rw [← add_neg_eq_zero, ← int_id_map_add_int hf h, Int.cast_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact this _ (Int.fract_nonneg x) (Int.fract_lt_one x)
  suffices ∀ m k : ℕ, k < m → f (k / m) = 0 from λ x h1 h2 ↦ by
    replace h1 : |x.num| = x.num := abs_eq_self.mpr (Rat.num_nonneg.mpr h1)
    replace h2 : x.num.natAbs < x.den := by
      rw [← Int.ofNat_lt, Int.natCast_natAbs, h1]
      rw [← x.num_div_den, div_lt_one (Nat.cast_pos.mpr x.den_pos)] at h2
      exact Int.cast_lt.mp h2
    specialize this x.den x.num.natAbs h2
    rwa [Nat.cast_natAbs, h1, Rat.num_div_den] at this
  replace h0 : f 2⁻¹ = 0 := by
    replace h0 : 0 < 1 - 2 * f 2⁻¹ := by
      rw [sub_pos, ← Int.zero_add 1, Int.lt_add_one_iff]
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos zero_le_two h0
    specialize hf 2⁻¹ (-f 2⁻¹) (1 - 2 * f 2⁻¹).natAbs (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr h0.ne.symm)
    rw [Int.cast_neg, add_neg_cancel, zero_div, Nat.cast_natAbs, abs_eq_self.mpr h0.le,
      inv_eq_one_div, ← sub_eq_add_neg, div_sub' two_ne_zero, one_div] at hf
    have h1 : (1 - 2 * f 2⁻¹ : ℚ) = (1 - 2 * f 2⁻¹ : ℤ) := by
      rw [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_two]
    rwa [h1, div_right_comm, div_self (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr h0.ne.symm),
      one_div, ← Int.cast_zero, h, eq_comm] at hf
  
  refine Nat.rec (λ k h1 ↦ h1.not_ge.elim k.zero_le) (λ m hm ↦ ?_)
  replace hm (k) (h1 : k < m) : f (k / m.succ) = 0 := by
    specialize hf (k / m) k m.succ m.succ_pos
    have h2 : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt h1)
    have h3 : (m.succ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr m.succ_ne_zero
    rwa [Int.cast_natCast, div_add' _ _ _ h2, add_comm (k : ℚ),
      ← Nat.cast_mul, div_div, ← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.mul_succ, Nat.cast_mul,
      mul_div_mul_right _ _ h3, hm k h1, Int.cast_zero, zero_add] at hf
  simp only [Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq]; rintro k (h2 | rfl)
  · exact hm k h2
  
  rcases k with _ | k
  · rw [Nat.cast_one, div_one, Nat.cast_zero, ← Int.cast_zero, h]
  specialize hf (k / k.succ.succ) 1 2 Nat.two_pos
  rwa [hm k k.lt_succ_self, Int.cast_zero, zero_add, Int.cast_one, Nat.cast_two,
    one_div, h0, div_add_one (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (k + 1).succ_ne_zero),
    Nat.cast_succ, div_div, add_left_comm, ← Nat.cast_succ, ← mul_two,
    mul_div_mul_right _ _ two_ne_zero, eq_comm, ← Nat.cast_succ] at hf

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : good f ↔ (∃ C, f = λ _ ↦ C) ∨ f = Int.floor ∨ f = Int.ceil
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · refine (em' (∀ n : ℤ, f n = n)).imp
      (λ h0 ↦ (not_forall.mp h0).elim λ n ↦ const_of_not_int_id h)
      (λ h0 ↦ (le_or_gt (f 2⁻¹) 0).imp (eq_floor_of_map_half_nonpos h h0) (λ h1 ↦ ?_))
    
    replace h : (λ x ↦ -f (-x)) = Int.floor := by
      refine eq_floor_of_map_half_nonpos (good_neg_map_neg h) (λ n ↦ ?_) ?_
      · rw [neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, ← Int.cast_neg, h0]
      · have h2 := int_id_map_add_int h h0 (-2⁻¹) 1
        rw [Int.cast_one, ← add_halves 1, one_div, neg_add_cancel_left] at h2
        rwa [neg_nonpos, ← Int.lt_add_one_iff, ← h2]
    funext x; rw [← neg_neg x, ← neg_inj, congrFun h,
      eq_comm, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, neg_neg]; rfl
  
  · rcases h with ⟨C, rfl⟩ | rfl | rfl
    exacts [good_const C, good_floor, good_ceil]

name: injective
statement: theorem injective : f.Injective
proof: := h.injective'

name: rangeCompl_spec
statement: theorem rangeCompl_spec : (h.rangeCompl : Set α) = (Set.range f)ᶜ
proof:
:=
  h.rangeCompl_spec'

name: mem_rangeCompl_iff
statement: theorem mem_rangeCompl_iff : a ∈ h.rangeCompl ↔ a ∉ Set.range f
proof:
:=
  Set.ext_iff.mp h.rangeCompl_spec a

name: surjective_iff
statement: theorem surjective_iff : f.Surjective ↔ h.rangeCompl = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.range_eq_univ, ← compl_inj_iff,
    ← h.rangeCompl_spec, Set.compl_univ, coe_eq_empty]

name: iter_apply_ne_of_mem_rangeCompl_iter_ne
statement:
theorem iter_apply_ne_of_mem_rangeCompl_iter_ne (h0 : m ≠ n)
    (h1 : a ∈ h.rangeCompl) (h2 : b ∈ h.rangeCompl) : f^[m] a ≠ f^[n] b
proof:
:= by
  wlog h3 : m < n
  · exact (this h h0.symm h2 h1 <| (le_of_not_gt h3).lt_of_ne h0.symm).symm
  
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h3.le with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  rw [Nat.lt_add_right_iff_pos] at h3
  rw [f.iterate_add_apply m k b, (h.injective.iterate m).ne_iff]
  rintro rfl; rw [mem_rangeCompl_iff, Set.mem_range] at h1
  refine h1 ⟨f^[k.pred] b, ?_⟩
  rw [← f.iterate_succ_apply', Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos h3]

name: iter_injective
statement:
theorem iter_injective (h0 : a ∈ h.rangeCompl) (h1 : b ∈ h.rangeCompl)
    (h2 : f^[m] a = f^[n] b) : m = n ∧ a = b
proof:
:=
  (eq_or_ne m n).elim
    (λ h3 ↦ ⟨h3, h.injective.iterate n <| by rw [← h2, h3]⟩)
    (λ h3 ↦ absurd h2 (h.iter_apply_ne_of_mem_rangeCompl_iter_ne h3 h0 h1))

name: iter_eq_iff
statement:
theorem iter_eq_iff (h0 : a ∈ h.rangeCompl) (h1 : b ∈ h.rangeCompl) :
    f^[m] a = f^[n] b ↔ m = n ∧ a = b
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.iter_injective h0 h1, λ h2 ↦ congr_arg₂ _ h2.1 h2.2⟩

name: exactIterRange_def
statement: theorem exactIterRange_def (n : ℕ) : h.exactIterRange n = h.rangeCompl.image f^[n]
proof: := rfl

name: mem_exactIterRange_iff
statement: theorem mem_exactIterRange_iff : a ∈ h.exactIterRange n ↔ ∃ b ∈ h.rangeCompl, f^[n] b = a
proof:
:=
  mem_image

name: exactIterRange_spec
statement:
theorem exactIterRange_spec (n : ℕ) :
    (h.exactIterRange n : Set α) = Set.range f^[n] \ Set.range f^[n + 1]
proof:
:=
  Set.ext λ a ↦ by
    rw [exactIterRange, coe_image, h.rangeCompl_spec, iterate_succ,
      Set.range_comp _ f, Set.range_sdiff_image (h.injective.iterate n)]

name: exactIterRange_zero
statement: theorem exactIterRange_zero : h.exactIterRange 0 = h.rangeCompl
proof:
:=
  image_id

name: exactIterRange_disjoint_of_ne
statement:
theorem exactIterRange_disjoint_of_ne (h0 : m ≠ n) :
    Disjoint (h.exactIterRange m) (h.exactIterRange n)
proof:
:=
  disjoint_iff_ne.mpr λ a h1 b h2 ↦ by
    rw [h.mem_exactIterRange_iff] at h1 h2
    rcases h1 with ⟨a, h1, rfl⟩
    rcases h2 with ⟨b, h2, rfl⟩
    exact h.iter_apply_ne_of_mem_rangeCompl_iter_ne h0 h1 h2

name: exactIterRange_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem exactIterRange_pairwiseDisjoint (S : Set ℕ) :
    S.PairwiseDisjoint h.exactIterRange
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ _ _ ↦ h.exactIterRange_disjoint_of_ne

name: exactIterRange_card
statement:
theorem exactIterRange_card (n : ℕ) :
    (h.exactIterRange n).card = h.rangeCompl.card
proof:
:=
  h.rangeCompl.card_image_of_injective (h.injective.iterate n)

name: iterRangeCompl_eq
statement:
theorem iterRangeCompl_eq (n : ℕ) :
    h.iterRangeCompl n = (range n).disjiUnion _ (h.exactIterRange_pairwiseDisjoint _)
proof:
:=
  ((range n).disjiUnion_eq_biUnion _ _).symm

name: iterRangeCompl_zero
statement: theorem iterRangeCompl_zero : h.iterRangeCompl 0 = ∅
proof: := rfl

name: iterRangeCompl_succ
statement:
theorem iterRangeCompl_succ (n : ℕ) :
    h.iterRangeCompl n.succ = h.exactIterRange n ∪ h.iterRangeCompl n
proof:
:=
  (congr_arg₂ _ range_add_one rfl).trans biUnion_insert

name: iterRangeCompl_spec
statement:
theorem iterRangeCompl_spec :
    ∀ n, (h.iterRangeCompl n : Set α) = (Set.range f^[n])ᶜ
  | 0 => by rw [iterRangeCompl_zero, coe_empty,
              iterate_zero, Set.range_id, Set.compl_univ]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [h.iterRangeCompl_succ, coe_union, iterRangeCompl_spec n,
        h.exactIterRange_spec, Set.sdiff_eq, Set.inter_union_distrib_right,
        Set.union_compl_self, Set.univ_inter, ← Set.compl_inter]
      exact congrArg _ (Set.inter_eq_left.mpr λ x ⟨y, h1⟩ ↦ ⟨f y, h1⟩)

name: iterRangeCompl_one
statement: theorem iterRangeCompl_one : h.iterRangeCompl 1 = h.rangeCompl
proof:
:=
  (h.iterRangeCompl_succ 0).trans <| (union_empty _).trans h.exactIterRange_zero

name: mem_iterRangeCompl_iff
statement: theorem mem_iterRangeCompl_iff : a ∈ h.iterRangeCompl n ↔ a ∉ Set.range f^[n]
proof:
:=
  Set.ext_iff.mp (h.iterRangeCompl_spec n) a

name: iterRangeCompl_subset_succ
statement: theorem iterRangeCompl_subset_succ (n : ℕ) : h.iterRangeCompl n ⊆ h.iterRangeCompl (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  h.iterRangeCompl_succ n ▸ subset_union_right

name: iterRangeCompl_subset_of_le
statement: theorem iterRangeCompl_subset_of_le (h0 : m ≤ n) : h.iterRangeCompl m ⊆ h.iterRangeCompl n
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_induction Subset.rfl (λ n _ h0 ↦ h0.trans (h.iterRangeCompl_subset_succ n)) n h0

name: iterRangeCompl_disjoint_exactIterRange
statement:
theorem iterRangeCompl_disjoint_exactIterRange (h0 : m ≤ n) :
    Disjoint (h.exactIterRange n) (h.iterRangeCompl m)
proof:
:=
  (disjoint_biUnion_right _ _ _).mpr
    λ _ h1 ↦ h.exactIterRange_disjoint_of_ne ((mem_range.mp h1).trans_le h0).ne.symm

name: iterRangeCompl_card
statement:
theorem iterRangeCompl_card : ∀ n, (h.iterRangeCompl n).card = n * h.rangeCompl.card
  | 0 => card_empty.trans h.rangeCompl.card.zero_mul.symm
  | n + 1 => by
      have h0
proof:
:= card_union_of_disjoint (h.iterRangeCompl_disjoint_exactIterRange n.le_refl)
      rw [h.iterRangeCompl_succ, h0, h.exactIterRange_card,
        iterRangeCompl_card n, Nat.succ_mul, add_comm]

name: add_four_induction
statement:
theorem add_four_induction {P : ℕ → Prop}
    (h : P 0) (h0 : P 1) (h1 : P 2) (h2 : P 3)
    (h3 : ∀ n, P n → P (n + 4)) : ∀ n, P n
  | 0 => h
  | 1 => h0
  | 2 => h1
  | 3 => h2
  | n + 4 => h3 n (add_four_induction h h0 h1 h2 h3 n)

def good (f : ℕ → ℕ)

name: good_succ
statement: theorem good_succ : good Nat.succ
proof: := λ _ ↦ rfl

name: good_answer2
statement:
theorem good_answer2 : good answer2
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => rfl
  | 3 => rfl
  | n + 4 => congr_arg (· + 4) (good_answer2 n)



section Solution

variable (h : good f)
include h

name: iter_four_eq
statement: theorem iter_four_eq : ∀ n, f^[4] n = f^[4] 0 + n
proof:
:=
  have h0 n : f^[4] (n + 1) = f^[4] n + 1 := by
    rw [f.iterate_succ_apply, h, ← h n, ← f.iterate_succ_apply']
  Nat.rec rfl λ n h1 ↦ by rw [Nat.add_succ, h0, h1]

name: good_injective
statement: theorem good_injective : f.Injective
proof:
:=
  suffices f^[4].Injective from this.of_comp
  λ m n h0 ↦ by rwa [iter_four_eq h, iter_four_eq h n, add_right_inj] at h0

name: iterRangeCompl_three_subset
statement:
theorem iterRangeCompl_three_subset :
    (finChainFnOfgood h).iterRangeCompl 3 ⊆
      {0, (f 0).succ} ∪ image Nat.succ (finChainFnOfgood h).rangeCompl
proof:
:= by
  intro x h0
  rw [mem_union, mem_image, mem_insert, mem_singleton, or_assoc]
  refine x.eq_zero_or_eq_succ_pred.imp id λ h1 ↦ ?_
  generalize x.pred = c at h1; subst h1
  refine (em <| c ∈ Set.range f).imp (λ h1 ↦ ?_) (λ h1 ↦ ⟨c, ?_, rfl⟩)
  · rcases h1 with ⟨d, rfl⟩
    refine d.eq_zero_or_eq_succ_pred.elim (λ h2 ↦ h2 ▸ rfl) (λ h2 ↦ ?_)
    rw [(finChainFnOfgood h).mem_iterRangeCompl_iff] at h0
    refine absurd ⟨d.pred, ?_⟩ h0
    rw [h, ← d.pred.succ_eq_add_one, ← h2]
  · rwa [(finChainFnOfgood h).mem_rangeCompl_iff]

name: exists_rangeCompl_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem exists_rangeCompl_eq_singleton :
    ∃ a, (finChainFnOfgood h).rangeCompl = {a}
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := (card_le_card <| iterRangeCompl_three_subset h).trans <|
    (card_union_le _ _).trans <| Nat.add_le_add
      (card_pair (f 0).succ_ne_zero.symm).le card_image_le
  rw [(finChainFnOfgood h).iterRangeCompl_card, Nat.succ_mul,
    Nat.add_le_add_iff_right, mul_comm, ← Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Nat.succ_pos 1)] at h0
  refine h0.eq_or_lt.elim card_eq_one.mp (λ h0 ↦ ?_)
  rw [Nat.lt_one_iff, card_eq_zero, ← (finChainFnOfgood h).surjective_iff] at h0
  obtain ⟨a, h0⟩ := h0.iterate 3 0
  exact absurd ((h a).symm.trans h0) (f a.succ).succ_ne_zero

name: iter_four_zero_eq_four
statement: theorem iter_four_zero_eq_four : f^[4] 0 = 4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, h0⟩ := exists_rangeCompl_eq_singleton h
  suffices (finChainFnOfgood h).iterRangeCompl 4 = range (f^[4] 0) by
    rw [← card_range (f^[4] 0), ← this,
      (finChainFnOfgood h).iterRangeCompl_card, h0, card_singleton]
  
  ext n; rw [(finChainFnOfgood h).mem_iterRangeCompl_iff, mem_range, not_iff_comm, not_lt]
  refine ⟨λ h1 ↦ ⟨n - f^[4] 0, ?_⟩, λ ⟨k, h1⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [iter_four_eq h, Nat.add_sub_of_le h1]
  · rw [← h1, iter_four_eq h k]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ k

name: iter_four_eq_add_four
statement: theorem iter_four_eq_add_four (n : ℕ) : f^[4] n = n + 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [iter_four_eq h, add_comm, iter_four_zero_eq_four h]

name: map_add_four
statement: theorem map_add_four (n : ℕ) : f (n + 4) = f n + 4
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := iter_four_eq_add_four h
  rw [← h1, ← h1]; rfl

name: good_imp_succ_or_answer2
statement: theorem good_imp_succ_or_answer2 : f = Nat.succ ∨ f = answer2
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases exists_rangeCompl_eq_singleton h with ⟨a, h0⟩
  have h1 := iterRangeCompl_three_subset h
  let C := finChainFnOfgood h
  rw [C.iterRangeCompl_succ, C.iterRangeCompl_succ, C.iterRangeCompl_one] at h1
  unfold FinChainFn.exactIterRange at h1
  rw [h0, image_singleton, image_singleton, image_singleton, union_subset_iff,
    union_subset_iff, f.iterate_succ_apply, f.iterate_one] at h1
  iterate 3 rw [singleton_subset_iff, mem_union,
    mem_singleton, mem_insert, mem_singleton] at h1
  
  have h2 (n) : f (f n) ≠ n := λ h2 ↦ by
    apply absurd (iter_four_eq_add_four h n)
    change f (f (f (f n))) ≠ n + 4
    rw [h2, h2, left_ne_add]
    exact Nat.succ_ne_zero 3
  have h3 (n) : f n ≠ n := λ h3 ↦ h2 n (Function.iterate_fixed h3 2)
  rcases h1 with ⟨h1, h4, (rfl | rfl) | h5⟩
  
  · rw [or_iff_right (h3 0), or_iff_right (f 0).succ_ne_self.symm] at h4
    rw [or_iff_right (h2 0), h4, or_iff_left (h3 1)] at h1
    have h5 : f (f (f 0)) = f 1 + 1 := h 0
    have h6 : f (f (f (f 0))) = 4 := iter_four_zero_eq_four h
    rw [h5, h1] at h6
    rw [h4, h1] at h5
    left; refine funext (add_four_induction h4 h1 h5 h6 ?_)
    intro n h7; rw [map_add_four h, h7]
  
  · rw [or_iff_left (h3 _)] at h4
    rw [or_iff_left (h2 _)] at h1
    rcases h4 with h4 | h4
    
    · rw [h4, or_iff_right (h3 0)] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr (f 0).le_succ).ne
    
    rw [h4, or_iff_left (h3 _)] at h1
    have h5 : f (f (f (f 0 + 1))) = f (f 0 + 2) + 1 := h (f 0).succ
    have h6 : f (f (f (f (f 0 + 1)))) = f 0 + 5 := iter_four_eq_add_four h _
    rw [h5, h1, zero_add] at h6
    rw [h4, h1, zero_add] at h5
    rw [h5] at h1 h4 h6
    right; refine funext (add_four_induction h5 h6 h4 h1 ?_)
    intro n h7; rw [map_add_four h, h7, answer2]
  
  · exact absurd h5 a.lt_succ_self.ne

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : good f ↔ f = Nat.succ ∨ f = answer2
proof:
:=
  ⟨good_imp_succ_or_answer2,
  λ h ↦ h.elim (λ h ↦ h.symm ▸ good_succ) (λ h ↦ h.symm ▸ good_answer2)⟩

name: matrix_fin2_mulVec
statement:
theorem matrix_fin2_mulVec (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) (v : Fin 2 → R) (b : Fin 2) :
    M.mulVec v b = M b 0 * v 0 + M b 1 * v 1
proof:
:=
  vec2_dotProduct (M b) v

name: matrix_fin2_vecMul
statement:
theorem matrix_fin2_vecMul (v : Fin 2 → R) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) (b : Fin 2) :
    vecMul v M b = v 0 * M 0 b + v 1 * M 1 b
proof:
:=
  vec2_dotProduct v _

name: f_aux_nil
statement: theorem f_aux_nil : f_aux ([] : List R) = (1, 1)
proof: := rfl

name: f_aux_cons
statement:
theorem f_aux_cons (r : R) (l : List R) :
    f_aux (r :: l) = ((f_aux l).1 + r * (f_aux l).2, (f_aux l).1)
proof: := rfl

name: f_aux_alt1_nil
statement: theorem f_aux_alt1_nil : f_aux_alt1 nil = ![(1 : R), 0]
proof: := rfl

name: f_aux_alt1_cons
statement:
theorem f_aux_alt1_cons (r : R) (l : List R) :
    f_aux_alt1 (r :: l) = (M r).mulVec (f_aux_alt1 l)
proof: := rfl

name: f_aux_alt1_prod_description
statement:
theorem f_aux_alt1_prod_description :
    ∀ l : List R, f_aux_alt1 l = (l.map M).prod.mulVec ![1, 0]
proof:
:= by
  refine List.rec (one_mulVec ![1, 0]).symm λ r l h ↦ ?_
  rw [map_cons, prod_cons, f_aux_alt1_cons, h, mulVec_mulVec]

name: f_aux_matrix_description1
statement:
theorem f_aux_matrix_description1 :
    ∀ l : List R, f_aux l = (f_aux_alt1 l 0, f_aux_alt1 l 0 - f_aux_alt1 l 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine List.rec (Prod.ext rfl (sub_zero 1).symm) λ r l h ↦ ?_
  rw [f_aux_cons, f_aux_alt1_cons, h, Prod.mk_inj,
    matrix_fin2_mulVec, matrix_fin2_mulVec, M]
  simp only [of_apply, cons_val_one, cons_val_zero]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [one_add_mul, neg_mul, add_assoc, ← sub_eq_add_neg, mul_sub]
  · rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, one_add_mul, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: f_description1
statement: theorem f_description1 (l : List R) : f l = f_aux_alt1 l 0
proof:
:=
  congrArg Prod.fst (f_aux_matrix_description1 l)

name: f_aux_alt2_nil
statement: theorem f_aux_alt2_nil : f_aux_alt2 nil = ![(1 : R), 0]
proof: := rfl

name: f_aux_alt2_cons
statement:
theorem f_aux_alt2_cons (r : R) (l : List R) :
    f_aux_alt2 (r :: l) = vecMul (f_aux_alt2 l) (M r)
proof: := rfl

name: f_aux_alt2_prod_description
statement:
theorem f_aux_alt2_prod_description :
    ∀ l : List R, f_aux_alt2 l = vecMul ![1, 0] (l.reverse.map M).prod
proof:
:= by
  refine List.rec (vecMul_one ![1, 0]).symm λ r l h ↦ ?_
  rw [f_aux_alt2_cons, reverse_cons, map_append, map_singleton,
    prod_append, prod_singleton, h, vecMul_vecMul]

name: f_aux_matrix_description2
statement:
theorem f_aux_matrix_description2 :
    ∀ l : List R, f_aux l = (f_aux_alt2 l 0, f_aux_alt2 l 0 + f_aux_alt2 l 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine List.rec (Prod.ext rfl (add_zero 1).symm) λ r l h ↦ ?_
  rw [f_aux_cons, f_aux_alt2_cons, h, Prod.mk_inj,
    matrix_fin2_vecMul, matrix_fin2_vecMul, M]
  simp only [of_apply, cons_val_one, cons_val_zero]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mul_comm, add_mul, mul_one_add, add_assoc]
  · rw [← add_mul, mul_one_add, add_assoc (f_aux_alt2 l 0),
      ← add_mul, mul_neg, add_neg_cancel_right]

name: f_description2
statement: theorem f_description2 (l : List R) : f l = f_aux_alt2 l 0
proof:
:=
  congrArg Prod.fst (f_aux_matrix_description2 l)

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (l : List R) : f l.reverse = f l
proof:
:= by
  rw [f_description2, f_aux_alt2_prod_description, reverse_reverse, matrix_fin2_vecMul,
    f_description1, f_aux_alt1_prod_description, matrix_fin2_mulVec]
  simp

name: div_pos_of_dvd
statement: lemma div_pos_of_dvd (hm : 0 < m) (hk : k ∣ m) : 0 < m / k
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_right (hm.trans_eq (Nat.div_mul_cancel hk).symm)

name: clog_base_mul
statement: lemma clog_base_mul (hb : 1 < b) (hn : 0 < n) : b.clog (b * n) = b.clog n + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (Nat.clog_of_two_le hb (Nat.mul_le_mul hb hn)).trans (congrArg (b.clog · + 1) ?_)
  have hb' : 0 < b := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb
  rw [Nat.add_sub_assoc hb.le, Nat.mul_add_div hb', Nat.add_eq_left, Nat.div_eq_zero_iff]
  exact Or.inr (Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt hb)

name: two_pow_clog_mem_Ico
statement: lemma two_pow_clog_mem_Ico (hn : 0 < n) : 2 ^ Nat.clog 2 n ∈ Ico n (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  have X : 1 < 2 := Nat.one_lt_two
  refine mem_Ico.mpr ⟨Nat.le_pow_clog X n, ?_⟩
  rw [← Nat.lt_clog_iff_pow_lt X, clog_base_mul X hn, Nat.lt_succ_iff]

name: prod_mod_ne_one
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨i₀, hi₀, h⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hi₀', rfl⟩ : ∃ I' : Finset ι, i₀ ∉ I' ∧ insert i₀ I' = I :=
    ⟨I.erase i₀, I.notMem_erase i₀, insert_erase hi₀⟩
  replace hi₀ : ¬n ∣ f i₀ := (not_congr (h i₀ hi₀)).mpr (· rfl)
  replace h (i) (hi : i ∈ I) : (f i + 1) % n = 1 % n := by
    obtain ⟨k, h0⟩ := (h i (mem_insert_of_mem hi)).mpr (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi hi₀')
    rw [h0, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]
  rw [prod_nat_mod, prod_insert hi₀', prod_congr rfl h, ← Nat.mul_mod_mod,
    ← prod_nat_mod, prod_const_one, ← Nat.mul_mod, Nat.mul_one]
  intro h0; replace h0 : (f i₀ + 1 - 1) % n = 0 := Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq h0
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, ← Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at h0
  exact hi₀ h0

name: main_lemma
statement:
lemma main_lemma (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (h : ∀ k ∈ Ico n (2 * n), k ∣ m) :
    ∃ t, ∀ k ∈ Ico n (2 * n), 2 ^ t ∣ m / k ↔ k ≠ 2 ^ Nat.clog 2 n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨m.factorization 2 - Nat.clog 2 n + 1, λ k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  have X {k x} (hx : 0 < x) : 2 ^ k ∣ x ↔ k ≤ x.factorization 2 :=
    Nat.prime_two.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hx.ne.symm
  have X0 : Nat.clog 2 n ≤ m.factorization 2 := (X hm).mp (h _ (two_pow_clog_mem_Ico hn))
  specialize h k hk
  have hk0 : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos h hm
  rw [iff_not_comm, X (div_pos_of_dvd hm h), Nat.factorization_div h, Nat.not_le,
    Nat.lt_succ_iff, Finsupp.coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply, Nat.sub_le_sub_iff_left X0, ← X hk0]
  refine ⟨λ h0 ↦ dvd_of_eq h0.symm, λ h0 ↦ (Nat.eq_of_dvd_of_lt_two_mul hk0.ne.symm h0 ?_)⟩
  exact (mem_Ico.mp hk).2.trans_le (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.le_pow_clog Nat.one_lt_two _))

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 1 < n) (h : ∀ k ∈ Ico n (2 * n), k ∣ m) :
    ∀ N, ∏ k ∈ Ico n (2 * n), (m / k + 1) ≠ 2 ^ N + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := main_lemma hm hn0 h
  intro N hN; obtain h0 | h0 : t ≤ N ∨ N < t := le_or_gt t N
  
  · apply prod_mod_ne_one ⟨2 ^ Nat.clog 2 n, two_pow_clog_mem_Ico hn0, ht⟩
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, N = t + c := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h0
    rw [hN, Nat.pow_add, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]
  
  · revert hN; apply Nat.ne_of_gt
    apply (Nat.add_lt_add_right (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right Nat.one_lt_two h0) 1).trans_le
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, hk₀0⟩ : ∃ k ∈ Ico n (2 * n), k ≠ 2 ^ Nat.clog 2 n := by
      apply exists_mem_ne; rwa [Nat.card_Ico, Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    replace hk₀0 : 2 ^ t + 1 ≤ m / k₀ + 1 := by
      refine Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_of_dvd ?_ ((ht _ hk₀).mpr hk₀0)) 1
      exact div_pos_of_dvd hm (h _ hk₀)
    rw [← prod_erase_mul _ _ hk₀]
    exact hk₀0.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (prod_pos λ _ _ ↦ Nat.succ_pos _))

name: factorial_le_succ_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem factorial_le_succ_ascFactorial (a) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, n.factorial ≤ (a + 1).ascFactorial n
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec (Nat.le_refl 1) λ n ↦ Nat.mul_le_mul ?_
  rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc]
  exact n.succ.le_add_left a

name: ascFactorial_succ_mono_right
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_succ_mono_right (a) (h : m ≤ n) :
    (a + 1).ascFactorial m ≤ (a + 1).ascFactorial n
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ a.factorial_pos
  rw [Nat.factorial_mul_ascFactorial, Nat.factorial_mul_ascFactorial]
  exact Nat.factorial_le (Nat.add_le_add_left h a)

name: ascFactorial_mono_left
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_mono_left {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) :
    ∀ n, a.ascFactorial n ≤ b.ascFactorial n
proof:
:=
  Nat.rec (Nat.le_refl 1) λ n ↦ Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.add_le_add_right h n)

name: ascFactorial_succ'
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_succ' (n k) :
    n.ascFactorial (k + 1) = n * (n + 1).ascFactorial k
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ⟨n, rfl⟩ : n = 0 ∨ ∃ n', n = n' + 1 :=
    n.eq_zero_or_pos.imp_right Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le'
  · rw [Nat.zero_ascFactorial, Nat.zero_mul]
  · rw [← Nat.mul_right_inj n.factorial_ne_zero, Nat.factorial_mul_ascFactorial,
      ← Nat.mul_assoc, n.factorial.mul_comm, ← Nat.factorial_succ,
      Nat.factorial_mul_ascFactorial, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc]

name: add_one_dvd_of_dvd_mul
statement: theorem add_one_dvd_of_dvd_mul (h : a ∣ b) (h0 : b + 1 ∣ a * c) : b + 1 ∣ c
proof:
:=
  (Nat.dvd_add_right (Nat.dvd_trans h0 (Nat.mul_dvd_mul_right h c))).mp
    ⟨c, (b.succ_mul c).symm⟩

name: good_comm
statement: lemma good_comm : good c d ↔ good d c
proof:
:= by
  rw [good, good, Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_comm]

name: good_iff
statement: lemma good_iff : good c d ↔ c + d ∣ c * c
proof:
:= by
  have h : c + d ∣ c * c + c * d := ⟨c, by rw [← c.mul_add, c.mul_comm]⟩
  refine ⟨λ h0 ↦ (Nat.dvd_add_iff_left h0).mpr h, λ h0 ↦ (Nat.dvd_add_iff_right h0).mpr h⟩

name: not_good_one_right
statement: lemma not_good_one_right (hc : 0 < c) : ¬good c 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [good, c.mul_one]; exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt hc c.lt_succ_self

name: not_good_one_left
statement: lemma not_good_one_left (hd : 0 < d) : ¬good 1 d
proof:
:=
  mt good_comm.mp (not_good_one_right hd)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (h : good a.factorial b.factorial) :
    2 * b + 2 ≤ 3 * a ∧ (2 * b + 2 = 3 * a ↔ a = 2 ∧ b = 2 ∨ a = 4 ∧ b = 5)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain h0 | ⟨c, rfl⟩ : b < a ∨ ∃ c, b = a + c :=
    (lt_or_ge b a).imp_right Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le
  · have h1 : 2 * b + 2 < 3 * a := by
      refine (Nat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le ?_ ?_).trans_eq (Nat.succ_mul 2 a).symm
      · exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h0 Nat.two_pos
      · refine Nat.le_of_not_lt λ h1 ↦ not_good_one_left b.factorial_pos ?_
        rwa [← Nat.factorial_eq_one.mpr (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h1)]
    refine ⟨h1.le, iff_of_false h1.ne ?_⟩
    rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact h0.ne rfl
    · exact h0.not_gt (Nat.lt_succ_self 4)
  
  replace h : (a + 1).ascFactorial c + 1 ∣ a.factorial := by
    rwa [good_iff, ← a.factorial_mul_ascFactorial, Nat.add_comm,
      ← Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left a.factorial_pos] at h
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, a = c + d := by
    refine Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_le λ h0 ↦ ?_)
    revert h; refine Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt a.factorial_pos (Nat.lt_succ_of_le ?_)
    exact (factorial_le_succ_ascFactorial a a).trans (ascFactorial_succ_mono_right a h0)
  
  suffices c + 2 ≤ d ∧ (c + 2 = d → c = 0 ∨ c = 1) by
    rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.succ_mul 2, Nat.add_assoc, c.two_mul, Nat.add_assoc]
    revert this; refine And.imp (λ h0 ↦ ?_) (λ h0 ↦ ?_)
    · rwa [Nat.add_le_add_iff_left, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left]
    · rw [Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_right_inj]
      refine ⟨λ h1 ↦ ?_, λ h1 ↦ ?_⟩
      · refine (h0 h1).imp (λ h2 ↦ ?_) (λ h2 ↦ ?_)
        all_goals subst h1 h2; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rcases h1 with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · rw [h1, Nat.add_right_inj (k := 0)] at h2
          rw [h2, Nat.zero_add] at h1
          rw [h2, h1]
        · rw [h1, Nat.add_right_inj (k := 1)] at h2
          rw [h2, Nat.add_right_inj (k := 3)] at h1
          rw [h2, h1]
  
  replace h : (c + d + 1).ascFactorial c + 1 ∣ (c + 1).ascFactorial d :=
    add_one_dvd_of_dvd_mul (Nat.factorial_dvd_ascFactorial _ _)
      (c.factorial_mul_ascFactorial d ▸ h)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · refine Nat.le_of_not_lt λ h0 ↦ ?_
    rw [Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.le_succ_iff] at h0
    rcases h0 with h0 | rfl
    
    · revert h; apply Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.ascFactorial_pos _ _)
      refine Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((ascFactorial_succ_mono_right _ h0).trans' ?_)
      exact ascFactorial_mono_left (Nat.succ_le_succ (c.le_add_right d)) d
    
    · replace h : (2 * c + 2).ascFactorial c + 1 ∣ (c + 2).ascFactorial c := by
        rw [Nat.add_right_comm, ← Nat.two_mul, ascFactorial_succ'] at h
        revert h; apply add_one_dvd_of_dvd_mul
        obtain rfl | ⟨c, rfl⟩ : c = 0 ∨ ∃ c', c = c' + 1 :=
          c.eq_zero_or_pos.imp_right Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le'
        · exact Nat.one_dvd _
        · rw [ascFactorial_succ', Nat.mul_right_comm]
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _
      revert h; apply Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.ascFactorial_pos _ _)
      refine Nat.lt_succ_of_le (ascFactorial_mono_left ?_ _)
      rw [ Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_assoc]
      exact Nat.le_add_left _ _
  
  · rintro rfl; obtain rfl | ⟨c, rfl⟩ : c = 0 ∨ ∃ c', c = c' + 1 :=
      c.eq_zero_or_pos.imp_right Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le'
    · left; rfl
    
    right; rw [Nat.add_left_inj, ← Nat.lt_one_iff, ← Nat.not_le,
      Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, or_comm]
    rintro (rfl | h0)
    · revert h; show ¬57 ∣ 360; decide
    
    replace h : (2 * c + 5).ascFactorial (c + 1) + 1 ∣ (c + 2) * (c + 5).ascFactorial c := by
      replace h : (2 * c + 5).ascFactorial (c + 1) + 1 ∣ (c + 2).ascFactorial (c + 3) := by
        rwa [Nat.add_assoc, c.add_add_add_comm 1 c 4, ← Nat.two_mul] at h
      rw [ascFactorial_succ' (c + 2), ascFactorial_succ' (c + 3),
        ascFactorial_succ' (c + 4), ← (c + 3).mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm] at h
      revert h; apply add_one_dvd_of_dvd_mul
      obtain rfl | ⟨d, rfl⟩ : 2 = c ∨ ∃ d, c = d + 3 :=
        h0.eq_or_lt.imp_right Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le'
      
      · show 30 ∣ 990; exact ⟨33, rfl⟩
      
      · rw [Nat.mul_add 2, ascFactorial_succ']
        refine Nat.dvd_trans ?_ (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)
        rw [ascFactorial_succ']; refine Nat.mul_dvd_mul ⟨2, ?_⟩ ?_
        · rw [Nat.mul_comm, d.add_assoc, d.add_mul]
        rw [ascFactorial_succ']; refine Nat.dvd_trans ?_ (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)
        rw [ascFactorial_succ']; refine Nat.dvd_trans ⟨2, ?_⟩ (Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _)
        rw [Nat.mul_comm, d.add_assoc, d.add_mul]
    revert h; apply Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt
    · exact Nat.mul_pos (c + 1).succ_pos (Nat.ascFactorial_pos _ _)
    · rw [Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.ascFactorial_succ, Nat.two_mul, c.add_assoc]
      refine Nat.mul_le_mul ?_ (ascFactorial_mono_left (Nat.le_add_left _ _) _)
      rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left, Nat.add_right_comm]
      exact Nat.le_add_left 2 (c + c + 3)

name: nice_of_special_form
statement:
theorem nice_of_special_form (hk : 0 < k) (hn : 0 < n) :
    nice (k * n ^ 2) (k * n) (k * n) k
proof:
:= by
  have hkn : 0 < k * n := mul_pos hk hn
  have hkn2 : 0 < k * n ^ 2 := mul_pos hk (pow_pos hn 2)
  refine ⟨hkn2, hkn, hkn, hk, ?_⟩
  replace hn : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn).ne.symm
  replace hkn : ((k * n.succ : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.mul_pos hk n.succ_pos).ne.symm
  rw [sq, ← mul_assoc k, ← Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.mul_succ, k.mul_right_comm n n.succ,
    mul_right_comm, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul _ n, mul_div_mul_right _ _ hn, ← add_div,
    ← mul_assoc, ← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.cast_mul, add_assoc,
    mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hkn, ← Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.mul_succ, Nat.cast_mul (_ * _),
    mul_assoc, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hkn, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, ← mul_rotate',
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr n.succ_ne_zero), mul_comm]

name: eq_nice_sum_of_not_Squarefree
statement:
theorem eq_nice_sum_of_not_Squarefree (hn : 0 < n) (h : ¬Squarefree n) :
    ∃ a b c d, nice a b c d ∧ a + b + c + d = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.squarefree_iff_prime_squarefree] at h
  simp only [not_forall, not_not] at h
  rcases h with ⟨p, hp, k, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨_, _, _, _, nice_of_special_form (Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left hn) hp.pred_pos, ?_⟩
  rw [sq, ← mul_assoc, ← Nat.mul_succ, add_assoc, ← Nat.mul_succ, mul_right_comm,
    ← Nat.mul_succ, Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hp.pos, mul_rotate]

name: nice_sum_not_Squarefree
statement: theorem nice_sum_not_Squarefree (h : nice a b c d) : ¬Squarefree (a + b + c + d)
proof:
:= λ h0 ↦ by
  have hab : 0 < a + b := Nat.add_pos_left h.a_pos b
  have hcd : 0 < c + d := Nat.add_pos_left h.c_pos d
  replace h : a + b + (c + d) ∣ ((a + b) * (c + d)) ^ 2 := by
    replace hab : 0 < ((a + b : ℕ) : ℚ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hab
    replace hcd : 0 < ((c + d : ℕ) : ℚ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hcd
    have h1 := h.spec
    rw [div_add_div _ _ hab.ne.symm hcd.ne.symm, add_assoc, (a + b).cast_add,
      div_eq_div_iff (mul_pos hab hcd).ne.symm (add_pos hab hcd).ne.symm] at h1
    simp only [← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.cast_mul] at h1
    rw [Nat.cast_inj, ← sq] at h1; exact Dvd.intro_left _ h1
  rw [Nat.add_assoc] at h0
  generalize a + b = k, c + d = m at h h0 hab hcd; clear a b c d
  
  have h1 : k ^ 2 ≡ m ^ 2 [MOD k + m] := by
    rw [Nat.modEq_iff_dvd, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_pow, add_comm]
    exact ⟨m - k, sq_sub_sq _ _⟩
  replace h1 : k ^ 2 * k ^ 2 % (k + m) = k ^ 2 * m ^ 2 % (k + m) := h1.mul_left _
  rw [← pow_add, ← mul_pow, Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h] at h1
  replace h1 : k + m ∣ k :=
    (h0.dvd_pow_iff_dvd (Nat.succ_ne_zero 3)).mp (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h1)
  exact (Nat.le_of_dvd hab h1).not_gt (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right hcd)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∃ a b c d, nice a b c d ∧ a + b + c + d = n) ↔ ¬Squarefree n
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ ⟨_, _, _, _, h, h0⟩ ↦ h0 ▸ nice_sum_not_Squarefree h, eq_nice_sum_of_not_Squarefree hn⟩

name: x_pos
statement: lemma x_pos (hi : i < N) : 0 < X.x i
proof:
:=
  X.x_pos' i hi

name: x_inj
statement: lemma x_inj (hi : i < N) (hj : j < N) (h : X.x i = X.x j) : i = j
proof:
:=
  X.x_inj' i hi j hj h

name: x_inj_iff
statement: lemma x_inj_iff (hi : i < N) (hj : j < N) : X.x i = X.x j ↔ i = j
proof:
:=
  ⟨X.x_inj hi hj, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

name: spec
statement:
lemma spec (hi : i ≤ N) :
    (X.a i : F) ^ 2 = (range i).sum X.x * (range i).sum λ i ↦ (X.x i)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  X.spec' i hi

name: x_ne_zero
statement: lemma x_ne_zero (hi : i < N) : X.x i ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (X.x_pos hi).ne.symm

name: x_nonneg
statement: lemma x_nonneg (hi : i < N) : 0 ≤ X.x i
proof:
:=
  (X.x_pos hi).le

name: x_inv_ne_zero
statement: lemma x_inv_ne_zero (hi : i < N) : (X.x i)⁻¹ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  inv_ne_zero (X.x_ne_zero hi)

name: x_mul_inv
statement: lemma x_mul_inv (h : i < N) : X.x i * (X.x i)⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:=
  mul_inv_cancel₀ (X.x_ne_zero h)

name: x_inv_pos
statement: lemma x_inv_pos (hi : i < N) : 0 < (X.x i)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  inv_pos.mpr (X.x_pos hi)

name: x_inv_nonneg
statement: lemma x_inv_nonneg (hi : i < N) : 0 ≤ (X.x i)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (X.x_inv_pos hi).le

name: a_zero_eq_zero
statement: lemma a_zero_eq_zero : X.a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := X.spec N.zero_le
  rwa [sum_range_zero, zero_mul, sq_eq_zero_iff, Nat.cast_eq_zero] at h

name: a_one_eq_one
statement: lemma a_one_eq_one (h : 0 < N) : X.a 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := X.spec h
  rwa [sum_range_one, sum_range_one, X.x_mul_inv h, ← Nat.cast_pow,
    Nat.cast_eq_one, sq, Nat.mul_self_inj (n := 1)] at h0

name: special_formula1
statement:
lemma special_formula1 (h : i + 1 ≤ N) :
    (X.a (i + 1) : F) ^ 2 - (X.a i + 1) ^ 2
      = (X.x i)⁻¹ * (range i).sum X.x
        + X.x i * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹) - 2 * X.a i
proof:
:= calc
  _ = (range (i + 1)).sum X.x * (range (i + 1)).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹)
      - ((range i).sum X.x * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹) + 1 + 2 * X.a i) := by
    rw [X.spec h, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ, add_sq',
      X.spec (Nat.le_of_succ_le h), one_pow, mul_one]
  _ = (range i).sum X.x * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹)
      + (range i).sum X.x * (X.x i)⁻¹ + (X.x i * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹) + 1)
      - ((range i).sum X.x * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹) + 1 + 2 * X.a i) := by
    rw [sub_left_inj, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ,
      add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, X.x_mul_inv h]
  _ = _ := by rw [add_comm _ 1, add_add_add_comm, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, mul_comm]

name: special_formula2
statement:
lemma special_formula2 (h : i < N) :
    ((X.x i)⁻¹ * (range i).sum X.x + X.x i * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹)) ^ 2
      = ((X.x i)⁻¹ * (range i).sum X.x - X.x i * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹)) ^ 2
        + (2 * X.a i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', sq_sub_sq, add_add_sub_cancel, add_sub_sub_cancel,
    ← two_mul, ← two_mul, mul_mul_mul_comm, ← sq, mul_pow, X.spec (Nat.le_of_succ_le h),
    mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_comm _ (X.x i), X.x_mul_inv h, one_mul]

name: a_add_one_le_a_succ
statement: lemma a_add_one_le_a_succ (h : i + 1 ≤ N) : X.a i + 1 ≤ X.a (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.mul_self_le_mul_self_iff, ← sq, ← sq, ← Nat.cast_le (α := F), Nat.cast_pow,
    Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_succ, ← sub_nonneg, X.special_formula1 h, sub_nonneg]
  refine le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1) ?_
    ((le_add_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _)).trans_eq (X.special_formula2 h).symm)
  refine add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (X.x_nonneg h)) (sum_nonneg λ j h1 ↦ ?_))
    (mul_nonneg (X.x_nonneg h) (sum_nonneg λ j h1 ↦ inv_nonneg.mpr ?_))
  all_goals exact X.x_nonneg ((mem_range.mp h1).trans h)

name: a_succ_eq_a_add_one_iff
statement:
lemma a_succ_eq_a_add_one_iff (h : i + 1 ≤ N) :
    X.a (i + 1) = X.a i + 1 ↔
      (range i).sum X.x = X.x i ^ 2 * (range i).sum λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹
proof:
:= calc
  _ ↔ (X.a (i + 1) : F) ^ 2 - (X.a i + 1) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_succ, ← Nat.cast_pow, ← Nat.cast_pow,
      sub_eq_zero, Nat.cast_inj, sq, sq, Nat.mul_self_inj]
  _ ↔ (X.x i)⁻¹ * (range i).sum X.x + X.x i * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹)
      = 2 * X.a i := by rw [X.special_formula1 h, sub_eq_zero]
  _ ↔ ((X.x i)⁻¹ * (range i).sum X.x + X.x i * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹)) ^ 2
      = (2 * X.a i) ^ 2 := by
    refine (sq_eq_sq₀ ?_ (mul_nonneg zero_le_two (X.a i).cast_nonneg)).symm
    have h0 : 0 ≤ X.x i := X.x_nonneg h
    refine add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr h0) (sum_nonneg λ j h1 ↦ ?_))
      (mul_nonneg h0 (sum_nonneg λ j h1 ↦ inv_nonneg.mpr ?_))
    all_goals exact X.x_nonneg ((mem_range.mp h1).trans h)
  _ ↔ (X.x i)⁻¹ * (range i).sum X.x = X.x i * (range i).sum (λ j ↦ (X.x j)⁻¹) := by
    rw [X.special_formula2 h, add_eq_right, sq_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero]
  _ ↔ _ := by rw [inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ (X.x_ne_zero h), sq, mul_assoc]

name: three_add_a_le_a_add_two
statement: lemma three_add_a_le_a_add_two (h : i + 2 ≤ N) : X.a i + 3 ≤ X.a (i + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h' : i + 1 ≤ N := Nat.le_of_succ_le h
  
  obtain h0 | h0 : X.a i + 2 ≤ X.a (i + 1) ∨ X.a i + 1 = X.a (i + 1) :=
    (Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (X.a_add_one_le_a_succ h')).symm
  · exact (Nat.succ_le_succ h0).trans (X.a_add_one_le_a_succ h)
  obtain h1 | h1 : X.a (i + 1) + 2 ≤ X.a (i + 2) ∨ X.a (i + 1) + 1 = X.a (i + 2) :=
    (Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (X.a_add_one_le_a_succ h)).symm
  · rwa [← h0] at h1
  
  rw [eq_comm, X.a_succ_eq_a_add_one_iff (by assumption)] at h0 h1
  rw [sum_range_succ, h0, sum_range_succ, sq, mul_assoc, ← mul_add_one,
    ← X.x_mul_inv h', ← mul_add, ← mul_assoc, ← sq, mul_eq_mul_right_iff] at h1
  replace h1 : X.x i ^ 2 = X.x (i + 1) ^ 2 := by
    refine h1.resolve_right (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ?_ (X.x_inv_pos h')).ne.symm
    exact sum_nonneg λ j hj ↦ X.x_inv_nonneg ((mem_range.mp hj).trans h')
  rw [sq_eq_sq₀ (X.x_nonneg h') (X.x_nonneg h), X.x_inj_iff h' h] at h1
  exact absurd i.lt_succ_self h1.not_lt

name: general_a_bound
statement:
theorem general_a_bound : ∀ {i}, i ≤ N → 3 * i / 2 ≤ X.a i
  | 0 => λ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _
  | 1 => λ h ↦ (X.a_one_eq_one h).ge
  | n + 2 => λ h ↦ calc 3 * (n + 2) / 2
