      _ = 3 * n / 2 + 3
proof:
:= by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ Nat.two_pos]
      _ ≤ X.a n + 3 := Nat.add_le_add_right (general_a_bound (Nat.le_of_add_right_le h)) _
      _ ≤ X.a (n + 2) := X.three_add_a_le_a_add_two h

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution [Field F] [LinearOrder F] [IsStrictOrderedRing F] (X : goodSeq N F) : 3 * N / 2 ≤ X.a N
proof:
:=
  X.general_a_bound N.le_refl

name: a_le_succ
statement: lemma a_le_succ : ∀ n, X.a n ≤ X.a (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec ?_ λ n hn ↦ ?_
  · rw [X.a_zero, X.a_one]; exact Nat.zero_le 1
  · obtain ⟨c, h⟩ := X.a_step n
    rw [← Nat.add_le_add_iff_right (n := c * X.a n), h, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hn) _

name: a_monotone
statement: lemma a_monotone {m} : ∀ {n}, m ≤ n → X.a m ≤ X.a n
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_induction (Nat.le_refl _) (λ n _ hn ↦ Nat.le_trans hn (X.a_le_succ n)) _

name: a_succ_pos
statement: lemma a_succ_pos (n) : 0 < X.a (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := X.a_monotone n.succ_pos; rwa [X.a_one] at h

name: one_le_a_succ
statement: lemma one_le_a_succ (n) : 1 ≤ X.a (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  X.a_succ_pos n

name: a_sub_one_step
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := X.a_step (n + 1)
  refine ⟨c, (c.1 + 1).mul_sub_one _ ▸ Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq ?_⟩
  rw [c.1.add_comm, Nat.add_add_add_comm, Nat.sub_add_cancel (X.one_le_a_succ _),
    ← Nat.mul_add_one, Nat.sub_add_cancel (X.one_le_a_succ _), hc, Nat.add_comm 1]

name: a_two_pred_mem
statement: lemma a_two_pred_mem : X.a 2 - 1 ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, h⟩ : ∃ c : S, X.a 2 + c * X.a 0 = (c + 1) * X.a 1 := X.a_step 0
  rw [X.a_zero, X.a_one, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.mul_one, Nat.add_zero] at h
  rw [h, Nat.add_sub_cancel]; exact c.2

name: of_mem_a_succ
statement: lemma of_mem_a_succ (c : S) (n) : (of_mem c).a (n + 1) = c * (of_mem c).a n + 1
proof: := rfl

name: a_two
statement: lemma a_two : X.a 2 = X.tail_coeff + 1
proof:
:=
  (Nat.sub_add_cancel (X.one_le_a_succ 1)).symm

name: tail_coeff_dvd_a_sub_one
statement:
lemma tail_coeff_dvd_a_sub_one : ∀ n, X.tail_coeff.1 ∣ X.a n - 1
  | 0 => X.a_zero.symm ▸ Nat.dvd_zero _
  | 1 => X.a_one.symm ▸ Nat.dvd_zero _
  | 2 => Nat.dvd_refl _
  | n + 3 => by
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩
proof:
:= X.a_sub_one_step n
      have h : X.tail_coeff.1 ∣ c.1 * (X.a (n + 1) - 1) :=
        Nat.dvd_trans (tail_coeff_dvd_a_sub_one (n + 1)) (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)
      have h0 : X.tail_coeff.1 ∣ (c.1 + 1) * (X.a (n + 2) - 1) :=
        Nat.dvd_trans (tail_coeff_dvd_a_sub_one (n + 2)) (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)
      rwa [← hc, ← Nat.dvd_add_iff_left h] at h0

name: a_succ_of_tail_coeff_eq_zero
statement: lemma a_succ_of_tail_coeff_eq_zero (h : X.tail_coeff.1 = 0) (n) : X.a (n + 1) = 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.eq_add_of_sub_eq (X.one_le_a_succ n)
    (Nat.zero_dvd.mp (h ▸ X.tail_coeff_dvd_a_sub_one _))

name: a_succ_drop_tail_formula_of_pos
statement:
lemma a_succ_drop_tail_formula_of_pos (h : 0 < X.tail_coeff.1) (n) :
    X.a (n + 1) = X.tail_coeff * (X.drop_tail_of_pos h).a n + 1
proof:
:=
  (Nat.sub_add_cancel (X.one_le_a_succ n)).symm.trans
    (congrArg Nat.succ (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (X.tail_coeff_dvd_a_sub_one _)).symm)

name: drop_tail_eq_of_pos
statement: lemma drop_tail_eq_of_pos (h : 0 < X.tail_coeff.1) : X.drop_tail = X.drop_tail_of_pos h
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left h

name: drop_tail_eq_of_zero
statement:
lemma drop_tail_eq_of_zero (h : X.tail_coeff.1 = 0) :
    X.drop_tail = of_mem ⟨0, h ▸ X.tail_coeff.2⟩
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.le_zero.mpr h))

name: a_succ_drop_tail_formula
statement: lemma a_succ_drop_tail_formula (n) : X.a (n + 1) = X.tail_coeff * X.drop_tail.a n + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h : X.tail_coeff.1 = 0 ∨ 0 < X.tail_coeff.1 := X.tail_coeff.1.eq_zero_or_pos
  · rw [h, Nat.zero_mul, X.a_succ_of_tail_coeff_eq_zero h]
  · rw [X.drop_tail_eq_of_pos h, X.a_succ_drop_tail_formula_of_pos h]

name: tail_coeff_append_tail
statement: lemma tail_coeff_append_tail (c : S) : (X.append_tail c).tail_coeff = c
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext ((congrArg (c.1 * ·) X.a_one).trans c.1.mul_one)

name: append_tail_a_succ
statement: lemma append_tail_a_succ (c : S) (n) : (X.append_tail c).a (n + 1) = c * X.a n + 1
proof: := rfl

name: isKawaii.induction
proof:
:=
  λ _ h1 ↦ h1.recOn h λ c n _ ↦ h0 c n

name: isKawaii.one
statement: theorem isKawaii.one {S : Set ℕ} (hS : S.Nonempty) : isKawaii S 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hS with ⟨c, hc⟩
  have h := (isKawaii.zero S).rec_mul_succ ⟨c, hc⟩
  rwa [Nat.mul_zero] at h

name: isKawaii.eq_zero_or_rec_mul_succ
statement:
theorem isKawaii.eq_zero_or_rec_mul_succ :
    ∀ k, isKawaii S k → k = 0 ∨ ∃ (c : S) (n : ℕ), isKawaii S n ∧ k = c * n + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine isKawaii.induction (Or.inl rfl) λ c k h ↦ Or.inr ?_
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨d, m, hm, rfl⟩
  exacts [⟨c, 0, isKawaii.zero S, rfl⟩, ⟨c, d * m + 1, hm.rec_mul_succ d, rfl⟩]

name: isKawaii.succ_imp
statement:
theorem isKawaii.succ_imp (h : isKawaii S (k + 1)) :
    ∃ (c : S) (n : ℕ), isKawaii S n ∧ k = c * n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, n, h0, h1⟩ := (h.eq_zero_or_rec_mul_succ _).resolve_left k.succ_ne_zero
  exact ⟨c, n, h0, Nat.succ_inj.mp h1⟩

name: KawaiiSequence.a_isKawaii
statement: theorem KawaiiSequence.a_isKawaii : ∀ (k : ℕ) (X : KawaiiSequence S), isKawaii S (X.a k)
proof:
:=
  Nat.rec (λ X ↦ X.a_zero.symm ▸ isKawaii.zero S)
    λ n hn X ↦ X.a_succ_drop_tail_formula n ▸ (hn X.drop_tail).rec_mul_succ _ _

name: isKawaii.exists_mem_KawaiiSequence
statement:
theorem isKawaii.exists_mem_KawaiiSequence (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∀ n, isKawaii S n → ∃ (X : KawaiiSequence S) (k : ℕ), n = X.a k
proof:
:= by
  refine isKawaii.induction ?_ ?_
  · rcases hS with ⟨c, hc⟩; exact ⟨KawaiiSequence.of_mem ⟨c, hc⟩, 0, rfl⟩
  · rintro d _ ⟨X, k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨X.append_tail d, k + 1, rfl⟩

name: isKawaii_iff_mem_KawaiiSequence
statement:
theorem isKawaii_iff_mem_KawaiiSequence (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    isKawaii S n ↔ ∃ (X : KawaiiSequence S) (k : ℕ), n = X.a k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isKawaii.exists_mem_KawaiiSequence hS _, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨X, k, rfl⟩; exact X.a_isKawaii k

name: isKawaii23_mod_three
statement: theorem isKawaii23_mod_three : ∀ m, isKawaii {2, 3} m → 3 ∣ m ∨ m % 3 = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine isKawaii.induction (Or.inl ⟨0, rfl⟩) λ c n hn ↦ ?_
  rcases c with ⟨c, rfl | rfl⟩
  
  · refine (hn.imp ?_ ?_).symm
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; rw [Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.mul_add_mod]
    · intro hn0; refine ⟨2 * (n / 3) + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.succ_inj, Nat.mul_left_comm,
        ← Nat.mul_add_one, ← hn0, n.div_add_mod]
  
  · right; rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.one_mod]

name: isKawaii23_self_and_succ
statement:
theorem isKawaii23_self_and_succ (hm : isKawaii {2, 3} m) (hm0 : isKawaii {2, 3} (m + 1)) :
    ∃ k, isKawaii {2, 3} k ∧ m = 3 * k
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : 3 ∣ m := by
    refine (isKawaii23_mod_three _ hm).resolve_right λ h ↦ ?_
    replace h0 : (m + 1) % 3 = 2 := by rw [← Nat.mod_add_mod, h]
    apply absurd (isKawaii23_mod_three _ hm0)
    rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, h0]; decide
  refine ⟨k, ?_, rfl⟩
  
  have three_ne_zero : 3 ≠ 0 := Nat.succ_ne_zero 2
  obtain h | h : 3 * k = 0 ∨ _ := hm.eq_zero_or_rec_mul_succ _
  · exact (Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left three_ne_zero ▸ isKawaii.zero _
  rcases h with ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, n, -, h⟩
  obtain rfl : c = 2 := by
    refine hc.resolve_right λ (hc : c = 3) ↦ absurd (congrArg (· % 3) h) ?_
    simp only [hc, Nat.mul_mod_right, Nat.mul_add_mod]; exact Nat.zero_ne_one
  
  simp only at h; clear hc
  obtain ⟨⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩, m, hm, h0⟩ := hm0.succ_imp
  
  · apply absurd (congrArg (· % 2) (h.symm.trans h0))
    simp only [Nat.mul_mod_right, Nat.mul_add_mod]; exact Nat.one_ne_zero
  
  · rwa [(Nat.mul_right_inj three_ne_zero).mp h0]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (hn : ∃ (X : KawaiiSequence {2, 3}) (k : ℕ), n = X.a k)
    (hn0 : ∃ (X : KawaiiSequence {2, 3}) (k : ℕ), n + 1 = X.a k) :
    ∃ m, (∃ (X : KawaiiSequence {2, 3}) (k : ℕ), m = X.a k) ∧ n = 3 * m
proof:
:= by
  have h : ({2, 3} : Set ℕ).Nonempty := ⟨2, Or.inl rfl⟩
  simp only [← isKawaii_iff_mem_KawaiiSequence h] at hn hn0 ⊢
  exact isKawaii23_self_and_succ hn hn0

name: two_mul_add_dist_sq_eq
statement:
theorem two_mul_add_dist_sq_eq (k m : ℕ) :
    2 * k * m + k.dist m ^ 2 = k ^ 2 + m ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  wlog h : k ≤ m
  · rw [(k ^ 2).add_comm, Nat.mul_right_comm, Nat.dist_comm]
    exact this m k (Nat.le_of_not_ge h)
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = k + n := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le h, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_assoc,
    ← Nat.pow_two, Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_assoc, add_sq, Nat.add_assoc]

name: add_sq_add_dist_sq_eq
statement:
theorem add_sq_add_dist_sq_eq (k m : ℕ) :
    (k + m) ^ 2 + k.dist m ^ 2 = 2 * (k ^ 2 + m ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_sq', Nat.add_assoc, two_mul_add_dist_sq_eq, Nat.two_mul]

name: succ_div_two_eq
statement: theorem succ_div_two_eq (N) : (N + 1) / 2 = N / 2 + N % 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.succ_div, Nat.add_left_cancel_iff]
  simp_rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, ← Nat.even_iff, Nat.even_add_one, Nat.not_even_iff]
  split_ifs with h; exacts [h.symm, (Nat.mod_two_ne_one.mp h).symm]

name: div_two_add_succ_div_two
statement: theorem div_two_add_succ_div_two (N) : N / 2 + (N + 1) / 2 = N
proof:
:= by
  rw [succ_div_two_eq, ← Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.two_mul, Nat.div_add_mod]

name: two_mul_succ_div_two
statement: theorem two_mul_succ_div_two (N) : 2 * ((N + 1) / 2) = N + N % 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [succ_div_two_eq, Nat.mul_add, (N % 2).two_mul, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.div_add_mod]

name: mod_two_sq_eq_self
statement: theorem mod_two_sq_eq_self (N) : (N % 2) ^ 2 = N % 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h : N % 2 = 0 ∨ N % 2 = 1 := N.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one
  all_goals rw [h]; rfl

name: add_div_two_lt_max_of_ne
statement: theorem add_div_two_lt_max_of_ne {x y : ℕ} (h : x ≠ y) : (x + y) / 2 < x.max y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul Nat.two_pos, Nat.mul_two]
  obtain h | h : x < y ∨ y < x := h.lt_or_gt
  · exact Nat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (lt_sup_of_lt_right h) (x.le_max_right y)
  · exact Nat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (x.le_max_left y) (lt_sup_of_lt_left h)

name: sum_dist_abs_eq
statement:
theorem sum_dist_abs_eq :
    2 * ∑ i : Fin N, Nat.dist (X.toPerm i.castSucc) (X.toPerm i.succ) = (N + 1) * N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [X.distPerm_spec, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  rw [sum_add_distrib, Fin.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_one,
    Equiv.sum_comp, Nat.mul_add, mul_sum, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range,
    ← sum_range_succ, ← mul_sum, Nat.mul_comm, sum_range_id_mul_two]; rfl

name: sum_dist_rel_eq
statement:
theorem sum_dist_rel_eq (hk : k ≤ N) :
    2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), Nat.dist (X.toPerm i) k
      = (k + 1) * k + (N - k + 1) * (N - k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, N = k + m := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hk
  rw [X.toPerm.sum_comp λ i ↦ i.val.dist k, Nat.add_assoc, Fin.sum_univ_add, Nat.mul_add]
  refine congrArg₂ _ ?_ ?_
  · suffices ∑ i : Fin k, i.val.dist k = ∑ i ∈ range (k + 1), i from
      (congrArg (2 * ·) this).trans (by rw [Nat.mul_comm, sum_range_id_mul_two]; rfl)
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range λ i ↦ i.dist k, ← sum_flip, sum_range_succ, k.sub_self]
    exact sum_congr rfl λ i hi ↦ Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le (mem_range.mp hi).le
  · change 2 * ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), (k + i).dist (k + 0) = _
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Nat.dist_add_add_left, Nat.dist_zero_right]
    rw [mul_sum, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range, ← mul_sum,
      Nat.mul_comm, sum_range_id_mul_two]; rfl

name: sum_dist_abs_le_sum_dist_rel
statement:
theorem sum_dist_abs_le_sum_dist_rel (k) :
    ∑ i : Fin N, Nat.dist (X.toPerm i.castSucc) (X.toPerm i.succ)
        + (Nat.dist (X.toPerm (Fin.last N)) k + Nat.dist (X.toPerm 0) k)
      ≤ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), Nat.dist (X.toPerm i) k
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N, (Nat.dist (X.toPerm i.castSucc) k + Nat.dist k (X.toPerm i.succ))
        + (Nat.dist (X.toPerm (Fin.last N)) k + Nat.dist (X.toPerm 0) k) :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right (sum_le_sum λ i _ ↦ Nat.dist.triangle_inequality _ _ _) _
    _ = (∑ i : Fin N, Nat.dist (X.toPerm i.castSucc) k + Nat.dist (X.toPerm (Fin.last N)) k)
        + (∑ i : Fin N, Nat.dist (X.toPerm i.succ) k + Nat.dist (X.toPerm 0) k) := by
      rw [sum_add_distrib, Nat.add_add_add_comm]; simp only [k.dist_comm]
    _ = _ + _ := congrArg₂ _ ?_ ?_
    _ = _ := (Nat.two_mul _).symm
  · rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Nat.add_comm]
  · rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Nat.add_comm]

name: dist_rel_main_free_ineq
statement:
theorem dist_rel_main_free_ineq (hk : k ≤ N) :
    2 * (Nat.dist (X.toPerm (Fin.last N)) k + Nat.dist (X.toPerm 0) k)
      ≤ k.dist (N - k) ^ 2 + N
proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (X.sum_dist_abs_le_sum_dist_rel k)
  rw [Nat.mul_add, X.sum_dist_abs_eq, X.sum_dist_rel_eq hk] at h
  generalize 2 * _ = a at h ⊢
  replace hk : k + (N - k) = N := Nat.add_sub_of_le hk
  generalize N - k = m at hk h; subst hk
  rw [Nat.succ_mul, k.succ_mul, m.succ_mul, Nat.add_add_add_comm, ← Nat.pow_two,
    ← Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_add, ← add_sq_add_dist_sq_eq, Nat.add_assoc,
    ((k + m) ^ 2).add_assoc, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left, Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_left_comm] at h
  exact Nat.le_of_add_le_add_left h

name: toPerm_last_add_toPerm_zero_bound
statement:
theorem toPerm_last_add_toPerm_zero_bound :
    (N + 1) / 2 ≤ X.toPerm (Fin.last N) + X.toPerm 0
proof:
:= by
  let aN := X.toPerm (Fin.last N); let a0 := X.toPerm 0
  have h {k} (hk : k ≤ N) : 2 * (k + k) ≤ k.dist (N - k) ^ 2 + N + 2 * (aN + a0) := calc
    _ ≤ 2 * ((Nat.dist aN k + aN) + (Nat.dist a0 k + a0)) := by
      refine Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.add_le_add ?_ ?_)
      all_goals exact Nat.dist_tri_left _ k
    _ = 2 * (Nat.dist aN k + Nat.dist a0 k) + 2 * (aN + a0) := by
      rw [Nat.add_add_add_comm, Nat.mul_add]
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.add_le_add_right (X.dist_rel_main_free_ineq hk) _
  replace h := h (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.div_lt_self N.succ_pos Nat.one_lt_two))
  rw [← Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq (div_two_add_succ_div_two N), ← (N / 2).add_zero,
    ← Nat.two_mul, succ_div_two_eq, Nat.dist_add_add_left, Nat.dist_zero_right,
    mod_two_sq_eq_self, (N % 2).add_comm, ← two_mul_succ_div_two,
    ← succ_div_two_eq, Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left] at h
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left h Nat.two_pos

name: toPerm_last_max_toPerm_zero_bound
statement:
theorem toPerm_last_max_toPerm_zero_bound (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    (N + 1) / 4 + 1 ≤ (X.toPerm (Fin.last N)).1.max (X.toPerm 0)
proof:
:=
  calc (N + 1) / 4
    _ = (N + 1) / 2 / 2 := (Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul (N + 1) 2 2).symm
    _ ≤ _ / 2 := Nat.div_le_div_right X.toPerm_last_add_toPerm_zero_bound
    _ < _ := add_div_two_lt_max_of_ne λ h0 ↦
      hN (Fin.last_eq_zero_iff.mp (X.toPerm.injective (Fin.eq_of_val_eq h0)))

name: prod_range_add_two
statement: theorem prod_range_add_two (n : ℕ) : ∏ x ∈ range n, (x + 2) = (n + 1).factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial, prod_range_succ', Nat.mul_one]

name: prod_range_add_two_mul_Ico_succ
statement:
theorem prod_range_add_two_mul_Ico_succ (h : i ≤ n) :
    (range i).prod (· + 2) * (Ico i n).prod Nat.succ = (i + 1) * n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial, prod_range_add_two, Nat.factorial_succ,
    Nat.mul_assoc,  ← prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial, prod_range_mul_prod_Ico _ h]

name: a_lt_b
statement: lemma a_lt_b (h : i < n) : X.a i < X.b i
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right X.D_pos).trans_eq (X.spec i h).symm
  rw [prod_range_succ, prod_eq_prod_Ico_succ_bot h, Nat.mul_assoc] at h0
  exact Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h0)

name: b_sub_a_pos
statement: lemma b_sub_a_pos (h : i < n) : 0 < X.b i - X.a i
proof:
:=
  Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (X.a_lt_b h)

name: spec_alt
statement:
lemma spec_alt (h : i < n) :
    (range i).prod X.b * (Ico (i + 1) n).prod X.a * (X.b i - X.a i) = X.D
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_sub]; apply Nat.sub_eq_of_eq_add'
  rw [Nat.mul_right_comm, ← prod_range_succ, X.spec _ h,
    prod_eq_prod_Ico_succ_bot h, Nat.mul_assoc, (X.a i).mul_comm]

name: prod_a_pos
statement: lemma prod_a_pos (S : Finset ℕ) : 0 < S.prod X.a
proof:
:=
  prod_pos λ _ _ ↦ X.a_pos _

name: prod_b_pos
statement: lemma prod_b_pos (S : Finset ℕ) : 0 < S.prod X.b
proof:
:=
  prod_pos λ _ _ ↦ X.b_pos _

name: mul_sub_eq_mul_sub
statement:
lemma mul_sub_eq_mul_sub (h : i + 1 < n) :
    X.a (i + 1) * (X.b i - X.a i) = X.b i * (X.b (i + 1) - X.a (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := (X.spec_alt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt h)).trans (X.spec_alt h).symm
  rw [prod_range_succ,  prod_eq_prod_Ico_succ_bot h, ← Nat.mul_assoc,
    Nat.mul_right_comm _ (X.a _), Nat.mul_right_comm _ (X.b _),
    Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_assoc _ (X.b _)] at h0
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.mul_pos (X.prod_b_pos _) (X.prod_a_pos _)) h0

name: mul_b_sub_a_lt_a
statement: lemma mul_b_sub_a_lt_a (h : i < n) : i * (X.b i - X.a i) < X.a i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact (Nat.zero_mul _).trans_lt (X.a_pos 0)
  | succ i i_ih => ?_
  have h0 := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt h
  specialize i_ih h0
  apply Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (a := X.b i - X.a i)
  calc
    _ = (i * (X.b i - X.a i) + (X.b i - X.a i)) * (X.b (i + 1) - X.a (i + 1)) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_left_comm, ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.succ_mul]
    _ < (X.a i + (X.b i - X.a i)) * (X.b (i + 1) - X.a (i + 1)) :=
      Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Nat.add_lt_add_right i_ih _) (X.b_sub_a_pos h)
    _ = X.b i * (X.b (i + 1) - X.a (i + 1)) := by rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (X.a_lt_b h0).le]
    _ = _ := by rw [← X.mul_sub_eq_mul_sub h, Nat.mul_comm]

name: self_lt_a
statement: lemma self_lt_a (h : i < n) : i < X.a i
proof:
:=
  (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right i (X.b_sub_a_pos h)).trans_lt (X.mul_b_sub_a_lt_a h)

name: succ_le_a
statement: lemma succ_le_a (h : i < n) : i.succ ≤ X.a i
proof:
:=
  X.self_lt_a h

name: factorial_le_D
statement: lemma factorial_le_D : n.factorial ≤ X.D
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ 0 < n := n.eq_zero_or_pos
  · exact X.D_pos
  · have h := prod_eq_prod_Ico_succ_bot hn Nat.succ
    rw [Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range, prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial, Nat.one_mul] at h
    rw [← X.spec_alt hn, prod_range_zero, Nat.one_mul, h]
    refine Nat.le_trans ?_ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (X.b_sub_a_pos hn))
    exact prod_le_prod λ i hi ↦ X.succ_le_a (mem_Ico.mp hi).2

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (n : ℕ) : IsLeast (Set.range (goodSeq.D (n := n))) n.factorial
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨linear_goodSeq n, rfl⟩, λ _ ⟨X, hX⟩ ↦ (X.factorial_le_D).trans_eq hX⟩

name: le_padicValNat_iff
statement: lemma le_padicValNat_iff (ha : 1 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : n ≤ padicValNat a b ↔ a ^ n ∣ b
proof:
:=
  (Nat.pow_dvd_iff_le_padicValNat ha.ne.symm hb.ne.symm).symm

name: padicValNat_eq_iff
statement:
lemma padicValNat_eq_iff (ha : a ≠ 1) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    padicValNat a b = n ↔ a ^ n ∣ b ∧ ¬a ^ (n + 1) ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pow_dvd_iff_le_padicValNat ha hb, Nat.pow_dvd_iff_le_padicValNat ha hb,
    Nat.not_le, Nat.lt_succ_iff, ← Nat.le_antisymm_iff, eq_comm]

name: padicValNat_pow_left
statement: lemma padicValNat_pow_left (a b k) : padicValNat (a ^ k) b = padicValNat a b / k
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain rfl | hk : k = 0 ∨ k ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne _ _
  · rw [Nat.pow_zero, padicValNat_one_left, Nat.div_zero]
  
  obtain rfl | ha : a = 1 ∨ a ≠ 1 := eq_or_ne _ _
  · rw [Nat.one_pow, padicValNat_one_left, Nat.zero_div]
  
  obtain rfl | hb : b = 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne _ _
  · rw [padicValNat_zero_right, padicValNat_zero_right, Nat.zero_div]
  
  refine (padicValNat_eq_iff (mt Nat.pow_eq_one.mp (not_or.mpr ⟨ha, hk⟩)) hb).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.pow_dvd_iff_le_padicValNat ha hb]
    exact Nat.mul_div_le _ _
  · rw [← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.pow_dvd_iff_le_padicValNat ha hb, Nat.not_le,
      Nat.mul_comm, ← Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hk)]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_self _

name: padicValNat_prime_mul_left
statement:
lemma padicValNat_prime_mul_left
    [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [Fact (Nat.Prime q)] (h : p ≠ q) (n : ℕ) :
    padicValNat (p * q) n = min (padicValNat p n) (padicValNat q n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn : n = 0 ∨ n ≠ 0 := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp only [padicValNat_zero_right]; rfl
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  have hq : q.Prime := Fact.out
  have hp0 : p ≠ 1 := hp.ne_one
  have hq0 : q ≠ 1 := hq.ne_one
  refine (padicValNat_eq_iff (λ h ↦ hp0 (Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_right h)) hn).mpr
    ⟨?_, λ h0 ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h0 : p.Coprime q :=
      hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr λ h0 ↦ h ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hq).mp h0)
    rw [Nat.mul_pow]; apply (h0.pow _ _).mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd
    exacts [Nat.pow_dvd_of_le_of_pow_dvd (min_le_left _ _) pow_padicValNat_dvd,
      Nat.pow_dvd_of_le_of_pow_dvd (min_le_right _ _) pow_padicValNat_dvd]
  · wlog h1 : padicValNat p n ≤ padicValNat q n
    · refine this h.symm n hn hq hp hq0 hp0 ?_ (Nat.le_of_not_le h1)
      rwa [min_comm, Nat.mul_comm]
    rw [min_eq_left h1, Nat.mul_pow] at h0
    replace h0 : p ^ (padicValNat p n + 1) ∣ n := dvd_of_mul_right_dvd h0
    rw [Nat.pow_dvd_iff_le_padicValNat hp0 hn, Nat.add_one_le_iff] at h0
    exact h0.ne rfl

name: padicValNat_factorial_prime_le
statement:
lemma padicValNat_factorial_prime_le
    [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [Fact (Nat.Prime q)] (h : p ≤ q) (n : ℕ) :
    padicValNat q n.factorial ≤ padicValNat p n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hp, hq⟩ : ∃ M, p.log n < M ∧ q.log n < M :=
    ⟨max (p.log n) (q.log n) + 1, max_lt_iff.mp (Nat.lt_succ_self _)⟩
  rw [padicValNat_factorial hp, padicValNat_factorial hq]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum λ i _ ↦ Nat.div_le_div_left (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h i) ?_
  have h : p.Prime := Fact.out; exact Nat.pow_pos h.pos

name: padicValNat_prime_mul_factorial_of_lt
statement:
lemma padicValNat_prime_mul_factorial_of_lt
    [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [Fact (Nat.Prime q)] (h : p < q) (n : ℕ) :
    padicValNat (p * q) n.factorial = padicValNat q n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat_prime_mul_left h.ne, min_eq_right (padicValNat_factorial_prime_le h.le n)]

name: padicValNat_9_eq
statement: lemma padicValNat_9_eq (n : ℕ) : padicValNat 9 n = padicValNat 3 n / 2
proof:
:=
  padicValNat_pow_left 3 n 2

name: padicValNat_9_factorial_eq
statement:
lemma padicValNat_9_factorial_eq (n : ℕ) :
    padicValNat 9 n.factorial = (n - (Nat.digits 3 n).sum) / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat_9_eq, ← sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial,
    ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul _ 2 2, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ Nat.two_pos]

name: padicValNat_10_factorial_eq'
statement:
lemma padicValNat_10_factorial_eq' (n : ℕ) :
    padicValNat 10 n.factorial = padicValNat 5 n.factorial
proof:
:=
  padicValNat_prime_mul_factorial_of_lt (by norm_num : 2 < 5) n

name: padicValNat_10_factorial_eq
statement:
lemma padicValNat_10_factorial_eq (n : ℕ) :
    padicValNat 10 n.factorial = (n - (Nat.digits 5 n).sum) / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat_10_factorial_eq', ← sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial,
    Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (Nat.succ_pos 3)]

name: Nat_digits_self_pow
statement:
lemma Nat_digits_self_pow {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    ∀ n, b.digits (b ^ n) = List.replicate n 0 ++ [1]
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec ?_ λ n hn ↦ ?_
  · rw [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.digits_of_lt _ _ Nat.one_ne_zero hb]; rfl
  · have hb0 : 0 < b := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb
    rw [Nat.digits_of_two_le_of_pos hb (Nat.pow_pos hb0), Nat.pow_succ,
      Nat.mul_mod_left, Nat.mul_div_left _ hb0, hn]; rfl

name: Nat_ofDigits_replicate_zero
statement: lemma Nat_ofDigits_replicate_zero (b) : ∀ n, Nat.ofDigits b (List.replicate n 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec rfl λ n hn ↦ ?_
  rw [List.replicate_succ, Nat.ofDigits_cons, hn, Nat.mul_zero]

name: Nat_digits_sum_pos
statement: lemma Nat_digits_sum_pos (b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) : 0 < (b.digits n).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne, List.sum_eq_zero_iff]
  intro h0; apply h.ne.symm
  rw [← b.ofDigits_digits n, List.eq_replicate_of_mem h0, Nat_ofDigits_replicate_zero]

name: Nat_digits3_5pow
statement: lemma Nat_digits3_5pow (k : ℕ) : 1 < (Nat.digits 3 (5 ^ (k + 1))).sum
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 < 5 := Nat.succ_pos 4
  rw [Nat.digits_of_two_le_of_pos (Nat.le_succ 2) (Nat.pow_pos h), List.sum_cons]
  refine Nat.add_le_add (Nat.emod_pos_of_not_dvd λ h ↦ ?_) (Nat_digits_sum_pos _ ?_)
  · exact absurd (Nat.prime_three.dvd_of_dvd_pow h) (by decide)
  · refine Nat.div_pos ?_ (Nat.succ_pos 2)
    exact (Nat.le_add_right 3 2).trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.pow_pos h))

name: main_step1
statement:
lemma main_step1 (N : ℕ) :
    padicValNat 9 (5 ^ (N + 1)).factorial < padicValNat 10 (5 ^ (N + 1)).factorial
proof:
:= by
  have h : 1 < 5 := by norm_num
  rw [padicValNat_9_factorial_eq, padicValNat_10_factorial_eq]
  refine Nat.div_lt_div_of_lt_of_dvd ⟨_, (sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial _).symm⟩ ?_
  rw [Nat_digits_self_pow h, List.sum_append, List.sum_replicate]
  exact Nat.sub_lt_sub_left (Nat.one_lt_pow N.succ_ne_zero h) (Nat_digits3_5pow _)

name: final_solution_part1
statement:
theorem final_solution_part1 (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ n > N, padicValNat 9 n.factorial < padicValNat 10 n.factorial
proof:
:=
  ⟨5 ^ (N + 1), N.lt_succ_self.trans (Nat.lt_pow_self (by norm_num)), main_step1 N⟩

name: Nat_digits5_3pow
statement: lemma Nat_digits5_3pow (k : ℕ) : 5 ≤ (Nat.digits 5 (3 ^ (2 * (2 * k + 1)))).sum
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 < 3 := Nat.succ_pos 2
  rw [Nat.digits_of_two_le_of_pos (by norm_num) (Nat.pow_pos h), List.sum_cons, Nat.pow_mul]
  refine Nat.add_le_add (?_ : 4 ≤ _) (?_ : 0 < _)
  · rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow k]
  · refine Nat_digits_sum_pos _ (Nat.div_pos ?_ (Nat.succ_pos 4))
    refine (by norm_num : 5 ≤ 9).trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ ?_)
    exact Nat.pow_pos (Nat.pow_pos h)

name: main_step2
statement:
lemma main_step2 (N : ℕ) :
    padicValNat 10 (3 ^ (2 * (2 * N + 1))).factorial
      < padicValNat 9 (3 ^ (2 * (2 * N + 1))).factorial
proof:
:= by
  have h : 1 < 3 := by norm_num
  rw [padicValNat_9_factorial_eq, padicValNat_10_factorial_eq,
    Nat_digits_self_pow h, List.sum_append, List.sum_replicate,
    ← Nat.add_one_le_iff, ← Nat.add_div_right _ (Nat.succ_pos 3)]
  refine Nat.div_le_div_right (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le (?_ : _ - _ + 5 ≤ _))
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_comm (Nat.digit_sum_le _ _)]
  exact Nat.sub_le_of_le_add (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat_digits5_3pow _) _)

name: final_solution_part2
statement:
theorem final_solution_part2 (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ n > N, padicValNat 10 n.factorial < padicValNat 9 n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨3 ^ (2 * (2 * N + 1)), ?_, main_step2 _⟩; calc
    _ = 9 ^ (2 * N + 1) := Nat.pow_mul 3 2 _
    _ > 2 * N + 1 := Nat.lt_pow_self (by norm_num)
    _ > 2 * N := (2 * N).lt_succ_self
    _ ≥ N := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left N Nat.two_pos

name: y_ineq
statement: lemma y_ineq₁ (hy : 3 ≤ y) : (y + 2) ^ 2 < 3 * y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.succ_mul, add_sq, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right,
    sq, ← Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_lt_mul_left Nat.two_pos, sq]
  apply (Nat.add_le_add_left hy _).trans ((Nat.succ_mul 2 y).ge.trans ?_)
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right y hy

name: y_ineq
statement: lemma y_ineq₂ (hy : 5 ≤ y) : (y + 2) ^ 2 < 2 * y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.two_mul, add_sq, Nat.mul_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left]
  apply (Nat.add_lt_add_left hy _).trans_le
  rw [← Nat.succ_mul, sq]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right y hy

name: y_bound
statement:
lemma y_bound₀ (hn : 0 < n) (hp : 3 ≤ p) (h : 2 * (2 * n + 1) ^ 2 < k * p ^ n) (hy : n ≤ y) :
    2 * (2 * y + 1) ^ 2 < k * p ^ y
proof:
:= by
  induction y, hy using Nat.le_induction with | base => exact h | succ y hy h0 => ?_
  calc 2 * (2 * y + 1 + 2) ^ 2
    _ < 2 * (3 * (2 * y + 1) ^ 2) := ?_
    _ = 3 * (2 * (2 * y + 1) ^ 2) := Nat.mul_left_comm _ _ _
    _ ≤ p * (k * p ^ y) := Nat.mul_le_mul hp h0.le
    _ = k * (p ^ y * p) := mul_rotate' _ _ _
  refine Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (y_ineq₁ ?_) Nat.two_pos
  exact Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (hn.trans_le hy))

name: y_bound
statement: lemma y_bound₁ (hp : 5 ≤ p) (y) : 2 * (2 * y + 1) ^ 2 < (p - 1) * p ^ y
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 3 < p := hp.trans_lt' (by decide)
  rcases y with _ | y
  
  · rwa [p.pow_zero, Nat.mul_one, Nat.lt_sub_iff_add_lt]
  
  · refine y_bound₀ Nat.one_pos hp0.le ?_ y.succ_pos
    rw [p.pow_one]; exact (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.pred_le_pred hp) hp).trans_lt' (by decide)

name: y_bound
statement: lemma y_bound₂ (hy : 10 ≤ y) : 2 * (2 * y + 1) ^ 2 < 2 ^ y
proof:
:= by
  induction y, hy using Nat.le_induction with | base => decide | succ y hy h0 => ?_
  calc 2 * (2 * y + 1 + 2) ^ 2
    _ < 2 * (2 * (2 * y + 1) ^ 2) := ?_
    _ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ y := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h0.le
    _ = 2 ^ (y + 1) := Nat.pow_succ'.symm
  refine Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (y_ineq₂ (Nat.succ_le_succ ?_)) Nat.two_pos
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.le_of_add_right_le (k := 8) hy)

name: good_imp_alt
statement:
lemma good_imp_alt (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h : good a p) :
    ∃ x y, a = x + y ∧ good_alt x y p
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨b, h⟩
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, b = c + a ^ 2 := by
    apply Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le'
    rw [← Nat.mul_self_le_mul_self_iff, ← sq, ← sq, ← Nat.pow_mul, ← h]
    exact Nat.le_add_left _ _
  rw [add_sq, ← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.add_left_inj, sq, Nat.mul_right_comm, ← Nat.add_mul] at h
  obtain ⟨x, ⟨y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ : ∃ x, (∃ y, a = x + y) ∧ c = p ^ x := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ : ∃ x ≤ a, c = p ^ x :=
      (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp).mp (h ▸ c.dvd_mul_left _)
    exact ⟨x, Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hx, rfl⟩
  rw [Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_comm] at h
  exact ⟨x, y, rfl, Nat.mul_right_cancel (Nat.pow_pos hp.pos) h.symm⟩

name: good_alt_imp
statement:
lemma good_alt_imp (hxy : 0 < x + y) (h : good_alt x y p) :
    p = 3 ∧ (x + y = 1 ∨ x + y = 2 ∨ x + y = 6 ∨ x + y = 9)
proof:
:= by
  replace hxy : 1 < 2 * (x + y) ^ 2 := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right 2 (Nat.pow_pos hxy)
  have hp : 1 < p ^ y := h ▸ (hxy.trans_le (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
  match y with | 0 => exact absurd rfl hp.ne | y + 1 => ?_
  replace hp : 1 < p := (Nat.one_lt_pow_iff y.succ_ne_zero).mp hp
  replace hxy : x ≤ y := by
    rw [← Nat.lt_succ_iff, ← Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right hp, ← h, Nat.lt_add_right_iff_pos]
    exact Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hxy
  have h0 : (p - 1) * p ^ y ≤ 2 * (2 * y + 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.one_mul, ← Nat.pow_succ', ← h, Nat.add_comm]
    refine Nat.sub_le_of_le_add (Nat.add_le_add ?_ ?_)
    · rw [y.two_mul, Nat.add_assoc]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right hxy _) 2)
    · exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hp) hxy
  replace hp : 2 = p ∨ 3 = p ∨ 4 = p ∨ 5 ≤ p := by
    simpa only [Nat.succ_le_iff, ← le_iff_eq_or_lt]
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | hp
  
  · replace h0 : y < 10 := Nat.lt_of_not_le λ h1 ↦
      h0.not_gt ((y_bound₂ h1).trans_eq (Nat.one_mul _).symm)
    exfalso; revert x; revert y
    unfold good_alt; decide
  
  · replace h0 : y < 5 := Nat.lt_of_not_le λ h1 ↦
      h0.not_gt (y_bound₀ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) h1)
    revert x; revert y
    unfold good_alt; decide
  
  · replace h0 : y < 3 := Nat.lt_of_not_le λ h1 ↦
      h0.not_gt (y_bound₀ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) h1)
    exfalso; revert x; revert y
    unfold good_alt; decide
  
  · exact absurd (y_bound₁ hp y) h0.not_gt

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {a p : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hp : p.Prime) :
    good a p ↔ p = 3 ∧ (a = 1 ∨ a = 2 ∨ a = 6 ∨ a = 9)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · obtain ⟨x, y, rfl, h0⟩ : ∃ x y, a = x + y ∧ good_alt x y p := good_imp_alt hp h
    exact good_alt_imp ha h0
  
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl⟩
    exacts [⟨2, rfl⟩, ⟨5, rfl⟩, ⟨45, rfl⟩, ⟨162, rfl⟩]

name: b_zero
statement: lemma b_zero : X.b 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [b, sum_range_zero, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_div]

name: b_spec
statement: lemma b_spec (k) : X.b k * X.a k = 2 * ∑ i ∈ range k, X.a i
proof:
:=
  Nat.div_mul_cancel (X.a_spec k)

name: b_succ_pos
statement: lemma b_succ_pos (k) : 0 < X.b (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_right (b := X.a (k + 1))
  rw [X.b_spec, sum_range_succ]
  exact Nat.mul_pos Nat.two_pos (Nat.add_pos_right _ (X.a_pos k))

name: b_formula
statement: lemma b_formula (k) : X.b (k + 1) * X.a (k + 1) = (X.b k + 2) * X.a k
proof:
:= by
  rw [X.b_spec, Nat.add_mul, X.b_spec, sum_range_succ, Nat.mul_add]

name: b_succ_le
statement: lemma b_succ_le (k) : X.b (k + 1) ≤ X.b k + 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_of_lt_succ <| Nat.lt_of_not_le λ h ↦ (X.b_formula k).not_gt <|
    Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt h (X.a_strictMono k.lt_succ_self) (X.b_succ_pos k)

name: b_not_bdd
statement: lemma b_not_bdd (M) : ∃ k, M ≤ X.b k
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h; simp only [not_exists, not_le] at h
  obtain ⟨p, ha0p, hMp, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, X.a 0 < p ∧ M + 2 ≤ p ∧ p.Prime := by
    obtain ⟨p, h0, hp⟩ := (max (X.a 0).succ (M + 2)).exists_infinite_primes
    exact ⟨p, le_of_max_le_left h0, le_of_max_le_right h0, hp⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, p ∣ X.a k := X.exists_dvd_a_of_prime p hp
  revert ha0p; refine (Nat.le_of_dvd (X.a_pos 0) ?_).not_gt
  
  refine Nat.decreasingInduction (λ k _ hk ↦ ?_) hk k.zero_le
  have h0 : p ∣ X.b k + 2 ∨ p ∣ X.a k := hp.dvd_mul.mp (X.b_formula _ ▸ hk.mul_left _)
  refine h0.resolve_left (Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.succ_pos _) ?_)
  exact (Nat.add_lt_add_right (h k) 2).trans_le hMp

name: exists_dvd_a_of_pos
statement: lemma exists_dvd_a_of_pos (hN : 0 < N) : ∃ k, N ∣ X.a k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hk0⟩ : ∃ k, X.b (k + 1) = N ∧ X.b k + 1 = N := by
    have h : ∃ k, N ≤ X.b k := X.b_not_bdd N
    have h0 := Nat.find_spec h
    obtain ⟨k, h1⟩ : ∃ k, Nat.find h = k + 1 :=
      Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero λ h1 ↦ h0.not_gt (h1 ▸ X.b_zero.trans_lt hN)
    have h2 := Nat.lt_of_not_le (Nat.find_min h (k.lt_succ_self.trans_eq h1.symm))
    have h3 : X.b (k + 1) ≤ X.b k + 1 := X.b_succ_le k
    replace h0 : X.b (k + 1) = N := Nat.le_antisymm (h3.trans h2) (h1 ▸ h0)
    exact ⟨k, h0, Nat.le_antisymm h2 (h3.trans_eq' h0)⟩
  refine ⟨k, (Nat.dvd_add_right ⟨X.a k, rfl⟩).mp ⟨X.a (k + 1), ?_⟩⟩
  calc _ = (X.b k + 1 + 1) * X.a k := by rw [hk0, Nat.succ_mul]
       _ = _ := by rw [← X.b_formula, hk]

name: sum_offDiag_eq'
statement:
theorem sum_offDiag_eq' [AddCommMonoid M] [DecidableEq ι] (a : ι × ι → M) (S : Finset ι) :
    S.sum (λ i ↦ a (i, i)) + S.offDiag.sum a = (S ×ˢ S).sum a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← S.sum_diag, ← sum_disjUnion S.disjoint_diag_offDiag,
    ← diag_union_offDiag, disjUnion_eq_union]

name: sum_offDiag_eq
statement:
theorem sum_offDiag_eq [AddCommGroup G] [DecidableEq ι] (a : ι × ι → G) (S : Finset ι) :
    S.offDiag.sum a = (S ×ˢ S).sum a - S.sum (λ i ↦ a (i, i))
proof:
:=
  eq_sub_of_add_eq' (sum_offDiag_eq' a S)

name: orderedPair_sum_eq_offDiag
statement:
theorem orderedPair_sum_eq_offDiag (a : ι × ι → M) :
    ((S ×ˢ S).filter λ p ↦ p.1 < p.2).sum a + ((S ×ˢ S).filter λ p ↦ p.2 < p.1).sum a
      = S.offDiag.sum a
proof:
:= by
  have h : Disjoint ((S ×ˢ S).filter λ p ↦ p.1 < p.2) ((S ×ˢ S).filter λ p ↦ p.2 < p.1) :=
    disjoint_left.mpr λ p h h0 ↦ (mem_filter.mp h).2.asymm (mem_filter.mp h0).2
  rw [← sum_disjUnion h]; refine sum_congr ?_ λ _ _ ↦ rfl
  
  ext x; rw [mem_offDiag, disjUnion_eq_union, ← filter_or,
    mem_filter, lt_or_lt_iff_ne, mem_product, and_assoc]

name: orderedPair_symm_sum
statement:
theorem orderedPair_symm_sum {a : ι × ι → M} (ha : ∀ p, a p.swap = a p) :
    ((S ×ˢ S).filter λ p ↦ p.1 < p.2).sum a = ((S ×ˢ S).filter λ p ↦ p.2 < p.1).sum a
proof:
:= by
  refine sum_bijective Prod.swap Prod.swap_bijective (λ p ↦ ?_) (λ p _ ↦ (ha p).symm)
  rw [mem_filter, mem_filter, mem_product, mem_product]
  exact and_congr_left' and_comm

name: orderedPair_sum_eq_offDiag_of_symm
statement:
theorem orderedPair_sum_eq_offDiag_of_symm {a : ι × ι → M} (ha : ∀ p, a p.swap = a p) :
    2 • ((S ×ˢ S).filter λ p ↦ p.1 < p.2).sum a = S.offDiag.sum a
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_nsmul, ← orderedPair_sum_eq_offDiag, orderedPair_symm_sum S ha]

name: field_id1
statement: theorem field_id1 (x y : F) : 2 ^ 2 * (x * y / (x + y)) = x + y - (x - y) ^ 2 / (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : x + y = 0
  · rw [h, div_zero, div_zero, sub_zero, mul_zero]
  · rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_eq_iff h, sub_mul, ← sq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h,
      add_sq', sub_sq', add_sub_sub_cancel, mul_assoc, ← add_mul, ← two_mul, sq]

name: field_id2
statement: theorem field_id2 : S.offDiag.sum (λ p ↦ a p.1 + a p.2) = 2 * ((S.card - 1) * S.sum a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_offDiag_eq, sum_offDiag_eq, sum_product, sum_product]
  simp only [sum_const]; rw [sum_nsmul, ← two_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, sub_one_mul]

name: field_id3
statement:
theorem field_id3 :
    2 ^ 2 * S.offDiag.sum (λ p ↦ a p.1 * a p.2 / (a p.1 + a p.2))
      = 2 * ((S.card - 1) * S.sum a)
        - S.offDiag.sum (λ p ↦ (a p.1 - a p.2) ^ 2 / (a p.1 + a p.2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_sum]; simp only [field_id1]
  rw [sum_sub_distrib, field_id2]

name: field_id4
statement:
theorem field_id4 :
    S.offDiag.sum (λ p ↦ (a p.1 - a p.2) ^ 2)
      = 2 * (S.card • S.sum λ i ↦ a i ^ 2) - 2 * S.sum a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_offDiag_eq, sum_product]
  simp only [sub_self, sub_sq', sum_sub_distrib, sum_add_distrib, sum_const]
  rw [zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), nsmul_zero, sub_zero, sum_nsmul, ← two_mul]
  simp only [← mul_sum]; rw [← sum_mul, ← mul_sum, mul_assoc, sq]

name: field_id5
statement:
theorem field_id5 :
    S.offDiag.sum (λ p ↦ a p.1 * a p.2) = S.sum a ^ 2 - S.sum (λ i ↦ a i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_offDiag_eq, sum_product]
  simp only [← mul_sum, sq]; rw [sum_mul]

name: unordered_index_version
statement:
theorem unordered_index_version [Field F] [LinearOrder F] [IsStrictOrderedRing F]
    [DecidableEq ι] (a : ι → F) {S : Finset ι} (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, 0 < a i) :
    S.offDiag.sum (λ p ↦ a p.1 * a p.2 / (a p.1 + a p.2))
      ≤ S.card • S.offDiag.sum (λ p ↦ a p.1 * a p.2) / (2 * S.sum a)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain (rfl | hS0) : S = ∅ ∨ S.Nonempty := eq_empty_or_nonempty S
  · rw [offDiag_empty, sum_empty, card_empty, zero_nsmul, zero_div]
  
  have h : (0 : F) < 2 := two_pos
  rw [le_div_iff₀' (mul_pos two_pos (sum_pos hS hS0)), ← mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ h,
    mul_right_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← sq, field_id3, sub_one_mul,
    mul_sub, sub_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← sq, ← nsmul_eq_mul,
    field_id5, nsmul_sub, mul_sub, sub_le_sub_iff_left, add_mul,
    ← sub_le_iff_le_add', mul_assoc, ← sq, ← field_id4, sum_mul]
  refine sum_le_sum λ (i, j) h0 ↦ ?_
  
  rw [mem_offDiag] at h0; rcases h0 with ⟨hi, hj, h⟩
  rw [← mul_div_right_comm, le_div_iff₀ (add_pos (hS i hi) (hS j hj))]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_sum (λ k hk ↦ (hS k hk).le) hi hj h) (sq_nonneg _)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [Field F] [LinearOrder F] [IsStrictOrderedRing F]
    [LinearOrder ι] (a : ι → F) {S : Finset ι} (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, 0 < a i) :
    let T
proof:
:= (S ×ˢ S).filter λ p ↦ p.1 < p.2
    T.sum (λ p ↦ a p.1 * a p.2 / (a p.1 + a p.2))
      ≤ S.card • T.sum (λ p ↦ a p.1 * a p.2) / (2 * S.sum a) := by
  apply le_of_nsmul_le_nsmul_right (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
  have h (i j) : a i * a j / (a i + a j) = a j * a i / (a j + a i) := by
    rw [add_comm, mul_comm]
  have h0 (i j) : a i * a j = a j * a i := mul_comm _ _
  rw [orderedPair_sum_eq_offDiag_of_symm _ (λ _ ↦ h _ _), nsmul_eq_mul,
    nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_div_assoc, mul_left_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul,
    ← nsmul_eq_mul, orderedPair_sum_eq_offDiag_of_symm _ (λ _ ↦ h0 _ _)]
  exact unordered_index_version a hS

name: sq_eq_two_pow_mul_add_one_imp
statement:
lemma sq_eq_two_pow_mul_add_one_imp {a : ℤ} (h : 2 ^ (k + 1) ∣ a ^ 2 - 1) :
    2 ^ k ∣ a - 1 ∨ 2 ^ k ∣ a + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : Odd a := by
    rw [← Int.odd_pow' (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), ← Int.not_even_iff_odd,
      ← Int.even_sub_one, even_iff_two_dvd]
    exact dvd_of_mul_left_dvd (a := 2 ^ k) h
  rw [← one_pow (M := ℤ) 2, sq_sub_sq] at h
  refine (Int.four_dvd_add_or_sub_of_odd h0 odd_one).symm.imp (λ h1 ↦ ?_) (λ h1 ↦ ?_)
  
  · rcases h1 with ⟨b, h1⟩
    replace h1 : a + 1 = 2 * 2 * b + 2 := h1 ▸ (sub_add_add_cancel a 1 1).symm
    rw [h1, mul_assoc 2 2 b, ← mul_add_one 2 (2 * b), pow_succ', mul_assoc] at h
    exact (IsCoprime.mul_add_left_right isCoprime_one_right b).pow_left.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left
      (Int.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left (OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero 2) h)
  
  · rcases h1 with ⟨b, h1⟩
    replace h1 : a - 1 = 2 * 2 * b - 2 := h1 ▸ (add_sub_add_right_eq_sub a 1 1).symm
    rw [h1, mul_assoc 2 2 b, ← mul_sub_one, pow_succ', mul_left_comm, sub_eq_add_neg] at h
    refine (IsCoprime.mul_add_left_right ?_ b).pow_left.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
      (Int.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left (OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero 2) h)
    rw [IsCoprime.neg_right_iff]; exact isCoprime_one_right

name: good_zero_iff
statement: lemma good_zero_iff : good 0 y ↔ y = 2 ∨ y = -2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg, eq_comm]; rfl

name: good_four_iff
statement: lemma good_four_iff : good 4 y ↔ y = 23 ∨ y = -23
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg, eq_comm]; rfl

name: good_neg_right
statement: lemma good_neg_right (h : good x y) : good x (-y)
proof: := h.trans (neg_sq y).symm

name: good_succ_imp_three
statement: lemma good_succ_imp_three (h : good (x + 1) y) : x = 3
proof:
:= by
  wlog hy : 0 ≤ y
  · refine this (good_neg_right h) (neg_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_not_ge hy))
  rw [good, two_mul, (x + 1).add_right_comm, pow_add, ← add_one_mul] at h
  rcases x with _ | x
  
  · replace h : Int.sqrt 11 * Int.sqrt 11 = 11 :=
      (Int.exists_mul_self 11).mp ⟨y, (sq y).symm.trans h.symm⟩
    exact absurd h (by norm_num)
  
  have X : (0 : ℤ) < 2 := by decide
  have X0 : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := X.ne.symm
  obtain h0 | h0 : 2 ^ (x + 1) ∣ y - 1 ∨ 2 ^ (x + 1) ∣ y + 1 := by
    apply sq_eq_two_pow_mul_add_one_imp
    rw [← h, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact Int.dvd_mul_left _ _
  
  · rcases h0 with ⟨m, h0⟩; rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at h0; subst h0
    rw [add_sq, one_pow, add_left_inj, mul_one, sq, ← add_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
      pow_succ, mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, or_iff_left (pow_ne_zero _ X0), pow_succ' 2 x,
      mul_assoc, ← mul_add_one (2 : ℤ), mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, or_iff_left X0] at h
    replace hy : 0 ≤ m := by
      rw [← Int.lt_add_one_iff, add_assoc, pow_succ', mul_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two,
        ← mul_add_one (2 : ℤ), mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left X, Int.lt_add_one_iff] at hy
      exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right hy (pow_pos X x)
    change 2 ^ (x + 3) + 1 = _ at h
    
    iterate 3 rw [le_iff_eq_or_lt, ← Int.add_one_le_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | (rfl : 1 = m) | (rfl : 2 = m) | (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    · apply h.not_gt.elim
      rw [mul_zero, Int.lt_add_one_iff]
      exact pow_nonneg X.le (x + 3)
    · apply h.not_gt.elim
      rw [mul_one, mul_one, add_lt_add_iff_right]
      exact pow_right_strictMono₀ one_lt_two (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (Nat.succ_pos 2))
    · rw [pow_succ, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq', ← sub_mul, mul_comm] at h
      refine absurd ⟨_, h⟩ (?_ : ¬(2 : ℤ) ∣ 1)
      exact Int.two_dvd_ne_zero.mpr rfl
    · apply h.not_lt.elim
      rw [← Int.add_one_le_iff, add_assoc, pow_add, add_one_mul _ m, mul_assoc, ← sq]
      refine add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (pow_nonneg X.le x)) ?_
      · have h0 : (2 : ℤ) ^ 3 ≤ 3 ^ 2 := Int.le_add_one (Int.le_refl 8)
        have h1 : 0 ≤ (3 : ℤ) := Int.sign_nonneg_iff.mp Int.one_nonneg
        exact h0.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ h1 hm 2)
      · exact (Int.lt_of_add_one_le (a := 2) hm).le
  
  · rcases h0 with ⟨m, h0⟩; rw [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at h0; subst h0
    rw [Int.le_sub_one_iff, mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (pow_pos X _)] at hy
    replace h : 2 ^ x * (m ^ 2 - 2 ^ 3) = m + 1 := by
      rw [sub_sq, one_pow, add_left_inj, mul_one, sq, ← sub_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
        pow_succ, mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, or_iff_left (pow_ne_zero _ X0),
        pow_succ' 2 x, mul_assoc, ← mul_sub_one, mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_left_iff,
        or_iff_left X0, sub_one_mul, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, sub_sub] at h
      change 2 ^ (x + 3) = 2 ^ x * m * m - (m + 1) at h
      rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq', mul_assoc, ← sq, pow_add, ← mul_sub] at h
      exact h.symm
    obtain rfl : m = 3 := by
      refine ((lt_trichotomy m 3).resolve_left λ h0 ↦ ?_).resolve_right λ h0 ↦ ?_
      
      · refine (((add_pos hy one_pos).trans' (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (pow_pos X x) ?_))).ne h
        change m < 2 + 1 at h0
        have h1 : (2 ^ 2 : ℤ) < 8 := Batteries.compareOfLessAndEq_eq_lt.mp rfl
        have h2 : m ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hy.le (Int.le_of_lt_add_one h0) 2
        exact sub_neg_of_lt (h2.trans_lt h1)
      
      · replace h : m ^ 2 - 2 ^ 3 ∣ m + 1 := Dvd.intro_left (2 ^ x) h
        refine (Int.le_of_dvd (add_pos hy one_pos) h).not_gt ?_
        rw [lt_sub_iff_add_lt, add_assoc, sq]
        apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Int.add_one_le_of_lt h0) hy.le).trans_lt'
        rw [add_comm 3, mul_one_add m, add_lt_add_iff_left]
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h0 three_pos
    change 2 ^ x * 1 = (2 ^ 2 : ℤ) at h
    rw [Int.mul_one, pow_right_inj₀ X (OfNat.one_ne_ofNat 2).symm] at h
    exact congrArg Nat.succ h

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    good x y ↔ (x = 0 ∧ (y = 2 ∨ y = -2)) ∨ (x = 4 ∧ (y = 23 ∨ y = -23))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← good_zero_iff, ← good_four_iff]
  rcases x with _ | x
  · rw [or_iff_left λ h ↦ h.1.not_lt (Nat.succ_pos 3), and_iff_right rfl]
  · rw [or_iff_right λ h ↦ h.1.not_gt x.succ_pos, Nat.succ_inj]
    refine ⟨λ h ↦ (and_iff_left_of_imp ?_).mpr (good_succ_imp_three h), λ ⟨h, h0⟩ ↦ h ▸ h0⟩
    rintro rfl; exact h

name: ring_id1
statement:
theorem ring_id1 [CommRing R] (a b c : R) :
    a * b * (a ^ 2 - b ^ 2) + b * c * (b ^ 2 - c ^ 2) + c * a * (c ^ 2 - a ^ 2)
      = (b - a) * (c - b) * (a - c) * (a + b + c)
proof: := by ring

name: ring_id2
statement:
theorem ring_id2 [CommRing R] (a b c : R) :
    (b - a) ^ 2 + (c - b) ^ 2 + (a - c) ^ 2 + (a + b + c) ^ 2
      = 3 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
proof: := by ring

name: good_alt
statement:
theorem good_alt {M : R} :
    good M ↔ ∀ a b c, 3 ^ 2 * |(b - a) * (c - b) * (a - c) * (a + b + c)|
      ≤ M * ((b - a) ^ 2 + (c - b) ^ 2 + (a - c) ^ 2 + (a + b + c) ^ 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine forall₃_congr λ a b c ↦ ?_
  rw [ring_id1, ring_id2, mul_pow, mul_left_comm]
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (pow_pos zero_lt_three 2)).symm

name: ring_ineq1
statement: theorem ring_ineq1 (r t : R) : 2 ^ 8 * (r ^ 3 * t) ≤ 3 ^ 3 * (r + t) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_sub_nonneg; calc
    0 ≤ (r - 3 * t) ^ 2 * ((5 * r + t) ^ 2 + 2 * (r + t) ^ 2) :=
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) <| add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) <|
        mul_nonneg zero_le_two (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: ring_ineq2
statement:
theorem ring_ineq2 {x y z : R} (h : x + y + z = 0) :
    2 * 3 ^ 3 * (x * y * z) ^ 2 ≤ (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + z ^ 2) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_sub_nonneg; calc
    0 ≤ 2 * ((x - y) * (x + 2 * y) * (2 * x + y)) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg zero_le_two (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + (-(x + y)) ^ 2) ^ 3 - 2 * 3 ^ 3 * (x * y * -(x + y)) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h]

name: ring_ineq3
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (pow_pos zero_lt_three 3)
  rw [mul_left_comm, pow_succ, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc 2, mul_pow, ← mul_assoc (2 * _)]
  refine (ring_ineq1 _ _).trans' <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ring_ineq2 ?_) (sq_nonneg _)) (pow_nonneg zero_le_two 8)
  rw [sub_add_sub_cancel', sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_self]

name: good_lower_bound
statement: theorem good_lower_bound (hM : 3 ^ 2 * √2 ≤ 2 ^ 5 * M) : good M
proof:
:= by
  refine good_alt.mpr λ a b c ↦ ?_
  have h : (0 : R) < 2 := two_pos
  rw [← mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left (pow_pos h 5), mul_left_comm, ← mul_assoc _ M]
  apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM (sq_nonneg _)).trans'
  rw [mul_assoc (3 ^ 2), mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left (pow_pos zero_lt_three 2),
    ← abs_of_nonneg h.le, ← abs_of_nonneg (sqrt2_nonneg (R := R)), pow_abs,
    ← abs_mul, ← abs_sq, ← abs_mul, ← sq_le_sq, mul_pow, mul_pow √2, sqrt2_sq,
    ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ring_ineq3 a b c) h.le

name: good_upper_bound
statement: theorem good_upper_bound (hM : good M) : 9 * √2 ≤ 32 * M
proof:
:= by
  specialize hM (√2 - 3) (√2 + 3) √2
  rw [ring_id1, add_sub_sub_cancel, sub_add_cancel_left, sub_sub_cancel_left, ← two_mul,
    mul_assoc (2 * 3), ← sq, neg_sq, sub_add_add_cancel, ← two_mul, ← add_one_mul (2 : R),
    sub_sq', add_sq' √2, sub_add_add_cancel, sqrt2_sq, ← mul_assoc, abs_mul] at hM
  have h : |2 * 3 * 3 ^ 2 * (2 + 1)| = (18 * 9 : R) := by norm_num
  have h0 : (2 + 3 ^ 2 + (2 + 3 ^ 2) + 2) ^ 2 = (18 * 32 : R) := by norm_num
  rw [h, h0, mul_comm M, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, abs_of_nonneg sqrt2_nonneg] at hM
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hM (by norm_num)

name: good_iff
statement: theorem good_iff : good M ↔ 9 * √2 ≤ 32 * M
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨good_upper_bound, ?_⟩
  have h : (9 : R) = 3 ^ 2 := by norm_num
  have h0 : (32 : R) = 2 ^ 5 := by norm_num
  rw [h, h0]; exact good_lower_bound

name: ring_id1
statement:
theorem ring_id1 [CommRing R] {a b c : R} (h : a * b * c = (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1)) :
    a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 - 1 = (a + b + c - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= calc
  _ = (a + b + c - 1) ^ 2 - 2 * (a * b * c - (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1)) := by ring
  _ = _ := by rw [sub_eq_zero_of_eq h, mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: field_eq1
statement: theorem field_eq1 [Field F] {x : F} (h : x ≠ 1) : x / (x - 1) - 1 = 1 / (x - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_sub_one (sub_ne_zero_of_ne h), sub_sub_cancel]

name: field_eq2
proof:
:= by
  rw [field_eq1 hx, field_eq1 hy, field_eq1 hz, div_mul_div_comm,
    div_mul_div_comm, h, ← one_div_mul_one_div, ← one_div_mul_one_div]

name: ring_ineq1
statement:
theorem ring_ineq1 [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R]
    {a b c : R} (h : a * b * c = (a - 1) * (b - 1) * (c - 1)) :
    1 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_nonneg, ring_id1 h]; exact sq_nonneg _

name: final_solution_part1
statement:
theorem final_solution_part1 [Field F] [LinearOrder F] [IsOrderedRing F]
    {x y z : F} (hx : x ≠ 1) (hy : y ≠ 1) (hz : z ≠ 1) (h : x * y * z = 1) :
    1 ≤ (x / (x - 1)) ^ 2 + (y / (y - 1)) ^ 2 + (z / (z - 1)) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  ring_ineq1 (field_eq2 hx hy hz h)

name: ring_id2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ring_id1 h, h0, sub_self, sq_eq_zero_iff]

name: field_eq3
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_div, neg_mul, neg_mul_neg, div_mul_div_comm,
    ← mul_pow, mul_comm (t + 1), ← mul_div_right_comm, ← sq]
  exact div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 (mul_ne_zero h h0))

name: field_eq4
statement:
theorem field_eq4 [Field F] (a) {b : F} (h : b ≠ 0) :
    a / b / (a / b - 1) = a / (a - b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_div, mul_sub_one, mul_div_cancel₀ a h]

name: field_eq5
statement:
theorem field_eq5 [Field F] {t : F} (h : t ≠ 0) (h0 : t + 1 ≠ 0) (h1 : t * (t + 1) + 1 ≠ 0) :
    let x
proof:
:= -(t + 1) / t ^ 2
    let y := t / (t + 1) ^ 2
    let z := -(t * (t + 1))
    x / (x - 1) + y / (y - 1) + z / (z - 1) = 1 := by
  dsimp only; rw [field_eq4 _ (pow_ne_zero 2 h), field_eq4 _ (pow_ne_zero 2 h0)]
  have h2 : -(t + 1) - t ^ 2 = -(t * (t + 1) + 1) := by ring
  have h3 : t - (t + 1) ^ 2 = -(t * (t + 1) + 1) := by ring
  rw [h2, neg_div_neg_eq, h3, div_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_add',
    neg_div_neg_eq, ← sub_div, ← add_div, add_sub_cancel_left, add_comm]
  exact div_self h1

name: field_ineq1
statement: theorem field_ineq1 : -(t + 1) / t ^ 2 ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  div_ne_one_of_ne ((neg_lt_zero.mpr (add_pos h one_pos)).trans (pow_pos h 2)).ne

name: field_ineq2
statement: theorem field_ineq2 : t / (t + 1) ^ 2 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine div_ne_one_of_ne ((lt_add_of_pos_left t h).trans ?_).ne
  rw [add_sq', mul_one, two_mul, one_pow, lt_add_iff_pos_left]
  exact add_pos (pow_pos h 2) one_pos

name: field_ineq3
statement: theorem field_ineq3 : -(t * (t + 1)) ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  ((neg_lt_zero.mpr (mul_pos h (add_pos h one_pos))).trans one_pos).ne

name: field_eq6
statement:
theorem field_eq6 :
    let x
proof:
:= -(t + 1) / t ^ 2
    let y := t / (t + 1) ^ 2
    let z := -(t * (t + 1))
    (x / (x - 1)) ^ 2 + (y / (y - 1)) ^ 2 + (z / (z - 1)) ^ 2 = 1 := by
  have h' : t ≠ 0 := h.ne.symm
  have h0 : 0 < t + 1 := add_pos h one_pos
  have h0' : t + 1 ≠ 0 := h0.ne.symm
  exact ring_id2
    (field_eq2 (field_ineq1 h) (field_ineq2 h) (field_ineq3 h) (field_eq3 h' h0'))
    (field_eq5 h' h0' (add_pos (mul_pos h h0) one_pos).ne.symm)

name: ratMapSol_prod2_strictAnti
statement: theorem ratMapSol_prod2_strictAnti : StrictAnti (λ k ↦ ratMapSol k 2)
proof:
:= λ k m h ↦ by
  unfold ratMapSol; simp only
  rw [neg_lt_neg_iff, ← Nat.cast_succ, ← Nat.cast_succ,
    ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_lt]

name: ineq1
statement: lemma ineq1 : (4 * a) ^ 4 / (a * b * c * d) ≤ (2 * (a / b) + (b / c + a / d)) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  
  calc (4 * a) ^ 4 / (a * b * c * d)
    _ = (4 * (2 * (a / b))) ^ 2 * (4 * (b / c) * (a / d)) := ?_
    _ ≤ (4 * (2 * (a / b))) ^ 2 * (b / c + a / d) ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (four_mul_le_sq_add _ _) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = (4 * (2 * (a / b)) * (b / c + a / d)) ^ 2 := by rw [← mul_pow, mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ ((2 * (a / b) + (b / c + a / d)) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      have X {u v : F} (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) : 0 ≤ u / v := (div_pos hu hv).le
      refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg ?_ ?_) (four_mul_le_sq_add _ _) 2
      · exact mul_nonneg zero_le_four (mul_nonneg zero_le_two (X ha hb))
      · exact add_nonneg (X hb hc) (X ha hd)
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul]
  
  calc
    _ = 4 ^ 4 * (a ^ 3 / (b * c * d)) := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_div_assoc, pow_succ' a, mul_assoc a,
        mul_assoc a, mul_div_mul_left _ _ ha.ne.symm]
    _ = 4 ^ 4 * (a / b * (a / c) * (a / d)) := by
      rw [div_mul_div_comm, div_mul_div_comm, ← sq, ← pow_succ]
    _ = 4 ^ 4 * ((a / b) ^ 2 * ((b / c) * (a / d))) := by
      rw [sq, mul_mul_mul_comm, div_mul_div_cancel₀ hb.ne.symm,
        mul_left_comm (a / c), mul_assoc]
    _ = 4 ^ 2 * ((2 * (a / b)) ^ 2 * (4 * (b / c) * (a / d))) := by
      have X : (2 : F) ^ 2 = 4 := by rw [sq, two_mul, two_add_two_eq_four]
      rw [mul_pow, mul_assoc 4, mul_mul_mul_comm, X, ← sq, ← mul_assoc (4 ^ 2), ← pow_add]
    _ = (4 * (2 * (a / b))) ^ 2 * (4 * (b / c) * (a / d)) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]

name: ineq2
statement: lemma ineq2 : 4 * a ≤ 2 * (a / b) + (b / c + a / d)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := ineq1 ha hb hc hd
  rw [h, div_one] at h0
  refine le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.succ_ne_zero 3) ?_ h0
  exact (add_pos (mul_pos two_pos (div_pos ha hb))
    (add_pos (div_pos hb hc) (div_pos ha hd))).le

name: main_ineq
statement:
lemma main_ineq : 4 * (a + b + c + d) ≤
    3 * (a / b + b / c + c / d + d / a) + (b / a + c / b + d / c + a / d)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = 4 * a + 4 * b + 4 * c + 4 * d := by rw [mul_add, mul_add, mul_add]
  _ ≤ (2 * (a / b) + (b / c + a / d)) + (2 * (b / c) + (c / d + b / a))
      + (2 * (c / d) + (d / a + c / b)) + (2 * (d / a) + (a / b + d / c)) := by
    refine add_le_add (add_le_add_three ?_ ?_ ?_) ?_
    all_goals apply ineq2 <;> try assumption
    · rw [mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, h]
    · rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, h]
    · rw [mul_rotate d, mul_right_comm, h]
  _ = _ := by
    rw [add_add_add_comm (2 * _), ← mul_add, add_add_add_comm (2 * _),
      ← mul_add, add_add_add_comm (2 * _), ← mul_add, add_add_add_comm (b / c),
      add_add_add_comm (b / c + c / d), add_add_add_comm (_ + _ + _),
      ← two_add_one_eq_three, add_one_mul, add_assoc (2 * _), add_right_inj]
    refine congrArg₂ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [add_comm, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc]
    · rw [add_rotate (a / d), add_right_comm]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (h0 : a / b + b / c + c / d + d / a < a + b + c + d) :
    a + b + c + d < b / a + c / b + d / c + a / d
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_not_ge λ h1 ↦ (main_ineq ha hb hc hd h).not_gt ?_
  rw [← three_add_one_eq_four, add_one_mul]
  exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h0 three_pos) h1

name: side_ineq
statement:
theorem side_ineq [ExistsAddOfLE R] {x y : R} (h : (x ^ 2 + 1) * y = (y ^ 2 + 1) * x) :
    x = y ∨ y * x = 1
proof:
:= by
  wlog h0 : ∃ c, y = x + c
  · rw [eq_comm, mul_comm]; apply this h.symm
    exact exists_add_of_le ((le_total x y).resolve_left (mt exists_add_of_le h0))
  
  rw [sq, sq, add_one_mul _ y, add_one_mul _ x, mul_rotate, mul_assoc, mul_assoc] at h
  rcases h0 with ⟨c, rfl⟩
  rw [add_mul x c (_ * x), add_assoc, add_right_inj, add_comm, add_left_inj, eq_comm] at h
  rw [left_eq_add, or_comm, add_comm]
  generalize (c + x) * x = y at h ⊢
  
  obtain ⟨d, h0⟩ | ⟨d, rfl⟩ : (∃ d, 1 = y + d) ∨ (∃ d, y = 1 + d) :=
    (le_total y 1).imp exists_add_of_le exists_add_of_le
  · rw [h0, left_eq_add, ← mul_eq_zero, mul_comm,
      ← add_eq_left, ← mul_add, ← h0, h, mul_one]
  · rw [mul_one_add c, add_eq_left, mul_eq_zero] at h
    rwa [add_eq_left, or_comm]

name: weakGood_iff
statement:
theorem weakGood_iff [ExistsAddOfLE R] {f : R → R} :
    weakGood f ↔ (∀ x > 0, f x = x) ∨ (∀ x > 0, x * f x = 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hf ↦ ?_, λ hf ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · have two_pos : (0 : R) < 2 := two_pos
    have h {x} (hx : 0 < x) : f (x ^ 2) = f x ^ 2 := by
      have h := hf.good' x hx x hx x hx x hx rfl
      rwa [mul_comm, ← two_mul, mul_left_cancel_iff_of_pos (mul_pos two_pos (pow_pos hx 2)),
        ← two_mul, ← two_mul, mul_left_cancel_iff_of_pos two_pos, eq_comm] at h
    have h0 : f 1 = 1 := by
      have X : (0 : R) < 1 := one_pos
      have h0 := h X; rw [← one_mul (f (1 ^ 2)), one_pow, sq] at h0
      exact (mul_right_cancel₀ (hf.map_pos_of_pos _ X).ne.symm h0).symm
    have h1 {x y} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
        (f x ^ 4 + f y ^ 4) * (x * y) ^ 2 = (x ^ 4 + y ^ 4) * f (x * y) ^ 2 := by
      have X : 0 < x * y := mul_pos hx hy
      have h1 := hf.good' _ (mul_pos hx hx) _ (mul_pos hy hy)
        _ X _ X (mul_mul_mul_comm x x y y)
      rwa [← mul_two, ← mul_two, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← sq, ← sq, h hx, h hy, ← pow_mul,
        ← pow_mul, mul_right_cancel_iff_of_pos two_pos, h X, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul] at h1
    have h2 {x} (hx : 0 < x) : f x = x ∨ x * f x = 1 := by
      specialize h1 hx one_pos
      rw [h0, one_pow, mul_one, pow_mul _ 2 2, pow_mul _ 2 2] at h1
      have hfx : 0 < f x := hf.map_pos_of_pos x hx
      refine (side_ineq h1).imp (sq_eq_sq₀ hfx.le hx.le).mp λ h2 ↦ ?_
      rwa [← mul_pow, pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (mul_pos hx hfx).le (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at h2
    have h3 {x y} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hx' : x * f x ≠ 1) : f y = y := by
      specialize h1 hx hy
      have hx0 : f x = x := (h2 hx).resolve_right hx'
      have hxy : 0 < x * y := mul_pos hx hy
      refine (h2 hy).elim id λ hy0 ↦ (h2 hxy).elim (λ h3 ↦ ?_) (λ h3 ↦ ?_)
      
      · rw [h3, mul_right_cancel_iff_of_pos (pow_pos hxy 2), hx0, add_right_inj] at h1
        exact (pow_left_inj₀ (hf.map_pos_of_pos y hy).le hy.le four_ne_zero).mp h1
      
      · have hx'' : 0 < x * f x := mul_pos hx (hf.map_pos_of_pos x hx)
        rw [← mul_right_cancel_iff_of_pos (pow_pos hxy 2), mul_assoc, ← pow_add, mul_assoc,
          mul_comm (f _ ^ 2), ← mul_pow, h3, one_pow, mul_one, add_mul, ← mul_pow, ← mul_pow,
          ← mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm (f y), hy0, mul_one, add_comm, add_right_inj,
          mul_comm (f x), pow_left_inj₀ (mul_pos hx'' hy).le hy.le four_ne_zero] at h1
        refine absurd ?_ hx'; rwa [← mul_right_cancel_iff_of_pos hy, one_mul]
    refine (em' (∀ x > 0, x * f x = 1)).imp_left λ h4 ↦ ?_
    simp only [not_forall] at h4; rcases h4 with ⟨c, hc, h4⟩
    intro x hx; exact h3 hc hx h4
  
  · rcases hf with hf | hf
    
    · refine ⟨λ x hx ↦ hx.trans_eq (hf x hx).symm, λ p hp q hq r hr s hs _ ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [hf p hp, hf q hq, hf _ (pow_pos hr 2), hf _ (pow_pos hs 2)]
    
    · refine ⟨λ x hx ↦ pos_of_mul_pos_right (one_pos.trans_eq (hf x hx).symm) hx.le,
        λ p hp q hq r hr s hs h ↦ mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_pos (mul_pos hp hq) 2).ne.symm ?_⟩
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_add ((p * q) ^ 2), ← mul_pow, mul_right_comm, hf p hp,
        one_mul, ← mul_pow, mul_assoc, hf q hq, mul_one, add_comm, mul_left_comm,
        h, mul_pow, mul_add (_ * _), mul_right_comm, hf _ (pow_pos hr 2), one_mul,
        mul_assoc, hf _ (pow_pos hs 2), mul_one, add_comm (r ^ 2)]

name: posSubtypeExt_spec

name: good_iff_posSubtypeExt_weakGood
statement:
lemma good_iff_posSubtypeExt_weakGood {f : {x : R // 0 < x} → {x : R // 0 < x}} :
    good f ↔ weakGood (posSubtypeExt f)
proof:
:= by
  have X (x : {x : R // 0 < x}) : x.1 ^ 2 = (x ^ 2).1 := rfl
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ ⟨_, h⟩ p q r s h0 ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · refine ⟨λ x hx ↦ (f ⟨x, hx⟩).2.trans_eq (posSubtypeExt_spec f _).symm,
      λ p hp q hq r hr s hs h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    lift p to {x : R // 0 < x} using hp
    lift q to {x : R // 0 < x} using hq
    lift r to {x : R // 0 < x} using hr
    lift s to {x : R // 0 < x} using hs
    simp only [posSubtypeExt_spec, ← Positive.coe_add, X]
    exact congrArg (λ x ↦ x.1) (h p q r s (Subtype.coe_inj.mp h0))
  
  · specialize h p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 r.1 r.2 s.1 s.2 (congrArg Subtype.val h0)
    simp only [posSubtypeExt_spec, ← Positive.coe_add, X] at h
    exact Subtype.coe_inj.mp h

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [ExistsAddOfLE R] {f : {x : R // 0 < x} → {x : R // 0 < x}} :
    good f ↔ f = id ∨ ∀ x, x * f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [good_iff_posSubtypeExt_weakGood, weakGood_iff, funext_iff]
  refine or_congr ⟨λ h x ↦ ?_, λ h x hx ↦ ?_⟩ ⟨λ h x ↦ ?_, λ h x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← Subtype.coe_inj, ← posSubtypeExt_spec, h x.1 x.2]; rfl
  · rw [posSubtypeExt_spec f ⟨x, hx⟩, h ⟨x, hx⟩]; rfl
  · rw [← Subtype.coe_inj, Positive.val_mul, ← posSubtypeExt_spec, h x.1 x.2]; rfl
  · rw [posSubtypeExt_spec f ⟨x, hx⟩]; exact congrArg (λ x ↦ x.1) (h ⟨x, hx⟩)

/-! ### General structure of functions with finite fiber -/

/
structure FiniteFiberFn (α β) where
  toFun : α → β
  fiber : β → Finset α
  fiber_spec : ∀ a b, a ∈ fiber b ↔ toFun a = b

namespace FiniteFiberFn

@[ext] lemma ext {X Y : FiniteFiberFn α β} (h : X.toFun = Y.toFun) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  refine (mk.injEq _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨h, funext λ p ↦ Finset.ext λ i ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [fiber_spec, fiber_spec, h]

name: ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {X Y : FiniteFiberFn α β} (h : X.toFun = Y.toFun) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  refine (mk.injEq _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨h, funext λ p ↦ Finset.ext λ i ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [fiber_spec, fiber_spec, h]

name: fiber_disjoint_of_ne

proof:

  rw [← (X.fiber_spec _ _).mp hlp, ← (X.fiber_spec _ _).mp hlq, h0]

statement:

  | 0 => match ((s.fiber (0, l)).card : Fin 2) with | 0 => rfl | 1 => rfl
  | 1 => by nth_rw 2 [← s.fiber_card_add_Fin2 l]
            generalize ((s.fiber (0, l)).card : Fin 2) = x
            generalize ((s.fiber (1, l)).card : Fin 2) = y
            revert x y; decide

name: card_wrt_MSeq
statement:
theorem card_wrt_MSeq :
    Fintype.card (KSequence I Λ) = 2 ^ Fintype.card I * Fintype.card (MSequence I Λ)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = Fintype.card (MSequence I Λ × Finset I) := Fintype.card_congr EquivPairMSeqFinset
  _ = _ := by rw [Fintype.card_prod, Nat.mul_comm, Fintype.card_finset]

    Fintype.card (KSequence I Λ) = 2 ^ Fintype.card Λ * Fintype.card (NSequence I Λ)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = Fintype.card (NSequence I Λ × (Λ → Fin 2)) := Fintype.card_congr EquivPairNSeqPi
  _ = _ := by rw [Fintype.card_prod, Nat.mul_comm, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]

name: card_NSeq_vs_MSeq
statement:

    2 ^ Fintype.card Λ * Fintype.card (NSequence I Λ)
      = 2 ^ Fintype.card I * Fintype.card (MSequence I Λ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← KSequence.card_wrt_MSeq, ← KSequence.card_wrt_NSeq]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    Fintype.card (NSequence I Λ) =
      2 ^ (Fintype.card I - Fintype.card Λ) * Fintype.card (MSequence I Λ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := lt_or_ge (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card Λ)
  · have h0 : IsEmpty (NSequence I Λ) := ⟨λ s ↦ h.not_ge s.card_lamp_le_step⟩
    have h1 : IsEmpty (MSequence I Λ) := ⟨λ s ↦ h.not_ge s.card_lamp_le_step⟩
    rw [Fintype.card_of_isEmpty, Fintype.card_of_isEmpty (α := MSequence I Λ), Nat.mul_zero]
  · rw [← Nat.mul_right_inj (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp (Nat.two_pow_pos (Fintype.card Λ))),
      card_NSeq_vs_MSeq, ← Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' h]

name: isNatTriangleSide.rotate

  ⟨h.side_y, h.side_z, h.side_x⟩
