:=
  ⟨λ ⟨_, hf⟩ ↦ hf.mod_le_div, λ h ↦ ⟨_, mul_div_good_of_bound h⟩⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    [ExistsAddOfLE R] {M : Multiset R} (hM : M.sum = 0)
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ M, x ≤ a) (hb : ∀ x ∈ M, b ≤ x) :
    card M • (a * b) + (M.map λ x ↦ x ^ 2).sum ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h : card M = 0 ∨ card M ≠ 0 := Decidable.eq_or_ne (card M) 0
  · rw [h, zero_nsmul, zero_add, card_eq_zero.mp h, Multiset.map_zero, sum_zero]
  
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by
    apply le_of_nsmul_le_nsmul_right h
    rw [nsmul_zero, ← hM]
    exact sum_le_card_nsmul M a ha
  have hb0 : b ≤ 0 := by
    apply le_of_nsmul_le_nsmul_right h
    rw [nsmul_zero, ← hM]
    exact card_nsmul_le_sum hb
  let N := M.filter λ x ↦ x ≤ 0
  let P := M.filter λ x ↦ ¬x ≤ 0
  have h0 : (N.map λ x ↦ x ^ 2).sum ≤ (N.map λ x ↦ x * b).sum :=
    sum_map_le_sum_map _ _ λ x hx ↦ let hx := mem_filter.mp hx;
      (sq x).trans_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left (hb x hx.1) hx.2)
  have h1 : (P.map λ x ↦ x ^ 2).sum ≤ (P.map λ x ↦ a * x).sum :=
    sum_map_le_sum_map _ _ λ x hx ↦ let hx := mem_filter.mp hx;
      (sq x).trans_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ha x hx.1) (le_of_not_ge hx.2))
  replace h : (M.map λ x ↦ x ^ 2).sum ≤ (N.map λ x ↦ x * b).sum + (P.map λ x ↦ a * x).sum := by
    apply (add_le_add h0 h1).trans_eq'
    rw [← sum_add, ← Multiset.map_add, filter_add_not]
  replace h0 : card N • (a * b) ≤ (N.map λ x ↦ a * x).sum := by
    rw [← sum_replicate, ← map_const']
    exact sum_map_le_sum_map _ _ λ x hx ↦
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb x (mem_filter.mp hx).1) ha0
  replace h1 : card P • (a * b) ≤ (P.map λ x ↦ x * b).sum := by
    rw [← sum_replicate, ← map_const']
    exact sum_map_le_sum_map _ _ λ x hx ↦
      mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right (ha x (mem_filter.mp hx).1) hb0
  replace h0 : card M • (a * b) ≤ (N.map λ x ↦ a * x).sum + (P.map λ x ↦ x * b).sum := by
    apply (add_le_add h0 h1).trans_eq'
    rw [← add_nsmul, ← card_add, filter_add_not]
  refine (add_le_add h0 h).trans_eq ?_
  rw [add_comm (sum _), add_add_add_comm, ← sum_add, ← sum_add, ← Multiset.map_add,
    ← Multiset.map_add, add_comm P, filter_add_not, sum_map_mul_left,
    sum_map_mul_right, map_id', hM, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: dvd_iff_of_dvd_add
statement: lemma dvd_iff_of_dvd_add {c : ℕ} (h : c ∣ a + b) : c ∣ a ↔ c ∣ b
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h0 ↦ (Nat.dvd_add_right h0).mp h, λ h0 ↦ (Nat.dvd_add_left h0).mp h⟩

name: dvd_sq_iff_dvd_sq_of_dvd_add
statement:
theorem dvd_sq_iff_dvd_sq_of_dvd_add {c : ℕ} (h : c ∣ a + b) :
    c ∣ a ^ 2 ↔ c ∣ b ^ 2
proof:
:=
  have h0 {u v w : ℕ} (h0 : u ∣ v + w) : u ∣ v ^ 2 ↔ u ∣ v * w :=
    dvd_iff_of_dvd_add (by rw [sq, ← Nat.mul_add]; exact h0.mul_left v)
  by rw [h0 h, mul_comm, ← h0 (a.add_comm b ▸ h)]

name: eq_zero_of_prime_add_dvd_sq
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_prime_add_dvd_sq (h : p.Prime) (h0 : a < p) (h1 : p + a ∣ p ^ 2) :
    a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.dvd_prime_pow h] at h1
  rcases h1 with ⟨k, h1, h2⟩
  rw [Nat.le_add_one_iff, Nat.le_add_one_iff, zero_add, le_zero_iff] at h1
  rcases h1 with (rfl | rfl) | rfl
  · exact absurd h2 (h.one_lt.trans_le le_self_add).ne.symm
  · rwa [pow_one, add_eq_left] at h2
  · refine absurd ((add_lt_add_right h0 p).trans_le ?_) h2.not_lt
    rw [sq, ← two_mul]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right p h.two_le

name: linear_is_good
statement: theorem linear_is_good (C k : ℕ) : good C (k * ·)
proof:
:=
  λ a b _ ↦ ⟨a, by rw [sq, add_mul, Nat.mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]⟩

name: good_is_linear
statement: theorem good_is_linear {f : ℕ → ℕ} (h : good C f) : ∃ k, f = (k * ·)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 {n} (h0 : C < n) : f n ≤ n * f 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.succ_le_succ_iff, Nat.succ_eq_one_add, Nat.succ_eq_one_add]
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.add_pos_left Nat.one_pos _)
      (h 1 n <| Nat.lt_one_add_iff.mpr h0.le)
  
  have h1 {p} (h1 : C < p) (h2 : p.Prime) : ∃ k ≤ f 1, f p = k * p := by
    suffices p ∣ f p ^ 2 by
      rcases h2.dvd_of_dvd_pow this with ⟨k, h3⟩
      exact ⟨k, Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (h3.ge.trans (h0 h1)) h2.pos,
        h3.trans (p.mul_comm k)⟩
    rcases exists_gt (C + f p) with ⟨n, h3⟩
    replace h3 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (h3.le.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ h2.pos))
    rcases h3 with ⟨a, h3⟩; rw [add_right_comm] at h3
    specialize h (C + a) p ((C.le_add_right a).trans_lt (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right h2.pos))
    replace h3 : p ∣ C + a + f p := ⟨n, h3.symm.trans (n.mul_comm p)⟩
    rw [← dvd_sq_iff_dvd_sq_of_dvd_add h3, dvd_iff_of_dvd_add (h3.trans h)]
    exact p.dvd_mul_right _
  
  have h2 (x) : ∃ B, ∀ p, p.Prime → B < p → ∃ k, f p = k * p ∧ f x = k * x := by
    refine ⟨max C (max (f x) (max (x * f 1) (x ^ 2))), λ p h2 h3 ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [max_lt_iff, max_lt_iff, max_lt_iff] at h3
    rcases h3 with ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4⟩
    rcases h1 hp1 h2 with ⟨k, h3, h4⟩
    refine ⟨k, h4, ?_⟩
    rcases (f x).eq_zero_or_pos with h5 | h5
    · rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | h6
      · rw [h5, zero_mul]
      · suffices x ^ 2 = 0 by rw [h5, eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero this, mul_zero]
        specialize h x p (Nat.lt_add_left x hp1)
        rw [h5, mul_zero, add_zero, h4] at h
        exact Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h <|
          Nat.lt_add_left x (lt_mul_of_one_le_of_lt h6 hp4)
    · specialize h p x (Nat.lt_add_right x hp1)
      have h6 : (p + f x).Coprime p := by
        rw [Nat.coprime_self_add_left, Nat.coprime_comm, h2.coprime_iff_not_dvd]
        exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt h5 hp2
      rw [sq, h4, ← mul_assoc, ← add_mul, h6.dvd_mul_right] at h
      clear h6; rcases h with ⟨_ | _ | t, h⟩
      · exact h.not_gt.elim (Nat.lt_add_right _ h2.pos)
      · rwa [Nat.mul_one, add_right_inj, eq_comm, mul_comm] at h
      · rw [add_assoc, mul_add, add_mul _ _ 2] at h
        refine h.not_lt.elim (Nat.lt_add_left _ (Nat.lt_add_right _ ?_))
        rw [mul_two, add_lt_add_iff_left]
        exact hp3.trans_le' (Nat.mul_le_mul_left x h3)
  
  rcases C.succ.exists_infinite_primes with ⟨p, (h3 : C < p), h4⟩
  rcases h1 h3 h4 with ⟨k, -, h5⟩
  refine ⟨k, funext λ n ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases h2 p with ⟨Bp, hp⟩
  rcases h2 n with ⟨Bn, hn⟩
  rcases (max Bp Bn).succ.exists_infinite_primes with ⟨q, h6, h7⟩
  rw [Nat.succ_le_iff, max_lt_iff] at h6
  specialize hp q h7 h6.1; rcases hp with ⟨kp, h8, h9⟩
  rw [h5, Nat.mul_left_inj h4.ne_zero] at h9
  specialize hn q h7 h6.2; rcases hn with ⟨kn, h10, h11⟩
  rw [h8, Nat.mul_left_inj h7.ne_zero] at h10
  rw [h11, ← h10, ← h9]

name: final_solution_Nat
statement: theorem final_solution_Nat : good C f ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, f = (k * ·)
proof:
:=
  ⟨good_is_linear, λ h ↦ h.elim λ k h ↦ h ▸ linear_is_good C k⟩

name: linear_is_goodPNat
statement: theorem linear_is_goodPNat (C k : ℕ+) : goodPNat C (k * ·)
proof:
:=
  λ a b _ ↦ ⟨a, by rw [sq, add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]⟩

name: goodPNat_is_linear
statement: theorem goodPNat_is_linear (h : goodPNat C f) : ∃ k : ℕ+, f = (k * ·)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℕ → ℕ := λ n ↦ dite (0 < n) (λ h ↦ f ⟨n, h⟩) (λ _ ↦ 0)
  have h0 : good C g := λ a b H ↦ by
    rcases a.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | ha
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    rcases b.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hb
    · rw [zero_mul]; exact ⟨a, sq a⟩
    · dsimp only [g]; rw [dite_eq_left ha, dite_eq_left hb]
      exact PNat.dvd_iff.mp (h ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ H)
  rcases good_is_linear h0 with ⟨k, h1⟩
  replace h0 : 0 < k := by rw [← k.mul_one, ← congr_fun h1]; exact (f 1).pos
  let k0 : ℕ+ := ⟨k, h0⟩
  refine ⟨k0, funext λ x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← PNat.coe_inj, PNat.mul_coe, PNat.mk_coe, ← congr_fun h1, eq_comm]
  exact dite_eq_left x.pos

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : goodPNat C f ↔ ∃ k : ℕ+, f = (k * ·)
proof:
:=
  ⟨goodPNat_is_linear, λ h ↦ h.elim λ k h ↦ h ▸ linear_is_goodPNat C k⟩

name: exists_ne_pow_eq
statement: theorem exists_ne_pow_eq (h : k ≠ 0) (b : ℤ) : ∃ m n : ℕ, m ≠ n ∧ k ∣ b ^ m - b ^ n
proof:
:=
  have h0 : Set.MapsTo (λ x : ℕ ↦ b ^ x % k) Set.univ (Finset.Ico 0 |k|) :=
    λ x _ ↦ Finset.coe_Ico 0 |k| ▸ ⟨(b ^ x).emod_nonneg h, Int.emod_lt_abs _ h⟩
  (Set.infinite_univ.exists_ne_map_eq_of_mapsTo h0 (Set.toFinite _)).elim
    λ m ⟨_, n, _, h, h0⟩ ↦ ⟨m, n, h, Int.ModEq.dvd h0.symm⟩

name: univ_rootiful
statement: theorem univ_rootiful : rootiful Set.univ
proof: := λ x _ _ _ _ ↦ Set.mem_univ x

name: rootiful_neg_one_mem
statement: theorem rootiful_neg_one_mem (x : ℤ) (h0 : x ≠ 0) (h1 : x ∈ S) : (-1 : ℤ) ∈ S
proof:
:=
  h (-1) (replicate 2 x)
    (λ _ h2 ↦ Set.mem_of_eq_of_mem (eq_of_mem_replicate h2) h1)
    ⟨x, mem_replicate.mpr ⟨Nat.succ_ne_zero 1, rfl⟩, h0⟩
    (by change x + -1 * (x + 0) = 0; rw [add_zero, neg_one_mul, add_neg_cancel])

name: rootiful_one_mem_of_nat
statement: theorem rootiful_one_mem_of_nat (n : ℕ) (h0 : n ≠ 0) (h1 : (n : ℤ) ∈ S) : (1 : ℤ) ∈ S
proof:
:=
  let h0 : (n : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr h0
  h 1 (n :: replicate n (-1))
    (forall_mem_cons.mpr
      ⟨h1, λ x h2 ↦ (mem_replicate.mp h2).2 ▸ rootiful_neg_one_mem h n h0 h1⟩)
    ⟨n, mem_cons_self, h0⟩
    (by simp only [one_mul]; rw [← sum_eq_foldr, sum_cons,
      sum_replicate, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_neg_one, add_neg_cancel])

name: rootiful_one_mem_of_pos
statement: theorem rootiful_one_mem_of_pos (n : ℤ) (h0 : 0 < n) (h1 : n ∈ S) : (1 : ℤ) ∈ S
proof:
:=
  rootiful_one_mem_of_nat h n.natAbs (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr h0.ne.symm)
    (Int.eq_natAbs_of_nonneg h0.le ▸ h1)

name: rootiful_neg_mem_of_one_mem
statement: theorem rootiful_neg_mem_of_one_mem (h0 : (1 : ℤ) ∈ S) (x : ℤ) (h1 : x ∈ S) : -x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  h (-x) [x, 1]
    (λ a h2 ↦ by
      rw [mem_cons, mem_singleton] at h2
      rcases h2 with rfl | rfl; exacts [h1, h0])
    ⟨1, mem_cons_of_mem _ (mem_singleton_self 1), Int.one_ne_zero⟩
    (by show x + -x * (1 + -x * 0) = 0; rw [mul_zero, add_zero, mul_one, add_neg_cancel])

name: rootiful_neg_mem_of_pos
statement: theorem rootiful_neg_mem_of_pos {x : ℤ} (h0 : 0 < x) (h1 : x ∈ S) : -x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  rootiful_neg_mem_of_one_mem h (rootiful_one_mem_of_pos h x h0 h1) x h1

name: rootiful_induction_of_nat_dvd_nat
statement:
theorem rootiful_induction_of_nat_dvd_nat (h0 : 1 < n) (h1 : ∀ k : ℕ, k < n → (k : ℤ) ∈ S)
    (N : ℕ) (h2 : 0 < N) (h3 : n ∣ N) (h4 : -(N : ℤ) ∈ S) : (n : ℤ) ∈ S
proof:
:=
  h3.elim λ K h3 ↦ h n (-(N : ℕ) :: (n.digits K).map Nat.cast)
    (forall_mem_cons.mpr ⟨h4, λ x h5 ↦ by
      rw [mem_map] at h5; rcases h5 with ⟨d, h5, rfl⟩
      exact h1 d (Nat.digits_lt_base h0 h5)⟩)
    ⟨-N, mem_cons_self, by rw [Int.neg_ne_zero, Nat.cast_ne_zero]; exact h2.ne.symm⟩
    (by rw [List.foldr, foldr_map, ← Nat.ofDigits_eq_foldr, ← Nat.coe_ofDigits,
      Nat.ofDigits_digits, h3, Nat.cast_mul, neg_add_cancel])

name: rootiful_induction_of_nat_dvd_int
statement:
theorem rootiful_induction_of_nat_dvd_int (h0 : 1 < n) (h1 : ∀ k : ℕ, k < n → (k : ℤ) ∈ S)
    (N : ℤ) (h2 : N ≠ 0) (h3 : (n : ℤ) ∣ N) (h4 : N ∈ S) : (n : ℤ) ∈ S
proof:
:=
  have h2 := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr h2
  rootiful_induction_of_nat_dvd_nat h h0 h1 N.natAbs h2 (Int.natCast_dvd.mp h3)
    (N.natAbs_eq.symm.elim
      (λ h5 ↦ h5 ▸ h4) (λ h5 ↦ rootiful_neg_mem_of_pos h (Nat.cast_pos.mpr h2) (h5 ▸ h4)))

name: rootiful_nat_subset
statement:
theorem rootiful_nat_subset (h0 : (0 : ℤ) ∈ S) (h1 : (1 : ℤ) ∈ S)
    (h2 : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → ∃ N : ℤ, N ≠ 0 ∧ (k : ℤ) ∣ N ∧ N ∈ S) (k : ℕ) : (k : ℤ) ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h k h3 => ?_
  match k with
  | 0 => exact h0
  | 1 => exact h1
  | k + 2 =>
      rcases h2 (k + 2) k.succ.succ_pos with ⟨N, h4, h5, h6⟩
      exact rootiful_induction_of_nat_dvd_int h (Nat.succ_lt_succ k.succ_pos) h3 N h4 h5 h6

name: rootiful_eq_univ
statement:
theorem rootiful_eq_univ (h0 : (0 : ℤ) ∈ S) (h1 : (1 : ℤ) ∈ S)
    (h2 : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → ∃ N : ℤ, N ≠ 0 ∧ (k : ℤ) ∣ N ∧ N ∈ S) : S = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.eq_univ_of_forall λ k ↦ ?_
  have h3 := rootiful_nat_subset h h0 h1 h2 k.natAbs
  rcases le_or_gt 0 k with h4 | h4
  · rwa [Int.natAbs_of_nonneg h4] at h3
  · apply rootiful_neg_mem_of_pos h (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr h4.ne)) at h3
    rwa [Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos h4.le, neg_neg] at h3

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {N : ℤ} (h : 1 < |N|) {S : Set ℤ} :
    (rootiful S ∧ ∀ a b : ℕ, N ^ (a + 1) - N ^ (b + 1) ∈ S) ↔ S = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h0 ↦ ?_, λ h0 ↦ h0 ▸ ⟨univ_rootiful, λ _ _ ↦ Set.mem_univ _⟩⟩
  rcases h0 with ⟨h0, h1⟩; apply rootiful_eq_univ h0 (sub_self (N ^ 1) ▸ h1 0 0)
  
  · refine rootiful_one_mem_of_pos h0 (N ^ 2 - N ^ 1) ?_ (h1 1 0)
    rw [sub_pos, pow_one, ← sq_abs, sq]
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans_lt (lt_mul_self h)
  
  · intro k h2; rcases exists_ne_pow_eq (Nat.cast_pos.mpr h2).ne.symm N with ⟨m, n, h3, h4⟩
    specialize h1 m n; rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ← sub_mul] at h1
    refine ⟨_, mul_ne_zero ?_ (abs_pos.mp (Int.one_pos.trans h)), h4.mul_right N, h1⟩
    intro h5; refine h3 (Int.pow_right_injective ?_ (sub_eq_zero.mp h5))
    exact (Int.natAbs_lt_natAbs_of_nonneg_of_lt Int.one_nonneg h).trans_eq N.natAbs_abs

name: multiset_max_mem_cons
statement: theorem multiset_max_mem_cons (a : α) (S : Multiset α) : S.fold max a ∈ a ::ₘ S
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on S (mem_cons_self a 0) λ b T h ↦ by
    rw [fold_cons_left, cons_swap]
    rcases max_choice b (T.fold max a) with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0]; exact mem_cons_self b _
    · rw [h0]; exact mem_cons_of_mem h

name: multiset_le_max_of_mem
statement:
theorem multiset_le_max_of_mem (a : α) (S : Multiset α) :
    ∀ b : α, b ∈ a ::ₘ S → b ≤ S.fold max a
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on S (λ _ h => (mem_singleton.mp h).le) λ b T h c h0 ↦ by
    rw [fold_cons_left, le_max_iff]
    rw [cons_swap, mem_cons] at h0
    exact h0.imp le_of_eq (h c)

name: exists_max_add_rest
statement:
theorem exists_max_add_rest {S : Multiset α} (h : S ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (a : α) (S₀ : Multiset α), S = a ::ₘ S₀ ∧ ∀ x : α, x ∈ S₀ → x ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_mem_of_ne_zero h with ⟨b, h0⟩
  rcases exists_cons_of_mem h0 with ⟨T, rfl⟩
  rcases exists_cons_of_mem (multiset_max_mem_cons b T) with ⟨U, h1⟩
  refine ⟨T.fold max b, U, h1, λ x h2 ↦ multiset_le_max_of_mem _ _ _ ?_⟩
  rw [h1]; exact mem_cons_of_mem h2

name: LinearOrder_induction
statement:
theorem LinearOrder_induction {P : Multiset α → Prop}
    (h : P 0) (h0 : ∀ a S, P S → (∀ x ∈ S, x ≤ a) → P (a ::ₘ S)) (S) : P S
proof:
:= by
  generalize hS : card S = n
  induction n generalizing S with
  | zero => exact card_eq_zero.mp hS ▸ h
  | succ n h1 =>
      obtain ⟨a, S₀, rfl, h2⟩ : ∃ a S₀, S = a ::ₘ S₀ ∧ ∀ x : α, x ∈ S₀ → x ≤ a :=
        exists_max_add_rest (card_pos.mp (n.succ_pos.trans_eq hS.symm))
      rw [card_cons, Nat.succ_inj] at hS
      exact h0 a S₀ (h1 S₀ hS) h2

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] (g : G) :
    ∀ (S : Multiset G) (_ : ∀ x : G, x ∈ S → g ≤ x) (_ : S.sum ≤ (2 * card S) • g)
      {r : G} (_ : -(2 • g) ≤ r) (_ : r ≤ S.sum),
        ∃ T : Multiset G, T ≤ S ∧ r ≤ T.sum ∧ T.sum ≤ r + 2 • g
proof:
:=
  LinearOrder_induction
    
    (λ _ _ r hr hr0 ↦ ⟨0, le_refl _, hr0, neg_le_iff_add_nonneg.mp hr⟩)
    
    λ s₀ S₀ h h0 h1 h2 ↦ by
      
      rw [forall_mem_cons] at h1; rcases h1 with ⟨-, h1⟩
      rw [card_cons, Nat.mul_succ, sum_cons, add_nsmul, add_comm] at h2
      replace h (r) : -(2 • g) ≤ r → r ≤ S₀.sum → ∃ T ≤ S₀, r ≤ T.sum ∧ T.sum ≤ r + 2 • g := by
        refine h h1 (le_of_not_gt λ h3 ↦ h2.not_gt (add_lt_add h3 ?_))
        replace h3 := h3.trans_le (sum_le_card_nsmul S₀ s₀ h0)
        rw [mul_nsmul] at h3; exact lt_of_nsmul_lt_nsmul_right _ h3
      
      suffices s₀ + -(2 • g) ≤ S₀.sum by
        clear h0 h1 h2; intro r hr hr₀
        obtain (hr | hr₀) : s₀ + -(2 • g) ≤ r ∨ r ≤ S₀.sum := this.ge_or_le r
        · rw [sum_cons, ← sub_le_iff_le_add'] at hr₀
          specialize h (r - s₀) (le_sub_iff_add_le'.mpr hr) hr₀
          rcases h with ⟨T, h, h0, h1⟩
          refine ⟨s₀ ::ₘ T, (cons_le_cons_iff s₀).mpr h, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rwa [sum_cons, ← sub_le_iff_le_add']
          · rwa [sum_cons, ← le_sub_iff_add_le', add_sub_right_comm]
        · specialize h r hr hr₀; rcases h with ⟨T, h, h0⟩
          exact ⟨T, h.trans (le_cons_self S₀ s₀), h0⟩
      
      refine add_neg_le_iff_le_add.mpr (le_of_add_le_add_left (a := S₀.sum) (h2.trans ?_))
      rw [← add_assoc, add_le_add_iff_right, ← two_nsmul, mul_nsmul']
      exact nsmul_le_nsmul_right (card_nsmul_le_sum h1) 2

name: x_zero
statement: theorem x_zero : x 0 = false
proof:
:=
  Nat.binaryRec_zero false λ bit k ↦ xor (bit || k.bodd)

name: x_mul2
statement: theorem x_mul2 (k : ℕ) : x (2 * k) = xor k.bodd (x k)
proof:
:=
  Nat.binaryRec_eq false k (Or.inl rfl)

name: x_mul2_add1
statement: theorem x_mul2_add1 (k : ℕ) : x (2 * k + 1) = !x k
proof:
:= by
  apply (Nat.binaryRec_eq true k (Or.inl rfl)).trans
  rw [Bool.true_or, Bool.true_xor]

name: x_mul4
statement: theorem x_mul4 (k : ℕ) : x (4 * k) = xor k.bodd (x k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_assoc 2 2, x_mul2, x_mul2, Nat.bodd_mul,
    Nat.bodd_two, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_xor]

name: x_mul4_add1
statement: theorem x_mul4_add1 (k : ℕ) : x (4 * k + 1) = !x (4 * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_assoc 2 2, x_mul2, x_mul2_add1, Nat.bodd_mul,
    Nat.bodd_two, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_xor]

name: x_mul4_add2
statement: theorem x_mul4_add2 (k : ℕ) : x (4 * k + 2) = x k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_assoc 2 2, ← Nat.mul_succ, x_mul2, x_mul2_add1, Nat.bodd_succ, Nat.bodd_mul,
    Nat.bodd_two, Bool.false_and, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_xor, Bool.not_not]

name: x_mul4_add3
statement: theorem x_mul4_add3 (k : ℕ) : x (4 * k + 3) = x k
proof:
:= by
  show x (2 * 2 * k + 2 + 1) = x k
  rw [Nat.mul_assoc, ← Nat.mul_succ, x_mul2_add1, x_mul2_add1, Bool.not_not]

name: S_zero
statement: theorem S_zero : S 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: S_succ
statement: theorem S_succ (a : ℕ) : S a.succ = S a + cond (x a) (-1) 1
proof:
:=
  sum_range_succ _ a

name: S_mul4_add2
statement: theorem S_mul4_add2 (k : ℕ) : S (4 * k + 2) = S (4 * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [S_succ, S_succ, add_assoc, add_eq_left, x_mul4_add1]
  exact (x (4 * k)).recOn rfl rfl

name: S_mul4
statement: theorem S_mul4 : ∀ k : ℕ, S (4 * k) = 2 * S k
proof:
:=
  Nat.rec rfl λ k h ↦ by
    change S (4 * k + 4) = 2 * S k.succ
    rw [S_succ, x_mul4_add3, S_succ, x_mul4_add2, S_mul4_add2,
      h, add_assoc, ← two_mul, ← mul_add, ← S_succ]

name: S_parity
statement: theorem S_parity : ∀ k : ℕ, (S k).bodd = k.bodd
proof:
:=
  Nat.rec rfl λ k h ↦ by
    rw [Nat.bodd_succ, S_succ, Int.bodd_add, h, ← Bool.xor_true]
    exact (x k).rec rfl rfl

name: S_four_mul_add_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem S_four_mul_add_eq_zero_iff (q : ℕ) {r : ℕ} (h : r < 4) :
    S (4 * q + r) = 0 ↔ S q = 0 ∧ (r = 0 ∨ r = 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ (and_iff_right_of_imp ?_).mpr ?_, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
  
  replace h : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := two_ne_zero
  rintro (rfl | rfl)
  · rwa [add_zero, S_mul4, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right h] at h0
  · rwa [S_mul4_add2, S_mul4, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right h] at h0
  
  replace h0 := congrArg Int.bodd h0
  rw [Int.bodd_zero, S_parity, Nat.bodd_add, Nat.bodd_mul] at h0
  change xor (false && q.bodd) r.bodd = false at h0
  iterate 3 rw [Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq] at h
  rw [Nat.lt_one_iff, or_assoc, or_or_or_comm] at h
  revert h; refine (or_iff_left ?_).mp
  rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> exact Bool.true_eq_false_eq_False h0
  
  rcases h0 with ⟨h0, rfl | rfl⟩
  · rw [add_zero, S_mul4, h0]; rfl
  · rw [S_mul4_add2, S_mul4, h0]; rfl

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ S k
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∀ k, S k = 0 → x k = false by
    refine Nat.rec (Int.le_refl 0) (λ k h ↦ ?_)
    rw [le_iff_lt_or_eq, Int.lt_iff_add_one_le, zero_add, or_comm] at h
    rw [S_succ]; rcases h with h | h
    · rw [← h, zero_add, this k h.symm]
      exact Int.zero_lt_one.le
    · rw [← Int.add_right_neg 1]
      exact add_le_add h ((x k).rec (neg_le_self zero_le_one) (-1).le_refl)
  
  intro k h; induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h k k_ih =>
  obtain ⟨q, r, h0, rfl⟩ : ∃ q r : ℕ, r < 4 ∧ 4 * q + r = k :=
    ⟨k / 4, k % 4, Nat.mod_lt k four_pos, Nat.div_add_mod k 4⟩
  rw [S_four_mul_add_eq_zero_iff q h0, or_comm] at h
  clear h0; rcases h with ⟨h, rfl | rfl⟩
  · rw [x_mul4_add2]
    exact k_ih q (lt_add_of_le_of_pos (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ four_pos) two_pos) h
  rcases q.eq_zero_or_pos with (rfl | h0)
  rw [add_zero, MulZeroClass.mul_zero, x_zero]
  replace k_ih := k_ih q (lt_mul_left h0 <| Nat.succ_lt_succ <| Nat.succ_pos 2) h
  replace h : q.bodd = false := by simpa [S_parity] using congrArg Int.bodd h
  rw [add_zero, x_mul4, h, k_ih]; rfl

name: special_ineq
statement:
theorem special_ineq {w x y z c : R} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (h : w + x + y ≤ 2 • c) (h0 : x + y + z ≤ 2 • c) :
    w * y + x * z ≤ c ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  replace h : w * y + (x + y) * y ≤ (2 • c) * y := by
    rw [← add_mul, ← add_assoc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hy
  replace h0 : (x + y) * x + z * x ≤ (2 • c) * x :=
     add_mul _ _ x ▸ mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h0 hx
  have h1 := add_le_add h h0
  rw [add_comm (w * y), add_add_add_comm, ← mul_add, ← mul_add, add_comm y,
    mul_comm z, ← sq, add_comm, two_nsmul, ← two_mul] at h1
  exact le_of_add_le_add_right (h1.trans (two_mul_le_add_sq _ _))

name: good_targetSum_le
statement:
theorem good_targetSum_le {x : ℕ → R} (h : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) {c : R} (h0 : good c x) :
    ∀ n, targetSum x (2 * n) ≤ n • c ^ 2
  | 0 => by rw [targetSum, sum_range_zero, zero_nsmul]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [targetSum, Nat.mul_succ, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ, add_assoc, succ_nsmul]
      exact add_le_add (good_targetSum_le h h0 n) (special_ineq (h _) (h _) (h0 _) (h0 _))

open Fin.NatCast in
omit [ExistsAddOfLE R] in

name: targetSum_of_Fin2Map
statement:
theorem targetSum_of_Fin2Map (c : R) :
    ∀ n, targetSum (λ n ↦ ![c, 0] n) (2 * n) = n • c ^ 2
  | 0 => by rw [Nat.mul_zero, targetSum, sum_range_zero, zero_nsmul]
  | n + 1 => by
      have h (n) : ((2 * n : ℕ) : Fin 2) = 0
proof:
:= Fin.val_injective (Nat.mul_mod_right 2 n)
      have h0 (n) : ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : Fin 2) = 1 := Fin.val_injective (Nat.mul_add_mod 2 n 1)
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, targetSum, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ,
        ← targetSum, targetSum_of_Fin2Map, succ_nsmul, add_assoc,
        add_right_inj, h, add_right_comm, ← Nat.mul_succ, h, h0, h0]
      change c * c + 0 * 0 = c ^ 2; rw [sq, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {c : R} (h : 0 ≤ c) (n : ℕ) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range λ (X : goodPeriodicSeq c n) ↦ targetSum X.x (2 * n)) (n • c ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨Fin2Map_goodPeriodicSeq h n, targetSum_of_Fin2Map c n⟩,
  λ _ ⟨X, h0⟩ ↦ h0.symm.trans_le (good_targetSum_le X.nonneg X.good n)⟩

name: lem1
statement: lemma lem1 : ∃ a, ∀ k, (∃ x, f x = k) ↔ a ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∃ n, ∃ x, f x = n := ⟨f 0, 0, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.find h0, λ k ↦ ⟨Nat.find_min' h0, Nat.le_induction (Nat.find_spec h0) ?_ k⟩⟩
  rintro n h1 ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨g x, h x⟩

name: lem2
statement: lemma lem2 (h0 : g x = g y) : f x = f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.succ_inj, ← h, ← h, h0]

name: lem3
statement: lemma lem3 (h0 : ∀ k, (∃ x, g x = k) ↔ a ≤ k) : a < g a
proof:
:=
  (lt_or_eq_of_le <| (h0 (g a)).mp ⟨a, rfl⟩).resolve_right
    λ h1 ↦ (f a).succ_ne_self <| (h a).symm.trans (congr_arg f h1.symm)

name: lem4
statement: lemma lem4 (h1 : ∃ x, f x = k) (h2 : ∃ y, f y = m) (h3 : f k = f m) : k = m
proof:
:= by
  rcases h1 with ⟨x, rfl⟩; rcases h2 with ⟨y, rfl⟩
  replace h3 := lem2 h0 h3
  rw [h0, h0, Nat.succ_inj] at h3
  exact lem2 h h3

name: lem5
statement:
lemma lem5 (h1 : ∀ k : ℕ, (∃ x, f x = k) ↔ a ≤ k)
    (h2 : ∀ k : ℕ, (∃ x, g x = k) ↔ b ≤ k) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  wlog h3 : a ≤ b
  · exact (this h0 h h2 h1 (le_of_not_ge h3)).symm
  refine h3.antisymm ((h2 _).mp ?_)
  obtain ⟨k, h4⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (lem3 h0 h1)
  obtain ⟨d, h5⟩ := (h1 (a + k)).mpr (a.le_add_right k)
  rw [Nat.succ_add, ← h5, ← h, eq_comm] at h4
  exact ⟨d, lem4 h h0 ((h1 _).mpr <| h3.trans <| (h2 _).mp ⟨d, rfl⟩)
    ((h1 a).mpr a.le_refl) h4⟩

name: lem6
statement: lemma lem6 : ∃ a, (∀ k, (∃ x, f x = k) ↔ a ≤ k) ∧ (∀ k, (∃ x, g x = k) ↔ a ≤ k)
proof:
:=
  (lem1 h).elim λ a h1 ↦ ⟨a, h1, (lem1 h0).elim λ _ h2 ↦ (lem5 h h0 h1 h2).symm ▸ h2⟩

name: lem7
statement:
lemma lem7 (h1 : ∀ k : ℕ, (∃ x, f x = k) ↔ a ≤ k)
    (h2 : ∀ k : ℕ, (∃ x, g x = k) ↔ a ≤ k) : f a = a.succ
proof:
:= by
  refine (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lem3 h0 h1)).eq_or_lt'.resolve_right λ h3 ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨t, h3⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt h3
  obtain ⟨x, h4⟩ := (h1 (a + t)).mpr (a.le_add_right t)
  obtain ⟨y, h5⟩ := (h1 (g x)).mpr <| (h2 _).mp ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [Nat.succ_add, ← h4, ← h, ← Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← h, ← h5] at h3
  refine (lem4 h h0 ((h1 a).mpr a.le_refl) ((h1 _).mpr <| (h2 _).mp ⟨f y, rfl⟩) h3).not_lt ?_
  rw [h0, Nat.lt_succ_iff, ← h2]
  exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : f = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, h1, h2⟩ := lem6 h h0
  suffices h3 : ∀ n, a ≤ n → f n = n.succ ∧ g n = n.succ by
    ext x; rw [← Nat.succ_inj, ← h, (h3 _ <| (h2 _).mp ⟨x, rfl⟩).1]
  refine Nat.le_induction ⟨lem7 h h0 h1 h2, lem7 h0 h h2 h1⟩ (λ n _ h3 ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
  · rw [← Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← h3.2, h, h3.1, h3.2]
  · rw [← Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← h3.1, h0, h3.1, h3.2]

name: P_zero
statement: theorem P_zero (seed) : P seed 0 = seed
proof: := rfl

name: P_succ
statement: theorem P_succ (seed n) : P seed n.succ = P (2 ^ seed) n
proof: := rfl

name: P_succ'
statement:
theorem P_succ' (seed) : ∀ n, P seed n.succ = 2 ^ P seed n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by rw [P_succ, P_succ', P_succ]

name: P_pos_of_seed
statement:
theorem P_pos_of_seed (h : 0 < seed) : ∀ n, 0 < P seed n
  | 0 => h
  | n + 1 => P_pos_of_seed (Nat.pow_pos Nat.two_pos) n

name: P_lt_of_seed
statement:
theorem P_lt_of_seed (h : seed₁ < seed₂) : ∀ n, P seed₁ n < P seed₂ n
  | 0 => h
  | n + 1 => P_lt_of_seed (Nat.pow_lt_pow_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self 1) h) n

/

name: Nat_lt_two_pow
statement: theorem Nat_lt_two_pow : ∀ n, n < 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec Nat.one_pos λ n h ↦ ?_
  rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]; exact Nat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le h Nat.one_le_two_pow

name: seed_lt_P_one
statement: theorem seed_lt_P_one (seed) : seed < P seed 1
proof:
:=
  Nat_lt_two_pow seed

name: P_lt_succ_iter
statement: theorem P_lt_succ_iter (seed n) : P seed n < P seed (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  P_lt_of_seed (seed_lt_P_one seed) n

name: P_le_add_iter
statement:
theorem P_le_add_iter (seed n) : ∀ k, P seed n ≤ P seed (n + k)
  | 0 => Nat.le_refl _
  | k + 1 => Nat.le_trans (P_le_add_iter seed n k) (Nat.le_of_lt (P_lt_succ_iter seed _))

name: P_monotone_iter
statement: theorem P_monotone_iter (seed) (h : n ≤ m) : P seed n ≤ P seed m
proof:
:=
  Nat.add_sub_cancel' h ▸ P_le_add_iter seed n (m - n)

name: P_strict_mono_iter
statement: theorem P_strict_mono_iter (seed) (h : n < m) : P seed n < P seed m
proof:
:=
  Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (P_lt_succ_iter seed n) (P_monotone_iter seed h)

name: le_of_P_le_iter
statement: theorem le_of_P_le_iter (h : P seed n ≤ P seed m) : n ≤ m
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_of_not_lt λ h0 ↦ Nat.not_lt_of_le h (P_strict_mono_iter seed h0)

name: P_iter_le_iff
statement: theorem P_iter_le_iff : P seed n ≤ P seed m ↔ n ≤ m
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_of_P_le_iter, P_monotone_iter seed⟩

name: log2_lt_iff
statement: theorem log2_lt_iff₂ {n} (hk : 0 < k) : n.log2 < k ↔ n < 2 ^ k
proof:
:=
  match n with
  | 0 => ⟨λ _ ↦ k.two_pow_pos, λ _ ↦ by rwa [Nat.log2_zero]⟩
  | n + 1 => Nat.log2_lt n.succ_ne_zero

name: log2_monotone
statement: theorem log2_monotone {m n : Nat} (h : m ≤ n) : m.log2 ≤ n.log2
proof:
:=
  match m with
  | 0 => by rw [Nat.log2_zero]; exact n.log2.zero_le
  | m + 1 => (Nat.le_log2 (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt h))).mpr
      (Nat.le_trans (Nat.log2_self_le m.succ_ne_zero) h)

name: log2_two_pow
statement:
theorem log2_two_pow : ∀ n : Nat, (2 ^ n).log2 = n
  | 0 => by simp [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.log2_def]
  | n + 1 => by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.log2_def, Nat.mul_div_left _ Nat.two_pos,
      log2_two_pow, ite_eq_left (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left 2 n.two_pow_pos)]





/-! ### Iteration of `log2` -/

def log2_iter (seed : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => seed
  | n + 1 => log2_iter seed.log2 n

name: log2_iter_zero
statement: theorem log2_iter_zero (seed) : log2_iter seed 0 = seed
proof: := rfl

name: log2_iter_succ
statement: theorem log2_iter_succ (seed n) : log2_iter seed (n + 1) = log2_iter seed.log2 n
proof: := rfl

name: log2_iter_add
statement:
theorem log2_iter_add (seed n) :
    ∀ k, log2_iter seed (n + k) = log2_iter (log2_iter seed k) n
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by rw [← n.add_assoc, log2_iter_succ, log2_iter_succ, log2_iter_add]

name: log2_iter_lt_iff
statement:
theorem log2_iter_lt_iff {seed} (hk : 0 < k) : ∀ {n}, log2_iter seed n < k ↔ seed < P k n
  | 0 => Iff.rfl
  | n + 1 => by rw [P_succ', log2_iter, log2_iter_lt_iff hk,
      log2_lt_iff₂ (P_pos_of_seed hk n)]

name: log2_iter_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem log2_iter_eq_zero_iff : log2_iter seed n = 0 ↔ seed < P 1 n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← log2_iter_lt_iff Nat.one_pos, Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.le_zero]

name: log2_iter_monotone_seed
statement:
theorem log2_iter_monotone_seed (h : seed₁ ≤ seed₂) :
    ∀ n, log2_iter seed₁ n ≤ log2_iter seed₂ n
  | 0 => h
  | n + 1 => log2_iter_monotone_seed (log2_monotone h) n

name: log2_iter_le_self
statement:
theorem log2_iter_le_self (seed) : ∀ n, log2_iter seed n ≤ seed
  | 0 => seed.le_refl
  | n + 1 => Nat.le_trans (log2_iter_le_self seed.log2 n) (Nat.log2_le_self seed)

name: log2_antitone_iter
statement: theorem log2_antitone_iter (seed) (h : m ≤ n) : log2_iter seed n ≤ log2_iter seed m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h, log2_iter_add]; exact log2_iter_le_self _ _

name: append_left
statement:
theorem append_left (h : isReachable l₁ l₂) : ∀ l, isReachable (l ++ l₁) (l ++ l₂)
  | [] => h
  | k :: l => cons_left (append_left h l) k

name: append_left_right
statement:
theorem append_left_right (h : isReachable l₁ l₂) (l l') :
    isReachable (l ++ l₁ ++ l') (l ++ l₂ ++ l')
proof:
:=
  append_right (append_left h l) l'

name: type1_repeat
statement:
theorem type1_repeat (k m) : ∀ n, isReachable [k + n, m] [k, m + 2 * n]
  | 0 => refl [k, m]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, ← m.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_comm]
      exact (type1_move _ _).trans (type1_repeat _ _ n)

name: type1_repeat_zero
statement: theorem type1_repeat_zero (n) : isReachable [n, 0] [0, 2 * n]
proof:
:= by
  have h := type1_repeat 0 0 n; rwa [n.zero_add, Nat.zero_add] at h

name: two_pow
statement:
theorem two_pow₁ (k n m) : ∀ c, isReachable [k + c, n + m, n] [k, n + 2 ^ c * m, n]
  | 0 => by rw [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.one_mul]; exact refl _
  | c + 1 => by
      rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]
      exact (cons_left (type1_repeat _ _ _) _).trans
        ((type2_move _ _ _).trans (two_pow₁ _ _ _ _))

name: two_pow
statement: theorem two_pow₂ (k n c) : isReachable [k + (c + 1), n, n] [k, n + 2 ^ (c + 1), n]
proof:
:=
  (append_right (type1_move _ _) [n]).trans (two_pow₁ _ _ _ _)

name: two_pow
statement: theorem two_pow₃ (k n) (hc : 0 < c) : isReachable [k + c, n, n] [k, n + 2 ^ c, n]
proof:
:=
  Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hc ▸ two_pow₂ k n c.pred

name: two_pow_iter
statement:
theorem two_pow_iter₁ (k n) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∀ c, isReachable [k + c, n + m, n, n] [k, n + P m c, n, n]
  | 0 => refl _
  | Nat.succ c => (cons_left (two_pow₃ _ _ hm) _).trans <|
      (append_right (type2_move _ _ _) [n]).trans (two_pow_iter₁ k n m.two_pow_pos c)

name: two_pow_iter
statement:
theorem two_pow_iter₂ (k n c) :
    isReachable [k + (c + 1), n, n, n] [k, n + P 1 (c + 1), n, n]
proof:
:=
  (append_right (type1_move _ _) _).trans (two_pow_iter₁ k n Nat.two_pos _)

name: two_pow_iter
statement:
theorem two_pow_iter₃ (k n) (hc : 0 < c) :
    isReachable [k + c, n, n, n] [k, n + P 1 c, n, n]
proof:
:=
  Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hc ▸ two_pow_iter₂ k n c.pred

name: two_pow_iter
statement: theorem two_pow_iter₄ (n) (hc : 0 < c) : isReachable [c, n, n, n] [0, n + P 1 c, n, n]
proof:
:= by
  have h := two_pow_iter₃ 0 n hc; rwa [c.zero_add] at h

name: type2_repeat_drain
statement:
theorem type2_repeat_drain₀ (k n) : ∀ c, isReachable [k + c, n, n] [k, n, n]
  | 0 => refl _
  | c + 1 => (type2_move (k + c) n n).trans (type2_repeat_drain₀ k n c)

name: type2_repeat_drain
statement: theorem type2_repeat_drain (n) (h : k ≤ m) : isReachable [m, n, n] [k, n, n]
proof:
:=
  Nat.add_sub_of_le h ▸ type2_repeat_drain₀ k n (m - k)

name: replicate_ones_to_3
statement:
theorem replicate_ones_to_3₀ :
    ∀ n, isReachable (replicate (n + 2) 1) (0 :: 3 :: replicate n 0)
  | 0 => type1_move 0 1
  | n + 1 => (cons_left (replicate_ones_to_3₀ n) _).trans
      (append_right (type2_move 0 0 3) (replicate n 0))

name: replicate_ones_to_3
statement:
theorem replicate_ones_to_3₁ (n) :
    isReachable (replicate (n + 2) 1) (0 :: 3 :: replicate n 1)
proof:
:=
  append_right (type1_move 0 1) (replicate n 1)

name: cons_replicate4_to_P
statement:
theorem cons_replicate4_to_P₀ (n) (hN : 0 < N) :
    isReachable [N, n, n, n, n] [0, 0, n + P 1 (n + P 1 N), n, n]
proof:
:=
  (append_right (two_pow_iter₄ n hN) [n]).trans
    (cons_left (two_pow_iter₄ n (Nat.add_pos_right _ (P_pos_of_seed Nat.one_pos N))) 0)

name: cons_replicate4_to_P
statement:
theorem cons_replicate4_to_P (n) (hN : 0 < N) :
    isReachable [N, n, n, n, n] [0, 0, P 1 (P 1 N), n, n]
proof:
:=
  suffices P 1 (P 1 N) ≤ n + P 1 (n + P 1 N) from
    (cons_replicate4_to_P₀ n hN).trans (append_left (type2_repeat_drain n this) [0, 0])
  Nat.le_trans (P_monotone_iter 1 ((P 1 N).le_add_left n)) (Nat.le_add_left _ n)

name: type1_double_repeat
statement: theorem type1_double_repeat (a b c N) : isReachable [a + N, b, c] [a, b, c + 4 * N]
proof:
:=
  Nat.mul_assoc 2 2 N ▸ (append_right (type1_repeat a b N) [c]).trans
    (cons_left (type1_repeat b c (2 * N)) a)

name: type1_double_repeat_a_eq_zero
statement: theorem type1_double_repeat_a_eq_zero (b c N) : isReachable [N, b, c] [0, b, c + 4 * N]
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using type1_double_repeat 0 b c N

name: Nadd2_zero_zero_to_4Nadd5
statement: theorem Nadd2_zero_zero_to_4Nadd5 (N) : isReachable [N + 2, 0, 0] [0, 0, 4 * N + 5]
proof:
:= by
  apply (append_right (type1_move (N + 1) 0) [0]).trans
  apply (cons_left (type1_move 1 0) (N + 1)).trans
  apply (type2_move N 1 2).trans
  apply (type1_double_repeat_a_eq_zero 2 1 N).trans
  exact (4 * N).add_comm 1 ▸ cons_left (type1_repeat 0 (4 * N + 1) 2) 0

name: Nadd2_zero_zero_to_4Nadd2
statement: theorem Nadd2_zero_zero_to_4Nadd2 (N) : isReachable [N + 2, 0, 0] [0, 0, 4 * N + 2]
proof:
:= by
  apply (append_right (type1_move (N + 1) 0) [0]).trans
  apply (type2_move N 2 0).trans
  exact (4 * N).add_comm 2 ▸ type1_double_repeat_a_eq_zero 0 2 N

name: Nadd5_zero_zero_to_4Nadd22
statement: theorem Nadd5_zero_zero_to_4Nadd22 (N) : isReachable [N + 5, 0, 0] [0, 0, 4 * N + 22]
proof:
:= by
  apply (two_pow₃ (N + 1) 0 (Nat.succ_pos 3)).trans
  apply (cons_left (type1_repeat 14 0 2) (N + 1)).trans
  apply (type2_move N 14 4).trans
  apply (cons_left (type1_repeat 0 14 4) N).trans
  exact (4 * N).add_comm 22 ▸ type1_double_repeat_a_eq_zero 0 22 N

name: N_one_one_to_4Nadd3
statement: theorem N_one_one_to_4Nadd3 (N) : isReachable [N, 1, 1] [0, 0, 4 * N + 3]
proof:
:=
  (cons_left (type1_move 0 1) N).trans <|
    (4 * N).add_comm 3 ▸ type1_double_repeat_a_eq_zero 0 3 N

name: three_stack_0mod4
statement:
theorem three_stack_0mod4 (N) (hA : A % 4 = 0) (h : A < 4 * N) :
    isReachable [N, 0, 0] [0, 0, A]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← A.div_add_mod 4, Nat.add_comm, hA]
  exact (type2_repeat_drain 0 (Nat.div_le_of_le_mul (Nat.le_of_lt h))).trans
    (type1_double_repeat_a_eq_zero 0 0 (A / 4))

name: three_stack_1mod4
statement:
theorem three_stack_1mod4 (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hA : A % 4 = 1) (hA0 : A ≠ 1) (h : A < 4 * N) :
    isReachable [N, 0, 0] [0, 0, A]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N', rfl⟩ : ∃ N', N = N' + 2 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hN
  obtain ⟨A', h0, rfl⟩ : ∃ A', A' ≤ N' ∧ A = 4 * A' + 5 := by
    refine ⟨A / 4 - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Nat.mul_comm, ← Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.succ_pos 3), Nat.lt_succ_iff] at h
      exact Nat.sub_le_of_le_add h
    · rw [← A.div_add_mod 4, hA, Ne, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hA0
      replace hA0 := (Nat.mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hA0).2
      change A = 4 * (A / 4 - 1 + 1) + 1
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.ne_zero_iff_zero_lt.mp hA0), ← hA, A.div_add_mod]
  exact (type2_repeat_drain 0 (Nat.add_le_add_right h0 2)).trans
    (Nadd2_zero_zero_to_4Nadd5 A')

name: three_stack_2mod4
statement:
theorem three_stack_2mod4 (hN : 6 ≤ N) (hA : A % 4 = 2) (h : A < 4 * N) :
    isReachable [N, 0, 0] [0, 0, A]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← A.div_add_mod 4, hA]
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ : ∃ N', N'.succ = N :=
    ⟨N.pred, Nat.sub_one_add_one_eq_of_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hN)⟩
  rw [Nat.mul_comm, ← Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.succ_pos 3), Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  
  · refine (type2_repeat_drain 0 ?_).trans (Nadd2_zero_zero_to_4Nadd2 (A / 4))
    rwa [Nat.succ_le_succ_iff, Nat.succ_le_iff]
  
  · rw [h]; clear A hA h
    rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' (Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.mp hN) with ⟨K, rfl⟩
    rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_assoc]
    exact (type2_move (K + 5) 0 0).trans (Nadd5_zero_zero_to_4Nadd22 K)

name: three_stack_3mod4
statement:
theorem three_stack_3mod4 (N) (hA : A % 4 = 3) (h : A < 4 * N) :
    isReachable [N, 1, 1] [0, 0, A]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_comm, ← Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.succ_pos 3)] at h
  rw [← A.div_add_mod 4, hA]
  exact (type2_repeat_drain 1 (Nat.le_of_succ_le h)).trans (N_one_one_to_4Nadd3 _)

name: three_stack_of_bdd
statement:
theorem three_stack_of_bdd (hN : 6 ≤ N) (hL₀ : isReachable L [0, 0, 0, N, 0, 0])
    (hL₁ : isReachable L [0, 0, 0, N, 1, 1]) (h : A ≠ 1) (h0 : A < 4 * N) :
    isReachable L (replicate 5 0 ++ [A])
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : A % 4 < 4 := A.mod_lt (Nat.succ_pos 3)
  iterate 3 rw [Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq] at h1
  
  rcases h1 with ((h1 | h1) | h1) | h1
  · rw [Nat.lt_one_iff] at h1
    exact hL₀.trans (append_left (three_stack_0mod4 N h1 h0) [0, 0, 0])
  · replace hN : 2 ≤ N := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left 2 4) hN
    exact hL₀.trans (append_left (three_stack_1mod4 hN h1 h h0) [0, 0, 0])
  · exact hL₀.trans (append_left (three_stack_2mod4 hN h1 h0) [0, 0, 0])
  · exact hL₁.trans (append_left (three_stack_3mod4 N h1 h0) [0, 0, 0])

name: six_stack_of_bdd
statement:
theorem six_stack_of_bdd (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hL₀ : isReachable L (0 :: N :: replicate 4 0))
    (hL₁ : isReachable L (0 :: N :: replicate 4 1)) (hA : A < 4 * P 1 (P 1 N)) :
    isReachable L (replicate 5 0 ++ [A])
proof:
:= by
  obtain h0 | rfl : A ≠ 1 ∨ A = 1 := (Decidable.em _).symm
  
  · have X (n) := cons_left (cons_replicate4_to_P n (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hN)) 0
    refine three_stack_of_bdd ?_ (hL₀.trans (X 0)) (hL₁.trans (X 1)) h0 hA
    exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left 6 65530) (P_monotone_iter 1 (P_monotone_iter 1 hN))
  
  · refine hL₁.trans (append_left_right (?_ : isReachable [N, 1, 1, 1] _) [0] [1])
    apply (cons_left (replicate_ones_to_3₀ 1) N).trans
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hN]
    apply (append_right (type2_move _ 0 3) [0]).trans
    apply (cons_left (type2_repeat_drain₀ 0 0 3) _).trans
    exact append_right (type2_repeat_drain 0 (Nat.zero_le _)) [0]

name: six_stack_of_bdd_log
statement:
theorem six_stack_of_bdd_log (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hL₀ : isReachable L (0 :: N :: replicate 4 0))
    (hL₁ : isReachable L (0 :: N :: replicate 4 1)) (hA : log2_iter (A / 4) (P 1 N) = 0) :
    isReachable L (replicate 5 0 ++ [A])
proof:
:=
  six_stack_of_bdd hN hL₀ hL₁ <| by
    rwa [Nat.mul_comm, ← Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.succ_pos 3), ← log2_iter_eq_zero_iff]

name: replicate6_ones_to_A
statement:
theorem replicate6_ones_to_A (hA : log2_iter (A / 4) 16 = 0) :
    isReachable (replicate 6 1) (replicate 5 0 ++ [A])
proof:
:=
  six_stack_of_bdd_log (Nat.le_succ 2) (replicate_ones_to_3₀ 4) (replicate_ones_to_3₁ 4) hA

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    isReachable (replicate 6 1) (replicate 5 0 ++ [2010 ^ 2010 ^ 2010])
proof:
:= by
  refine isReachable.replicate6_ones_to_A (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero ?_)
  generalize hM : 2010 = M 
  replace hM : M ≤ 2 ^ 11 := hM ▸ Nat.le_add_right 2010 38
  calc
    _ ≤ log2_iter (2 ^ (11 * M ^ M)) 16 := by
      refine log2_iter_monotone_seed (Nat.le_trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _) ?_) 16
      rw [Nat.pow_mul]; exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left hM (M ^ M)
    _ = log2_iter (11 * M ^ M) 15 := by rw [log2_iter_succ, log2_two_pow]
    _ ≤ log2_iter (2 ^ (4 + 11 * M)) 15 := by
      refine log2_iter_monotone_seed ?_ 15
      rw [Nat.pow_add, Nat.pow_mul]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_right 11 5) (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hM M)
    _ = log2_iter (4 + 11 * M) 14 := by rw [log2_iter_succ, log2_two_pow]
    _ ≤ log2_iter (2 ^ 15) 14 :=
      log2_iter_monotone_seed (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 11 hM) 4) 14
    _ = 0 := rfl

name: abs_le_max_range_sup'
statement:
theorem abs_le_max_range_sup' (a : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ) :
    |a n| ≤ max ((range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (-a))
      (2 • (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_max_iff]; refine (le_total (a n) 0).imp (λ h ↦ ?_) (λ h ↦ ?_)
  · exact (abs_of_nonpos h).trans_le (le_sup' (-a) (self_mem_range_succ _))
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg h, two_nsmul]
    have h0 : a n ≤ (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a :=
      le_sup' a (self_mem_range_succ _)
    exact le_add_of_le_of_nonneg h0 (h.trans h0)

name: good1_bdd_above
statement:
theorem good1_bdd_above {a : ℕ → G} (h : good1 D a) (h0 : D ≤ n) :
    a (n + 1) ≤ (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (-a)
      - (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, h2, h1⟩ :
      ∃ i ∈ range (n + 1), (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a = a i :=
    exists_mem_eq_sup' nonempty_range_add_one a
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, n = i + j := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (mem_range_succ_iff.mp h2)
  apply (h i j h0).trans
  rw [h1, neg_add_rev, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_le_sub_iff_right]
  exact le_sup' (-a) (mem_range_succ_iff.mpr (Nat.le_add_left j i))

name: good1_range_sup'
statement:
theorem good1_range_sup' {a : ℕ → G} (h : good1 D a) (h0 : D ≤ n) :
    (range (n + 2)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a ≤
      max ((range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a)
        ((range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (-a)
          - (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [range_add_one (n := n + 1), sup'_insert nonempty_range_add_one, max_comm (a _)]
  refine max_le_max (le_refl _) (good1_bdd_above h h0)

name: good2_bdd_below
statement:
theorem good2_bdd_below {a : ℕ → G} (h : good2 D a) (h0 : D ≤ n) :
    -a (n + 1) ≤ 2 • (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a
proof:
:= by
  rcases h n h0 with ⟨i, j, rfl, h0⟩
  rw [h0, neg_neg, two_nsmul]
  exact add_le_add (le_sup' a (mem_range_succ_iff.mpr (Nat.le_add_right i j)))
    (le_sup' a (mem_range_succ_iff.mpr (Nat.le_add_left j i)))

name: good2_range_sup'
statement:
theorem good2_range_sup' {D : ℕ} {a : ℕ → G} (h : good2 D a) {n : ℕ} (h0 : D ≤ n) :
    (range (n + 2)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (-a)
      ≤ max ((range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (-a))
        (2 • (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [range_add_one (n := n + 1), sup'_insert nonempty_range_add_one, max_comm ((-a) _)]
  exact max_le_max (le_refl _) (good2_bdd_below h h0)

name: c_bdd
statement:
theorem c_bdd (h2 : D ≤ K) (h3 : c K ≤ 2 • b K) :
    b (K + 1) = b K ∧ c (K + 1) ≤ 2 • b (K + 1)
proof:
:= by
  suffices b K = b (K + 1) from ⟨this.symm, (h0 K h2).trans_eq (this ▸ max_eq_right h3)⟩
  rw [two_nsmul, ← sub_le_iff_le_add] at h3
  exact (h1 K.le_succ).antisymm ((h K h2).trans_eq (max_eq_left h3))

name: c_succ_eq_D_of_b_bdd
statement:
theorem c_succ_eq_D_of_b_bdd (h2 : Monotone c) (h3 : D ≤ K) :
    2 • b K < c K → c (K + 1) = c D
proof:
:= by
  have X {M : ℕ} : D ≤ M → 2 • b M < c M → c (M + 1) = c M := λ h3 h4 ↦
    ((h0 M h3).trans_eq (max_eq_left_of_lt h4)).antisymm (h2 M.le_succ)
  refine Nat.le_induction (X D.le_refl) (λ n h4 h5 h6 ↦ ?_) K h3
  rw [X (Nat.le_succ_of_le h4) h6]
  exact h5 (lt_of_not_ge λ h7 ↦ h6.not_ge (c_bdd h h0 h1 h4 h7).2)

name: max_two_nsmul_b_and_c_bdd
statement:
theorem max_two_nsmul_b_and_c_bdd (h2 : Monotone c) (n : ℕ) :
    max (c n) (2 • b n) ≤ max (2 • b D) (2 • (c D - b D))
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : max (c D) (2 • b D) ≤ max (2 • b D) (2 • (c D - b D)) := by
    refine max_le (le_max_of_two_nsmul_le_add ?_) (le_max_left _ _)
    rw [← nsmul_add, add_sub_cancel]
  refine (le_total n D).elim 
    (λ h4 ↦ h3.trans' (max_le_max (h2 h4) (nsmul_le_nsmul_right (h1 h4) 2)))
    (Nat.le_induction h3 (λ n h4 h5 ↦ ?_) n)
  rcases le_or_gt (c n) (2 • b n) with h6 | h6
  
  · rcases c_bdd h h0 h1 h4 h6 with ⟨h7, h8⟩
    rwa [max_eq_right h8, h7, ← max_eq_right h6]
  
  · have h7 := c_succ_eq_D_of_b_bdd h h0 h1 h2 h4 h6
    refine max_le (h7 ▸ h3.trans' (le_max_left _ _))
      (le_max_of_le_right <| nsmul_le_nsmul_right ((h _ h4).trans ?_) 2)
    rw [two_nsmul, ← lt_sub_iff_add_lt] at h6
    rw [max_eq_right h6.le, ← h7]
    exact sub_le_sub (h2 n.le_succ) (h1 h4)

name: range_sup'_monotone
statement:
theorem range_sup'_monotone [LinearOrder α] (f : ℕ → α) :
    Monotone (λ n ↦ (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one f)
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ hmn ↦ sup'_mono _ (range_subset_range.mpr (Nat.succ_le_succ hmn)) _

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {a : ℕ → G} (h : good1 D a) (h0 : good2 D a) (n : ℕ) :
    |a n| ≤ max (2 • (range (D + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a)
      (2 • ((range (D + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (-a)
        - (range (D + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a))
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_le_max_range_sup' a n).trans ?_
  exact max_two_nsmul_b_and_c_bdd (G := G)
    (b := λ n ↦ ((range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one a))
    (c := λ n ↦ ((range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one (-a)))
    (λ _ ↦ good1_range_sup' h) (λ _ ↦ good2_range_sup' h0)
    (range_sup'_monotone _) (range_sup'_monotone _) n

name: iterate_add_mul_eq
statement:
lemma iterate_add_mul_eq {S : Type*} {f : S → S} (h : f^[n + k] = f^[n]) :
    ∀ t, f^[n + k * t] = f^[n]
  | 0 => rfl
  | t + 1 => by rw [k.mul_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc, f.iterate_add,
               iterate_add_mul_eq h t, ← f.iterate_add, h]

name: range_iter_two_eq_of_exists_iter_eq_self
statement:
theorem range_iter_two_eq_of_exists_iter_eq_self
    {f : S → S} (h : 2 ≤ m) (h0 : f^[m] = f) :
    Set.range f^[2] = Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  apply (Set.range_comp_subset_range f f).antisymm
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  nth_rw 1 [← h0, f.iterate_add]; exact Set.range_comp_subset_range _ _

name: exists_lt_iterate_eq
statement: theorem exists_lt_iterate_eq (f : S → S) : ∃ a b, a < b ∧ f^[a] = f^[b]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, h, h0⟩ : ∃ a b : ℕ, a ≠ b ∧ f^[a] = f^[b] :=
    Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite _
  exact h.lt_or_gt.elim (λ h ↦ ⟨a, b, h, h0⟩) (λ h ↦ ⟨b, a, h, h0.symm⟩)

name: exists_iterate_idempotent
statement:
theorem exists_iterate_idempotent (f : S → S) :
    ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ f^[2 * n] = f^[n]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, h, h0⟩ := exists_lt_iterate_eq f
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h.le with ⟨c, rfl⟩
  rw [Nat.lt_add_right_iff_pos] at h
  refine ⟨c * a.succ, Nat.mul_pos h a.succ_pos, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.two_mul]; refine iterate_add_mul_eq ?_ _
  obtain ⟨k, h1⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le
    (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left a.succ h)
  rw [h1, Nat.add_right_comm, f.iterate_add, Nat.succ_add,
    f.iterate_succ, ← h0, ← f.iterate_succ, f.iterate_add]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (h : ∀ g : S → S, f ∘ g ∘ f = g ∘ f ∘ g → g = f) :
    Set.range f^[2] = Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_iterate_idempotent f with ⟨n, h0, h1⟩
  refine range_iter_two_eq_of_exists_iter_eq_self
    (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left h0) (h _ ?_)
  rw [← f.iterate_succ', ← f.iterate_add]
  change (f ∘ f^[n]) ∘ f^[2] = f^[n + 1 + n] ∘ f^[2]
  rw [Nat.succ_add, ← Nat.two_mul, f.iterate_succ' (2 * n), h1]

name: nice_one_cons
statement:
theorem nice_one_cons {S : Multiset ℚ} (h : nice S) : nice (1 ::ₘ S) where
  pos
proof:
:= forall_mem_cons.mpr ⟨one_pos, h.pos⟩
  sum_eq_int := by
    obtain ⟨k, h0⟩ := h.sum_eq_int
    use k + 1; rw [sum_cons, h0, Int.cast_add, add_comm, Int.cast_one]
  sum_inv_eq_int := by
    obtain ⟨k, h0⟩ := h.sum_inv_eq_int
    use k + 1; rw [map_cons, sum_cons, h0, Int.cast_add, add_comm, Int.cast_one, inv_one]

name: good_iff_of_spec
statement: theorem good_iff_of_spec (hn : ¬good n) (hn0 : good n.succ) : good k ↔ n.succ ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  have h {m} (hm : good m) : good m.succ := by
    refine Set.infinite_of_injOn_mapsTo (λ _ _ _ _ ↦ (cons_inj_right (1 : ℚ)).mp) ?_ hm
    rintro S ⟨h, h0⟩; exact ⟨h ▸ S.card_cons 1, nice_one_cons h0⟩
  replace h {m m'} (hm : good m) : m ≤ m' → good m' :=
    Nat.le_induction hm (λ _ _ ↦ h) m'
  exact ⟨λ h0 ↦ Nat.le_of_not_lt λ h1 ↦ hn (h h0 (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h1)), h hn0⟩

name: rat_inv_den
statement: theorem rat_inv_den {q : ℚ} (h : 0 < q) : (q⁻¹.den : ℤ) = q.num
proof:
:= by
  rw [q.inv_def, Rat.divInt_eq_div]
  exact Rat.den_div_eq_of_coprime (Rat.num_pos.mpr h) q.reduced.symm

name: den_eq_of_add_eq_int
statement: theorem den_eq_of_add_eq_int : ∀ {q r : ℚ} {k : ℤ}, q + r = k → q.den = r.den
proof:
:= by
  have h {q r : ℚ} {k : ℤ} (h : q + r = k) : q.den ∣ r.den := by
    have h0 := Rat.add_den_dvd k (-r)
    rwa [Rat.den_intCast, Nat.one_mul, Rat.neg_den, ← h, add_neg_cancel_right] at h0
  intro q r k h0; exact Nat.dvd_antisymm (h h0) (h ((r.add_comm q).trans h0))

name: nat_dvd_two_imp
statement: theorem nat_dvd_two_imp (hn : n ∣ 2) : n = 1 ∨ n = 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : n ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd Nat.two_pos hn
  rw [Nat.le_succ_iff, Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one] at h
  refine h.imp_left (Or.resolve_left · ?_)
  rintro rfl; exact absurd hn (of_decide_eq_false rfl)

name: setOf_nice_card_two_subseteq
statement:
theorem setOf_nice_card_two_subseteq :
    {S : Multiset ℚ | card S = 2 ∧ nice S} ⊆
      ({replicate 2 2⁻¹, replicate 2 1, replicate 2 2} : Finset (Multiset ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  
  rintro S ⟨hS', hS, ⟨k, hS0⟩, ⟨m, hS1⟩⟩
  simp only [card_eq_two, insert_eq_cons] at hS'
  rcases hS' with ⟨x, y, rfl⟩
  rw [sum_cons, sum_singleton] at hS0
  rw [map_cons, map_singleton, sum_cons, sum_singleton] at hS1
  
  have hx : 0 < x := hS x (mem_cons_self x _)
  obtain rfl : x = y := by
    have hy : 0 < y := hS y (mem_cons_of_mem (mem_singleton_self y))
    have h := den_eq_of_add_eq_int hS1
    rw [← Int.natCast_inj, rat_inv_den hx, rat_inv_den hy] at h
    exact Rat.ext h (den_eq_of_add_eq_int hS0)
  
  suffices x = (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ ∨ x = 1 ∨ x = 2 by
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    revert this; refine Or.imp (λ h ↦ ?_) (Or.imp (λ h ↦ ?_) (λ h ↦ ?_))
    all_goals subst x; rfl
  
  replace hS {y : ℚ} {k : ℤ} (hy : y + y = k) : y.den = 1 ∨ y.den = 2 := by
    rw [← mul_two, ← eq_div_iff_mul_eq two_ne_zero] at hy
    subst hy; rw [← Int.cast_two, ← Rat.divInt_eq_div]
    exact nat_dvd_two_imp (Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mp (Rat.den_dvd k 2))
  
  replace hS1 := hS hS1; rw [← Int.natCast_inj, ← Int.natCast_inj, rat_inv_den hx] at hS1
  replace hS0 := hS hS0; rcases hS0 with h0 | h0 <;> rcases hS1 with h1 | h1
  · right; left; exact Rat.ext h1 h0
  · right; right; exact Rat.ext h1 h0
  · left; rw [Rat.inv_def]; exact Rat.ext h1 h0
  · refine absurd x.reduced ?_
    rw [h0, h1]; exact Nat.ne_of_beq_eq_false rfl

name: not_good_two
statement: theorem not_good_two : ¬good 2
proof:
:=
  Set.not_infinite.mpr ((finite_toSet _).subset setOf_nice_card_two_subseteq)

name: fib_formula1
statement: theorem fib_formula1 : ∀ n, ((n + 1).fib ^ 2 : ℤ) = (n + 2).fib * n.fib + (-1) ^ n
proof:
:=
  Nat.rec rfl λ n hn ↦ calc
    _ = ((n + 2).fib : ℤ) * (n.fib + (n + 1).fib : ℕ) := by rw [sq, ← Nat.fib_add_two]
    _ = (n + 2).fib * n.fib + (n + 2).fib * (n + 1).fib := by rw [Nat.cast_add, mul_add]
    _ = (n + 1).fib ^ 2 + (n + 2).fib * (n + 1).fib - (-1) ^ n := by
      rw [hn, add_right_comm, add_sub_cancel_right]
    _ = (n + 3).fib * (n + 1).fib - (-1) ^ n := by
      rw [sub_left_inj, sq, Nat.fib_add_two (n := n + 1), Nat.cast_add, add_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← Int.mul_neg_one, pow_succ]

name: fib_formula2
statement: theorem fib_formula2 (n) : (2 * n + 2).fib ^ 2 + 1 = (2 * n + 3).fib * (2 * n + 1).fib
proof:
:= by
  have h := add_neg_eq_of_eq_add (fib_formula1 (2 * n + 1))
  rwa [← Int.mul_neg_one, ← pow_succ, ← Nat.mul_succ 2, pow_mul, neg_one_sq,
    one_pow, ← Nat.cast_pow, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_succ, Nat.cast_inj] at h

name: fib_formula3
statement:
theorem fib_formula3 (n) :
    (2 * n + 3).fib ^ 2 + (2 * n + 1).fib ^ 2 + 1
      = 3 * ((2 * n + 3).fib * (2 * n + 1).fib)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = ((2 * n + 1).fib + (2 * n + 2).fib) ^ 2 + (2 * n + 1).fib ^ 2 + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.fib_add_two]
  _ = 2 * (((2 * n + 1).fib + (2 * n + 2).fib) * (2 * n + 1).fib)
      + ((2 * n + 2).fib ^ 2 + 1) := by ring
  _ = _ := by rw [← Nat.fib_add_two, fib_formula2, ← Nat.succ_mul]

name: fib_formula4
statement:
theorem fib_formula4 (n) :
    ((2 * n + 1).fib.succ + 1) * (2 * n + 1).fib.succ
      + (2 * n + 3).fib.succ * ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ + 1)
      = 3 * ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ * (2 * n + 1).fib.succ)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = (2 * n + 3).fib ^ 2 + (2 * n + 1).fib ^ 2 + 1
      + 3 * (2 * n + 3).fib + 3 * ((2 * n + 1).fib + 1) := by
    rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]; ring
  _ = 3 * ((2 * n + 3).fib * (2 * n + 1).fib)
      + 3 * (2 * n + 3).fib + 3 * ((2 * n + 1).fib + 1) := by rw [fib_formula3]
  _ = _ := by rw [← Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.succ_mul]

name: fib_formula5
statement:
theorem fib_formula5 (n) :
    (((2 * n + 1).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / (2 * n + 3).fib.succ +
      ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ) / (2 * n + 1).fib.succ = 3
proof:
:= by
  have X (k : ℕ) : (k.fib.succ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
  calc
    _ = ((((2 * n + 1).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (2 * n + 1).fib.succ
          + (2 * n + 3).fib.succ * ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ))
        / ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ * (2 * n + 1).fib.succ) :=
      div_add_div _ _ (X _) (X _)
    _ = (((2 * n + 1).fib.succ + 1) * (2 * n + 1).fib.succ
          + (2 * n + 3).fib.succ * ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ + 1) : ℕ)
        / ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ * (2 * n + 1).fib.succ) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_add]
    _ = (3 * ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ * (2 * n + 1).fib.succ))
        / ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ * (2 * n + 1).fib.succ) := by
      rw [fib_formula4, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_mul]
    _ = 3 := mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (mul_ne_zero (X _) (X _))

name: fib_main_formula
statement:
theorem fib_main_formula (n) :
    (((2 * n + 3).fib.succ + (2 * n + 1).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / (2 * n + 3).fib.succ +
      ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ + (2 * n + 1).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ) / (2 * n + 1).fib.succ = 5
proof:
:=
  calc
  _ = ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ + ((2 * n + 1).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / (2 * n + 3).fib.succ
      + ((2 * n + 1).fib.succ + ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ)) / (2 * n + 1).fib.succ := by
    refine congrArg₂ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.cast_add]
    · rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.cast_add]
  _ = (1 + ((2 * n + 1).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ) / (2 * n + 3).fib.succ)
      + (1 + ((2 * n + 3).fib.succ + 1 : ℕ) / (2 * n + 1).fib.succ) := by
    have X (k : ℕ) : (k.fib.succ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
    rw [add_div, div_self (X _), add_div, div_self (X _)]
  _ = 5 := by rw [add_add_add_comm, fib_formula5]; norm_num

name: FibNatMultiset_pos
statement: theorem FibNatMultiset_pos {n q} (hq : q ∈ FibNatMultiset n) : 0 < q
proof:
:= by
  rw [FibNatMultiset, insert_eq_cons, mem_cons,
    insert_eq_cons, mem_cons, mem_singleton] at hq
  rcases hq with rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals exact Nat.succ_pos _

name: FibNatMultiset_sum_formula
statement:
theorem FibNatMultiset_sum_formula (n) :
    (FibNatMultiset n).sum = (2 * n + 3).fib.succ + ((2 * n + 1).fib.succ + 1)
proof: := rfl

name: FibNatMultiset_sum_pos
statement: theorem FibNatMultiset_sum_pos (n) : 0 < (FibNatMultiset n).sum
proof:
:=
  Nat.add_pos_left (Nat.succ_pos _) _

name: FibNatMultiset_sum_strictMono
statement: theorem FibNatMultiset_sum_strictMono : StrictMono λ n ↦ (FibNatMultiset n).sum
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h; replace h : 2 * m + 1 < 2 * n + 1 :=
    Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h Nat.two_pos)
  refine Nat.add_lt_add_right (Nat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le ?_ ?_) 2
  exacts [Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.fib_add_two_strictMono h), Nat.fib_mono h.le]

name: niceFibMultiset_card
statement: theorem niceFibMultiset_card (n) : card (niceFibMultiset n) = 3
proof: := rfl

name: niceFibMultiset_pos
statement: theorem niceFibMultiset_pos (n) : ∀ q ∈ niceFibMultiset n, 0 < q
proof:
:= by
  rw [niceFibMultiset, forall_mem_map_iff]
  exact λ q hq ↦ div_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (FibNatMultiset_pos hq))
    (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (FibNatMultiset_sum_pos n))

name: niceFibMultiset_sum_eq_one
statement: theorem niceFibMultiset_sum_eq_one (n) : (niceFibMultiset n).sum = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [niceFibMultiset, FibNatMultiset]
  simp only [insert_eq_cons, sum_cons, map_cons]
  rw [map_singleton, sum_singleton, sum_singleton,
    ← add_div, ← add_div, ← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.cast_add]
  exact div_self (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (FibNatMultiset_sum_pos n).ne.symm)

name: niceFibMultiset_inv_eq
statement:
theorem niceFibMultiset_inv_eq (n) :
    (niceFibMultiset n).map (·⁻¹) =
      {((FibNatMultiset n).sum : ℚ) / (2 * n + 3).fib.succ,
        ((FibNatMultiset n).sum : ℚ) / (2 * n + 1).fib.succ,
        ((FibNatMultiset n).sum : ℚ)}
proof:
:= calc
  _ = {(((2 * n + 3).fib.succ : ℚ) / (FibNatMultiset n).sum)⁻¹,
      (((2 * n + 1).fib.succ : ℚ) / (FibNatMultiset n).sum)⁻¹,
      ((1 : ℚ) / (FibNatMultiset n).sum)⁻¹} := rfl
  _ = _ := by simp only [inv_div]; rw [div_one]

name: niceFibMultiset_inv_sum_eq
statement:
theorem niceFibMultiset_inv_sum_eq (n) :
    ((niceFibMultiset n).map (·⁻¹)).sum = ((FibNatMultiset n).sum + 5 : ℕ)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = ((FibNatMultiset n).sum : ℚ) / (2 * n + 3).fib.succ
      + ((FibNatMultiset n).sum / (2 * n + 1).fib.succ + (FibNatMultiset n).sum) := by
    rw [niceFibMultiset_inv_eq, insert_eq_cons, sum_cons,
      insert_eq_cons, sum_cons, sum_singleton]
  _ = (FibNatMultiset n).sum + 5 := by
    rw [← add_assoc, add_comm _ 5, add_left_inj]
    exact fib_main_formula n
  _ = _ := by rw [Nat.cast_add]; rfl

name: niceFibMultiset_is_nice
statement:
theorem niceFibMultiset_is_nice (n) : nice (niceFibMultiset n) where
  pos
proof:
:= niceFibMultiset_pos n
  sum_eq_int := ⟨1, niceFibMultiset_sum_eq_one n⟩
  sum_inv_eq_int := ⟨_, niceFibMultiset_inv_sum_eq n⟩

name: niceFibMultiset_inj
statement: theorem niceFibMultiset_inj : Function.Injective niceFibMultiset
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h; apply congrArg (λ M ↦ (M.map (·⁻¹)).sum) at h
  rw [niceFibMultiset_inv_sum_eq, niceFibMultiset_inv_sum_eq, Nat.cast_inj] at h
  exact FibNatMultiset_sum_strictMono.injective (Nat.add_right_cancel h)

name: good_three
statement: theorem good_three : good 3
proof:
:=
  Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem niceFibMultiset_inj
    λ n ↦ ⟨niceFibMultiset_card n, niceFibMultiset_is_nice n⟩

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : good n ↔ 3 ≤ n
proof:
:=
  good_iff_of_spec not_good_two good_three

name: exists_eq_add_mul_of_le_of_mod_eq
statement:
theorem exists_eq_add_mul_of_le_of_mod_eq (h : m ≤ n) (h0 : m % p = n % p) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, n = m + p * r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q, n = m + q := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  replace h0 : (m + q - m) % p = 0 := Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq h0.symm
  rw [← Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at h0
  rcases h0 with ⟨r, rfl⟩; exact ⟨r, rfl⟩

name: exists_restricted_sq_mod_eq
statement:
theorem exists_restricted_sq_mod_eq (h : 0 < p) (h0 : ∃ x, x ^ 2 % p = k % p) :
    ∃ j > 0, j ≤ p ∧ (k.sqrt + j) ^ 2 % p = k % p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p', p = p' + 1 :=
    Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt h)
  clear h; rcases h0 with ⟨x, h⟩
  let y : ℕ := (x + p * (k.sqrt + 1)) % (p + 1) + 1
  refine ⟨y, Nat.succ_pos _, Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt _ p.succ_pos), ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mod_add_mod, Nat.add_assoc,
    ← Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, ← Nat.pow_mod, h]

name: exists_add_mul_eq_sqrt_add_sq_of_sq_mod
statement:
theorem exists_add_mul_eq_sqrt_add_sq_of_sq_mod (hp : 0 < p) (hk : ∃ x, x ^ 2 % p = k % p) :
    ∃ j > 0, j ≤ p ∧ ∃ m, (k.sqrt + j) ^ 2 = k + p * m
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_restricted_sq_mod_eq hp hk with ⟨j, hj, hj0, h⟩
  refine ⟨j, hj, hj0, exists_eq_add_mul_of_le_of_mod_eq (Nat.le_of_lt ?_) h.symm⟩
  rwa [← Nat.sqrt_lt', Nat.lt_add_right_iff_pos]

name: sqrt_add_lt_of_two_mul_lt
statement: theorem sqrt_add_lt_of_two_mul_lt (h : 0 < p) (h0 : 2 * p < k) : k.sqrt + p < k
proof:
:= by
  revert h0; revert k; apply Nat.le_induction
  
  · rw [Nat.two_mul, ← Nat.succ_add, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right, Nat.sqrt_lt, Nat.mul_succ,
      Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.lt_add_left_iff_pos]
    exact Nat.mul_pos h h
  
  · rintro k - hk0; refine Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (Nat.succ_lt_succ hk0)
    rw [← Nat.succ_add, Nat.add_le_add_iff_right]
    exact k.sqrt_succ_le_succ_sqrt

name: exists_add_mul_eq_small_sq_of_sq_mod
statement:
theorem exists_add_mul_eq_small_sq_of_sq_mod
    (hp : 0 < p) (hk : 2 * p < k) (hk0 : ∃ x, x ^ 2 % p = k % p) :
    ∃ x < k, ∃ m, x ^ 2 = k + p * m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, -, hj, h⟩ := exists_add_mul_eq_sqrt_add_sq_of_sq_mod hp hk0
  refine ⟨k.sqrt + j, ?_, h⟩
  exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.add_le_add_left hj _) (sqrt_add_lt_of_two_mul_lt hp hk)

name: sq_mod_eq_of_dvd_add
statement: theorem sq_mod_eq_of_dvd_add {p a b : ℕ} (h : p ∣ a + b) : a ^ 2 % p = b ^ 2 % p
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨n, h⟩
  obtain h0 | h0 : a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 ∨ b ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 := le_total (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2)
  · obtain ⟨m, h1⟩ : p ∣ b ^ 2 - a ^ 2 := by
      rw [Nat.sq_sub_sq, Nat.add_comm, h, p.mul_assoc]
      exact Nat.dvd_mul_right p _
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_cancel' h0, h1, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]
  · obtain ⟨m, h1⟩ : p ∣ a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by
      rw [Nat.sq_sub_sq, h, p.mul_assoc]
      exact Nat.dvd_mul_right p _
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_cancel' h0, h1, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]

name: lt_sub_self_of_sq_lt
statement: theorem lt_sub_self_of_sq_lt (hp : 2 < p) (h : x ^ 2 < p) : x < p - x
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.lt_sub_of_add_lt (x.two_mul ▸ Nat.lt_of_not_le λ h0 ↦ Nat.not_le_of_lt h ?_)
  replace h : 2 ≤ x := Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (a := 2) (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hp h0)
  rw [Nat.pow_two]; exact Nat.le_trans h0 (Nat.mul_le_mul_right x h)

name: exists_add_mul_eq_sq_of_small_sq_mod
statement:
theorem exists_add_mul_eq_sq_of_small_sq_mod
    (hp : 2 < p) (hk : k ≤ 2 * p) (h : ∃ x, x ^ 2 % p = k % p) :
    ∃ x ≤ p, ∃ m, x ^ 2 = k + p * m
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hp
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ : ∃ x < p, x ^ 2 % p = k % p := by
    rcases h with ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x % p, Nat.mod_lt x hp0, (Nat.pow_mod _ _ _).symm.trans hx⟩
  clear h; obtain h | ⟨m, rfl⟩ : k < p ∨ ∃ m, k = p + m :=
    (lt_or_ge k p).imp_right Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le
  
  · refine ⟨x, Nat.le_of_lt hx, exists_eq_add_mul_of_le_of_mod_eq ?_ hx0.symm⟩
    rw [← Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h, ← hx0]; exact Nat.mod_le _ _
  
  rw [Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left, Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq, or_comm] at hk
  rcases hk with rfl | hm
  · refine ⟨m, m.le_refl, m - 2, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.mul_two, ← m.mul_add,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt hp), Nat.pow_two]
  
  rw [Nat.add_mod_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm] at hx0
  clear hm; subst hx0
  obtain ⟨d, h⟩ : ∃ d, x ^ 2 = x ^ 2 % p + p * d := ⟨x ^ 2 / p, (Nat.mod_add_div _ _).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ | rfl : (∃ d', d = d' + 1) ∨ d = 0 :=
    (ne_or_eq d 0).imp_left Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero
  · refine ⟨x, Nat.le_of_lt hx, d, ?_⟩
    rw [p.add_comm, Nat.add_assoc, p.add_comm, ← p.mul_succ, ← h]
  · refine ⟨p - x, p.sub_le x, ?_⟩
    rw [p.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero, eq_comm, Nat.mod_eq_iff_lt (Nat.ne_of_gt hp0)] at h
    replace hx : (p - x) ^ 2 % p = x ^ 2 % p :=
      sq_mod_eq_of_dvd_add ⟨1, by rw [p.mul_one, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt hx)]⟩
    obtain ⟨d, h0⟩ : ∃ d, (p - x) ^ 2 = (p - x) ^ 2 % p + p * d :=
      ⟨(p - x) ^ 2 / p, (Nat.mod_add_div _ _).symm⟩
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d', d = d' + 1 := by
      refine Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero λ hd ↦ ?_
      subst d; rw [hx, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h, p.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero] at h0
      have h1 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (lt_sub_self_of_sq_lt hp h) (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)
      exact Nat.ne_of_gt h1 h0
    refine ⟨d, ?_⟩; rw [h0, hx, p.mul_succ, p.add_comm, Nat.add_assoc, p.add_comm]

name: f_sq
statement: theorem f_sq (p x) : f p (x ^ 2) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [f, Nat.sqrt_eq', ite_eq_left rfl]

name: f_iterate_zero
statement: theorem f_iterate_zero (p) : ∀ m, (f p)^[m] 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.rec rfl λ k hk ↦ by rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', hk]; rfl

name: f_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem f_eq_zero_iff {p k} : f p k = 0 ↔ k = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hk ↦ ?_, λ hk ↦ hk.symm ▸ rfl⟩
  unfold f at hk; split_ifs at hk with h
  · rwa [hk, Nat.pow_two, Nat.zero_mul, eq_comm] at h
  · exact Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_right hk

name: f_iterate_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem f_iterate_eq_zero_iff : (f p)^[m] k = 0 ↔ k = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec Iff.rfl (λ n hn ↦ ?_) m
  rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', f_eq_zero_iff, hn]

name: f_iterate_one
statement: theorem f_iterate_one (p) : ∀ m, (f p)^[m] 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.rec rfl λ k hk ↦ by rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', hk]; rfl

name: f_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem f_eq_one_iff {p k} : f p k = 1 ↔ k = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hk ↦ ?_, λ hk ↦ hk.symm ▸ rfl⟩
  unfold f at hk; split_ifs at hk with h
  · rwa [hk, Nat.one_pow, eq_comm] at h
  · rw [Nat.add_eq_one_iff] at hk
    rcases hk with ⟨rfl, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩
    exacts [absurd rfl h, rfl]

name: f_iterate_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem f_iterate_eq_one_iff : (f p)^[m] k = 1 ↔ k = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec Iff.rfl (λ n hn ↦ ?_) m
  rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', f_eq_one_iff, hn]

name: f_iterate_of_not_sq_mod
statement:
theorem f_iterate_of_not_sq_mod (h : ∀ x, x ^ 2 % p ≠ k % p) :
    ∀ m, (f p)^[m] k = k + p * m
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec rfl λ m hm ↦ ?_
  rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', hm, Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc]
  refine ite_eq_right λ h0 ↦ h (k + p * m).sqrt ?_
  rw [h0, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]

name: f_iterate_eq_or_exists_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem f_iterate_eq_or_exists_le_sqrt (p k) :
    ∀ m, (∃ n ≤ m, (f p)^[n] k ≤ (k + p * m).sqrt) ∨ (f p)^[m] k = k + p * m
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Nat.rec (Or.inr rfl) λ m hm ↦ ?_
  have X : (k + p * m).sqrt ≤ (k + p * m.succ).sqrt := by
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, ← k.add_assoc]; exact Nat.sqrt_le_sqrt (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  
  rcases hm with ⟨n, hn, hn0⟩ | hm
  · left; exact ⟨n, Nat.le_succ_of_le hn, Nat.le_trans hn0 X⟩
  
  refine (dec_em ((k + p * m).sqrt ^ 2 = k + p * m)).imp (λ h ↦ ?_) (λ h ↦ ?_)
  · refine ⟨m.succ, m.succ.le_refl, ?_⟩
    rwa [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', hm, f, ite_eq_left h]
  · rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', hm, f, ite_eq_right h, p.mul_succ, k.add_assoc]

name: exists_f_iterate_lt_self_of_big
statement:
theorem exists_f_iterate_lt_self_of_big
    (hp : 0 < p) (hk : 2 * p < k) (h : ∃ x, x ^ 2 % p = k % p) :
    ∃ n, (f p)^[n] k < k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, m, h0⟩ := exists_add_mul_eq_small_sq_of_sq_mod hp hk h
  obtain ⟨n, -, h1⟩ | h1 := f_iterate_eq_or_exists_le_sqrt p k m
  
  · rw [← h0, Nat.sqrt_eq'] at h1
    exact ⟨n, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hx⟩
  
  · refine ⟨m.succ, ?_⟩
    rwa [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', h1, ← h0, f_sq]

name: exists_f_iterate_le_p_of_small
statement:
theorem exists_f_iterate_le_p_of_small
    (hp : 2 < p) (hk : k ≤ 2 * p) (h : ∃ x, x ^ 2 % p = k % p) :
    ∃ n, (f p)^[n] k ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, m, h0⟩ := exists_add_mul_eq_sq_of_small_sq_mod hp hk h
  obtain ⟨n, -, h1⟩ | h1 := f_iterate_eq_or_exists_le_sqrt p k m
  
  · rw [← h0, Nat.sqrt_eq'] at h1
    exact ⟨n, Nat.le_trans h1 hx⟩
  
  · refine ⟨m.succ, ?_⟩
    rwa [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', h1, ← h0, f_sq]

name: dvd_of_dvd_f
statement: theorem dvd_of_dvd_f (h : p ∣ f p N) : p ∣ N
proof:
:= by
  unfold f at h; split_ifs at h with h0
  · rcases h with ⟨m, h⟩
    rw [← h0, Nat.pow_two, h, p.mul_assoc]
    exact Nat.dvd_mul_right p _
  · exact Nat.dvd_add_self_right.mp h

name: dvd_of_dvd_f_iterate
statement: theorem dvd_of_dvd_f_iterate (h : p ∣ (f p)^[k] N) : p ∣ N
proof:
:= by
  revert h; refine Nat.rec id (λ k hk h ↦ hk ?_) k
  rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply'] at h; exact dvd_of_dvd_f h

name: f_zero_left
statement: theorem f_zero_left (k) : f 0 k = if k.sqrt ^ 2 = k then k.sqrt else k
proof: := rfl

name: f_zero_left_le_self
statement: theorem f_zero_left_le_self (k) : f 0 k ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [f_zero_left]; split_ifs with h
  exacts [Nat.sqrt_le_self k, k.le_refl]

name: exists_f_one_iterate_le_two
statement: theorem exists_f_one_iterate_le_two (k) : ∃ n, (f 1)^[n] k ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  
  induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind k k_ih => ?_
  obtain h | h : k ≤ 2 ∨ 2 < k := le_or_gt k 2
  · exact ⟨0, h⟩
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, (f 1)^[m] k < k := by
    refine exists_f_iterate_lt_self_of_big Nat.one_pos h ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.mod_one, Nat.mod_one]
  
  obtain ⟨m', h0⟩ : ∃ m', (f 1)^[m'] ((f 1)^[m] k) ≤ 2 := k_ih _ hm
  refine ⟨m' + m, ?_⟩; rwa [(f 1).iterate_add_apply]

name: good_zero_right
statement: lemma good_zero_right (p) : good p 0
proof: := ⟨0, λ m ↦ ⟨m, m.le_refl, f_iterate_zero p m⟩⟩

name: good_one_right
statement: lemma good_one_right (p) : good p 1
proof: := ⟨1, λ m ↦ ⟨m, m.le_refl, f_iterate_one p m⟩⟩

name: good_f_iff
statement: lemma good_f_iff : good p (f p N) ↔ good p N
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_congr λ a ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h m; obtain ⟨n, hn, h0⟩ := h m
    exact ⟨n.succ, Nat.le_succ_of_le hn, h0⟩
  · intro h m; obtain ⟨n, hn, h0⟩ := h m.succ
    match n with
    | 0 => exact absurd hn m.not_succ_le_zero
    | n + 1 => exact ⟨n, Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hn, h0⟩

name: good_f_iterate_iff
statement: lemma good_f_iterate_iff : good p ((f p)^[k] N) ↔ good p N
proof:
:= by
  induction k with | zero => exact Iff.rfl | succ k h => ?_
  rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', good_f_iff, h]

name: not_good_of_not_sq_mod
statement: theorem not_good_of_not_sq_mod (hp : 0 < p) (h : ∀ x, x ^ 2 % p ≠ k % p) : ¬good p k
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
  have h0 := f_iterate_of_not_sq_mod h
  obtain ⟨n, -, rfl⟩ := ha 0
  obtain ⟨n', hn', h1⟩ := ha (n + 1)
  rw [h0, h0, Nat.add_left_cancel_iff, Nat.mul_right_inj (Nat.ne_of_gt hp)] at h1
  subst n'; exact Nat.not_lt_of_le hn' n.lt_succ_self

name: not_good_of_not_sq_mod_fin
statement:
theorem not_good_of_not_sq_mod_fin (hp : 0 < p) (h : ∀ x : Fin p, x ^ 2 % p ≠ k % p) :
    ¬good p k
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero p := ⟨Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hp⟩
  refine not_good_of_not_sq_mod hp λ x hx ↦ h (Fin.ofNat p x) ?_
  rw [Fin.val_ofNat, ← Nat.pow_mod, hx]

name: good.exists_mod_eq_sq
statement: theorem good.exists_mod_eq_sq (hp : 0 < p) (h : good p k) : ∃ x, x ^ 2 % p = k % p
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h0; exact not_good_of_not_sq_mod hp (not_exists.mp h0) h

name: good.exists_iterate_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem good.exists_iterate_le_two_mul (hp : 0 < p) (h : good p N) :
    ∃ k, (f p)^[k] N ≤ 2 * p
proof:
:= by
  
  induction N using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind N N_ih => ?_
  have hp0 : 0 < p := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hp
  have hN0 : ∃ x, x ^ 2 % p = N % p := h.exists_mod_eq_sq hp0
  obtain hN | hN : N ≤ 2 * p ∨ 2 * p < N := le_or_gt N (2 * p)
  · exact ⟨0, hN⟩
  
  obtain ⟨m, h0⟩ := exists_f_iterate_lt_self_of_big hp0 hN hN0
  obtain ⟨k, h1⟩ := N_ih _ h0 (good_f_iterate_iff.mpr h)
  refine ⟨k + m, ?_⟩; rwa [(f p).iterate_add_apply]

name: good.exists_iterate_le_p
statement:
theorem good.exists_iterate_le_p (hp : 2 < p) (h : good p N) :
    ∃ k, (f p)^[k] N ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  
  induction N using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind N N_ih => ?_
  have hp0 : 0 < p := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hp
  have hN0 : ∃ x, x ^ 2 % p = N % p := h.exists_mod_eq_sq hp0
  obtain hN | hN : N ≤ 2 * p ∨ 2 * p < N := le_or_gt N (2 * p)
  · exact exists_f_iterate_le_p_of_small hp hN hN0
  
  obtain ⟨m, h0⟩ := exists_f_iterate_lt_self_of_big hp0 hN hN0
  obtain ⟨k, h1⟩ := N_ih _ h0 (good_f_iterate_iff.mpr h)
  refine ⟨k + m, ?_⟩; rwa [(f p).iterate_add_apply]

name: good_zero_left
statement: theorem good_zero_left (k) : good 0 k
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind k k_ih => ?_
  obtain h | h : f 0 k < k ∨ f 0 k = k := Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (f_zero_left_le_self k)
  exacts [good_f_iff.mp (k_ih (f 0 k) h), ⟨k, λ m ↦ ⟨m, m.le_refl, (f 0).iterate_fixed h m⟩⟩]

name: good_one_left
statement: theorem good_one_left (k) : good 1 k
proof:
:= by
  
  induction k using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind k h0 => ?_
  obtain h | h : 2 < k ∨ k ≤ 2 := lt_or_ge 2 k
  
  · obtain ⟨m, h1⟩ : ∃ m, (f 1)^[m] k ≤ 2 := exists_f_one_iterate_le_two k
    exact good_f_iterate_iff.mp (h0 _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h))
  
  rw [Nat.le_succ_iff, Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one] at h
  rcases h with (rfl | rfl) | rfl
  · exact good_zero_right 1
  · exact good_one_right 1
  · replace h0 : (f 1)^[3] 2 = 2 := by unfold f; norm_num
    refine ⟨2, λ m ↦ ⟨3 * m, Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left m (Nat.succ_pos 2), ?_⟩⟩
    rw [(f 1).iterate_mul, Function.iterate_fixed h0]

name: squarefree.of_dvd
statement: lemma squarefree.of_dvd (hn : squarefree n) (hk : k ∣ n) : squarefree k
proof:
:=
  λ x hx ↦ hn x (Nat.dvd_trans hx hk)

name: three_is_squarefree
statement: lemma three_is_squarefree : squarefree 3
proof:
:= λ x hx ↦ by
  have X : 0 < 3 := Nat.succ_pos 2
  have h : x = 0 ∨ x = 1 := by
    have h : Nat.sqrt 3 = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [← Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one, ← h, Nat.le_sqrt']
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd X hx
  exact h.resolve_left (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left (Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hx X)))

name: zero_is_not_squarefree
statement: lemma zero_is_not_squarefree : ¬squarefree 0
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ Nat.zero_ne_one (h 0 (Nat.dvd_zero 0))

name: squarefree.ne_zero
statement: lemma squarefree.ne_zero : p ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ zero_is_not_squarefree (h ▸ hp)

name: squarefree.pos
statement: lemma squarefree.pos : 0 < p
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp.ne_zero

name: squarefree.dvd_sq_imp
statement: lemma squarefree.dvd_sq_imp (hk : p ∣ k ^ 2) : p ∣ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h : p = 0 ∨ 0 < p := p.eq_zero_or_pos
  · rw [Nat.zero_dvd, Nat.pow_eq_zero] at hk
    exact Nat.zero_dvd.mpr hk.1
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : p.gcd k ∣ p := p.gcd_dvd_left k
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : p.gcd k ∣ k := p.gcd_dvd_right k
    suffices a = 1 from ⟨b, by rwa [ha, this, Nat.mul_one]⟩
    suffices a ∣ p.gcd k by
      refine hp a ?_
      rw [Nat.pow_two, ha]
      exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_right this a
    replace hn : 0 < p.gcd k := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left k h
    replace h : a.Coprime b := by
      rw [Nat.Coprime, ← Nat.mul_right_inj (Nat.ne_of_gt hn),
        ← Nat.gcd_mul_left, ← ha, ← hb, Nat.mul_one]
    generalize p.gcd k = d at ha hb hn ⊢; subst p k
    rw [Nat.mul_pow, d.pow_two, d.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hn] at hk
    exact Nat.Coprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (h.pow_right 2) hk

name: squarefree.dvd_of_mul_eq_sq
statement: lemma squarefree.dvd_of_mul_eq_sq (hk : p * k = x ^ 2) : p ∣ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : p ∣ x := hp.dvd_sq_imp ⟨k, hk.symm⟩
  rw [Nat.mul_pow, p.pow_two, p.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_right_inj hp.ne_zero] at hk
  exact ⟨m ^ 2, hk⟩

name: squarefree.f_self
statement: lemma squarefree.f_self (h : p ≠ 1) : f p p = 2 * p
proof:
:= by
  refine p.two_mul ▸ ite_eq_right λ h0 ↦ absurd (hp p.sqrt ⟨1, ?_⟩) (λ h1 ↦ h ?_)
  · rw [h0, p.mul_one]
  · rwa [h1, Nat.one_pow, eq_comm] at h0

name: squarefree.f_iterate_self
statement: lemma squarefree.f_iterate_self (h : k < p) : (f p)^[k] p = p * (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with | zero => exact p.mul_one.symm | succ k hk => ?_
  rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply', hk (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt h), p.mul_succ (k + 1)]
  exact ite_eq_right λ h0 ↦ Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt k.succ_pos h (hp.dvd_of_mul_eq_sq h0.symm)

name: squarefree.f_iterate_self_self
statement: lemma squarefree.f_iterate_self_self : (f p)^[p] p = p
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (f p) (hp.f_iterate_self (Nat.pred_lt hp.ne_zero))
  rw [← (f p).iterate_succ_apply', ← Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.succ_pred hp.ne_zero] at h
  rw [h, ← Nat.pow_two, f, Nat.sqrt_eq', ite_eq_left rfl]

name: squarefree.good_self
statement: lemma squarefree.good_self : good p p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨p, λ m ↦ ⟨p * m, Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left m hp.pos, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [(f p).iterate_mul, Function.iterate_fixed hp.f_iterate_self_self m]

name: squarefree.good_two_mul
statement: lemma squarefree.good_two_mul : good p (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h : p = 1 ∨ p ≠ 1 := dec_em (p = 1)
  · exact good_one_left 2
  · rw [← hp.f_self h, good_f_iff]; exact hp.good_self

name: squarefree.dvd_f_of_dvd
statement: lemma squarefree.dvd_f_of_dvd (h : p ∣ N) : p ∣ f p N
proof:
:= by
  unfold f; split_ifs with h0
  exacts [hp.dvd_sq_imp (h0.symm ▸ h), Nat.dvd_add_self_right.mpr h]

name: squarefree.dvd_f_iterate_of_dvd
statement: lemma squarefree.dvd_f_iterate_of_dvd (h : p ∣ N) : ∀ k, p ∣ (f p)^[k] N
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec h λ n ↦ ?_
  rw [(f p).iterate_succ_apply']; exact hp.dvd_f_of_dvd

name: squarefree.good_of_dvd
statement: theorem squarefree.good_of_dvd (hN : p ∣ N) : good p N
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases hN with ⟨N, rfl⟩
  induction N using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind N N_ih => ?_
  obtain h | h : 2 < N ∨ N ≤ 2 := lt_or_ge 2 N
  
  · obtain ⟨m, h0⟩ : ∃ m, (f p)^[m] (p * N) < p * N := by
      refine exists_f_iterate_lt_self_of_big hp.pos ?_ ⟨0, ?_⟩
      · rwa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hp.pos]
      · rw [Nat.pow_two, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_mod, Nat.mul_mod_right]
    obtain ⟨N', h1⟩ : p ∣ (f p)^[m] (p * N) := hp.dvd_f_iterate_of_dvd ⟨N, rfl⟩ m
    rw [h1, Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hp.pos] at h0
    rw [← good_f_iterate_iff (k := m), h1]
    exact N_ih N' h0
  
  rw [Nat.le_succ_iff, Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one] at h
  rcases h with (rfl | rfl) | rfl
  · rw [p.mul_zero]; exact good_zero_right p
  · rw [p.mul_one]; exact hp.good_self
  · rw [p.mul_comm]; exact hp.good_two_mul

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution : good 3 N ↔ N = 1 ∨ 3 ∣ N
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hN ↦ ?_, λ hN ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · obtain ⟨k, h⟩ : ∃ k, (f 3)^[k] N ≤ 3 := hN.exists_iterate_le_p (Nat.lt_succ_self 2)
    rw [Nat.le_succ_iff, Nat.le_succ_iff, Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one] at h
    rcases h with ((h | h) | h) | h
    · right; exact ⟨0, f_iterate_eq_zero_iff.mp h⟩
    · left; exact f_iterate_eq_one_iff.mp h
    · rw [← good_f_iterate_iff (k := k), h] at hN
      refine absurd hN (not_good_of_not_sq_mod_fin (Nat.succ_pos 2) ?_)
      decide
    · right; exact dvd_of_dvd_f_iterate ⟨1, h⟩
  
  · rcases hN with rfl | hN
    exacts [good_one_right 3, three_is_squarefree.good_of_dvd hN]

name: sum_neg_one_pow_Ico
statement:
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_Ico (a : ℕ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (Ico a (a + n)).sum ((-1 : ℤ) ^ ·) = bif n.bodd then (-1 : ℤ) ^ a else 0
  | 0 => by rw [add_zero, Ico_self]; rfl
  | 1 => by rw [Nat.Ico_succ_singleton, sum_singleton]; rfl
  | n + 2 => by
      have h : a ≤ a + n
proof:
:= a.le_add_right n
      rw [← add_assoc, sum_Ico_succ_top (h.trans (a + n).le_succ),
        pow_succ', neg_one_mul, sum_Ico_succ_top h, sum_neg_one_pow_Ico a n,
        add_neg_cancel_right, Nat.bodd_add, Nat.bodd_two, Bool.xor_false]

name: disjiUnion_weight_eq
statement:
theorem disjiUnion_weight_eq {I : Finset ι} (h : (I : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint F) :
    weight (I.disjiUnion F h) = I.sum λ i ↦ weight (F i)
proof:
:=
  sum_disjiUnion _ _ _

name: latticeRect_weight
statement:
