theorem latticeRect_weight (q : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ × ℕ) :
    weight (latticeRect q) =
      bif (q.2.1.bodd && q.2.2.bodd) then ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (q.1.1 + q.1.2)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [weight, latticeRect, sum_product]; simp_rw [← mul_sum]
  rw [← sum_mul, sum_neg_one_pow_Ico, sum_neg_one_pow_Ico]
  cases q.2.1.bodd; exact zero_mul _
  cases q.2.2.bodd; exacts [mul_zero _, (pow_add _ _ _).symm]

name: latticeRect_weight_pos_imp
statement:
theorem latticeRect_weight_pos_imp :
    (h : 0 < weight (latticeRect q)) →
      (q.2.1.bodd = true ∧ q.2.2.bodd = true) ∧ (q.1.1 + q.1.2).bodd = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [latticeRect_weight, ← Bool.and_eq_true]
  cases q.2.1.bodd && q.2.2.bodd
  · exact λ h ↦ absurd h (le_refl 0).not_gt
  · rw [neg_one_pow_eq_pow_mod_two (R := ℤ), Nat.mod_two_of_bodd]
    cases (q.1.1 + q.1.2).bodd
    exacts [λ _ ↦ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, λ h ↦ absurd (by simp) h.not_gt]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {I : Finset ι}
    (h : (I : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint (latticeRect ∘ Q))
    (h0 : m.bodd = true ∧ n.bodd = true)
    (h1 : latticeRect ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, ⟨m, n⟩⟩ = I.disjiUnion (latticeRect ∘ Q) h) :
    ∃ i ∈ I, ((Q i).2.1.bodd = true ∧ (Q i).2.2.bodd = true)
      ∧ ((Q i).1.1 + (Q i).1.2).bodd = false
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ i ∈ I, 0 < weight (latticeRect (Q i))
    from this.elim λ i h3 ↦ ⟨i, h3.1, latticeRect_weight_pos_imp h3.2⟩
  replace h1 := congrArg weight h1
  rw [latticeRect_weight, disjiUnion_weight_eq, h0.1, h0.2, add_zero] at h1
  exact exists_lt_of_sum_lt (sum_const_zero.trans_lt (Int.zero_lt_one.trans_eq h1))

name: main_equality
statement:
theorem main_equality :
    ∀ n, a b n.succ = (a b n * (b n - 1) + (range n).sum λ i ↦ a b i * |b i - 2|) + 1
  | 0 => by rw [a, a, Int.zero_mul, zero_add, sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [a, Int.mul_sub, Int.mul_one, ← add_sub_right_comm, add_sub_assoc,
        add_assoc, add_right_inj, main_equality, sum_range_succ_comm,
        ← sub_sub, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, sub_add_cancel, ← Int.mul_sub]
      specialize b_pos n; rw [← Int.add_one_le_iff, zero_add, le_iff_eq_or_lt] at b_pos
      rcases b_pos with h | h
      · rw [ite_eq_left h.symm, ← h]; rfl
      · have h0 : 0 ≤ b n - 2
proof:
:= sub_nonneg_of_le (Int.add_one_le_of_lt h)
        rw [ite_eq_right h.ne.symm, abs_of_nonneg h0, sub_sub_sub_cancel_left]; rfl

name: a_and_sum_nonneg
statement:
theorem a_and_sum_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a b n ∧ 0 ≤ (range n).sum λ i ↦ a b i * |b i - 2|
  | 0 => ⟨le_refl 0, le_refl 0⟩
  | n + 1 => by
      obtain ⟨h, h0⟩
proof:
:= a_and_sum_nonneg n
      rw [main_equality b_pos, sum_range_succ]; constructor
      · have h1 : 0 ≤ b n - 1 := by rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, Int.add_one_le_iff]; exact b_pos n
        exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg h h1) h0) Int.one_nonneg
      · exact add_nonneg h0 (Int.mul_nonneg h (abs_nonneg _))

name: a_plus_sum_ge
statement:
theorem a_plus_sum_ge : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℤ) ≤ a b n + (range n).sum λ i ↦ a b i * |b i - 2|
  | 0 => le_refl 0
  | n + 1 => by
    apply (add_le_add_left (a_plus_sum_ge n) 1).trans
    rw [sum_range_succ_comm, ← add_assoc, add_right_comm,
      add_le_add_iff_right, main_equality b_pos n, add_right_comm,
      add_le_add_iff_right, add_right_comm, ← Int.mul_add]
    obtain ⟨h, h0⟩
proof:
:= a_and_sum_nonneg b_pos n
    refine le_add_of_le_of_nonneg ?_ h0
    rw [← add_sub_right_comm, Int.mul_sub, Int.mul_one,
      le_sub_iff_add_le, ← Int.two_mul, Int.mul_comm]
    refine Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ h
    rw [← sub_le_iff_le_add', ← neg_sub]; exact neg_le_abs (b n - 2)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℤ) ≤ a b n ∨ (n : ℤ) ≤ a b n.succ
  | 0 => Or.inl (le_refl 0)
  | n + 1 => by
      have h0 (n) : 0 ≤ a b n
proof:
:= (a_and_sum_nonneg b_pos n).1
      refine (Int.add_one_le_of_lt (b_pos n)).lt_or_eq.imp (λ h ↦ ?_) (λ h ↦ ?_)
      
      · rw [main_equality b_pos, Int.natCast_succ, add_le_add_iff_right]
        refine (a_plus_sum_ge b_pos n).trans (add_le_add_left ?_ _)
        rw [Int.mul_sub, Int.mul_one, le_sub_iff_add_le, ← Int.two_mul, Int.mul_comm]
        exact Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (h0 n)
      
      · rw [Int.natCast_succ, main_equality b_pos, add_le_add_iff_right]
        apply le_add_of_nonneg_of_le (Int.mul_nonneg (h0 _) (Int.le_sub_one_of_lt (b_pos _)))
        apply (a_plus_sum_ge b_pos n).trans_eq
        rw [sum_range_succ_comm, add_left_inj, ← h]
        exact (mul_one _).symm

name: mod_succ_eq_iff
statement: lemma mod_succ_eq_iff : k % n.succ = n ↔ n.succ ∣ k + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, ← Nat.mod_add_mod, h, Nat.mod_self]
  · obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = n + k' :=
      Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ (Nat.le_of_dvd k.succ_pos h))
    rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.dvd_add_self_left] at h
    rcases h with ⟨j, rfl⟩
    rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_succ]

name: Nat_exists_iterate_mod_eq
statement:
theorem Nat_exists_iterate_mod_eq (hp : 0 < p) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ k m, m > 0 ∧ m ≤ p ∧ f^[k + m] i % p = f^[k] i % p
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∃ m ∈ range p.succ, ∃ n ∈ range p.succ, m ≠ n ∧ f^[m] i % p = f^[n] i % p by
    rcases this with ⟨m, hm, n, hn, h, h0⟩
    wlog h1 : m < n
    · exact this hp f i n hn m hm h.symm h0.symm
        (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_not_lt h1) h.symm)
    refine ⟨m, n - m, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt h1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Nat.sub_le _ _).trans (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hn))
    · rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h1.le, h0]
  
  apply exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to (t := range p)
  · rw [card_range, card_range]; exact p.lt_succ_self
  · rintro a -; exact mem_range.mpr (Nat.mod_lt _ hp)

name: sum_Ico_fin_boole_last
statement:
lemma sum_Ico_fin_boole_last (a : M) (n k m : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Ico k m, (if (i : Fin n.succ) = Fin.last n then a else 0)
      = (m / n.succ - k / n.succ) • a
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | ⟨j, rfl⟩ : m ≤ k ∨ ∃ j, m = k + j :=
    (Nat.le_total m k).imp_right Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le
  
  · have h0 : m / n.succ ≤ k / n.succ := Nat.div_le_div_right h
    rw [Ico_eq_empty h.not_gt, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h0, zero_nsmul, sum_empty]
  
  induction j with
  | zero => rw [Nat.add_zero, Ico_self, Nat.sub_self, zero_nsmul, sum_empty]
  | succ j j_ih =>
      have h : k ≤ k + j := k.le_add_right j
      have h0 : k / n.succ ≤ (k + j) / n.succ := Nat.div_le_div_right h
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, sum_Ico_succ_top h, j_ih, Nat.succ_div,
        (_ / n.succ).add_comm, Nat.add_sub_assoc h0, add_comm, add_nsmul, ite_smul]
      refine congrArg₂ _ (if_congr ?_ (one_nsmul a).symm (zero_nsmul a).symm) rfl
      rw [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_natCast, Fin.val_last, mod_succ_eq_iff]

name: sum_Ico_fin_add
statement:
lemma sum_Ico_fin_add {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n.succ → M) (i : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Ico i (i + n.succ), f j = ∑ j : Fin n.succ, f j
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_Ico_eq_sum_range, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Fin.cast_val_eq_self]
  exact Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addLeft (i : Fin n.succ)) f

name: sum_Ico_fin_add_mul
statement:
lemma sum_Ico_fin_add_mul {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n.succ → M) (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ k, ∑ j ∈ Ico i (i + n.succ * k), f j = k • ∑ j : Fin n.succ, f j
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec ?_ λ k hk ↦ ?_
  · rw [Nat.mul_zero, i.add_zero, Ico_self, zero_nsmul, sum_empty]
  · rw [Nat.mul_succ, ← i.add_assoc, succ_nsmul, ← hk, ← sum_Ico_fin_add f (i + n.succ * k)]
    exact (sum_Ico_consecutive _ (i.le_add_right _) (Nat.le_add_right _ n.succ)).symm

name: sum_def
statement: lemma sum_def : X.sum = ∑ i : Fin n.pred.succ, X.toFun i
proof: := rfl

name: lt_jump_index
statement: lemma lt_jump_index (i : ℕ) : i < X.jump_index i
proof:
:=
  Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (Nat.succ_pos _)

name: le_jump_index
statement: lemma le_jump_index (i : ℕ) : i ≤ X.jump_index i
proof:
:=
  (X.lt_jump_index i).le

name: le_jump_index_iterate
statement: lemma le_jump_index_iterate (i) : ∀ k, i ≤ X.jump_index^[k] i
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec i.le_refl λ k hk ↦ hk.trans ?_
  rw [iterate_succ_apply']; exact X.le_jump_index _

name: lt_jump_index_iterate_of_pos
statement: lemma lt_jump_index_iterate_of_pos (i) (hk : 0 < k) : i < X.jump_index^[k] i
proof:
:=
  Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hk ▸ (X.lt_jump_index _).trans_le (X.le_jump_index_iterate _ _)

name: jump_index_le_add
statement: lemma jump_index_le_add (i : ℕ) : X.jump_index i ≤ i + n.pred.succ
proof:
:=
  Nat.add_le_add_left (Fin.isLt _) i

name: ofComposite_toFun_apply
statement:
lemma ofComposite_toFun_apply (i) :
  (ofComposite ha hb).toFun i = a - if i = Fin.last _ then a else 0
proof: := rfl

name: ofComposite_sum
statement: theorem ofComposite_sum : (ofComposite ha hb).sum = a * (a * b - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sum_def, ofComposite_toFun_apply, Nat.cast_ite]
  rw [sum_sub_distrib, Fin.sum_const, Nat.cast_zero, Fintype.sum_ite_eq',
    Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt ha) hb),
    nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Int.mul_comm, mul_sub_one]

name: dvd_sum_range_jump_shift_succ
statement:
lemma dvd_sum_range_jump_shift_succ (i : Fin n.pred.succ) :
    (n : ℤ) ∣ ∑ j ∈ range (X.jump_shift i + 1), X.toFun (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := X.jump_shift_spec i
  simp only [sum_Ico_eq_sum_range, Nat.cast_add] at h
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Fin.cast_val_eq_self] at h

name: dvd_sum_Ico_jump_index
statement:
lemma dvd_sum_Ico_jump_index (i : ℕ) :
    (n : ℤ) ∣ ∑ j ∈ Ico i (X.jump_index i), X.toFun j
proof:
:= by
  rw [jump_index, sum_Ico_eq_sum_range, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add]; exact X.dvd_sum_range_jump_shift_succ _

name: dvd_sum_Ico_jump_index_iterate
statement:
lemma dvd_sum_Ico_jump_index_iterate (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ k, (n : ℤ) ∣ ∑ j ∈ Ico i (X.jump_index^[k] i), X.toFun j
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec ⟨0, ?_⟩ λ k hk ↦ ?_
  · rw [iterate_zero, id, Ico_self, mul_zero, sum_empty]
  · replace hk := dvd_add hk (X.dvd_sum_Ico_jump_index (X.jump_index^[k] i))
    rw [sum_Ico_consecutive _ (X.le_jump_index_iterate i k) (X.le_jump_index _)] at hk
    rwa [iterate_succ_apply']

name: exists_dvd_pos_lt_nsmul_sum
statement:
lemma exists_dvd_pos_lt_nsmul_sum (hn : 0 < n) (X : SpecialTuple n.succ) :
    ∃ m > 0, m < n.succ ∧ (n.succ : ℤ) ∣ m • X.sum
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 1 < n.succ := Nat.succ_lt_succ hn
  
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ | hX :
      (∃ i, X.jump_index i = i + n.succ) ∨ (∀ i, X.jump_index i < i + n.succ) := by
    refine (em' _).imp_left λ h ↦ ?_
    rcases not_forall.mp h with ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, Nat.le_antisymm (jump_index_le_add X i) (Nat.le_of_not_lt hi)⟩
  · refine ⟨1, Nat.one_pos, hn0, ?_⟩
    have h := X.dvd_sum_Ico_jump_index_iterate i 1
    rwa [iterate_one, hi, sum_Ico_fin_add, ← one_nsmul (∑ _, _)] at h
  
  replace hX (i) : ∀ k, X.jump_index^[k] i ≤ i + n * k := by
    refine Nat.rec (Nat.le_add_right _ _) λ k hk ↦ ?_
    rw [iterate_succ_apply', Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc]
    exact (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (hX _)).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hk _)
  
  obtain ⟨k, m, t, ht, ht0, h⟩ : ∃ k m t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ n ∧
      X.jump_index^[k + m] 0 = X.jump_index^[k] 0 + (n + 1) * t := by
    obtain ⟨k, m, hm, hm0, h⟩ := Nat_exists_iterate_mod_eq n.succ_pos X.jump_index 0
    refine ⟨k, m, ?_⟩
    let i₀ := X.jump_index^[k] 0
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u, X.jump_index^[m] i₀ = i₀ + u :=
      Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (X.le_jump_index_iterate i₀ m)
    apply Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq at h
    rw [Nat.add_comm, iterate_add_apply, hu] at h ⊢
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, ← Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at h
    rcases h with ⟨t, rfl⟩; refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · have h : i₀ < X.jump_index^[m] i₀ := X.lt_jump_index_iterate_of_pos i₀ hm
      rw [hu, Nat.lt_add_right_iff_pos] at h
      exact Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left h
    · have h := (hX i₀ m).trans_lt (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right hm)
      rw [hu, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left, ← Nat.succ_mul] at h
      exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ ((Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h).trans_le hm0)
  
  refine ⟨t, ht, Nat.lt_succ_of_le ht0, ?_⟩
  have h0 := X.dvd_sum_Ico_jump_index_iterate (X.jump_index^[k] 0) m
  rwa [← iterate_add_apply, Nat.add_comm, h, sum_Ico_fin_add_mul] at h0

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (hn : 1 < n) : (∀ X : SpecialTuple n, (n : ℤ) ∣ X.sum) ↔ n.Prime
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h X ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · by_contra h0; obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ : ∃ a > 1, ∃ b > 1, a * b = n := by
      obtain ⟨p, hp, k, rfl⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n :=
        Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hn.ne.symm
      refine ⟨p, hp.one_lt, k, Nat.lt_of_not_le ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one]; rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · rw [p.mul_zero] at hn; exact hn.not_gt Nat.one_pos
      · exact h0 (p.mul_one.symm ▸ hp)
    clear h0 hn; specialize h (SpecialTuple.ofComposite ha (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb))
    rw [SpecialTuple.ofComposite_sum, ← Int.natCast_mul, mul_sub_one,
      Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, Int.add_mul_emod_self_right,
      ← Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, Int.dvd_neg, Int.ofNat_dvd] at h
    have ha0 : 0 < a := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt ha
    exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt ha0 ((Nat.lt_mul_iff_one_lt_right ha0).mpr hb) h
  
  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n' : ℕ, n = n'.succ :=
      Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn).ne.symm
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hm0, h0⟩ := X.exists_dvd_pos_lt_nsmul_sum (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hn)
    have h1 : n.succ.Coprime m := h.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr (Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt hm hm0)
    rwa [Int.natCast_dvd, nsmul_eq_mul, Int.natAbs_mul,
      Int.natAbs_natCast, h1.dvd_mul_left, ← Int.natCast_dvd] at h0

name: good_imp_good_alt
statement: theorem good_imp_good_alt {f : G → G} (hf : good f) : good_alt (λ x ↦ x - f x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h; rw [sub_lt_sub_iff, add_comm, add_comm y] at h
  refine (hf y x h).symm.imp (λ h0 ↦ ?_) (λ h0 ↦ ?_)
  · rwa [sub_le_iff_le_add', add_left_comm, le_add_iff_nonneg_right]
  · rwa [le_sub_iff_add_le', ← add_assoc, add_le_iff_nonpos_left]

name: dense_good_alt_imp_Monotone
statement:
theorem dense_good_alt_imp_Monotone [DenselyOrdered G] {g : G → G} (hf : good_alt g) :
    Monotone g
proof:
:= by
  
  have hf0 {x y} (h : x < y) {z} (hzy : g y - y < z) (hzx : z < g x - x) :
      g z = g x ∨ g z = g y := by
    
    rcases lt_trichotomy (g z) (g y) with h1 | h1 | h1
    · exact absurd (lt_add_of_sub_right_lt hzy) (hf z y h1).2.not_gt
    · right; exact h1
    
    rcases lt_trichotomy (g x) (g z) with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact absurd (add_lt_of_lt_sub_left hzx) (hf x z h2).1.not_gt
    · left; exact h2.symm
    
    refine absurd ?_ ((hf y z h1).2.trans (hf z x h2).1).not_gt
    rwa [add_comm, add_lt_add_iff_right]
  
  intro x y; rw [le_iff_eq_or_lt]
  rintro (rfl | h)
  · exact le_refl (g _)
  refine le_of_not_gt λ h0 ↦ ?_
  
  obtain ⟨z, hxz, hzy⟩ : ∃ z, x < z ∧ z < y := exists_between h
  obtain h1 | h1 : g z = g x ∨ g z = g y := by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ : g y ≤ y + x ∧ y + x ≤ g x := hf y x h0
    exact hf0 h (hxz.trans_le' (sub_left_le_of_le_add h1))
      (hzy.trans_le (le_tsub_of_add_le_right h2))
  
  · 
    obtain ⟨w, hxw, hwz⟩ : ∃ w, x < w ∧ w < z := exists_between hxz
    obtain h2 | h2 : g (g x - w) = g x ∨ g (g x - w) = g y :=
      hf0 h (sub_lt_sub h0 (hwz.trans hzy)) (sub_lt_sub_left hxw _)
    
    · have h3 : y + (g x - w) ≤ g (g x - w) := (hf _ _ (h0.trans_eq h2.symm)).2
      rw [h2, add_sub_left_comm, add_le_iff_nonpos_right, sub_nonpos] at h3
      exact h3.not_gt (hwz.trans hzy)
    
    · have h3 : g x - w + z ≤ g z := (hf _ _ (h2.trans_lt (h0.trans_eq h1.symm))).2
      rw [h1, ← le_sub_iff_add_le, sub_le_sub_iff_left] at h3
      exact h3.not_gt hwz
  
  · obtain ⟨w, hzw, hwy⟩ : ∃ w, z < w ∧ w < y := exists_between hzy
    obtain h2 | h2 : g (g y - w) = g x ∨ g (g y - w) = g y :=
      hf0 h (sub_lt_sub_left hwy _) (sub_lt_sub h0 (hxz.trans hzw))
    
    · have h3 : g z ≤ z + (g y - w) := (hf _ _ (h1.trans_lt (h0.trans_eq h2.symm))).1
      rw [h1, add_sub_left_comm, le_add_iff_nonneg_right, sub_nonneg] at h3
      exact h3.not_gt hzw
    
    · have h3 : g (g y - w) ≤ g y - w + x := (hf _ _ (h2.trans_lt h0)).1
      rw [h2, ← sub_le_iff_le_add, sub_le_sub_iff_left] at h3
      exact h3.not_gt (hxz.trans hzw)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [DenselyOrdered G] {f : G → G} (hf : good f) {x y} (h : x ≤ y) :
    f y + x ≤ f x + y
proof:
:= by
  replace hf := dense_good_alt_imp_Monotone (good_imp_good_alt hf) h
  rwa [sub_le_sub_iff, add_comm, add_comm y] at hf

name: discrete_counterexample
statement:
theorem discrete_counterexample (h : ¬DenselyOrdered G) :
    ∃ f : G → G, ¬(∀ x y, x ≤ y → f y + x ≤ f x + y) ∧ good f
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg0⟩ : ∃ g : G, 0 < g ∧ ∀ x > 0, g ≤ x := by
    contrapose! h; refine ⟨λ x y h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hb0⟩ := h (y - x) (sub_pos_of_lt h0)
    exact ⟨b + x, lt_add_of_pos_left x hb, lt_tsub_iff_right.mp hb0⟩
  replace hg0 {x y} : x < y ↔ x + g ≤ y :=
    ⟨λ h0 ↦ add_le_of_le_sub_left (hg0 _ (sub_pos_of_lt h0)),
    (lt_add_of_pos_right x hg).trans_le⟩
  
  let f := λ x ↦ if x = 0 then -g else if x = g then g else -x
  refine ⟨f, λ h1 ↦ ?_, λ x y ↦ ?_⟩
  · apply (h1 0 g hg.le).not_gt; dsimp only [f]
    rwa [ite_eq_left rfl, neg_add_cancel, ite_eq_right hg.ne.symm, ite_eq_left rfl, add_zero]
  
  simp only [f]; split_ifs
  
  · subst x y; intro h0
    exact absurd rfl h0.ne
  
  · subst x y; rintro -
    exact ⟨(neg_add_cancel g).le, hg.le.trans_eq (add_zero g).symm⟩
  
  · subst x; intro h0
    rw [hg0, add_zero, neg_add_cancel_comm, le_neg_self_iff] at h0
    refine ⟨add_nonpos (neg_nonpos.mpr hg.le) h0, ?_⟩
    rwa [add_zero, neg_nonneg]
  
  · subst x y; intro h0
    refine absurd ?_ h0.not_gt
    rwa [neg_add_cancel, add_zero]
  
  · subst x y; intro h0
    exact absurd rfl h0.ne
  
  · subst x; intro h0
    rw [add_comm, add_lt_add_iff_right, lt_neg_self_iff] at h0
    exact ⟨(add_comm g y).trans_le (hg0.mp h0), add_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr h0.le) hg.le⟩
  
  · subst y; intro h0
    rw [add_zero, hg0, neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, ← neg_add_eq_sub, neg_le_self_iff] at h0
    refine ⟨le_of_lt ?_, h0⟩
    rwa [add_zero, neg_lt_zero, hg0, zero_add, ← le_neg_add_iff_le]
  
  · subst y; intro h0
    rw [add_comm, add_lt_add_iff_left, neg_lt_self_iff] at h0
    refine ⟨?_, (add_pos hg h0).le⟩
    rwa [neg_add_nonpos_iff, ← zero_add g, ← hg0]
  
  · intro h0; rw [neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, ← neg_add_eq_sub] at h0 ⊢
    rw [neg_nonpos, and_self]; exact (neg_lt_self_iff.mp h0).le

name: final_solution_extra
statement:
theorem final_solution_extra :
    (∀ {f : G → G} (_ : good f) {x y}, x ≤ y → f y + x ≤ f x + y) ↔ DenselyOrdered G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hG ↦ ?_, λ hG ↦ final_solution⟩
  contrapose! hG; obtain ⟨f, hf, hf0⟩ := discrete_counterexample hG
  simp only [not_forall, not_le] at hf
  rcases hf with ⟨x, y, h, h0⟩
  exact ⟨f, hf0, x, y, h, h0⟩

name: inv'_is_good
statement: lemma inv'_is_good {f : M → M} (h : ∀ x, x * f x = 1) : good f
proof:
:= λ x y ↦ by
  have h0 (y) : f (f y) = y := by rw [← mul_left_cancel_iff, h, mul_comm, h]
  rw [h0, h0, h0, mul_add]; apply congrArg₂
  · rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_left_cancel_iff (a := x), ← mul_assoc,
      ← mul_assoc, h, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (f _), ← mul_assoc, h]
  · rw [← mul_left_cancel_iff (a := y * f x), h, mul_comm,
      mul_assoc, mul_mul_mul_comm, h, mul_one, mul_comm, h]

name: good_imp_inv'
statement: theorem good_imp_inv' [IsCancelAdd M] {f : M → M} (hf : good f) : ∀ x, x * f x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : f 1 = 1 := by simpa [mul_add] using hf 1 1
  have h0 (y) : f y * f (f (y * y)) = f (f y) := by simpa [h, mul_add] using (hf 1 y).symm
  replace h (x) : x * f (x * x) = f x := by simpa [h0, mul_add] using hf x 1
  replace h0 (x) : f (f (x * x)) = f (f x * f x) := by rw [← mul_right_inj, h0, h]
  suffices f.Injective from λ x ↦ by
    rw [← mul_eq_right (b := f x), mul_assoc, ← this (h0 x), h]
  replace hf (x y) : f x * f (f y) + f (y * f x)
      = f (x * y) * (f (f y * f y) + f (f x * f x)) := by
    specialize hf x y; rwa [h, h0, h0] at hf
  replace hf {a b} (h1 : f a = f b) (y) : f (a * y) = f (b * y) := by
    have h2 := (hf a y).symm; rwa [h1, hf, mul_left_inj] at h2
  intro a b h1
  have h2 : f (a * a) = f (b * b) := by rw [hf h1, mul_comm, hf h1]
  rw [← mul_left_inj, h, h2, h, h1]

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution [IsCancelAdd M] {f : M → M} : good f ↔ ∀ x, x * f x = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨good_imp_inv', inv'_is_good⟩

name: dvd_of_pow_sub_one_dvd
statement: lemma dvd_of_pow_sub_one_dvd (hn : 1 < n) (h : n ^ k - 1 ∣ n ^ l - 1) : k ∣ l
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices h0 : n ^ (l % k) - 1 = 0 by
    refine Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero ((eq_or_ne _ _).resolve_right λ h1 ↦ absurd ?_ h0.not_gt)
    exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Nat.one_lt_pow h1 hn)
  
  have h0 (c) : 0 < n ^ c := Nat.pow_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, n ^ k = x + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' (h0 k)
  replace h : n ^ l % x = 1 % x := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' (h0 l)
    rw [hx, Nat.add_sub_cancel, hy, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
    rw [hy, ← Nat.mod_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h]
  
  rw [← Nat.div_add_mod l k, Nat.pow_add, Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.mod_mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod,
    hx, Nat.add_mod_left, ← Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow, Nat.mod_mul_mod, Nat.one_mul] at h
  replace h : x ∣ n ^ (l % k) - 1 :=
    Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero (Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq h)
  obtain rfl : x = n ^ k - 1 := Nat.eq_sub_of_add_eq hx.symm
  
  clear hx; obtain rfl | hk : k = 0 ∨ 0 < k := k.eq_zero_or_pos
  · exact Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd h
  · refine Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h (Nat.sub_lt_sub_right (h0 _) ?_)
    exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_right hn (Nat.mod_lt l hk)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 1 < n)
    (h : n ^ k + m * n ^ l + 1 ∣ n ^ (k + l) - 1) :
    (m = 1 ∧ l = 2 * k) ∨ (∃ t > 0, k = (t + 1) * l ∧ m * (n ^ l - 1) = n ^ (l * t) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : 0 < n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn
  replace h : n ^ k + m * n ^ l + 1 ∣ n ^ k + m * n ^ l + n ^ (k + l) := by
    have X : 1 ≤ n ^ (k + l) := Nat.pow_pos hn'
    rwa [← Nat.dvd_add_self_right, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.sub_add_cancel X] at h
  have h0 : (n ^ k + m * n ^ l + 1).Coprime n := by
    obtain ⟨N, h0⟩ : n ∣ n ^ k + m * n ^ l := by
      refine ⟨n ^ (k - 1) + m * n ^ (l - 1), ?_⟩
      rw [n.mul_add, ← n.pow_add_one', Nat.sub_add_cancel hk,
        n.mul_left_comm,← n.pow_add_one', Nat.sub_add_cancel hl]
    rw [h0, Nat.coprime_mul_left_add_left]
    exact n.gcd_one_left
  refine (le_or_gt k l).imp (λ h1 ↦ ?_) (λ h1 ↦ ?_)
  
  · obtain ⟨l', rfl⟩ : ∃ l', l = k + l' := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h1
    replace h1 : n ^ k + m * n ^ (k + l') + n ^ (k + (k + l'))
        = n ^ k * (n ^ (k + l') + m * n ^ l' + 1) := by
      rw [n.pow_add, m.mul_left_comm, n.pow_add, Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.mul_add,
        Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.mul_succ, ← n.pow_add, Nat.add_comm]
    replace h : n ^ k + m * n ^ (k + l') + 1 ∣ n ^ (k + l') + m * n ^ l' + 1 := by
      rwa [h1, (h0.pow_right k).dvd_mul_left] at h
    replace h1 {a} (ha : 0 < a) : a + 1 ≤ 2 * a := by
      rwa [Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left]
    replace h : n ^ (k + l') + m * n ^ l' = n ^ k + m * n ^ (k + l') := by
      refine Nat.add_left_inj.mp (Nat.eq_of_dvd_of_lt_two_mul (Nat.succ_ne_zero _) h ?_)
      calc
        _ ≤ (m + 1) * n ^ (k + l') + 1 := by
          rw [Nat.add_le_add_iff_right, Nat.add_comm, m.succ_mul]
          refine Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left m ?_) _
          exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right hn' (l'.le_add_left k)
        _ < 2 * (m * n ^ (k + l') + 1) := by
          rw [← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.mul_succ 2, ← Nat.mul_assoc]
          exact Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (h1 hm)) 2
        _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
    obtain rfl : m = 1 := by
      obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hm
      refine m'.eq_zero_or_pos.elim (congrArg Nat.succ) λ h2 ↦ absurd ?_ h.not_lt
      calc
        _ ≤ n ^ (k + l') + n ^ k * m' * n ^ l' := by
          refine Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ((h1 h2).trans ?_)) _
          exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hn.trans_le (Nat.le_self_pow hk.ne.symm n))
        _ = (m' + 1) * n ^ (k + l') := by
          rw [Nat.mul_right_comm, ← Nat.pow_add, Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.mul_succ, mul_comm]
        _ < _ := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left (Nat.pow_pos hn')
    rw [Nat.one_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_inj] at h
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩; rw [Nat.two_mul, Nat.pow_right_injective hn h]
  
  · obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = l + k' := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h1.le
    replace h1 : n ^ (l + k') + m * n ^ l + n ^ (l + k' + l)
        = n ^ l * (n ^ (l + k') + n ^ k' + m) := by
      rw [← add_rotate, Nat.pow_add, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.pow_add,
        ← Nat.mul_add, m.mul_comm, ← Nat.mul_add]
    replace h : n ^ (l + k') + m * n ^ l + 1 ∣ n ^ (l + k') + n ^ k' + m := by
      rwa [h1, (h0.pow_right l).dvd_mul_left] at h
    replace h : n ^ (l + k') + n ^ k' + m = n ^ (l + k') + m * n ^ l + 1 := by
      apply Nat.eq_of_dvd_of_lt_two_mul (Nat.add_pos_right _ hm).ne.symm h
      calc
        _ < 2 * (n ^ (l + k') + m) := by
          rw [Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left]
          exact Nat.lt_add_right m (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right hn (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left hl))
        _ < _ := by
          refine Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ?_ Nat.two_pos
          rw [Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left]
          exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pow_pos hn')
    replace h : n ^ k' - 1 = m * (n ^ l - 1) := by
      rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_inj] at h
      apply congrArg (· - (m + 1)) at h
      rwa [Nat.add_sub_add_right, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_sub_add_left, ← Nat.mul_sub_one] at h
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : l ∣ k' := dvd_of_pow_sub_one_dvd hn ⟨m, h.trans (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_, h.symm⟩
    · apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero; rintro rfl
      rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.pow_zero, Nat.zero_eq_mul] at h
      exact h.elim hm.ne.symm (Nat.zero_lt_sub_of_lt (Nat.one_lt_pow hl.ne.symm hn)).ne.symm
    · rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_comm, t.succ_mul]

name: zero_is_good
statement: lemma zero_is_good [Semiring S] [LinearOrder S] : good (λ _ : R ↦ (0 : S))
proof:
:= λ x y ↦ by
  rw [zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, max_self]

name: neg_one_is_good
statement:
lemma neg_one_is_good [Ring S] [LinearOrder S] [IsStrictOrderedRing S] :
    good (λ _ : R ↦ (-1 : S))
proof:
:= λ x y ↦ by
  rw [mul_assoc, ← sq, neg_one_sq, two_mul, add_assoc, left_eq_add,
    ← max_add_add_left, ← add_assoc, add_neg_cancel, zero_add, max_eq_right_iff]
  exact neg_one_lt_zero.le

name: hom_is_good
statement: lemma hom_is_good [CommSemiring S] [LinearOrder S] (φ : R →+* S) : good φ
proof:
:= λ x y ↦ by
  rw [φ.map_add, φ.map_add, max_self, add_comm (_ * _), φ.map_pow, φ.map_pow, add_sq']

name: hom_sub_one_is_good
statement:
lemma hom_sub_one_is_good [CommRing S] [LinearOrder S] [IsStrictOrderedRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) : good (φ · - 1)
proof:
:= λ x y ↦ by
  simp only [φ.map_add, φ.map_pow]
  rw [sub_add_sub_comm, ← sub_sub, max_eq_right (sub_le_self _ (zero_le_one' S)), sub_sq,
    one_pow, mul_one, mul_sub_one 2, mul_sub_one, sub_mul, sub_sub, add_comm (_ * _ - _),
    sub_add_sub_comm, ← add_sq', sub_add, sub_right_inj, add_comm 1, ← add_sub_assoc,
    ← mul_add, add_comm, sub_add, sub_right_inj, ← one_add_one_eq_two, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: eq_zero_or_hom_of_map_add_map_sq
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x y, f (x * y) = f x * f y by
    have h1 : f 1 = 0 ∨ f 1 = 1 := by
      specialize h0 1; rwa [one_pow, sq, ← sub_eq_zero, ← one_sub_mul,
        mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm, or_comm] at h0
    revert h1; refine Or.imp (λ h1 ↦ ?_) (λ h1 ↦ ⟨RingHom.mk' ⟨⟨f, h1⟩, this⟩ h, rfl⟩)
    funext x; rw [← mul_one x, this, h1, mul_zero]; rfl
  have h1 (x y) : f (x * y) + f (y * x) = 2 * (f x * f y) := by
    have h1 := h0 (x + y)
    rwa [h, add_sq, sq, add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, h, h, h, ← sq, h0, ← sq,
      h0, ← add_assoc, add_left_inj, add_assoc, add_right_inj, mul_assoc] at h1
  have X : (2 : S) ≠ 0 := (OfNat.zero_ne_ofNat 2).symm
  intro x y; have h2 : f (x * y * x) = f x ^ 2 * f y := by
    have h2 : _ + _ = _ + _ := congrArg₂ _ (h1 x (x * y)) (h1 (y * x) x)
    rwa [add_add_add_comm, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, h1, ← sq, h0, ← mul_assoc x,
      ← two_mul, ← mul_add, ← mul_add, mul_comm (f (y * x)), ← sub_eq_zero,
      ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero, ← mul_add, h1, mul_left_comm, ← mul_assoc (f x),
      ← sq, two_mul, or_iff_right X, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h2
  replace h2 : f (x * y) ^ 2 + f (y * x) ^ 2 = 2 * (f x * f y) ^ 2 := by
    specialize h1 (x * y * x) y; rwa [h2, mul_assoc, ← sq, h0, mul_assoc,
      ← mul_assoc, ← sq, h0, mul_assoc, ← sq, ← mul_pow] at h1
  replace h2 : f (x * y) = f (y * x) := by
    refine eq_of_sub_eq_zero (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp ?_)
    have h3 : _ ^ 2 = _ ^ 2 := congrArg₂ _ (h1 x y) rfl
    rw [add_sq', h2, mul_pow 2, sq 2, mul_assoc 2 2, two_mul (2 * _), add_right_inj] at h3
    rw [sub_sq', h2, h3, sub_self]
  specialize h1 x y
  rw [← h2, ← two_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right X] at h1
  exact eq_of_sub_eq_zero h1

name: good_map_zero
statement:
theorem good_map_zero [Ring S] [LinearOrder S] [IsStrictOrderedRing S]
    {f : R → S} (hf : good f) : f 0 = 0 ∨ f 0 = -1
proof:
:= by
  specialize hf 0 0
  rw [zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), add_zero, mul_assoc, ← sq,
    two_mul, add_assoc, left_eq_add, ← neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero] at hf
  have h : f 0 ≤ 0 := le_of_max_le_right (hf.symm.trans_le (neg_nonpos.mpr (sq_nonneg _)))
  rwa [max_eq_right (add_le_of_nonpos_left h), sq, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero,
    ← mul_add_one (f 0), mul_eq_zero, ← eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero] at hf

name: good_map_main_ineq
statement:
theorem good_map_main_ineq [Ring S] [LinearOrder S] [IsOrderedRing S]
    {f : R → S} (hf : good f) (x y : R) :
    2 * f x * f y + (f (x ^ 2) + f (y ^ 2)) ≤ f (x + y) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  (add_le_add_right (le_max_left _ _) _).trans_eq (hf x y).symm

name: good_case_one
statement: theorem good_case_one (hf : good f) (h : f 0 = 0) : f = 0 ∨ ∃ φ : R →+* S, f = φ
proof:
:= by
  have h0 (x) : f (x ^ 2) = f x ^ 2 := by
    specialize hf x 0; rwa [add_zero, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), h,
      mul_zero, add_zero, add_zero, max_self, zero_add, eq_comm] at hf
  suffices h1 : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y from eq_zero_or_hom_of_map_add_map_sq h1 h0
  replace h0 {x y z} (h1 : x + y + z = 0) : (f x + f y + f z) * (f x + f y - f z) ≤ 0 := by
    rw [← sq_sub_sq, sub_nonpos, ← h0, ← neg_sq z, add_sq',
      ← eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h1, h0, ← h0, ← h0, add_comm]
    exact good_map_main_ineq hf x y
  replace h0 {x y z} (h1 : x + y + z = 0) : f x + f y + f z = 0 := by
    have h2 := add_le_of_le_of_nonpos (h0 h1) (h0 ((add_rotate _ _ _).trans h1))
    rw [← add_rotate, ← mul_add, add_sub_assoc, add_sub_assoc,
      add_add_add_comm, sub_add_sub_cancel', add_add_sub_cancel] at h2
    replace h2 := add_le_of_le_of_nonpos h2 (h0 ((add_rotate _ _ _).symm.trans h1))
    rw [← add_rotate, ← mul_add, add_add_sub_cancel, ← add_rotate, ← add_assoc, ← sq] at h2
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (h2.antisymm (sq_nonneg _))
  replace h (x) : f (-x) = -f x := by
    specialize h0 ((add_zero _).trans (add_neg_cancel x))
    rwa [h, add_zero, add_comm, ← eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero] at h0
  intro x y; specialize h0 (add_neg_cancel (x + y))
  rwa [h, add_neg_eq_zero, eq_comm] at h0

name: good_case_two
statement: theorem good_case_two (hf : good f) (h : f 0 = -1) : f = -1 ∨ ∃ φ : R →+* S, f = φ - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 (x) : f (x ^ 2) = f x ^ 2 + 2 * f x := by
    specialize hf x 0
    have X : (-1 : S) ≤ 0 := neg_one_lt_zero.le
    rw [add_zero, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), h, mul_neg_one, eq_neg_add_iff_add_eq,
      add_zero, add_comm, max_eq_right (add_le_of_nonpos_right X)] at hf
    exact hf.symm
  suffices h1 : ∀ x y, f (x + y) + 1 = (f x + 1) + (f y + 1) by
    rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero (G := R → S)]; simp only [eq_sub_iff_add_eq]
    refine eq_zero_or_hom_of_map_add_map_sq h1 λ x ↦ ?_
    change f (x ^ 2) + 1 = (f x + 1) ^ 2; rw [h0, add_sq, mul_one, one_pow]
  have h1 {t} (ht : f (-t) = f t) : f t < 1 := by
    have h1 := good_map_main_ineq hf t (-t)
    rw [neg_sq, h0, ht, add_neg_cancel, h, neg_one_sq, ← two_mul, mul_assoc, ← sq,
      mul_add, ← add_assoc, ← two_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← sq, ← mul_pow] at h1
    replace h := le_of_add_le_of_nonneg_right h1 (sq_nonneg _)
    refine lt_of_mul_lt_mul_of_nonneg_left (h.trans_lt ?_) (sq_nonneg 2)
    have X : (1 : S) < 2 := one_lt_two
    rw [mul_one, sq]; exact one_lt_mul X.le X
  rcases em' (∀ t, f (-t) = f t) with h2 | h2
  
  · replace h (x y) : f (x + y) - f (-(x + y)) = f (-x) * f (-y) - f x * f y := by
      have h3 := h0 (-(x + y))
      rw [neg_sq, neg_add, h0, add_comm, ← sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, ← mul_sub, hf, hf,
        neg_sq, neg_sq, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← mul_sub,
        ← neg_add, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h3
      exact h3.resolve_left two_ne_zero
    replace h0 (x) : f x + f (-x) = -2 := by
      have h3 := h0 (-x)
      rw [neg_sq, h0, add_comm, ← sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, ← mul_sub,
        sq_sub_sq, ← neg_sub, mul_neg, ← neg_mul, ← sub_eq_zero,
        ← sub_mul, mul_eq_zero, add_comm, sub_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h3
      rcases h3 with h3 | h3; exact h3.symm
      rw [not_forall] at h2; rcases h2 with ⟨t, h2⟩
      replace h0 : f t - f (-t) = f x * (f (-(x + t)) - f (x + t)) := by
        have h4 := h (-x) (x + t); rwa [neg_add_cancel_left, neg_neg, h3, ← mul_sub] at h4
      replace h : f (x + t) - f (-(x + t)) = f x * (f (-t) - f t) := by rw [h, h3, mul_sub]
      rw [← neg_sub (f (x + t)), h, ← mul_neg, neg_sub, ← mul_assoc, ← sq, ← sub_eq_zero,
        ← one_sub_mul, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_left (sub_ne_zero_of_ne (Ne.symm h2)),
        sub_eq_zero, eq_comm, sq_eq_one_iff, or_iff_right (h1 h3).ne] at h0
      rw [h3, h0, ← two_mul, mul_neg_one]
    replace h0 (x) : f (-x) = -(f x + 2) := by rw [neg_add, ← h0 x, neg_add_cancel_left]
    intro x y; specialize h x y
    rwa [h0, sub_neg_eq_add, h0, h0, neg_mul_neg, ← add_assoc, ← two_mul, add_mul,
      mul_add, mul_add, ← mul_add_one, add_assoc, add_sub_cancel_left, mul_comm (f x),
      ← mul_add, ← mul_add, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero,
      or_iff_right two_ne_zero, ← one_add_one_eq_two, ← add_assoc, add_add_add_comm] at h
  
  · suffices ∀ x, f x = -1 from λ x y ↦ by rw [this, this, this, neg_add_cancel, zero_add]
    have X : (0 : S) < 2 := zero_lt_two
    replace h1 (t) : f t < 1 := h1 (h2 t)
    replace h (x) : f (x + x) = -1 := by
      have h3 := hf x (-x)
      rw [add_neg_cancel, h, neg_one_sq, neg_sq, h2, ← hf, eq_comm, sq_eq_one_iff] at h3
      exact h3.resolve_left (h1 _).ne
    replace h2 (x) : f x = -1 ∨ (0 < f x ∧ 2 * 2 * (f x ^ 2 + f x) = 1) := by
      specialize hf x x
      rw [h, h, neg_one_sq, ← two_mul, h0, mul_assoc, ← sq] at hf
      refine (le_total (2 * (f x ^ 2 + 2 * f x)) (-1)).imp (λ h3 ↦ ?_) (λ h3 ↦ ?_)
      · rw [max_eq_right h3, eq_add_neg_iff_add_eq, ← two_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub,
          mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right two_ne_zero, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm, sq_eq_one_iff] at hf
        exact hf.resolve_left (h1 _).ne
      · have h4 : -1 ≤ f x := by
          rw [← neg_neg (f x), neg_le_neg_iff]
          refine le_of_not_gt λ h4 ↦ hf.not_lt
            ((add_le_add_right (le_max_right _ _) _).trans_lt' ?_)
          rw [lt_add_neg_iff_add_lt, ← two_mul, ← neg_sq, mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ X, sq]
          exact one_lt_mul h4.le h4
        rw [max_eq_left h3, ← mul_add, ← add_assoc, ← two_mul, ← mul_add, ← mul_assoc] at hf
        refine ⟨lt_of_not_ge λ h5 ↦ hf.not_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le' ?_), hf.symm⟩
        rw [sq, ← mul_add_one (f x), ← sq]
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sq_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h5 (neg_le_iff_add_nonneg.mp h4))
    intro x; refine (h2 (x ^ 2)).elim (λ h3 ↦ ?_) (λ h3 ↦ (h2 x).resolve_right λ h4 ↦ ?_)
    · rwa [h0, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← one_pow 2, ← mul_one (2 * _),
        ← add_sq, sq_eq_zero_iff, ← eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero] at h3
    · refine (h3.2.trans h4.2.symm).not_gt (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ?_ (mul_pos X X))
      have h5 : f x < f (x ^ 2) := by
        rw [h0, two_mul, ← add_assoc, lt_add_iff_pos_left]
        exact add_pos (pow_pos h4.1 2) h4.1
      rw [sq, sq]; exact add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul h5 h5.le h4.1 h3.1.le) h5

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    good f ↔ (f = 0 ∨ ∃ φ : R →+* S, f = φ) ∨ (f = -1 ∨ ∃ φ : R →+* S, f = φ - 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ (good_map_zero h).imp (good_case_one h) (good_case_two h), λ h ↦ by
    rcases h with (rfl | ⟨φ, rfl⟩) | (rfl | ⟨φ, rfl⟩)
    exacts [zero_is_good, hom_is_good φ, neg_one_is_good, hom_sub_one_is_good φ]⟩

name: ring_prod_le_pow_card
statement:
theorem ring_prod_le_pow_card [CommSemiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R]
    {M : Multiset R} (hM : ∀ x ∈ M, 0 ≤ x) (hr : ∀ x ∈ M, x ≤ r) :
    M.prod ≤ r ^ card M
proof:
:= by
  induction M using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => rw [prod_zero, card_zero, pow_zero]
  | cons a M M_ih =>
      rw [prod_cons, card_cons, pow_succ']
      rw [forall_mem_cons] at hM hr
      exact mul_le_mul hr.1 (M_ih hM.2 hr.2) (prod_nonneg hM.2) (hM.1.trans hr.1)

name: ring_id
statement:
theorem ring_id [CommSemiring R] {x y z c : R} (h : x * y = c + z) :
    (x ^ 2 + c) * (y ^ 2 + c) = z ^ 2 + c * (x + y) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_mul, mul_add, ← mul_pow, add_assoc, h, add_comm c, mul_comm, ← mul_add,
    add_sq, add_assoc, add_assoc, sq c, ← mul_add, ← mul_rotate, mul_assoc, ← mul_add]
  refine congrArg₂ _ rfl (congrArg₂ _ rfl ?_)
  rw [← add_rotate' c, ← add_assoc c, ← two_mul, ← add_assoc,
    ← mul_add, add_comm z, ← h, ← mul_assoc, add_comm, add_sq']

name: main_claim
statement:
theorem main_claim {x y z w c : R} (h : x + y = z + w) (h0 : c ≤ x * y) (h1 : x * y ≤ z * w) :
    (x ^ 2 + c) * (y ^ 2 + c) ≤ (z ^ 2 + c) * (w ^ 2 + c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, x * y = c + a := exists_add_of_le h0
  rw [ha, le_add_iff_nonneg_right] at h0
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, z * w = c + (a + b) :=
    (exists_add_of_le h1).imp λ b h2 ↦ by rw [h2, ha, add_assoc]
  rw [ha, hb, add_le_add_iff_left] at h1
  rw [ring_id ha, ring_id hb, h, add_le_add_iff_right]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 h1 2

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution {M : Multiset R} (hM : ∀ x ∈ M, 0 ≤ x) :
    ∀ {c} (_ : 0 ≤ c) (_ : ∀ x y, {x, y} ≤ M → c ≤ x * y) {r} (_ : M.sum ≤ card M • r),
    (M.map (· ^ 2 + c)).prod ≤ (r ^ 2 + c) ^ (card M)
proof:
:= by
  
  generalize hn : card M = n
  revert hM hn M
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rintro M - hM0 _ - - _ -
      rw [card_eq_zero.mp hM0, Multiset.map_zero, prod_zero, pow_zero]
  | succ n n_ih => ?_
  intro M hM hn c hc hc0 r hr
  
  rcases em (∀ x ∈ M, x ≤ r) with h | h
  · rw [← hn, ← card_map (· ^ 2 + c)]
    refine ring_prod_le_pow_card ?_ ?_
    · simp only [mem_map]; rintro x ⟨x, -, rfl⟩
      exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) hc
    · simp only [mem_map]; rintro x ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact add_le_add_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (hM x hx) (h x hx) 2) c
  
  simp only [not_forall, not_le] at h
  rcases h with ⟨a, haM, ha⟩
  apply exists_cons_of_mem at haM; rcases haM with ⟨M, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le ha.le
  rw [lt_add_iff_pos_right] at ha
  rw [card_cons, Nat.succ_inj] at hn; subst hn
  
  rw [sum_cons, add_assoc, succ_nsmul', add_le_add_iff_left] at hr
  obtain ⟨b, hbM, hb⟩ : ∃ b ∈ M, b < r := by
    by_contra! h
    exact (lt_add_of_pos_left M.sum ha).not_ge (hr.trans (card_nsmul_le_sum h))
  apply exists_cons_of_mem at hbM; rcases hbM with ⟨M, rfl⟩
  rw [forall_mem_cons, forall_mem_cons] at hM
  rcases hM with ⟨-, hb0, hM⟩
  
  replace n_ih : (((a + b) ::ₘ M).map (· ^ 2 + c)).prod ≤ (r ^ 2 + c) ^ (card M + 1) := by
    
    rw [sum_cons, ← add_assoc, ← sum_cons] at hr
    rw [← card_cons b M]; refine n_ih ?_ ?_ hc (λ x y h ↦ ?_) hr
    · exact forall_mem_cons.mpr ⟨add_nonneg ha.le hb0, hM⟩
    · rw [card_cons, card_cons]
    rcases em' (a + b ∈ ({x, y} : Multiset R)) with h0 | h0
    
    · exact hc0 x y ((le_cons_self _ _).trans'
        ((le_cons_self _ _).trans' ((le_cons_of_notMem h0).mp h)))
    
    · have h1 (z) (h1 : z ∈ M) : c ≤ z * (a + b) := by
        apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_add_of_nonneg_left ha.le) (hM z h1)).trans'
        refine hc0 z b ((le_cons_self _ _).trans' ?_)
        rwa [pair_comm, insert_eq_cons, cons_le_cons_iff, singleton_le]
      rw [insert_eq_cons, mem_cons, mem_singleton] at h0
      rcases h0 with rfl | rfl
      · rw [insert_eq_cons, cons_le_cons_iff, singleton_le] at h
        rw [mul_comm]; exact h1 y h
      · rw [pair_comm, insert_eq_cons, cons_le_cons_iff, singleton_le] at h
        exact h1 x h
  
  calc
  _ = ((r + a) ^ 2 + c) * (b ^ 2 + c) * (M.map (· ^ 2 + c)).prod := by
    rw [map_cons, map_cons, prod_cons, prod_cons, mul_assoc]
  _ ≤ (r ^ 2 + c) * ((a + b) ^ 2 + c) * (M.map (· ^ 2 + c)).prod := by
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ ?_
    
    · refine main_claim (add_assoc r a b) ?_ ?_
      · refine hc0 _ _ (Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mpr ⟨M, ?_⟩)
        rw [insert_eq_cons, cons_add, singleton_add]
      · rw [add_mul, mul_add, add_comm, add_le_add_iff_right, mul_comm]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb.le ha.le
    
    · apply prod_nonneg
      simp only [mem_map]; rintro x ⟨x, -, rfl⟩
      exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) hc
  _ = (r ^ 2 + c) * (((a + b) ::ₘ M).map (· ^ 2 + c)).prod := by
    rw [map_cons, prod_cons, mul_assoc]
  _ ≤ (r ^ 2 + c) * (r ^ 2 + c) ^ (card M + 1) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left n_ih (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg r) hc)
  _ = _ := by rw [card_cons, pow_succ' (r ^ 2 + c) (card M + 1)]

name: neg_left
statement: theorem neg_left : nice k a (-x) y
proof:
:= by
  rwa [nice, neg_sq]

name: neg_right
statement: theorem neg_right : nice k a x (-y)
proof:
:= by
  rwa [nice, neg_sq]

name: neg_neg
statement: theorem neg_neg : nice k a (-x) (-y)
proof:
:=
  h.neg_left.neg_right

name: abs_left
statement: theorem abs_left : nice k a |x| y
proof:
:= by
  rwa [nice, sq_abs]

name: abs_right
statement: theorem abs_right : nice k a x |y|
proof:
:= by
  rwa [nice, sq_abs]

name: abs_abs
statement: theorem abs_abs : nice k a |x| |y|
proof:
:=
  h.abs_left.abs_right

name: linear_transform
statement:
theorem linear_transform :
    nice k a ((2 * k + 1) * x + 2 * (k + 1) * y) (2 * k * x + (2 * k + 1) * y)
proof:
:= calc
  _ = (k + 1) * y ^ 2 - k * x ^ 2 := by ring
  _ = a := h

name: k_mirror
statement: theorem k_mirror : nice (-(k + 1)) a y x
proof:
:= by
  rwa [nice, neg_mul, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm,
    neg_add', sub_add_cancel, neg_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: y_ne_zero
statement: theorem y_ne_zero (hk : 0 ≤ k) (ha : 0 < a) (h : nice k a x y) : y ≠ 0
proof:
:= λ h1 ↦ by
  rw [h1, nice, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1), mul_zero, zero_sub] at h
  exact h.not_lt ((neg_nonpos.mpr (mul_nonneg hk (sq_nonneg x))).trans_lt ha)

name: exists_x_ge_bound_nat
statement:
theorem exists_x_ge_bound_nat (h : ∃ x y, nice k a x y) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ x y : ℤ, 0 ≤ x ∧ N ≤ x ^ 2 ∧ nice k a x y
proof:
:= by
  
  refine Nat.rec ?_ (λ N h0 ↦ ?_)
  · rcases h with ⟨x, y, h⟩; exact ⟨|x|, |y|, abs_nonneg x, sq_nonneg _, h.abs_abs⟩
  clear h; rcases h0 with ⟨x, y, hx, hx0, h⟩
  
  have X : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 1 := Int.zero_le_ofNat 1
  have X0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 2 := Int.zero_le_ofNat 2
  have X1 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 2 * k := Int.mul_nonneg X0 hk
  have X2 : (0 : ℤ) < 2 * (k + 1) := Int.mul_pos two_pos (Int.lt_add_one_of_le hk)
  refine ⟨(2 * k + 1) * x + 2 * (k + 1) * |y|, 2 * k * x + (2 * k + 1) * |y|,
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg X1 X) hx) (mul_nonneg X2.le (abs_nonneg y)),
    ?_, h.abs_right.linear_transform⟩
  
  rw [Nat.cast_succ, Int.add_one_le_iff]
  refine hx0.trans_lt (pow_lt_pow_left₀ ?_ hx (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1))
  rw [add_one_mul (2 * k), add_right_comm, lt_add_iff_pos_left]
  exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (mul_nonneg X1 hx)
    (mul_pos X2 (abs_pos.mpr (h.y_ne_zero hk ha)))

name: exists_x_sq_le_a
statement:
theorem exists_x_sq_le_a (h : ∃ x y, nice k a x y) :
    ∃ x y : ℤ, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ^ 2 ≤ a ∧ nice k a x y
proof:
:= by
  
  let P (N : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ x y : ℤ, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ^ 2 ≤ N ∧ nice k a x y
  suffices P a.natAbs by
    dsimp only [P] at this; rwa [Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_of_nonneg ha.le] at this
  revert h; suffices ∀ N, a.natAbs ≤ N → P (N + 1) → P N by
    rintro ⟨x, y, h⟩
    obtain h0 | h0 : x ^ 2 ≤ a.natAbs ∨ a.natAbs ≤ x ^ 2 := le_total _ _
    · exact ⟨|x|, y, abs_nonneg x, (sq_abs _).trans_le h0, h.abs_left⟩
    
    replace h0 : a.natAbs ≤ x.natAbs ^ 2 := by
      rwa [← sq_abs, ← Int.natCast_natAbs, ← Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_le] at h0
    refine Nat.decreasingInduction' (λ k _ ↦ this k) h0 ⟨|x|, y, abs_nonneg _, ?_, h.abs_left⟩
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Int.natCast_natAbs]
  
  rintro N hN ⟨x, y, hx, hx0, h0⟩
  rw [Nat.cast_succ, Int.le_add_one_iff] at hx0
  rcases hx0 with hx0 | hx0
  · exact ⟨x, y, hx, hx0, h0⟩
  
  refine ⟨_, _, abs_nonneg _, ?_, h0.abs_abs.neg_right.linear_transform.abs_left⟩
  rw [← Int.lt_add_one_iff, ← hx0, sq_lt_sq, abs_abs, mul_neg, abs_lt]
  have hk0 : 0 < k + 1 := Int.lt_add_one_of_le hk
  have h1 : |y| < |x| := by
    rw [← sq_lt_sq, ← mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_left hk0, (eq_add_of_sub_eq' h0), add_one_mul k]
    refine add_lt_add_right (lt_of_abs_lt ?_) _
    rwa [hx0, Int.lt_add_one_iff, ← Int.natCast_natAbs, Nat.cast_le]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · have h2 : 0 < 2 * (k + 1) := mul_pos two_pos hk0
    rwa [lt_add_neg_iff_add_lt, neg_add_lt_iff_lt_add', ← add_one_mul,
      add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two, ← mul_add_one 2 k, mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_left h2]
  
  · rw [add_neg_lt_iff_lt_add, add_one_mul _ |x|, add_comm]
    refine add_lt_add_right (lt_of_not_ge λ h2 ↦ ?_) _
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left two_pos] at h2
    apply (mul_le_mul h2 h1.le (abs_nonneg y) (mul_nonneg hk (abs_nonneg x))).not_gt
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← sq, sq_abs, ← sq, sq_abs, ← sub_pos, h0]

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution :
    (∃ x y, 0 ≤ x ∧ a < x ^ 2 ∧ nice k a x y)
      ↔ (∃ x y, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ^ 2 ≤ a ∧ nice k a x y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ ⟨x, y, _, _, h⟩ ↦ exists_x_sq_le_a hk ha ⟨x, y, h⟩, λ ⟨x, y, _, _, h⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, y, h0, h1, h2⟩ := exists_x_ge_bound_nat hk ha ⟨x, y, h⟩ (a.natAbs + 1)
  refine ⟨x, y, h0, ?_, h2⟩
  rw [Nat.cast_succ, Int.add_one_le_iff, Int.natCast_natAbs] at h1
  exact lt_of_abs_lt h1

name: sum_of_periodic
statement:
lemma sum_of_periodic [AddCommMonoid M] {a : ℕ → M} (hn : a.Periodic (n + 1)) :
    ∀ d, ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), a (k + d) = ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), a k
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec (sum_range a) λ d hd ↦ ?_
  rw [← hd, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ', n.add_left_comm d 1, hn, d.zero_add]
  simp only [Nat.add_succ, Nat.succ_add]

name: stdGoodSeq_is_good
statement: theorem stdGoodSeq_is_good : good (stdGoodSeq R d)
proof:
:= λ k ↦ by
  unfold stdGoodSeq; rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_two, Nat.cast_succ,
    add_right_comm, add_right_comm (k : Fin 3) 1 d]
  generalize (k : Fin 3) + d = c
  match c with
  | 0 => show (-1 : R) = 2 * -1 + 1; rw [two_mul, neg_add_cancel_right]
  | 1 => show (2 : R) = -1 * -1 + 1; rw [neg_mul_neg, one_mul, one_add_one_eq_two]
  | 2 => show (-1 : R) = -1 * 2 + 1; rw [mul_two, neg_add_cancel_right]

name: stdGoodSeq_periodic3
statement: theorem stdGoodSeq_periodic3 : (stdGoodSeq R d).Periodic 3
proof:
:= λ n ↦ by
  unfold stdGoodSeq; rw [Nat.cast_add, add_right_comm]
  exact congrArg _ (add_zero _)

name: stdGoodSeq_periodic_three_mul
statement: theorem stdGoodSeq_periodic_three_mul : ∀ k, (stdGoodSeq R d).Periodic (3 * k)
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.rec (λ _ ↦ rfl) (λ k hk n ↦ ?_)
  rw [Nat.mul_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc, stdGoodSeq_periodic3, hk]

name: stdGoodSeq_periodic_of_three_dvd
statement: theorem stdGoodSeq_periodic_of_three_dvd (h : 3 ∣ k) : (stdGoodSeq R d).Periodic k
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact stdGoodSeq_periodic_three_mul R d k

name: stdGoodSeq_periodic_iff_three_dvd
statement:
theorem stdGoodSeq_periodic_iff_three_dvd (R)
    [Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {n} :
    (stdGoodSeq R d).Periodic n ↔ 3 ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ ⟨k, hk⟩ ↦ hk ▸ stdGoodSeq_periodic_three_mul R d k⟩
  replace h : ![2, -1, -1] n = (2 : R) := by
    specialize h (2 * d.1); unfold stdGoodSeq at h
    have X : ((2 : ℕ) : Fin 3) + 1 = 0 := rfl
    rwa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Fin.cast_val_eq_self,
      add_right_comm, ← add_one_mul, X, zero_mul, zero_add] at h
  rw [← Fin.natCast_eq_zero]; generalize (n : Fin 3) = k at h ⊢
  have X : (-1 : R) ≠ 2 := by norm_num
  match k with | 0 => rfl | 1 => exact absurd h X | 2 => exact absurd h X

name: eq1
statement:
lemma eq1 [Semiring R] {a : ℕ → R} (ha : good a) (k) :
    a (k + 2) ^ 2 + a k = a k * a (k + 3) + a (k + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ha (k + 1), mul_add_one (a k), add_right_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← add_one_mul, ← ha, sq]

name: eq2
statement:
lemma eq2 [Semiring R] [IsCancelAdd R] {a : ℕ → R} (ha : good a) (hn : a.Periodic (n + 1)) :
    ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), a k ^ 2 = ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), a k * a (k + 3)
proof:
:= by
  apply add_right_cancel (b := ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), a k); calc
    _ = ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), a (k + 2) ^ 2 + ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), a k :=
      congrArg₂ _ (sum_of_periodic (hn.comp _) 2).symm (sum_range _).symm
    _ = ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (a (k + 2) ^ 2 + a k) := sum_add_distrib.symm
    _ = ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (a k * a (k + 3) + a (k + 2)) := by simp only [ha.eq1]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), _ + ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), _ := sum_add_distrib
    _ = _ := congrArg₂ _ (sum_range _) (sum_of_periodic hn 2)

name: eq3
statement:
lemma eq3 [CommRing R] {a : ℕ → R} (ha : good a) (hn : a.Periodic (n + 1)) :
    ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), (a k - a (k + 3)) ^ 2 = 0
proof:
:= calc
  _ = ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), a k ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), a (k + 3) ^ 2
      - ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), 2 * (a k * a (k + 3)) := by
    simp only [sub_sq', mul_assoc]
    rw [sum_sub_distrib, sum_add_distrib]
  _ = 2 * ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), a k ^ 2 - 2 * ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), a k * a (k + 3) := by
    refine congrArg₂ _ ?_ (mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    rw [two_mul, add_right_inj, ← sum_range (λ x ↦ a (x + 3) ^ 2)]
    exact sum_of_periodic (hn.comp _) 3
  _ = _ := by rw [ha.eq2 hn, sub_self]

name: exists_eq_stdGoodSeq_of_periodic3
statement: theorem exists_eq_stdGoodSeq_of_periodic3 (h : a.Periodic 3) : ∃ d, a = stdGoodSeq R d
proof:
:= by
  have X {x y z : R} (h : x * y + 1 = z) (h0 : y * z + 1 = x) : y = -1 ∨ x = z := by
    replace h0 : _ - _ = _ - _ := congrArg₂ (· - ·) h h0
    rwa [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, mul_comm, ← mul_sub, ← neg_sub x,
      ← neg_one_mul, mul_eq_mul_right_iff, sub_eq_zero] at h0
  have h0 : a 0 = a 1 * a 2 + 1 := by rw [← ha, h]
  have h1 : a 1 = a 2 * a 0 + 1 := by rw [← h 1, ha 2, h]
  replace ha : a 2 = a 0 * a 1 + 1 := ha 0
  obtain h2 | h2 : a 0 = -1 ∨ a 2 = a 1 := X h1.symm ha.symm
  all_goals obtain h3 | h3 : a 1 = -1 ∨ a 0 = a 2 := X ha.symm h0.symm
  
  · rw [h2, h3, neg_mul_neg, one_mul, one_add_one_eq_two] at ha
    refine ⟨1, funext λ n ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← h.map_mod_nat, ← Fin.val_natCast, stdGoodSeq]
    match (n : Fin 3) with | 0 => exact h2 | 1 => exact h3 | 2 => exact ha
  
  · rw [eq_comm, h2] at h3
    rw [h2, h3, neg_mul_neg, one_mul, one_add_one_eq_two] at h1
    refine ⟨2, funext λ n ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← h.map_mod_nat, ← Fin.val_natCast, stdGoodSeq]
    match (n : Fin 3) with | 0 => exact h2 | 1 => exact h1 | 2 => exact h3
  
  · rw [h3] at h2; rw [h2, h3, neg_mul_neg, one_mul, one_add_one_eq_two] at h0
    refine ⟨0, funext λ n ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← h.map_mod_nat, ← Fin.val_natCast, stdGoodSeq]
    match (n : Fin 3) with | 0 => exact h0 | 1 => exact h3 | 2 => exact h2
  
  · rw [← h2, ← h3] at h0; clear h1 ha h2 h3 X h
    replace h0 : (2 * a 0 - 1) ^ 2 + 3 = 0 := calc
      _ = 4 * (a 0 * a 0 + 1 - a 0) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [← h0, sub_self, mul_zero]
    exact absurd (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg _) three_pos) h0.not_gt

name: periodic3_Fin_of_periodic
statement: lemma periodic3_Fin_of_periodic (k : Fin (n + 1)) : a (k + 3) = a k
proof:
:= by
  have h := (sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg λ k _ ↦ sq_nonneg _).mp (ha.eq3 hn) k (mem_univ k)
  rwa [sq_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at h

name: periodic3_of_periodic
statement: lemma periodic3_of_periodic : a.Periodic 3
proof:
:= by
  intro m; have h := ha.periodic3_Fin_of_periodic hn m
  rwa [Fin.val_natCast, hn.map_mod_nat, ← hn.map_mod_nat,
    Nat.mod_add_mod, hn.map_mod_nat] at h

name: three_dvd_period
statement: theorem three_dvd_period : 3 ∣ n + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := ha.exists_eq_stdGoodSeq_of_periodic3 (ha.periodic3_of_periodic hn)
  exact (stdGoodSeq_periodic_iff_three_dvd d R).mp hn

name: final_solution_general
statement:
theorem final_solution_general [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    {a : ℕ → R} : (good a ∧ ∃ n, a.Periodic (n + 1)) ↔ ∃ d, a = stdGoodSeq R d
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ ⟨ha, _, hn⟩ ↦ ha.exists_eq_stdGoodSeq_of_periodic3 (ha.periodic3_of_periodic hn),
    λ ⟨d, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ ⟨stdGoodSeq_is_good R d, 2, stdGoodSeq_periodic3 R d⟩⟩

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {n : ℕ} :
    (∃ a : ℕ → R, good a ∧ a.Periodic (n + 1)) ↔ 3 ∣ n + 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ ⟨_, ha, hn⟩ ↦ ha.three_dvd_period hn,
  λ h ↦ ⟨stdGoodSeq R 0, stdGoodSeq_is_good R 0, stdGoodSeq_periodic_of_three_dvd R 0 h⟩⟩

name: PNat_eq_of_dvd_of_lt_mul_one_add_one
statement:
lemma PNat_eq_of_dvd_of_lt_mul_one_add_one
    {a b : ℕ+} (h : a ∣ b) (h0 : b < a * (1 + 1)) : b = a
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨c, rfl⟩
  rw [mul_lt_mul_iff_left, PNat.lt_add_one_iff, le_one_iff_eq_one] at h0
  rw [h0, mul_one]

name: PNat_exists_greatest_infinite_fiber
statement:
lemma PNat_exists_greatest_infinite_fiber {f : ℕ+ → ℕ+} (h : ∃ N, ∀ n, f n ≤ N) :
    ∃ M, (∀ N, ∃ n ≥ N, f n = M) ∧ (∃ C, ∀ n ≥ C, f n ≤ M)
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  suffices ∀ M N, ∃ n ≥ N, M ≤ f n by
    intro N; obtain ⟨n, -, hn⟩ := this (N + 1) 1
    exact ⟨n, PNat.add_one_le_iff.mp hn⟩
  intro M; induction M using PNat.recOn with
  | one => intro N; exact ⟨N, le_refl N, one_le⟩
  | succ M M_ih =>
      by_contra! h0; rcases h0 with ⟨K, hK⟩
      have h0 (N) : ∃ n ≥ N, f n = M := by
        obtain ⟨n, hn, h1⟩ := M_ih (N + K)
        exact ⟨n, (N.lt_add_right K).le.trans hn,
          h1.antisymm' <| PNat.lt_add_one_iff.mp <| hK n <| (K.lt_add_left N).le.trans hn⟩
      obtain ⟨n, h1, h2⟩ := h _ h0 K
      exact (PNat.add_one_le_iff.mpr h2).not_gt (hK n h1)

name: PNat_exists_big_not_dvd
statement: lemma PNat_exists_big_not_dvd {d : ℕ+} (hd : d > 1) (N : ℕ+) : ∃ n ≥ N, ¬d.val ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  refine (em' (d.val ∣ N)).elim (λ h ↦ ⟨N, le_refl N, h⟩)
    (λ h ↦ ⟨N + 1, (N.lt_add_right _).le, λ h0 ↦ ?_⟩)
  rw [PNat.add_coe, Nat.dvd_add_right h, ← PNat.dvd_iff] at h0
  exact hd.not_ge (PNat.le_of_dvd h0)

name: ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {f g : GoodFun G} : (∀ x, f x = g x) → f = g
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext _ _

name: good_def
statement: theorem good_def (f : GoodFun G) : ∀ m n, f (m + n) ∣ f m + f n
proof:
:=
  f.good_def'

name: good_def2
statement: theorem good_def2 (f : GoodFun G) (m n) : (f (m + n)).val ∣ f m + f n
proof:
:=
  PNat.dvd_iff.mp (f.good_def m n)

name: smul_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem smul_apply (c : ℕ+) (f : GoodFun G) (n) : (c • f) n = c * f n
proof: := rfl

name: div_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem div_apply : f.div h n = (f n).divExact M
proof: := rfl

name: smul_div
statement: theorem smul_div : M • f.div h = f
proof:
:=
  ext λ n ↦ PNat.mul_div_exact (h n)

name: id_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem id_apply (n) : GoodFun.id n = n
proof: := rfl

name: const_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem const_apply (c x) : GoodFun.const G c x = c
proof: := rfl

name: const_mul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem const_mul_eq_smul (m n : ℕ+) :
    GoodFun.const G (m * n) = m • GoodFun.const G n
proof: := rfl

name: const_eq_smul_const_one
statement: theorem const_eq_smul_const_one (m : ℕ+) : GoodFun.const G m = m • GoodFun.const G 1
proof:
:=
  GoodFun.ext λ _ ↦ (mul_one m).symm

name: periodic_one_two_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem periodic_one_two_apply (d n) :
    GoodFun.periodic_one_two d n = if d.val ∣ n then 2 else 1
proof: := rfl

name: periodic_one_two_apply_of_dvd
statement:
theorem periodic_one_two_apply_of_dvd {d n : ℕ+} (h : d.val ∣ n) :
    GoodFun.periodic_one_two d n = 2
proof: := ite_eq_left h

name: periodic_one_two_apply_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem periodic_one_two_apply_of_not_dvd {d n : ℕ+} (h : ¬d.val ∣ n) :
    GoodFun.periodic_one_two d n = 1
proof: := ite_eq_right h

name: map_le_mul_map_one
statement: theorem map_le_mul_map_one (f : GoodFun ℕ+) (n : ℕ+) : f n ≤ f 1 * n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using PNat.recOn with | one => exact (mul_one _).ge | succ n hn => ?_
  apply (PNat.le_of_dvd (f.good_def n 1)).trans
  rwa [mul_add_one, add_le_add_iff_right]

name: map_add_eq_of_map_lt_dvd_map_add
statement:
theorem map_add_eq_of_map_lt_dvd_map_add {f : GoodFun ℕ+}
    (h : f k < M) (h0 : f m < M) (h1 : M ∣ f (k + m)) : f k + f m = M
proof:
:=
  PNat_eq_of_dvd_of_lt_mul_one_add_one (h1.trans (f.good_def k m))
    ((add_lt_add h h0).trans_eq (by rw [mul_add_one, mul_one]))

name: map_add_eq_of_map_lt
statement:
theorem map_add_eq_of_map_lt {f : GoodFun ℕ+} (h : f k < f (k + m)) (h0 : f m < f (k + m)) :
    f k + f m = f (k + m)
proof:
:=
  map_add_eq_of_map_lt_dvd_map_add h h0 (dvd_refl _)

name: eq_smul_id_of_unbounded
statement:
theorem eq_smul_id_of_unbounded {f : GoodFun ℕ+} (hf : ∀ N, ∃ n, N < f n) :
    ∃ d : ℕ+, f = d • GoodFun.id
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∀ n, f (n + 1) = f n + f 1 by
    refine ⟨f 1, ext λ n ↦ ?_⟩
    induction n using PNat.recOn with
    | one => exact (mul_one (f 1)).symm
    | succ n n_ih => rw [this, n_ih]; exact (mul_add_one _ _).symm
  
  intro n
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ :
      ∃ N, f 1 * (n + (n + 1)) < f N ∧ ∀ m < N, f m ≤ f 1 * (n + (n + 1)) := by
    set C := f 1 * (n + (n + 1)); let hC := hf C
    exact ⟨PNat.find hC, PNat.find_spec hC, λ m hm ↦ le_of_not_gt (PNat.find_min hC hm)⟩
  replace hf (m) (hm : m < N) : f m < f N := (hN0 m hm).trans_lt hN
  
  replace hf {k m} (h : k + m = N) : f k + f m = f N := by
    subst h; exact f.map_add_eq_of_map_lt (hf _ (k.lt_add_right m)) (hf _ (m.lt_add_left k))
  
  obtain ⟨M, rfl⟩ : ∃ M, M + (n + 1) = N :=
    ⟨N - (n + 1), PNat.sub_add_of_lt <| lt_of_not_ge λ h ↦
      hN.not_ge <| (f.map_le_mul_map_one N).trans <|
        mul_le_mul_right (h.trans (PNat.lt_add_left _ _).le) _⟩
  
  replace hf : f M + f (n + 1) = f (M + 1) + f n :=
    (hf rfl).trans (hf (by rw [add_right_comm, add_assoc])).symm
  
  suffices f (M + 1) = f M + f 1 by
    rwa [this, add_right_comm, add_assoc, add_right_inj] at hf
  
  refine (PNat_eq_of_dvd_of_lt_mul_one_add_one (f.good_def M 1) ?_).symm
  replace hN0 : f M ≤ f 1 * (n + (n + 1)) := hN0 _ (PNat.lt_add_right _ _)
  replace hN : f 1 * (n + 1) < f (M + 1) :=
    lt_of_add_lt_add_right (a := f n) <| calc f 1 * (n + 1) + f n
      _ ≤ f 1 * (n + 1) + f 1 * n := add_le_add_right (f.map_le_mul_map_one n) _
      _ = f 1 * (n + (n + 1)) := by rw [← mul_add, add_comm]
      _ < f (M + (n + 1)) := hN
      _ = f (M + 1 + n) := by rw [add_right_comm, add_assoc]
      _ ≤ f (M + 1) + f n := PNat.le_of_dvd (f.good_def _ _)
  calc f M + f 1
    _ ≤ f 1 * (n + (n + 1)) + f 1 := add_le_add_left hN0 (f 1)
    _ = f 1 * (n + 1) * (1 + 1) := by
      rw [← mul_add_one, add_right_comm, mul_assoc, mul_add_one, mul_one]
    _ < f (M + 1) * 2 := mul_lt_mul_left hN 2

name: dvd_map_add_imp_iff
statement:
theorem dvd_map_add_imp_iff {f : GoodFun ℕ+} {M : ℕ}
    (h : M ∣ f (m + n)) (h0 : M ∣ f m) : M ∣ f n
proof:
:=
  (Nat.dvd_add_right h0).mp (h.trans (PNat.dvd_iff.mp (f.good_def m n)))

name: dvd_map_dvd_map_mul_add_imp
statement:
theorem dvd_map_dvd_map_mul_add_imp {f : GoodFun ℕ+} {M : ℕ}
    (h : M ∣ f d) (h0 : M ∣ f (d * (m + k))) : M ∣ f (d * m)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 {m} (h1 : M ∣ f (d * (m + 1))) : M ∣ f (d * m) := by
    rw [mul_add_one, add_comm] at h1; exact dvd_map_add_imp_iff h1 h
  induction k using PNat.caseStrongInductionOn with
  | hz => exact h1 h0
  | hi k k_ih => exact k_ih _ (le_refl k) (h1 (add_assoc m k 1 ▸ h0))

name: dvd_map_dvd_map_mul_imp
statement:
theorem dvd_map_dvd_map_mul_imp {f : GoodFun ℕ+} {M : ℕ}
    (h : M ∣ f d) (h0 : M ∣ f (d * k)) (h1 : m ≤ k) : M ∣ f (d * m)
proof:
:=
  h1.eq_or_lt.elim (λ h2 ↦ h2 ▸ h0)
    (λ h2 ↦ dvd_map_dvd_map_mul_add_imp h (by rwa [PNat.add_sub_of_lt h2]))

name: exists_dvd_dvd_imp
statement:
theorem exists_dvd_dvd_imp {f : GoodFun ℕ+} {M : ℕ} (h : ∃ n, M ∣ f n) :
    ∃ d : ℕ+, M ∣ f d ∧ ∀ n, M ∣ f n → d.val ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  let d := PNat.find h
  have d_spec : M ∣ f d := PNat.find_spec h
  refine ⟨d, d_spec, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  induction n using PNat.strongInductionOn with | _ n n_ih => ?_
  obtain rfl | ⟨m, rfl⟩ : d = n ∨ ∃ m, m + d = n :=
    (PNat.find_min' h hn).eq_or_lt.imp_right λ h0 ↦ ⟨n - d, PNat.sub_add_of_lt h0⟩
  exacts [d.val.dvd_refl, Nat.dvd_add_self_right.mpr <| n_ih _ (m.lt_add_right d) <|
    (Nat.dvd_add_iff_left d_spec).mpr (hn.trans (f.good_def2 m d))]

name: dvd_set_infinite_imp
statement:
theorem dvd_set_infinite_imp {f : GoodFun ℕ+} {M : ℕ} (h : ∀ N, ∃ n ≥ N, M ∣ f n) :
    ∃ d : ℕ+, ∀ n, M ∣ f n ↔ d.val ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hd0⟩ := exists_dvd_dvd_imp ((h 1).imp λ _ ↦ And.right)
  refine ⟨d, λ n ↦ ⟨hd0 n, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [← PNat.dvd_iff]; rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨n, h0, h1⟩ : ∃ n ≥ d * k, M ∣ f n := h (d * k)
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : d ∣ n := (PNat.dvd_iff).mpr (hd0 n h1)
  exact dvd_map_dvd_map_mul_imp hd h1 ((mul_le_mul_iff_left d).mp h0)

name: exists_limsup_and_dvd_map_iff
statement:
theorem exists_limsup_and_dvd_map_iff {f : GoodFun ℕ+} (h : ∃ N, ∀ n, f n ≤ N) :
    ∃ M, (∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, f n ≤ M) ∧ (∃ d : ℕ+, ∀ n, M.val ∣ f n ↔ d.val ∣ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, h0, h1⟩ := PNat_exists_greatest_infinite_fiber h
  exact ⟨M, h1, dvd_set_infinite_imp λ N ↦ (h0 N).imp λ n ↦ And.imp_right λ h2 ↦ by rw [h2]⟩

name: dvd_set_cofinite_imp
statement:
theorem dvd_set_cofinite_imp {f : GoodFun ℕ+} {M : ℕ} (h : ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, M ∣ f n) :
    ∀ n, M ∣ f n
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨K, h⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ+, ∀ n, M ∣ f n ↔ d.val ∣ n :=
    f.dvd_set_infinite_imp λ N ↦ ⟨K ⊔ N, le_max_right K N, h _ (le_max_left K N)⟩
  suffices d = 1 from λ n ↦ (hd n).mpr (this ▸ n.1.one_dvd)
  simp only [hd] at h
  rw [← PNat.dvd_one_iff, PNat.dvd_iff, Nat.dvd_add_iff_right (h K (le_refl K))]
  exact h (K + 1) (K.lt_add_right 1).le

name: eq_set_cofinite_imp
statement:
theorem eq_set_cofinite_imp {f : GoodFun ℕ+} (h : ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, f n = M) :
    ∃ g : GoodFun ℕ+, f = M • g ∧ ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, g n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨N, hN⟩
  have h0 (n) : M ∣ f n := PNat.dvd_iff.mpr <|
    f.dvd_set_cofinite_imp ⟨N, λ n hn ↦ dvd_of_eq (congrArg _ (hN n hn).symm)⟩ n
  let hg : M • f.div h0 = f := f.smul_div h0
  refine ⟨f.div h0, hg.symm, N, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← mul_eq_left, ← smul_apply, hg, hN n hn]

name: eventually_bound_and_dvd_iff_period_imp
statement:
theorem eventually_bound_and_dvd_iff_period_imp {f : GoodFun ℕ+} (hN : ∀ n ≥ N, f n ≤ M)
    {d : ℕ+} (hd : d > 1) (hd0 : ∀ n, M.val ∣ f n ↔ d.val ∣ n) :
    ∃ C, 2 * C = M ∧ ∀ n, n ≥ N → f n = C * if d.val ∣ n then 2 else 1
proof:
:= by
  replace hd0 (n) (hn : n ≥ N) : f n = M ↔ d.val ∣ n := by
    rw [← hd0, ← PNat.dvd_iff]
    exact ⟨λ h ↦ h ▸ dvd_refl _, λ h ↦ (hN n hn).antisymm (PNat.le_of_dvd h)⟩
  replace hN (n) (hn : n ≥ N) (hn0 : ¬d.1 ∣ n) : f n < M :=
    (hN n hn).lt_of_ne λ h ↦ hn0 ((hd0 n hn).mp h)
  
  suffices ∀ n ≥ N, ¬d.1 ∣ n → 2 * f n = M by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ := PNat_exists_big_not_dvd hd N
    obtain rfl := this c hc hc0
    refine ⟨f c, rfl, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    split_ifs with hn0
    · rw [(hd0 n hn).mpr hn0, mul_comm]
    · rw [mul_one, ← mul_left_cancel_iff, this n hn hn0]
  
  replace hN {k m : ℕ+} (hk : k ≥ N) (hm : m ≥ N) (hk0 : ¬d.val ∣ k)
      (hm0 : ¬d.val ∣ m) (h : d.val ∣ k + m) : f k + f m = M :=
    map_add_eq_of_map_lt_dvd_map_add (hN _ hk hk0) (hN _ hm hm0)
      (dvd_of_eq ((hd0 (k + m) (hk.trans (k.lt_add_right m).le)).mpr h).symm)
  
  replace hd0 : f (N * d) = M :=
    (hd0 _ (le_mul_of_one_le_right' one_le)).mpr (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)
  replace hd0 {k m : ℕ+} (hk : k ≥ N) (hm : m ≥ N) (hk0 : ¬d.val ∣ k)
      (hm0 : ¬d.val ∣ m) (h : d.val ∣ k + m) : (f k).val ∣ f m := by
    have h0 : f k + f m = M := hN hk hm hk0 hm0 h
    have h1 : f (N * d + k) + f m = M := by
      have h1 : d.val ∣ N * d := d.val.dvd_mul_left N
      refine hN (hk.trans (k.lt_add_left _).le) hm ?_ hm0 ?_
      · rwa [PNat.add_coe, PNat.mul_coe, Nat.dvd_add_right h1]
      · rwa [PNat.add_coe, PNat.mul_coe, add_assoc, Nat.dvd_add_right h1]
    rw [← h0, add_left_inj] at h1
    rw [← Nat.dvd_add_self_left, ← PNat.add_coe, h0, ← hd0,
      ← Nat.dvd_add_self_right, ← PNat.add_coe, ← PNat.dvd_iff]
    exact (dvd_of_eq h1.symm).trans (f.good_def _ _)
  
  intro k hk hk0
  obtain ⟨m, hm, h1⟩ : ∃ m ≥ N, d.val ∣ k + m := by
    refine ⟨k * (d - 1), le_mul_of_le_of_one_le hk one_le, ?_⟩
    rw [← PNat.add_coe, ← PNat.dvd_iff, ← mul_one_add, PNat.add_sub_of_lt hd]
    exact dvd_mul_left d k
  have hm0 : ¬d.val ∣ m := λ hm0 ↦ hk0 ((Nat.dvd_add_iff_left hm0).mpr h1)
  change (1 + 1) * f k = M
  rw [← hN hk hm hk0 hm0 h1, add_one_mul, one_mul, add_right_inj, ← PNat.coe_inj]
  exact Nat.dvd_antisymm (hd0 hk hm hk0 hm0 h1) (hd0 hm hk hm0 hk0 (by rwa [add_comm]))

name: exists_smul_eventually_eq_one_or_one_two
statement:
theorem exists_smul_eventually_eq_one_or_one_two {f : GoodFun ℕ+} (h : ∃ N, ∀ n, f n ≤ N) :
    (∃ (C : ℕ+) (g : GoodFun ℕ+), f = C • g ∧ ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, g n = 1) ∨
    (∃ (C : ℕ+) (g : GoodFun ℕ+), f = C • g ∧ ∃ d : ℕ+, d > 1 ∧
      ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, g n = if d.val ∣ n then 2 else 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨N, hN⟩, ⟨d, hd⟩⟩ := exists_limsup_and_dvd_map_iff h
  apply (eq_one_or_one_lt d).imp
  
  · rintro rfl; exact ⟨M, eq_set_cofinite_imp ⟨N, λ n hn ↦ (hN n hn).antisymm <|
      PNat.le_of_dvd <| PNat.dvd_iff.mpr <| (hd n).mpr n.1.one_dvd⟩⟩
  
  · intro hd0; obtain ⟨C, rfl, hC⟩ := eventually_bound_and_dvd_iff_period_imp hN hd0 hd
    have hC0 (n) : C ∣ f n := PNat.dvd_iff.mpr
      (dvd_set_cofinite_imp ⟨N, λ n hn ↦ PNat.dvd_iff.mp ⟨_, hC n hn⟩⟩ n)
    let hg : f = C • f.div hC0 := (f.smul_div hC0).symm
    refine ⟨C, f.div hC0, hg, d, hd0, N, λ n hn ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← mul_left_cancel_iff, ← hC n hn]
    exact (GoodFun.ext_iff.mp hg n).symm

name: exists_smul_id_or_eventually_eq_one_or_one_two
statement:
theorem exists_smul_id_or_eventually_eq_one_or_one_two (f : GoodFun ℕ+) :
    (∃ C : ℕ+, f = C • GoodFun.id) ∨
    (∃ (C : ℕ+) (g : GoodFun ℕ+), f = C • g ∧ ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, g n = 1) ∨
    (∃ (C : ℕ+) (g : GoodFun ℕ+), f = C • g ∧ ∃ d : ℕ+, d > 1 ∧
      ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, g n = if d.val ∣ n then 2 else 1)
proof:
:=
  (forall_or_exists_not λ N ↦ ∃ n, N < f n).imp eq_smul_id_of_unbounded
    λ h ↦ exists_smul_eventually_eq_one_or_one_two (by simpa using h)

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (f : GoodFun ℕ+) : ∃ m, ∀ n, f m ∣ f n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ | ⟨C, g, rfl, N, hN⟩ | ⟨C, g, rfl, d, hd, N, hN⟩ :=
    f.exists_smul_id_or_eventually_eq_one_or_one_two
  
  · exact ⟨1, λ n ↦ ⟨n, congrArg (· * n) (mul_one C).symm⟩⟩
  
  · exact ⟨N, λ n ↦ mul_dvd_mul_left C (hN N (le_refl N) ▸ one_dvd _)⟩
  
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ : ∃ c ≥ N, ¬d.val ∣ c := PNat_exists_big_not_dvd hd N
    refine ⟨c, λ n ↦ mul_dvd_mul_left C ?_⟩
    rw [hN c hc, ite_eq_right hc0]
    exact one_dvd _

name: good_iff
statement:
lemma good_iff {S : Finset ℕ} :
    good S ↔ ∀ m ≥ 2, m ≤ S.card / 2 → ∃ T ⊆ S, T.card = m ∧ 2 * T.sum id = S.sum id
proof:
:= by
  have X {T} (h : T ⊆ S) : T.sum id = (S \ T).sum id ↔ 2 * T.sum id = S.sum id := by
    rw [← Nat.add_left_inj, ← Nat.two_mul, sum_sdiff h]
  refine ⟨λ hS m hm hm0 ↦ ?_, λ hS m hm hm0 ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · replace hm0 : m + 2 ≤ S.card := calc
      _ ≤ m + m := Nat.add_le_add_left hm m
      _ = m * 2 := m.mul_two.symm
      _ ≤ S.card := Nat.mul_le_of_le_div _ _ _ hm0
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hT0, hT1⟩ := hS m hm hm0
    exact ⟨T, hT, hT0, (X hT).mp hT1⟩
  
  · obtain hm1 | hm1 : m ≤ S.card / 2 ∨ S.card / 2 < m := le_or_gt _ _
    · obtain ⟨T, hT, hT0, hT1⟩ := hS m hm hm1
      exact ⟨T, hT, hT0, (X hT).mpr hT1⟩
    · replace hm : m ≤ S.card := Nat.le_of_add_right_le hm0
      replace hm0 : 2 ≤ S.card - m := Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' hm0
      replace hm1 : S.card - m ≤ S.card / 2 := Nat.sub_le_of_le_add <| calc
        _ = 2 * (S.card / 2) + S.card % 2 := (Nat.div_add_mod _ _).symm
        _ ≤ 2 * (S.card / 2) + 1 :=
          Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.mod_lt _ Nat.two_pos)) _
        _ = S.card / 2 + (S.card / 2 + 1) := by rw [Nat.two_mul, Nat.add_assoc]
        _ ≤ S.card / 2 + m := Nat.add_le_add_left hm1 _
      obtain ⟨T, hT, hT0, hT1⟩ := hS (S.card - m) hm0 hm1
      refine ⟨S \ T, sdiff_subset, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [card_sdiff_of_subset hT, hT0, Nat.sub_sub_self hm]
      · rwa [sdiff_sdiff_right_self, inf_eq_inter, inter_eq_right.mpr hT, eq_comm, X hT]

name: good_of_card_lt_four
statement: theorem good_of_card_lt_four {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : S.card < 4) : good S
proof:
:=
  λ _ hm hm0 ↦ absurd hm0 (Nat.not_le_of_lt (hS.trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_right hm 2)))

name: mul_three_pow_inj
statement: lemma mul_three_pow_inj (n : ℕ) : (n.succ * 3 ^ ·).Injective
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ h ↦ Nat.pow_right_injective (by decide : 1 < 3) (Nat.mul_left_cancel n.succ_pos h)

name: image_mul_three_pow_disj
statement:
lemma image_mul_three_pow_disj (N) :
    Disjoint ((range N).image (2 * 3 ^ ·)) ((range N).image (4 * 3 ^ ·))
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_iff_ne.mpr λ a ha b hb h ↦ ?_
  rw [mem_image] at ha hb
  rcases ha with ⟨k, -, rfl⟩
  rcases hb with ⟨m, -, rfl⟩
  rw [Nat.mul_assoc 2 2, Nat.mul_right_inj (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at h
  apply absurd (congrArg (· % 2) h : _ % 2 = _ % 2)
  rw [Nat.mul_mod_right, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow]
  exact Nat.one_ne_zero

name: GoodSetBase_card
statement: lemma GoodSetBase_card (N : ℕ) : (GoodSetBase N).card = 2 * N
proof:
:= calc
  _ = ((range N).image (2 * 3 ^ ·)).card + ((range N).image (4 * 3 ^ ·)).card :=
    card_union_of_disjoint (image_mul_three_pow_disj N)
  _ = (range N).card + (range N).card :=
    let X (n) := card_image_of_injective (range N) (mul_three_pow_inj n)
    congrArg₂ _ (X _) (X _)
  _ = _ := by rw [card_range, Nat.two_mul]

name: GoodSetBase_pos
statement: lemma GoodSetBase_pos (hx : x ∈ GoodSetBase N) : 0 < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [GoodSetBase, mem_union, mem_image, mem_image] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, -, rfl⟩
  all_goals exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos _) (Nat.pow_pos (Nat.succ_pos 2))

name: GoodSetBase_sum
statement: lemma GoodSetBase_sum (N : ℕ) : (GoodSetBase N).sum id + 3 = 3 ^ (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have X (n : ℕ) :
      ((range N).image (n.succ * 3 ^ ·)).sum id = ∑ k ∈ range N, n.succ * 3 ^ k :=
    sum_image λ _ _ _ _ h ↦ mul_three_pow_inj n h
  rw [GoodSetBase, sum_union (image_mul_three_pow_disj N), X, X]
  clear X; induction N with | zero => rfl | succ N hN => ?_
  rw [sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ, add_add_add_comm, add_right_comm, hN, ← Nat.add_mul,
    Nat.mul_assoc 2 3, ← Nat.pow_succ', add_comm, ← Nat.succ_mul, ← Nat.pow_succ']

name: GoodSetBase_two_dvd_of_mem
statement: lemma GoodSetBase_two_dvd_of_mem (hx : x ∈ GoodSetBase N) : 2 ∣ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [GoodSetBase, mem_union, mem_image, mem_image] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, -, rfl⟩
  exacts [Nat.dvd_mul_right 2 _, ⟨2 * 3 ^ k, Nat.mul_assoc 2 2 _⟩]

name: GoodSubsetBase_subset_GoodSetBase
statement:
lemma GoodSubsetBase_subset_GoodSetBase (hm : 0 < m) (h : K + m ≤ N) :
    GoodSubsetBase K m ⊆ GoodSetBase N
proof:
:= by
  show ∀ x ∈ insert (2 * 3 ^ K) _, x ∈ GoodSetBase N
  refine (forall_mem_insert _ _ _).mpr ⟨?_, forall_mem_image.mpr λ k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine mem_union_left _ (mem_image.mpr ⟨K, ?_, rfl⟩)
    exact mem_range.mpr ((Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right hm).trans_le h)
  · refine mem_union_right _ (mem_image.mpr ⟨K + k, mem_range.mpr ?_, rfl⟩)
    exact (Nat.add_lt_add_left (mem_range.mp hk) _).trans_le h

name: GoodSubsetBase_disjoint'
statement:
lemma GoodSubsetBase_disjoint' (K m : ℕ) :
    2 * 3 ^ K ∉ (range m).image λ k ↦ 4 * 3 ^ (K + k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_image]; rintro ⟨k, -, h⟩
  rw [Nat.mul_assoc 2 2, Nat.mul_right_inj (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)] at h
  apply absurd (congrArg (· % 2) h : _ % 2 = _ % 2)
  rw [Nat.mul_mod_right, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow]
  exact Nat.zero_ne_one

name: mul_three_pow_add_inj
statement: lemma mul_three_pow_add_inj (n K : ℕ) : (λ k ↦ n.succ * 3 ^ (K + k)).Injective
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ h ↦ Nat.add_left_cancel (mul_three_pow_inj n h)

name: GoodSubsetBase_card
statement: lemma GoodSubsetBase_card (K m) : (GoodSubsetBase K m).card = m + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [GoodSubsetBase, card_insert_of_notMem (GoodSubsetBase_disjoint' K m),
    card_image_of_injective _ (mul_three_pow_add_inj 3 _), card_range]

name: GoodSubsetBase_sum
statement: lemma GoodSubsetBase_sum (K m) : (GoodSubsetBase K m).sum id = 2 * 3 ^ (K + m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GoodSubsetBase, sum_insert (GoodSubsetBase_disjoint' K m),
    sum_image λ _ _ _ _ h ↦ mul_three_pow_add_inj 3 _ h]
  induction m with | zero => rfl | succ m m_ih => ?_
  rw [sum_range_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc, m_ih, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.pow_succ,
    ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_right_comm, Nat.add_comm]; rfl

name: EvenGoodSet_disjoint
statement: theorem EvenGoodSet_disjoint (N : ℕ) : Disjoint (GoodSetBase N) {1, 3 ^ N + 2}
proof:
:= by
  refine disjoint_iff_ne.mpr λ a ha b hb h ↦ ?_
  replace ha : a % 2 = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp (GoodSetBase_two_dvd_of_mem ha)
  rw [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hb
  subst b; rcases hb with rfl | rfl
  · exact absurd ha Nat.one_ne_zero
  · rw [Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.one_pow] at ha
    exact absurd ha Nat.one_ne_zero

name: EvenGoodSet_card
statement: theorem EvenGoodSet_card (N : ℕ) : (EvenGoodSet N).card = 2 * (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [EvenGoodSet, card_union_of_disjoint (EvenGoodSet_disjoint N)]
  exact congrArg₂ _ (GoodSetBase_card N) rfl

name: EvenGoodSet_pos
statement: theorem EvenGoodSet_pos (hx : x ∈ EvenGoodSet N) : 0 < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [EvenGoodSet, mem_union, mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hx
  rcases hx with hx | rfl | rfl
  exacts [GoodSetBase_pos hx, Nat.one_pos, Nat.succ_pos _]

name: EvenGoodSet_sum
statement: theorem EvenGoodSet_sum (N : ℕ) : (EvenGoodSet N).sum id = 4 * 3 ^ N
proof:
:= calc
  _ = (GoodSetBase N).sum id + (1 + (3 ^ N + 2)) := sum_union (EvenGoodSet_disjoint N)
  _ = _ := by rw [Nat.add_left_comm 1, Nat.add_left_comm, GoodSetBase_sum,
    Nat.pow_succ, Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

name: EvenGoodSet_good
statement: theorem EvenGoodSet_good (N : ℕ) : good (EvenGoodSet N)
proof:
:= by
  refine good_iff.mpr λ m hm hm0 ↦ ?_
  rw [EvenGoodSet_card, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ Nat.two_pos] at hm0
  replace hm0 : m - 1 ≤ N := Nat.pred_le_pred hm0
  refine ⟨GoodSubsetBase (N - (m - 1)) (m - 1), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (GoodSubsetBase_subset_GoodSetBase (Nat.pred_le_pred hm)
      (Nat.sub_add_cancel hm0).le).trans subset_union_left
  · rw [GoodSubsetBase_card, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_of_lt hm)]
  · rw [GoodSubsetBase_sum, Nat.sub_add_cancel hm0, EvenGoodSet_sum, ← Nat.mul_assoc]

name: OddGoodSet_disjoint
statement: theorem OddGoodSet_disjoint (hN : 2 < N) : 3 ^ N + 3 ∉ GoodSetBase N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ : ∃ N', N = N' + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hN)
  rw [GoodSetBase, mem_union, mem_image, mem_image]
  have X : 0 < 3 := Nat.succ_pos 2
  rintro (⟨k, hk, h⟩ | ⟨k, hk, h⟩)
  
  · apply h.not_lt; calc
      _ < 3 * 3 ^ N := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self 2)
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right X (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp hk))) (Nat.pow_pos X)
      _ = 3 ^ (N + 1) := Nat.pow_succ'.symm
      _ ≤ 3 ^ (N + 1) + 3 := Nat.le_add_right _ _
  
  · rw [mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq] at hk
    rcases hk with hk | rfl
    
    · apply h.not_lt; calc
      _ < 9 * 3 ^ k := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (by decide)
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right X k.le_refl) (Nat.pow_pos X)
      _ = 3 ^ (k + 2) := by rw [← Nat.pow_add 3 2, Nat.add_comm]
      _ ≤ 3 ^ (N + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right X (Nat.succ_le_succ hk)
      _ ≤ 3 ^ (N + 1) + 3 := Nat.le_add_right _ _
    
    · rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.pow_succ', Nat.add_right_inj] at h
      exact h.not_gt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by decide : 1 < 3) (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hN))

name: OddGoodSet_card
statement: theorem OddGoodSet_card (hN : 2 < N) : (OddGoodSet N).card = 2 * N + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [OddGoodSet, card_insert_of_notMem (OddGoodSet_disjoint hN)]
  exact congrArg₂ _ (GoodSetBase_card N) rfl

name: OddGoodSet_pos
statement: theorem OddGoodSet_pos (hx : x ∈ OddGoodSet N) : 0 < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [OddGoodSet, mem_insert] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl | hx
  exacts [Nat.succ_pos _, GoodSetBase_pos hx]

name: OddGoodSet_sum
statement: theorem OddGoodSet_sum (hN : 2 < N) : (OddGoodSet N).sum id = 4 * 3 ^ N
proof:
:= calc
  _ =  (3 ^ N + 3) + (GoodSetBase N).sum id := sum_insert (OddGoodSet_disjoint hN)
  _ = _ := by rw [← add_rotate, Nat.add_right_comm,
    GoodSetBase_sum, Nat.pow_succ', ← Nat.succ_mul]

name: OddGoodSet_good
statement: theorem OddGoodSet_good (hN : 2 < N) : good (OddGoodSet N)
proof:
:= by
  refine good_iff.mpr λ m hm hm0 ↦ ?_
  rw [OddGoodSet_card hN, Nat.mul_add_div Nat.two_pos] at hm0
  replace hm0 : m - 1 ≤ N := m.pred_le.trans hm0
  refine ⟨GoodSubsetBase (N - (m - 1)) (m - 1), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (GoodSubsetBase_subset_GoodSetBase (Nat.pred_le_pred hm)
      (Nat.sub_add_cancel hm0).le).trans (subset_insert _ _)
  · rw [GoodSubsetBase_card, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_of_lt hm)]
  · rw [GoodSubsetBase_sum, Nat.sub_add_cancel hm0, OddGoodSet_sum hN, ← Nat.mul_assoc]

name: final_solution
statement: theorem final_solution (n : ℕ) : ∃ S : Finset ℕ, S.card = n ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, 0 < x) ∧ good S
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain hn | hn : n / 2 < 2 ∨ 2 ≤ n / 2 := lt_or_ge _ _
  · have h : ((range n).image Nat.succ).card = n := by
      rw [card_image_of_injective _ Nat.succ_injective, card_range]
    exact ⟨(range n).image Nat.succ, h, forall_mem_image.mpr λ k _ ↦ k.succ_pos,
      good_of_card_lt_four (h.trans_lt (Nat.lt_mul_of_div_lt hn Nat.two_pos))⟩
  
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, rfl⟩ : ∃ q r, r < 2 ∧ n = 2 * (q + 2) + r := by
    refine ⟨n / 2 - 2, n % 2, Nat.mod_lt n Nat.two_pos, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hn, Nat.div_add_mod]
  
  clear hn; rw [Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one] at hr
  rcases hr with rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨EvenGoodSet _, EvenGoodSet_card _, λ _ ↦ EvenGoodSet_pos, EvenGoodSet_good _⟩
  
  obtain hq | rfl : 0 < q ∨ q = 0 := q.eq_zero_or_pos.symm
  · have hq0 : 2 < q + 2 := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left hq
    exact ⟨OddGoodSet _, OddGoodSet_card hq0, λ _ ↦ OddGoodSet_pos, OddGoodSet_good hq0⟩
  
  refine ⟨{4, 5, 6, 7, 8}, rfl, by decide, good_iff.mpr λ m hm hm0 ↦ ?_⟩
  exact ⟨{7, 8}, by decide, hm.antisymm hm0, rfl⟩

name: lemma1
statement: lemma lemma1 {a c : ℕ} (h : a * a.gcd c ∣ c ^ 2) : a ∣ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha : a = 0 ∨ 0 < a := a.eq_zero_or_pos
  · rw [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_dvd, sq, Nat.mul_eq_zero, or_self] at h
    exact Nat.zero_dvd.mpr h
  · replace h : a * a.gcd c ∣ c * a.gcd c := by
      rw [c.mul_comm, ← Nat.gcd_mul_right, ← sq]
      exact Nat.dvd_gcd (Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left a (a.gcd_dvd_right c)) h
    exact Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_right (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left c ha) h

name: lemma2
statement: lemma lemma2 {a b c : ℕ} (h : a.gcd b * c ∣ a * b + c ^ 2) : a.gcd b ∣ a.gcd c
proof:
:= by
  replace h : a.gcd b * (a.gcd b).gcd c ∣ a * b + c ^ 2 :=
