  have hc3 : f 0 + f (2 * c) = 0 := by
    rw [hf.map_two_mul_eq_of_map_eq (hc.trans hf.map_ι_map_zero_mul_self.symm),
      hf.map_two_mul_ι_map_zero_mul_self]
  
  have hc2 : f (c * c) = 0 := by rw [hc0, ← two_mul, hc3]
  replace hc2 (x) : f (x * (c * c)) = f 0 + f (x + c * c) := hf.map_mul_kernel hc2 x
  
  replace hc3 : f (c * c * c) = 0 := by
    have h : f (2 * c + 1) = f (c + 1 + 1) :=
      hf.map_add_one_eq_of_map_eq (add_left_cancel (hc3.trans hc1.symm))
    rw [hc0, ← add_one_mul, hc0, add_right_comm, ← two_mul, h,
      add_assoc c, one_add_one_eq_two, add_comm, ← hc0, hc3]
  
  intro x; refine add_left_cancel (a := f 0) (add_left_cancel (a := f 0) ?_)
  calc f 0 + (f 0 + f (x + c * c + c))
    _ = f (x * c * (c * c * c)) := by rw [hf.map_mul_kernel hc3, ← hc0, add_mul]
    _ = f (x * (c * c) * (c * c)) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = f 0 + (f 0 + f (x + c * c + 1)) := by rw [hc2, ← add_one_mul, hc2, add_right_comm]

name: map_add_
statement: theorem map_add_ι_map_zero_mul_self (x) : f (x + ι (f 0) * ι (f 0)) = f (x + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let D := ι (f 0) * ι (f 0)
  have h : f D = 0 := hf.map_ι_map_zero_mul_self
  
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, d + D * D = 0 := by
    refine ⟨D * (ι (f 0) * ι (f (D + 1))), ?_⟩
    rw [← mul_add, add_comm, ← mul_add, ← ι.map_add,
      hf.map_kernel_add_one h, ι.map_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  
  have h0 : f (x + d + D * D + D) = f (x + d + D * D + 1) :=
    hf.period_of_map_eq_zero' h (x + d)
  rwa [add_assoc x, hd, add_zero] at h0

name: map_one_eq_zero
statement: theorem map_one_eq_zero : f 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zero_add 1, ← hf.map_add_ι_map_zero_mul_self, zero_add, hf.map_ι_map_zero_mul_self]

name: map_zero_add_map_add_one
statement: theorem map_zero_add_map_add_one (x) : f 0 + f (x + 1) = f x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_one] using (hf.map_mul_kernel hf.map_one_eq_zero x).symm

name: map_sub_one
statement:
theorem map_sub_one [Ring R] [AddCancelMonoid G]
    {ι : G →+ R} {f : R → G} (hf : good ι f) (x) : f (x - 1) = f 0 + f x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using (hf.map_zero_add_map_add_one (x - 1)).symm

name: map_one_sub_map_
statement: theorem map_one_sub_map_ι_map_zero_mul_ι_map (x) : f (1 - ι (f 0) * ι (f x)) = f x
proof:
:= by
  let C := ι (f 0)
  have h : ι (f (C * ι (f x))) = -ι (f x) + C := by
    rw [eq_neg_add_iff_add_eq, add_comm, ← ι.map_add, hf.map_ι_map_zero_mul_ι_map_add_map]
  refine (add_right_inj (f 0)).mp ?_
  calc f 0 + f (1 - C * ι (f x))
    _ = f (C * ι (f (C * ι (f x)))) + f 0 := by
      rw [h, mul_add, hf.map_add_ι_map_zero_mul_self, mul_neg, neg_add_eq_sub, add_comm]
    _ = f (C * ι (f (C * ι (f x)))) + f (C * ι (f x)) + f x := by
      rw [add_assoc, hf.map_ι_map_zero_mul_ι_map_add_map]
    _ = f 0 + f x := by rw [hf.map_ι_map_zero_mul_ι_map_add_map]

name: map_add_map_neg
statement: theorem map_add_map_neg (x) : f x + f (-x) = 2 • f 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : f 0 + f (ι (f 0) * ι (f x)) = f (-x) := by
    rw [← hf.map_sub_one, ← neg_sub, hf.map_neg_eq_iff_map_eq]
    exact hf.map_one_sub_map_ι_map_zero_mul_ι_map x
  rw [← h, add_rotate', hf.map_ι_map_zero_mul_ι_map_add_map, two_nsmul]

name: map_eq_zero_imp_eq_one
statement: theorem map_eq_zero_imp_eq_one (h : f c = 0) : c = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine add_left_cancel (a := c * c) (hf0 _ _ λ x ↦ ?_)
  rw [← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, hf.period_of_map_eq_zero' h]

name: map_eq_zero_iff_eq_one
statement: theorem map_eq_zero_iff_eq_one : f x = 0 ↔ x = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨hf.map_eq_zero_imp_eq_one hf0, λ h ↦ h ▸ hf.map_one_eq_zero⟩

name: sideFE
statement:
theorem sideFE [NonAssocRing R] [AddCancelCommMonoid G]
    (hG2 : IsSMulRegular G 2) (hG3 : IsSMulRegular G 3)
    {g : R → G} (hg : ∀ x y, g (x + y - x * y) + g (1 - (x + y)) = g (1 - x * y)) :
    ∃ φ : R →+ G, g = φ
proof:
:= by
  
  have hg0 (x) : g x + g (1 - x) = g 1 := by
    simpa only [zero_add, zero_mul, sub_zero] using hg 0 x
  have hg1 (x) : g 1 + g (-x) = g (1 - x) := by
    simpa only [mul_one, add_sub_cancel_left, sub_add_cancel_right] using hg x 1
  replace hg1 (x) : g x + g (-x) = 0 := by
    rw [← add_eq_right (b := g 1), add_right_comm, add_assoc, hg1, hg0]
  have hg2 (x) : g (x + 1) = g x + g 1 := by
    have h := hg 1 (-x)
    rwa [one_mul, add_sub_cancel_right, sub_add_cancel_left,
      neg_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm, eq_comm, add_comm] at h
  
  have hg3 : g 0 = 0 := by
    refine hG2 (?_ : 2 • g 0 = 2 • 0)
    rw [two_nsmul, nsmul_zero, ← hg1 0, neg_zero]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨g, hg3⟩, ?_⟩, rfl⟩; simp only
  
  have hg4 (x : R) (n : ℕ) : g (x + n) = g x + n • g 1 := by
    induction n with
    | zero => rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, zero_nsmul, add_zero]
    | succ n n_ih => rw [succ_nsmul, Nat.cast_succ, ← add_assoc, hg2, n_ih, add_assoc]
  
  replace hg (x y) : g (x + y + 1) = g (1 - x * y) + g (x * y + (x + y)) := by
    rw [← neg_mul_neg, ← hg, neg_mul_neg, ← neg_add, sub_neg_eq_add,
      ← add_rotate (g _), ← neg_add', add_comm, add_comm (x * y), hg1, zero_add]
  replace hg (x y) : g ((x + 1) * (y + 1)) = g (x * y) + g (x + y) + g 1 := by
    rw [add_assoc, ← hg2, hg, ← add_assoc, hg0, add_one_mul, mul_add_one,
      add_assoc, ← add_assoc x, ← add_assoc, hg2, add_comm]
  
  replace hg (x y) (n : ℕ) :
      g ((x + n) * (y + n)) = g (x * y) + n • g (x + y) + (n * n) • g 1 := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp_rw [Nat.cast_zero, Nat.mul_zero, zero_nsmul, add_zero]
    | succ n n_ih =>
        calc g ((x + ↑(n + 1)) * (y + ↑(n + 1)))
        _ = g ((x + n + 1) * (y + n + 1)) := by rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_assoc, add_assoc]
        _ = g (x * y) + n • g (x + y) + (n * n) • g 1 + g (x + y + ↑(n + n)) + g 1 := by
          rw [hg, n_ih, add_add_add_comm, Nat.cast_add]
        _ = g (x * y) + ((n • g (x + y) + g (x + y)) + (n * n + (n + n)) • g 1) + g 1 := by
          rw [hg4, add_assoc (g _), add_assoc (g _), add_add_add_comm, add_nsmul _ (n * n)]
        _ = g (x * y) + (n + 1) • g (x + y) + (n * n + (n + n) + 1) • g 1 := by
          rw [← add_assoc, ← succ_nsmul, add_assoc, succ_nsmul (g 1)]
        _ = g (x * y) + (n + 1) • g (x + y) + ((n + 1) * (n + 1)) • g 1 := by
          rw [add_right_inj, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_succ]
          iterate 3 rw [Nat.add_assoc]
  
  replace hg0 (t) (n : ℕ) : g (n * t) = n • g t := by
    have h := hg 0 (t - n) n
    rwa [zero_add, zero_mul, hg3, zero_add,  mul_nsmul,
      ← nsmul_add, ← hg4, zero_add, sub_add_cancel] at h
  
  replace hg2 (t) : g (2 * t) = 2 • g t := hg0 t 2
  replace hg3 (t) : g (3 * t) = 3 • g t := hg0 t 3
  
  replace hg0 (x y) : g ((x + 2) * (y + 2)) = g (x * y) + 2 • g (x + y) + 4 • g 1 := hg x y 2
  replace hg1 (x y) : g ((x + 3) * (y + 3)) = g (x * y) + 3 • g (x + y) + 9 • g 1 := hg x y 3
  
  replace hg (x y) : g ((x + 1) * (y + 2)) = g (x * y) + g (2 * x + y) + 2 • g 1 := by
    have h := hg0 (2 * x) y
    have X (t u : R) : 2 * t * u = 2 * (t * u) := by rw [two_mul, two_mul, add_mul]
    rw [← mul_add_one, X, hg2, X, hg2, mul_nsmul _ 2 2, ← nsmul_add, ← nsmul_add] at h
    exact hG2 h
  
  replace hg2 (x y) : g ((x + 2) * (y + 1)) = g (x * y) + g (x + 2 * y) + 2 • g 1 := by
    have h := hg0 x (2 * y)
    have X (t u : R) : t * (2 * u) = 2 * (t * u) := by rw [two_mul, two_mul, mul_add]
    rw [← mul_add_one, X, hg2, X, hg2, mul_nsmul _ 2 2, ← nsmul_add, ← nsmul_add] at h
    exact hG2 h
  
  replace hg (x y) : g (2 * x + y) + g (x + 2 * y) = 3 • g (x + y) := by
    
    suffices g ((x + 3) * (y + 3)) = g (x * y) + (g (2 * x + y) + g (x + 2 * y)) + 9 • g 1 by
      rwa [hg1, add_left_inj, add_right_inj, eq_comm] at this
    
    calc g ((x + 3) * (y + 3))
      _ = g ((x + 1 + 2) * (y + 2 + 1)) := by
        rw [add_assoc, add_assoc, add_comm 1, two_add_one_eq_three]
      _ = g ((x + 1) * (y + 2)) + g (x + 2 * y + (2 * 2 + 1)) + 2 • g 1 := by
        rw [hg2, mul_add 2, add_add_add_comm, add_comm 1]
      _ = g ((x + 1) * (y + 2)) + g (x + 2 * y + (5 : ℕ)) + 2 • g 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_succ, two_mul 2, two_add_two_eq_four, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      _ = g ((x + 1) * (y + 2)) + g (x + 2 * y) + 7 • g 1 := by
        rw [hg4, ← add_assoc, add_assoc, ← add_nsmul]
      _ = g (x * y) + (g (2 * x + y) + g (x + 2 * y)) + 9 • g 1 := by
        rw [hg, add_assoc, add_add_add_comm, add_assoc (g _), ← add_nsmul]
  
  replace hg4 (x y : R) : 2 * (2 * x - y) + (2 * y - x) = 3 * x := by
    rw [mul_sub, sub_add_sub_cancel, ← two_add_one_eq_three, add_one_mul,
      two_mul, two_mul, ← add_assoc, add_sub_cancel_right]
  intro x y; specialize hg (2 * x - y) (2 * y - x)
  rw [hg4, add_comm (2 * x - y), hg4, hg3, hg3, ← nsmul_add, sub_add_sub_comm,
    ← mul_add, add_comm y, two_mul, add_sub_cancel_right] at hg
  exact (hG3 hg).symm

name: injective_of_IsSMulRegular_two
statement:
theorem injective_of_IsSMulRegular_two (hG2 : IsSMulRegular G 2)
    {ι : G →+ R} {f : R → G} (hf : good ι f) (hf0 : nonperiodic f) : f.Injective
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have h0 : f (a * b) = f (b * a) :=
    hf.map_mul_eq_of_map_eq_of_map_add_eq h h.symm (congrArg f (add_comm a b))
  replace h0 : f (a * -b) = f (b * -a) := by
    rw [mul_neg, mul_neg, hf.map_neg_eq_iff_map_eq, h0]
  replace h0 : f (a + -b) = f (b + -a) :=
    (hf.map_add_eq_iff_map_mul_eq h (hf.map_neg_eq_of_map_eq h).symm).mpr h0
  replace h : f (-(a - b)) = f (a - b) := by
    rw [neg_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, ← h0, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  replace h : 2 • f (a - b) = 2 • f 0 := by
    rw [← hf.map_add_map_neg (a - b), h, two_nsmul]
  replace h : f (a - b) = f 0 := hG2 h
  rwa [← hf.map_zero_add_map_add_one, add_eq_left,
    hf.map_eq_zero_iff_eq_one hf0, add_eq_right, sub_eq_zero] at h

name: exists_central_mul_self_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_central_mul_self_eq_one
    {ι : G →+ R} {f : R → G} (hf : good ι f) (hf0 : f.Injective) :
    ∃ a : R, a * a = 1 ∧ (∀ x, a * x = x * a) ∧ (∀ x, ι (f x) = a * (1 - x))
proof:
:= by
  
  let a := ι (f 0)
  
  have ha : a * a = 1 := hf0 (hf.map_ι_map_zero_mul_self.trans hf.map_one_eq_zero.symm)
  have ha0 (x) : ι (f x) = a * (1 - x) := calc
    _ = a * (1 - (1 - a * ι (f x))) := by rw [sub_sub_cancel, ← mul_assoc, ha, one_mul]
    _ = a * (1 - x) := by rw [hf0 (hf.map_one_sub_map_ι_map_zero_mul_ι_map x)]
  
  refine ⟨a, ha, λ x ↦ ?_, ha0⟩
  
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, ι (f t) = x :=
    ⟨1 - a * x, by rw [ha0, sub_sub_cancel, ← mul_assoc, ha, one_mul]⟩
  
  refine hf0 (add_right_cancel (b := f t) ?_)
  rw [hf.map_ι_map_zero_mul_ι_map_add_map, ← mul_zero t, ← hf, add_zero]

name: IsSMulRegular_two_three_nonperiodic_imp
statement:
theorem IsSMulRegular_two_three_nonperiodic_imp
    (hG2 : IsSMulRegular G 2) (hG3 : IsSMulRegular G 3)
    {ι : G →+ R} {f : R → G} (hf : good ι f) (hf0 : nonperiodic f) :
    ∃ (φ : R →+ G) (_ : ∀ x, ι (φ x) = x) (a : R) (_ : a * a = 1) (_ : ∀ x, a * x = x * a),
      f = λ x : R ↦ φ (a * (1 - x))
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha0, ha1⟩ :
      ∃ a, a * a = 1 ∧ (∀ x, a * x = x * a) ∧ (∀ x, ι (f x) = a * (1 - x)) :=
    hf.exists_central_mul_self_eq_one (hf.injective_of_IsSMulRegular_two hG2 hf0)
  
  have hf1 (x y) : f ((1 - x) * (1 - y)) + f (x + y) = f (x * y) := by
    rw [← hf x y, ha1, ha1, ha0, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc a, ha, one_mul]
  
  replace hf1 (x y) :
      f (1 - (x + y - x * y)) + f (1 - (1 - (x + y))) = f (1 - (1 - x * y)) := by
    rw [sub_sub_cancel, sub_sub_cancel, add_sub_assoc,
      ← one_sub_mul, ← sub_sub, ← mul_one_sub, hf1]
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : R →+ G, (λ x ↦ f (1 - x)) = φ := sideFE hG2 hG3 hf1
  
  replace hφ (x) : (φ.comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft a)) x = f (1 - a * x) := by
    rw [φ.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_mulLeft, ← hφ]
  refine ⟨φ.comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft a), ?_, a, ha, ha0, ?_⟩
  · intro x; rw [hφ, ha1, sub_sub_cancel, ← mul_assoc, ha, one_mul]
  · funext x; rw [hφ, ← mul_assoc, ha, one_mul, sub_sub_cancel]

name: good_iff
statement:
theorem good_iff [Ring R] [AddCancelCommMonoid G]
    (hG2 : IsSMulRegular G 2) (hG3 : IsSMulRegular G 3) {ι : G →+ R} {f : R → G} :
    good ι f ↔ ∃ (I : RingCon R) (φ : I.Quotient →+ G) (_ : ∀ x, ↑(ι (φ x)) = x)
      (a : I.Quotient) (_ : a * a = 1) (_ : ∀ x, a * x = x * a),
      f = λ x : R ↦ φ (a * (1 - x))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ hf ↦ ?_, λ hf ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · obtain ⟨φ, hφ, a, ha, ha0, h⟩ :=
      hf.Quotient_is_good.IsSMulRegular_two_three_nonperiodic_imp
        hG2 hG3 hf.Quotient_is_nonperiodic
    exact ⟨hf.inducedRingCon, φ, hφ, a, ha, ha0, funext λ x ↦ congrFun h x⟩
  
  · rcases hf with ⟨I, φ, hφ, a, ha, ha0, rfl⟩
    exact good_of_RingCon ι hφ ha ha0

name: IsSMulRegular_of_IsLeftRegular_Nat
statement:
theorem IsSMulRegular_of_IsLeftRegular_Nat
    [NonAssocSemiring R] {n : ℕ} (hRn : IsLeftRegular (n : R)) : IsSMulRegular R n
proof:
:=
  λ a b h ↦ hRn (by simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using h)

name: final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution
    [Ring R] (hR2 : IsLeftRegular (2 : R)) (hR3 : IsLeftRegular (3 : R)) {f : R → R} :
    (∀ x y, f (f x * f y) + f (x + y) = f (x * y)) ↔
      ∃ (I : RingCon R) (φ : I.Quotient →+ R) (_ : ∀ x, ↑(φ x) = x)
        (a : I.Quotient) (_ : a * a = 1) (_ : ∀ x, a * x = x * a),
        f = λ x : R ↦ φ (a * (1 - x))
proof:
:=
  good_iff (IsSMulRegular_of_IsLeftRegular_Nat hR2)
    (IsSMulRegular_of_IsLeftRegular_Nat hR3) (ι := AddMonoidHom.id R)

name: map_neg
statement: theorem map_neg : f (-c) = f c
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : f (c + 1) = 0 := by cases h with
  | Left h => rw [h, hf.map_one, mul_zero]
  | Right h => rw [add_comm, h, hf.map_one, zero_mul]
  have h1 := hf.is_good (c + 1) (-1)
  rwa [h0, zero_mul, zero_add, add_neg_cancel_right,
    mul_neg_one, neg_add_rev, neg_add_cancel_comm] at h1

name: map_mul_self_eq_one
statement: theorem map_mul_self_eq_one : f c * f c = 1
proof:
:=
  have h0 : f (-c) = f c := map_neg hf h
  have h1 : f 0 = -(f c * f c) := by cases h with
  | Left h => specialize h (-c); rwa [add_neg_cancel, h0, neg_mul] at h
  | Right h => specialize h (-c); rwa [neg_add_cancel, h0, mul_neg] at h
  by rwa [hf.map_zero, neg_inj, eq_comm] at h1

name: map_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement: theorem map_eq_one_or_neg_one : f c = 1 ∨ f c = -1
proof:
:=
  mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp (map_mul_self_eq_one hf h)

name: map_commute
statement: private theorem map_commute (x : R) : Commute (-f c) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  cases map_eq_one_or_neg_one hf h with
  | inl h => rw [h]; exact Commute.neg_one_left (f x)
  | inr h => rw [h, neg_neg]; exact Commute.one_left (f x)

name: imp_left
statement: theorem imp_left : ∀ x, f (c + x) = -f c * f x
proof:
:=
  h.casesOn id λ h0 x ↦ by rw [add_comm, h0, map_commute hf h]

name: imp_right
statement: theorem imp_right : ∀ x, f (x + c) = f x * -f c
proof:
:=
  h.casesOn (λ h0 x ↦ by rw [add_comm, h0, map_commute hf h]) id

name: iff_left
statement: theorem iff_left : QuasiPeriodic f c ↔ ∀ x, f (c + x) = -f c * f x
proof:
:=
  ⟨QuasiPeriodic.imp_left hf, QuasiPeriodic.Left⟩

name: iff_right
statement: theorem iff_right : QuasiPeriodic f c ↔ ∀ x, f (x + c) = f x * -f c
proof:
:=
  ⟨QuasiPeriodic.imp_right hf, QuasiPeriodic.Right⟩

name: iff_left2
statement: theorem iff_left2 : QuasiPeriodic f c ↔ ∀ x, f (c * x + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  (iff_left hf).trans <| forall_congr' λ x ↦ by
    rw [neg_mul, hf.is_good, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]

name: iff_right2
statement: theorem iff_right2 : QuasiPeriodic f c ↔ ∀ x, f (x * c + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  (iff_right hf).trans <| forall_congr' λ x ↦ by
    rw [mul_neg, hf.is_good, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]

name: mul_left
statement: theorem mul_left (d : R) : QuasiPeriodic f (d * c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_right2 hf] at h ⊢
  intro x; rw [← mul_assoc]; exact h (x * d)

name: mul_right
statement: theorem mul_right (d : R) : QuasiPeriodic f (c * d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_left2 hf] at h ⊢
  intro x; rw [mul_assoc]; exact h (d * x)

name: reduced_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem reduced_eq_zero_iff : c = 0 ↔ f c = -1
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h0 ↦ h0 ▸ hf.map_zero, λ h0 ↦ hf.period_imp_eq c 0 λ x ↦ by
    rw [add_zero, (iff_right hf.toNontrivialGood).mp h, h0, neg_neg, mul_one]⟩

name: reduced_map_eq_one
statement: theorem reduced_map_eq_one : f c = 1
proof:
:=
  (map_eq_one_or_neg_one hf.toNontrivialGood h).resolve_right <|
    mt (reduced_eq_zero_iff hf h).mpr h0

name: reduced_QuasiPeriodic_eq
statement: theorem reduced_QuasiPeriodic_eq (h1 : QuasiPeriodic f d) : d = 0 ∨ d = c
proof:
:=
  (map_eq_one_or_neg_one hf.toNontrivialGood h1).symm.imp
    
    (reduced_eq_zero_iff hf h1).mpr
    
    (λ h2 ↦ hf.period_imp_eq d c λ x ↦ by
      have h3 (c) := (iff_right hf.toNontrivialGood (c := c)).mp
      rw [h3 c h, h3 d h1, h2, reduced_map_eq_one hf h h0])

name: reduced_mul_left_eq_zero_imp
statement: theorem reduced_mul_left_eq_zero_imp {d} (h1 : d * c = 0) : QuasiPeriodic f d
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_left2 hf.toNontrivialGood]; intro x
  have h2 := reduced_map_eq_one hf h h0
  have h3 : f (d * (c + x) + 1) = -f (d * x + 1) := by
    rw [iff_left hf.toNontrivialGood] at h
    rw [hf.is_good, h, add_left_comm, h, h2, neg_one_mul,
      neg_one_mul, mul_neg, ← neg_add, hf.is_good]
  rw [mul_add, h1, zero_add, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← two_mul, mul_eq_zero] at h3
  refine h3.resolve_left λ h3 ↦ h0 ?_
  rw [reduced_eq_zero_iff hf h, h2, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, one_add_one_eq_two, h3]

name: reduced_QuasiPeriod_equiv_cases
statement:
theorem reduced_QuasiPeriod_equiv_cases (d) :
    QuasiPeriodic f d ∨ QuasiPeriodic f (d - 1)
proof:
:=
  let h1 (d) := reduced_mul_left_eq_zero_imp hf h h0 (d := d)
  (reduced_QuasiPeriodic_eq hf h h0 <| mul_left hf.toNontrivialGood h d).imp
    (h1 d) (λ h2 ↦ h1 (d - 1) <| by rwa [sub_one_mul, sub_eq_zero])

name: reduced_main_cases
statement: theorem reduced_main_cases (d) : (d = 0 ∨ d = c) ∨ (d = 1 ∨ d = c + 1)
proof:
:=
  let h1 (d) := reduced_QuasiPeriodic_eq hf h h0 (d := d)
  (reduced_QuasiPeriod_equiv_cases hf h h0 d).imp
    (h1 d) (λ h2 ↦ (h1 _ h2).imp eq_of_sub_eq_zero eq_add_of_sub_eq)

name: good_comp_hom
statement:
theorem good_comp_hom (h : good f) [NonAssocSemiring R₀]
    (φ : R₀ →+* R) : good (f ∘ φ)
proof:
:= λ x y ↦ by
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [φ.map_add, φ.map_mul, φ.map_one, h, φ.map_add]

name: good_hom_comp
statement:
theorem good_hom_comp (h : good f) [NonAssocSemiring S₀]
    (φ : S →+* S₀) : good (φ ∘ f)
proof:
:= λ x y ↦ by
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [h, φ.map_add, φ.map_mul]

name: NontrivialGood.comp_hom
statement:
theorem NontrivialGood.comp_hom (hf : NontrivialGood f) [NonAssocSemiring R₀]
    (φ : R₀ →+* R) : NontrivialGood (f ∘ φ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨good_comp_hom hf.is_good φ, hf.map_zero_add_one ▸ congrArg (λ x ↦ f x + 1) φ.map_zero⟩

name: NontrivialGood.hom_comp
statement:
theorem NontrivialGood.hom_comp (hf : NontrivialGood f) [NonAssocSemiring S₀]
    (φ : S →+* S₀) : NontrivialGood (φ ∘ f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨good_hom_comp hf.is_good φ,
  by rw [← φ.map_one, ← φ.map_zero, ← hf.map_zero_add_one, φ.map_add]; rfl⟩

name: codomainLift_is_good
statement: lemma codomainLift_is_good {f : R → S} (hf : good f) : good (codomainLift f)
proof:
:=
  λ a b ↦ Subtype.ext (hf a b)

name: codomainLift_is_NontrivialGood
statement:
lemma codomainLift_is_NontrivialGood {f : R → S} (hf : NontrivialGood f) :
    NontrivialGood (codomainLift f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨codomainLift_is_good hf.is_good, Subtype.ext hf.map_zero_add_one⟩

name: oneVarDomainLift_is_good
statement:
lemma oneVarDomainLift_is_good {f : R → S} (hf : good f) :
    good (oneVarDomainLift c f)

name: oneVarDomainLift_is_NontrivialGood
statement:
lemma oneVarDomainLift_is_NontrivialGood {f : R → S} (hf : NontrivialGood f) :
    NontrivialGood (oneVarDomainLift c f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨oneVarDomainLift_is_good c hf.is_good, hf.map_zero_add_one⟩

name: oneVarCommLift_is_NontrivialGood
statement:
lemma oneVarCommLift_is_NontrivialGood {f : R → S} (hf : NontrivialGood f) :
    NontrivialGood (oneVarCommLift c f)
proof:
:=
  codomainLift_is_NontrivialGood (oneVarDomainLift_is_NontrivialGood c hf)

name: oneVarCommLift_exists
statement:
theorem oneVarCommLift_exists {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    {f : R → S} (hf : NontrivialGood f) (c : R) :
    ∃ (R' : Type u) (_ : CommRing R')
        (φ : R' →+* R) (_ : Function.Injective φ) (_ : c ∈ Set.range φ)
      (S' : Type v) (_ : CommRing S') (ρ : S' →+* S) (_ : Function.Injective ρ)
      (f' : R' → S') (_ : ∀ a, f (φ a) = ρ (f' a)), NontrivialGood f'
proof:
:=
  
  ⟨Subring.closure {c},
  instCommRingClosure_of_singleton c,
  SubringClass.subtype _,
  λ _ _ ↦ Subtype.ext,
  ⟨⟨c, Subring.subset_closure rfl⟩, rfl⟩,
  
  OneVarRange c f,
  OneVarRange_commRing_of_good c hf.is_good,
  SubringClass.subtype _,
  λ _ _ ↦ Subtype.ext,
  
  λ a ↦ ⟨f a.1, Subring.subset_closure ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩,
  λ _ ↦ rfl,
  oneVarCommLift_is_NontrivialGood c hf⟩

name: oneVarCommLiftDomain_exists
statement:
theorem oneVarCommLiftDomain_exists {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    [NoZeroDivisors S] {f : R → S} (hf : NontrivialGood f) (c : R) :
    ∃ (R' : Type u) (_ : CommRing R')
        (φ : R' →+* R) (_ : Function.Injective φ) (_ : c ∈ Set.range φ)
      (S' : Type v) (_ : CommRing S') (_ : NoZeroDivisors S')
        (ρ : S' →+* S) (_ : Function.Injective ρ)
      (f' : R' → S') (_ : ∀ a, f (φ a) = ρ (f' a)), NontrivialGood f'
proof:
:=
  
  ⟨Subring.closure {c},
  instCommRingClosure_of_singleton c,
  SubringClass.subtype _,
  λ _ _ ↦ Subtype.ext,
  ⟨⟨c, Subring.subset_closure rfl⟩, rfl⟩,
  
  OneVarRange c f,
  OneVarRange_commRing_of_good c hf.is_good,
  Subsemiring.noZeroDivisors _,
  SubringClass.subtype _,
  λ _ _ ↦ Subtype.ext,
  
  λ a ↦ ⟨f a.1, Subring.subset_closure ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩,
  λ _ ↦ rfl,
  oneVarCommLift_is_NontrivialGood c hf⟩

name: iff_def
statement:
lemma iff_def [AddCommSemigroup R] {f : R → S} {c d : R} :
    PeriodEquiv f c d ↔ ∀ x, f (x + c) = f (x + d)
proof:
:=
  Eq.to_iff rfl

name: apply_eq
statement:
lemma apply_eq [AddCommMonoid R] {f : R → S} {c d : R} (h : PeriodEquiv f c d) :
    f c = f d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zero_add c, h, zero_add]

name: zero_right
statement:
lemma zero_right [AddCommMonoid R] {f : R → S} {c : R} :
    PeriodEquiv f c 0 ↔ ∀ x, f (x + c) = f x
proof:
:=
  forall_congr' λ x ↦ by rw [add_zero]

name: zero_right'
statement:
lemma zero_right' [AddCommMonoid R] {f : R → S} {c : R} :
    PeriodEquiv f c 0 ↔ ∀ x, f (c + x) = f x
proof:
:=
  zero_right.trans <| forall_congr' λ x ↦ by rw [add_comm]

name: iff_sub
statement:
lemma iff_sub [AddCommGroup R] {f : R → S} {c d : R} :
    PeriodEquiv f c d ↔ PeriodEquiv f (c - d) 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h x ↦ by rw [← add_comm_sub, h, sub_add_cancel, add_zero],
  λ h x ↦ by rw [← add_add_sub_cancel x c d, h, add_zero]⟩

name: equiv_zero_iff
statement: theorem equiv_zero_iff : PeriodEquiv f c 0 ↔ QuasiPeriodic f c ∧ f c = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_right, QuasiPeriodic.iff_right hf]
  refine ⟨λ h ↦ ?_, λ h x ↦ by rw [h.1, h.2, neg_neg, mul_one]⟩
  
  have h0 : f c = -1 := by rw [← zero_add c, h, hf.map_zero]
  refine ⟨λ x ↦ ?_, h0⟩
  rw [h0, neg_neg, mul_one, h]

name: mul_left_equiv_zero
statement: theorem mul_left_equiv_zero (h : PeriodEquiv f c 0) : ∀ d, PeriodEquiv f (d * c) 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 (d) : QuasiPeriodic f (d * c) :=
    ((equiv_zero_iff hf).mp h).1.mul_left hf d
  have h1 := zero_right'.mp h
  have h2 (d x) : f (d * c) = -1 ∨ f (d * x + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← mul_eq_zero, add_one_mul (f _),
      ← neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, ← neg_mul, ← (h0 d).imp_left hf,
      ← add_assoc, ← mul_add, hf.is_good, hf.is_good, h1, add_left_comm, h1]
  
  refine λ d ↦ (equiv_zero_iff hf).mpr ⟨h0 d, (h2 d (-d)).elim id λ h3 ↦ ?_⟩
  
  refine (h2 (d - 1) 1).elim (λ h4 ↦ ?_) (λ h4 ↦ ?_)
  · rwa [← h1, ← one_add_mul _ c, add_sub_cancel] at h4
  · rw [mul_one, sub_add_cancel] at h4
    rw [hf.is_good, h4, zero_mul, zero_add, add_neg_cancel, hf.map_zero] at h3
    rw [h3, ← neg_neg (f _), ← neg_one_mul, h3, zero_mul]

name: mul_right_equiv_zero
statement: theorem mul_right_equiv_zero (h : PeriodEquiv f c 0) : ∀ d, PeriodEquiv f (c * d) 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 (d) : QuasiPeriodic f (c * d) :=
    ((equiv_zero_iff hf).mp h).1.mul_right hf d
  have h1 := zero_right.mp h
  have h2 (d x) : f (c * d) = -1 ∨ f (x * d + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, or_comm, ← mul_eq_zero, mul_add_one (f _),
      ← neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, ← mul_neg, ← (h0 d).imp_right hf,
      add_right_comm, ← add_mul, hf.is_good, hf.is_good, h1, add_right_comm, h1]
  
  refine λ d ↦ (equiv_zero_iff hf).mpr ⟨h0 d, (h2 d (-d)).elim id λ h3 ↦ ?_⟩
  
  refine (h2 (d - 1) 1).elim (λ h4 ↦ ?_) (λ h4 ↦ ?_)
  · rwa [← h1, ← mul_add_one c, sub_add_cancel] at h4
  · rw [one_mul, sub_add_cancel] at h4
    rw [hf.is_good, h4, mul_zero, zero_add, neg_add_cancel, hf.map_zero] at h3
    rw [h3, ← neg_neg (f _), ← neg_one_mul, h3, zero_mul]

name: mul_left_equiv
statement:
theorem mul_left_equiv (h : PeriodEquiv f c d) (a) :
    PeriodEquiv f (a * c) (a * d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_sub, ← mul_sub]
  exact mul_left_equiv_zero hf (iff_sub.mp h) a

name: mul_right_equiv
statement:
theorem mul_right_equiv (h : PeriodEquiv f c d) (a) :
    PeriodEquiv f (c * a) (d * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_sub, ← sub_mul]
  exact mul_right_equiv_zero hf (iff_sub.mp h) a

name: mul_equiv
statement:
theorem mul_equiv (h : PeriodEquiv f a b) (h0 : PeriodEquiv f c d) :
    PeriodEquiv f (a * c) (b * d)
proof:
:=
  λ x ↦ (mul_left_equiv hf h0 a x).trans (mul_right_equiv hf h d x)

name: toQuotientMap_good
statement: lemma toQuotientMap_good : good (toQuotientMap hf)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.ind₂ hf.is_good

name: toQuotientMap_NonTrivialGood
statement: lemma toQuotientMap_NonTrivialGood : NontrivialGood (toQuotientMap hf)
proof:
:=
  ⟨toQuotientMap_good hf, hf.map_zero_add_one⟩

name: toQuotientMap_ReducedGood
statement: lemma toQuotientMap_ReducedGood : ReducedGood (toQuotientMap hf)
proof:
:=
  ⟨toQuotientMap_NonTrivialGood hf, Quotient.ind₂ λ _ _ h ↦ Quot.sound λ x ↦ h x⟩

name: toQuotientMap_factor
statement: lemma toQuotientMap_factor : f = toQuotientMap hf ∘ (toRingCon hf).mk'
proof: := rfl

name: RestrictedSq_coe
statement: theorem RestrictedSq_coe (x : R) : (RestrictedSq x : R) = x ^ 2
proof: := rfl

name: RestrictedSq_apply_zero
statement: theorem RestrictedSq_apply_zero : RestrictedSq (R := R) 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext <| zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero 1)

name: sq_sub_one_is_good
statement: theorem sq_sub_one_is_good : good (λ (x : R) ↦ x ^ 2 - 1)
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ ↦ by ring

name: RestrictedSq_sub_one_is_good
statement: theorem RestrictedSq_sub_one_is_good : good (RestrictedSq (R := R) - 1)
proof:
:=
  λ x y ↦ Subtype.ext (sq_sub_one_is_good x y)

name: RestrictedSq_sub_one_is_NontrivialGood
statement:
theorem RestrictedSq_sub_one_is_NontrivialGood :
    NontrivialGood (RestrictedSq (R := R) - 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨RestrictedSq_sub_one_is_good, (sub_add_cancel _ _).trans RestrictedSq_apply_zero⟩

name: sub_one_is_good
statement: theorem sub_one_is_good : good (λ (x : R) ↦ x - 1)
proof:
:= λ x y ↦ by
  rw [sub_one_mul, mul_sub_one, sub_sub, ← add_sub_assoc x, sub_add_cancel]
  exact add_sub_cancel_right _ _

name: sub_one_is_NontrivialGood
statement: theorem sub_one_is_NontrivialGood : NontrivialGood (λ (x : R) ↦ x - 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨sub_one_is_good, sub_add_cancel 0 1⟩

name: sub_one_solver
statement:
theorem sub_one_solver [NonAssocRing S] {f : R → S} (hf : NontrivialGood f)
    (h : ∀ x, f (x + 1) = f x + 1) : ∃ φ : R →+* S, ∀ x, f x = φ (x - 1)
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y + 1 by
    have h0 (x y) : f (x + y + 1) = f (x + 1) + f (y + 1) := by
      rw [h, h, h, this, add_assoc, add_add_add_comm]
    have h1 (x y) : f (x * y + 1) = f (x + 1) * f (y + 1) := by
      rw [hf.is_good, h, h, this, add_assoc, ← add_assoc,
        ← mul_add_one (f x), ← add_one_mul (f x)]
    exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨λ x ↦ f (x + 1), (h 1).trans <| by rw [hf.map_one, zero_add]⟩, h1⟩,
        ((h 0).trans hf.map_zero_add_one), h0⟩,
      λ x ↦ congrArg f (sub_add_cancel x 1).symm⟩
  
  have h0 (x y) : f (x * y) + 1 = f x * f y + f (x + y) :=
    (h _).symm.trans (hf.is_good x y)
  have h1 (x y) : f (x * y) = f x * f y + f (x + y) - 1 :=
    eq_sub_of_add_eq (h0 x y)
  have h2 (x y) : f ((x + 1) * y) = f (x * y) + (f y + 1) := by
    rw [h1, h, add_right_comm, add_one_mul (f x), h, add_add_add_comm,
      ← h0, add_right_comm, add_sub_cancel_right]
  
  intro x y
  have h3 : f (x * ((x + 1) * y)) = f ((x + 1) * (x * y)) := by
    rw [add_one_mul x, add_one_mul x, mul_add]
  
  rwa [h2, h1, h2, mul_add, ← add_assoc, add_right_comm _ _ 1, h0, ← h,
    sub_eq_iff_eq_add, add_assoc, add_assoc, add_assoc, add_right_inj,
    ← add_left_inj 1, add_assoc, ← h, add_right_comm, ← mul_one_add (x + 1),
    h2, add_left_comm, mul_one_add x, add_assoc, add_right_inj, add_comm 1,
    h, mul_add_one (f x), h0, add_assoc, add_assoc (_ * _), add_right_inj,
    ← add_assoc, add_left_inj, ← add_assoc, eq_comm] at h3

name: zero_is_good
statement: theorem zero_is_good : good (λ _ : R ↦ (0 : S))
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ ↦ by rw [add_zero, zero_mul]

name: good_Nontrivial_or_eq_zero
statement:
theorem good_Nontrivial_or_eq_zero [IsCancelAdd S] [NoZeroDivisors S]
    {f : R → S} (h : good f) : NontrivialGood f ∨ f = (λ _ ↦ 0)
proof:
:=
  
  have h0 : f 1 = 0 := zero_eq_mul_self.mp <| add_right_cancel (b := f (1 + 1)) <| by
    rw [zero_add, ← h, one_mul]
  
  have h1 (x : R) : 0 = f x * (f 0 + 1) := by
    have h1 := h x 0; rwa [mul_zero, zero_add, h0, add_zero, ← mul_add_one (f x)] at h1
  
  (zero_eq_mul.mp (h1 0)).symm.imp (λ h1 ↦ ⟨h, h1⟩)
    (λ h2 ↦ funext λ x ↦ by specialize h1 x; rwa [h2, zero_add, mul_one, eq_comm] at h1)

name: good_iff_Nontrivial_or_eq_zero
statement:
theorem good_iff_Nontrivial_or_eq_zero [IsCancelAdd S] [NoZeroDivisors S] {f : R → S} :
    good f ↔ NontrivialGood f ∨ f = (λ _ ↦ 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨good_Nontrivial_or_eq_zero, λ h ↦ h.elim NontrivialGood.is_good λ h ↦ h ▸ zero_is_good⟩

name: isPolyGoodMap.NontrivialGood
statement: theorem isPolyGoodMap.NontrivialGood (hX : isPolyGoodMap X) : NontrivialGood X.f
proof:
:=
  hX.rec (λ R ↦ sub_one_is_NontrivialGood (R := R))
    (λ R ↦ RestrictedSq_sub_one_is_NontrivialGood (R := R))

name: isFinGoodMap.NontrivialGood
statement: theorem isFinGoodMap.NontrivialGood (hX : isFinGoodMap X) : NontrivialGood X.f
proof:
:=
  hX.rec 𝔽₂Map_is_NontrivialGood 𝔽₃Map1_is_NontrivialGood 𝔽₃Map2_is_NontrivialGood
    ℤ₄Map_is_NontrivialGood 𝔽₂εMap_is_NontrivialGood 𝔽₄Map_is_NontrivialGood

name: BundledRingFun.Hom.NontrivialGood_trans
statement:
theorem BundledRingFun.Hom.NontrivialGood_trans {A X : BundledRingFun}
    (hA : NontrivialGood A.f) (F : A.Hom X) : NontrivialGood X.f
proof:
:=
  have h : X.f = F.targetHom ∘ A.f ∘ F.sourceHom := funext F.spec
  h ▸ (hA.hom_comp _).comp_hom _

name: isNontrivialAnswer.NontrivialGood
statement: theorem isNontrivialAnswer.NontrivialGood (hX : isNontrivialAnswer X) : NontrivialGood X.f
proof:
:=
  hX.elim (λ ⟨_, h, h0⟩ ↦ h0.elim λ φ ↦ φ.NontrivialGood_trans h.NontrivialGood)
    (λ ⟨_, h, h0⟩ ↦ h0.elim λ φ ↦ φ.NontrivialGood_trans h.NontrivialGood)

name: Eq1
statement: theorem Eq1 (x : R) : f (-x) = f (x + 1) * f (-1) + f x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := hf.is_good (x + 1) (-1)
  rwa [add_neg_cancel_right, mul_neg_one (x + 1), neg_add, neg_add_cancel_right] at h0

name: Eq2
statement: theorem Eq2 (x : R) : f (-x) = -f (x + 2)
proof:
:= by
  replace hf := Eq1 hf
  have h0 := hf (-(x + 1))
  rw [neg_neg, hf (x + 1), neg_add, neg_add_cancel_right, ← add_assoc, right_eq_add,
    ← add_mul, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_left h, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] at h0
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h0

name: map_two
statement: lemma map_two : f 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zero_add 2, ← neg_inj, ← Eq2 hf h, neg_zero, hf.map_zero]

name: Eq3
statement: theorem Eq3 (x y : R) : f (-x) * f (-y) + f (-(x + y)) = f x * f y + f (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_add, ← hf.is_good, neg_mul_neg, hf.is_good]

name: Eq4
statement: theorem Eq4 (x : R) : f (2 * x + 1) = f x - f (-x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf.is_good, map_two hf h, one_mul, add_comm 2, Eq2 hf h, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: Eq5
statement: theorem Eq5 (x : R) : f (x + 1) = 0 ∨ f x + f (-x) = f (-1)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 : f x * f x - f (-x) * f (-x) = (f x - f (-x)) * (f x + f (-x)) := by
    have h0 : x * -x = -x * x := by rw [mul_neg, neg_mul]
    rw [sub_mul, mul_add, mul_add, map_commute_of_commute hf.is_good h0,
      add_comm, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
  
  have h1 := Eq3 hf x x
  rw [add_comm, ← sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, h0, Eq1 hf, add_sub_cancel_right,
    ← two_mul, Eq4 hf h, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero] at h1
  refine h1.imp (λ h1 ↦ ?_) (λ h1 ↦ (eq_of_sub_eq_zero h1).symm)
  rw [Eq1 hf, sub_add_cancel_right, neg_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero] at h1
  exact h1.resolve_right h

name: Eq6
statement: theorem Eq6 {x : R} (h0 : f (x + 1) = 0) : f x = -1
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 := Eq1 hf x
  rw [h0, zero_mul, zero_add] at h1
  
  have h2 := Eq3 hf x (-(x + 1))
  rw [neg_neg, h0, mul_zero, zero_add, ← sub_eq_add_neg,
    sub_add_cancel_left, neg_neg, hf.map_one] at h2
  
  have h3 := Eq3 hf x (x + 1)
  rw [h0, mul_zero, zero_add, ← add_assoc, ← two_mul,
    Eq4 hf h, h1, sub_self, h2, add_right_inj] at h3
  
  replace h2 := Eq4 hf h (-x - 1)
  rw [two_mul, add_assoc, sub_add_cancel, ← add_sub_right_comm, ← two_mul, mul_neg,
    ← neg_add', h3, eq_comm, Eq1 hf, sub_add_cancel_right, sub_add_cancel,
    neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, h1, ← add_one_mul (f x), mul_eq_zero] at h2
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (h2.resolve_right h)

name: map_neg_one_cases
statement: lemma map_neg_one_cases : f (-1) = -2 ∨ f (-1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero (b := 1), eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← mul_eq_zero,
    mul_sub_one, add_mul, two_mul, add_sub_assoc, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
  have h0 := Eq5 hf h (-1 + -1)
  rw [neg_add_cancel_right, or_iff_right h, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at h0
  have h1 := hf.is_good (-1) (-1)
  rwa [h0, neg_mul_neg, one_mul, ← neg_add, neg_neg, one_add_one_eq_two, map_two hf h,
    eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, add_sub_assoc, sub_sub, one_add_one_eq_two] at h1

name: Subcase11_solution
statement:
theorem Subcase11_solution (h0 : f (-1) = -2) :
    ∃ φ : R →+* S, ∀ x, f x = φ (x - 1)
proof:
:=
  sub_one_solver hf λ x ↦ by
    rcases Eq5 hf h x with h2 | h2
    
    · rw [Eq6 hf h h2, h2, neg_add_cancel]
    
    · rw [Eq1 hf, h0, add_left_comm, ← mul_two, mul_neg, ← neg_mul, ← add_mul,
        eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← add_one_mul _ (2 : S), mul_eq_zero, add_assoc] at h2
      exact neg_add_eq_zero.mp (h2.resolve_right (neg_ne_zero.mp (h0.symm.trans_ne h)))

name: map_neg_one_ne_zero
statement: lemma map_neg_one_ne_zero : f (-1) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ hf.Schar <| by rw [← mul_one (3 : S), ← hf.map_neg_one, h, mul_zero]

name: eq_zero_of_map_add_one
statement: lemma eq_zero_of_map_add_one (h : f (x + 1) = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 (x) : f (-x) = f (x + 1) + f x := by
    rw [Eq1 hf.toNontrivialGood, hf.map_neg_one, mul_one]
  have h1 : f (-x) = f x := by rw [h0, h, zero_add]
  refine hf.period_imp_zero λ y ↦ ?_
  
  have h2 := Eq3 hf.toNontrivialGood x (y - 1)
  rwa [h1, Case1.Eq6 hf.toNontrivialGood (map_neg_one_ne_zero hf) h, neg_one_mul,
    neg_one_mul, h0, h0 (x + _), add_assoc, sub_add_cancel, ← add_assoc, add_left_inj,
    neg_add_rev, add_assoc, add_eq_left, neg_add_eq_zero, eq_comm, add_comm] at h2

name: eq_zero_or_map_neg_add_self
statement: lemma eq_zero_or_map_neg_add_self (x) : x = 0 ∨ f x + f (-x) = 1
proof:
:=
  (Case1.Eq5 hf.toNontrivialGood (map_neg_one_ne_zero hf) x).imp
    (λ h ↦ eq_zero_of_map_add_one hf h) (λ h ↦ h.trans hf.map_neg_one)

name: triple_sum_eq_zero
statement: lemma triple_sum_eq_zero (x) : f x + f (x + 1) + f (x + 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := Eq1 hf.toNontrivialGood x
  rwa [Case1.Eq2 hf.toNontrivialGood (map_neg_one_ne_zero hf), hf.map_neg_one,
    mul_one, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm, add_comm (f _)] at h

name: Rchar
statement: lemma Rchar : (3 : R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine hf.period_imp_zero λ x ↦ ?_
  have h := triple_sum_eq_zero hf
  have h0 := h (x + 1)
  rwa [add_assoc x, one_add_one_eq_two, ← add_rotate, ← h x, add_left_inj,
    add_left_inj, add_assoc, add_comm 1, two_add_one_eq_three] at h0

name: value_bash
statement: lemma value_bash (x : R) : x = 0 ∨ x = 1 ∨ x = -1
proof:
:= by
  
  have h := eq_zero_or_map_neg_add_self hf
  refine (h x).imp_right λ h0 ↦ (h (x - 1)).imp eq_of_sub_eq_zero
    λ h1 ↦ eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left <| (h (x + 1)).resolve_right λ h2 ↦ ?_
  
  replace h (x) : f x + f (x + 1) + f (x - 1) = 0 := by
    have h3 : (2 : R) = -1 := by
      rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, two_add_one_eq_three, Rchar hf]
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← h3, triple_sum_eq_zero hf]
  
  replace h : _ + (f (-x) + _ + _) = 0 + 0 := congrArg₂ (· + ·) (h x) (h (-x))
  rw [add_zero, ← neg_add', add_right_comm (f _), add_add_add_comm,
    add_add_add_comm (f _), h0, h2, neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub x, h1,
    one_add_one_eq_two, two_add_one_eq_three] at h
  exact hf.Schar h

name: solution
statement: theorem solution : ∃ φ : R →+* 𝔽₃, ∀ x, f x = 𝔽₃Map1 (φ x)
proof:
:=
  have h : (𝔽₃.cast : 𝔽₃ → R).Bijective :=
    ⟨𝔽₃.castRingHom_injective (Rchar hf)
      λ h ↦ map_neg_one_ne_zero hf (by rw [h, neg_zero, ← h, hf.map_one]),
    λ x ↦ (value_bash hf x).elim (λ h ↦ ⟨𝔽₃.𝔽₃0, h.symm⟩)
      λ h ↦ h.elim (λ h ↦ ⟨𝔽₃.𝔽₃1, h.symm⟩) (λ h ↦ ⟨𝔽₃.𝔽₃2, h.symm⟩)⟩
  have h0 : ∀ x, f (𝔽₃.cast x) = 𝔽₃Map1 x
    | 𝔽₃.𝔽₃0 => by
        change f 0 = ((-1 : ℤ) : S)
        rw [hf.map_zero, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]
    | 𝔽₃.𝔽₃1 => (hf.map_one).trans Int.cast_zero.symm
    | 𝔽₃.𝔽₃2 => hf.map_neg_one.trans Int.cast_one.symm
  let ρ := RingEquiv.ofBijective (𝔽₃.castRingHom (Rchar hf)) h
  ⟨ρ.symm, λ x ↦ h0 _ ▸ congrArg f (Equiv.apply_symm_apply ρ.toEquiv _).symm⟩

name: solution
statement:
theorem solution {f : R → S} (hf : ReducedGood f) (h : f (-1) ≠ 0) :
    (∃ φ : R →+* S, ∀ x, f x = φ (x - 1)) ∨
    (∃ φ : R →+* 𝔽₃, ∀ x, f x = 𝔽₃Map1 (φ x))
proof:
:=
  let hf' := hf.toNontrivialGood
  (em (f (-1) = -2)).imp
    (Subcase11_solution hf' h)
    (λ h0 ↦ GoodSubcase12.solution <|
      have h1 := (map_neg_one_cases hf' h).resolve_left h0
      ⟨hf, h1, by rwa [← two_add_one_eq_three, Ne,
        ← neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, ← h1, eq_comm]⟩)

name: map_even_of_map_one
statement: theorem map_even_of_map_one (hf : good f) (h : f (-1) = 0) (x) : f (-x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  specialize hf (x + 1) (-1)
  rwa [h, mul_zero, zero_add, add_neg_cancel_right,
    mul_neg_one, neg_add, neg_add_cancel_right] at hf

name: Eq1
statement: theorem Eq1 (x y) : f (x * y - 1) = f x * f y + f (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h y, sub_eq_add_neg x, ← hf.is_good, mul_neg, neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, h]

name: Eq2
statement: theorem Eq2 (x) : f (x * 2 - 1) = f (x - 1) * f 2 + f (x + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := hf.is_good (x - 1) (1 + 1)
  rwa [sub_add_add_cancel, one_add_one_eq_two, mul_two, add_assoc,
    sub_add_cancel, ← add_sub_right_comm, ← mul_two] at h0

name: Eq3
statement: theorem Eq3 (x) : f (x * 2 + 1) = f (x + 1) * f 2 + f (x - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := Eq2 hf (-x)
  rwa [neg_mul, ← neg_add', h, ← neg_add', h, neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, h] at h0

name: Eq5
statement: theorem Eq5 {x} (h0 : f x = 0) (h1 : f (x + 1) = 0) : ∀ y, f (y + (2 * x + 1)) = f y
proof:
:=
  suffices ∀ y, f (x + y + 1) = f (x - y) from λ y ↦ by
    rw [two_mul, ← add_assoc, add_left_comm, this, sub_add_cancel_right, h]
  λ y ↦ by
    have h2 : f (x * ((x + 1) * y) + 1) = f ((x + 1) * (x * y) + 1) := by
      rw [add_one_mul x, mul_add, add_one_mul x]
    have h3 : x + (x + 1) * y = (x + 1) * (y + 1) - 1 := by
      rw [mul_add_one _ y, add_sub_assoc, add_sub_cancel_right, add_comm]
    rwa [hf.is_good, h3, Eq1 hf h, hf.is_good, ← add_rotate, ← mul_add_one x,
      hf.is_good, h0, h1, zero_mul, zero_add, zero_mul, zero_add, zero_add,
      zero_mul, zero_add, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← add_assoc, eq_comm] at h2

name: Eq4
statement: theorem Eq4 (x) : f x * f (x * 2 - 1) = (f (x - 1) + 1) * f (x * 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : x * (x + 1) - 1 = (x - 1) * (x + 1 + 1) + 1 := by
    rw [mul_add_one (x - 1), add_assoc, sub_add_cancel, sub_one_mul,
      ← add_sub_right_comm, add_comm, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
  apply congrArg f at h0
  rw [Eq1 hf h, hf.is_good, sub_add_cancel_left, h, hf.map_one, sub_add_add_cancel,
    add_zero, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two, ← add_assoc, ← mul_two] at h0
  rw [Eq2 hf, mul_add, h0, ← add_assoc, add_one_mul (f _),
    add_left_inj, mul_left_comm, ← mul_add, ← hf.is_good]

name: Eq4_alt
statement: theorem Eq4_alt (x) : f x * f (x * 2 + 1) = (f (x + 1) + 1) * f (x * 2 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := Eq4 hf h (-x)
  rwa [h, neg_mul, ← neg_add', h, ← neg_add', h, neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, h] at h0

name: two_periodic_of_map_two
statement: theorem two_periodic_of_map_two (h0 : f 2 = -1) : ∀ x, f (x + 2) = f x
proof:
:=
  have h1 (x) : f (x * 2 + 1) = f (x + 2) - f x := by
    rw [hf.is_good, h0, mul_neg_one, neg_add_eq_sub]
  have h2 (x) : f (x * 2 + 1) = -f (x * 2 - 1) := by
    rw [Eq2 hf, Eq3 hf h, h0, mul_neg_one, mul_neg_one, neg_add_rev, neg_neg]
  
  have h3 (x) : f x + f (x + 1) = -1 ∨ f (x * 2 - 1) = 0 := by
    have h3 := Eq4_alt hf h x
    rw [h2, mul_neg, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, ← add_mul, mul_eq_zero, ← add_assoc] at h3
    exact h3.imp_left eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
  
  λ x ↦ (h3 (x + 1)).symm.elim
    (λ h4 ↦ by rwa [mul_two, add_sub_assoc, add_sub_cancel_right,
      add_right_comm, ← mul_two, h1, sub_eq_zero] at h4)
    λ h4 ↦ (h3 x).symm.elim
      (λ h5 ↦ by rwa [← neg_eq_zero, ← h2, h1, sub_eq_zero] at h5)
      (λ h5 ↦ by rwa [← h5, add_comm, add_left_inj, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] at h4)

name: Eq6_ring_id
statement:
theorem Eq6_ring_id {S} [CommRing S] (a b c d : S) :
    a * (c * d + b) - a * (b * d + c) - ((c + 1) * (b * d + c) - (b + 1) * (c * d + b))
      = (b + c - (a + 1) * (d - 1)) * (b - c)
proof: := by ring

name: Eq6
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 (x) : f (x + 1) + f (x - 1) = (f x + 1) * (f 2 - 1) ∨ f (x + 1) = f (x - 1) := by
    have h1 : _ - _ = _ - _ := congrArg₂ (· - ·) (Eq4 hf h x) (Eq4_alt hf h x)
    rw [Eq2 hf, Eq3 hf h, ← sub_eq_zero, Eq6_ring_id, mul_eq_zero] at h1
    exact h1.imp eq_of_sub_eq_zero eq_of_sub_eq_zero
  
  intro x; refine (h1 x).elim id λ h2 ↦ ?_
  specialize h1 (x + 1)
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] at h1
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1
  · have h2 := Eq3 hf h x
    rw [hf.is_good, eq_sub_of_add_eq h1, add_sub_left_comm, ← mul_sub_one,
      add_one_mul (f _), add_assoc, ← one_add_mul (f x), mul_sub_one,
      ← add_sub_right_comm, add_sub_assoc, add_right_inj, add_comm] at h2
    exact (eq_add_of_sub_eq' h2).symm
  · have h0 : f 2 + 1 ≠ 0 := λ X ↦ h0 (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left X)
    have h3 := Eq3 hf h x
    rw [← h2, hf.is_good, h1, ← mul_add_one (f x), ← mul_add_one (f _),
      ← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_mul, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_left h0, sub_eq_zero] at h3
    have h4 := Eq4 hf h x
    rw [Eq3 hf h, Eq2 hf, ← h2, ← h3, ← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_mul, sub_add_cancel_left,
      neg_one_mul, neg_eq_zero, ← mul_add_one (f x), mul_eq_zero, or_iff_left h0] at h4
    rw [eq_comm, h4] at h3; rw [eq_comm, h3] at h2
    have h5 := Eq5 hf h h4 h3 0
    rw [zero_add, hf.is_good, add_comm 2 x, h1, h4, mul_zero,
      add_zero, hf.map_zero, eq_comm, neg_eq_zero] at h5
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← one_mul (_ - _), h5, zero_mul]

name: Eq7
proof:
:= by
  
  have h2 : _ * _ = _ * _ := congrArg (f x * ·) (Eq4_alt hf h x)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← sq, mul_left_comm, Eq4 hf h,
    ← mul_assoc, ← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_mul, mul_eq_zero] at h2
  rcases h2 with h2 | h2; exact (eq_of_sub_eq_zero h2).symm
  have h3 : _ * _ = _ * _ := congrArg (f x * ·) (Eq4 hf h x)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← sq, mul_left_comm, Eq4_alt hf h,
    ← mul_assoc, ← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_mul, mul_eq_zero] at h3
  rcases h3 with h3 | h3; rwa [sub_eq_zero, eq_comm, mul_comm] at h3
  
  rw [Eq3 hf h] at h2
  replace h3 : _ + _ = _ + _ := congrArg₂ (· + ·) h2 h3
  rw [Eq2 hf, add_add_add_comm, add_zero, ← add_mul,
    add_comm (f _), ← mul_add_one (α := S), mul_eq_zero,
    or_iff_left (h0 ∘ eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left), ← eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero] at h3
  have X : f 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := h1 ∘ eq_of_sub_eq_zero
  rw [h3, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← mul_sub_one, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_left X] at h2
  rw [h2, neg_zero] at h3
  have h4 := Eq6 hf h h0 x
  rw [h2, h3, add_zero, zero_eq_mul, or_iff_left X] at h4
  rw [h2, h3, zero_add, one_mul, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h4, neg_one_sq]

name: Rtwo_ne_zero
statement: theorem Rtwo_ne_zero : (2 : R) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ hf.map_two_ne_neg_one <| by rw [h, hf.map_zero]

name: oneVarLift_exists
statement:
theorem oneVarLift_exists [NoZeroDivisors S] (c : R) :
    ∃ (R' : Type u) (_ : CommRing R')
        (φ : R' →+* R) (_ : Function.Injective φ) (_ : c ∈ Set.range φ)
      (S' : Type v) (_ : CommRing S') (_ : NoZeroDivisors S')
        (ρ : S' →+* S) (_ : Function.Injective ρ)
      (f' : R' → S') (_ : ∀ a, f (φ a) = ρ (f' a)), GoodCase2 f'
proof:
:= by
  rcases CommSubring.oneVarCommLiftDomain_exists hf.toNontrivialGood c with
    ⟨R', R'comm, φ, hφ, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, hρ, f', h0, hf'⟩
  refine ⟨R', R'comm, φ, hφ, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, hρ, f', h0, hf', ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · intro x; apply hρ
    rw [← h0, ← h0, φ.map_neg, hf.map_even]
  
  · intro h1; apply hf.map_two_ne_neg_one
    rw [← map_ofNat φ 2, h0, h1, ρ.map_neg, ρ.map_one]

name: Eq1
statement: theorem Eq1 : ∀ x y, f (x * y - 1) = f x * f y + f (x - y)
proof:
:=
  Case2.Eq1 hf.toNontrivialGood hf.map_even

name: Eq2
statement: theorem Eq2 : ∀ x, f (x * 2 - 1) = f (x - 1) * f 2 + f (x + 1)
proof:
:=
  Case2.Eq2 hf.toNontrivialGood

name: Eq3
statement: theorem Eq3 : ∀ x, f (x * 2 + 1) = f (x + 1) * f 2 + f (x - 1)
proof:
:=
  Case2.Eq3 hf.toNontrivialGood hf.map_even

name: Eq6
statement: theorem Eq6 (x) : f (x + 1) + f (x - 1) = (f x + 1) * (f 2 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases oneVarLift_exists hf x with
    ⟨R', R'comm, φ, -, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, -, f', h0, hf'⟩
  rw [h0, ← φ.map_one, ← φ.map_sub, ← φ.map_add, h0, h0, ← map_ofNat φ 2, h0,
    ← ρ.map_one, ← ρ.map_add, ← ρ.map_add, ← ρ.map_sub, ← ρ.map_mul]
  exact congrArg ρ
    (CommCase.Eq6 hf'.toNontrivialGood hf'.map_even hf'.map_two_ne_neg_one x)

name: Eq7
proof:
:= by
  rcases oneVarLift_exists hf x with
    ⟨R', R'comm, φ, -, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, -, f', h0, hf'⟩
  have h2 : f' 2 ≠ 1 := λ h2 ↦ h1 <| by rw [← map_ofNat φ 2, h0, h2, ρ.map_one]
  rw [h0, ← φ.map_one, ← φ.map_sub, ← φ.map_add, h0, h0, ← ρ.map_one,
    ← ρ.map_add, ← ρ.map_add, ← ρ.map_mul, ← ρ.map_pow]
  exact congrArg ρ
    (CommCase.Eq7 hf'.toNontrivialGood hf'.map_even hf'.map_two_ne_neg_one h2 x)

name: map_two_cases
statement: theorem map_two_cases : f 2 = 1 ∨ f 2 = 0 ∨ f 2 = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := Eq1 hf (2 + 1) 2
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, hf.map_one, add_zero,
    mul_two, add_sub_assoc, add_sub_cancel_right] at h
  have h0 := Eq6 hf (2 + 1 + 1)
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two, h, ← mul_add_one (f _)] at h0
  replace h := Eq6 hf (2 + 1)
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right, add_one_mul (α := S), add_sub_left_comm,
    add_comm, add_right_inj, eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at h
  rw [h, mul_assoc, eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero] at h0
  clear h; revert h0; refine Or.imp (λ h ↦ ?_) (λ h ↦ ?_)
  · have h0 := Eq1 hf 2 (1 + 1)
    rw [two_mul, ← add_assoc, add_sub_cancel_right, one_add_one_eq_two, sub_self,
      hf.map_zero, h, eq_comm, add_neg_eq_zero, mul_self_eq_one_iff] at h0
    exact h0.resolve_right hf.map_two_ne_neg_one
  · rw [mul_sub_one, sub_one_mul, sub_sub, sub_add_add_cancel, ← two_mul,
      sub_sub, ← one_add_mul 2 (f 2), ← sub_mul, mul_eq_zero, add_comm] at h
    exact h.symm.imp_right λ h ↦ (eq_of_sub_eq_zero h).trans two_add_one_eq_three

name: RGoodSubcase21.solution
statement:
theorem RGoodSubcase21.solution [Ring R] [Ring S] [NoZeroDivisors S]
    {f : R → S} (hf : RGoodCase2 f) (h : f 2 = 1) :
    ∃ φ : R →+* ℤ₄, ∀ x, f x = ℤ₄Map (φ x)
proof:
:=
  have h0 (x) : f (x + 2) = -f x := by
    have h0 := hf.toGoodCase2.Eq6 (x + 1)
    rw [h, sub_self, mul_zero, add_sub_cancel_right, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] at h0
    exact eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr h0
  have h1 : (4 : R) = 0 := hf.period_imp_zero λ x ↦ by
    have h1 : (2 : R) + 2 = 4 := by norm_num
    rw [← h1, ← add_assoc, h0, h0, neg_neg]
  have hInj : (ℤ₄.cast : ℤ₄ → R).Injective :=
    ℤ₄.castRingHom_injective h1 hf.toGoodCase2.Rtwo_ne_zero
  have hSurj : (ℤ₄.cast : ℤ₄ → R).Surjective :=
    have h2 : QuasiPeriodic f 2 := (QuasiPeriodic.iff_right hf.toNontrivialGood).mpr
      λ x ↦ by rw [h0, h, mul_neg_one]
    have X : (2 : R) + 1 = -1 := by
      rwa [two_add_one_eq_three, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, three_add_one_eq_four]
    λ x ↦ (h2.reduced_main_cases hf.toReducedGood hf.toGoodCase2.Rtwo_ne_zero x).elim
      (λ h3 ↦ h3.elim (λ h3 ↦ ⟨ℤ₄.ℤ₄0, h3.symm⟩) (λ h3 ↦ ⟨ℤ₄.ℤ₄2, h3.symm⟩))
      (λ h3 ↦ h3.elim (λ h3 ↦ ⟨ℤ₄.ℤ₄1, h3.symm⟩) (λ h3 ↦ ⟨ℤ₄.ℤ₄3, (h3.trans X).symm⟩))
  have h2 : (ℤ₄.cast : ℤ₄ → R).Bijective := ⟨hInj, hSurj⟩
  have h3 : ∀ x, f (ℤ₄.cast x) = ℤ₄Map x
    | ℤ₄.ℤ₄0 => by
        change f 0 = ((-1 : ℤ) : S)
        rw [hf.map_zero, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]
    | ℤ₄.ℤ₄1 => hf.map_one.trans Int.cast_zero.symm
    | ℤ₄.ℤ₄2 => h.trans Int.cast_one.symm
    | ℤ₄.ℤ₄3 => (hf.map_even _).trans (hf.map_one.trans Int.cast_zero.symm)
  let ρ := RingEquiv.ofBijective (ℤ₄.castRingHom h1) h2
  ⟨ρ.symm, λ x ↦ h3 _ ▸ congrArg f (Equiv.apply_symm_apply ρ.toEquiv _).symm⟩

name: Eq1
statement: theorem Eq1 (x) : f (x + 1) + f (x - 1) + f x = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf.toGoodCase2.Eq6, h, zero_sub, mul_neg_one, neg_add_rev, neg_add_cancel_right]

name: Rchar
statement: theorem Rchar : (3 : R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← two_add_one_eq_three, ← eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
  refine hf.period_imp_eq _ _ λ x ↦ ?_
  have h0 := Eq1 hf h (x + 1)
  rwa [add_sub_cancel_right, add_assoc x, one_add_one_eq_two, ← Eq1 hf h x,
    ← add_rotate, add_left_inj, add_right_inj, sub_eq_add_neg] at h0

name: Rchar'
statement: theorem Rchar' : (2 : R) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, two_add_one_eq_three, Rchar hf h]

name: Eq2
statement: theorem Eq2 (x) : f (x + 1) * f (x - 1) = (f x + 1) * f x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : f 2 ≠ 1 := λ h0 ↦ hf.map_two_ne_neg_one (by rw [h, zero_eq_neg, ← h, ← h0])
  rw [add_one_mul (f x), ← sq, ← hf.toGoodCase2.Eq7 h0, add_one_mul (f _),
    mul_add_one (f _), add_assoc, add_assoc, left_eq_add,
    add_right_comm, ← add_assoc, ← add_assoc, Eq1 hf h, neg_add_cancel]

name: map_eq_neg_one_imp
statement: theorem map_eq_neg_one_imp (h0 : f x = -1) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : f (x + 1) = 0 ∧ f (x - 1) = 0 := by
    have h1 : f (x + 1) + f (x - 1) = 0 := by
      rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq (Eq1 hf h x), h0, sub_self]
    obtain h2 | h2 : f (x + 1) = 0 ∨ f (x - 1) = 0 := by
      rw [← mul_eq_zero, Eq2 hf h, h0, neg_add_cancel, zero_mul]
    · rw [h2, zero_add] at h1; exact ⟨h2, h1⟩
    · rw [h2, add_zero] at h1; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← Rchar' hf h, ← one_add_one_eq_two, ← add_assoc] at h1
  replace h1 := hf.toReducedGood.period_imp_zero
    (Eq5 hf.toNontrivialGood hf.map_even h1.1 h1.2)
  rwa [Rchar' hf h, neg_one_mul, neg_add_rev, neg_add_cancel_comm, neg_eq_zero] at h1

name: map_eq_neg_one_or_zero
statement: theorem map_eq_neg_one_or_zero (h0 : (3 : S) ≠ 0) (x) : f x = -1 ∨ f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have Rchar' := Rchar' hf h
  
  have h1 : f (x * x + 1) = (f x + 1) * f x := by
    rw [hf.is_good, ← two_mul, Rchar', neg_one_mul, hf.map_even, add_one_mul (f x)]
  have h2 : f (x * x - 1) = f x * f x - 1 := by
    rw [Case2.Eq1 hf.toNontrivialGood hf.map_even, sub_self, hf.map_zero, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have h3 : f (x * x) = (f x + 1 + 1) * f x := by
    have h2 := hf.is_good (x + 1) (x - 1)
    rw [Eq2 hf h, add_one_mul x, mul_sub_one, sub_add_sub_cancel, sub_add_cancel,
      add_add_sub_cancel, ← two_mul, Rchar', neg_one_mul, hf.map_even] at h2
    exact h2.trans (add_one_mul _ (f x)).symm
  
  have h4 := Eq1 hf h (x * x)
  rw [h1, h2, h3, ← add_sub_assoc, ← add_mul, ← add_sub_right_comm,
    sub_eq_neg_self, ← add_mul, mul_eq_zero, add_add_add_comm] at h4
  clear h1 h2 h3; revert h4; refine Or.imp_left λ h1 ↦ ?_
  rw [← two_mul, ← add_one_mul 2 (f x + 1), mul_eq_zero, two_add_one_eq_three] at h1
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (h1.resolve_left h0)

name: value_bash
statement: theorem value_bash (h0 : (3 : S) ≠ 0) (x : R) : x = 0 ∨ x = 1 ∨ x = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 (x) : x = 0 ∨ f x = 0 :=
    (map_eq_neg_one_or_zero hf h h0 x).imp_left (map_eq_neg_one_imp hf h)
  refine (h1 x).imp_right λ h2 ↦ (h1 (x - 1)).imp eq_of_sub_eq_zero λ h3 ↦
    (h1 (x + 1)).elim eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left λ h4 ↦ ?_
  have h5 := Eq1 hf h x
  rw [h2, h3, h4, add_zero, add_zero, eq_comm, neg_eq_zero] at h5
  rw [← mul_one 3, h5, mul_zero] at h0
  exact absurd rfl h0

name: solution
statement: theorem solution (h0 : (3 : S) ≠ 0) : ∃ φ : R →+* 𝔽₃, ∀ x, f x = 𝔽₃Map2 (φ x)
proof:
:=
  have h1 : (𝔽₃.cast : 𝔽₃ → R).Bijective :=
    ⟨𝔽₃.castRingHom_injective (Rchar hf h) λ h ↦ h0 <| by
      have h0 := hf.map_one; rw [h, hf.map_zero, neg_eq_zero] at h0
      rw [← mul_one 3, h0, mul_zero],
    λ x ↦ (value_bash hf h h0 x).elim (λ h ↦ ⟨𝔽₃.𝔽₃0, h.symm⟩)
      λ h ↦ h.elim (λ h ↦ ⟨𝔽₃.𝔽₃1, h.symm⟩) (λ h ↦ ⟨𝔽₃.𝔽₃2, h.symm⟩)⟩
  have h2 : ∀ x, f (𝔽₃.cast x) = 𝔽₃Map2 x
    | 𝔽₃.𝔽₃0 => by
        change f 0 = ((-1 : ℤ) : S)
        rw [hf.map_zero, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]
    | 𝔽₃.𝔽₃1 => (hf.map_one).trans Int.cast_zero.symm
    | 𝔽₃.𝔽₃2 => (hf.map_even _).trans ((hf.map_one).trans Int.cast_zero.symm)
  let ρ := RingEquiv.ofBijective (𝔽₃.castRingHom (Rchar hf h)) h1
  ⟨ρ.symm, λ x ↦ h2 _ ▸ congrArg f (Equiv.apply_symm_apply ρ.toEquiv _).symm⟩

name: oneVarLift_exists
statement:
theorem oneVarLift_exists {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [Ring R] [Ring S]
    [NoZeroDivisors S] {g : R → S} (hg : ShiftGood23 g) (c : R) :
    ∃ (R' : Type u) (_ : CommRing R')
        (φ : R' →+* R) (_ : Function.Injective φ) (_ : c ∈ Set.range φ)
      (S' : Type v) (_ : CommRing S') (_ : NoZeroDivisors S')
        (ρ : S' →+* S) (_ : Function.Injective ρ)
      (g' : R' → S') (_ : ∀ a, g (φ a) = ρ (g' a)), ShiftGood23 g'
proof:
:= by
  rcases hg.shift_good.oneVarLift_exists c with
    ⟨R', R'comm, φ, hφ, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, hρ, f', h0, hf'⟩
  refine ⟨R', R'comm, φ, hφ, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, hρ, f' + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · intro x; rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.one_apply, ρ.map_add, ← h0, ρ.map_one]
    exact (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm
  
  · refine ⟨by rwa [add_sub_cancel_right], hρ ?_⟩
    rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.one_apply, ρ.map_add, ρ.map_one, ← h0, map_ofNat,
      map_ofNat, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.one_apply, hg.map_two, sub_add_cancel]

name: mk_iff
statement: lemma mk_iff {g : R → S} : ShiftGood23 g ↔ GoodCase2 (g - 1) ∧ g 2 = 4

name: shift_mk_iff
statement: lemma shift_mk_iff {f : R → S} : ShiftGood23 (f + 1) ↔ GoodCase2 f ∧ f 2 = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_iff, add_sub_cancel_right, ← three_add_one_eq_four]
  exact and_congr_right' (add_left_inj _)

name: map_zero
statement: lemma map_zero : g 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_neg_self.mp hg.shift_good.map_zero

name: map_one
statement: lemma map_one : g 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  eq_of_sub_eq_zero hg.shift_good.map_one

name: map_even
statement: lemma map_even (x) : g (-x) = g x
proof:
:=
  sub_left_injective (hg.shift_good.map_even x)

name: Schar_ne_two
statement: lemma Schar_ne_two : (2 : S) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  λ h ↦ hg.shift_good.map_two_ne_neg_one <| by
    rw [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.one_apply, sub_eq_neg_self, hg.map_two, ← three_add_one_eq_four,
      ← two_add_one_eq_three, h, zero_add, one_add_one_eq_two, h]

name: is_good
statement: lemma is_good (x y) : g (x * y + 1) = (g x - 1) * (g y - 1) + g (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hg.shift_good.is_good x y
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.one_apply] at h
  rwa [← add_sub_assoc, sub_left_inj] at h

name: alt_good
statement: lemma alt_good (x y) : g (x * y - 1) = (g x - 1) * (g y - 1) + g (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hg.is_good x (-y)
  rwa [hg.map_even, mul_neg, neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, hg.map_even, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at h

name: Eq1
statement: lemma Eq1 (x) : g (x + 1) + g (x - 1) = 2 * (g x + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hg.shift_good.Eq6 x; simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.one_apply] at h
  rwa [sub_add_cancel, hg.map_two, sub_eq_of_eq_add (G := S) three_add_one_eq_four.symm,
    sub_eq_of_eq_add (G := S) two_add_one_eq_three.symm, sub_add_sub_comm, mul_two,
    sub_eq_iff_eq_add, one_add_one_eq_two, ← two_mul, ← mul_add_one] at h

name: Eq2
statement: lemma Eq2 (x y) : g (x * y + 1) - g (x * y - 1) = g (x + y) - g (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hg.is_good, hg.alt_good, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]

name: Eq3_1
proof:
:= by
  have h : (g - 1) 2 ≠ 1 := λ h0 ↦ by
    rw [Pi.sub_apply, hg.map_two, sub_eq_of_eq_add three_add_one_eq_four.symm,
      ← two_add_one_eq_three, add_eq_right] at h0
    exact hg.Schar_ne_two h0
  replace h := hg.shift_good.Eq7 h x
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.one_apply, sub_add_cancel] at h; exact h

name: CommCase.Eq3_2
statement:
lemma CommCase.Eq3_2 {S} [CommRing S] [NoZeroDivisors S]
    {g : R → S} (hg : ShiftGood23 g) (x) :
    (g (x + 1) - g (x - 1)) ^ 2 = 2 ^ 4 * g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_sq', ← sub_eq_of_eq_add (add_sq' (g _) _),
    Eq1 hg, mul_assoc, Eq3_1 hg]
  ring

name: Eq3_2
proof:
:= by
  rcases oneVarLift_exists hg x with
    ⟨R', R'comm, φ, -, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, -, g', h0, hg'⟩
  rw [← φ.map_one, ← φ.map_add, ← φ.map_sub, h0, h0, ← ρ.map_sub, ← ρ.map_pow,
    CommCase.Eq3_2 hg', h0, ρ.map_mul, ρ.map_pow, map_ofNat]

name: Eq3
statement: lemma Eq3 (x y) : (g (x + y) - g (x - y)) ^ 2 = 2 ^ 4 * g (x * y)
proof:
:=
  Eq2 hg x y ▸ Eq3_2 hg _

name: Eq4
statement:
lemma Eq4 (x y) : 2 * (g (x * y) - g x * g y) =
    g (x + y) + g (x - y) - 2 * (g x + g y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : _ + _ = _ + _ := congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hg.is_good x y) (hg.alt_good x y)
  rw [Eq1 hg, add_add_add_comm, ← two_mul, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← mul_sub] at h
  rw [← h, ← mul_sub, sub_sub, sub_one_mul, mul_sub_one, sub_sub, sub_add,
    ← add_sub_assoc, sub_sub_cancel_left, sub_neg_eq_add, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]

name: Eq5
statement: lemma Eq5 (x) : g (x * 2) = g x * 4
proof:
:= by
  have h : _ + _ = _ + _ := congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hg.shift_good.Eq3 x) (hg.shift_good.Eq2 x)
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.one_apply] at h
  rw [← add_sub_add_comm, Eq1 hg, add_add_add_comm, ← add_mul,
    add_comm (g (x - 1) - 1), mul_sub_one, sub_add_cancel, ← add_sub_add_comm,
    Eq1 hg, one_add_one_eq_two, mul_add_one (α := S), add_sub_cancel_right,
    mul_add_one (α := S), add_sub_cancel_right, hg.map_two, mul_assoc,
    ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero] at h
  exact eq_of_sub_eq_zero (h.resolve_left hg.Schar_ne_two)

name: mk_iff
statement: lemma mk_iff {g : R → S} : RShiftGood23 g ↔ RGoodCase2 (g - 1) ∧ g 2 = 4
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ ⟨h, h0⟩ ↦ ⟨h, (ShiftGood23.mk_iff.mp h0).2⟩, λ ⟨h, h0⟩ ↦ ⟨h, h.toGoodCase2, h0⟩⟩

name: shift_mk_iff
statement: lemma shift_mk_iff {f : R → S} : RShiftGood23 (f + 1) ↔ RGoodCase2 f ∧ f 2 = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_iff, add_sub_cancel_right, ← three_add_one_eq_four]
  exact and_congr_right' (add_left_inj _)

name: period_imp_eq
statement: lemma period_imp_eq₀ (c d) (h : ∀ x, g (x + c) = g (x + d)) : c = d
proof:
:=
  hg.period_imp_eq c d λ x ↦ congrArg₂ (· - ·) (h x) rfl

name: period_imp_zero
statement: lemma period_imp_zero₀ {c} (h : ∀ x, g (x + c) = g x) : c = 0
proof:
:=
  hg.period_imp_eq₀ c 0 λ x ↦ by rw [h, add_zero]

name: Eq6
statement: lemma Eq6 {x} (h : g x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 := hg.Eq3 x 1
  rw [mul_one, h, mul_zero, sq_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero] at h0
  have h1 := hg.Eq1 x
  rw [h, zero_add, h0, ← two_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub,
    mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right hg.Schar_ne_two, sub_eq_zero] at h1
  rw [h1] at h0
  
  have h2 (y) : g (y - x) + 2 * g y = (2 + 1) * g (y + x) := by
    have h2 : g (x + (x + 1) * (y - 1)) = g (x + 1 - y) := by
      rw [mul_sub_one, add_sub_left_comm, sub_add_cancel_left, ← sub_eq_add_neg,
        hg.toShiftGood23.alt_good, h0, sub_self, zero_mul, zero_add]
    have h3 := hg.toShiftGood23.is_good (x + 1) (x * (y - 1))
    rw [h0, sub_self, zero_mul, zero_add, ← add_rotate, ← mul_add_one x, sub_add_cancel,
      ← mul_assoc, add_one_mul x, ← mul_add_one x, mul_assoc, hg.toShiftGood23.is_good,
      h2, hg.toShiftGood23.is_good, h, zero_sub, neg_one_mul, neg_one_mul, neg_sub,
      neg_sub, sub_add, sub_add, sub_right_inj, sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at h3
    replace h2 := hg.Eq4 (x + 1) (y - 1)
    rw [h0, one_mul, mul_sub, mul_one_add (α := S), ← sub_sub, sub_left_inj,
      eq_sub_iff_add_eq, h3, mul_add, add_assoc, ← mul_add_one (α := S),
      add_add_sub_cancel, ← hg.Eq1, ← sub_add, ← add_assoc, ← add_rotate,
      add_left_inj, sub_sub, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, mul_sub,
      hg.toShiftGood23.map_even, ← add_sub_assoc, sub_eq_iff_eq_add'] at h2
    rw [h2, add_one_mul (α := S), add_comm x]
  
  refine hg.period_imp_zero₀ λ y ↦ ?_
  have h3 := h2 (-y)
  rw [← neg_add', hg.toShiftGood23.map_even, hg.toShiftGood23.map_even,
    neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, hg.toShiftGood23.map_even] at h3
  replace h2 : _ - _ = _ - _ := congrArg₂ (· - ·) h3 (h2 y)
  rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← mul_sub, ← neg_sub, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero,
    ← one_add_mul (α := S), mul_eq_zero, add_left_comm, one_add_one_eq_two,
    ← two_mul, mul_self_eq_zero, or_iff_right hg.Schar_ne_two, sub_eq_zero] at h2
  rwa [h2, add_one_mul (α := S), add_comm, add_left_inj, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub,
    mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right hg.Schar_ne_two, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at h3

name: Rcomm
statement: lemma Rcomm : ∀ x y : R, x * y = y * x
proof:
:= by
  
  have X : (2 : S) ^ 4 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 4 hg.Schar_ne_two
  have h (x y) : g (x * y) = g (y * x) := by
    have h := hg.Eq3 x y
    rw [add_comm, ← neg_sub y, hg.toShiftGood23.map_even, hg.Eq3,
      ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right X] at h
    exact (eq_of_sub_eq_zero h).symm
  replace h (x y : R) : (x * x - y * y) * (x * y - y * x) = 0 := hg.Eq6 <| by
    have h0 := hg.Eq3 (x * x - y * y) (x * y - y * x)
    rwa [sub_add_sub_comm, ← mul_add, ← mul_add, add_comm y, ← sub_mul, h,
      sub_sub_sub_comm, ← mul_sub, ← mul_sub, ← neg_sub x, mul_neg, sub_neg_eq_add,
      add_mul, sub_self, sq, zero_mul, zero_eq_mul, or_iff_right X] at h0
  
  have h0 (x y : R) : (x + 1) * y - y * (x + 1) = x * y - y * x := by
    rw [add_one_mul x, mul_add_one y, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
  replace h (x y : R) : (x * 2 + 1) * (x * y - y * x) = 0 := by
    have h1 := h (x + 1) y
    rwa [h0, add_one_mul x, mul_add_one x, add_assoc, add_sub_right_comm,
      add_mul, h, zero_add, ← add_assoc, ← mul_two] at h1
  intro x y; have h1 := h (x + 1) y
  rw [h0, add_one_mul x, add_right_comm, add_mul, h, zero_add] at h1
  specialize h x y
  rwa [add_one_mul (α := R), mul_assoc, h1, mul_zero, zero_add, sub_eq_zero] at h

name: Eq7
statement: lemma Eq7 : ∀ x y, g (x * y) = g x * g y
proof:
:= by
  
  have h (x y) : g (x * y * y) = g (x * y) * g y := by
    suffices g (x * y + y) + g (x * y - y) = 2 * (g (x * y) + g y) by
      rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← hg.Eq4, mul_eq_zero] at this
      exact eq_of_sub_eq_zero (this.resolve_left hg.Schar_ne_two)
    have h : _ + _ = _ + _ := congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hg.Eq4 (x + 1) y) (hg.Eq4 (x - 1) y)
    rwa [← mul_add, sub_add_sub_comm, ← add_mul, sub_add_sub_comm, add_add_add_comm,
      hg.Eq1, add_right_comm x, ← add_sub_right_comm x y, hg.Eq1, add_sub_right_comm x,
      sub_right_comm, hg.Eq1, ← mul_add, ← mul_add, ← mul_sub, add_add_add_comm,
      add_add_add_comm (g _) (g y), hg.Eq1, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero,
      or_iff_right hg.Schar_ne_two, sub_eq_zero, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, one_add_one_eq_two,
      mul_add_one (α := S), ← two_mul, add_right_comm (2 * g x), add_sub_add_right_eq_sub,
      ← mul_add, ← hg.Eq4, ← mul_add_one (α := S), mul_assoc, ← mul_add, add_one_mul (g x),
      add_comm _ (g y), sub_add_add_cancel, add_one_mul x, sub_one_mul] at h
  
  replace h (x y) : x * y = 0 ∨ g (x * y) = g x * g y := by
    have h0 := h 1 (x * y)
    rw [one_mul, ← mul_assoc, hg.Rcomm _ x, ← mul_assoc, h, mul_assoc, hg.Rcomm x,
      hg.Rcomm x, h, mul_assoc, hg.Rcomm y, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, mul_eq_zero] at h0
    exact h0.imp hg.Eq6 (λ h0 ↦ (eq_of_sub_eq_zero h0).symm)
  
  intro x y; refine (h x y).elim (λ h0 ↦ ?_) id
  refine (h (x + 1) y).elim (λ h1 ↦ ?_) (λ h1 ↦ ?_)
  · rw [add_one_mul x, h0, zero_add] at h1
    rw [h1, mul_zero, hg.toShiftGood23.map_zero, mul_zero]
  refine (h (x - 1) y).elim (λ h2 ↦ ?_) (λ h2 ↦ ?_)
  · rw [sub_one_mul x, h0, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at h2
    rw [h2, mul_zero, hg.toShiftGood23.map_zero, mul_zero]
  rw [add_one_mul x, h0, zero_add] at h1
  rw [sub_one_mul, h0, zero_sub, hg.toShiftGood23.map_even] at h2
  have h3 : _ + _ = _ + _ := congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2
  rw [← two_mul, ← add_mul, hg.Eq1, mul_add_one (α := S), add_mul, right_eq_add,
    mul_assoc, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right hg.Schar_ne_two] at h3
  rw [h0, hg.toShiftGood23.map_zero, h3]

name: Eq8
statement: lemma Eq8 (x y) : g (x + y) + g (x - y) = 2 • (g x + g y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_nsmul, ← two_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← hg.Eq4, hg.Eq7, sub_self, mul_zero]

name: solution
statement:
theorem solution :
    ∃ (R' : Type u) (_ : CommRing R') (φ : R →+* R') (ι : SqSubring R' →+* S),
      ∀ x, g x = ι (RestrictedSq (φ x))
proof:
:= by
  let hR := CommRing.mk hg.Rcomm
  refine ⟨R, hR, RingHom.id R, ?_⟩
  have hS (x y : S) (h : 2 • x = 2 • y) : x = y := by
    rwa [two_nsmul, ← two_mul, two_nsmul, ← two_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub,
      mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right hg.Schar_ne_two, sub_eq_zero] at h
  let φ := BilinMap hS hg.Eq8
  let ρ := φ 1
  
  have h : ∀ x, φ x x = 2 • g x := BilinMap_eq_two_nsmul _ _
  have h0 (x y) : φ x y = ρ (x * y) :=
    hS _ _ <| by rw [two_nsmul_BilinMap_eq, two_nsmul_BilinMap_eq,
      ← hg.Eq2, add_comm, ← neg_sub (x * y), hg.toShiftGood23.map_even]
  
  let R₂ := AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range λ x : R ↦ x ^ 2)
  obtain ⟨ι, h1⟩ : ∃ ι : SqSubring R →+ S, ∀ a : SqSubring R, ρ a = 2 • ι a :=
    suffices ∃ ι : SqSubring R → S, ∀ a : SqSubring R, ρ a = 2 • ι a by
      rcases this with ⟨ι, h1⟩
      have h3 (x y) : ι (x + y) = ι x + ι y := hS _ _ <| by
        rw [← h1, Subring.coe_add, ρ.map_add, h1, h1, nsmul_add]
      exact ⟨AddMonoidHom.mk' ι h3, h1⟩
    suffices ∀ r ∈ R₂, ∃ s, ρ r = 2 • s
      from Classical.axiomOfChoice λ (a : SqSubring R) ↦ this a.1 a.2
    λ r ↦ AddSubgroup.closure_induction
      (λ y ⟨x, h3⟩ ↦ ⟨g x, by rw [← h, h0 x, ← sq, ← h3]⟩)
      ⟨0, by rw [ρ.map_zero, nsmul_zero]⟩
      (λ x y _ _ ⟨s, hs⟩ ⟨t, ht⟩ ↦ ⟨s + t, by rw [ρ.map_add, hs, ht, nsmul_add]⟩)
      (λ x _ ⟨s, hs⟩ ↦ ⟨-s, by rw [ρ.map_neg, hs, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_neg, nsmul_eq_mul]⟩)
  
  suffices ∀ x y, ι (x * y) = ι x * ι y by
    have h2 : ι 1 = 1 := hS _ _ <| by
      rw [← h1, Subring.coe_one, h, hg.toShiftGood23.map_one]
    refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨ι, h2⟩, this⟩, ι.map_zero, ι.map_add⟩, λ x ↦ hS _ _ ?_⟩
    change 2 • g x = 2 • ι (RestrictedSq x)
    rw [← h, ← h1, RestrictedSq_coe, sq, h0]
  
  have X (x y : S) : (2 • x) * (2 • y) = 2 • 2 • (x * y) := by
    rw [two_nsmul, two_nsmul, add_mul, mul_add, ← two_nsmul, ← two_nsmul]
  suffices ∀ a b, a ∈ R₂ → b ∈ R₂ → 2 • ρ (a * b) = ρ a * ρ b
    from λ x y ↦ hS _ _ <| hS _ _ <| by
      rw [← h1, Subring.coe_mul, this _ _ x.2 y.2, h1, h1, X]
  replace h (x) : ρ (x ^ 2) = 2 • g x := by rw [← h, sq, ← h0]
  intro a b; refine AddSubgroup.closure_induction₂ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ _ ⟨c, rfl⟩ ⟨d, rfl⟩; rw [← mul_pow, h, h, h, X, hg.Eq7]
  · rintro x -; rw [zero_mul, ρ.map_zero, zero_mul, nsmul_zero]
  · rintro x -; rw [mul_zero, ρ.map_zero, mul_zero, nsmul_zero]
  · rintro x₁ x₂ y - - - hx₁ hx₂
    rw [add_mul, ρ.map_add, nsmul_add, hx₁, hx₂, ρ.map_add, add_mul]
  · rintro x y₁ y₂ - - - hy₁ hy₂
    rw [mul_add, ρ.map_add, nsmul_add, hy₁, hy₂, ρ.map_add, mul_add]
  · rintro x y - - h2; rw [neg_mul, ρ.map_neg, ρ.map_neg, neg_mul, ← h2]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_neg]
  · rintro x y - - h2; rw [mul_neg, ρ.map_neg, ρ.map_neg, mul_neg, ← h2]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_neg]

name: RGoodSubcase23.solution
statement:
theorem RGoodSubcase23.solution (hf : RGoodCase2 f) (h : f 2 = 3) :
    ∃ (R' : Type u) (_ : CommRing R') (φ : R →+* R') (ι : SqSubring R' →+* S),
      ∀ x, f x = ι (RestrictedSq (φ x) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases (RShiftGood23.shift_mk_iff.mpr ⟨hf, h⟩).solution with ⟨R', _, φ, ι, h0⟩
  refine ⟨R', _, φ, ι, λ x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [ι.map_sub, ← h0, ι.map_one]
  exact (add_sub_cancel_right _ _).symm

name: RGoodCase2.solution
statement:
theorem RGoodCase2.solution (hf : RGoodCase2 f) :
    (∃ (R' : Type u) (_ : CommRing R') (φ : R →+* R') (ι : SqSubring R' →+* S),
      ∀ x, f x = ι (RestrictedSq (φ x) - 1)) ∨
    (∃ φ : R →+* ℤ₄, ∀ x, f x = ℤ₄Map (φ x)) ∨
    (∃ φ : R →+* 𝔽₃, ∀ x, f x = 𝔽₃Map2 (φ x))
proof:
:=
  (em (f 2 = 3)).imp (RGoodSubcase23.solution hf) λ h ↦
    hf.toGoodCase2.map_two_cases.imp (RGoodSubcase21.solution hf) λ h0 ↦
      have h0 := h0.resolve_right h
      RGoodSubcase22.solution hf h0 (h0.symm.trans_ne h).symm

name: CharTwo'_of_map_two
statement:
theorem CharTwo'_of_map_two (hf : ReducedGood f)
    (h : f (-1) = 0) (h0 : f 2 = -1) : (2 : R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine hf.period_imp_zero λ x ↦ ?_
  rcases CommSubring.oneVarCommLiftDomain_exists hf.toNontrivialGood x with
    ⟨R', R'comm, φ, -, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, hρ, f', h1, hf'⟩
  rw [← map_ofNat φ 2, ← φ.map_add, h1, h1, CommCase.two_periodic_of_map_two hf']
  · refine map_even_of_map_one hf'.is_good (hρ ?_)
    rw [← h1, φ.map_neg, φ.map_one, h, ρ.map_zero]
  · apply hρ; rw [← h1, map_ofNat, h0, ρ.map_neg, ρ.map_one]

name: solution
statement:
theorem solution (hf : ReducedGood f) (h : f (-1) = 0) (h0 : f 2 ≠ -1) :
    (∃ (R' : Type u) (_ : CommRing R') (φ : R →+* R') (ι : SqSubring R' →+* S),
      ∀ x, f x = ι (RestrictedSq (φ x) - 1)) ∨
    (∃ φ : R →+* ℤ₄, ∀ x, f x = ℤ₄Map (φ x)) ∨
    (∃ φ : R →+* 𝔽₃, ∀ x, f x = 𝔽₃Map2 (φ x))
proof:
:=
  RGoodCase2.solution ⟨hf, map_even_of_map_one hf.is_good h, h0⟩

name: Eq1
statement: lemma Eq1 (x) : f (x * (x + 1) + 1) = f x * f (x + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf.is_good, add_add_cancel_left, hf.map_one, add_zero]

name: Eq2
statement: lemma Eq2 (x) : f (x * x + 1) = f x ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sq, hf.is_good, add_self_eq_zero, hf.map_zero, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Eq2_v2
statement: lemma Eq2_v2 (x) : f (x * x) = f (x + 1) ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Eq2 hf, add_one_mul_self, add_add_cancel_right]

name: Eq3
proof:
:= by
  have h : x * (x + 1) = x * x + x := mul_add_one x x
  rw [← Eq2_v2 hf, ← Eq1 hf, mul_sub_one, ← add_sub_right_comm, h, add_assoc,
    ← hf.is_good, mul_assoc, hf.is_good, h, add_add_cancel_middle₁, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Eq3_v2
statement:
lemma Eq3_v2 (x) : f (x + 1) * f (x * x + x) =
    (f x ^ 2 - 1) * (f x - 1) + f (x + 1) * f x
proof:
:= by
  have h := Eq3 hf (x + 1)
  rwa [add_add_cancel_right, add_one_mul_self, add_add_add_cancel_right] at h

name: Thm1_ring_id1
proof: := by ring

name: Thm1_ring_id2
proof: := by ring

name: Thm1
statement: theorem Thm1 (x) : f x ^ 2 + f (x + 1) ^ 2 = 1 ∨ f x + f (x + 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have h := Thm1_ring_id1 (f x) (f (x + 1))
  rw [← Eq3 hf, ← Eq3_v2 hf, mul_left_comm, sub_self, zero_eq_mul,
    mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h
  cases h with | inl h => exact h | inr h => ?_
  right
  
  rw [← h, ← two_mul]
  have h0 : _ ^ 2 = _ ^ 2 := congrArg (λ x ↦ x ^ 2) (Eq3 hf x)
  rw [mul_pow, ← add_eq_of_eq_sub (Eq2 hf (x * x + x)), ← h, add_mul_self,
    ← mul_add_one (x * x), Eq1 hf, Eq2 hf, Eq2_v2 hf, ← h,
    ← sub_eq_zero, ← sq, Thm1_ring_id2, mul_eq_zero] at h0
  cases h0 with | inl h0 => exact (eq_of_sub_eq_zero h0).symm | inr h0 => ?_
  
  have h1 : f (x * x) = 0 := by rw [Eq2_v2 hf, ← h, h0]
  replace h := Eq3_v2 hf (x * x)
  rw [h1, mul_zero, add_zero, sq, zero_mul, zero_sub,
    neg_mul_neg, one_mul, Eq2 hf, h0, zero_mul] at h
  rw [← mul_one (2 * f x), ← h, mul_zero]

name: SCharTwo_map_add_one
statement: theorem SCharTwo_map_add_one [CharTwo S] (x) : f (x + 1) = f x + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Thm1 hf x
  rwa [← CharTwo.add_sq, CharTwo.sq_eq_one_iff, or_self, add_eq_iff_eq_add''] at h

name: pow_four_Eq1
statement: lemma pow_four_Eq1 (x) : f ((x ^ 2) ^ 2) = (f x ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_add_cancel_right (x ^ 2) 1, add_one_sq, sq, sq, Eq2 hf, Eq2 hf]

name: pow_four_Eq2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_four_Eq1 hf, add_one_sq, add_one_sq]

name: SCharNeTwo_main_ring_id
proof: := by ring

name: SCharNeTwo_cases
statement:
theorem SCharNeTwo_cases (h : (2 : S) ≠ 0) (x) :
    (f x = 0 ∨ f (x + 1) = 0) ∨ (f x + f (x + 1) = 1 ∧ f x * f (x + 1) = -1)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 := pow_four_Eq2 hf (x * (x + 1))
  rw [Eq1 hf, mul_pow, mul_pow, add_one_sq, add_one_sq, Eq1 hf, pow_four_Eq1 hf,
    pow_four_Eq2 hf, ← sub_eq_zero, mul_pow, SCharNeTwo_main_ring_id, mul_eq_zero,
    or_iff_right h, mul_eq_zero, ← mul_pow, sq_eq_zero_iff] at h0
  revert h0; refine Or.imp mul_eq_zero.mp λ h0 ↦ ?_
  rw [sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at h0
  
  refine (Thm1 hf x).elim (λ h1 ↦ Not.elim h ?_) (λ h1 ↦ ⟨h1, ?_⟩)
  · rwa [h0, add_eq_right] at h1
  apply congrArg (λ y ↦ y ^ 2) at h1
  rw [one_pow, add_sq', h0, add_right_comm, add_eq_right,
     mul_assoc, ← mul_one_add (2 : S), mul_eq_zero] at h1
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right (h1.resolve_left h)

name: SCharTwo.solution
statement:
theorem SCharTwo.solution [CharTwo S] {f : R → S} (hf : NontrivialGood f) :
    ∃ φ : R →+* S, ∀ x, f x = φ (x - 1)
proof:
:=
  sub_one_solver hf λ x ↦ by
    rcases CommSubring.oneVarCommLiftDomain_exists hf x with
      ⟨R', R'comm, φ, hφ, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, hρ, f', h, hf'⟩
    have R'char := pullback_of_inj φ.toAddMonoidHom hφ
    have S'char := pullback_of_inj ρ.toAddMonoidHom hρ
    rw [h, ← φ.map_one, ← φ.map_add, h, ← ρ.map_one, ← ρ.map_add]
    exact ρ.congr_arg (CommCase.SCharTwo_map_add_one hf' x)

name: main_cases
statement:
lemma main_cases (x) :
    (f x = 0 ∨ f (x + 1) = 0) ∨ (f x + f (x + 1) = 1 ∧ f x * f (x + 1) = -1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases CommSubring.oneVarCommLiftDomain_exists hf x with
    ⟨R', R'comm, φ, hφ, ⟨x, rfl⟩, S', S'comm, S'nzd, ρ, -, f', h, hf'⟩
  have R'char := pullback_of_inj φ.toAddMonoidHom hφ
  have S'char : (2 : S') ≠ 0 := λ h1 ↦ hS <| by rw [← map_ofNat ρ 2, h1, ρ.map_zero]
  rw [h, ← φ.map_one, ← φ.map_add, h, ← ρ.map_zero]
  refine (CommCase.SCharNeTwo_cases hf' S'char x).imp
    (Or.imp ρ.congr_arg ρ.congr_arg) (And.imp (λ h0 ↦ ?_) (λ h0 ↦ ?_))
  · rw [← ρ.map_add, h0, ρ.map_one]
  · rw [← ρ.map_mul, h0, ρ.map_neg, ρ.map_one]

name: map_add_one_eq_zero_iff_map_eq
statement: lemma map_add_one_eq_zero_iff_map_eq {x} : f (x + 1) = 0 ↔ f x ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨λ h0 ↦ ?_, λ h0 ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h1 := Eq3_v2 hf x
    rw [h0, zero_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_eq_mul] at h1
    refine h1.elim eq_of_sub_eq_zero λ h1 ↦ ?_
    rw [eq_of_sub_eq_zero h1, one_pow]
  · rcases main_cases hS hf x with (h1 | h1) | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [h1, sq, zero_mul] at h0
      rw [← mul_one (f _), ← h0, mul_zero]
    · exact h1
    · apply congrArg (f x * ·) at h2
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← sq, h0, one_mul, mul_neg_one] at h2
      rw [h2, add_neg_cancel] at h1
      rw [← mul_one (f _), ← h1, mul_zero]

name: map_eq_neg_one_imp_map_add_one
statement: lemma map_eq_neg_one_imp_map_add_one {x} (h : f x = -1) : f (x + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  (map_add_one_eq_zero_iff_map_eq hS hf).mpr (h ▸ neg_one_sq)

name: Lem1
statement: lemma Lem1 : f (r * r) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Eq2_v2 hf, map_eq_neg_one_imp_map_add_one hS hf h, sq, zero_mul, zero_sub]

name: Lem2
statement: lemma Lem2 : f (r * r + r) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := Eq3 hf r
  rwa [map_eq_neg_one_imp_map_add_one hS hf h, mul_zero, add_zero,
    sq, mul_zero, zero_sub, mul_neg_one, h, neg_one_mul, neg_inj] at h0

name: Lem3
statement: lemma Lem3 (x) : f (r * x + 1) = f (r + x) - f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf.is_good, h, neg_one_mul, neg_add_eq_sub]

 omit [NoZeroDivisors S] hS in

name: Lem4
statement: lemma Lem4 {x} (h0 : ∃ y, x = r * y + 1) : f (r * r + x) = -f x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h0 with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [Lem3 hf h, ← add_assoc, ← mul_add, Lem3 hf h, add_add_cancel_left, neg_sub]

name: Lem5
statement:
lemma Lem5 {x} (h0 : ∃ y, x = r * r * y + 1) :
    f ((r * r + r) * (r * r + r) + x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h0 with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have h1 : Commute (r * r) r := mul_assoc r r r
  rw [add_mul_self_of_Commute h1, add_assoc, Lem4 hf (Lem1 hS hf h), Lem4 hf h, neg_neg]
  exacts [⟨r * x, by rw [mul_assoc]⟩, ⟨1 + x, by rw [← add_assoc, mul_one_add (r * r)]⟩]

name: Lem6
statement: lemma Lem6 : QuasiPeriodic f (r * r * (r + 1))
proof:
:=
  (QuasiPeriodic.iff_left2 hf).mpr λ x ↦ by
    
    have h0 : ∃ y, r * r * (r + 1) * x + 1 = r * r * y + 1 :=
      ⟨(r + 1) * x, by rw [← mul_assoc]⟩
    apply Lem5 hS hf h at h0
    
    have h1 : ∃ y, r * r * (r + 1) * x + 1 = (r * r + r) * y + 1 :=
      ⟨r * x, by rw [← mul_assoc, add_mul, mul_add_one (r * r)]⟩
    apply Lem4 hf (Lem2 hS hf h) at h1
    
    rw [h1, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, ← two_mul, mul_eq_zero] at h0
    exact h0.resolve_left hS

name: map_eq_neg_one_reduced_imp
statement: theorem map_eq_neg_one_reduced_imp (h : f r = -1) : r = 0
proof:
:= by
  let hf' := hf.toNontrivialGood
  
  have h0 : (r * r + r) * (r * r + r) = 0 := by
    refine (QuasiPeriodic.reduced_eq_zero_iff hf ?_).mpr
      (ReductionLemmas.Lem1 hS hf' (ReductionLemmas.Lem2 hS hf' h))
    have h0 : Commute (r * r) r := mul_assoc r r r
    rw [add_mul_self_of_Commute h0, ← mul_add_one (r * r), ← add_one_mul_self, ← mul_assoc]
    exact (ReductionLemmas.Lem6 hS hf' h).mul_right hf' (r + 1)
  
  replace h0 : r * r + r = 0 := by
    refine (QuasiPeriodic.reduced_eq_zero_iff hf <|
      (QuasiPeriodic.iff_left2 hf').mpr λ x ↦ ?_).mpr (ReductionLemmas.Lem2 hS hf' h)
    have h1 := ReductionLemmas.Lem4 hf' (ReductionLemmas.Lem2 hS hf' h) ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [h0, zero_add, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← two_mul, mul_eq_zero] at h1
    exact h1.resolve_left hS
  
  refine (QuasiPeriodic.reduced_eq_zero_iff hf <|
    (QuasiPeriodic.iff_left2 hf').mpr λ x ↦ ?_).mpr h
  have h1 := hf.is_good (r + 1) (r * (x - 1))
  rwa [map_eq_neg_one_imp_map_add_one hS hf' h, zero_mul, zero_add,
    ← mul_assoc, add_one_mul r, h0, zero_mul, zero_add, hf.map_one,
    ← add_rotate, ← mul_add_one r, sub_add_cancel, eq_comm] at h1

name: map_add_one_eq_zero_imp
statement: lemma map_add_one_eq_zero_imp (h : f (x + 1) = 0) : x * x = 0
proof:
:=
  map_eq_neg_one_reduced_imp hS hf <| by
    rw [Eq2_v2 hf.toNontrivialGood, h, sq, zero_mul, zero_sub]

name: reduced_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem reduced_eq_zero_iff : r = 0 ↔ f r = -1
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ h ▸ hf.map_zero, map_eq_neg_one_reduced_imp hS hf⟩

name: reduced_
statement: theorem reduced_𝔽₂ε_iff : r * r = 0 ↔ f (r + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [reduced_eq_zero_iff hS hf, Eq2_v2 hf.toNontrivialGood,
    sub_eq_neg_self, sq_eq_zero_iff]

name: reduced_
statement:
theorem reduced_𝔽₄_iff :
    r * (r + 1) + 1 = 0 ↔ (f r + f (r + 1) = 1 ∧ f r * f (r + 1) = -1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reduced_eq_zero_iff hS hf, Eq1 hf.toNontrivialGood, iff_and_self]
  intro h; refine (main_cases hS hf.toNontrivialGood r).elim (λ h0 ↦ ?_) And.left
  rw [← mul_eq_zero, h, neg_eq_zero] at h0
  rw [← mul_one (_ + _), h0, mul_zero]

name: R_elts_cases
statement:
theorem R_elts_cases (r : R) :
    ((r + 1) * (r + 1) = 0 ∨ r * r = 0) ∨ r * (r + 1) + 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [reduced_𝔽₂ε_iff hS hf, reduced_𝔽₂ε_iff hS hf,
    reduced_𝔽₄_iff hS hf, add_add_cancel_right]
  exact main_cases hS hf.toNontrivialGood r

name: R_elts_claim1
statement:
theorem R_elts_claim1 {r s : R} (hr : r * r = 0) (hs : s * s = 0) :
    r = 0 ∨ s = 0 ∨ r = s
proof:
:= by
  
  have h : (r * s) * (r * s) = 0 := by
    have h : (r + s) * (r + s) = r * s + s * r := by
      rw [add_mul, mul_add, hr, zero_add, mul_add, hs, add_zero]
    rcases R_elts_cases hS hf (r + s) with (h0 | h0) | h0
